spells.description_en: Shift into Bear Form and invoke the spirit of Ursol to let loose a deafening roar, incapacitating all enemies within 10 yards for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 变为熊形态并召唤乌索尔之魂，发出震耳的咆哮，使10码范围内的所有敌人瘫痪3秒。伤害可能解除该效果。

spells.description_en:
Charge to an enemy, dealing 7 Physical damage, rooting it for 1 sec.

Generates 20 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
向一名敌人冲锋，造成7点物理伤害，使其定身1秒。

产生20点怒气值。

spells.description_en: Targets in a cone in front of you take 183 Frost damage and have movement slowed by 50% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你前方锥形区域内的目标受到180点冰霜伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Fill the target with faith in the light, healing for 1,528 over 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 让目标满怀对圣光的信仰，在15秒内恢复1,528点生命值。

spells.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.
spells.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除1个有益魔法效果。

spells.description_en: Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 使40码范围内的小队和团队成员受到自身虔诚的激励，受到的伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.
spells.description_zh: 从一个友方目标身上移除所有诅咒。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage you take by 20% for 8 sec. Usable while stunned.
spells.description_zh: 使你受到的所有伤害降低20%，持续8秒。能够在昏迷中使用。

spells.description_en: Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.
spells.description_zh: 驱散敌方目标身上的魔法，移除1个增益魔法效果。

spells.description_en: Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 渐隐，移除你的所有威胁值并缩短敌人对你的侦测距离，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: A powerful prayer that heals your target and 4 injured allies within 40 yards for 2,220.
spells.description_zh: 强大的祷言，为你的目标及其周围40码内的4名受伤的盟友恢复2,225点生命值。

spells.description_en: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec. Does not work versus Demonic, Undead, or Mechanical beings. Shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.
spells.description_zh: 控制一个等级不高于你的等级+1的目标，持续30秒。对恶魔、亡灵或机械类生物无效。与其他迷惑类效果共享递减效果。

spells.description_en:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh:
治疗一个友方目标，数值相当于你的最大生命值的100%。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律效果，持续30秒。

spells.description_en:
Grants immunity to all damage, harmful effects, knockbacks and forced movement effects for 8 sec. 

Cannot be used if you have Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你对所有的伤害、有害效果、击退和强制移动效果免疫，持续8秒。

带有自律效果时无法使用。造成自律效果，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Banishes an enemy Demon, Aberration, or Elemental, preventing any action for 30 sec. Limit 1. Casting Banish again on the target will cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 放逐一个敌方恶魔、畸变怪或元素生物，使其无法行动，持续30秒。只能对一个目标使用。再次对目标施放放逐术会取消该效果。

spells.description_en:
Heals all allies within 40 yards for 19,810 over 5.4 sec. Healing decreased beyond 5 targets.

Roots form around you while channeling, absorbing up to 60% of your health in damage and preventing knockbacks.
spells.description_zh:
在5.4秒内为40码范围内的所有盟友恢复19,260点生命值。超过5个目标时治疗效果降低。

引导时根须缠绕周身，吸收相当于你生命值60%的伤害，并防止被击退。

spells.description_en: Wounds the target, causing 44 Physical damage instantly and an additional 74 Bleed damage over 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 重伤目标，立即造成43点物理伤害，并在随后的15秒内额外造成74点流血伤害。

spells.description_en: Heals the target for 1,925 over 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在12秒内为目标恢复1,925点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Strikes all enemies in front of you for 81 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

If you know Rend, inflicts Rend on all targets.
spells.description_zh:
横扫你面前的所有敌人，造成80点物理伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。

若你已习得撕裂，则对所有目标施加撕裂效果。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage you take by 40% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你受到的所有伤害降低40%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Protects the target with an earthen shield, increasing your healing on them by 20% and healing them for 325 when they take damage. This heal can only occur once every 3 sec. Maximum 9 charges.

Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman.
spells.description_zh:
用大地之盾保护目标，使你对其造成的治疗效果提高20%，在其受到伤害时为其恢复327点生命值。这个治疗效果每3秒只能触发一次。最多拥有9层充能。

同一时间只能在一个目标身上施放大地之盾。萨满祭司在同一时间只能激活一种元素护盾。

spells.description_en:
Inflicts increasing agony on the target, causing up to 2,854 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Damage starts low and increases over the duration. Refreshing Agony maintains its current damage level.

Agony damage sometimes generates 1 Soul Shard.
spells.description_zh:
使目标受到越来越深的痛楚，在18秒内造成最多2,854点暗影伤害。该伤害在初期较低，但随着持续时间会不断提高。在目标身上刷新痛楚时会保持其当前的伤害。

痛楚造成伤害有几率产生1块灵魂碎片。

spells.description_en:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫所有物理伤害和有害效果，持续10秒。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫任何移动限制效果，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Heals the friendly target for 893, then jumps up to 20 yards to heal the 3 most injured nearby allies. Healing is reduced by 30% with each jump.
spells.description_zh: 为友方目标恢复868点生命值，然后跳跃到最多20码范围内受伤最重的3名盟友进行治疗。治疗效果每跳一次就会降低30%。

spells.description_en:
Finishing move that causes Bleed damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 8 over 1 sec
   2 points: 12 over 2 sec
   3 points: 16 over 3 sec
   4 points: 20 over 3 sec
   5 points: 24 over 4 sec
spells.description_zh:
终结技，使目标持续受到流血伤害。连击点数越多，持续时间越长。

   1点：在1秒内造成8点伤害
   2点：在2秒内造成12点伤害
   3点：在3秒内造成16点伤害
   4点：在3秒内造成20点伤害
   5点：在4秒内造成24点伤害

spells.description_en:
Summons an Infernal from the Twisting Nether, impacting for 233 Fire damage and stunning all enemies in the area for 2 sec.

The Infernal will serve you for 30 sec, dealing 220 damage to all nearby enemies every 1.8 sec and generating 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec.
spells.description_zh:
从扭曲虚空召唤出地狱火，对坠落区域内的所有敌人造成227点火焰伤害，并使其昏迷2秒。

地狱火会在30秒内为你作战，每1.8秒对附近所有敌人造成216点伤害，并且每1秒就会产生1块灵魂碎片裂片。

spells.description_en: Demoralizes all enemies within 10 yards, reducing the damage they deal to you by 20% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使10码内的所有敌人士气下降，对你造成的伤害降低25%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only one beast can be feared at a time.
spells.description_zh: 恐吓一头野兽，使其因恐慌而逃跑，最多持续20秒。任何伤害都有可能打断这个效果。每个猎人在同一时间内只能恐吓一头野兽。

spells.description_en:
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
spells.description_zh:
强迫目标使用恶魔语，使其所有法术的施放时间延长30%，持续1分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

spells.description_en: Go berserk, increasing all Rage generation by 50% and granting your abilities 20% increased critical strike chance for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 变得狂暴，所有产生的怒气提高50%，并使你的技能的爆击几率提高20%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Must be in front of your target.

Awards 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh:
凿击敌方目标，令其瘫痪4秒。伤害可能打断此效果。

只能在目标的前方施放。

奖励1个连击点数。

spells.description_en:
Rake the target for 10 Bleed damage and an additional 57 Bleed damage over 15 sec.

Awards 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh:
斜掠目标，造成10点流血伤害，并在15秒内额外造成57点流血伤害。

奖励1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering stealth while in combat. For the first 3 sec after vanishing, damage and harmful effects received will not break stealth. Also breaks movement impairing effects.
spells.description_zh: 使你从敌人的视野中消失，在战斗中进入潜行模式。消失后的最初3秒内，受到伤害和有害效果影响都不会脱离潜行。同时解除一切移动限制效果。

spells.description_en: Performs an evasive maneuver, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 40% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 做出闪避动作，使你在6秒内因范围攻击而受到的伤害降低40%。

spells.description_en:
Perform a miracle, healing an ally for 8,013.

Cooldown reduced by 6 sec when you cast Flash Heal.
spells.description_zh:
施展神迹，为一名盟友恢复7,977点生命值。

你施放的快速治疗可以使该技能的冷却时间缩短6秒。

spells.description_en: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 使目标失明并迷惑地乱转，持续1分钟。任何伤害都可能打断此效果。只能对一个目标使用。

spells.description_en:
Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 1,456 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一根火柱，燃烧区域内的所有敌人，造成1,448点火焰伤害。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低

该法术对指定位置施放。

spells.description_en: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.
spells.description_zh: 使敌方目标沉睡，最多持续40秒，任何伤害都会唤醒被催眠的目标。在同一时间内只能强制使一个目标进入休眠状态，只对野兽和龙类有效。

spells.description_en: Nullifies corrupting effects on the friendly target, removing all Curse and Poison effects.
spells.description_zh: 抵消友方目标身上的腐蚀效果，移除所有诅咒和中毒效果。

spells.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy for 27 Nature damage over 12 sec. Subsequent poison applications will instantly deal 2 Nature damage.
spells.description_zh: 使用致命药膏给一件武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，并使其在12秒内受到27点自然伤害。随后产生的毒药效果将立即造成2点自然伤害。

spells.description_en:
Increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.

Allies receiving this effect will become Sated and unable to benefit from Bloodlust or Time Warp again for 10 min.
spells.description_zh:
使所有小队及团队成员的急速提高30%，持续40秒。

受到该效果影响的盟友将变得心满意足，在10分钟内无法再受到嗜血或时间扭曲效果的影响。

spells.description_en: Soothes the target, dispelling all enrage effects.
spells.description_zh: 安抚目标，驱散所有激怒效果。

spells.description_en:
Scorches an enemy for 415 Fire damage.

When cast on a target below 30% health, Scorch is a guaranteed critical strike.

Castable while moving.
spells.description_zh:
灼烧敌人，对其造成417点火焰伤害。

对生命值低于30%的目标施放时，灼烧必定爆击。

可在移动中施放。

spells.description_en: Run at high speed toward an ally, intercepting all melee and ranged attacks against them for 6 sec while they remain within 10 yds.
spells.description_zh: 高速冲向一位盟友，只要该盟友在10码范围内，就可以为该盟友拦截所有的近战和远程攻击，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 眩晕目标，使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Requires Clearcasting
Launches 5 waves of Arcane Missiles at the enemy over 2.2 sec, causing a total of 2,208 Arcane damage.
spells.description_zh:
需要节能施法
在2.2秒内向敌人射出5波奥术飞弹，对其造成总计2,240点奥术伤害。

spells.description_en: Invokes the spirit of Ursoc to stun the target for 4 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.
spells.description_zh: 召唤乌索克之魂使目标昏迷4秒。这个技能可以在所有形态下使用。

spells.description_en: Instantly restores 50 Energy, and increases the damage of all your attacks by 15% for their full duration. Lasts 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 立即恢复50点能量，并且使你所有攻击造成的伤害在其持续时间内提高15%。持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.
Damage may cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh:
使目标敌人因恐惧而畏缩，并使你8码范围内的所有敌人逃离你，敌人移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。
受到伤害可能取消该效果。

spells.description_en: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 躲闪几率提高100%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 145 Physical damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.
spells.description_zh: 尝试终结一名受伤的敌人，造成145点物理伤害。只能对生命值低于20%的敌人使用。

spells.description_en:
Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that heals an injured party or raid member within 40 yards for 259 every 1.8 sec.

If you already know Healing Stream Totem, instead gain 1 additional charge of Healing Stream Totem.
spells.description_zh:
在你的脚下召唤一个图腾，持续15秒。每1.8秒为40码范围内一名受伤的小队或团队成员恢复251点生命值。

如果你已经习得了治疗之泉图腾，则治疗之泉图腾会获得1次额外的使用次数。

spells.description_en: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 施放出恐怖的嚎叫，使附近10码内的5名敌人在恐惧中逃走，并使其陷入迷惑，持续20秒。受到伤害可能取消此效果。

spells.description_en:
Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing armor by 220% and Stamina by 25%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and increasing threat generation.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.
spells.description_zh:
变形进入熊形态，护甲值提高220%，耐力提高25%，免疫变形效果，并提高产生的威胁值。

变形可以解除施法者身上的移动限制效果。

spells.description_en:
Calls down a rain of hellfire the target location, dealing 1,814 Fire damage over 7.1 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
spells.description_zh:
地狱之火如雨般落在目标位置，在7.1秒内对范围内的敌人造成1,814点火焰伤害。

该法术对指定位置施放。

spells.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给一件武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其反应迟钝，攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

Awards 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh:
使用你的副手进行攻击，造成2点物理伤害，驱散所有激怒效果，并对目标施放浓缩形态的激活的非致命药膏。

奖励1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 82 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 震击8码范围内的所有敌人，造成82点物理伤害并使其移动速度降低20%，持续10秒。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Burns the enemy's soul, dealing 14,587 Fire damage and applying Immolate.

Generates 1 Soul Shard.
spells.description_zh:
灼烧敌人的灵魂，造成14,490点火焰伤害并施加献祭效果。

产生1块灵魂碎片。

spells.description_en: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 8 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
spells.description_zh: 朝目标区域腾空跃起，同时以毁灭性的力量重击地面，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成8点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Swing in a wide arc, dealing 98 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Your successful dodges, parries, and auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Revenge cost no Rage.
spells.description_zh:
横扫一个宽阔的弧面，对你面前的所有敌人造成99点物理伤害。目标数量超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

你成功进行躲闪、招架或自动攻击时，有几率使你的下一次复仇不消耗怒气。

spells.description_en: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 使敌方目标因恐惧而逃跑，瘫痪3秒，并为你恢复20%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Maul the target for 73 Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 重殴目标，造成74点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.

Last 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.
spells.description_zh:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其所受伤害降低30%，降低伤害的100%由你来承担。

持续12秒，或直到转移的伤害使你的生命值降至20%以下为止。

spells.description_en: Overpower the enemy, dealing 134 Physical damage. Cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
spells.description_zh: 压制敌人，造成132点物理伤害。无法被格挡、躲闪或招架。

spells.description_en: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 3,044 Nature damage.
spells.description_zh: 立即以震荡性的力量冲击目标，对其造成2,944点自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Blast the target's mind for 304 Shadow damage. Costs a high amount of mana.
spells.description_zh: 冲击目标的心灵，造成297点暗影伤害。消耗大量法力值。

spells.description_en: Lets out a psychic scream, causing all enemies within 8 yards to flee, disorienting them for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.
spells.description_zh: 发出心灵尖啸，令8码范围内的所有敌人逃跑，使其迷惑8秒。对目标造成的任何伤害都可能解除该效果。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at your feet that shakes the ground around it for 10 sec, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party and raid members within 30 yards.
spells.description_zh: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续10秒。该图腾会震动附近的地面，移除30码范围内所有小队和团队成员的恐惧、魅惑和睡眠效果。

spells.description_en: A quick beam of lunar light burns the enemy for 81 Arcane damage and then an additional 705 Arcane damage over 18 sec.
spells.description_zh: 一束月光灼烧敌人，造成80点奥术伤害，并在18秒内额外造成705点奥术伤害。

spells.description_en: Shackles an aberration or undead enemy for 50 sec, preventing all actions and movement. Damage will cancel the effect. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 束缚一个畸变怪或亡灵单位，持续50秒，使其无法移动或行动。受到伤害会取消此效果。仅限一个目标。

spells.description_en:
Infuses the target with power for 15 sec, increasing haste by 20%.

Can only be cast on players.
spells.description_zh:
将能量注入目标体内，使急速提高20%，持续15秒。

只能对玩家施放。

spells.description_en: The power of the Light compels an Undead, Aberration, or Demon target to flee for up to 40 sec. Damage may break the effect. Lesser creatures have a chance to be destroyed. Only one target can be turned at a time.
spells.description_zh: 圣光的力量迫使一个亡灵、畸变怪或恶魔目标逃跑，最多迷惑40秒。受到伤害后可能会打破这一效果。小型生物有几率被消灭。同一时间只能对一个目标施放。

spells.description_en: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 2,635 Fire damage.
spells.description_zh: 发射一颗巨大的烈焰巨石，造成2,707点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en:
Shields you with ice, absorbing 10,692 damage for 1 min.

Melee attacks against you reduce the attacker's movement speed by 50%.
spells.description_zh:
为你施加寒冰护盾，吸收10,692点伤害，持续1分钟。

对你进行近战攻击的攻击者的移动速度降低50%。

spells.description_en: Increases your mana regeneration by 1,500% for 2.7 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你的法力回复速度提高1,500%，持续2.7秒。

spells.description_en: A vicious strike that deals 181 Physical damage and reduces the effectiveness of healing on the target by 50% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 一次残忍的突袭，对目标造成185点物理伤害，并使其受到的治疗效果降低50%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Spurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh:
诱捕12码范围内的所有敌人，使其移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。

鼓舞6码范围内的所有盟友，使其移动速度提高30%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Calm your mind, sending you into a focused trance for 25 sec. Grants 20% haste, increases spell damage by 15%, and prevents damage from delaying your spellcasts.
spells.description_zh: 凝神静气，进入专注状态，持续25秒。获得20%急速，法术伤害提高15%，施法时免疫伤害导致的延长效果。

spells.description_en:
Whirlwind causes your next 4 single-target attacks to strike up to 4 additional targets for 65% damage.

Whirlwind generates an additional 1 Rage per target hit. Maximum 8 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
旋风斩会使你接下来的4个单目标攻击额外击中最多4个目标，造成65%的伤害。

旋风斩每击中一个目标会额外产生1点怒气值。最大8点怒气值。

spells.description_en: Increases maximum health by 30% for 8 sec and instantly heals you for that amount.
spells.description_zh: 使最大生命值提高30%，持续8秒，同时立即为你恢复等量的生命值。

spells.description_en: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 75%, your maximum Energy by 50, and your attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你的能量恢复速度提高75%，最大能量值提升50点，攻击速度提高20%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant a combo point.
spells.description_zh: 终结技每消耗一个连击点数，便有20%几率获得一个额外的连击点数。

spells.description_en: Critical strikes with attacks that generate combo points grant an additional combo point per critical strike.
spells.description_zh: 产生连击点数的攻击造成爆击时，每次爆击额外获得一个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Consumes the enemy in Holy flames that cause 1,183 Holy damage and an additional 421 Holy damage over 7 sec.
spells.description_zh: 神圣的烈焰吞噬敌人，对其造成1,159点神圣伤害，并在7秒内造成421点额外的神圣伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的能量值上限提高50点，能量回复加快5%。

spells.description_en: Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy for 12 sec, causing you to heal a nearby ally for 40% of any single-target Shadow spell damage you deal.
spells.description_zh: 一股暗影能量充满你的全身，持续12秒，使你的任意单体暗影法术造成伤害后，将对附近的一名盟友进行治疗，数值相当于伤害值的40%。

spells.description_en: Casting Lava Burst increases the damage or healing of your next Nature, Physical, or Frost spell by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 施放熔岩爆裂使你下一次自然、物理或冰霜法术的伤害或治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at your feet for 8 sec, granting 80% increased mana regeneration to allies within 40 yards.
spells.description_zh: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续8秒，使40码范围内的盟友的法力恢复速度提高80%。

spells.description_en: Your direct heal criticals refund a percentage of your maximum mana: 0.80% from Healing Wave, 0.48% from Riptide, and 0.20% from Chain Heal.
spells.description_zh: 你的直接治疗法术所造成的爆击会为你恢复一定比例的最大法力值：治疗波恢复0.80%，激流恢复0.48%，治疗链恢复0.20%。

spells.description_en: Your auto attacks have a chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Shred or Swipe cost no Energy.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击有几率触发节能施法，使你的下一个撕碎或横扫不消耗能量。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的所有伤害降低4%。

spells.description_en:
Blasts a target for 1,890 Shadowflame damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

Restores 1 Soul Shard and removes its cooldown if the target dies within 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
冲击目标，造成1,874点暗影烈焰伤害，仅可对生命值低于20%的敌人使用。

如果目标在5秒内死亡，则恢复1块灵魂碎片并重置其冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Triggers an explosion on the target, dealing 1,371 Fire damage.

Generates 5 Soul Shard Fragments.
spells.description_zh:
在目标身上引发爆炸，造成1,366点火焰伤害。

生成5块灵魂碎片裂片。

spells.description_en: Consume a Regrowth, Wild Growth, or Rejuvenation effect to instantly heal an ally for 4,028. Healing is increased by 40% of the consumed heal over time effect.
spells.description_zh: 吞噬一个愈合、野性成长或回春术效果，立即为一名盟友恢复3,893点生命值。治疗效果提高，数值相当于被吞噬的持续治疗效果剩余总量的40%。

spells.description_en: Increases maximum health by 25% for 10 sec, and instantly heals you for that amount.
spells.description_zh: 使最大生命值提高25%，持续10秒，同时立即为你恢复等量的生命值。

spells.description_en: A powerful aimed shot that deals 341 Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 强大的瞄准射击，造成339点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: Sends you and your pet into a rage, instantly dealing 280 Physical damage to its target, and increasing all damage you both deal by 20% for 15 sec. Removes all crowd control effects from your pet.
spells.description_zh: 使你和你的宠物进入狂怒状态，立即对宠物的目标造成280点物理伤害，你和宠物造成的所有伤害提高20%，持续15秒。移除你的宠物受到的所有控制效果。

spells.description_en: Commands your pet to intimidate the target stunning your target for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 命令你的宠物胁迫目标，使其昏迷5秒。

spells.description_en: Removes 1 Enrage and 1 Magic effect from an enemy target.
spells.description_zh: 从一个敌方目标身上移除1个激怒效果和1个魔法效果。

spells.description_en:
Triggers a burst of Light on the target, dealing 815 Holy damage to an enemy, or 4,250 healing to an ally.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
在目标身上引发圣光爆发，对一名敌人造成810点神圣伤害，或为一个盟友恢复4,259点生命值。

产生1层神圣能量。

spells.description_en: Increases your attack power by 38 for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 攻击强度提高38，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Finishing move that causes Physical damage and stuns the target. Damage and duration increased per combo point:

   1 point  : 5 damage, 1 sec
   2 points: 10 damage, 2 sec
   3 points: 15 damage, 3 sec
   4 points: 20 damage, 4 sec
   5 points: 25 damage, 5 sec
spells.description_zh:
终结技，造成物理伤害并使目标昏迷。根据连击点数决定伤害量和昏迷持续时间：

   1点：5点伤害，1秒
   2点：10点伤害，2秒
   3点：15点伤害，3秒
   4点：20点伤害，4秒
   5点：25点伤害，5秒

spells.description_en:
Your skin becomes as tough as bark, reducing all damage you take by 20% and preventing damage from delaying your spellcasts. Lasts 8 sec.

Usable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared, or asleep, and in all shapeshift forms.
spells.description_zh:
你的皮肤变得如树皮般坚硬，受到的所有伤害降低20%，受到伤害也不会延迟施法。持续8秒。

这个法术可以在昏迷、冰冻、瘫痪、恐惧或沉睡时使用。可在所有形态下使用。

spells.description_en: Heals you for 32% health over 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在3秒内为你恢复32%的生命值。

spells.description_en:
Assault the target in a bloodthirsty craze, dealing 147 Physical damage and restoring 3% of your health.

Generates 8 Rage and has a 30% chance to Enrage you.
spells.description_zh:
在嗜血的狂乱中攻击目标，造成149点物理伤害，并为你恢复3%的生命值。

产生8点怒气，并且有30%几率使你进入激怒状态。

spells.description_en: Raise your weapon, reflecting the first spell cast on you and reducing magic damage you take by 20% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 举起你的武器，反射第一个对你施放的法术，同时使你受到的魔法伤害降低20%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing the damage of your spells by 10% and your armor by 125%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.
spells.description_zh:
变形进入枭兽形态，使你的法术伤害提高10%，护甲值提高125%，并免疫变形效果。

变形可以解除你身上的移动限制效果。

spells.description_en: Increases your haste by 10% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高10%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Consecrates the land beneath you, causing 25 Holy damage over 12 sec to enemies who enter the area. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 将圣洁的能量灌入你脚下的土地，在12秒内对进入该区域的敌人造成26点神圣伤害。最多可留下1片奉献。

spells.description_en:
Embeds a demon seed in the enemy target that will explode after 10.7 sec, dealing 894 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards and applying Corruption to them. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

The seed will detonate early if the target is hit by other detonations, or takes 190 damage from your spells.
spells.description_zh:
将恶魔之种嵌入敌人身体，10.7秒后爆炸，对10码范围内所有施法者的敌人造成903点暗影伤害，并对其施放腐蚀术。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

如果目标被其他腐蚀之种的爆炸击中，或从你的法术中受到190点伤害，则会提前引爆。

spells.description_en: Infuse a friendly healer with energy, causing them to regenerate 25% of their maximum mana over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 向一名友善的治疗者注入能量，使其在8秒内恢复25%的最大法力值。

spells.description_en: Your attacks have a chance to make your next Execute cost no Rage, be usable on any target regardless of their health, and deal damage as if you spent 40 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 你的攻击有一定几率使你的下一个斩杀不消耗怒气，可无视生命值高低对任意目标施放，并造成相当于你消耗40点怒气时的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Restores 6% health every 1 sec when you have not taken damage for 5 sec.

Restores 2% health every 1 sec while you are below 35% health. The amount restored increases the closer you are to death.
spells.description_zh:
当你在5秒以内没有受到任何伤害时，每1秒恢复6%的生命值。

当你的生命值降至35%以下时，每1秒恢复2%的生命值。生命值越低，恢复量越高。

spells.description_en: Summons a Felguard under your command as a powerful melee combatant.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一个恶魔卫士为你作战，恶魔卫士是强大的近战斗士。

spells.description_en: Stuns all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使8码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续3秒。

spells.description_en: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.
spells.description_zh: 从目标身上窃取一个增益魔法效果。此效果最多持续2分钟。

spells.description_en:
Quickly fling a shard of ice at the target, dealing 781 Frost damage.

Shatters 4 stacks of Freezing.
spells.description_zh:
迅速向目标发射一枚寒冰碎片，造成789点冰霜伤害。

粉碎4层冻结效果。

spells.description_en: When your health is brought below 35%, you instantly heal for 40% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你的生命值降低到35%以下时，立即为你恢复40%的最大生命值。每45秒最多触发一次。

spells.description_en: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 提供短暂的魔法免疫，并立即移除所有的有害法术效果。斗篷激活期间，抵抗所有有害法术效果，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Fatal attacks instead reduce you to 7% of your maximum health. For 3 sec afterward, you take 85% reduced damage. Cannot trigger more often than once per 6 min.
spells.description_zh: 原本致命的攻击转而使你的生命值降到最大生命值的7%。之后的3秒内，你受到的伤害降低85%。该效果每6分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Enemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take 283 Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 你面前12码锥形区域内的敌人受到281点火焰伤害并陷入迷惑状态，持续4秒。受到伤害会移除此效果。

spells.description_en: Summons a Water Elemental to follow and fight for you.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一个水元素来跟随你并为你作战。

spells.description_en:
Empowers your chosen aura for 8 sec.

Devotion Aura: Damage reduction increased to 12%.

Crusader Aura: Mount speed bonus increased to 60%.

Concentration Aura: Affected allies immune to interrupts and silences.
spells.description_zh:
强化你选择的光环，持续8秒。

虔诚光环：伤害减免提高至12%。

十字军光环：骑乘速度加成提高至60%。

专注光环：受影响的盟友免疫打断和沉默效果。

spells.description_en:
Reduces all damage you take by 30% for 12 sec.

While Ardent Defender is active, the next attack that would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 20% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh:
你承受的所有伤害降低30%，持续12秒。

炽热防御者激活时，下一次原本会杀死你的攻击反而会治疗你，使你获得20%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 20% for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤圣光之力，成为惩戒的化身，你的伤害、治疗效果和爆击几率提高20%，持续20秒。

spells.description_en: Hurls your shield at an enemy target, dealing 70 Holy damage, interrupting and silencing the non-Player target for 3 sec, and then jumping to 2 additional nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 将你的盾牌扔向一名敌方目标，造成70点神圣伤害，打断非玩家目标施法并使其沉默3秒，接着跳转攻击附近额外的2个敌人。

spells.description_en: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing all harmful Magic from 5 friendly targets and 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemy targets. Potent enough to remove Magic that is normally undispellable.
spells.description_zh: 驱散半径15码范围内的魔法，从5个友方目标身上移除全部的有害魔法效果，并从5个敌方目标身上移除1个有益魔法效果。这种驱散法术非常强大，可以移除通常无法被驱散的魔法效果。

spells.description_en:
A word of dark binding that inflicts 324 Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health.

Damage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health.
spells.description_zh:
黑暗的咒语，对目标造成328点暗影伤害。如果目标没有被暗言术：灭消灭，则你会受到相当于最大生命值5%的反噬伤害。

对生命值低于20%的目标造成的伤害提高150%。

spells.description_en: Places a ward on an ally that heals them for 280 the next time they take damage, and then jumps to another ally within 30 yds. Jumps up to 4 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump.
spells.description_zh: 为一名盟友施加结界，使其在下一次受到伤害时恢复282点生命值，触发之后会跳转到30码范围内的另一名盟友身上。最多可转移4次，每次转移后在目标身上持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by a friendly target by 40% for 8 sec. Castable while stunned.
spells.description_zh: 使一个友方目标受到的所有伤害降低40%，持续8秒。昏迷时仍可施放。

spells.description_en: Imbue your main-hand weapon with the element of Wind for 1 hour. Each main-hand attack has a 15% chance to trigger two extra attacks, dealing 9 Physical damage each.
spells.description_zh: 将风元素灌注进你的主手武器之中，持续1小时。每次主手武器攻击都有15%的几率触发两次额外攻击，每次造成9点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Heals the target for 1,715 over 15 sec. When Lifebloom expires, is dispelled, or is refreshed near expiration the target is instantly healed for 817.

May be active on one target at a time.
spells.description_zh:
在15秒内为目标恢复1,715点生命值。当生命绽放效果结束、被驱散或在快结束时被刷新，会立即为目标恢复832点生命值。

同一时间可以在一个目标身上激活。

spells.description_en: Tosses the enemy target into the air, disorienting them but making them invulnerable for up to 5 sec. Only one target can be affected by your Cyclone at a time.
spells.description_zh: 将敌方目标吹上天空，使其迷惑，但也无法被攻击，最多持续5秒。德鲁伊在同一时间内只能对一个目标使用旋风。

spells.description_en: Magical damage and healing increased by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 法术伤害和治疗效果提高6%。

spells.description_en:
Shapeshift into the Tree of Life, instantly Regrowthing 3 nearby injured allies, increasing healing done by 10%, increasing armor by 120%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects. Functionality of Rejuvenation, Wild Growth, Regrowth, Entangling Roots, and Wrath is enhanced.

Lasts 30 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this form for its duration.
spells.description_zh:
进入生命之树形态，立即对附近3个受伤的盟友施放愈合，治疗效果提高10%，护甲值提高120%，并免疫变形效果。得到强化的法术：回春术、野性成长、愈合、纠缠根须和愤怒。

持续30秒。你可以在持续期间在其他形态与生命之树之间切换。

spells.description_en: Give the command to kill, causing your pet to charge your target and savagely deal 86 Physical damage to the enemy.
spells.description_zh: 发出杀戮命令，使你的宠物立即向目标冲锋对其进行狂野撕咬，造成86点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Shadow Word: Death has a 40% chance to summon a Shadowfiend for 5 sec when damaging targets below 20% health.

 Shadowfiend
Summons a Shadowfiend to attack your target for 5 sec.

Generates 0.5% mana each time the Shadowfiend attacks.
spells.description_zh:
暗言术：灭对生命值低于20%的目标造成伤害时有40%的几率召唤一个暗影魔，持续5秒。

暗影魔
召唤一个暗影魔攻击目标，持续5秒。

暗影魔每次攻击产生0.5%的法力值。

spells.description_en: Misdirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next attack within 30 sec and lasting for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在30秒内，你接下来造成的所有威胁值会误导给指定的小队或团队成员，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Releases miraculous light at a target location, healing up to 5 allies within 10 yds for 2,305.

Cooldown reduced by 6 sec when you cast Prayer of Healing.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置释放一道奇迹之光，为目标周围10码范围内最多5名盟友恢复2,336点生命值。

施放治疗祷言会使冷却时间缩短6秒。

spells.description_en: Your off-hand attacks and Pistol Shots have a 25% chance to generate 8 Energy.
spells.description_zh: 你的副手攻击和手枪射击有25%的几率产生8点能量。

spells.description_en:
Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies.

 Death Orders
Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing 11 Shadow damage to your target.

 Epidemic Orders
Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing 2 Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
召唤或强化次级食尸鬼，组成一支由8名成员组成的亡者大军，持续30秒。激活时，召唤次级食尸鬼会改为根据附近敌人执行命令。

死亡命令
次级食尸鬼与你一同攻击，对目标造成11点暗影伤害。

疫病命令
次级食尸鬼爆裂出内脏，对附近敌人造成2点暗影伤害。超过5个目标时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Unleash a flurry of ice, striking the target 3 times for a total of 1,627 Frost damage.

Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.
spells.description_zh:
释放寒冰风暴，打击敌人3次，总共造成1,615点冰霜伤害。

施加3层冻结效果。

spells.description_en:
Encases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh:
一道寒冰屏障笼罩了你，使你在10秒内不会受到任何伤害，但是在这期间你也无法攻击、移动或施法。

引发低温效果，在30秒内不能再次施放寒冰屏障。

spells.description_en: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一个食尸鬼为你作战。你一次最多只能召唤一个食尸鬼。持续1分钟。

spells.description_en: Sends a wave of force in a frontal cone, causing 7 damage and stunning all enemies within 10 yards for 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 向前方锥形区域释放一道能量波，造成6点伤害，并使10码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续2秒。

spells.description_en: Direct critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 30% of the amount healed. Lasts 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 直接爆击治疗将为目标附加一层护盾，可吸收相当于该次治疗量30%的伤害，护盾持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 以极寒的能量攻击目标的心智，打断目标施法，并且使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。

spells.description_en: Drain the will of your enemy to empower your rune weapon, dealing 91 Shadowfrost damage and reduced damage to enemies nearby, gaining 40 Runic Power, and grants you Killing Machine.
spells.description_zh: 汲取敌人的意志来强化你的符文武器，对目标造成91点暗影冰霜伤害，对附近敌人造成较少伤害，获得40点符文能量，并获得杀戮机器效果。

spells.description_en:
Disperse into pure shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 75% for 6 sec and healing you for 25% of your maximum health over its duration, but you are unable to attack or cast spells.

Increases movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to all movement impairing effects.

Castable while stunned, feared, or silenced.
spells.description_zh:
化为纯粹的暗影能量，受到的所有伤害降低75%，持续6秒，在此期间恢复25%的最大生命值，但无法攻击或施放法术。

移动速度提高50%，并使你免疫所有移动限制效果。

可以在昏迷、恐惧或沉默状态下施放。

spells.description_en:
Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target for 10 sec, increasing healing received by 60%. If the target would die, the Spirit sacrifices itself and restores the target to 40% health.

Castable while stunned. Cannot save the target from massive damage.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个守护之魂来看护友方目标，持续10秒，使目标受到的治疗效果提高60%。如果目标死亡，守护之魂会牺牲自己来使目标恢复40%的生命值。

可以在昏迷时施放。目标如果受到极高伤害，此效果也无法救活目标。

spells.description_en:
A ghostly soul haunts a single target, dealing 2,715 Shadow damage and increasing your damage dealt to the target by 16% for 18 sec.

If the target dies, Haunt's cooldown is reset.
spells.description_zh:
鬼魂纠缠一个目标，造成2,744点暗影伤害，并使你对该目标造成的伤害提高16%，持续18秒。

如果目标死亡，重置鬼影缠身的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Stamina increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 耐力提高20%。

spells.description_en:
For 10 sec, your movement speed is increased by 35%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.

Passive: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal speed.
spells.description_zh:
你的移动速度提高35%，且无法被降低到正常速度的100%以下，持续10秒。在此期间，你对强制移动效果和击退效果免疫。

被动：你的移动速度无法被降低到正常速度的70%以下。

spells.description_en: Heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 1,434 over 7 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.
spells.description_zh: 治疗目标周围30码范围内最多5个受伤的盟友，为其在7秒内恢复1,434点生命值。初始治疗量较高并随着时间的流逝逐步降低。

spells.description_en: Rake damage increased by 30%, and Rake causes an Infected Wound in the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 20% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 斜掠的伤害提高30%，而且会对目标施加感染伤口效果，使目标的移动速度降低20%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell for 5 sec, absorbing up to 9,165 magic damage and preventing application of harmful magical effects. Damage absorbed generates Runic Power.
spells.description_zh: 用反魔法护盾将你包围，持续5秒，吸收最多9,165点魔法伤害，并免疫有害的魔法效果。吸收的伤害将产生符文能量。

spells.description_en: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 制造死亡契约，为你恢复50%的最大生命值，但会吸收治疗效果，数值相当于最大生命值的30%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冻结自己的血液，对昏迷效果免疫，受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: A brutal attack that deals 32 Physical and 32 Frost damage.
spells.description_zh: 一次凶蛮打击，造成32点物理伤害和32点冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en:
Summons a rune weapon for 8 sec that mirrors your melee attacks and bolsters your defenses.

While active, you gain 30% parry chance.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一把符文武器，复制你的近战攻击，并强化你的防御，持续8秒。

激活时，你的招架几率提高30%。

spells.description_en: Draw upon unholy energy to become Undead for 10 sec, increasing Leech by 6% and making you immune to Charm, Fear, and Sleep.
spells.description_zh: 抽取邪恶能量变成一个亡灵，使吸血效果提高6%，并免疫魅惑、恐惧和沉睡，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Chill your weapon with icy power and quickly strike the enemy, dealing 58 Frost damage.
spells.description_zh: 使用寒冰之力附魔你的武器并快速打击敌人，造成58点冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en:
Blast the target with a frigid wind, dealing 15 Frost damage to that foe, and reduced damage to all other enemies within 10 yards, infecting all targets with Frost Fever.

 Frost Fever
A disease that deals 117 Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.
spells.description_zh:
以刺骨的寒风冲击目标，对目标造成15点冰霜伤害，对10码内的所有其他敌人造成较低的伤害，并使所有目标感染冰霜疫病。

 冰霜疫病
疾病效果，在24秒内造成117点冰霜伤害，每次造成伤害时有几率使死亡骑士获得4点符文能量。

spells.description_en: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 恐惧瘟疫有35%几率使你心智亢奋，使你的下一个凋零缠绕或扩散减少15点符文能量消耗，伤害提高35%。

spells.description_en: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 53 Physical damage and heals you for 20.00% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 将黑暗的力量灌注到武器中，造成54点物理伤害，并为你恢复之前5秒内所受伤害的20.00%，至少恢复7.0%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Go berserk for 15 sec, reducing the cooldowns of Mangle, Thrash, and Growl by 50% and the cooldown of Frenzied Regeneration by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 进入狂暴状态，持续15秒，使裂伤、痛击和低吼的冷却时间缩短50%，狂暴回复的冷却时间缩短100%。

spells.description_en: You become a whirling storm of destructive force, striking all nearby targets with your main hand weapon for 94 Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 你化身为充满毁灭力量的旋风，使用你的主手武器攻击附近所有的目标，造成93点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Deals 57 Shadow damage and infects all enemies within 10 yds with Blood Plague.

 Blood Plague
A shadowy disease that drains 93 health from the target over 24 sec.
spells.description_zh:
造成57点暗影伤害，并使10码范围内的所有敌人感染血之疫病。

 血之疫病
暗影疾病效果，在24秒内从目标身上吸取93点生命值。

spells.description_en: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 制造一个反魔法领域，持续6秒，使小队或团队成员受到的魔法伤害降低15%。

spells.description_en: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to make your next Obliterate deal Frost damage and critically strike, or make your next Frostscythe critically strike for 4 times the normal damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击爆击时有一定几率使你的下一个湮灭造成冰霜伤害且必定暴击，或使下一次冰霜之镰必定暴击且造成4倍的普通伤害。

spells.description_en: The power of frost increases your Strength by 20% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜的能量使你的力量提高20%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 20 sec. The totem pulses every 2 sec, rooting all enemies within 8 yards for 8 sec. Enemies previously rooted by the totem instead suffer 50% movement speed reduction.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续20秒。该图腾每2秒作用一次，使8码范围内的所有敌人定身，持续8秒。已经受其影响的敌人不会再被图腾定身，但移动速度降低50%。

spells.description_en: Hurls molten lava at the target, dealing 684 Fire damage. Lava Burst will always critically strike if the target is affected by Flame Shock and its damage is increased by your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 向目标投掷炽热的岩浆，造成684点火焰伤害。如果目标受到烈焰震击的影响，熔岩爆裂将必定爆击，其伤害随你的爆击几率提高。

spells.description_en: Transforms the enemy into a frog for 1 min. While hexed, the victim is incapacitated, and cannot attack or cast spells. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.
spells.description_zh: 将敌人变成一只青蛙，持续1分钟。受妖术影响期间目标将瘫痪，不能攻击或施法。任何伤害都有可能打断该效果。只能影响一个目标。只能对人型生物和野兽使用。

spells.description_en:
Summons two Spirit Wolves that aid you in battle for 15 sec. They are immune to movement-impairing effects, and each Feral Spirit summoned grants you 15% increased Physical damage dealt by your abilities.

Feral Spirit generates one stack of Maelstrom Weapon immediately, and one stack every 3 sec for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh:
召唤两只幽灵狼为你作战，持续15秒。它们对移动限制效果免疫，而且每个召唤的野性狼魂会使你的技能造成的物理伤害提高15%。

野性狼魂会立即使你获得一层漩涡武器效果，之后每3秒产生一层，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Casting Riptide grants 1 stack of Tidal Waves. Tidal Waves reduces the cast time of your next Healing Wave or Chain Heal by 20%.

Can accumulate up to 2 stacks.
spells.description_zh:
施放激流会获得1层潮汐奔涌。潮汐奔涌使你的下一个治疗波或治疗链的施法时间缩短20%。

最多可积攒2层。

spells.description_en:
Finishing move that unleashes a barrage of gunfire, striking random enemies within 8 yards for Physical damage. Number of strikes increased per combo point.

Restores 1 combo point every 0.45 sec. Each combo point spent above 5 increases damage by 15%.

   1 point  : 316 over 0.45 sec
   2 points: 474 over 0.89 sec
   3 points: 633 over 1.34 sec
   4 points: 791 over 1.78 sec
   5 points: 949 over 2.23 sec
spells.description_zh:
终结技，以枪林弹雨打击8码内的随机敌人，造成物理伤害。连击点数会提高打击次数。

每0.45秒恢复1个连击点数。如果消耗的连击点数超过5个，每多消耗一个连击点数便使伤害提高15%。

   1点：0.45秒内315点伤害
   2点：0.89秒内473点伤害
   3点：1.34秒内630点伤害
   4点：1.78秒内788点伤害
   5点：2.23秒内945点伤害

spells.description_en: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.
spells.description_zh: 移除一个友方目标身上所有诅咒效果。

spells.description_en: You attempt to finish off a wounded target, dealing 367 Physical damage. Only usable on enemies with less than 20% health.
spells.description_zh: 你尝试终结一个受伤的目标，造成369点物理伤害。只能对生命值低于20%的敌人使用。

spells.description_en: Avenging Wrath and Avenging Crusader have 25% increased duration.
spells.description_zh: 复仇之怒和复仇十字军的持续时间延长25%。

spells.description_en:
Unleashes a whirl of divine energy, dealing 91 Holy damage to all nearby enemies. 

Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
释放神圣能量的旋风，对附近所有敌人造成93点神圣伤害。

目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Instructs your pet to protect a friendly target, reducing their damage taken by 15%, but 50% of all damage taken by that target is transferred to your pet. 

Lasts 10 sec or until your pet's health drops below 25%.
spells.description_zh:
命令你的宠物保护一名盟友，使其受到的伤害降低15%，但受保护目标受到伤害的50%会转移给你的宠物。

持续10秒，或直到你宠物的生命值低于25%。

spells.description_en:
Your Holy Shocks have a 10% chance to empower your next spell cast:

Flash of Light: healing increased by 200% and becomes instant cast.
Judgment: Greater Judgment prevents an additional 150% damage dealt by the target and generates 1 additional Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
你的神圣震击有10%几率强化你的下一个法术：

圣光闪现：治疗效果提高200%并变为瞬发。
审判：强效审判抵挡目标的伤害提高150%并额外产生1层神圣能量。

spells.description_en:
Hammers the current target for 70 Physical damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
锤击当前目标，造成69点物理伤害。

产生1层神圣能量。

spells.description_en: Slams enemies in front of you with your shield, causing 33 Holy damage, and increasing your Armor by 608 for 4.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 用盾牌猛击你前方的敌人，造成33点神圣伤害，并使你的护甲值提高608，持续4.5秒。

spells.description_en:
An unholy strike that deals 47 Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.

Applies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.
spells.description_zh:
一次邪恶的打击，造成46点暗影伤害，并引爆目标身上的瘟疫，以35%效果额外爆发一次伤害。

施放恶性瘟疫，或将其传播至附近的一名敌人。

spells.description_en: Embrace your undeath, increasing your maximum health by 30% and increasing all healing and absorbs received by 30% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 殷切地接受不死的生命，使你的最大生命值提高30%，受到的所有治疗和吸收效果提高30%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.

Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.
spells.description_zh:
在你身边召唤3个持续15秒的镜像，可以施放法术并攻击你的敌人。镜像激活期间，你产生的仇恨值大幅降低。

受到直接伤害将导致你的一个镜像消散。

spells.description_en: Psychic Scream causes enemies to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.
spells.description_zh: 心灵尖啸不再使敌人因恐惧而逃跑，而是在原地颤栗。

spells.description_en: Your Fear causes the target to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.
spells.description_zh: 你的恐惧术将使受影响的目标在原地战栗而不是仓惶地逃跑。

spells.description_en: Your Flurry and Frostbolt spells strike 1 additional target at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 你的冰风暴和寒冰箭法术会以50%的效果额外击中1个目标。

spells.description_en: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 从30秒内的下一次伤害性攻击开始，将你产生的所有威胁值转移给选中的小队或团队成员，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 以强风冲击干扰目标的专注，打断施法并使其在4秒内无法施放该系的法术。

spells.description_en: Your finishing moves generate 4 Energy per combo point spent.
spells.description_zh: 你的终结技每消耗一个连击点数，就产生4点能量。

spells.description_en: Removes all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 60% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 移除所有的移动限制效果，并使你的移动速度提高60%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Any threat is restored versus enemies still in combat upon cancellation of this effect.
spells.description_zh: 激活之后遁入阴影，降低敌人侦测到你的几率。持续直到取消或进行移动。取消这个效果之后，你对任何仍在战斗中的敌人造成的威胁值将恢复。

spells.description_en:
Charges your off-hand weapon with lava and burns your target, dealing 4 Fire damage.

Damage is increased by 100% if your offhand weapon is imbued with Flametongue Weapon.
spells.description_zh:
你将熔岩的能量注入到副手武器中，燃烧目标，造成4点火焰伤害。

如果你的副手武器已经受到火舌武器影响，伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Your damaging critical strikes deal 250% damage instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh: 你的伤害技能爆击会造成250%的伤害，而非通常的200%。

spells.description_en: Restorative waters wash over a friendly target, healing them for 2,329 and an additional 2,036 over 18 sec.
spells.description_zh: 恢复之水洗刷一名友方目标，为其恢复2,310点生命值，并在18秒内额外恢复2,036点生命值。

spells.description_en: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 16%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的能量值恢复速度提高16%。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage you take by 50% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你受到的所有伤害降低50%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Causes the earth within 8 yards of the target location to tremble and break, dealing 1,448 Nature damage over 6 sec and has a 5% chance to knock the enemy down. Multiple uses of Earthquake may overlap.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
spells.description_zh:
使目标位置8码范围内的大地分崩离析，在6秒内造成1,430点自然伤害，并有5%的几率击倒敌人。多次使用地震术可以叠加。

该法术对指定位置施放。

spells.description_en: Summons a holy barrier to protect all allies at the target location for 10 sec, reducing all damage taken by 20% and preventing damage from delaying spellcasting.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一道神圣的屏障，保护指定位置的所有盟友，持续10秒，使其受到的所有伤害降低20%。处于屏障中的角色的不会因受到伤害而延长施法时间。

spells.description_en: Power Word: Shield and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：盾和信仰之跃使目标的移动速度提高40%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy,  removing any magical immunities and causing 211 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
spells.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，移除魔法免疫效果并造成208点无视护甲的物理伤害。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Heals all party or raid members within 40 yards for 10,503 over 4.5 sec. Each heal increases all targets' healing taken by 4% for 15 sec, stacking.

You gain Guardian Spirit while channeling Divine Hymn.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
在4.5秒内为40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员恢复10,628点生命值。每次治疗都会使所有目标受到的治疗提高4%，持续15秒，此效果可叠加。

在引导神圣赞美诗期间，你获得守护之魂。

目标超过5个时治疗效果降低。

spells.description_en: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, instantly moving them directly in front of you.
spells.description_zh: 拉拽一名小队或团队成员的灵魂，使其立即移动到你面前。

spells.description_en:
Shadowy Apparitions that float towards your primary target explode, dealing 532 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
暗影幻灵飘向你的主要目标后爆炸，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成532点暗影伤害。

超过5个目标后伤害递减。

spells.description_en:
Unleash elemental forces of Life, healing a friendly target for 4,712.

Increases the healing of your next Riptide, Chain Heal, or Healing Wave by 25% and reduces its cast time by 30%.
spells.description_zh:
释放生命的元素力量，为一个友方目标恢复4,526点生命值。

你的下一个激流、治疗链或治疗波的治疗效果提高25%，且施法时间缩短30%。

spells.description_en:
Blanket the target area in healing rains, restoring 1,048 health to up to 6 allies over 18 sec.

You can only have one Healing Rain active at a time.
spells.description_zh:
用治疗之雨覆盖目标区域，为最多6个盟友恢复1,052点生命值，持续18秒。

你一次只能激活一个治疗之雨。

spells.description_en: Heals every 2 sec for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每2秒恢复一次生命值，持续4秒。

spells.description_en:
Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

Dread Plague
A malicious plague that deals 153 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Explodes for 64 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

Virulent Plague
An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing 71 Shadow damage over 24 sec.
spells.description_zh:
使目标同时感染恐惧瘟疫和恶性病变。

恐惧瘟疫
一种恶性瘟疫，在24秒内造成153点暗影伤害。宿主死亡时会爆炸，对附近敌人造成64点暗影伤害，并感染其中一名敌人。一次只能施加于1个宿主。

恶性病变
一种传染性瘟疫，会扩散到附近所有敌人身上，在24秒内造成71点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Launch a surge of stellar energies at the target, dealing 1,381 Astral damage.
spells.description_zh: 向目标发射汹涌的星界能量，造成1,416点星界伤害。

spells.description_en: Summons a beam of solar light over an enemy target's location, interrupting the target and silencing all enemies within the beam. Lasts 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在敌方目标的位置召唤一道日光，打断其法术，并使光柱内的所有敌人陷入沉默。持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 闪避还会使受到的伤害降低20%。佯攻还会使受到的非范围类伤害降低20%。

spells.description_en:
You regain 3 Energy each time your Garrote or Rupture deal Bleed damage to a target affected by your weapon poisons. Energy gain is reduced for bleeds beyond the first.

If an enemy dies while afflicted by your Rupture, you regain energy based on its remaining duration.
spells.description_zh:
锁喉和割裂每次对受到你的涂毒武器影响的目标造成流血伤害时，都可以为你恢复3点能量。在首次造成流血伤害后，每次恢复的能量会衰减。

如果一名敌人在受到你的割裂影响时死亡，你将根据敌人身上割裂剩余的持续时间恢复能量。

spells.description_en: Calls upon the guidance of the spirits for 15 sec, permitting movement while casting Shaman spells. Castable while casting.
spells.description_zh: 召唤灵魂保护你，持续15秒。可以在施放萨满法术的过程中移动。此法术可以在施放其它法术时施放。

spells.description_en: Marks a target with Havoc for 15 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 用浩劫标记一个目标，持续15秒，使你的单体目标法术也会攻击浩劫的目标，造成初始伤害50%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Power Word: Shield, Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, Plea, and Power Word: Radiance apply Atonement to your target for 15 sec.

Your spell damage heals all targets affected by Atonement for 46% of the damage done. Healing is reduced when healing more than 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
真言术：盾、快速治疗、暗影愈合、恳求和真言术：耀会对你的目标施放救赎，持续15秒。

你的法术伤害会治疗所有受到救赎影响的目标，治疗量相当于该伤害的46%。在治疗的目标超过5个时，治疗效果降低。

spells.description_en:
Launches an orb of swirling ice in front of you, dealing up to 5,784 Frost damage to all enemies it passes through over 15 sec. After a short delay, Frozen Orb will pursue its target. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Enemies damaged by the Frozen Orb are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
朝你的前方施放一颗旋转的寒冰宝珠，在15秒内对其行进路线上的所有敌人造成最多5,783点冰霜伤害。一小段时间后，寒冰宝珠会追踪目标。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

受到寒冰宝珠伤害的敌人移动速度降低50%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: When you avoid a melee attack or use Crusader Strike, you have a 15% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Avenger's Shield.
spells.description_zh: 当你躲过一次近战攻击或使用十字军打击时，有15%的几率刷新复仇者之盾剩余的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Unleashes Holy energy, healing up to 5 injured allies within a 40 yd radius around you for 1,925.
spells.description_zh: 释放神圣能量，为周围40码范围内最多5个受伤的盟友恢复1,925点生命值。

spells.description_en:
A mighty blow with both weapons that deals a total of 78 Physical damage.

Generates 12 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
用两把武器发动一次强力打击，总计造成78点物理伤害。

产生12点怒气值。

spells.description_en: Empowers you with the spirit of ancient kings, reducing all damage you take by 50% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你被远古列王的灵魂赋予了力量，受到的所有伤害降低50%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Fatal damage instead brings you to 35% health and then burns you for 28% of your maximum health over 6 sec.

While burning, movement slowing effects are suppressed and your movement speed is increased by 150%.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 6 min.
spells.description_zh:
原本致命的伤害会使你的生命值达到35%，并在之后的6秒内燃烧28%的最大生命值。

燃烧期间，抑制所有使你的移动速度减慢的效果，并使你的移动速度提高150%。

该效果每6分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Chastises the target for 1,460 Holy damage and incapacitates them for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 惩戒目标，造成1,448点神圣伤害并使其瘫痪，持续4秒。

spells.description_en:
Grow a magical mushroom at the target enemy's location. After 1 sec, the mushroom detonates, dealing 1,211 Nature damage and then an additional 684 Nature damage over 10 sec. Affected targets are slowed by 50%.

Generates up to 20 Astral Power based on targets hit.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置处生长出魔法蘑菇。1秒后，蘑菇会被引爆，造成1,211点自然伤害，并在10秒内额外造成684点自然伤害。受影响的目标被减速50%。

根据命中的目标数量产生最多20点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Your Stealth abilities allow you to see the flaws in enemies' defenses, causing your attacks to ignore 30% armor for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你在潜行状态下的技能将暴露目标的防御弱点，使你所有的攻击能够忽略敌人30%的护甲值，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: A quick beam of solar light burns the enemy for 80 Nature damage and then an additional 705 Nature damage over 18 sec.
spells.description_zh: 一束月光灼烧敌人，造成80点自然伤害，并在18秒内额外造成705点自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 打断施法并使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。

spells.description_en:
Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec.

Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.
spells.description_zh:
释放集结呐喊，使40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员的当前生命值和最大生命值提高10%，持续10秒。

不在团队中时，获得的生命值提高50%。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 6 sec, which reduces damage taken by all party and raid members within 10 yards by 10%. Immediately and every 1 sec, the health of all affected players is redistributed evenly.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续6秒，使10码范围内的所有小队或团队成员受到的伤害降低10%。受到影响的所有玩家的生命值会立即平均分配，此后每隔1秒也会重新平均分配一次生命值。

spells.description_en: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.
spells.description_zh: 将你的肉体和灵魂分离，并将灵魂留在原地，持续15分钟。使用魂体双分：转移，让你的肉体和你的灵魂交换位置。

spells.description_en: The target's skin becomes as tough as Ironwood, reducing damage taken by 20% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 目标的皮肤变得像铁木一样坚韧，受到的所有伤害降低20%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Roots the target and all enemies within 12 yards in place for 10 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Usable in all shapeshift forms.
spells.description_zh: 使目标和12码范围内的敌人定身，持续10秒。受到伤害可能打断该效果。在任何形态下都可以使用。

spells.description_en: Fly to a nearby ally's position.
spells.description_zh: 飞向附近一个盟友的位置。

spells.description_en:
An improved Cat Form that grants all of your known Berserk effects and lasts 20 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this improved Cat Form for its duration. During Incarnation:

Energy cost of all Cat Form abilities is reduced by 25%, and Prowl can be used once while in combat.
spells.description_zh:
一种强化的猎豹形态，能够给予你所有已知的狂暴效果，持续20秒。你可以在持续期间在其他形态与强化的猎豹形态之间切换。在化身期间：

所有猎豹形态技能的能量消耗降低25%，可以在战斗中使用一次潜行。

spells.description_en:
An improved Bear Form that grants the benefits of Berserk, causes Mangle to hit up to 3 targets, and increases maximum health by 30%.

Lasts 30 sec. You may freely shapeshift in and out of this improved Bear Form for its duration.
spells.description_zh:
一种强化的熊形态，能够给予你狂暴效果，使裂伤最多可以击中3个目标，并且最大生命值提高30%。

持续30秒。持续期间内，你可以在其他形态与强化的熊形态之间自由切换。

spells.description_en:
An improved Moonkin Form that grants both Eclipses, any learned Celestial Alignment bonuses, and 10% critical strike chance.

Lasts 20 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this improved Moonkin Form for its duration.
spells.description_zh:
一种强化的枭兽形态，能够给予你日月之蚀和习得的超凡之盟效果，并使你的爆击几率提高10%。

持续20秒。你可以在持续期间在其他形态与强化的枭兽形态之间切换。

spells.description_en: Conjures a vortex of wind for 10 sec at the destination, reducing the movement speed of all enemies within 8 yards by 50%. The first time an enemy attempts to leave the vortex, winds will pull that enemy back to its center. Usable in all shapeshift forms.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置制造一股持续10秒的旋风，使8码范围内的所有敌人移动速度降低50%。敌人首次尝试离开漩涡时，狂风会将其拉回漩涡中心。可在所有形态下使用。

spells.description_en: Charge gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冲锋可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Summons 2 ferocious Dreadstalkers to attack the target for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤2只凶猛的恐惧猎犬攻击目标，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Hardens your skin, reducing all damage you take by 25% and granting immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 硬化你的皮肤，使你受到的所有伤害降低25%，并免疫打断、沉默和施法推迟效果，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Calls down a demonic meteor full of Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target.

Deals up to 581 Shadowflame damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summons 3 Wild Imps.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一枚装满野生小鬼的恶魔流星，爆炸后攻击敌人。

命中时对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成最多571点暗影烈焰伤害，并召唤3个野生小鬼。

spells.description_en: You charge and bash the target's skull, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你向目标冲锋，发动迎头痛击，打断其正在施放的法术并使其在5秒内无法施放该系法术。

spells.description_en: Shift into Bear Form and let loose a wild roar, increasing the movement speed of all friendly players within 15 yards by 60% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 变为熊形态并发出一声野性咆哮，使15码范围内的所有友方玩家的移动速度提高60%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Go Berserk for 15 sec. While Berserk:

Generate 1 combo point every 1.5 sec. Combo point generating abilities generate 1 additional combo point. Finishing moves restore up to 3 combo points generated over the cap.

All attack and ability damage is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
进入狂暴，持续15秒。在狂暴期间：

每1.5秒产生1个连击点数，生成连击点数的技能额外产生1个连击点数。终结技可返还最多3个超过上限的连击点数。

所有攻击和技能的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Kick upwards, dealing 50 Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 向上猛踢，造成50点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: Hurls your weapon at an enemy, causing 9 Physical damage and stunning for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 将你的武器掷向一名敌人，造成9点物理伤害并使其昏迷4秒。

spells.description_en: Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing damage you take from area of effect attacks by 5% for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 化身为巨人，使你造成的所有伤害提高20%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低5%持续20秒。

spells.description_en: Shadowy tendrils coil around all enemies within 15 yards of a hostile or friendly target, pulling them to the target's location and Silencing them for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 暗影触须会缠绕一个敌方或友方目标15码范围内的所有敌人，并将他们拉向目标的所在位置，并沉默3秒。

spells.description_en:
Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 3 sec after Stealth breaks.

Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 3 sec after Stealth breaks.
spells.description_zh:
脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的技能仍可继续使用。

脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的战斗增益仍可保留。

spells.description_en: Abilities deal 10% more damage while Stealth or Shadow Dance is active.
spells.description_zh: 潜行或暗影之舞激活时，技能造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Instantly heals you for 30% of maximum health. Usable in all shapeshift forms.
spells.description_zh: 立即为你恢复最大生命值的30%。可在所有形态下使用。

spells.description_en: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 将部分身体移入元素位面，使受到的伤害降低40%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
Summons a totem at your feet for 10 sec, which pulses every 1.8 sec, healing all party or raid members within 40 yards for 1,932.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
在你的脚下召唤一个图腾，持续10秒。该图腾每1.8秒作用一次，为40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员恢复1,975点生命值。

目标超过5个时治疗量降低。

spells.description_en: For the next 10 sec, 25% of your healing done and 25% of your damage done is converted to healing on up to 3 nearby injured party or raid members, up to 6,110 healing to each target per second.
spells.description_zh: 在接下来的10秒内，25%的治疗和25%的伤害将转化成治疗效果，为附近最多3名受伤的小队或团队成员恢复生命值。每秒最多为每个目标恢复6,110点生命值。

spells.description_en: Resets the cooldown of your most recently used totem with a base cooldown shorter than 3 minutes.
spells.description_zh: 重置你最近使用的基础冷却时间短于3分钟的图腾的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.
spells.description_zh: 将你所放置的图腾迁移到指定位置。

spells.description_en: Physical damage and Armor increased by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 物理伤害和护甲提高6%。

spells.description_en:
5% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh:
你所受伤害的5%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高3%。

spells.description_en: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 950 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
spells.description_zh: 牺牲你当前生命值的20%，为你施加护盾抵挡伤害。该护盾可吸收相当于已牺牲生命值的200%以及额外的950点伤害，持续20秒。可在遭受控制限制效果时施放。

spells.description_en:
Sacrifices your demon pet for power, gaining its command demon ability, and causing your spells to sometimes also deal 143 additional Shadow damage.

Lasts until canceled or until you summon a demon pet.
spells.description_zh:
牺牲你的恶魔宠物来获得力量，获得它的恶魔掌控技能，并使你的法术有时会额外造成140点暗影伤害。

持续直到主动取消或者直到你召唤出一个恶魔宠物为止。

spells.description_en:
Corruption damage has a chance to cause your next Shadow Bolt or Malefic Grasp to deal 25% increased damage. 

Shadow Bolt is instant cast and Malefic Grasp channels 50% faster when affected.
spells.description_zh:
腐蚀术的伤害有一定几率使你的下一次暗影箭或灾难之握造成25%的额外伤害。

受此影响时，暗影箭变为瞬发，灾难之握的引导速度提升50%。

spells.description_en:
Blasts the enemy, critically striking for 829 Fire damage.

Castable while casting other spells.
spells.description_zh:
冲击敌人，造成必定爆击的826点火焰伤害。

可以在施放其它法术时施放。

spells.description_en: Activating Fade removes all snare effects.
spells.description_zh: 激活渐隐术会移除你身上的所有诱捕效果。

spells.description_en: When an attack brings you below 30% health, you gain an absorption shield equal to 25% of your maximum health for 20 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 90 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当一次攻击将你的生命值降到30%以下时，你会获得一个吸收护盾，为你吸收相当于最大生命值25%的伤害，持续20秒。
该效果每90秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal or Shadow Mend instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.
spells.description_zh: 你的治疗法术和惩击有8%的几率使你的下一个快速治疗或暗影愈合变为瞬发，且消耗的法力值降低50%。最多可叠加2层。

spells.description_en: Disengage also frees you from all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 逃脱还会移除所有移动限制效果，并使你的移动速度提高50%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Fires a magical projectile, tethering the enemy and any other enemies within 5 yds for 10 sec, stunning them for 3 sec if they move more than 5 yds from the arrow.
spells.description_zh: 射出一支魔法箭矢，束缚敌人及其5码范围内的其他任意敌人，持续10秒。如果目标离开箭矢5码范围外，则会昏迷3秒。

spells.description_en: Heals you for 30% and your pet for 100% of maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 为你恢复30%的最大生命值，并为你的宠物恢复100%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.
spells.description_zh: 使你隐形，无法成为敌人的目标，持续20秒并移除所有威胁值。任何动作都会解除该效果。

spells.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 50%, but also damages you for 4% of your maximum health every 1 sec. Movement impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until canceled.
spells.description_zh: 使你的移动速度提高50%，但每1秒会对你造成4%最大生命值的伤害。期间移动限制效果不会让你的移动速度降低到正常移动速度的100%以下，持续直到主动取消。

spells.description_en: Dominates the target undead creature up to level 71, forcing it to do your bidding for 5 min.
spells.description_zh: 控制等级不高于71的目标亡灵生物，迫使其听从你的命令，持续5分钟。

spells.description_en: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在两个位置分别召唤一个恶魔传送门。使用者激活传送门后会立即被传送到另一个传送门。每名玩家每90秒只能使用一次恶魔传送门。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Felguard who attacks the target for 17 sec that deals 125% increased damage.

This Felguard will stun and interrupt their target when summoned.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个恶魔卫士攻击目标，持续17秒，造成的伤害提高125%。

恶魔卫士被召唤出来后会打断目标并使其昏迷。

spells.description_en:
Frostbolt has a 15% chance to grant a charge of Fingers of Frost.

Fingers of Frost causes your next Ice Lance to deal Shatter damage equal to 4 stacks of Freezing and does not consume Freezing stacks.

Maximum 2 charges.
spells.description_zh:
寒冰箭有15%几率提供一层寒冰指。

寒冰指使你的下一个冰枪术造成相当于4层冻结效果的粉碎伤害，并且不消耗冻结层数。

最多叠加2层。

spells.description_en: Your healing over time from Lifebloom has a 4% chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Regrowth cost no mana.
spells.description_zh: 生命绽放的持续治疗效果有4%的几率使你获得节能施法效果，你的下1个愈合不消耗法力值。

spells.description_en: Pummels all targets in front of you, dealing 456 Physical damage to your primary target and 274 damage to all other enemies over 3.6 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Can be channeled while moving.
spells.description_zh: 对你前方的所有目标施展拳击，在3.6秒内对你的主要目标造成456点物理伤害，对其他所有敌人造成274点伤害。目标数量超过5个后，造成的伤害降低。可以在移动中引导。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.

When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置处召唤一道冰霜之环，持续10秒。进入环内的敌人将瘫痪10秒。目标上限为10个。

当瘫痪效果结束时，敌人会被减速65%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en:
Transform into a Flame Ascendant for 15 sec, instantly casting a Flame Shock and a 50% effectiveness Lava Burst at up to 6 nearby enemies.

While ascended, Elemental Overload damage is increased by 30% and spells affected by your Mastery: Elemental Overload cause 1 additional Elemental Overload.
spells.description_zh:
转化成火焰升腾者形态，持续15秒，立即对附近最多6个敌人施放烈焰震击和效果为50%的熔岩爆裂。

处于火焰升腾者形态时，元素过载的伤害提高30%，且受你的精通：元素过载影响的法术会额外造成1次元素过载。

spells.description_en:
Transform into an Air Ascendant for 15 sec and unleash Doom Winds, reducing the cooldown and cost of Stormstrike by 60%, and transforming your auto attack and Stormstrike into Wind attacks which bypass armor and have a 30 yd range.

Maelstrom Weapon spenders have a 0.5% chance to unleash Doom Winds per Maelstrom Weapon spent while Ascendance is not active.
spells.description_zh:
转化成空气升腾者形态，持续15秒并施放毁灭之风，使风暴打击的冷却时间和消耗降低60%，并将自动攻击和风暴打击变成风切，无视护甲，攻击距离为30码。

未激活升腾效果时，消耗漩涡武器的技能每消耗一层漩涡武器，就有0.5%的几率施放毁灭之风。

spells.description_en:
Immediately heals for 4,854 split between allies within 20 yds and transforms into a Water Ascendant for 15 sec.

While ascended, Chain Heal jumps to 3 additional allies with 10% healing reduced for all jumps, Healing Wave always critical heals and heals 1 additional ally at 50% effectiveness, and the mana cost of Chain Heal and Healing Wave is reduced by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
立即为20码内的盟友恢复总计4,970点生命值，由受影响的盟友分摊，并转化成流水升腾者形态，持续15秒。

升腾状态下，治疗链可以额外跳向3个目标，且所有跳跃的治疗效果降低10%；治疗波必定产生暴击，且会额外治疗1个目标，效果为初始目标的50%；此外，治疗链和治疗波的法力消耗降低25%。

spells.description_en: Solar Eclipse increases Wrath's Astral Power generation by 40% and Lunar Eclipse increases Starfire's Astral Power generation by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 日蚀状态下，愤怒产生的星界能量提高40%；月蚀状态下，星火术产生的星界能量提高40%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Lay on Hands by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的圣盾术、圣佑术和圣疗术的冷却时间缩短30%。

spells.description_en:
Fires a beam of light that scatters to strike a clump of targets. 

If the beam is aimed at an enemy target, it deals 2,444 Holy damage and radiates 2,576 healing to 5 allies within 30 yds.

If the beam is aimed at a friendly target, it heals for 6,133 and radiates 928 Holy damage to 5 enemies within 30 yds.

Generates 3 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
发射一束圣光，散射后照向一群目标。

如果光束瞄准的是敌方目标，则会使其受到2,486点神圣伤害，并使附近30码范围内的5个盟友恢复2,641点生命值。

如果光束瞄准的是友方目标，则为其恢复5,949点生命值，并使附近30码范围内的5个敌人受到915点神圣伤害。

产生3层神圣能量。

spells.description_en:
An unholy pact that prevents fatal damage, instead absorbing incoming healing equal to the damage prevented, lasting 3 sec.

If any healing absorption remains when this effect expires, you will die. This effect may only occur every 4 min.
spells.description_zh:
当你遭受致命伤害时，邪恶契约可保你免于一死，转而吸收随后获得的治疗量，数值相当于被阻挡的伤害量，持续3秒。

该效果结束时，如果没有吸收足够的治疗量，你就会死亡。该效果每4分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Torpedoes you forward a long distance and increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 sec, stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 向前突进很长一段距离，并使移动速度提高30%，持续10秒，可叠加2次。

spells.description_en: You shrug off attacks, delaying a portion of Physical damage based on your Agility, instead taking it over 10 sec. Affects magical attacks at 58% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 灵活地应对敌人的攻击，化解部分受到的物理伤害，改为在10秒内承受，化解的比例由你的敏捷决定。对魔法攻击有58%的化解效果。

spells.description_en: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 使目标瘫痪，持续1分钟。只能对一个目标使用。伤害可能取消该效果。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.
spells.description_zh: 使滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒，使用次数上限提高1次。

spells.description_en: Heals the target for 6,386 over 7.1 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.
spells.description_zh: 在7.1秒内为目标恢复6,386点生命值。引导时，可以在目标身上瞬发氤氲之雾和活血术。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by 60% for 8 sec. Being hit by a melee attack, or taking another action will cancel this effect.
spells.description_zh: 受到的所有伤害降低60%，持续8秒。受到近战攻击或进行其他动作会取消该效果。

spells.description_en:
Breathe fire on targets in front of you, causing 35 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

Targets affected by Keg Smash will also burn, taking 23 Fire damage and dealing 5% reduced damage to you for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
向你面前的目标喷吐火焰，造成35点火焰伤害。对次要目标造成的伤害降低。

受到醉酿投影响的目标将被点燃，在12秒内受到23点火焰伤害，且对你造成的伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 让你的皮肤化为坚石，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Heals all party and raid members within 40 yds for 23,111 and clears them of 3 harmful Magic, all Poison, and all Disease effects.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
为40码范围内所有小队或团队成员恢复23,135点生命值，并为其移除3个有害的魔法效果，以及所有中毒和疾病效果。

目标超过5个时治疗量降低。

spells.description_en: Summons a Jade Serpent Statue at the target location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一座青龙雕像。当你引导抚慰之雾时，青龙雕像也会开始对你的目标引导抚慰之雾，在7.1秒内为其恢复2,128点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Black Ox Statue at the target location for 15 min, pulsing threat to all enemies within 20 yards.

You may cast Provoke on the statue to taunt all enemies near the statue.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置召唤一座玄牛雕像，持续15分钟。对20码范围内的所有敌人产生威胁值。

你可以对雕像使用嚎镇八方，嘲讽雕像附近的所有敌人。

spells.description_en: Increases your maximum Chi by 1, maximum Energy by 20, and your Energy regeneration by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 最大真气值提高1点，最大能量值提高20点，能量回复速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Chug some Black Ox Brew, which instantly refills your Energy, Purifying Brew charges, and grants one charge of Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion.
spells.description_zh: 饮下玄牛酒，立即回满你的能量、活血酒层数，并获得一层天神酒或天神灌注的充能。

spells.description_en: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 向四面八方发出耀眼的光芒，使10码范围内的敌人暂时失明，并使其迷惑地游荡，持续6秒。伤害可能取消该效果。

spells.description_en:
For every 3,000 Mana you spend, you gain 1 stack of Mana Tea, with a chance equal to your critical strike chance to generate 1 extra stack.

Mana Tea:
Consumes 1 stack of Mana Tea per 0.4 sec to restore 648 Mana.

Can be cast while moving, but movement speed is reduced by 40% while channeling.
spells.description_zh:
每消耗3,000点法力值，你将获得一层法力茶效果。除此之外，你还有一定几率额外获得一层法力茶效果，该几率相当于你的爆击几率。

法力茶：
每0.4秒消耗一层法力茶，恢复648点法力值。

可以在移动时施放，但引导时移动速度降低40%。

spells.description_en: After you Wild Thrash, your pet's melee attacks also strike all nearby enemies for 70% of the damage for the next 10.0 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 在施放狂野鞭笞之后的10.0秒内，你的宠物的近战攻击还会击中附近的所有敌人，造成70%的伤害。目标数量超过8个后，造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec, duration refreshed by your melee attacks.
spells.description_zh: 使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续15秒。近战攻击会刷新持续时间。

spells.description_en:
Tiger Palm causes your next Blackout Kick to strike an additional time dealing 29 Physical damage, stacking up to 4.

Blackout Kick has a 12% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.
spells.description_zh:
猛虎掌会使下个幻灭踢额外攻击一次，造成29点物理伤害，最多可叠加4次。

幻灭踢有12%的几率重置旭日东升踢的剩余冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Receive a jolt of energy, empowering your next spell cast:

Enveloping Mist: Immediately heals for 2,787 and is instant cast.
Renewing Mist: Duration increased by 10 sec.
Rising Sun Kick: Cooldown reduced by 9 sec.
spells.description_zh:
获得一股能量，使你接下来施放的一个法术得到增强：

氤氲之雾：变为瞬发并立即恢复2,800点生命值。
复苏之雾：持续时间延长10秒。
旭日东升踢：冷却时间缩短9秒。

spells.description_en: Jabs the target in the throat, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 猛击目标的咽喉，打断其施法，并阻止其施放任何同系的法术，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.
spells.description_zh: 使一名友方目标的移动速度提高70%，持续6秒，并解除所有定身和诱捕效果。

spells.description_en: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置形成平心之环，持续5秒。进入环中的敌人将被推出环外。

spells.description_en: Summons a whirling tornado around you, causing 42 Physical damage over 5.4 sec to all enemies within 8 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 在你身边召唤出一股旋转疾风，在5.4秒内对8码范围内的所有敌人造成42点物理伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Encases the target in a cocoon of Chi energy for 12 sec, absorbing 14,664 damage and increasing all healing over time received by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 将目标包裹在真气形成的茧中，持续12秒，吸收14,664点伤害，并使其受到的所有持续治疗效果提高50%。

spells.description_en: Unleashes a devastating blast of chaos, dealing a critical strike for 3,261 Chaos damage. Damage is further increased by your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 释放出一道破坏性的混乱冲击，总是爆击，造成3,263点混乱伤害。你的爆击几率会进一步使伤害提高。

spells.description_en: Your Earth, Fire, and Storm Elementals are drawn from primal elementals 80% more powerful than regular elementals, with additional abilities, and you gain direct control over your Primal Fire Elemental.
spells.description_zh: 召唤土元素、火元素和风暴元素时会召唤出更强大的原始元素，它们的威力比普通元素高80%，并拥有额外的技能。你能直接控制你的原始火元素。

spells.description_en: Harnesses the raw power of the elements, dealing 773 Elemental damage and increasing your Critical Strike or Haste by 3% or Mastery by 6% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 驾驭元素的原始力量，造成766点元素伤害，并使你的爆击或急速提高3%，或使你的精通提高6%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Your spells have a 4% increased chance to deal a critical strike.

You gain 10% more of the Critical Strike stat from all sources.
spells.description_zh:
你的法术造成爆击的几率提高4%。

通过任何渠道获得的爆击属性提高10%。

spells.description_en: Channel Jade lightning, causing 9 Nature damage over 3.6 sec to the target and sometimes knocking back melee attackers.
spells.description_zh: 引导碎玉闪电攻击目标，在3.6秒内造成9点自然伤害，并有一定几率击退近战攻击者。

spells.description_en: Increases your parry chance by 100% and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你的招架几率提高100%，并使你受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Clears 50% of your Staggered damage, or a minimum of 8% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 清除醉拳50%的延缓伤害，或至少相当于你最大生命值8%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Creates a ring of Holy energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 598 and dealing 538 Holy damage to enemies.

Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.
spells.description_zh:
在你周围制造一个神圣能量之环，迅速扩散到半径40码的范围，为盟友恢复最多623点生命，并对敌人造成549点神圣伤害。

目标数量超过6个后造成的治疗量降低。

spells.description_en: Creates a ring of Shadow energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 608 and dealing 544 Shadow damage to enemies. Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.
spells.description_zh: 在你周围制造一个暗影能量之环，迅速扩散到半径40码的范围，为盟友恢复最多601点生命，并对敌人造成554点暗影伤害。目标数量超过6个后造成的治疗量降低。

spells.description_en: Damage from your bleed effects has a 4% chance of attracting a powerful wild beast that attacks your target for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的流血效果造成伤害有4%的几率吸引一只强大的野兽攻击你的目标，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Smash a keg of brew, dealing 102 Physical damage to your primary target and 67 Physical damage to all other enemies within 8 yds, and reducing their movement speed by 20% for 15 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 向目标投掷一桶酒，对主要目标造成99点物理伤害，对8码范围内的所有其他敌人造成66点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低20%，持续15秒。超过5个目标后，造成的伤害降低。
