spells.description_en: Draws upon surrounding shadows to empower your weapons, causing your attacks to deal 20% additional damage as Shadow and causing your combo point generating abilities to generate double combo points for 16 sec.
spells.description_zh: 吸取周围的暗影能量，强化你的武器，使你的攻击额外造成20%的暗影伤害，且产生连击点数的技能可以产生双倍连击点数，持续16秒。

spells.description_en: Places a feather at the target location, granting the first ally to walk through it 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec. Only 3 feathers can be placed at one time.
spells.description_zh: 将一根羽毛放在目标位置，使第一个触碰羽毛的盟友的移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。同一时间只能放置3根羽毛。

spells.description_en:
While out of combat, your Chi balances to 2 instead of depleting to empty.

Your stamina is increased by 5% and every 15 sec, your next Tiger Palm also casts Expel Harm.

 Expel Harm
Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 455 and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.
spells.description_zh:
未进入战斗时，你的真气会平衡至2点，而非完全耗尽。

你的耐力提高5%，并且每15秒，你的下一个猛虎掌还会施放移花接木。

 移花接木
逼出体内逆行的真气，恢复464点生命值，并对20码范围内的一名敌人造成相当于治疗量10%的自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage you take by 20% to 50% for 10 sec, with larger attacks being reduced by more.
spells.description_zh: 使你在10秒内受到的所有伤害降低20%到50%。伤害越高，减伤比例越高。

spells.description_en:
You consume a healing elixir when you drop below 40% health or generate excess healing elixirs, instantly healing you for 15% of your maximum health.

You generate 1 healing elixir every 30 sec, stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh:
生命值降至40%时或获得过量金创药时消耗一瓶金创药，立即为你恢复15%的最大生命值。

你每30秒获得1瓶金创药，最多叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Absorbs all damage taken for 10 sec, up to 50% of your maximum health, and redirects 70% of that amount to the enemy target as Nature damage over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在10秒内吸收受到的所有伤害，最多可吸收你最大生命值的50%，并将所吸收伤害的70%转移给敌方目标，在6秒内持续造成自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Reduces magic damage you take by 60% for 6 sec, and transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.
spells.description_zh: 使你受到的魔法伤害降低60%，持续6秒。如果可能的话，还会将你身上当前激活的所有有害魔法效果返还给施法者。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Mindbender to attack the target for 12 sec. 

Generates 0.2% Mana each time the Mindbender attacks.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个摧心魔攻击目标，持续12秒。

摧心魔每次攻击时都会产生0.2%的法力值。

spells.description_en: Summons an effigy of Xuen, the White Tiger for 20 sec. Xuen attacks your primary target, and strikes 3 enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec with Tiger Lightning for 9 Nature damage.
spells.description_zh: 召唤白虎雪怒的幻身，持续20秒。雪怒会攻击你的主要目标，并且每0.9秒对10码范围内的3个敌人施放伏虎闪雷，造成9点自然伤害。

spells.description_en:
Hurls a torrent of Chi energy up to 40 yds forward, dealing 98 Nature damage to all enemies, and 77 healing to the Monk and all allies in its path. Healing and damage reduced beyond 5 targets.


Casting Chi Burst does not prevent avoiding attacks.
spells.description_zh:
向前丢出真气能量漩涡，最远40码，对其路径上的所有敌人造成98点自然伤害，并为武僧和所有盟友恢复76点生命值。目标数量超过5个后造成的治疗量和伤害降低。


施放真气爆裂时依然可以躲闪攻击。

spells.description_en:
When you take damage, you have a chance to summon a Healing Sphere.

Healing Sphere:
Summon a Healing Sphere visible only to you. Moving through this Healing Sphere heals you for 114.
spells.description_zh:
当你承受伤害时，有几率召唤一个只有你能看到的疗伤珠。

疗伤珠：
召唤一个只有你能看到的疗伤珠。穿过疗伤珠时会为你恢复116点生命值。

spells.description_en: Wraps the target in healing mists, healing for 3,189 over 6 sec, and increasing healing received from your other spells by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 用治疗迷雾包裹目标，在6秒内为其恢复3,189点生命值，并使目标从你的其他法术获得的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 移动速度提高15%。

spells.description_en: An explosion of holy light around you deals up to 156 Holy damage to enemies and up to 118 healing to allies within 12 yds, reduced if there are more than 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 在你周围12码范围内制造一次圣光爆炸，对敌人造成最多154点神圣伤害，并为盟友恢复117点生命值。目标多于5个时效果会衰减。

spells.description_en: Your next Regrowth, Rebirth, or Entangling Roots is instant, free, castable in all forms, and heals for an additional 60%.
spells.description_zh: 你的下一个愈合、复生或纠缠根须变为瞬发、不消耗资源、可以在所有形态下施放并且治疗量提高60%。

spells.description_en: Blasts targets within 15 yards in front of you with a violent Typhoon, knocking them back and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 6 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.
spells.description_zh: 用猛烈的台风冲击你前方15码内的目标，将其击退，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。在任何形态下都可以使用该技能。

spells.description_en:
Summons an effigy of Niuzao, the Black Ox for 25 sec that attacks your primary target and Stomps when you cast Blackout Kick, damaging all nearby enemies.

While active, 40% of damage delayed by Stagger is instead Staggered by Niuzao, and Niuzao is healed for 100% of your purified Stagger.
spells.description_zh:
召唤玄牛砮皂的幻身，持续25秒。砮皂会攻击你的主要目标，并在你施放幻灭踢时施放践踏，对附近所有敌人造成伤害。

激活时，醉拳化解伤害的40%会由砮皂代为化解，清除醉拳伤害的100%会治疗砮皂。

spells.description_en: You have a 8% chance when you Tiger Palm to cause your next Blackout Kick to cost no Chi within 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你使用猛虎掌时，有8%的几率使你在15秒内施放的下一次幻灭踢不会消耗真气。

spells.description_en:
Split into 3 elemental spirits for 15 sec, each spirit dealing 40% of normal damage and healing.

You directly control the Storm spirit, while Earth and Fire spirits mimic your attacks on nearby enemies.

While active, casting Storm, Earth, and Fire again will cause the spirits to fixate on your target.
spells.description_zh:
分裂成为3个元素之灵，持续15秒，每个元素之灵造成的伤害和治疗量为正常值的40%。

你可以直接控制风之灵。同时地之灵与火之灵会模仿你的动作，攻击附近的目标。

激活之后再次施放风火雷电会让元素之灵集中攻击你的目标。

spells.description_en: Heals you for 3% of your maximum health every 5 sec. If you are at full health, an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.
spells.description_zh: 每5秒为你恢复3%的最大生命值。如果你的生命值已满，则会治疗一个受伤的团队或小队成员。

spells.description_en: Grows a healing blossom at the target location, restoring 226 health to three injured allies within 10 yards every 1.8 sec for 30 sec. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置处生长出一片治疗之花，每1.8秒为10码范围内3个受伤的盟友恢复219点生命值，持续30秒。同一时间只能放置1个百花齐放。

spells.description_en:
Removing harmful effects with Divine Shield heals you for 10% for each effect removed.  This heal cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Divine Shield may now be cast while Forbearance is active.
spells.description_zh:
圣盾术每移除一个有害效果，就会为你恢复10%的生命值。该治疗的治疗量不会超过你最大生命值的30%。

处于自律效果时仍可施放圣盾术。

spells.description_en: Interrupts spellcasting, preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 打断目标施法，并使其在5秒内无法施放任何该系法术。

spells.description_en: Calls forth a cataclysm at the target location, dealing 1,400 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 8 yards and afflicting them with Immolate.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一场大灾变，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成1,388点暗影烈焰伤害，并施加献祭。

spells.description_en:
Performs a devastating whirling upward strike, dealing 324 damage to all nearby enemies and an additional 158 damage to the first target struck. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Only usable while both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are on cooldown.
spells.description_zh:
施展拳法，发动盘旋向上的毁灭性攻击，对附近的所有敌人造成329点伤害，并对第一个击中的目标额外造成155点伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

只有在怒雷破和旭日东升踢都在冷却时才能使用。

spells.description_en: Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗20点怒气用于攻击，就会使天神下凡和巨人打击的剩余冷却时间缩短1秒。

spells.description_en:
Calls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 3,771 Fire damage to all enemies, and burns the ground, dealing 1,754 Fire damage over 4 sec to all enemies in the area.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一颗流星，3秒后落在目标位置，对所有敌人造成3,802点火焰伤害。同时还会灼烧大地，在4秒内对该区域内的所有敌人造成1,754点火焰伤害。

目标超过8个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Launches an Arcane Orb forward from your position, traveling up to 40 yds, dealing 1,259 Arcane damage to enemies it passes through.

Grants 1 Arcane Charge when cast and every time it deals damage.
spells.description_zh:
从你的位置向前射出一颗奥术宝珠，最多行进40码，对其触碰到的敌人造成1,230点奥术伤害。

施放时获得一层奥术充能，每造成一次伤害获得一层奥术充能。

spells.description_en: Your Shadowy Apparitions deal 15% increased damage and have a chance to generate 1 Insanity.
spells.description_zh: 你的暗影幻灵的伤害提高15%，并有几率产生1点狂乱值。

spells.description_en: Mangle increases the duration of your next Ironfur by 3 sec, or the healing of your next Frenzied Regeneration by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 裂伤会使你的下一个铁鬃的持续时间延长3秒，或使下一次狂暴回复恢复的生命值提高20%。

spells.description_en: Moonfire is usable in Cat Form, costs 30 energy, and generates 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh: 现在可在猎豹形态下施放月火术，消耗30点能量，产生1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: You can apply Rejuvenation twice to the same target.
spells.description_zh: 你可以对同一目标施加两次回春术。

spells.description_en: Bristle your fur, causing you to generate Rage based on damage taken for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 鬃毛倒竖，使你根据受到的伤害恢复怒气，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Heals an ally for 1,436 and an additional 465 over 16 sec.

Healing increased by 25% when cast on self.
spells.description_zh:
为一名盟友恢复1,436点生命值，并在16秒内额外恢复465点。

对自己施放时治疗效果提高25%。

spells.description_en: Mark a second target as a Beacon, mimicking the effects of Beacon of Light. Your heals will now heal both of your Beacons, but at 30% reduced effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 将另一个目标设成道标，效果形同圣光道标。你的治疗现在同时影响两个道标，但效果会降低30%。

spells.description_en: When an ally with your Beacon of Light is damaged, they absorb the next 85 damage, increasing by up to 300% based on their current health. Lower health allies are shielded for more.
spells.description_zh: 当一名受到你圣光道标影响的盟友受到伤害时，会吸收接下来受到的85点伤害，吸收量最多提高当前生命值的300%。生命值越低的盟友获得的护盾越多。

spells.description_en: You and your allies within 10 yards have 10% increased movement speed. Stacks with other similar effects.
spells.description_zh: 你和10码内的盟友的移动速度提高10%。可与其他类似效果叠加。

spells.description_en: Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing 177 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 在选中的敌人或盟友周围制造奥术能量脉冲，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成178点奥术伤害，并将其击飞。主要敌方目标将额外受到100%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Causes a whirl of icy wind around the enemy, dealing 590 Frost damage to the target and all other enemies within 8 yds, freezing them in place for 2 sec. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 在敌人周围制造一场凛冽的寒风，对目标和8码范围内的所有其他敌人造成582点冰霜伤害，并将其冻结在原地，持续2秒。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Your finishing moves grant 2 Energy per combo point spent and deal 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高5%，且每消耗一个连击点数就将获得2点能量。

spells.description_en: Mangle generates 5 more Rage and deals 25% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 裂伤额外提高25%的伤害，并额外产生5点怒气值。

spells.description_en: Swiftmend increases the healing of your next Regrowth or Rejuvenation by 60%.
spells.description_zh: 迅捷治愈会使你的下一个愈合或回春术的治疗效果提高60%。

spells.description_en:
Wrath and Shred transfer 100% of their damage and Starfire and Swipe transfer 50% of their damage into healing onto a nearby ally. 

This effect is increased by 200% while Call of the Elder Druid is active.
spells.description_zh:
愤怒和撕碎会将100%的伤害、星火术和横扫会将50%的伤害转化为治疗，为附近的一名盟友恢复生命值。

德鲁伊长者之唤激活时，该效果提高200%。

spells.description_en:
While in Cat Form, when you critically strike with an attack that generates a combo point, you gain an additional combo point. Damage over time cannot trigger this effect.

Mangle critical strike damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
在猎豹形态下，当一个产生连击点数的攻击造成爆击时，你会额外获得一个连击点数。持续性伤害效果不会触发该效果。

裂伤的爆击伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Smash the ground and shatter the armor of all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 107 Physical damage and increasing damage you deal to them by 30% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 猛击地面并粉碎10码范围内所有敌人的护甲，造成109点物理伤害，并使你对其造成的伤害提高30%，持续10秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Your damaging spells incite the earth around you to come to your aid for 6 sec, repeatedly dealing 160 Nature damage to your most recently attacked target.
spells.description_zh: 你的伤害性法术会煽动周围的大地来协助你，持续6秒，对你最近攻击过的目标持续造成163点自然伤害。

spells.description_en:
Renewing Mist now has 3 charges and reduces the remaining cooldown of Rising Sun Kick by 1.0 sec.

Rising Sun Kick now reduces the remaining cooldown of Renewing Mist by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
复苏之雾现在可以使用3次，并使旭日东升踢的剩余冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

旭日东升踢现在使复苏之雾的剩余冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Unleash an eruption of fel energy, dealing 9 Chaos damage and stunning all nearby enemies for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 释放出一股强劲的邪能能量，对附近的所有敌人造成9点混乱伤害并使其昏迷3秒。

spells.description_en: While you are above 85% health, 5% of all damage taken by allies within 20 yds is redirected to you, up to a maximum of 1,527 every 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当20码内的盟友受到伤害时，如果你的生命值在85%以上，所受伤害的5%将转移到你身上，每5秒最多转移1,527点伤害。

spells.description_en: Disrupt generates 30 Fury on a successful interrupt.
spells.description_zh: 瓦解成功打断可以产生30点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Reduces damage taken by 30% and Bloodthirst restores an additional 20% health for 8 sec. Usable while stunned or incapacitated.
spells.description_zh: 受到的伤害降低30%，嗜血为你恢复的生命值提高20%，持续8秒。可以在昏迷或瘫痪时使用。

spells.description_en:
Unleash a series of 4 brutal strikes for a total of 104 Physical damage.

Enrages you.
spells.description_zh:
释放一连串共计4次的残暴打击，造成总共104点物理伤害。

使你激怒。

spells.description_en:
Pierce an enemy with a blade of light, dealing 66 Holy damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
用圣光的利刃刺穿一名敌人，对目标造成67点神圣伤害。

产生1层神圣能量。

spells.description_en:
Creates a barrier of holy light that absorbs 9,165 damage for 10 sec.

When the shield expires, it bursts to inflict Holy damage equal to the total amount absorbed, divided among all nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
制造一个圣光壁垒，吸收9,165点伤害，持续10秒。

当壁垒持续时间结束时会产生爆炸，造成相当于吸收伤害总量的神圣伤害，由附近的所有敌人分摊。

spells.description_en:
You have a 30% chance to gain a charge of Overpower when you use an attack that has a Rage cost.
This effect applies even if that ability's Rage cost has been reduced to zero.
spells.description_zh:
每当你使用消耗怒气的攻击时，都有30%的几率获得一层压制充能。
即使该技能的怒气消耗已降至零，此效果仍然适用。

spells.description_en: Drink an alchemical concoction that heals you for 20% of your maximum health over 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 喝下一瓶炼金混合物，在4秒内为你恢复20%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Allows the use of Stealth abilities, grants the combat benefits of Stealth, and drastically reduces threat for 6 sec. Effect not broken from taking damage or attacking.
spells.description_zh: 允许使用潜行技能，获得潜行战斗增益，并大幅降低威胁值，持续6秒。受到伤害或攻击时不会打破此效果。

spells.description_en:
Shadow Dance duration is increased by 150% of your Haste stat.

Current bonus duration: 0.00 sec
spells.description_zh:
暗影之舞的持续时间延长，数值相当于你的急速属性的150%。

当前额外持续时间：0.00秒

spells.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 90% for 3 sec. Upon expiring, increases your movement speed by 30% for another 9 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你的移动速度提高90%，持续3秒。效果结束时，在接下来的9秒内使你的移动速度提高30%。

spells.description_en: Causes all spells and attacks to miss and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec, but you cannot attack.
spells.description_zh: 偏转所有法术和攻击，使你受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒，但你无法攻击。

spells.description_en: A vicious slash dealing 134 Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 一次恶毒的斩击，造成139点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases the range of your Raptor Strike and Mastery: Spirit Bond to 40 yds for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你的猛禽一击和精通：灵魂联结的范围增加到40码，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Hurls a tar trap to the target location that creates a 8 yd radius pool of tar around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches. All enemies have 50% reduced movement speed while in the area of effect. Limit 1. Trap will exist for 1 min.
spells.description_zh: 向目标位置发射一个焦油陷阱，当第一个敌人靠近时在其周围制造一个半径8码的焦油池，持续30秒。所有敌人在作用范围内时移动速度降低50%，最多1个。陷阱可存在1分钟。

spells.description_en: Interrupts spellcasting, preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 打断目标施法，并使其在5秒内无法施放任何该系法术。

spells.description_en: Transform to demon form for 15 sec, increasing current health by 40%, healing for that amount, and increasing Armor by 200%.
spells.description_zh: 变身为恶魔形态，持续15秒，当前生命值提高40%，为你恢复等量的生命值，并且护甲值提高200%。

spells.description_en:
Electrocutes all enemies in front of you, dealing 63 Nature damage. 

Enhances your weapons for 12 sec, causing Stormstrike and Lava Lash to discharge 34 Nature damage split between up to 5 enemies in front of you.
spells.description_zh:
对前方所有敌人施放电击，造成65点自然伤害。

你的武器将受到强化，持续12秒，使风暴打击和熔岩猛击还能造成34点自然伤害，由你前方最多5个目标平均分摊。

spells.description_en:
When you deal damage with a melee weapon, you have a chance to generate Maelstrom Weapon, stacking up to 5 times. 

Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon reduces the cast time of your next Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning by 20% and increases its damage by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
当你用近战武器造成伤害时，有一定几率生成一层漩涡武器，至多可叠加5层。

每层漩涡武器会使你的下一个闪电箭或闪电链的施法时间缩短20%，造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 439 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Affects 3 total targets
spells.description_zh: 向敌人投掷一发闪电箭，造成448点自然伤害，然后跃向附近的其他敌人。总共影响3个目标。

spells.description_en:
Engulfs you in flames for 10 sec, increasing your spells' critical strike chance by 100%.

Castable while casting other spells.
spells.description_zh:
火焰将你笼罩起来，持续10秒，使你的法术爆击几率提高100%。

可在施放其他法术时施放。

spells.description_en:
Ice shards pelt the target area, dealing 1,682 Frost damage over 10.7 sec and reducing movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

This spell is cast at a selected location
spells.description_zh:
目标区域骤然落下寒冰碎片，在10.7秒内造成1,680点冰霜伤害，并使敌人的移动速度降低50%，持续3秒。

该法术对指定位置施放。

spells.description_en:
Unleashes a whirlwind of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 56 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Generates 3 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
释放一道钢铁旋风，对附近所有敌人造成56点物理伤害。目标超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

产生3点怒气。

spells.description_en: Frostbolt has a 25% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Flurry and cause your next Flurry to deal 50% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰箭有25%的几率重置冰风暴的剩余冷却时间，并使你的下一个冰风暴造成的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Fight through the pain, ignoring 50% of damage taken for 12 sec sec or until 564 damage has been prevented.
spells.description_zh: 在痛苦中继续战斗，无视接下来受到伤害中的50%，持续12秒秒。或者直到防止564点伤害。

spells.description_en: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.
spells.description_zh: 跃上战马，移动速度提高100%，持续3秒。可以在室内或战斗中使用。

spells.description_en: Hurl a ball of energy at the target, dealing 555 Nature damage.
spells.description_zh: 向目标投掷能量球，造成559点自然伤害。

spells.description_en:
Increases the damage of Bite, Claw, Smack and the effectiveness of your pet's unique abilities by 30%.

Increases the effectiveness of your pet's Predator's Thirst, Endurance Training, and Pathfinding passives by 50%.
spells.description_zh:
使撕咬、爪击和拍击的伤害，以及宠物的独特技能效果提高30%。

宠物的被动技能：掠食者的渴望、耐力训练和寻路的效果提高50%。

spells.description_en: Charge yourself with lightning, causing your next 2 Lightning Bolts to be instant cast and deal 150% more damage, or cause your next 2 Chain Lightings to be instant cast and trigger an Elemental Overload on every target.
spells.description_zh: 用闪电为自己充能，使你的下2个闪电箭变成瞬发并且造成的伤害提高150%，或者使你的下2个闪电链变成瞬发并在击中每个目标时触发元素过载。

spells.description_en: Casting Stormkeeper summons a Greater Storm Elemental to hurl gusts of wind at your enemies for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放风暴守护者会召唤一个巨型风暴元素，用猛烈的飓风攻击你的敌人，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt have a 15% chance to cause your next Lava Burst deal 20% extra damage, stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 闪电链和闪电箭有15%的几率使你的下一次熔岩爆裂造成的伤害提高20%，最多叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and explodes after 2 sec, stunning all enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，从周围的空气中聚集电能，在2秒之后爆炸，使周围8码内的敌人昏迷3秒。

spells.description_en: A gust of wind hurls you forward.
spells.description_zh: 一股强风吹动你向前。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续15秒，使经过图腾附近10码范围内的盟友移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases armor by 124 for 7 sec.
spells.description_zh: 护甲提高124点，持续7秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Spiritwalker's Grace by 30 sec and increases your movement speed by 20% while it is active.
spells.description_zh: 使灵魂行者的恩赐的冷却时间缩短30秒，激活时使你的移动速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location that erupts dealing 376 Fire damage and applying Flame Shock to 3 enemies within 8 yards. Continues hurling liquid magma at a random nearby target every 0.9 sec for 6 sec, dealing 189 Fire damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，迸发岩浆造成371点火焰伤害，并对附近8码范围内的3名敌人施放烈焰震击。在6秒内，图腾每0.9秒会向附近的一个随机目标投出液态岩浆，对8码内的所有敌人造成186点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en:
Calls forth a Greater Storm Elemental to hurl gusts of wind at your enemies for 10 sec.

While the Storm Elemental is active, casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning increases your haste by 4%, stacking up to 4 times.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个强力风暴元素，用猛烈的飓风攻击萨满祭司的敌人，持续10秒。

当风暴元素激活时，施放闪电箭或闪电链会使你的急速提高4%，最多叠加4次。

spells.description_en: Casting Flash Heal or Shadow Mend on yourself reduces all damage you take by 10% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 对自己施放快速治疗或暗影愈合会使你受到的所有伤害降低10%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Penance fires one additional bolt of holy light over its duration.
spells.description_zh: 苦修可在持续时间内多发射一支圣光箭。

spells.description_en: You regenerate mana 25% faster.
spells.description_zh: 你的法力恢复速度提高25%。

spells.description_en:
Your Prayer of Mending has a 12% chance to leave a Renew on each target it heals.

 Renew
Fill the target with faith in the light, healing for 1,528 over 15 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的愈合祷言每次治疗时有12%几率在目标身上留下恢复效果。

恢复
让目标满怀对圣光的信仰，在15秒内恢复1,528点生命值。

spells.description_en:
A quick shot causing 139 Physical damage.

Reduces the cooldown of Kill Command by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh:
一次快速射击，造成136点物理伤害。

使杀戮命令的冷却时间缩短1秒。

spells.description_en:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
连击点数的上限额外提高1点。

消耗5点连击点数以上的终结技产生的效果得以加强，并且终结技造成的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Activating Bestial Wrath grants 1 charge of Barbed Shot.
spells.description_zh: 激活狂野怒火会获得1层倒刺射击。

spells.description_en: Backstab and Shadowstrike have a 15% chance to create a Shadow Clone that repeats the attack for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
spells.description_zh: 背刺和暗影打击有15%的几率创造一个暗影克隆体，该克隆体会重复这次攻击，造成相当于正常伤害50%的暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Haste increased by 1.5%.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高1.5%。

spells.description_en: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 你从猩红之瓶、治疗药水和治疗石获得的治疗效果提高25%。

spells.description_en:
Call down a burst of energy, causing 462 Arcane damage to the target, and 323 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 10 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Generates 8 Astral Power.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一股爆发能量，对目标造成466点奥术伤害，并对10码范围内的所有其他敌人造成330点奥术伤害。目标超过8名时造成的伤害降低。

产生8点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Celestial bodies align, maintaining both Eclipses and granting 10% haste for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 调动星体，同时开始日蚀和月蚀，使急速提高10%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: A burst of light heals the target and 4 injured allies within 40 yards for 2,195, and applies Atonement for 60% of its normal duration.
spells.description_zh: 圣光爆发，为一个友方目标及其周围40码内最多4名受伤的盟友恢复2,208点生命值，并对其施放救赎，持续时间为通常持续时间的60%。

spells.description_en: Your ranged auto attacks have a 10% chance to trigger Lock and Load, causing your next Aimed Shot to cost no Focus and be instant.
spells.description_zh: 你的远程自动攻击有10%几率触发荷枪实弹，使你的下一次瞄准射击变为瞬发且不消耗集中值。

spells.description_en:
Your Blood Plague and Death and Decay deal damage 15% more often.

Additionally, your Blood Plague leeches 85% more Health.
spells.description_zh:
你的血之疫病和枯萎凋零造成伤害的几率提高15%。

你的血之疫病会额外吸取85%的生命值。

spells.description_en: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh: 消耗符文能量的技能会使你的近战攻击速度提高6%，持续10秒，最多叠加3次。

spells.description_en: Each Rune spent during Remorseless Winter increases its damage by 10%, and extends its duration by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冷酷严冬期间每消耗一个符文，就会使冷酷严冬造成的伤害提高10%，并使其持续时间延长0.5秒。

spells.description_en:
Raise Dead summons an additional skeletal archer at your command that shoots Blighted Arrows.

Blighted Arrow
An unholy arrow that deals 11 Shadow damage. When consuming Sudden Doom, your Death Coil commands your archer to fire an additional Blighted Arrow at 80% effectiveness. Epidemic will instead cause Blighted Arrow to ricochet and hit up to 5 additional targets.
spells.description_zh:
亡者复生会额外召唤一个骷髅射手听从你的命令并发射枯萎箭矢。

枯萎箭矢
进行一次邪恶射击，造成11点暗影伤害。消耗末日突降时，你的凋零缠绕会命令射手以80%效果额外射出一发枯萎箭矢。扩散会使枯萎箭矢进行弹射，并最多额外命中5个目标。

spells.description_en:
Smash the target, dealing 77 Physical damage and generating 3 charges of Bone Shield.

 Bone Shield
Surrounds you with a barrier of whirling bones, increasing Armor by 110. Each melee attack against you consumes a charge. Lasts 30 sec or until all charges are consumed.
spells.description_zh:
猛击目标，造成77点物理伤害，并获得3层白骨之盾。

 白骨之盾
用旋转的白骨屏障将你包围，使你的护甲值提高110点。每次对你发动的近战攻击都会消耗一层效果。持续30秒或直到所有层数被消耗完毕为止。

spells.description_en:
Your auto attacks have a chance to summon a Bloodworm.

Bloodworms deal minor damage to your target for 15 sec and then burst, healing you for 15% of your missing health.

If you drop below 50% health, your Bloodworms will immediately burst and heal you.
spells.description_zh:
你的自动攻击有几率召唤一只血虫。

血虫会在15秒内攻击你的目标，造成少量伤害，然后在你身边爆炸，为你恢复生命，数值相当于你所损失的生命值的15%。

如果你的血量降至50%以下，你的血虫会立即产生爆炸并治疗你。

spells.description_en:
Corruption is now permanent and deals 15% increased damage.

Duration reduced to 24 sec against players.
spells.description_zh:
腐蚀术变为永久效果，造成的伤害提高15%。

对玩家的持续时间缩短至24秒。

spells.description_en: Seed of Corruption now embeds demon seeds into 2 additional nearby enemies at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 腐蚀之种现在会以50%的效果向附近额外的2个敌人身上植入恶魔之种。

spells.description_en: Demonic forces suck 6 of your Wild Imps toward the target, and then cause them to violently explode, dealing 510 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔之力将你的6只野生小鬼吸引到目标周围，然后使其发生强烈的爆炸，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成513点暗影烈焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Conflagrate reduces the cast time of your next Incinerate, Chaos Bolt, or Soul Fire by 30%. Maximum 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧将使你的下一个烧尽或混乱之箭或灵魂之火的施法时间缩短30%。最多可拥有2次使用次数。

spells.description_en: Incinerate now also hits all enemies near your target for 25% damage.
spells.description_zh: 烧尽现在还会击中目标周围所有的敌人，对其造成25%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Launches 15 bolts of felfire over 2.7 sec at random targets afflicted by your Immolate within 40 yds. Each bolt deals 148 Fire damage to the target and 75 Fire damage to nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 向40码以内被你的献祭影响的目标随机射出15枚邪火箭矢，持续2.7秒。每枚箭矢对目标造成150点火焰伤害，并对目标附近的敌人造成74点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Slip into the nether when you active Blur, increasing movement speed by 100% and becoming immune to damage for 2.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你激活疾影时滑入虚空，移动速度提高100%且免疫所有伤害，持续2.5秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Psychic Scream by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 心灵尖啸的冷却时间缩短10秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Spirit of Redemption by 50% and the range of its spells by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 救赎之魂的持续时间延长50%，法术射程延长50%。

spells.description_en:
Summons darkness around you in an 8 yd radius, granting friendly targets a 15% chance to avoid all damage from an attack. Lasts 8 sec.

Chance to avoid damage increased by 100% when not in a raid.
spells.description_zh:
在你周围8码范围内召唤黑暗，使友方目标有15%的几率避开攻击。持续8秒。

不在团队中时，避免伤害的几率提高100%。

spells.description_en: Drinking from your Brews has a 100% chance to toss a keg high into the air that lands nearby after 3 sec, dealing 34 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用所有酒类技能时，有100%的几率将一个酒桶掷向空中，3秒后在附近落下，对周围8码范围内的所有敌人造成34点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Blackout Kick also empowers your next ability:

 Tiger Palm: Damage increased by 100%.

 Keg Smash: Reduces the remaining cooldown on your Brews by 2 additional sec.
spells.description_zh:
幻灭踢还将强化你的下一个技能：

猛虎掌：伤害提高100%。

醉酿投：你所有酒类技能的剩余冷却时间额外缩短2秒。

spells.description_en:
Stagger is 5% more effective at delaying damage.

Purifying Brew refunds 4.0 sec of its cooldown if cast at Elevated Stagger.
spells.description_zh:
醉拳化解伤害的效果提高5%。

活血酒在强化醉拳时施放，可以返还4.0秒冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Each successive attack that triggers Combo Strikes in a row grants 1% increased damage, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 每次触发组合拳的连续攻击都会使伤害提高1%，最多叠加5次。

spells.description_en: Chills the target with frost, causing 272 Frost damage and reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 用寒冷的冰霜冲击目标，造成272点冰霜伤害并使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Garrotes applied from stealth or during the Improved Garrote window silence their target for 5 sec.

Enemies silenced by Garrote deal 15% reduced damage for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
潜行或强化锁喉期间施放的锁喉会使目标沉默5秒。

被锁喉沉默的敌人造成的伤害降低15%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Movement speed increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 移动速度提高15%。

spells.description_en: Holy Shock reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 1.5 sec and Crusader Strike reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 1.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击使审判的冷却时间缩短1.5秒，十字军打击使审判的冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

spells.description_en: Opportunity increases the damage of Pistol Shot by an additional 20%. Each charge of Opportunity consumed by Pistol Shot generates 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh: 可乘之机使手枪射击的伤害额外提高20%。手枪射击每消耗一层可乘之机，可以生成1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Gain 30 Energy over 3 sec when you enter Stealth or activate Shadow Dance.
spells.description_zh: 进入潜行或激活暗影之舞后，将在3秒内获得 30点能量。

spells.description_en: The cooldowns of your Holy Words are reduced by an additional 10% when you cast the relevant spells.
spells.description_zh: 当你施放对应的法术时，圣言术的剩余冷却时间额外缩短10%。

spells.description_en: When your Power Word: Shield is completely absorbed, you restore 0.5% of your maximum mana.
spells.description_zh: 当你的真言术：盾吸收伤害达到最大值时，你恢复最大法力值的0.5%。

spells.description_en: Ironbark increases healing from your heal over time effects by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 铁木树皮会使你的持续治疗法术的治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 30 sec.

While channeling Tranquility, you take 0% reduced damage and are immune to knockbacks.
spells.description_zh:
宁静的冷却时间缩短30秒。

引导宁静时，你受到的伤害降低0%，而且你免疫击退效果。

spells.description_en: Shatters a line of earth in front of you with your main hand weapon, causing 88 Flamestrike damage to any enemy hit.
spells.description_zh: 用主手武器击碎前方直线上的大地，对被击中的敌人造成89点烈焰打击伤害。

spells.description_en: Mastery: Lightbringer now increases your healing based on the target's proximity to either you or your Beacon of Light, whichever is closer.
spells.description_zh: 精通：光明使者现在将按照目标距离你或你的圣光道标中较近的一方的距离提高治疗量。

spells.description_en: Increases the range of all of your spells by 5 yards.
spells.description_zh: 使你的所有法术的射程提高5码。

spells.description_en:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing the damage of your spells by 10% and your armor by 125%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.
spells.description_zh:
变形进入枭兽形态，法术伤害提高10%，护甲值提高125%，并免疫变形效果。

变形可以解除你身上的移动限制效果。

spells.description_en: Launch a surge of stellar energies at the target, dealing 784 Astral damage.
spells.description_zh: 向目标发射汹涌的星界能量，造成809点星界伤害。

spells.description_en: Call down a burst of energy, causing 354 Arcane damage to the target, and 242 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 5 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一股爆发能量，对目标造成356点奥术伤害，并对5码范围内的所有其他敌人造成253点奥术伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Tranquility extends the duration of all of your heal over time effects by 2 sec every 0.9 sec.
spells.description_zh: 宁静每0.9秒使你所有的持续治疗效果持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: Evangelism increases your healing and absorption effects by 15% for 18 sec.
spells.description_zh: 福音使你的治疗和吸收效果提高15%，持续18秒。

spells.description_en: Thunder Focus Tea now empowers your next 2 spells.
spells.description_zh: 雷光聚神茶现在会强化你的下2个法术。

spells.description_en: Increases Enveloping Mist's duration by 1 sec and its healing bonus by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 氤氲之雾的持续时间延长1秒，治疗加成提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Vivify has a 20% chance to cause your next Rising Sun Kick or Enveloping Mist to generate 1 stack of Mana Tea.

Enveloping Mist and Rising Sun Kick have a 20% chance to cause your next Vivify to generate 1 stack of Mana Tea.
spells.description_zh:
活血术有20%的几率使你的下一个旭日东升踢或氤氲之雾生成1层法力茶。

氤氲之雾和旭日东升踢有20%的几率使你的下一个活血术生成1层法力茶。

spells.description_en: Blasts all enemies in front of you, for up to 280 Chaos damage over 1.8 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 冲击你身前的所有敌人，在1.8秒内造成至多283点混乱伤害。目标超过5个时，造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Strikes all enemies nearby for 50 Holy damage every 2 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 每2秒对附近所有敌人造成50点神圣伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain has a chance to empower your next Penance with Shadow, increasing its effectiveness by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：痛有几率用暗影之力强化你的下一次苦修，使其伤害或治疗效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一个巨型土元素保护你和你的盟友，产生大量威胁值并周期性嘲讽敌人，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by 25% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你受到的所有伤害降低25%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Remove all snares and vault away. Nearby enemies take 5 Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 移除所有的诱捕效果并跳开。附近的敌人受到5点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location with 18,330 health for 15 sec. 133 damage from each attack against allies within 10 yards of the totem is redirected to the totem.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个具有18,330点生命的图腾，持续15秒。图腾周围10码范围内的盟友每次受到攻击时，将133点伤害转移到图腾上。

spells.description_en: Conjures a cloud of hypnotic mist that slowly travels forward. Enemies touched by the mist fall asleep, Disoriented for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放一团催眠云雾，缓缓向前移动。接触到雾气的敌人将陷入沉睡，迷惑20秒。

spells.description_en: Allies are healed for 7,545 when you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Sacrifice on them.
spells.description_zh: 当你对盟友施放保护祝福或牺牲祝福时，同时使其获得7,642点治疗。

spells.description_en: You and your pet blend into the surroundings and gain stealth for 1 min. While camouflaged, you will heal for 2% of maximum health every 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你和你的宠物与周围的环境融为一体，获得潜行，持续1分钟。当在伪装状态下时，你每1秒会恢复2%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en:
Your direct damage spells inflict 25% of their damage on all other targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch within 40 yards.

Does not apply to damage from Shadowy Apparitions, Shadow Word: Pain, and Vampiric Touch.
spells.description_zh:
你的直接伤害性法术对40码范围内所有其他受到你的吸血鬼之触影响的目标造成25%的伤害。

对暗影幻灵、暗言术：痛和吸血鬼之触造成的伤害无效。

spells.description_en: When you cast Barbed Shot, your pet stomps the ground, dealing 49 Physical damage to all nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 当你施放倒刺射击时，你的宠物会践踏地面，对所有附近的敌人造成49点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: While Bestial Wrath is active, Cobra Shot resets the cooldown on Kill Command.
spells.description_zh: 当狂野怒火激活时，眼镜蛇射击将重置杀戮命令的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Your movement speed is increased by 30% anytime you have not attacked for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每当你有3秒不攻击时，会使你的移动速度提高30%。

spells.description_en:
Apply a Beacon of Light to your target and 4 injured allies within 30 yds for 9 sec.

All affected allies will be healed for 10% of the amount of your other healing done.
spells.description_zh:
对你的目标和30码范围内的4名受伤的盟友施放一个圣光道标，持续9秒。

所有受到影响的盟友都会同时受到你对其他目标造成的治疗的10%。

spells.description_en: Riptide's initial heal is increased 20% and has a 10% increased critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 激流的初始治疗量提高20%，爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Healing Wave and Chain Heal heal for an additional 15% on targets affected by your Healing Rain or Riptide.
spells.description_zh: 治疗波和治疗链对受到你的治疗之雨或激流影响的目标产生额外的15%的治疗效果。

spells.description_en: 25% of healing done by Flash Heal is replicated to the previous target you healed with those spells.
spells.description_zh: 快速治疗造成的治疗效果的25%会复制到你使用这些法术治疗的上一个目标身上。

spells.description_en: Reset the cooldown of your Holy Words, and enter a pure Holy form for 20 sec, increasing the cooldown reductions to your Holy Words by 200% and reducing their cost by 70%.
spells.description_zh: 重置圣言术的冷却时间，并进入纯粹的神圣形态，使圣言术的冷却时间缩短效果提高200%，消耗降低70%，持续20秒。

spells.description_en: Holy Word: Chastise stuns the target for 4 sec and is not broken by damage.
spells.description_zh: 圣言术：罚将使目标昏迷4秒且不会被伤害打断效果。

spells.description_en:
When Guardian Spirit saves the target from death, it does not expire.

When Guardian Spirit expires without saving the target from death, reduce its remaining cooldown to 60 seconds.
spells.description_zh:
守护之魂成功拯救死亡的目标时，其效果不会立刻消失。

守护之魂在持续时间结束时，如果没有拯救死亡的目标，则剩余冷却时间将缩短至60秒。

spells.description_en: Swiftmend now has 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 迅捷治愈现在可以使用2次。

spells.description_en: When Rejuvenation heals a target below 60% health, they are instantly healed for 115.
spells.description_zh: 当回春术治疗一个生命值低于60%的目标时，会立即为其治疗115点生命值。

spells.description_en: Aura Mastery also increases all healing received by party or raid members within 40 yards by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 光环掌握现在将使40码内的小队和团队成员受到的所有治疗量提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Releases the Light within yourself, healing 5 injured allies instantly and an injured ally every 0.9 sec within 40 yds for 133.

Allies healed also receive 10% increased healing from your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
释放你体内的圣光，立即为5名受伤的盟友恢复133点生命值，并且每0.9秒为40码范围内一名受伤的盟友恢复等量的生命值。

受到治疗的盟友从你的圣光术、圣光闪现和神圣震击法术中受到的治疗效果提高10%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 致盲的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短70%，并会对周围的所有敌人生效。

spells.description_en:
Punctures your target with your shadow-infused blade for 43 Shadow damage, bypassing armor.

Awards 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh:
用灌入暗影能量的武器突刺目标，无视护甲，造成43点暗影伤害。

奖励1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Unleashes the rage of Ursoc for 8 sec, preventing 20% of all damage you take, increasing your damage done by 15%, granting you 20% leech, and reflecting 16 Nature damage back at your attackers.
spells.description_zh: 释放乌索克的怒火，持续8秒，使你受到的所有伤害降低20%，造成的伤害提高15%，获得20%的吸血，并将16点自然伤害反弹给攻击者。

spells.description_en:
Ironfur has a 20% chance to make your next Maul or Ravage free.

Maul and Ravage have a 10% chance to make your next Ironfur free.
spells.description_zh:
铁鬃有20%的几率使你的下一次重殴或毁灭不消耗怒气。

重殴和毁灭有10%的几率使你的下一个铁鬃不消耗怒气。

spells.description_en:
Melee auto-attacks with Flametongue Weapon active have a 5% chance to reduce the cooldown of Lava Lash by 25% and increase the damage of Lava Lash by 20% for 8 sec.

May not occur during an active Hot Hand.
spells.description_zh:
灌注火舌武器激活时的自动攻击有5%的几率使熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短25%，并使熔岩猛击的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

不会在灼热之手触发期间触发效果。

spells.description_en:
Tiger's Fury lasts 5 additional seconds.

Your combo point-generating abilities' direct damage is increased by 40% of your Haste.
spells.description_zh:
猛虎之怒的持续时间延长5秒。

你的产生连击点数的技能的直接伤害提高，比例相当于你的急速的40%。

spells.description_en:
Ferocious Bite deals 15% increased damage.

For each Combo Point spent, Ferocious Bite's primary target takes 6% increased damage from your Cat Form bleed and other periodic abilities for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh:
凶猛撕咬的伤害提高15%。

每消耗一个连击点数，凶猛撕咬的主要目标受到你的猎豹形态的流血和其他周期性效果的伤害提高6%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Your maximum health is increased by 10% and every 15 Rage you spend heals you for 1% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 你的最大生命值提高10%，并且你每使用15点怒气值都能为你恢复1%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en:
Place a Sigil of Silence at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Silences all enemies affected by the sigil for 2 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置放置一个沉默咒符，于2秒后激活。

所有受到咒符影响的敌人将被沉默2秒。

spells.description_en:
Place a Sigil of Chains at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

All enemies affected by the sigil are pulled to its center and are snared, reducing movement speed by 70% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置放置一个锁链咒符，于2秒后激活。

所有受到咒符影响的敌人将被拉到咒符中心，移动速度降低70%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 15 sec and Heroic Leap also increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短15秒，并且在落地之后还会使你的移动速度提高70%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en:
Instantly attack the target, causing 20 damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.
spells.description_zh:
立即攻击目标，造成20点伤害，并为你恢复30%的最大生命值。

杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人，将重置胜利在望的冷却时间并使其不消耗怒气。

spells.description_en: If Cleave or Whirlwind hits 3 or more targets you also Slam your primary target. This Slam deals 50% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 如果顺劈斩或旋风斩命中了至少3个目标，你还会对你的主要目标施放猛击。此次猛击额外造成50%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Moonfire and Sunfire damage over time has a chance to call down a falling star, dealing 261 Astral damage and generating 2 Astral Power.
spells.description_zh: 月火术和阳炎术的持续伤害有几率召唤坠星，造成255点星界伤害，并产生2点星界能量。

spells.description_en:
Starsurge and Starfall grant you 2% Haste for 20 sec or until you enter a new Eclipse.

Stacks up to 3 times. Gaining a stack does not refresh the duration.
spells.description_zh:
星涌术和星辰坠落使你获得2%急速，持续20秒，或直到你进入新的日月之蚀状态。

可叠加3次。叠加层数不会刷新持续时间。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Life Cocoon by 45 sec.
spells.description_zh: 作茧缚命的冷却时间缩短45秒。

spells.description_en: Your next 3 Starfires are instant cast and generate 30% increased Astral Power.
spells.description_zh: 你的下3个星火术变为瞬发，且产生的星界能量提高30%。

spells.description_en:
While in combat you generate 1 Astral Power every 2 sec.

While out of combat your Astral Power rebalances to 50 instead of depleting to empty.
spells.description_zh:
在战斗中每2秒获得1点星界能量。

脱离战斗后，你的星界能量会调整至50点，而不会清零。

spells.description_en:
Your dodges, parries, and auto-attacks make your Revenge cost no Rage 20% more frequently and increase the damage your free Revenges deal by 15%. 

Revenge increases the damage of your next Thunder Clap by 8%.
spells.description_zh:
你的躲闪、招架和自动攻击使你的复仇不消耗怒气的几率提高20%，并使不消耗怒气的复仇造成的伤害提高15%。

复仇使你下一次雷霆一击的伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en: You gain 2% Haste for each enemy or ally within 10 yards, up to 8% Haste.
spells.description_zh: 10码内每有一个敌人或盟友，你将获得2%急速，最多可达到8%急速。

spells.description_en: Demoralizing Shout also generates 20 Rage and increases damage you deal to affected targets by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 挫志怒吼同时产生20点怒气，并使你对受到影响的目标造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy that follows the enemy, dealing up to 1,105 Astral damage over 8 sec within its area. Damage reduced on secondary targets.

Generates 40 Astral Power over its duration.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一道纯粹的天界能量追击敌人，在8秒内对区域内的敌人造成最多1,115点星界伤害。对次要目标造成较低的伤害。

持续期间产生40点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Reduces the remaining cooldown on Solar Beam by 15 sec when it interrupts the primary target.
spells.description_zh: 当日光术打断主要目标的施法时，其剩余的冷却时间就会缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Shield Slam generates 2 more Rage and extends the duration of Shield Block by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 盾牌猛击额外产生2点怒气值，并使盾牌格挡的持续时间延长1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Thunder Clap's radius is increased by 50% and it reduces affected target's movement speed by an additional 20%.
spells.description_zh: 雷霆一击的范围扩大50%，并且使受影响目标的移动速度额外降低20%。

spells.description_en: Furiously strikes all enemies in front of you, dealing 748 Physical damage over 2.7 sec. Critical strike chance increased by 50% against any target below 20% health. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 凶猛地攻击前方所有的敌人，造成748点物理伤害，持续2.7秒。对生命值低于20%的目标爆击几率提高50%。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Eye Beam generates 10 Fury every second, has 10% increased duration, and deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 眼棱每秒产生10点恶魔之怒，持续时间延长10%，伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Nature's Swiftness causes your next Regrowth to apply Lifebloom, Rejuvenation, and Wild Growth effects to an ally.
spells.description_zh: 自然迅捷使你下一个愈合为盟友施加生命绽放、回春术和野性成长效果。

spells.description_en:
Sharp brambles protect you, absorbing and reflecting up to 8 damage from each attack.

While Barkskin is active, the brambles also deal 2 Nature damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec.
spells.description_zh:
尖锐的刺藤保护着你，每次受到攻击时吸收并反弹最多8点伤害。

当树皮术激活时，刺藤还会每1秒对附近所有敌人造成2点自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Thrash also generates 3 Rage each time it deals damage, on up to 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 痛击每次造成伤害时还会使你产生3点怒气，最多5个目标。

spells.description_en:
Your damage has a 5% chance to trigger a free automatic Moonfire on that target.

 Moonfire:
When this occurs, the next Moonfire you cast generates 8 Rage, and deals 300% increased direct damage.

 Red Moon:
When this occurs, you gain 1 charge of Lunar Wrath. Each 20 Rage you spend while Red Moon is active consumes a stack to deal 380 additional Arcane damage to its target and heal you for 494.
spells.description_zh:
你的伤害有5%的几率在目标身上自动触发一次没有消耗的月火术。

 月火术：
当此效果发生时，你施放的下一个月火术产生8点怒气，并额外造成300%的直接伤害。

 赤红之月：
当此效果发生时，你获得1层月神之怒。在赤红之月激活期间，每消耗20点怒气会消耗一层该效果，对其目标造成380点额外奥术伤害，并为你治疗494点生命值。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldowns of Barkskin and Survival Instincts by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的树皮术和生存本能的冷却时间缩短12%。

spells.description_en:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.
spells.description_zh:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫所有魔法伤害和有害效果，持续10秒。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律效果，持续30秒。

与保护祝福共享冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Throws a Blessed Hammer that spirals outward, dealing 11 Holy damage to enemies and reducing the next damage they deal to you by 11.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
投掷出一柄祝福之锤，沿螺旋线向外飞出，对敌人造成11点神圣伤害并使其下一次对你造成的伤害降低11点。

产生1层神圣能量。

spells.description_en: Brand yourself and an enemy target with demonic symbols, reducing the damage you take by 40% and instantly dealing 146 Fire damage to the enemy.
spells.description_zh: 用恶魔印记标记你自己和一名敌方目标，使你受到的伤害降低40%，并立即对敌人造成144点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Judgment now has 2 charges, and Grand Crusader now also reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 审判现在有2次使用次数，且大十字军同时会使审判的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Each stack of Thrash reduces the target's damage to you by 3% and increases your damage to them by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 每一层痛击都会使目标对你造成的伤害降低3%，而你对目标造成的伤害提高2%。

spells.description_en: Your Consecration is 15% larger, and enemies within it have 50% reduced movement speed.
spells.description_zh: 你的奉献的影响范围扩大15%，且会使范围内的敌人移动速度降低50%。

spells.description_en:
Summons a beam of lunar light at your target's location, dealing 14 Arcane damage each second to your target and 14 to up to 5 other enemies within 8 yd. 

Lunar Beam also increases your mastery by 18%, and heals you for 999 over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在你的目标位置召唤一道月光，每秒对你的目标造成14点奥术伤害，并对8码内最多5名其他敌人造成14点伤害。

明月普照还使你的精通提高18%，并在8秒内为你恢复958点生命值。

spells.description_en: Avenging Wrath and Sentinel have 50% reduced cooldown and 40% reduced duration.
spells.description_zh: 复仇之怒和戒卫的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短40%。

spells.description_en: During Divine Shield, all targets within 15 yds are taunted.
spells.description_zh: 在圣盾术期间，15码范围内的所有敌人都会被嘲讽。

spells.description_en: When your abilities damage a target below 20% health, you gain 1% increased critical strike chance for 6 sec, stacking up to 30 times.
spells.description_zh: 当你的技能对生命值在20%以下的目标造成伤害时，你的爆击几率提高1%，持续6秒，可叠加最多30次。

spells.description_en:
Your Hex target is slowed by 70% during Hex and for 6 sec after it ends.

Reduces the cooldown of Hex by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的目标受到妖术效果影响时，移动速度降低70%，在妖术效果结束后，减速还会持续6秒。

妖术的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en:
Leech increased by 6%.

Gain an additional 6% leech while Metamorphosis is active.
spells.description_zh:
吸血提高6%。

激活恶魔变形时，你额外获得6%的吸血。

spells.description_en:
Channel an icy beam at the enemy for 3.6 sec, dealing 1,898 Frost damage every 0.45 sec.

Applies 8 stacks of Freezing over its duration.
spells.description_zh:
对敌人引导一道寒冰光束，持续3.6秒，每0.45秒造成1,898点冰霜伤害。

在其持续时间内施加8层冻结效果。

spells.description_en: Casting Arcane Intellect summons a Familiar that attacks your enemies and increases your maximum mana by 10% for 1 hour.
spells.description_zh: 施放奥术智慧会召唤一个魔宠攻击你的敌人，并使你的最大法力值提高10%，持续1小时。

spells.description_en: Spell damage increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 法术伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Causes your next 2 Arcane Blasts to be instant cast.
spells.description_zh: 使你的下2个奥术冲击变为瞬发。

spells.description_en: Your Fireball and Pyroblast spells always deal a critical strike when the target is above 90% health.
spells.description_zh: 你的火球术和炎爆术对生命值在90%以上的目标总会产生爆击。

spells.description_en: Arcane Barrage deals 8% increased damage per target it hits beyond the first.
spells.description_zh: 奥术弹幕每额外击中一个目标，造成的伤害就提高8%。

spells.description_en: Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 火焰冲击获得额外1层充能，冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Frostbolt grants you Fingers of Frost 25% more often and Brain Freeze 20% more often.
spells.description_zh: 你的寒冰箭触发寒冰指的几率提高25%，触发冰冷智慧的几率提高20%。

spells.description_en: Frost Nova now has 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜新星现在可以使用2次。

spells.description_en: Your spells have a chance to grant you 15% Haste for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术有一定几率使你的急速提高15%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Places a phantom singularity above the target, which consumes the life of all enemies within 15 yards, dealing 828 damage over 14.3 sec, healing you for 25% of the damage done.
spells.description_zh: 在目标上方召唤一个诡异魅影，吸收15码范围内所有敌人的生命，在14.3秒内造成828点伤害，并为你进行治疗，治疗量相当于造成伤害的25%。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Darkglare from the Twisting Nether that increases the damage of your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 20% while active.

The Darkglare will serve you for 20 sec, blasting its target for 1,880 Shadow damage, increased by 10% for every damage over time effect you have active on their current target.
spells.description_zh:
从扭曲虚空召唤一只黑眼，激活期间使你的痛楚，腐蚀术和痛苦无常的伤害提高20%。

黑眼会为你效命，持续20秒，冲击目标，造成1,845点暗影伤害。你在其当前目标身上每有一个持续伤害效果激活，就会使此伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec while still controlling your own mind. Does not work versus Demonic, Mechanical, or Undead beings or players. This spell shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.
spells.description_zh: 控制一个等级不超过你的等级+1的目标，持续30秒，同时保持自身清醒。对恶魔、机械或亡灵类目标或玩家无效。此法术与其他迷惑类法术共享递减效果。

spells.description_en:
Blur now reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.

Additionally, damage taken below 35% Health is reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
疾影现在使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

此外，当你的生命值降至35%以下时，受到的伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en:
Summons a stand of 3 Treants for 10 sec which immediately taunt and attack enemies in the targeted area.

Generates 20 Astral Power.
spells.description_zh:
召唤3个树人，持续10秒，立即嘲讽并攻击目标区域内的敌人。

产生20点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown on Vampiric Blood by 2.0 sec per 10 Runic Power spent.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗10点符文能量，便使吸血鬼之血的冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 反魔法护罩的冷却时间缩短20秒，持续时间和吸收量提高40%。

spells.description_en: Execute is usable on targets below 35% health and its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀现在可以对生命值低于35%的目标使用，冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

spells.description_en: Blade Dance deals 101 Chaos damage to the first target struck.
spells.description_zh: 刃舞对击中的第一个目标造成101点混乱伤害。

spells.description_en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase your damage by 5% for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔追击和复仇回避使你的伤害提高5%，持续20秒。

spells.description_en: Instantly strike the target and 1 other nearby enemy, causing 69 Physical damage, and reducing enemies' movement speed by 20% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 立即对目标及附近的另外1名敌人发动打击，造成68点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低20%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Drains 89 health from the target over 2.7 sec. The damage they deal to you is reduced by 15% for the duration and 5 sec after channeling it fully.

You can move, parry, dodge, and use defensive abilities while channeling this ability.

Generates 20 additional Runic Power over the duration.
spells.description_zh:
在2.7秒内从目标身上吸取89点生命值，目标在持续期间和完整引导后的5秒内对你造成的伤害降低15%。

你可以在引导此技能时移动、招架、躲闪或使用防御技能。

在持续期间额外产生20点符文能量。

spells.description_en: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 生命值低于30%时，受到的伤害降低20%。

spells.description_en: Each charge of Bone Shield increases your maximum health by 1%.
spells.description_zh: 每一层白骨之盾都会使你的最大生命值提高1%。

spells.description_en:
When Frost Strike damages an enemy with 5 stacks of Razorice it will consume them to deal an additional 115% damage.

Frostbane consumes the Razorice on your main target to deal an additional 300% damage.
spells.description_zh:
如果目标身上已经有了5层锋锐之霜效果，冰霜打击会消耗这些效果，并造成115%的额外伤害。

霜噬会消耗你主要目标身上的锋锐之霜，额外造成300%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Consuming the Killing Machine effect has a 20% chance to grant you 1 Rune.
spells.description_zh: 消耗杀戮机器的效果时有20%的几率使你获得1枚符文。

spells.description_en: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
spells.description_zh: 自动攻击有一定几率产生3点符文能量。

spells.description_en: Casting Howling Blast with Rime active causes jagged icicles to fall on enemies nearby your target, applying Razorice and dealing 8 Frost damage.
spells.description_zh: 白霜激活时施放凛风冲击会使锐利的冰块砸向目标附近的敌人，施加锋锐之霜效果，造成8点冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh:
致盲你前方锥形区域的目标，使其迷惑地乱走，持续5秒。伤害会解除该效果。

当致盲冰雨结束时，敌人会减速50%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的50%。

spells.description_en:
A sweeping attack that strikes all enemies in front of you for 17 Frost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. 

Consumes Killing Machine to have its critical strikes deal 4 times the normal damage.
spells.description_zh:
一次横扫攻击，打击你前方所有的敌人，造成17点冰霜伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

消耗杀戮机器使爆击造成4倍的普通伤害。

spells.description_en: Plagues deal 15% more damage over time in 75% of their duration.
spells.description_zh: 疫病在持续时间的前75%内造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: The infected claws of your ghouls have a chance to sicken the foe, dealing 5 Shadow damage over 12 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.
spells.description_zh: 食尸鬼受感染的爪子有几率使敌人染病，在12秒内造成5点暗影伤害。再次施加时，任何剩余伤害都会添加到新效果中。

spells.description_en: Strike your target dealing 44 Shadow damage, applying 4 Festering Wounds and sending you into an Unholy Frenzy increasing all damage done by 20% for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 打击目标，造成44点暗影伤害，施加4层溃烂之伤，同时你进入邪恶狂热状态，造成的所有伤害提高20%，持续20秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Immolation Aura by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环的爆击几率提高6%。

spells.description_en: While you have at least 5 Rejuvenations active, Regrowth's cost is reduced by 60% and critical chance is increased by 60%.
spells.description_zh: 当你有至少5个激活的回春术时，愈合的消耗降低60%，爆击几率提高60%。

spells.description_en: Consuming a Soul Fragment reduces all damage you take by 3% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗一个灵魂残片会使你受到的所有伤害降低3%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Summons a totem at the target location for 30 sec. All allies within 20 yards of the totem gain 10% increased health. If an ally dies, the totem will be consumed to allow them to Reincarnate with 20% health and mana.

Cannot reincarnate an ally who dies to massive damage.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续30秒。图腾周围20码内的盟友生命值提高10%。如果一名盟友死去，将使其起死回生，恢复20%的生命和法力值，同时图腾将会被消耗。

如果盟友一次承受了大量伤害而死，将无法被复活。

spells.description_en: Targets you heal with Healing Wave, Chain Heal, or Riptide's initial heal gain 5% increased health for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 受到你的治疗波、治疗链或激流的初始治疗而恢复生命值的目标，其生命值提高5%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Carve into the soul of your target, dealing 171 Fire damage and an additional 107 Fire damage over 3 sec.  Immediately shatters 3 Soul Fragments from the target and 1 additional Soul Fragment every 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 切割目标的灵魂，造成171点火焰伤害，并在3秒内额外造成105点火焰伤害。立即从目标身上切下3个灵魂残片，在此后每1秒额外产生1个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura increases your movement speed by 10% and its duration is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环使你的移动速度提高10%，并且其持续时间延长50%。

spells.description_en:
Place a Sigil of Misery at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Causes all enemies affected by the sigil to cower in fear, disorienting them for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置放置一个悲苦咒符，于2秒后激活。

所有受到咒符影响的敌人将在恐惧中畏缩，迷惑15秒。

spells.description_en: Soul Cleave heals for an additional 78.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂裂劈的治疗效果提高78。

spells.description_en: Every 1 sec, Fiery Brand spreads to one nearby enemy.
spells.description_zh: 每1秒烈火烙印都会扩散到附近一个敌人的身上。

spells.description_en: You take 10% reduced damage while Enrage is active.
spells.description_zh: 激怒激活时受到的伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en:
Sustaining fatal damage instead transforms you to Metamorphosis form.

This may occur once every 8 min.
spells.description_zh:
受到致命伤害时你会变成恶魔形态。

此效果每8分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Your Sigils activate 1 second faster.
spells.description_zh: 你的咒符的激活速度加快1秒。

spells.description_en: Avenger's Shield also shields you for 8 sec, absorbing 75% as much damage as it dealt, up to 50% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 复仇者之盾为你提供吸收护盾，吸收的伤害量相当于其造成伤害的75%，最多吸收50%的最大生命值，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 隐形术的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en:
Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning make your target a Lightning Rod for 8 sec.
 
Lightning Rods take 10% of all damage you deal with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.
spells.description_zh:
闪电箭和闪电链使目标变成引雷针，持续8秒。
 
你的闪电箭和闪电链造成伤害时，引雷针会承受总伤害量的10%。

spells.description_en: Thrash, Swipe, Moonfire, and Maul have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown on Mangle, and to cause it to generate an additional 4 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 痛击，横扫，月火术或重殴有15%几率重置裂伤的冷却时间，并使它额外产生4点怒气。

spells.description_en: Stormstrike damage is increased by 20%, and Stormstrike and Lava Lash have a 100% chance to generate 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.
spells.description_zh: 风暴打击的伤害提高20%。风暴打击和熔岩猛击有100%的几率产生1层漩涡武器。

spells.description_en: Unleash the fel within you, damaging enemies directly in front of you for 159 Fire damage over 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 释放体内的邪能，在2秒内对正前方的敌人造成159点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Fires an explosive shot at your target that lasts for 3 sec. Every 1 sec the target burns for 108 Fire damage and explode, dealing 50% of the damage to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 向目标射出一发爆炸射击，持续3秒。每1秒目标会因燃烧而受到105点火焰伤害并引发爆炸，对8码内的所有敌人造成相当于该伤害50%的伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。

spells.description_en:
Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

While active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.
spells.description_zh:
汲取暗影界的力量，解除所有定身效果并使你的移动速度提高70%，持续4秒。任何行动都会取消此效果。

在此期间，任何效果都不会使你的移动速度减速至正常的170%以下。

spells.description_en: Teleports you 20 yds forward, unless something is in the way. Unaffected by the global cooldown and castable while casting.
spells.description_zh: 将你向前传送20码，路线上有阻挡物则会停止。不受公共冷却时间影响，并可在施法过程中施放。

spells.description_en: You heal for 3% of all Fire damage you deal.
spells.description_zh: 造成火焰伤害时，为自己恢复相当于伤害值3%的生命。

spells.description_en: Eye Beam causes you to enter demon form for 5 sec after it finishes dealing damage.
spells.description_zh: 眼棱造成伤害结束后会使你进入恶魔形态，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Removes all Disease effects from a friendly target.
spells.description_zh: 移除一个友方目标身上所有的疾病效果。

spells.description_en: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects.
spells.description_zh: 净化一个友方目标，移除所有中毒效果和疾病效果。

spells.description_en: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting Physical damage. Damage varies by shapeshift form.
spells.description_zh: 横扫附近的敌人，造成物理伤害。伤害由变形形态决定。

spells.description_en: Bloodthirst always Enrages you the first time you strike a target and it has a 15% increased chance to trigger Enrage.
spells.description_zh: 你首次击中一个目标时，嗜血总会使你进入激怒状态，并且会使触发激怒的几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: The damage of Smite and Penance is increased by 8%, and Penance increases or decreases your target's movement speed by 25% for 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 惩击和苦修造成的伤害提高8%，并且苦修会使目标的移动速度提高或降低25%，持续2秒。

spells.description_en:
You become the ultimate crusader of light, for 15 sec. Auto-attack damage is increased by 1,000%, Judgment and Crusader Strike heal up to 5 injured allies within 40 yds for 55% of the damage done, split evenly among them.

This spell is replaced with Crusader Strike while active.

Crusader Strike:
Strike the target for 48 Physical damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
你化身成为圣光的终极战士，持续15秒。自动攻击伤害提高1,000%，审判和十字军打击会治疗40码范围内最多5名受伤的盟友，治疗量相当于技能造成伤害的55%，由这些盟友均摊。

此法术激活时会被十字军打击替代。

十字军打击：
打击目标，造成49点物理伤害。

产生1层神圣能量。

spells.description_en:
Fire a shot that tears through your enemy, causing them to bleed for 150 damage over 12 sec. If Barbed Shot is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Barbed Shot.

Generates 20 Focus over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
射出箭矢撕裂敌人，使其流血，在12秒内造成150点伤害。如果再次施放倒刺射击，所有剩余伤害都会叠加到新的倒刺射击效果上。

在8秒内生成20点集中值。

spells.description_en: Imprisons a demon, beast, or humanoid, incapacitating them for 1 min. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 禁锢一个恶魔、野兽或人型生物，使其瘫痪，持续1分钟。伤害可能取消此效果。只能对一个目标使用。

spells.description_en: Removes all Poison and Disease effects from the target.
spells.description_zh: 移除目标身上所有的中毒和疾病效果。

spells.description_en: Every 20 Fury spent reduces the remaining cooldown of Demon Spikes by 1.00 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗20点恶魔之怒，使恶魔尖刺剩余的冷却时间缩短1.00秒。

spells.description_en:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 5% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 45%.
spells.description_zh:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.2%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的5%。

你的护甲值提高45%。

spells.description_en:
While you have at least 5 Bone Shield charges, the cost of Death Strike is reduced by 5 Runic Power.

Additionally, your maximum Runic Power is increased by 10.
spells.description_zh:
当你有至少5层白骨之盾的充能时，灵界打击消耗的符文能量降低5点。

此外，你的符文能量最大值提高10点。

spells.description_en: Your Heart Strike generates 2 additional Runic Power per target hit.
spells.description_zh: 心脏打击每击中一个目标就额外产生2点符文能量。

spells.description_en: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 将敌方目标举到空中，用黑暗能量扼住他们的咽喉，使其昏迷5秒。

spells.description_en: Holy Power spending abilities have a 15% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 15% increased damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 消耗神圣能量的技能有15%的几率会使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能不消耗资源，并且伤害和治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura's initial burst has a chance to shatter Soul Fragments from enemies.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环的初始爆炸有几率从敌人身上炸出灵魂残片。

spells.description_en:
Become an unstoppable storm of destructive force, striking all nearby enemies for 668 Physical damage over 5.4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

You are immune to movement impairing and loss of control effects, but can use defensive abilities and can avoid attacks.
spells.description_zh:
化作一股具有毁灭性力量的旋转风暴，打击附近所有目标，在5.4秒内造成662点物理伤害。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

你将免疫所有的移动限制和失控效果，可以使用防御技能并躲避攻击。

spells.description_en:
Bombards your target with a Void Volley and twists your Shadowform with void magic, increasing your spell damage by 20% for 20 sec. 

During Voidform, Void Volley replaces this spell and can be used up to 3 times.

 Void Volley
Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for 362 Shadow damage.

Generates 10 Insanity.
spells.description_zh:
以虚空齐射轰炸目标，并以虚空魔法扭曲你的暗影形态，使你的法术伤害提高20%，持续20秒。

虚空形态下，虚空齐射将取代此法术，最多可使用3次。

 虚空齐射
释放一股纯粹虚空能量汇集的齐射，向你的目标发射10发飞弹，并向你目标10码范围内所有敌人额外发射1发飞弹，每发造成362点暗影伤害。

产生10点狂乱值。

spells.description_en:
Throws a whirling weapon at your target that chases nearby enemies, inflicting 371 Physical damage to all enemies over 12 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Enemies damaged by Ravager take 50% additional damage from your Bleeds for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
向目标投掷一把旋转的武器，追击附近的敌人，在12秒内对所有敌人造成共计381点物理伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

受到破坏者伤害的敌人从你的流血效果中受到的伤害提高50%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Divine Steed now has 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 神圣马驹现在可使用2次。

spells.description_en: Regrowth's initial heal has a 40% increased chance for a critical effect if the target is already affected by Regrowth.
spells.description_zh: 如果目标已经受到愈合影响，则愈合的初始治疗的爆击几率提高40%。

spells.description_en:
Rejuvenation's duration is increased by 3 sec.

Regrowth's duration is increased by 3 sec when cast on yourself.
spells.description_zh:
回春术的持续时间延长3秒。

对自身施放愈合的持续时间延长3秒。

spells.description_en: Shred deals 25% increased damage and Swipe deals 25% increased damage against bleeding targets.
spells.description_zh: 面对受流血效果影响的敌人时，撕碎造成的伤害提高25%，此外，横扫对流血的目标造成的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Reduce the cooldown of Bestial Wrath by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂野怒火的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: For each Arcane Charge, Arcane Barrage hits 1 additional nearby target for 40% damage.
spells.description_zh: 每有一层奥术充能，奥术弹幕就可以额外击中附近的1个目标，对其造成40%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Judgment deems the target unworthy, preventing the next 1,835 damage dealt by the target.
spells.description_zh: 审判将目标判定为失格者，抵挡其接下来造成的1,835点伤害。

spells.description_en:
Judgment causes the target to take 20% increased damage from your next Holy Power ability.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
审判使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能对目标造成的伤害提高20%。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Smite prevents the next 684 damage dealt by the enemy.
spells.description_zh: 惩击会抵挡敌人接下来造成的684点伤害。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使疾跑的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的物理伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: Conflagrate gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧获得一层额外充能。

spells.description_en:
Charge to your target and deal 43 Fire damage.

Generates 15 Fury.
spells.description_zh:
冲向目标，造成43点火焰伤害。

产生15点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Hammer of Justice's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 制裁之锤的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Agony, Corruption, Unstable Affliction, Seed of Corruption, and Shadow Bolt deal up to 40% increased damage on targets below 35% health. Damage increase is higher against lower health targets.
spells.description_zh: 痛楚、腐蚀术、痛苦无常、腐蚀之种和暗影箭对生命值低于35%的目标额外造成最多40%的伤害。对生命值越低的目标造成的伤害越高。

spells.description_en: Resets the cooldown of your Ice Barrier, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Cold, and Ice Block.
spells.description_zh: 重置你的寒冰护体、冰霜新星、冰锥术、深寒凝冰和寒冰屏障的冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Shields you in flame, absorbing 9,165 damage for 1 min.

Melee attacks against you cause the attacker to take 60 Fire damage.
spells.description_zh:
为你施加烈焰护盾，吸收9,165点伤害，持续1分钟。

对你进行近战攻击的攻击者将受到60点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en:
Shields you with an arcane force, absorbing 9,165 damage and reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 1 min.

The duration of harmful Magic effects against you is reduced by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
为你施加奥术护盾，吸收9,165点伤害，使受到的魔法伤害降低15%，持续1分钟。

你身上所有有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短25%。

spells.description_en: Critical strikes with Between the Eyes deal 2.5 times normal damage.
spells.description_zh: 正中眉心爆击时，将造成相当于普通伤害2.5倍的伤害。

spells.description_en: Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify gain an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 圣言术：静和圣言术：灵可以多使用一次。

spells.description_en: Omen of Clarity now triggers 30% more often, can accumulate up to 2 charges, and increases the damage of your next Shred or Swipe by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 清晰预兆的触发频率提高30%，最多可累积2层，并使你的下一个撕碎或横扫的伤害额外提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your auto-attacks deal an additional 45 Physical damage and have a 25% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Shield Slam.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击额外造成46点物理伤害，并有25%的几率重置盾牌猛击的剩余冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Arcane Missiles and Evocation can now be channeled while moving.
spells.description_zh: 奥术飞弹和唤醒现在可以在移动中引导。

spells.description_en: Arcane Missiles fires 2 additional missiles.
spells.description_zh: 奥术飞弹额外发射2枚飞弹。

spells.description_en: Moonfire reduces damage dealt to you by -1%.
spells.description_zh: 月火术使目标对你造成的伤害降低-1%。

spells.description_en: Atonement reduces damage taken by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 救赎会使受到的伤害降低2%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Desperate Prayer by 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 绝望祷言的冷却时间缩短20秒。

spells.description_en: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage and lasts 5 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：盾吸收的伤害提高20%，持续时间延长5秒。

spells.description_en: When Holy Word: Serenity or Holy Word: Sanctify finish their cooldown, you emit a burst of light that heals up to 5 injured targets within 40 yards for 472.
spells.description_zh: 当圣言术：静或圣言术：灵的冷却时间结束后，你会放出一道圣光，为40码内最多5个受伤的目标恢复460点生命值。

spells.description_en: Vampiric Touch also applies Shadow Word: Pain to the target. Shadow Word: Pain lasts an additional 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 吸血鬼之触还会对目标施加暗言术：痛。暗言术：痛额外持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Shadow Dance increases all ability damage by 5%, and Shadowstrike and Shuriken Storm damage by an additional 5%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影之舞使所有技能伤害提高5%，暗影打击和袖剑风暴的伤害额外提高5%。

spells.description_en: Consume up to 5 Soul Fragments then explode, dealing 69 Fire damage to nearby enemies, increased by 20% per fragment consumed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 消耗最多5个灵魂残片，然后爆炸，对附近敌人造成69点火焰伤害，每消耗一个灵魂残片，伤害提高20%。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Shift into Cat Form and increase your movement speed by 200%, reducing gradually over 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 变形进入猎豹形态，并使你的移动速度提高200%，在之后的5秒内加速效果逐渐降低。

spells.description_en:
Gain Inexorable Assault every 4 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Obliterate consumes up to 3 stacks, dealing an additional 9 Frost damage for each stack consumed.
spells.description_zh:
每4秒获得酷寒突袭，最多叠加5次。

湮灭消耗最多3层酷寒突袭，每消耗一层额外造成9点冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en: Envenom has a 5% chance per combo point spent to smash a vial of poison at the target's location, creating a pool of acidic death that deals 54 Nature damage over 2 sec to all enemies within it.
spells.description_zh: 施放毒伤时，每消耗一个连击点数就有5%的几率向目标位置投掷一瓶剧毒，形成一滩致命酸液，在2秒内对其中的所有敌人造成54点自然伤害。

spells.description_en:
Lash out at your enemies, dealing 110 Radiant damage to all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, and applying Truth's Wake, burning the targets for an additional 67 damage over 9 sec.

Demon and Undead enemies are also stunned for 5 sec.

Generates 3 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
猛击你的敌人，对你前方14码范围内的所有敌人造成112点光辉伤害，并且施加真理觉醒燃烧目标，在9秒内造成额外67点伤害。

恶魔和亡灵敌人还将昏迷5秒。

产生3层神圣能量。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Blind by 25% and increases its range by 5 yds.
spells.description_zh: 致盲的冷却时间缩短25%，射程扩大5码。

spells.description_en: Activating Adrenaline Rush improves the result of your next Roll the Bones by one level.
spells.description_zh: 使用冲动后，下一次命运骨骰的结果将提升一个等级。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Grappling Hook by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 抓钩的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en:
Shoot a stream of 7 shots at your target over 1.8 sec, dealing a total of 257 Physical damage. Usable while moving.

Each shot generates 3 Focus.
spells.description_zh:
在1.8秒内，朝你的目标射出7支箭矢，总共造成254点物理伤害。可在移动时使用。

每支箭矢可产生3点集中值。

spells.description_en: After using Vanish or Shadow Dance, your next Cheap Shot is free and ignores its cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 在进入潜行或使用暗影之舞后，你的下一次偷袭不消耗能量，并忽略冷却时间。

spells.description_en: When Multi-Shot hits 3 or more targets, your next Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire will ricochet and hit up to 5 additional targets for 60% of normal damage.
spells.description_zh: 当多重射击击中3名或以上目标时，你的下一个瞄准射击或急速射击将会弹射并击中最多5名额外目标，对其造成相当于正常情况60%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Slash all enemies in front of you for 163 Chaos damage, causing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance to deal 91 Chaos damage to them for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 斩击你身前的所有敌人，造成160点混沌伤害，使混乱打击和刃舞对其造成91点混乱伤害，持续4秒。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en: The final slash of Blade Dance inflicts an additional 25 Chaos damage.
spells.description_zh: 刃舞的最后一次斩击会造成额外的25点混乱伤害。

spells.description_en: Activating Eye Beam reduces the cooldown of your next Eye Beam by 2.5 sec, stacking up to 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 激活眼棱使你的下一个眼棱冷却时间减少2.5秒，最多减少10秒。

spells.description_en: Unleash a torrent of Fel energy, rapidly consuming Fury to inflict 12 Chaos damage to all enemies within 12 yds, lasting 8 sec or until Fury is depleted. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 爆发出洪流般的邪能能量，快速消耗恶魔之怒，对12码范围内的所有敌人造成12点混乱伤害，持续8秒或直至恶魔之怒耗尽。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Give the command to kill, causing your pet to savagely deal 105 Physical damage to the enemy.

Generates 15 Focus.
spells.description_zh:
发出杀戮命令，使你的宠物立即狂野地攻击目标，造成105点物理伤害。

产生15点集中值。

spells.description_en:
Hurl a bomb at the target, exploding for 55 Fire damage in a cone and coating enemies in wildfire, scorching them for 44 Fire damage over 6 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Deals 80% increased damage to your primary target.
spells.description_zh:
朝目标投掷一枚炸弹，爆炸对锥形范围内的敌人造成54点火焰伤害，并用野火将其点燃，在6秒内造成44点火焰伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

对主要目标造成的伤害提高80%。

spells.description_en:
Aimed Shot causes your next Arcane Shot or Multi-Shot to deal 50% more damage and cost 60% less Focus.

Precise Shots benefits Kill Shot's damage at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
瞄准射击使你的下一次奥术射击或多重射击造成的伤害额外提高50%，集中值消耗降低60%。

弹无虚发以100%的效果为夺命射击提供伤害加成。

spells.description_en: Rain a volley of arrows down over 6 sec, dealing up to 693 Physical damage to any enemy in the area, and gain the effects of Trick Shots for as long as Volley is active.
spells.description_zh: 在6秒内进行一连串的射击，对区域内的敌人造成至多703点物理伤害，只要乱射激活就能获得技巧射击的效果。

spells.description_en: You and your pet gain 10% attack speed for every bleeding enemy within 12 yds.
spells.description_zh: 在12码范围内每有一名敌人流血，你和你的宠物就能获得10%的攻击速度。

spells.description_en: Kill Command increases the direct damage of your other abilities by 15%, stacking up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令使你其他技能的直接伤害提高15%，最多可叠加3次。

spells.description_en: Your ranged ability critical strikes cause the target to bleed for an additional 10% of the damage dealt over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的远程技能爆击时，会使目标流血，在6秒内造成额外10%伤害。

spells.description_en: Trueshot's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 百发百中的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Your next 12 damaging single-target abilities hit 1 additional target within 8 yds for 75% damage. Lasts 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的下12个单体伤害性技能会击中8码范围内1个额外目标，造成75%的伤害，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: While transformed into a Ghost Wolf, you gain 5% increased movement speed and 5% damage reduction every 1 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
spells.description_zh: 当变形为幽魂之狼形态时，每过1秒，你的移动速度就会提高5%，伤害减免提高5%，最多叠加4次。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢会使旭日东升踢和怒雷破的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Overpower's impact causes a seismic wave, dealing 49 damage to all enemies in a 10 yd line around your target. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Dreadnaught benefits from all effects that modify Overpower's damage.
spells.description_zh:
压制会引起地震波，对目标周围10码直线上的所有敌人造成48点伤害。目标超过5个后伤害降低。

悍勇无畏会从所有能影响压制伤害的效果中获益。

spells.description_en: Smash the ground and shatter the armor of all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 105 Physical damage and increasing damage you deal to them by 30% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 猛击地面并粉碎10码范围内所有敌人的护甲，造成106点物理伤害，并使你对其造成的伤害提高30%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Your auto-attacks generate 10% more Rage.

Killing an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的自动攻击会额外产生10%的怒气。

消灭一名敌人会立即产生5点怒气，并使你的移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Windfury has a 10% additional chance to trigger and its damage is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 风怒触发几率额外提高10%，伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en:
Channel a torrent of void energy into the target, dealing 3,985 Shadow damage over 3 sec and tearing open an Entropic Rift.

 Entropic Rift
Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 228 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.

Generates 24 Insanity over the duration.
spells.description_zh:
对目标引导一股虚空能量流，在3秒内造成3,948点暗影伤害，并撕开一道熵能裂隙。

 熵能裂隙
心灵震爆撕开一道追踪敌人的熵能裂隙，持续8秒。位于路径中的敌人处于范围内时，每0.9秒受到227点暗影伤害。

持续过程中产生24点狂乱值。

spells.description_en: Your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction deal damage 10% faster.
spells.description_zh: 你的痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常造成伤害的速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: When your Dreadstalkers charge into battle, their Dreadbite attack now hits all targets within 8 yards and deals 10% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 当你的恐惧猎犬冲进战场时，恐惧之咬造成的伤害提高10%，且会攻击8码内的所有目标。

spells.description_en: Summon a Vilefiend to fight for you for the next 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤邪犬在接下来的15秒内为你作战。

spells.description_en: Instantly sacrifice up to 2 Wild Imps, generating 2 charges of Demonic Core that cause Demonbolt to deal 30% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 立刻牺牲最多2个野生小鬼，获得2层恶魔之核。恶魔之核可以使恶魔之箭额外造成30%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Wildfire Bomb now has 2 charges, and the initial explosion deals 15% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 野火炸弹现在有2次使用次数，且初始爆炸伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.
spells.description_zh: 使扫堂腿的范围提高4码。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage you and your pet take by 30% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你和你的宠物受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en:
Summon a Demonic Tyrant that damages your target for 15 sec. 

Damage dealt by Demonic Tyrant is increased by 10% for each Wild Imp and Dreadstalker active.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个恶魔暴君攻击目标，持续15秒。

每存在一个野生小鬼和恐惧猎犬，恶魔暴君造成的伤害就提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Heals all allies within 40 yards for 487, and applies Renew and 2 stacks of Prayer of Mending to each of them.
