Cooldown reduced by 15 sec when you cast Holy Word: Serenity or Holy Word: Sanctify.
spells.description_zh:
为40码内所有盟友恢复481点生命值，并对所有盟友施放恢复和2层愈合祷言。

每当你施放圣言术：静或圣言术：灵时冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: While your initial Infernal is active, every Soul Shard you spend has a 15% chance to summon an additional Infernal that lasts 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在你手动召唤的地狱火存在期间，你每消耗一块灵魂碎片，就有15%的几率额外召唤一只持续8秒的地狱火。

spells.description_en: Chaos Bolt consumes up to 5 sec of Immolate's damage over time effect on your target, instantly dealing that much damage.
spells.description_zh: 混乱之箭最多消耗掉目标身上5秒的献祭的持续伤害效果，并立刻造成同等的伤害。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Aspect of the Cheetah, and Aspect of the Turtle are reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 猎豹守护和灵龟守护的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Your Call Pet additionally summons the pet from the bonus slot in your stable. This pet will obey your Kill Command, but cannot use pet family abilities.
spells.description_zh: 你的召唤宠物技能可以额外召唤兽栏的附加栏位中的宠物。该宠物会服从你的杀戮命令，但无法使用宠物技能。

spells.description_en: Infuse your Felguard with demonic strength and command it to charge your target and unleash a Felstorm that will deal 300% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 将恶魔力量注入你的恶魔卫士，命令它向你的目标冲锋并发动魔刃风暴，使其造成的伤害提高300%。

spells.description_en: Tear open a portal to the nether above the target location, from which several Bilescourge will pour out of and crash into the ground over 6 sec, dealing 104 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置上空撕开一道通往虚空的传送门，让数只灾怨蝇从中涌出并撞向地面，持续6秒，对8码内的所有敌人造成106点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Shadow Bolt and Demonbolt deal 2% additional damage per demon you have summoned.
spells.description_zh: 你每召唤了一个恶魔，就会使暗影箭和恶魔之箭造成的伤害提高2%。

spells.description_en: You passively summon a Wild Imp to fight for you every 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你每12秒自动召唤一个野生小鬼为你而战。

spells.description_en: Tear open a portal to the Twisting Nether for 15 sec. Every time you spend Soul Shards, you will also command demons from the Nether to come out and fight for you.
spells.description_zh: 撕开一道通向扭曲虚空的传送门，持续15秒。每次你消耗灵魂碎片时，还会从扭曲虚空中召唤恶魔来协助你战斗。

spells.description_en: Frailty now also reduces all damage you take from afflicted targets by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 脆弱现在还会使受影响的目标对你造成的所有伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一道持续15分钟的恶魔法阵。施放恶魔法阵：传送可将你传送到恶魔法阵的位置，并移除所有减速效果。

你还学会了：

 恶魔法阵：传送
将你传送到你的恶魔法阵并移除所有移动减速效果。

spells.description_en:
Consuming Hot Streak has a 15% chance to make your next non-instant Pyroblast or Flamestrike cast within 20 sec deal 230% additional damage.

Maximum 2 stacks.
spells.description_zh:
消耗炽热连击有15%的几率使你在20秒内施放的下一个非瞬发的炎爆术或烈焰风暴造成的伤害提高230%。

最多可使用2次。

spells.description_en: Kill Command now has 2 charges, and deals 15% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令现在有2次使用次数，并且造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Frozen Orb makes Blizzard instant cast.

Blizzard damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
寒冰宝珠使暴风雪变为瞬发。

暴风雪伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Exhilaration's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 意气风发的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en:
Charge to your target with your blades out, dealing 299 Physical damage to the target and 134 to all other nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While Blade Flurry is active, damage to non-primary targets is increased by 100%.

Generates 25 Energy over 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
手持利刃向目标发动冲锋，对目标造成299点物理伤害，并对附近所有其他敌人造成129点物理伤害。超过8个目标时伤害降低。

当剑刃乱舞激活时，对非首要目标造成的伤害提高100%。

在5秒内产生25点能量。

spells.description_en: Blade Flurry strikes 3 additional enemies and its duration is increased by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃乱舞额外打击3个敌人，且持续时间延长3秒。

spells.description_en: Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake have a 25% chance to refund all Maelstrom spent.
spells.description_zh: 大地震击、元素冲击和地震术有25%的几率返还消耗的所有漩涡值。

spells.description_en: Kill Command deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Each enemy hit by Blood Boil increases the damage and healing done by your next Death Strike by 8%, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 血液沸腾每击中一个敌人使你的下一次灵界打击的伤害和治疗量提高8%，最多叠加5次。

spells.description_en: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.
spells.description_zh: 枯萎凋零使其范围内的所有敌人移动速度降低90%，此效果每秒衰减10%。

spells.description_en: Death Strike's healing is increased by 5% and grants you 15% Leech for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 灵界打击的治疗效果提高5%，并使你获得15%的吸血，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Deals 997 Astral damage to the target and empowers New Moon to become Half Moon. 

Generates 10 Astral Power.
spells.description_zh:
对目标造成985点星界伤害。将新月强化为半月。

产生10点星界能量。

spells.description_en:
Vivify heals all allies with your Renewing Mist active for 1,254.

Sheilun's Gift's healing is increased by 500% on its primary target.
spells.description_zh:
活血术为所有带有你的复苏之雾效果的盟友恢复1,210点生命值。

神龙之赐对其主要目标的治疗效果提高500%。

spells.description_en:
Unleash a furious frenzy, clawing your target 5 times for 28 Physical damage and an additional 192 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Awards 5 combo points.
spells.description_zh:
倾泄出狂暴的怒火，用你的利爪向目标发动5次扫击，造成28点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成192点流血伤害。

奖励5个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Your periodic heals on targets with Lifebloom have a 8% chance to cause it to bloom.
spells.description_zh: 你对带有生命绽放效果的目标的周期性治疗有8%的几率使其绽放。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick extends your Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist effects by 4 sec, up to 100% of their original duration.
spells.description_zh: 施放旭日东升踢会使你的复苏之雾和氤氲之雾效果的持续时间延长4秒，最多可达基础持续时间的100%。

spells.description_en: Shield Slam deals 15% increased damage and reduces enemies' damage against you by 3% for 9 sec. Multiple punishments may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 盾牌猛击造成的伤害提高15%，并使敌人对你造成的伤害降低3%，持续9秒。多重惩罚可以叠加。

spells.description_en: Avatar increases the damage of Thunder Clap by 50% and reduces its cooldown by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 天神下凡使雷霆一击的伤害提高50%，冷却时间缩短50%。

spells.description_en: Shockwave's range increased by 6 yards and when it strikes at least 3 targets its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 震荡波的范围提高6码，击中至少3个目标时冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Judges the target, dealing 727 Holy damage.
spells.description_zh: 审判目标，造成729点神圣伤害。

spells.description_en:
Sudden Doom triggers 30% more often and can accumulate up to 2 charges.

Summoning a Lesser Ghoul with Scourge Strike reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 2.5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
末日突降的触发几率提高30%，最多可积累2次充能。

以天灾打击召唤出一只次级食尸鬼时，腐化的冷却时间缩短2.5秒。

spells.description_en:
Increases the range of Death Grip by 10 yds.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Death Grip.
spells.description_zh:
死亡之握的射程提高10码。

在你杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人后，立即重置死亡之握的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Shuriken Storm reduces enemies' movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 袖剑风暴使敌人的移动速度降低50%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Consume 1 beneficial Magic effect removing it from the target.
spells.description_zh: 从目标身上移除1个增益魔法。

spells.description_en: Unleashes a vile explosion at the target location, dealing 996 Shadow damage over 10 sec to 8 enemies within 10 yds and applies Agony and Curse of Exhaustion to them.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置释放邪恶的爆炸，在10秒内对10码内的8个敌人造成996点暗影伤害，并对其施加痛楚和疲劳诅咒。

spells.description_en: Summons a frostwyrm who breathes on all enemies within 40 yd in front of you, dealing 105 Frost damage, stunning enemies for 3 sec, and slowing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一头冰霜巨龙，向前方40码内所有敌人发动吐息，造成104点冰霜伤害，使敌人昏迷3秒，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Moonfire deals 10% increased damage and also hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.
spells.description_zh: 月火术造成的伤害提高10%，同时还会击中目标周围15码内的另一个敌人。

spells.description_en:
Sinister Strike has a 30% chance to hit an additional time and grant Opportunity.

 Opportunity
Your next Pistol Shot costs 50% less Energy and deals 100% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
影袭有30%几率额外击中一次，并使你获得可乘之机。

可乘之机
你的下一次手枪射击能量消耗降低50%，伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Zenith is reduced by 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 乾元之巅的冷却时间缩短20秒。

spells.description_en: Armor granted by Shield of the Righteous is increased by up to 60%, based on your missing health.
spells.description_zh: 基于你损失的生命值，正义盾击提供的护甲值提高最多60%。

spells.description_en: Whirlwind deals 50% additional damage when it hits 3 or more targets.
spells.description_zh: 当旋风斩击中3个或更多目标时，该技能额外造成50%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Stagger by 5.0 sec, causing Staggered damage to be dealt to you more gradually.
spells.description_zh: 醉拳的持续时间延长5.0秒，因醉拳而延迟造成的伤害会施加得更加缓慢。

spells.description_en: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.0% Leech.
spells.description_zh: 为你的致命药膏添加吸血效果，使你的吸血提高3.0%。

spells.description_en:
Finishing move that creates shadow clones of yourself. You and your shadow clones each perform a piercing attack on all enemies near your target, dealing Physical damage to the primary target and reduced damage to other targets.
   1 point  : 30 total damage
   2 points: 60 total damage
   3 points: 87 total damage
   4 points: 116 total damage
   5 points: 148 total damage
spells.description_zh:
终结技，产生数个影分身。你和你的每个影分身会对你目标附近的所有敌人施展穿刺攻击，对主要目标造成物理伤害，对其他目标造成较低的伤害。
   1点：30点总伤害
   2点：60点总伤害
   3点：86点总伤害
   4点：120点总伤害
   5点：149点总伤害

spells.description_en: Execute is usable on targets below 35% health.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀可以对生命值低于35%的目标使用。

spells.description_en:
During Pillar of Frost, Frost Strike and Howling Blast always grant Killing Machine and have a 20% chance to generate a Rune.

Additionally during Pillar of Frost, Empower Rune Weapon causes your next Obliterate or Frostscythe to cost no Runes.
spells.description_zh:
冰霜之柱期间，冰霜打击和凛风冲击必定触发杀戮机器，并有20%几率产生一个符文。

此外，冰霜之柱期间，符文武器增效使你的下一个湮灭或冰霜之镰不消耗符文。

spells.description_en: Arcane Pulse has a 50% chance to repeat its explosion at 30% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 奥术脉冲有50%的几率以30%的效果重复一次爆炸。

spells.description_en:
Finishing move that deals instant damage and applies Rip to all enemies within 10 yards. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 11 plus Rip for 4 sec
   2 points: 16 plus Rip for 6 sec
   3 points: 22 plus Rip for 8 sec
   4 points: 27 plus Rip for 10 sec
   5 points: 32 plus Rip for 12 sec
spells.description_zh:
终结技，立即造成伤害，并对10码范围内的所有敌人施加割裂效果。根据连击点数决定持续时间：

   1点：造成11点伤害，割裂效果持续4秒
   2点：造成16点伤害，割裂效果持续6秒
   3点：造成22点伤害，割裂效果持续8秒
   4点：造成27点伤害，割裂效果持续10秒
   5点：造成32点伤害，割裂效果持续12秒

spells.description_en:
Increases your critical strike chance by 10% and critical strike damage by 20% for 15 sec.

 Aimed Shot
Cooldown recovers 40% faster.

 Rapid Fire
Cooldown recovers 60% faster.
spells.description_zh:
使你的爆击几率提高10%，爆击伤害提高20%，持续15秒。

 瞄准射击
冷却回复速度加快40%。

 急速射击
冷却回复速度加快60%。

spells.description_en: Dispersion heals you for an additional 25% of your maximum health over its duration and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消散在持续期间内额外为你恢复最大生命值的25%，并且冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Stampeding Roar's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂奔怒吼的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: Stamina increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 耐力提高10%。

spells.description_en: When your Lesser Ghouls expire, they explode in viscera, dealing 15 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
spells.description_zh: 当你的次级食尸鬼消失时，他们的内脏会发生爆炸，对附近的敌人造成15点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en:
Your abilities are amplified based on your current shapeshift form, granting an additional effect.

Wrath, Starfire, and Starsurge deal 30% additional damage and generate 324 Mana.

Bear Form
Ironfur grants 30% additional armor and generates 375 Mana.

 Cat Form
Rip, Ferocious Bite, and Maim deal 60% additional damage and generate 1,500 Mana when cast with 5 combo points.
spells.description_zh:
你的技能受到当前变形形态强化并获得额外效果。 

愤怒、星火术和星涌术额外造成30%的伤害，并恢复324点法力值。

熊形态
铁鬃额外获得30%的护甲并恢复375点法力值。

猎豹形态
割裂、凶猛撕咬和割碎额外造成60%的伤害，并在使用5点连击点数施放技能时恢复1,500点法力值。

spells.description_en: Stormstrike and Lava Lash unleash a Chain Lightning at 100% effectiveness that deals 20% reduced damage with each jump.
spells.description_zh: 风暴打击和熔岩猛击会释放一道100%效果的闪电链，每次跳跃伤害降低20%。

spells.description_en: Frenzied Regeneration and Barkskin increase all healing received by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 狂暴回复和树皮术会使所有受到的治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: Blessing of Freedom increases movement speed by 30%, and you gain Blessing of Freedom when cast on a friendly target.
spells.description_zh: 自由祝福使移动速度提高30%，并使你在对一名友方目标施放自由祝福时获得自由祝福。

spells.description_en:
Place a Kyrian Sigil at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Detonates to deal 131 Arcane damage and shatter up to 3 Lesser Soul Fragments from enemies affected by the sigil. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
将一枚格里恩咒符放置在目标位置，2秒后激活。

引爆咒符会造成131点奥术伤害，并从受到影响的敌人身上炸出最多3个小型灵魂残片。目标多于5个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Fire a resonating arrow to the target location that deals 7 Arcane damage to any enemy in the area, and fill the area with echoing anima for 10 sec. The effect causes your attacks to ignore line of sight to enemies in the area, and you have 30% increased critical strike chance against them. 

Leaving the area of echoing anima will still allow the hunter to ignore line of sight towards the enemy for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh:
向目标区域发射一支共鸣箭，对区域内的所有敌人造成7点奥术伤害，并使该区域充满回荡心能，持续10秒。该效果会使你在该区域的攻击无需在视野中看到敌人，并且对其爆击几率提高30%。

离开回荡心能区域后的4秒内，猎人对敌人的攻击依然无需视野。

spells.description_en: Roll the dice of fate, providing a random combat enhancement for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 摇动命运之骰，获得随机的战斗增益效果，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: When you cast Word of Glory on someone other than yourself, its healing is increased by up to 100% based on the target's missing health.
spells.description_zh: 你对别人施放荣耀圣令时，会根据目标失去的生命值而提高治疗效果，最高可达100%。

spells.description_en: Execute no longer costs Rage and now generates 20 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀不再消耗怒气值，并会产生20点怒气值。

spells.description_en: Execute no longer has a cooldown and if your foe survives, 10% of the Rage spent is refunded.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀不再有冷却时间。如果你的敌人存活下来，将返还10%的怒气消耗。

spells.description_en: Increases Frost Strike and Glacial Advance damage by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜打击和冰川突进的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Vampiric Blood's healing and absorb amount is increased by 5% and duration by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 吸血鬼之血的治疗和吸收量提高5%，持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
spells.description_zh: 不灭决心会使你受到的伤害额外降低15%。

spells.description_en: While Crimson Scourge is active, your next Death and Decay heals you for 13 health per Bone Shield charge and you immediately gain 10 Runic Power.
spells.description_zh: 当赤色天灾激活时，你每拥有一层白骨之盾，下一个枯萎凋零都会为你恢复13点生命值，并且你会立即获得10点符文能量。

spells.description_en: Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, increasing the damage of your Fire spells by 5.0%.
spells.description_zh: 为你的武器注入火元素的力量，持续1小时，并使你的火焰法术伤害提高5.0%。

spells.description_en: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.
spells.description_zh: 现在致伤药膏可以额外叠加2次。

spells.description_en:
Stormstrike has an additional charge.

Stormsurge now also causes your next Stormstrike to deal 25% additional damage as Nature damage, stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh:
风暴打击额外获得一次使用次数。

风暴喷涌还会使你的下一个风暴打击额外造成25%的自然伤害，最多叠加2次。

spells.description_en:
Backstab has 15% increased critical strike chance.

While behind your target, Backstab critical strikes grant Find Weakness for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
背刺的爆击几率提高15%。

当你位于目标背后时，背刺造成爆击会对其施加洞悉弱点，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Shuriken Storm has 15% increased critical strike chance.

Shuriken Storm critical strikes grant Find Weakness for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
袖剑风暴的爆击几率提高15%。

袖剑风暴爆击时会施加洞悉弱点，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Consume Magic generates 20 Fury when a beneficial Magic effect is successfully removed from the target.
spells.description_zh: 从目标身上成功移除增益魔法时，吞噬魔法会产生20点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura increases your armor by 20% and causes melee attackers to suffer 4 Fire damage.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环会使你的护甲提高20%，并且近战攻击者会受到4点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases the range of Disrupt to 10 yds.
spells.description_zh: 瓦解的距离扩大至10码。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura generates an additional 18 Fury over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环会在6秒内额外产生18点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Throw Glaive ricochets to 1 additional target.
spells.description_zh: 投掷利刃会额外弹射1个目标。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Fracture by 1 sec and Throw Glaive by 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 破裂的冷却时间缩短1秒，投掷利刃的冷却时间缩短6秒。

spells.description_en: The chance that Chaos Strike will refund 20 Fury is increased by 30% of your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 混乱打击返还20点恶魔之怒的几率提高，提高量等于你的爆击几率的30%。

spells.description_en: Shift gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 变换获得一层额外充能。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Sigil of Misery by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使悲苦咒符的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Vengeful Retreat reduces the movement speed of all nearby enemies by 70% for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 复仇回避会使附近所有敌人的移动速度降低70%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en: Mastery increases your movement speed.
spells.description_zh: 精通会提高你的移动速度。

spells.description_en: Increases maximum Fury by 20.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔之怒的上限提高20点。

spells.description_en:
Barbed Shot now instantly grants 25 Focus.

Passive Focus generation increased by 75%.
spells.description_zh:
倒刺射击现在立即回复25点集中值。

集中值的被动回复提高75%。

spells.description_en: Every 3 Shields of the Righteous make your next Word of Glory cost no Holy Power. Maximum 2 stacks.
spells.description_zh: 每施放3次正义盾击，你的下一个荣耀圣令就不会消耗神圣能量。最多叠加2层。

spells.description_en: Wildfire Bomb deals 6% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 野火炸弹会额外造成6%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
If a target dies within 7 sec after being struck by Shadow Word: Death, generate 8 Insanity.

When Shadow Word: Death fails to kill a target below 20% health, its cooldown is reset. Cannot occur more than once every 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
如果目标在受到你的暗言术：灭影响后的7秒内被消灭，你会获得8点狂乱值。

如果暗言术：灭没能消灭生命值低于20%的目标，重置其冷却时间。每10秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en:
Arcane damage dealt is increased based on your current mana, up to 6% at full mana.

Mana Regen is increased based on your current mana, up to 20% when out of mana.
spells.description_zh:
奥术伤害基于当前法力值提高，法力全满时最多提高6%。

法力值恢复速度基于当前法力值提高，法力值耗尽时最多提高20%。

spells.description_en: Clearcasting can stack up to 2 additional times.
spells.description_zh: 节能施法可以额外叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Kill Shot now has 2 charges and has its cooldown reduced by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 夺命射击可以使用2次，冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Applies Touch of the Magi to your current target, accumulating 20% of the damage you deal to the target for 12 sec, and then exploding for that amount of Arcane damage to the target and reduced damage to all nearby enemies.

Generates 4 Arcane Charges.
spells.description_zh:
对你当前的目标施加大法师之触，将你在12秒内对目标造成伤害的20%积累起来，然后发生爆炸，对目标造成相当于积累量的奥术伤害，并对所有附近的敌人造成较少的伤害。

产生4层奥术充能.

spells.description_en: Arcane Barrage grants you 2.0% of your maximum mana per Arcane Charge spent.
spells.description_zh: 奥术弹幕每消耗一层奥术充能，就为你恢复2.0%的最大法力值。

spells.description_en:
Bestial Wrath provokes your pets to tear into your target, causing your target to bleed for 42 damage over 12 sec.

Damage from Bloodshed has a 10% chance to summon Dire Beasts.
spells.description_zh:
狂野怒火使你的宠物撕咬目标，使目标流血，12秒内造成42点伤害。

血溅十方造成伤害时有10%的几率召唤凶暴野兽。

spells.description_en: Blazing Barrier gains an additional charge and cauterizes your wounds, healing you for 15% of the damage it absorbs.
spells.description_zh: 烈焰护体额外获得一层充能，并会烧灼你的伤口，为你恢复相当于其吸收伤害量的15%的生命值。

spells.description_en: Prismatic Barrier gains an additional charge and further reduces magic damage taken by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 棱光护体额外获得一层充能，并使受到的魔法伤害进一步降低5%。

spells.description_en:
You exploit the enemy target's weakest point, instantly dealing damage equal to 100% of your maximum health to them.

Only usable on creatures that have less health than you.
spells.description_zh:
你看破敌方目标的死穴，立即对目标造成相当于你的最大生命值100%的伤害。

只可以对生命值比你低的敌人使用。

spells.description_en: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.
spells.description_zh: 现在轮回之触可以对剩余生命值低于15%的目标使用，造成相当于你最大生命值35%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Power Word: Radiance gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：耀可以多使用一次。

spells.description_en:
Summons an effigy of Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent for 25 sec. Yu'lon will heal injured allies with Soothing Breath, healing the target and up to 2 allies for 797 over 4.0 sec. 

Enveloping Mist costs 50% less mana while Yu'lon is active.
spells.description_zh:
召唤青龙玉珑的幻身，持续25秒。玉珑会用抚慰之息来治疗受伤的盟友，在4.0秒内为目标以及最多2名盟友恢复797点生命值。

玉珑幻身激活期间，氤氲之雾消耗的法力值降低50%。

spells.description_en:
Niuzao's teachings allow you to shuffle during combat, increasing the effectiveness of your Stagger by 100%.

Shuffle is granted by attacking enemies with your Keg Smash, Blackout Kick, and Spinning Crane Kick.

 Stagger: You shrug off attacks, delaying a portion of Physical damage based on your Agility, instead taking it over 10 sec. Affects magical attacks at 58% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
砮皂的引导让你可以在战斗中触发酒醒入定，醉拳的效果提高100%。

用醉酿投、幻灭踢和神鹤引项踢攻击敌人可以获得酒醒入定效果。

 醉拳：灵活地应对敌人的攻击，化解部分受到的物理伤害，改为在10秒内承受，化解的比例由你的敏捷决定。对魔法攻击有58%的化解效果。

spells.description_en: A swig of strong brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 2,381 damage.
spells.description_zh: 吐出一大口凝结了纯正真气的烈酒，使其化为天神守卫，吸收2,381点伤害。

spells.description_en: While active, Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox can be recast to cause Niuzao to stomp mightily and knock nearby enemies into the air.
spells.description_zh: 玄牛下凡激活时可以再次施放一次，使砮皂重重践踏地面，并将附近敌人击飞。

spells.description_en:
Fortifying Brew increases Stagger effectiveness by 15% while active.

Combines with other Fortifying Brew effects.
spells.description_zh:
壮胆酒生效期间，醉拳的效果提升15%。

可与其他壮胆酒效果相结合。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Purifying Brew, Celestial Brew, and Celestial Infusion by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 活血酒、天神酒和天神灌注的冷却时间缩短20%。

spells.description_en:
Hurls a flaming keg at the target location, dealing 133 Fire damage to nearby enemies, causing your attacks against them to deal 10 additional Fire damage, and causing their melee attacks to deal 100% reduced damage for the next 3 sec.

Resets the cooldown of Keg Smash.
spells.description_zh:
向目标位置投掷一个燃烧的酒桶，对附近的敌人造成133点火焰伤害。你对这些敌人的攻击会额外造成10点火焰伤害，并使他们在接下来3秒内的近战攻击伤害降低100%。

重置醉酿投的冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Summon an effigy of Chi-Ji for 25 sec that kicks up 3 Gust of Mists when you Blackout Kick, Rising Sun Kick, or Spinning Crane Kick, healing up to 2 allies for 0.

Chi-Ji's presence makes you immune to movement impairing effects, makes Enveloping Mist instant cast, and reduces the mana cost of Enveloping Mist by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
召唤赤精雕像，持续25秒，你使用幻灭踢、旭日东升踢或神鹤引项踢时会踢出3道迷雾之风，为最多2名盟友恢复0点生命值。

赤精的气息会让你免疫移动限制效果，使氤氲之雾成为瞬发，并使氤氲之雾的法力值消耗降低20%。

spells.description_en: Spending Chi has a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick cost no Chi.
spells.description_zh: 消耗真气有几率使你的下一个神鹤引项踢不消耗真气。

spells.description_en: Crusader Strike has a 15% chance to make your next Divine Storm free and deal 15% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 十字军打击有15%的几率使你的下一个神圣风暴不消耗资源，并额外造成15%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
The cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced up to 60%, based on the target's missing health.

Word of Glory's healing is increased by up to 100% on yourself, based on your missing health.
spells.description_zh:
圣疗术的冷却时间最多缩短60%，数值取决于目标失去的生命值。

荣耀圣令对自身的治疗的治疗效果最多提高100%，数值取决于你失去的生命值。

spells.description_en: Fel Devastation heals for an additional 10%, and 50% of its healing is converted into an absorb shield for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 邪能毁灭的治疗效果提高10%，并且治疗的50%会转化为吸收伤害的护盾，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Strike the ground fiercely to expose a faeline for 30 sec, dealing 14 Nature damage to up to 5 enemies, and restores 341 health to up to 5 allies within 30 yds caught in the faeline. Stagger is 5% more effective for 8 sec against enemies caught in the faeline suffer an additional 23 damage.

Your abilities have a 6% chance of resetting the cooldown of Faeline Stomp while fighting on a faeline.
spells.description_zh:
猛击地面，唤出一道妖魂域，持续30秒，对最多5名敌人造成13点自然伤害，并为30码内的最多5名盟友恢复350点生命值。醉拳对妖魂域中的敌人的效果提高5%，持续8秒，敌人会受到22点额外伤害。

在妖魂域上战斗时，你的技能有6%几率会重置妖魂踏的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Casting Starfall extends the duration of active Moonfires and Sunfires by 3.0 sec, up to 28 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放星辰坠落会使激活的月火术和阳炎术的持续时间延长3.0秒，最多延长28秒。

spells.description_en: Barkskin's duration is increased by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 树皮术的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Wild Growth heals 2 additional targets.
spells.description_zh: 野性成长额外治疗2个目标。

spells.description_en: Ambush and Mutilate have a 10% chance to make your next Ambush free and usable without Stealth. Chance increased to 20% if the target is under 35% health.
spells.description_zh: 伏击和毁伤有10%的几率使你的下一个伏击不消耗能量，且无需潜行也可使用。当目标生命值低于35%时，该几率提高至20%。

spells.description_en:
Evoke the energy of Wild Spirits at the target location, dealing 8 Nature damage and apply Wild Mark to all enemy targets within the area for 15 sec.

While the Wild Spirits are active, each damaging ability you or your pet use against a target in the area will strike up to 5 nearby targets for 13 Nature damage.
spells.description_zh:
在目标位置激发野性之魂的能量，对范围内的所有敌方目标造成8点自然伤害并施加野性印记，持续15秒。

野性之魂激活期间，你或你的宠物每次对区域内的目标施放伤害性技能，都会打击附近的最多5个目标，造成13点自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Provoked targets move towards you at 50% increased speed.
spells.description_zh: 激怒的目标向你移动，并且移动速度提高50%。

spells.description_en: Blade Dance now reduces targets' healing received by 50% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 刃舞现在会使目标受到的治疗效果降低50%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
spells.description_zh: 你下一次召唤小鬼、虚空行者、夜魔、魅魔、地狱猎犬或恶魔卫士不消耗能量，施法时间缩短90%。

spells.description_en: Lava Burst has an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 熔岩爆裂可多使用一次。

spells.description_en: Lava Lash cooldown reduced by 6.0 sec, and if Lava Lash is used against a target affected by your Flame Shock, Flame Shock will be spread to up to 5 nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短6.0秒，而且对受你烈焰震击影响的目标使用熔岩猛击时，烈焰震击将扩散至附近最多5个敌人身上。

spells.description_en: Lava Lash and Sundering increases the damage of Flame Shock on its target by 100% for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 熔岩猛击和裂地术现在会使烈焰震击对目标造成的伤害提高100%，持续20秒。

spells.description_en:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
spells.description_zh:
使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续12秒。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

spells.description_en: Chain Lightning now jumps to 2 additional targets and deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 闪电链现在会额外跃向2个目标，且伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: When an ability used during Sweeping Strikes damages a second target, your next Cleave or Whirlwind deals 25% increased damage, stacking up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh: 当横扫攻击期间使用的技能伤害第二个目标时，你的下一个顺劈斩或旋风斩伤害提高25%，最多叠加3次。

spells.description_en: Rampage increases your haste by 2% for 12 sec. Multiple instances of this effect may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 暴怒使你的急速提高2%，持续12秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en:
A word of madness haunts the target's mind, dealing 864 Shadow damage instantly plus an additional 2,905 Shadow damage over 6 sec. Heals you for 30% of damage dealt.

When reapplied to a target, all remaining damage is added to the new effect.
spells.description_zh:
用疯狂之语折磨目标的心智，立即对其造成864点暗影伤害，并且在6秒内额外造成2,905点暗影伤害。为你恢复相当于30%伤害量的生命值。

如果重新施加此效果，所有剩余伤害都会添加到新的效果中。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura damage increases the duration of your Fiery Brand and Sigil of Flame by 0.25 sec.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环造成伤害时会使烈火烙印和烈焰咒符的持续时间延长0.25秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the mana cost of Purify and Mass Dispel by 50% and Dispel Magic by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 纯净术和群体驱散的法力值消耗降低50%，驱散魔法的法力值消耗降低10%。

spells.description_en: Voidform increases your spell damage by an additonal 5% and grants 2 additional uses of Void Volley.
spells.description_zh: 虚空形态使你的法术伤害额外提高5%，并赋予虚空齐射2次额外使用次数。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Madness conjures Shadowy Apparitions that float towards all targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch for 322 Shadow damage.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：癫召唤出暗影幻灵，向所有受到你的吸血鬼之触影响的目标飘去，造成322点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Your healing on allies with your Renew is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你对带有你的恢复效果的盟友造成的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Direct damage you deal to enemies affected by Touch of the Magi, causes an explosion that deals 42 Arcane damage to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 你对受大法师之触效果影响的敌人所造成的直接伤害会引发爆炸，对附近所有敌人造成41点奥术伤害。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Alters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.
spells.description_zh: 改变时间的结构，当你再次施法，或在10秒之后，你的位置和生命值会回到当前状态。死亡或距离太远会导致法术失效。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 操控时间的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en:
Fire Blast damage increased by 15%. 

Your direct damage spells reduce the cooldown of Fire Blast by 0.50 sec.
spells.description_zh:
火焰冲击伤害提高15%。

你的直接伤害法术使火焰冲击的冷却时间减少0.50秒。

spells.description_en:
6.0% of your Fire damage shields you, up to a maximum of 3,055.

Shield and maximum values are doubled while Fiery Brand is active.
spells.description_zh:
你的6.0%的火焰伤害为你产生最多3,055点护盾。

当烈火烙印激活时，护盾和最大吸收量翻倍。

spells.description_en: After entering Stealth, your next combo point generating ability generates full combo points.
spells.description_zh: 进入潜行状态后，你的下一个产生连击点数的技能会产生最大连击点数。

spells.description_en: Frost Nova duration is increased by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜新星的持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: Chaos Strike damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 混乱打击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Soul Cleave deals 60% increased damage to your primary target.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂裂劈对你的主目标造成的伤害提高60%。

spells.description_en: All Fire damage dealt increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 所有火焰伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Mend Pet heals for an additional 25% of your pet's health over its duration, and has a 25% chance to dispel a magic effect each time it heals your pet.
spells.description_zh: 治疗宠物在持续时间内额外为你的宠物恢复25%的生命值，并且每次治疗你的宠物时有25%的几率驱散一个魔法效果。

spells.description_en: When Counter Shot interrupts a cast, gain 30 Focus.
spells.description_zh: 当反制射击中断一次施法，获得30点集中值。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Tar Trap and Freezing Trap is reduced by 5.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 焦油陷阱和冰冻陷阱的冷却时间缩短5.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Kill Command has a 0% chance to cause your next Aimed Shot to grant Deathblow.

 Deathblow
The cooldown of Kill Shot is reset. Your next Kill Shot can be used on any target, regardless of their current health.
spells.description_zh:
杀戮命令有0%的几率使你的下一个瞄准射击获得夺命打击。

 夺命打击
重置夺命射击的冷却时间。你的下一个夺命射击可以作用于任意目标并无视其当前生命值。

spells.description_en:
Rupture the soul of your enemy, dealing 157 Shadowfrost damage and causing the foe to take 20% increased damage from your diseases and minions for 8 sec.

Only usable on enemies below 35% maximum health.

Consumes up to 3 Lesser Ghoul stacks to summon them instantly.
spells.description_zh:
撕裂敌人的灵魂，造成158点暗影冰霜伤害，并使该敌人受到你的疾病和仆从造成的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

只能对最大生命值低于35%的敌人使用。

消耗最多3层次级食尸鬼层数并立即将其召唤出来。

spells.description_en: When Eye Beam finishes fully channeling, your Haste is increased by an additional 8% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 完整施放眼棱之后，你的急速会额外提高8%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Unleash a heavenly blast around the target, dealing 176 Holy damage to all enemies within 10 yds, and call down a hammer that slowly falls from the sky upon the target. 

After 10 sec, they suffer 20% of the Holy damage you dealt to all targets affected by the initial blast during that time.
spells.description_zh:
在目标周围引发天界爆震，对10码范围内的所有敌人造成176点神圣伤害，并召唤一柄战锤从天而降，缓缓坠向目标。

10秒后，目标将受到神圣伤害，数值相当于此期间你对受初始爆震影响的所有目标所造成的神圣伤害的20%。

spells.description_en: During the first 6 sec of every Eclipse, Shooting Stars fall 200% more often.
spells.description_zh: 每次日月之蚀的前6秒里，坠星的触发频率提高200%。

spells.description_en:
When activated, Yu'lon and Chi-Ji apply Chi Cocoons to 5 targets within 40 yds, absorbing 7,332 damage for 10 sec.

Chi-Ji grants 4 stacks of Teachings of the Monastery when invoked.

Yu'lon reduces the cast speed of Enveloping Mist by 30%.
spells.description_zh:
激活后，玉珑和赤精会对40码内的5名目标施加真气之茧效果，吸收7,332点伤害，持续10秒。

赤精在召唤时获得4层禅院教诲。

玉珑会降低氤氲之雾30%的施法速度。

spells.description_en: Call down a blast of heavenly energy, dealing 176 Holy damage to all targets in the area and causing them to take 30% increased damage from your single target Holy Power abilities, and 15% increased damage from other Holy Power abilities for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一道天堂能量，对目标区域中的所有目标造成176点神圣伤害，并使你消耗神圣能量的单目标技能对其造成的伤害提高30%，其他消耗神圣能量的技能对其造成的伤害提高15%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Stormstrike has a 20% chance to strike the target an additional time for 40% of normal damage. This effect can chain off of itself.
spells.description_zh: 风暴打击有20%几率额外攻击目标一次，造成40%的伤害。此效果可以由其本身触发。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 15 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使分筋错骨的冷却时间缩短15秒，扫堂腿的冷却时间缩短10秒。

spells.description_en: Mangle and Maul cause an Infected Wound in the target, reducing their movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 裂伤和重殴会对目标施加感染伤口效果，使其移动速度降低50%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase the damage of your next Fel Rush or Felblade by 300%. Lasts 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔追击和复仇回避会使你的下一个邪能冲撞或邪能之刃的伤害提高300%。持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Interrupt an enemy's spellcasting and prevent any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 打断一名敌人施放的法术，使其无法施放任何同系法术，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Interrupting a spell with Wind Shear reduces all spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用风剪打断法术时，受到的所有法术伤害降低15%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
Inhale, gathering the power of the Dream. Release to exhale, healing yourself and 5 injured allies in a 40 yd cone in front of you for 1,977.

I:   Heals 350 instantly and 1,627 over 16 sec.

II:  Heals 757 instantly and 1,220 over 12 sec.

III: Heals 1,163 instantly and 814 over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
吸一口气，积聚梦境的力量，然后喷吐而出，为你和你前方40码锥形范围内的5名受伤盟友恢复1,977点生命值。

I：立即恢复350点生命值，并在16秒内恢复1,627点生命值。

II：立即恢复757点生命值，并在12秒内恢复1,220点生命值。

III：立即恢复1,163点生命值，并在8秒内恢复814点生命值。

spells.description_en: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 死神脚步，枯萎凋零和死亡之握额外获得1次充能。

spells.description_en: Stretch time around an ally for the next 8 sec, causing 50% of damage they would take to instead be dealt over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在接下来的8秒内延展一个盟友周围的时空，延缓其即将受到的伤害的50%，改为在8秒内承受。

spells.description_en: Lob a ball of flame, dealing 1,701 Fire damage to your target and all enemies within 8 yds.
spells.description_zh: 投掷一发火球，对目标及8码范围内的敌人造成1,675点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Conjure a path of shifting stone towards the target location, rooting enemies for 15 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤层层山岩，将敌人定身，持续15秒。任何伤害都有可能打断该效果。

spells.description_en:
Focus your energies to release a salvo of pure magic, dealing 4,185 Spellfrost damage to an enemy. Damages additional enemies within 25 yds when empowered.

I:   Damages 1 enemy.

II:  Damages 2 enemies.

III: Damages 3 enemies.
spells.description_zh:
集中能量释放一波纯净魔法齐射，对一名敌人造成4,132点法术冰霜伤害。蓄力施放会对25码范围内的额外敌人造成伤害。

I：   对1名敌人造成伤害。 

II：  对2名敌人造成伤害。 

III： 对3名敌人造成伤害。

spells.description_en:
Emerald Blossom sends out 1 flying seedling when it bursts, plus up to 2 additional seedlings if Emerald Blossom heals fewer than 3 allies.

Seedlings each heal an ally up to 40 yds away for 988.
spells.description_zh:
翡翠之花会在绽开时散播出1颗婆娑幼苗，若治疗的盟友少于3名，则额外散播2颗幼苗。

每颗幼苗为最远40码内的一名盟友恢复988点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Take in a deep breath and fly to the targeted location, healing all allies in your path for 1,900 immediately, and 4,253 over 15 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Removes all root effects. You are immune to movement impairing and loss of control effects.

Damage taken while you are flying is absorbed, up to 100% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh:
深深地吸一口气，飞向目标地点，立即为路径上的盟友恢复1,900点生命值，并在15秒内恢复4,167点生命值，目标超过5个时效果降低。

移除所有定身效果。你在飞行时免疫所有的移动限制和失控效果。

吸收你在飞行时受到的伤害，最多相当于你100%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en:
You sound the call of the wild, summoning 2 of your active pets for 20 sec. During this time, a random pet from your stable will appear every 4 sec to assault your target for 6 sec. 

Each time Call of the Wild summons a pet, the cooldown of Barbed Shot and Kill Command are reduced by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
你发出荒野的召唤，在20秒内召唤2只你的活跃宠物。在此期间，你的兽栏每4秒会随机出现一只宠物向目标发动攻击，持续6秒。

每当荒野的召唤召唤出一只宠物，倒刺射击和杀戮命令的冷却时间缩短25%。

spells.description_en:
Carve a deathmark into an enemy, dealing 125 Bleed damage and restoring 80 Energy to you over 16 sec. Damage dealt to the target by your Garrote, Rupture, and Lethal Poisons is increased by 75%.

Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to the target, apply it twice.
spells.description_zh:
在一个敌人身上刻下死亡印记，在16秒内造成125点流血伤害，并为你恢复80点能量。你对目标施放的锁喉、割裂和致命药膏造成的伤害提高75%。

每当你对目标施加致命药膏时，会额外施加一次。

spells.description_en: Disorient an enemy for 20 sec, causing them to sleep walk towards you. Damage has a chance to awaken them.
spells.description_zh: 迷惑一名敌人，持续20秒，使其在梦游中向你走来。伤害有几率将其唤醒。

spells.description_en:
Protect an ally with 15 explosive dragonscales, increasing their Armor by 20% of your own.

Melee attacks against the target cause 1 scale to explode, dealing 114 Volcanic damage to enemies near them. This damage can only occur every few sec.

Blistering Scales can only be placed on one target at a time. Casts on your enemy's target if they have one.
spells.description_zh:
用15枚高爆龙鳞保护一名盟友，使其护甲值提高，数值相当于你自身护甲值的20%。

对受保护目标的近战攻击会引爆一枚龙鳞，对附近的敌人造成114点熔岩伤害。此伤害每数秒只能触发一次。

同一时间只能对一个目标施放炽火龙鳞。若对敌方目标施放，则会施加给该敌人的目标。

spells.description_en:
You and your pet charge your enemy, striking them for a combined 112 Physical damage. You and your pet's bond is then strengthened for 20 sec, causing you and your pet to deal 20% increased damage.

While Coordinated Assault is active, Kill Command's chance to reset its cooldown is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
你和你的宠物冲向敌人，协力对其造成111点物理伤害。随后，你和宠物的关系会更加紧密，持续20秒，使你和宠物造成的伤害提高20%。

协同进攻激活时，杀戮命令重置自身冷却时间的几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: You give the signal, and your pet charges your target, bleeding them for 117 damage over 10 sec and increasing you and your pet's chance to critically strike your target by 30% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你发出信号，使你的宠物冲向敌人，使目标在10秒内流血，造成117点伤害，并且使你和你的宠物对目标的爆击几率提高30%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Fly to an ally and heal them for 6,532, or heal yourself for the same amount.
spells.description_zh: 飞向一个盟友，为其恢复6,532点生命值，或为你恢复等量的生命值。

spells.description_en: Each cast of a Bronze spell causes your next empower spell to reach maximum level in 10% less time, stacking up to 4 times.
spells.description_zh: 每施放一个青铜龙法术，都会使你的下一个蓄力法术达到最高级的时间缩短10%。最多叠加4次。

spells.description_en:
Rewind 30% of damage taken in the last 5 seconds by all allies within 40 yds. Always heals for at least 760.

Healing increased by 200% when not in a raid.
spells.description_zh:
回溯40码内所有盟友此前5秒中受到的所有伤害的30%，至少治疗760点生命值。

不在团队中时，治疗量提高200%。

spells.description_en: Reinforce your scales, reducing damage taken by 30% . Lasts 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 强化你的鳞片，使受到的伤害降低30%。持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Wrap an ally with temporal energy, healing them for 912 and causing your next healing spell to cast an additional time on that ally at 70% of normal healing. Essence spells cannot be Echoed.
spells.description_zh: 用时光能量封裹一名盟友，为其恢复912点生命值，并使你下一个治疗法术对该盟友额外施放一次，治疗量为正常的70%。精华法术无法回响。

spells.description_en:
Expend all of your current mana to annihilate your enemy target and nearby enemies for up to 3,844 Arcane damage based on Mana spent. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

For the next 15 sec, your Mana regeneration is increased by 425% and spell damage is increased by 35%.

Generates Clearcasting.
spells.description_zh:
消耗你当前的所有法力，歼灭你的目标和附近的敌人，根据消耗的法力值，造成最多3,844点奥术伤害。目标超过8个时伤害会降低。

在接下来的15秒内，你的法力恢复速度提高425%，法术伤害提高35%。

产生节能施法。

spells.description_en: Expunge toxins affecting an ally, removing all Poison effects.
spells.description_zh: 净除一名盟友沾染的毒素，移除其所有中毒效果。

spells.description_en: Hover gains 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 悬空额外获得1次使用次数。

spells.description_en: Living Flame deals 111 damage over 12 sec to enemies, or restores 224 health to allies over 12 sec. Stacks 3 times.
spells.description_zh: 活化烈焰会在12秒内对敌人造成113点伤害，或在12秒内为盟友恢复216点生命值。可叠加3层。

spells.description_en:
Reverse an ally's injuries, healing them for 1,092 over 12 sec.

When Reversion critically heals, its duration is extended by 2 sec, up to a maximum of 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
逆转一名盟友的伤势，在12秒内为其恢复1,092点生命值。

当逆转的治疗爆击时，其持续时间延长2秒，最多延长12秒。

spells.description_en: 20% of Flash Heal or Shadow Mend healing on other targets also heals you.
spells.description_zh: 20%的快速治疗或暗影愈合对其他目标造成的治疗也会治疗你。

spells.description_en:
When you or an ally fall below 30% health, a version of yourself enters your timeline and heals them for 19,596. Your alternate self continues healing for 8 sec before returning to their timeline.

May only occur once every 60 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当你或一名盟友的生命值降至30%以下时，另一个时间线中的你会为其恢复19,596点生命值。你的另一个自己会在返回其时间线前继续治疗，持续8秒。

此效果每60秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Wing Buffet's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.
spells.description_zh: 飞翼打击的冷却时间缩短2分钟。

spells.description_en: An explosion bombards the target area with white-hot embers, dealing 5,447 Fire damage to enemies over 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 向目标区域投掷炽燃灰烬，在10秒内对敌人造成5,422点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Pyre has a 15% chance to flare up and explode again on a nearby target.
spells.description_zh: 葬火有15%的几率在一个相邻的目标身上再次爆燃。

spells.description_en: Living Flame has a 20% chance, and Reversion has a 15% chance to make your next Essence ability free.
spells.description_zh: 活化烈焰有20%的几率，逆转有15%的几率使你下一个消耗精华的技能不产生消耗。

spells.description_en: Redirect your excess magic to a friendly healer for 1 hour. When you cast an empowered spell, you restore 0.25% of their maximum mana per empower level. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 将你溢出的魔力转移给一名友方治疗者，持续1小时。当你施放蓄力法术时，每层蓄力都会为其恢复最大法力的0.25%。只能影响一个目标。

spells.description_en:
After casting 6 Pyres, your next Pyre will explode into a Firestorm.

 Firestorm
An explosion bombards the target area with white-hot embers, dealing 5,459 Fire damage to enemies over 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在施放6次葬火后，你的下一个葬火将爆炸成为火焰风暴。

火焰风暴
向目标区域投掷炽燃灰烬，在10秒内对敌人造成5,406点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases your maximum Essence to 6.
spells.description_zh: 你的精华上限提高至6。

spells.description_en: Azure Strike damages 1 additional enemy.
spells.description_zh: 碧蓝打击额外对1个敌人造成伤害。

spells.description_en: Disintegrate channels 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 裂解的引导速度加快20%。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath causes your next Living Flame to strike 1 additional target per empower level.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息会使你的下一个活化烈焰命中额外的目标，每级蓄力增加一个。

spells.description_en: Casting Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace reduces the cast time of your next Living Flame by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 使用翡翠之花或青翠之拥治疗你自己会使你下一个活化烈焰的施法时间缩短40%。

spells.description_en: Every other Emerald Blossom has a 100% chance for one of your Fluttering Seedlings to grow into a new Emerald Blossom.
spells.description_zh: 每间隔一朵翡翠之花有100%的几率使你的一株婆娑幼苗长成新的翡翠之花。

spells.description_en: Your Blue damage increases the damage of your next Pyre by 2%, stacking 20 times.
spells.description_zh: 你的蓝龙伤害使你的下一次葬火的伤害提高2%，可叠加20次。

spells.description_en: Causes your next 3 helpful spells to be duplicated and stored in a time lock. You may reactivate Stasis any time within 30 sec to quickly unleash their magic.
spells.description_zh: 复制你接下来的3个有益法术，将其存入一道时空谜锁。你可以在30秒内随时重新激活静滞，快速释放出其中的魔法。

spells.description_en: Compress time to make your next empowered spell cast instantly at its maximum empower level.
spells.description_zh: 压缩时间，使你下一个蓄力法术变为瞬发，且为最高蓄力等级。

spells.description_en: While in Bear Form, you are healed for 18% of all Arcane damage done.
spells.description_zh: 在熊形态下，你能为自己恢复生命值，其数值相当于你所造成奥术伤害的18%。

spells.description_en: Swoop to an ally and fly with them to the target location. Clears movement impairing effects from you and your ally.
spells.description_zh: 飞向一名盟友，与其一同飞到目标地点。清除你和盟友受到的移动限制效果。

spells.description_en: While in Bear Form, you deal 10% increased Arcane damage.
spells.description_zh: 在熊形态下，你造成的奥术伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath reduces the Essence costs of your next 4 Disintegrates and Pyres by 1. Stacks up to 8 times.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸使你的下4个裂解和葬火的精华消耗降低1点。最多可叠加8次。

spells.description_en: Enemies affected by Fire Breath's damage over time effect take 25% increased damage from your Red spells.
spells.description_zh: 你所施放的红龙法术对受到火焰吐息持续伤害影响的敌人造成的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Disintegrate has a 15% chance each time it deals damage to launch a level 1 Eternity Surge at 40% power.
spells.description_zh: 裂解每次造成伤害时，都有15%的几率对目标发动一次40%威力的1级蓄力的永恒之涌。

spells.description_en: Living Flame deals 10% increased damage and healing and its cast time is reduced by 0.3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 活化烈焰造成的伤害和治疗提高10%，并且施法时间缩短0.3秒。

spells.description_en: Casting an empower spell increases your Essence regeneration rate by 100% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放一个蓄力法术会使你的精华恢复速度提高100%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Your damaging critical strikes deal 230% damage instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh: 你的伤害爆击效果并非通常的200%，改为230%。

spells.description_en: Casting an empower spell increases the damage of your next 2 spells of the same color by 20% within 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放一个蓄力法术会使你接下来施放的2个相同颜色法术的伤害在10秒内提高20%。

spells.description_en: Emerald Blossom heals 2 additional allies.
spells.description_zh: 翡翠之花额外治疗2名盟友。

spells.description_en: Rescue increases movement speed by 100% and allows spells to be cast while moving for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 营救使移动速度提高100%，并且可以在移动中施放，持续3秒。

spells.description_en:
Commune with the Emerald Dream, restoring 20% health and 2% mana every 0.9 sec for 4.5 sec. Overhealing is transferred to an injured ally within 40 yds.

Castable while stunned, disoriented, incapacitated, or silenced.
spells.description_zh:
沟通翡翠梦境，每0.9秒恢复20%的生命值和2%的法力值，持续4.5秒。过量治疗会转移到40码内一名受伤的盟友身上。

可以在昏迷、迷惑、瘫痪或沉默时施放。

spells.description_en: Charge to your target, striking them for 257 Chaos damage, rooting them in place for 1.5 sec and inflicting 188 Chaos damage over 6 sec to up to 5 enemies in your path.
spells.description_zh: 冲向你的目标，对其造成256点混沌伤害，将其定在原地1.5秒，并在6秒内对路径上最多5名敌人造成188点混沌伤害。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath stuns enemies for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸使敌人昏迷3秒。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath's damage is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: The critical strike chance of your spells is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术的爆击几率提高2%。

spells.description_en: Dream Breath healing is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 梦境吐息的治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath and Deep Breath heal 5 nearby injured allies for 80% of damage done to up to 5 targets, split evenly among them.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息和深呼吸会治疗附近5名受伤的盟友，效果相当于对最多5个目标所造成伤害的80%，由治疗的所有盟友均摊。

spells.description_en: You may reactivate Deep Breath within 3 sec after landing to travel back in time to your takeoff location.
spells.description_zh: 你可以在落地后的3秒内再次激活深呼吸，以返回起飞的地方。

spells.description_en: Every 300 Rage you spend causes a burst of restorative energy, healing up to 5 allies within 20 yds for 262.
spells.description_zh: 你每消耗300点怒气，都会爆发出一股治疗能量，为20码内的最多5名盟友恢复262点生命值。

spells.description_en: Let out a bone-shaking roar at enemies in a cone in front of you, increasing the duration of crowd controls that affect them by 50% in the next 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 对你前方锥形区域内的敌人发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，在接下来的10秒内使影响他们的群体控制持续时间提高50%。

spells.description_en: When you take non-periodic damage, you have a chance to cause your next Regrowth to heal for an additional 130%, and to be instant, free, and castable in all forms for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 受到非周期性伤害时，有几率使你的下一个愈合变为瞬发，治疗效果提高130%，不消耗资源，并且在任何形态下都可以使用，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Disintegrate deals 35% more damage and generates 1,080 mana over its duration.
spells.description_zh: 裂解额外造成35%的伤害，并在持续时间内产生1,080点法力值。

spells.description_en:
Increases the damage of Holy Fire by 30%.

Holy Fire deals 75% of its initial damage to all nearby enemies within 12 yards of your target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
神圣之火的伤害提高30%。

神圣之火对目标周围12码内的所有敌人造成75%的初始伤害。目标数量超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: While channeling Divine Hymn, place 2 stacks of Prayer of Mending on up to 3 allies within its range every 0.9 sec.
spells.description_zh: 引导神圣赞美诗期间，每0.9秒为其范围内最多3个盟友施加2层愈合祷言。

spells.description_en: Store 20% of your effective healing, up to 857. Your next damaging Living Flame consumes all stored healing to increase its damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 储存你有效治疗量的20%，最多不超过857点。你的下一个伤害性活化烈焰会消耗所有已储存的治疗量，造成额外的伤害。

spells.description_en: Echo replicates 50% more healing.
spells.description_zh: 回响复制治疗量提高50%。

spells.description_en: Moonfire deals 8% increased damage and also hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.
spells.description_zh: 月火术造成的伤害提高8%，同时还会攻击目标周围15码内的另一个敌人。

spells.description_en:
Holy Word: Chastise causes your next 2 casts of Holy Fire to be instant, cost no mana, and incur no cooldown.

Refreshing Holy Fire on a target now extends its duration by 7 sec.
spells.description_zh:
圣言术：罚使你接下来施放的2个神圣之火变为瞬发，不消耗法力值，并且不触发冷却时间。

在目标身上刷新神圣之火会使其持续时间延长7秒。

spells.description_en: Maul and Raze deal 30% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 重殴和摧折造成的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage and radius of Thrash by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 痛击的范围与伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Frenzied Regeneration heals over 1.0 additional sec and casts Rejuvenation and Regrowth on you at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 狂暴回复的持续时间延长1.0秒，并以100%的效果对你施加回春术和愈合。

spells.description_en: Each successive Penance bolt during a channel deals 5% increased damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 在引导期间，每一发后续的苦修箭矢造成的伤害和治疗效果提高5%。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast has a 100% chance to grant Power of the Dark Side and deals 20% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆有100%的几率提供阴暗面之力，造成20%的额外伤害。

spells.description_en: Pain Suppression also heals your target for 15% of their maximum health and applies Atonement.
spells.description_zh: 痛苦压制也会为你的目标恢复其最大生命值的15%，并会施加救赎。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain deals 5% additional damage and spreads to 1 additional target when you cast Penance to its target.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：痛造成的伤害提高5%，并且当你对其目标施放苦修时会额外向1个目标传播。

spells.description_en:
Pain Suppression gains an additional charge.

Power Word: Shield reduces the cooldown of Pain Suppression by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh:
痛苦压制可以多使用一次。

真言术：盾会使痛苦压制的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Atonements granted by Power Word: Shield last an additional 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：盾施加的救赎效果持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Atonement heals for 10% more when activated by Shadow spells.
spells.description_zh: 暗影法术激活的救赎治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Power Word: Radiance causes your next Penance to fire 3 additional bolts, stacking up to 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：耀使你的下一个苦修额外射出3枚飞弹，最多叠加2层。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast has a 8% chance to make your next Shadow Word: Madness cost no Insanity and deal 20% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆有8%的几率使你的下一个暗言术：癫不消耗狂乱值，并额外造成20%的伤害。

spells.description_en: While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Shadow Word: Madness, and Vampiric Touch active on the same target, your Mind Blast, Void Torrent, Mind Flay, and Void Volley deal 20% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 当暗言术：痛、暗言术：癫和吸血鬼之触同时作用于同一个目标时，你的心灵震爆、虚空洪流、精神鞭笞和虚空齐射会额外造成20%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases your Leech by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的吸血提高2%。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Death deals 50% less damage to you.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：灭对你造成的伤害降低50%。

spells.description_en: Verdant Embrace temporarily bonds your life with an ally, causing your healing on either partner to heal the other for 60% of the amount. Lasts 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 青翠之拥会暂时将你的生命与一名盟友联结在一起，使你对你们其中一人产生治疗效果时，该效果可以让另一名伙伴获得60%的治疗。持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
After conjuring Shadowy Apparitions, gain a stack of Idol of Yogg-Saron. At 20 stacks, you summon a Thing from Beyond that casts Void Spike at nearby enemies for 20 sec.

 Void Spike
Hurls a bolt of dark magic, dealing 357 Shadow damage and 188 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
在生成暗影幻灵后获得一层尤格-萨隆的神像。叠加至20层后，你会召唤一个彼岸之物，对附近的敌人施放虚空之刺，持续20秒。

 虚空之刺
向目标射出一支黑暗魔法箭，造成364点暗影伤害，并对该目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成188点暗影伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
You create Horrific Visions when casting harmful spells on enemies.

At 50 stacks of Horrific Visions, your target sees a nightmare, dealing 691 Shadow damage and granting you 2 Insanity over 3 sec.

At 100 stacks, your target witnesses a vision of N'Zoth, dealing 2,618 Shadow damage and granting you 6 Insanity over 3 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你对敌人施放有害法术时创造惊魂幻象。

惊魂幻象达到50层时，你的目标会看到噩梦，受到691点暗影伤害，并在3秒内为你产生2点狂乱值。

达到100层时，你的目标会见证恩佐斯的幻象，受到2,618点暗影伤害，并在3秒内为你产生6点狂乱值。

spells.description_en: While Shadowfiend, Mindbender, or Voidwraith are active, your haste is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影魔、摧心魔或虚空幽灵激活时，你的急速提高10%。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death cause your Shadowfiend, Mindbender, and Voidwraith to teleport behind your target, slashing up to 5 nearby enemies for 319 Shadow damage and extending their durations by 0.7 sec.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆和暗言术：灭会使你的暗影魔、摧心魔和虚空幽灵传送至目标身后，对附近至多5名敌人发动斩击，造成319点暗影伤害，并使它们的持续时间延长0.7秒。

spells.description_en: Fade reduces damage you take by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 渐隐术会使你受到的伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Increases the maximum health gained from Desperate Prayer by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 从绝望祷言中获得的最大生命值提高10%。

spells.description_en: While above 75% health, the cast time of your Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, and Smite are reduced by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 生命值在75%以上时，你的快速治疗、暗影愈合和惩击的施法时间缩短5%。

spells.description_en:
Power Infusion also grants you its effect at 100% value when used on an ally. 

If no ally is targeted, it will grant its effect at 100% value to a nearby ally, preferring damage dealers.
spells.description_zh:
当对盟友使用能量灌注时，你也会获得100%效果。

如果没有盟友被选中为目标，会以100%的效果赐予附近的一个盟友，优先选择伤害输出者。

spells.description_en: Dream Breath healing increased by 20%, and Living Flame healing increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 梦境吐息的治疗效果提高20%，活化烈焰的治疗效果提高30%。

spells.description_en:
Send forward a vortex of temporal energy, absorbing 2,280 damage on you and any allies in its path. Absorption is reduced beyond 5 targets.

Applies Echo at 30% effectiveness on the first 5 allies it passes through.
spells.description_zh:
向前发射一道时光能量漩涡，为你和路径中的任意盟友吸收2,280点伤害。目标数量超过5个后吸收量降低。

对经过的前5名盟友施加回响，效果为30%。

spells.description_en: Chains of Ice affects 1 additional nearby enemy.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰锁链额外影响1个附近的敌人。

spells.description_en: Increases Leech by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 吸血提高3%。

spells.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。受到失控效果影响时，该加成额外提高6%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤上升气流，将你和20码内最近的4位盟友托举到空中，使你们受到的范围攻击伤害降低20%，移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Cauterize an ally's wounds, removing all Bleed, Poison, Curse, and Disease effects. Heals for 1,330 upon removing any effect.
spells.description_zh: 给盟友的伤口加热，移除所有流血、中毒、诅咒和疾病效果。移除任何效果后恢复1,330点生命值。

spells.description_en: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你的符文熔铸的效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: Increases Haste by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.
spells.description_zh: 灵界打击的消耗减少10点，且治疗效果提高60%。

spells.description_en: Oppressing Roar removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy, and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 压迫怒吼从每个敌人身上移除1个激怒效果，冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Obsidian Scales surrounds you with a Renewing Blaze, causing 100% of the damage it prevented to be healed back over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片用新生光焰环绕着你，将所阻挡伤害的100%转化为治疗效果，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Anti-Magic Zone is reduced by 60 sec and its duration is increased by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 反魔法领域的冷却时间缩短60秒，持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的疾病效果有几率削弱你的敌人，使你对其造成的伤害提高6%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 3% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗一枚符文有几率使你的力量提高3%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
When you fall below 30% health you drain 42 health from nearby enemies, the damage you take is reduced by 10% and your Death Strike cost is reduced by 10 for 8 sec.

Can only occur every 2 min.
spells.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至30%以下时，你会从附近的敌人身上吸取42点生命值，并使你受到的伤害降低10%，你的灵界打击的消耗降低10点，持续8秒。

每2分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Bone Shield increases your Haste by 10% and it can stack 2 additional times.
spells.description_zh: 白骨之盾使你的急速提高10%，可以额外叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Heart Strike damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 心脏打击的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: When Crimson Scourge is consumed, damage taken is reduced by 4% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当赤色天灾被消耗时，受到的伤害降低4%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 扭曲时间，使你和40码内的盟友能够在接下来的10秒内施放一次主要移动技能，无视其冷却状态。

spells.description_en:
Erupt with draconic fury and exhale Pyres at 3 enemies within 25 yds.

For 18 sec, Essence Burst's chance to occur is increased to 100%.
spells.description_zh:
爆发龙族怒火，对25码内的3个敌人施加葬火。

18秒内，精华迸发的发生几率提高至100%。

spells.description_en: Obsidian Scales has an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片可以多使用一次。

spells.description_en: Tail Swipe's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.
spells.description_zh: 扫尾的冷却时间缩短2分钟。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续性伤害效果延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Hover lasts 4 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 悬空的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Essence regenerates 5% faster.
spells.description_zh: 精华的产生速度加快5%。

spells.description_en: Landslide's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, and it can withstand 200% more damage before breaking.
spells.description_zh: 山崩的冷却时间缩短30秒，并且在被打破前能够额外承受200%的伤害。

spells.description_en: While above 75% health, your movement speed is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 当生命值在75%以上时，你的移动速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Magic damage taken reduced by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低2%。

spells.description_en: Living Flame deals 3% more damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 活化烈焰造成的伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

spells.description_en: Hover increases your movement speed by 70% for the first 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 悬空的前4秒内，你的移动速度提高70%。

spells.description_en: Green spells restore 5% more health.
spells.description_zh: 绿龙法术治疗效果提高5%。

spells.description_en: Renewing Blaze restores you more quickly, causing damage you take to be healed back over 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 新生光焰会更高效的治疗你，在4秒内恢复等同于你所受到伤害的生命值。

spells.description_en: Instantly cast Holy Shock, Avenger's Shield, or Judgment on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.
spells.description_zh: 立即对30码范围内最多5个目标施放神圣震击、复仇者之盾或审判。

spells.description_en: Disintegrate and Azure Strike deal 8% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 裂解和碧蓝打击造成的伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en: Azure Strike has a 15% chance to cause an Essence Burst, making your next Disintegrate or Pyre cost no Essence.
spells.description_zh: 碧蓝打击有15%的几率触发一次精华迸发，使你的下一个裂解或葬火不消耗精华。

spells.description_en: Essence Burst stacks 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 精华迸发叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath deals 20% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Eternity Surge hits twice as many targets.
spells.description_zh: 永恒之涌击中的目标数量是原先的两倍。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Madness causes your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch to deal damage 40% faster on all targets for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：癫使你的暗言术：痛和吸血鬼之触对所有目标造成伤害的速度提高40%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en:
Disintegrate reduces the remaining cooldown of your empower spells by 0.50 sec each time it deals damage.

Pyre reduces the remaining cooldown of your empower spells by 0.40 sec per enemy struck, up to 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
裂解每次造成伤害时，会使你的蓄力法术的剩余冷却时间缩短0.50秒。

葬火每击中一名敌人，会使你的蓄力法术的剩余冷却时间缩短0.40秒，最多缩短2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 你的蓄力法术等级上限提高1级，且蓄力至最高等级的速度加快20%。

spells.description_en: Essence Burst has a 20% chance to not be consumed.
spells.description_zh: 精华迸发有20%的几率不会被消耗。

spells.description_en:
Casting an empower spell extends the duration of Dragonrage by 5 sec.

Each time this occurs during Dragonrage, its effectiveness is reduced by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
施放一个蓄力法术可使狂龙之怒的持续时间延长5秒。

狂龙之怒期间，每次此情况出现时，狂龙之怒的效果降低25%。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath damage has 16% chance to cause your next Living Flame to be instant cast, stacking 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息有16%的几率使你的下一个活化烈焰变为瞬发，可以叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain periodic damage has a chance to cause your next Mind Blast to be instant and ignore its cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：痛的周期性伤害有几率使你的下一次心灵震爆变为瞬发并忽略其冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Throw a deadly chakram at your current target that will rapidly deal 22 Physical damage 7 times, bouncing to other targets if they are nearby. Enemies struck by Death Chakram take 10% more damage from you and your pet for 10 sec.

Each time the chakram deals damage, its damage is increased by 15% and you generate 3 Focus.
spells.description_zh:
对你的当前目标掷出一枚死亡飞轮，飞速造成7次物理伤害，每次22点。如果其附近还有其他目标，飞轮还会在多个目标中间来回弹射。被死亡飞轮击中的敌人受到来自你和你的宠物的伤害提高10%，持续10秒。

每次飞轮造成伤害时，伤害都会提高15%，并使你产生3点集中值。

spells.description_en: Blast all targets affected by your Flame Shock within 40 yards with a Primordial Wave, dealing 1,997 Elemental damage.
spells.description_zh: 对40码范围内所有受到你烈焰震击影响的目标释放始源之潮，造成1,997点元素伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Mind Flay by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 精神鞭笞的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en:
Throw a spear at the target location, chaining all enemies in the area to the spear's location and dealing 83 Physical damage instantly and an additional 128 Physical damage over 6 sec. 

While the spear is active, activating this ability will cause you to leap to the spear, dealing 16 Physical damage to all targets.

All damage dealt reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 10 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
向目标位置投掷一柄长枪，将区域内所有敌人束缚在长枪周围，立即造成84点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成128点物理伤害。

长枪激活时，再次使用此技能将使你跃向长枪，对所有目标造成16点物理伤害。

目标数量超过5时造成的所有伤害降低。

产生10点怒气。

spells.description_en:
Conjure a radiant spark that causes 442 Arcane damage instantly, and an additional 322 damage over 12 sec.

The target takes 10% increased damage from your direct damage spells, stacking each time they are struck. This effect ends after 4 spells.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一道璀璨火花，立即造成442点奥术伤害，并在12秒内额外造成322点伤害。

目标受到你的直接法术的伤害提高10%，每次命中都会叠加。此效果在命中4个法术后结束。

spells.description_en: Empower spells increase your Essence regeneration rate by 100% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 蓄力法术会使你的精华恢复速度提高100%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Dream Breath's cooldown is reduced by 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 梦境吐息的冷却时间缩短6秒。

spells.description_en: Your Magic damage done is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你造成的魔法伤害提高2%。

spells.description_en: Your Stamina is increased by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 你的耐力提高6%。

spells.description_en: Red spells deal 20% additional damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 红龙法术造成的伤害和治疗效果额外提高20%。

spells.description_en: Time Dilation gains an additional charge, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 时间膨胀可以额外使用一次，冷却时间缩短10秒。

spells.description_en: 15% of delayed damage from Time Dilation is absorbed.
spells.description_zh: 吸收15%时间膨胀延缓的伤害。

spells.description_en: Temporal Anomaly applies Echo at 30% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 时空畸体会以30%的效果施加回响。

spells.description_en: Temporal Anomaly reduces the cooldowns of your empower spells by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 时空畸体使你的蓄力技能的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Your healing is increased by 10% on targets with your Reversion.
spells.description_zh: 你对带有你所施放逆转的目标造成的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Reversion, Time Dilation, Echo, and Temporal Anomaly last 15% longer and cost 15% less mana.
spells.description_zh: 逆转、时间膨胀、回响以及时空畸体的持续时间延长15%，消耗的法力值降低15%。

spells.description_en:
Increases your maximum Runic Power by 5.

Increases Rune regeneration rate by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
你的符文能量上限提高5点。

符文回复速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Your Living Flame has a 20% chance to cause an Essence Burst, making your next Disintegrate or Pyre cost no Essence.
spells.description_zh: 你的活化烈焰有20%的几率触发一次精华迸发，使你的下一个裂解或葬火不消耗精华。

spells.description_en:
During Deep Breath and Dragonrage you gain the maximum benefit of Mastery: Giantkiller regardless of targets' health.

Unbound Flame always gains the maximum benefit.
spells.description_zh:
深呼吸和狂龙之怒期间，你无视目标生命值，始终获得精通：巨人杀手的最大效果。

释缚烈焰始终获得最大效果。

spells.description_en: Your healing done and healing received are increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 造成和受到的治疗效果提高2%。

spells.description_en:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 50% increased damage to secondary targets.

Remorseless Winter deals 6% increased damage to enemies it hits, stacking up to 10 times.
spells.description_zh:
受白霜强化的凛风冲击会对次要目标额外造成50%伤害。

冷酷严冬对命中的敌人造成的伤害提高6%，最多叠加10层。

spells.description_en: Your Crusader Strike causes enemies struck to deal 10% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的十字军打击会使被击中的敌人对你造成的伤害降低10%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Remorseless Winter damage is increased by 35%. The first time Remorseless Winter deals damage to 3 different enemies, you gain Rime.
spells.description_zh: 冷酷严冬的伤害提高35%。冷酷严冬首次对3名不同的敌人造成伤害后，你获得白霜效果。

spells.description_en: Healing from Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Madness when you are at maximum health will shield you for the same amount. The shield cannot exceed 10% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 在生命值为满的状态下，受到吸血鬼之触和暗言术：癫的治疗会产生吸收护盾，吸收等同于治疗量的伤害。护盾吸收的伤害不会超过你最大生命值的10%。

spells.description_en: Runic Empowerment has a 25% chance to refund 1 additional Rune.
spells.description_zh: 符文强化有25%几率额外返还1个符文。

spells.description_en: Frost Strike and Glacial Advance have a 15% increased chance to trigger Rime and Howling Blast generates 8 Runic Power while Rime is active.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜打击和冰川突进有额外15%的几率触发白霜，当白霜激活时，凛风冲击会产生8点符文能量。

spells.description_en: Consuming Killing Machine grants 1% critical strike chance for 10 sec, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks your next Killing Machine consumes the stacks and grants you 10% increased Frost damage for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗杀戮机器效果会提供1%的爆击几率，持续10秒，最多叠加5层。叠加至5层时，你的下一个杀戮机器会消耗所有层数，使你的冰霜伤害提高10%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Consuming a full Temporal Compression grants you Essence Burst.
spells.description_zh: 消耗一个完整的时光压缩将使你获得精华迸发。

spells.description_en: Each time you gain Essence Burst, your critical heals are 230% effective instead of the usual 200% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每当获得精华迸发，你的爆击治疗效果就会变为230%，而非通常的200%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Consecration heals you and 5 allies within it for 2 every 0.9 sec.
spells.description_zh: 奉献每0.9秒为你和站在其中的5名盟友恢复2点生命值。

spells.description_en: When Pillar of Frost expires, your Strength is increased by 8% for 6 sec. This effect lasts 2 sec longer, up to 20 sec, for each Obliterate and Frostscythe critical strike during Pillar of Frost.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜之柱持续结束时，使你的力量提高8%，持续6秒。冰霜之柱期间每次湮灭或冰霜之镰造成爆击，就会使效果延长2秒，最多延长20秒。

spells.description_en: Thrash and Maul grant you an absorb shield for 35% of the damage dealt for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 痛击和重殴使你获得一个吸收护盾，吸收量相当于其造成伤害的35%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Pillar of Frost now summons a Remorseless Winter that lasts 4 sec longer.

Each enemy Remorseless Winter damages grants you 5% Mastery, up to 26% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh:
冰霜之柱现在会召唤一场持续时间延长4秒的冷酷严冬。

冷酷严冬每伤害一个敌人都会使你获得5%精通，最多26%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Mind Flay has a chance to spawn a Void Tendril that channels Mind Flay or Void Lasher that channels Mind Sear at your target.

 Mind Flay
Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 1,214 Shadow damage over 10 sec and slowing their movement speed by 30%.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.

 Mind Sear
Corrosive shadow energy radiates from the target, dealing 819 Shadow damage over 10 sec to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.
spells.description_zh:
精神鞭笞有几率召唤一个虚空触须，对你的目标引导精神鞭笞；或是召唤一个虚空鞭笞者，对你的目标引导精神灼烧。

精神鞭笞
用暗影能量攻击目标的精神，在10秒内造成1,194点暗影伤害，并使移动速度降低30%。

持续期间产生5点狂乱值。

 精神灼烧
从目标身上散发出腐蚀暗影能量，在10秒内对其周围10范围内的所有敌人造成817点暗影伤害。目标数量超过5个时，造成的伤害降低。

在持续期间产生5点狂乱值。

spells.description_en:
Magus of the Dead grants you 1.0% Haste for 15 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
亡者魔导师使你获得1.0%急速，持续15秒。

多次效果重叠时可叠加。

spells.description_en:
Scourge Strike, Festering Strike, and Death Coil deal 30% additional damage to enemies below 35% health.

Dark Transformation resets Soul Reaper's cooldown and allows it to be used on any target.
spells.description_zh:
天灾打击、脓疮打击和凋零缠绕对生命值低于35%的敌人额外造成30%的伤害。

黑暗突变会重置灵魂收割的冷却时间，并允许对任何目标使用。

spells.description_en: Putrefy deals 20% increased damage, has 2 additional charges and consumes up to 2 available charges.
spells.description_zh: 腐化的伤害提高20%，获得额外2次充能，并最多消耗2层可用充能。

spells.description_en: Dark Transformation increases the attack speed and damage of you and your Monstrosity by 5% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗突变使你与你畸兽的攻击速度与伤害提高5%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Spending Runic Power increases your Strength by 0.50% for 20 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
消耗符文能量会使你的力量提高0.50%，持续20秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Diseased enemies take 1% increased damage from you per disease they are affected by.
spells.description_zh: 你对感染疾病的敌人造成的伤害提高，每有一个疾病效果，就提高1%。

spells.description_en: Heart Strike heals you for 0.25% health for each enemy hit while affected by Blood Plague.
spells.description_zh: 心脏打击每击中一名受血之疫病影响的敌人，都会为你恢复0.25%生命值。

spells.description_en: Dancing Rune Weapon's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and now generates 5 Bone Shield charges.
spells.description_zh: 符文刃舞的冷却时间缩短30秒，并且现在会产生5层白骨之盾。

spells.description_en: Summons 1 additional copy of Dancing Rune Weapon and increases its duration by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 激活符文刃舞会额外召唤出1把符文武器，此外，符文刃舞的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 你获得的治疗效果提高4%。

spells.description_en:
Frenzied Regeneration's healing is increased by up to 80% based on your missing health.

Frenzied Regeneration has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh:
狂暴回复的治疗效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高80%。

狂暴回复额外获得1次使用次数。

spells.description_en:
Stampeding Roar's radius is increased by 30%.

Your movement speed is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
狂奔怒吼的范围和持续时间提高30%。

你的移动速度提高5%。

spells.description_en: For 4 sec after shifting into Bear Form, your health and armor are increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 在变为熊形态之后的4秒内，你的生命值和护甲提高15%。

spells.description_en: When you fall below 40% health, you cast Frenzied Regeneration, up to once every 120 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你的生命值低于40%时，你会施放狂暴回复，每120秒最多触发一次。

spells.description_en: Astral Shift reduces damage taken by an additional 20%.
spells.description_zh: 星界转移使受到的伤害额外降低20%。

spells.description_en: Movement speed increased by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 移动速度提高4%。

spells.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。

spells.description_en: Ghost Wolf removes snares and increases your movement speed by an additional 25% for the first 3 sec. May only occur once every 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 幽魂之狼会移除诱捕效果，且在前3秒内，你的移动速度额外提高25%。每20秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: When you cast Spiritwalker's Grace, you become immune to Silence and Interrupt effects for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放灵魂行者的恩赐之后，你会免疫沉默及打断效果，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Your next healing or damaging Nature spell is instant cast and costs no mana.
spells.description_zh: 你的下一个治疗或伤害性自然法术变为瞬发，且不消耗法力值。

spells.description_en: Elemental Fury increases critical strike damage by an additional 25%.
spells.description_zh: 元素之怒使爆击伤害额外提高25%。

spells.description_en: Reversion instantly heals the target for 15% of damage taken in the last 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 逆转会立即恢复目标在最近5秒内所受伤害的15%。

spells.description_en: While Beast Cleave is active, Kill Command now also strikes nearby enemies for 20% of damage dealt. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 当野兽顺劈激活时，杀戮命令还会对附近的敌人造成20%的伤害。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: All pet damage dealt increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 所有宠物造成的伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Your Healing Surge is 25% more effective on yourself.
spells.description_zh: 你对自己施放治疗之涌时，效果提高25%。

spells.description_en: Cobra Shot Focus cost reduced by 5. Cobra Shot damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 眼镜蛇射击的集中值消耗降低5点。眼镜蛇射击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Ascendance summons a Greater Fire Elemental to rain destruction on your enemies for 20 sec. 

While the Fire Elemental is active, Flame Shock deals damage 33% faster, and newly applied Flame Shocks last 100% longer.
spells.description_zh:
升腾会召唤一个巨型火元素，让毁灭降临到敌人头上，持续20秒。

当火元素激活时，烈焰震击造成伤害的速度加快33%，后续施放的烈焰震击持续时间延长100%。

spells.description_en:
Reduces the cooldown of Flame Shock and Voltaic Blaze by 1.5 sec.

Flame Shock deals damage 15% faster.
spells.description_zh:
烈焰震击和流电炽焰的冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

烈焰震击造成伤害的速度加快15%。

spells.description_en:
Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon consumed has a 0.6% chance to activate Ascendance for 6.0 sec.

 Ascendance
Transform into an Air Ascendant for 15 sec and unleash Doom Winds, reducing the cooldown and cost of Stormstrike by 60%, and transforming your auto attack and Stormstrike into Wind attacks which bypass armor and have a 30 yd range.
spells.description_zh:
每消耗一层漩涡武器有0.6%的几率激活升腾，持续6.0秒。

 升腾
转化成空气升腾者形态，持续15秒，施放毁灭之风。风暴打击的冷却时间和消耗降低60%，并将自动攻击和风暴打击变成风切，无视护甲，攻击距离为30码。

spells.description_en:
Each enemy hit by Avenger's Shield reduces the remaining cooldown on Guardian of Ancient Kings by 1.0 sec.

When you drop below 30% health, you become infused with Guardian of Ancient Kings for 4 sec. This cannot occur again for 45 sec.
spells.description_zh:
复仇者之盾每击中一个敌人，就会使远古列王守卫剩余的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

当你的生命值降至30%以下时，你会受到远古列王守卫的护持，持续4秒。此效果在45秒内不能再次触发。

spells.description_en: Your Avenger's Shield is imbued with holy fire, causing it to deal 4 Holy damage to all enemies within 5 yards of each target hit.
spells.description_zh: 神圣之火包覆着你的复仇者之盾，每击中一个目标，就会对5码内的所有敌人造成4点神圣伤害。

spells.description_en:
Word of Glory heals for an additional 40% over 10 sec.

Increased by 200% if cast on yourself while you are afflicted by a harmful damage over time effect.
spells.description_zh:
荣耀圣令在10秒内额外产生40%的治疗量。

如果在受到有害的持续性伤害效果影响时对自己施放，其治疗效果会提升200%。

spells.description_en: Frozen Orb has a 100% chance to grant Brain Freeze.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰宝珠有100%的几率使你获得冰冷智慧。

spells.description_en: Your Lay on Hands, Divine Shield, Blessing of Protection, and Blessing of Spellwarding have 15% reduced cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 你的圣疗术、圣盾术、破咒祝福和保护祝福的冷却时间缩短15%。

spells.description_en: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.
spells.description_zh: 佯攻和猩红之瓶的能量消耗降低10点。

spells.description_en: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 武器药膏的非伤害性效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: When your primary pet uses Stomp, apply Barbed Shot to a target hit by that Stomp. This Barbed Shot will not cause an extra Stomp.
spells.description_zh: 当你的主要宠物使用践踏时，对一个被该践踏击中的目标施加倒刺射击。该倒刺射击不会额外触发一次践踏。

spells.description_en: Deal 389 Nature damage every 1.8 sec to up to 5 enemies inside of your Healing Rain.
spells.description_zh: 每1.8秒，对你的治疗之雨中最多5个敌人造成385点自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Ice Lance strikes 1 additional target at 50% effectiveness, preferring enemies with more stacks of Freezing.
spells.description_zh: 冰枪术以50%的效果额外攻击1个目标，会优先攻击携带更多冻结层数的敌人。

spells.description_en: Avenger's Shield jumps to 2 additional targets.
spells.description_zh: 复仇者之盾会额外跳向2个目标。

spells.description_en: Kill Command has a 20% chance to also summon a Dire Beast to attack your target for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令有20%的几率召唤一只凶暴野兽攻击你的目标，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Avenger's Shield deals 10% increased damage to its primary target.
spells.description_zh: 复仇者之盾对主目标的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Consuming Precise Shots reduces the cooldown of Aimed Shot by 1.00 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗弹无虚发会使瞄准射击的冷却时间缩短1.00秒。

spells.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial Magic effects.
spells.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除2个有益的魔法效果。

spells.description_en: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 潜行或暗影之舞激活时，你的移动速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Movement speed increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 移动速度提高15%。

spells.description_en: When Avenger's Shield strikes a single enemy, it deals 100% additional Holy damage.
spells.description_zh: 复仇者之盾只打击一个目标时，额外造成100%的神圣伤害。

spells.description_en: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用心灵冰冻成功打断敌人会产生10点符文能量，并使其冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Each Wind Arrow fired reduces the cooldown of Rapid Fire by 0.5 sec, and every 8 Wind Arrows fired increases the duration of your next Trueshot by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 10.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每发射一支风之箭矢都能使急速射击的冷却时间缩短0.5秒，每发射8支风之箭矢都能使下一个百发百中的持续时间延长1.0秒，最多10.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Trick Shots now causes Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire to ricochet to 2 additional targets.

Aspect of the Hydra's damage bonus is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
