技巧射击会使瞄准射击和急速射击向2个额外目标弹射。

多头蛇守护的伤害加成提高15%。

spells.description_en: Frostbolt and Flurry critical strike damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰箭和冰风暴的爆击伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
The damage of your auto-attacks is increased by 25%.

Your Agility is increased by 3%, increased by an additional 1% while dual-wielding.
spells.description_zh:
你的自动攻击伤害提高25%。

你的敏捷提高3%，双持时额外提高1%。

spells.description_en: Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick damage increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 野火炸弹和爆裂火铳的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Flurry has a 12% chance each hit to call down an icy comet, crashing into your target and nearby enemies for 632 Frost damage.

Applies 1 stack of Freezing.
spells.description_zh:
冰风暴每次命中都有12%的几率召唤一颗冰霜彗星，砸向你的目标及其附近敌人，造成632点冰霜伤害。

施加1层冻结效果。

spells.description_en: Raptor Strike damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 猛禽一击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: All damage dealt by your pet is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你的宠物造成的所有伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
You gain 3% of a stat while in each form:

No Form: Haste
Cat Form: Critical Strike
Bear Form: Versatility
Moonkin Form: Mastery
spells.description_zh:
在每种形态下，你会分别获得3%的某种属性值：

无形态：急速
猎豹形态：爆击
熊形态：全能
枭兽形态：精通

spells.description_en: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 切割激活时，每3秒为你恢复最多1%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.
spells.description_zh: 在致盲或闷棍效果结束后的6秒内，敌人的伤害和治疗效果降低30%。

spells.description_en: While in your Consecration and for 4.0 sec after leaving it, your damage taken is reduced by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 当你在奉献范围内，以及离开奉献的4.0秒内，你受到的伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: Consecration lasts 2 sec longer and its damage is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 奉献的持续时间延长2秒，伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Divine Toll's, Holy Armament's, and Holy Prism's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 圣洁鸣钟、神圣军备和神圣棱镜的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Casting Glacial Spike has a 100% chance to grant you Fingers of Frost.
spells.description_zh: 施放冰川尖刺使你有100%的几率获得寒冰指效果。

spells.description_en: Enemies hit by Avenger's Shield deal 10% reduced melee damage to you for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 被复仇者之盾击中的敌人对你造成的近战伤害降低10%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 使你产生连击点数的攻击的爆击几率提高5%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你的武器药膏的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Versatility increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 全能提高3%。

spells.description_en: Ambush generates 1 additional combo point.
spells.description_zh: 伏击额外产生1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 终结技的能量消耗降低6%。

spells.description_en:
Restore 100 Energy.

When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.
spells.description_zh:
恢复100点能量。

当能量低于30点时，喝下一杯蓟叶茶。

spells.description_en: Increases the application chance of your weapon poisons by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的武器药膏生效几率提高5%。

spells.description_en: Garrote and Rupture damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 锁喉和割裂的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Kidney Shot and Rupture also apply Internal Bleeding, dealing up to 84 Bleed damage over 6 sec, based on combo points spent.
spells.description_zh: 肾击和割裂还会造成内出血，根据消耗的连击点数，在6秒内造成最多84点流血伤害。

spells.description_en: Fan of Knives has 5% increased critical strike chance and its critical strikes always apply your weapon poisons.
spells.description_zh: 刀扇的爆击几率提高5%，爆击时必定施加你的武器药膏效果。

spells.description_en: Shadowstep's cooldown is reduced by 33% when used on a target afflicted by your Garrote.
spells.description_zh: 对受到你的锁喉影响的目标施放暗影步时，暗影步的冷却时间缩短33%。

spells.description_en: Fan of Knives has its radius increased to 12 yds, deals 20% more damage, and an additional 10% when striking 5 or more targets.
spells.description_zh: 刀扇的范围扩大至12码，造成的伤害提高20%，击中的目标超过5个时额外造成10%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Garrote deals 50% increased damage and has no cooldown when used from Stealth and for 6 sec after breaking Stealth.
spells.description_zh: 锁喉造成的伤害提高50%。在潜行状态下及脱离潜行状态后6秒内施放锁喉没有冷却。

spells.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.0% for 1 min.
spells.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给你的武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其造成的伤害降低4.0%，持续1分钟。

spells.description_en: Your weapon poisons and Nature or Bleed damage over time abilities deal 1% increased damage to targets for each of your lethal poison or damage over time effects on them.
spells.description_zh: 根据目标身上已有的同类效果数量，你的武器药膏、自然伤害或流血持续伤害效果对目标造成的伤害提高1%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 星界转移的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces all magic damage taken by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的所有魔法伤害降低8%。

spells.description_en: Garrote increases the damage of Ambush and Mutilate on the target by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 锁喉会使你的伏击和毁伤对目标的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高2%。

spells.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, dealing 2 Nature damage and applying Amplifying Poison for 12 sec. Envenom can consume 10 stacks of Amplifying Poison to deal 35% increased damage. Max 20 stacks.
spells.description_zh: 使用致命药膏给你的武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，造成2点自然伤害并施加增效药膏，持续12秒。毒伤可以消耗10层增效药膏，造成的伤害提高35%。最多20层。

spells.description_en: Mutilate deals an additional 25% Bleed damage over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 毁伤会在8秒内额外造成25%的流血伤害。

spells.description_en:
Stamina increased by 8%.

While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 50% faster.
spells.description_zh:
耐力提高8%。

当你的生命值全满时，复生的冷却速度提高50%。

spells.description_en:
Increases your maximum Maelstrom by 50.

Increases Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake damage by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
使你的最大漩涡值提高50点。

大地震击、元素冲击和地震术的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Reduces the Maelstrom cost of Earth Shock and Earthquake by 5.

Reduces the Maelstrom cost of Elemental Blast by 10.
spells.description_zh:
大地震击和地震术消耗的漩涡值降低5点。

元素冲击消耗的漩涡值降低10点。

spells.description_en:
Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake can trigger your Mastery: Elemental Overload at 50% effectiveness.

Overloaded Earthquakes do not knock enemies down.
spells.description_zh:
大地震击、元素冲击和地震术可以触发你的精通：元素过载，效果为50%。

过载的地震术不会击倒敌人。

spells.description_en: Flame Shock damage has a chance to generate 2 Maelstrom.
spells.description_zh: 烈焰震击造成伤害时有几率产生2点漩涡值。

spells.description_en: Flame Shock damage increased by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 烈焰震击的伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Envenom's effect also increases the critical strike chance of your weapon poisons by 8%. Your Energy generation is increased by 4% for each lethal poison on your weapons.
spells.description_zh: 毒伤效果还会使你武器药膏的爆击几率提高8%。你的武器上每有一种致命药膏，你的能量回复速度就会提高4%。

spells.description_en: Your Bleed, weapon poison, and other Nature damage is increased by 15% against targets below 35% health.
spells.description_zh: 对生命值低于35%的目标，你的流血、武器药膏和其他自然伤害所造成的伤害会提高15%。

spells.description_en: Each enemy afflicted by your Rupture increases your Agility by 2%, up to a maximum of 20%.
spells.description_zh: 每个受到你的割裂影响的敌人都会使你的敏捷提高2%，最高可达20%。

spells.description_en: You may apply 1 additional Lethal and Non-Lethal Poison to your weapons, but they have 30% less application chance.
spells.description_zh: 你可以为你的武器额外浸毒1种致命和非致命药膏，但其施加几率降低30%。

spells.description_en: Between the Eyes has a 3% chance per combo point spent to grant 4 combo points and reset its own cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 正中眉心每消耗一个连击点数，便有3%的几率获得4个连击点数并重置其冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Roll the Bones has a 20% increased chance of granting more powerful results.
spells.description_zh: 命运骨骰获得更强效果的几率提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Using Pistol Shot with Opportunity has a 30% chance to make your next Ambush usable without Stealth.

Chance to trigger this effect matches the chance for Sinister Strike to grant Opportunity.

Ambush damage increased by 80%.
spells.description_zh:
使用受可乘之机影响的手枪射击有30%的几率使你的下一次伏击无需潜行即可使用。

触发此效果的几率等同于影袭获得可乘之机的几率。

伏击造成的伤害提高80%。

spells.description_en:
When you gain Opportunity, gain 1 additional charge. Max 6 charges.

Pistol Shot consumes 1 additional charge of Opportunity to fire 1 additional bullet. Additional shots deal 20% reduced damage.
spells.description_zh:
触发可乘之机时，额外获得1层可乘之机，最多叠加6层。

手枪射击会额外消耗1层可乘之机并额外射击1次。额外射击造成的伤害降低20%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of most totems by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 大部分图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Stamina increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 耐力提高5%。

spells.description_en: Blade Flurry's initial damage is increased by 100% and generates 1 combo point per target struck, but its Energy cost is increased by 30.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃乱舞的初始伤害提高100%，且每击中一个目标产生1个连击点数，但能量消耗提高30点。

spells.description_en: Attacks that generate combo points deal 15% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 能够产生连击点数的攻击所造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Casting Echo grants one stack of Ouroboros, increasing the healing of your next Emerald Blossom by 30%, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 施放回响会获得一层衔尾轮回，使你的下一个翡翠之花的治疗效果提高30%，最多可叠加5次。

spells.description_en: Rewind's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 回溯的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en:
Your Lava Burst casts restore 22 mana to you and 4 allies nearest to you within 40 yards.

Allies can only benefit from one Shaman's Mana Spring effect at a time, prioritizing healers.
spells.description_zh:
你施放的熔岩爆裂会为你和你40码范围内最近的4名盟友恢复22点法力值。

盟友只能从一名萨满的法力之泉效果中获益，并会优先以治疗者为目标。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 闪电箭和闪电链的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Increases Riptide's duration by 6.0 sec and its healing over time by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 激流的持续时间延长6.0秒，其持续治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.
spells.description_zh: 切割使攻击速度额外提高，数值相当于你的急速的100%。

spells.description_en: Increase the remaining duration of your active Roll the Bones combat enhancement by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你激活的命运骨骰战斗增益效果的剩余持续时间延长30秒。

spells.description_en: Dispatch deals 15% increased damage and costs 3 less Energy. This damage bonus is increased by 50% while your damage is enhanced by your Between the Eyes.
spells.description_zh: 斩击造成的伤害提高15%，消耗的能量降低3点。在你的伤害效果受到正中眉心强化时，此伤害加成额外提高50%。

spells.description_en: After activating Shadow Dance, your next 2 attacks that generate combo points deal 35% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 激活暗影之舞后，你的下2次产生连击点数的攻击造成的伤害提高35%。

spells.description_en: Your abilities deal 5% increased magic damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的技能额外造成5%的魔法伤害。

spells.description_en: Earth Shield reduces damage taken by 3% and its healing is increased by up to 150% as its target's health decreases. Maximum benefit is reached below 50% health.
spells.description_zh: 大地之盾使目标受到的伤害降低3%，并根据目标损失的生命值，其治疗效果最多提高150%。生命值低于50%时达到最大效果。

spells.description_en: Imbue your weapon with the element of Earth for 1 hour. Your Riptide, Healing Wave, and Chain Heal healing has a 20% chance to trigger Earthliving on the target, healing for 591 over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 为你的武器注入大地元素的能量，持续1小时。使你的激流、治疗波和治疗链的治疗效果有20%的几率在目标身上触发大地生命效果，在6秒内恢复591点生命值。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Healing Stream Totem by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage dealt by your Elemental Overloads by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 你的元素过载造成的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Chain Heal bounces an additional time and casting Chain Heal on a target affected by Riptide consumes Riptide, increasing the healing of your Chain Heal by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 治疗链会额外跳跃一次。对受到激流影响的目标施放治疗链会消耗激流效果，使你的治疗链的治疗效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: Casting Sundering grants you 15% Haste for 12 sec, and generates 5 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
spells.description_zh: 裂地术使你的急速提高15%并产生5层漩涡武器，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Every 4 casts of Riptide also applies Riptide to another friendly target near your Riptide target.
spells.description_zh: 每施放4次激流，你的激流就会施加给初始激流目标附近的另一个友方目标。

spells.description_en: For each Riptide active on an ally, your heals are 0.5% more effective.
spells.description_zh: 盟友身上每有一个激活的激流效果，你的治疗效果就提高0.5%。

spells.description_en: Cleanse Spirit, Wind Shear, Purge, and totem casts no longer cancel Ghost Wolf.
spells.description_zh: 施放净化灵魂、风剪、净化术和图腾不再会取消幽魂之狼效果。

spells.description_en:
Increases the radius of your totem effects by 15%.

Increases the duration of your Earthbind and Earthgrab Totems by 10 sec.

Increases the duration of your Healing Stream, Tremor, Poison Cleansing, and Wind Rush Totems by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的图腾的有效范围提高15%。

你的地缚图腾和陷地图腾的持续时间延长10秒。

你的治疗之泉、战栗、清毒、和狂风图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

spells.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 5% and the movement speed bonus of Ghost Wolf by an additional 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的移动速度提高5%，并且幽魂之狼的移动速度额外提高5%。

spells.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 产生连击点的攻击爆击时，会使你下一个终结技的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Leech increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 吸血提高3%。

spells.description_en: Movement speed increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 移动速度提高5%。

spells.description_en: The cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 闪现术和闪光术的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Invisibility increases your movement speed by 20% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 隐形术使你的移动速度提高20%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Counterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 法术反制的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: When you heal with your Healing Wave or Riptide you have a 30% chance to summon an Ancestral spirit to aid you, instantly healing an injured friendly party or raid target within 40 yards for 15% of the amount healed. Critical strikes increase this chance to 60%.
spells.description_zh: 当你的治疗波或激流产生治疗时，有30%的几率召唤一个先祖之魂出现并帮助你，立即为周围半径40码范围内一个受伤的友方小队或团队成员治疗，该次治疗量相当于触发效果的法术的15%。爆击使该几率提高至60%。

spells.description_en:
Earthliving receives 150% additional benefit from Mastery: Deep Healing.

Healing Wave always triggers Earthliving on its target.
spells.description_zh:
大地生命从精通：深度治疗中额外获得150%的加成。

治疗波必定对目标触发大地生命。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰屏障的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Healing Stream Totem heals for 100% more, decaying over its duration.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的治疗效果提高100%，并会在持续期间衰减。

spells.description_en: Increases Haste by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases critical strike chance by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。

spells.description_en: Shadowstep's cooldown is reduced by 20%, and its maximum range is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影步的冷却时间缩短20%，最大使用范围扩大20%。

spells.description_en:
Your weapon poisons have 10% increased application chance and now deal damage as Shadow instead of Nature.

Shadow damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
你的武器药膏生效几率提高10%，且现在由自然伤害变为暗影伤害。

造成的暗影伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Remaining out of combat for 6 sec increases the duration of your next Shadow Dance by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 未进入战斗6秒后，你的下一个暗影之舞的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Shadow Clones deal 15% increased damage and your effects that have a chance to create them have 5% additional chance to occur.
spells.description_zh: 暗影克隆体造成的伤害提高15%，有几率创造暗影克隆体的效果触发几率额外提高5%。

spells.description_en: Shroud of Concealment increases the movement speed of allies by 100% and leaving its area no longer cancels the effect.
spells.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕使盟友的移动速度提高100%，离开影响区域不再取消效果。

spells.description_en: Shadow Dance increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影之舞使你技能的爆击伤害加成提高10%。

spells.description_en: Eviscerate and Black Powder deal an additional 30% damage as Shadow while Find Weakness is active.
spells.description_zh: 洞悉弱点生效时，刺骨和黑火药会额外造成30%的伤害，并算作暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Find Weakness causes your attacks to ignore an additional 20% armor.
spells.description_zh: 洞悉弱点使你的攻击额外忽略20%的护甲值。

spells.description_en: Vanish has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 消失可以额外使用1次。

spells.description_en: Movement speed increased by 20% and damage taken reduced by 10% for 8 sec after gaining Stealth, Vanish, or Shadow Dance.
spells.description_zh: 在进入潜行、消失或暗影之舞后的8秒内，移动速度提高20%，受到的伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Vanish grants you a shield for 6 sec, absorbing damage equal to 18% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 消失会让你获得一个护盾，持续6秒，可吸收相当于你最大生命值18%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Shadow damage increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en: Backstab, Shuriken Storm, and Shadowstrike have 10% increased damage while Find Weakness is active.
spells.description_zh: 洞悉弱点激活时，背刺、袖剑风暴和暗影打击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: After Shadow Dance ends, Backstab and Shuriken Storm deal an additional 50% damage as Shadow, fading by 2.8% per sec.
spells.description_zh: 在暗影之舞结束后，背刺和袖剑风暴会额外造成50%的暗影伤害，该伤害增幅每秒降低2.8%。

spells.description_en: Eviscerate and Black Powder have 15% increased critical strike damage bonus.
spells.description_zh: 刺骨和黑火药的爆击伤害加成提高15%。

spells.description_en: While Shadow Dance is active, each different attack that generates or spends combo points lashes out at the target, dealing 146 Shadow damage.
spells.description_zh: 暗影之舞激活期间，每个产生或消耗连击点的不同技能都会对目标发起鞭笞，造成147点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Enemies hit by Divine Storm take 20% more damage from Consecration and Divine Hammers for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 被神圣风暴击中的敌人从奉献和神圣之锤中受到的伤害提高20%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
When you take any damage, heal for 2.0% of your maximum health. 

This can only occur once every 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当你受到任何伤害时，恢复2.0%的最大生命值。

该效果每10秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Nature's Swiftness's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 自然迅捷的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Ironbark's cooldown is reduced by 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 铁木树皮的冷却时间缩短20秒。

spells.description_en: Wild Growth's healing falls off 40% less over time.
spells.description_zh: 野性成长的治疗效果随时间衰减的幅度降低40%。

spells.description_en: Chain Heal bounces an additional time and its healing is increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 治疗链额外跳跃一次，并且治疗量提高8%。

spells.description_en: Mortal Strike deals an additional 5% damage and deals 5% increased critical strike damage.
spells.description_zh: 致死打击伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Maximum Rage increased by 30.
spells.description_zh: 怒气值上限提高30点。

spells.description_en: Increases all Fire and Frost damage you deal by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 你造成的所有火焰和冰霜伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Increases your attack speed by 15% for your next 3 melee swings after dealing a critical strike with a spell or ability.
spells.description_zh: 在你的法术或技能爆击后，使你下3次近战攻击的攻击速度提高15%。

spells.description_en: While wielding one-handed weapons your damage is increased by 3% and Leech increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 装备单手武器时，你的伤害提高3%，吸血提高2%。

spells.description_en: While wielding two-handed weapons your damage is increased by 3% and damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 装备双手武器时，你的伤害提高3%，受到的范围伤害减少2%。

spells.description_en: While dual wielding your damage is increased by 3% and movement speed is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 装备双持武器时，你的伤害提高3%，移动速度提高2%。

spells.description_en: Stamina increased by 5% and Armor increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 耐力提高5%。护甲提高5%。

spells.description_en: Haste increased by 1% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高1%。你的自动攻击爆击会使你的自动攻击速度提高10%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Increases the number of Elemental Shields you can have active on yourself by 1.

You can have Earth Shield on yourself and one ally at the same time.
spells.description_zh:
你身上可激活的元素护盾种类提高1种。

你可以在自己和一名盟友身上同时拥有大地之盾。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at your feet that removes all Poison effects from a nearby party or raid member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续6秒。每1.5秒为附近30码范围内的一名小队或团队成员移除所有中毒效果。

spells.description_en: Purify Spirit additionally removes all Curse effects.
spells.description_zh: 净化灵魂会额外移除所有诅咒效果。

spells.description_en: Slam, Whirlwind, and Cleave deal 10% more damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.
spells.description_zh: 猛击、旋风斩和顺劈斩造成的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Reduces magic damage taken by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低4%。

spells.description_en: You are healed for 85% of the Bleed damage dealt by Rend and Deep Wounds.
spells.description_zh: 撕裂和重伤为你恢复生命值，相当于造成的流血伤害的85%。

spells.description_en:
Transforms all enemies within 10 yards into sheep, wandering around incapacitated for 15 sec. While affected, the victims cannot take actions but will regenerate health very quickly. Damage will cancel the effect.

Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.
spells.description_zh:
将10码范围内的所有敌人变成绵羊，使其在周围到处闲逛，持续15秒。受此法术影响期间，绵羊无法采取行动，但会以极快的速度恢复生命值，任何伤害都会取消此效果。

只对野兽、人形生物和小动物有效。

spells.description_en:
Your abilities have a 5% increased chance to critically strike targets affected by Rend.

If you know Rend, Mortal Strike inflicts Rend on targets below 35% health.

Deep Wounds lasts 33% longer.
spells.description_zh:
你的技能对受到撕裂影响的目标的爆击几率提高5%。

如果你已习得撕裂，致死打击会对生命值低于35%的目标施加撕裂。

重伤的持续时间延长33%。

spells.description_en: Sweeping Strikes affects 6 additional damaging single-target abilities.
spells.description_zh: 横扫攻击额外影响6个单体伤害性技能。

spells.description_en: Rejuvenation healing is increased by up to 10%, and Tranquility healing is increased by up to 20%, healing for more on low-health targets.
spells.description_zh: 对低生命值目标的治疗效果提高，回春术最多提高10%，宁静最多提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Wrath damage increased by 12%.

Starfire damage increased by 12%.
spells.description_zh:
愤怒伤害提高12%。

星火术伤害提高12%。

spells.description_en: Every 30th Shooting Star calls down a Full Moon at 50% effectiveness upon its target.
spells.description_zh: 每召唤第30颗坠星就会对其目标施放一次满月，效果为普通满月的50%。

spells.description_en: Healing Rain instantly restores 287 health to 5 allies within its area, and its radius is increased by 2 yards.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之雨会立即为范围内的5名盟友恢复287点生命值，且范围半径增加2码。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 2 sec and Crusader Strike by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 审判的冷却时间缩短2秒，十字军打击的冷却时间缩短2秒。

spells.description_en:
Ambush has a chance to grant Opportunity. Chance to trigger this effect is 100% of the chance for Sinister Strike to grant Opportunity.

Energy cost of Ambush reduced by 5.
spells.description_zh:
伏击有几率获得可乘之机。触发此效果的几率等同于影袭获得可乘之机几率的100%。

伏击的能量消耗降低5。

spells.description_en: Your Bleed effects deal 5% increased damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的流血效果造成的伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Bloodthirst's critical strike chance increased by 5% and if you are Enraged, Bloodthirst extends your Enrage by 0.5 sec. This extension is doubled if Bloodthirst critically strikes your primary target.
spells.description_zh: 嗜血的爆击几率提高5%，如果你被激怒，嗜血使激怒的持续时间延长0.5秒。如果嗜血对主要目标造成爆击，延长效果翻倍。

spells.description_en: Raging Blow's critical strike chance increased by 5% and critical strike damage increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 怒击的爆击几率提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Unleashes a powerful weapon strike that deals 161 Holy damage to an enemy target,

Has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Judgment.
spells.description_zh:
发动一次强大的武器打击，对一个敌方目标造成161点神圣伤害，

有15%的几率重置审判的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Mortal Strike, Cleave, and Execute damage increased by 5% and critical strike damage increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 致死打击、顺劈斩和斩杀的伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Blade of Justice generates 1 additional Holy Power.
spells.description_zh: 公正之剑额外产生1层神圣能量。

spells.description_en: Your Blade of Justice causes the target to burn for 27 Radiant damage over 9 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.
spells.description_zh: 公正之剑会使目标燃烧，在9秒内造成27点光辉伤害。重复施加时，所有剩余伤害将添加到新的效果中。

spells.description_en: Maximum Energy increased by 20 and Energy regeneration increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的能量值上限提高20点。能量回复速度提高5%。

spells.description_en: Your haste is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的急速提高5%。

spells.description_en: Fire Blast increases your mastery by 2% for 4 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 火焰冲击使你的精通提高2%，持续4秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Divine Storm projects an additional wave of light, striking all enemies up to 20 yds in front of you for 20% of Divine Storm's damage.
spells.description_zh: 神圣风暴额外生成一道圣光能量，对你前方20码内的敌人造成20%神圣风暴的伤害。

spells.description_en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你的技能的爆击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Enraged Regeneration lasts 3 sec longer and instantly heals for 10% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 狂怒回复的持续时间延长3秒，并立即回复10%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: While Enraged, your auto-attacks can no longer miss.
spells.description_zh: 激怒状态下你的自动攻击不会出现未命中。

spells.description_en: While Combustion is active, Fire Blast recharges 50% faster.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧激活期间，火焰冲击的充能速度加快50%。

spells.description_en: Damaging an enemy with Fireball, Pyroblast, or Flamestrike increases the damage it receives from Ignite by 0.2%. Stacks up to 50 times.
spells.description_zh: 用火球术、炎爆术或烈焰风暴对敌人造成伤害后会使其受到的点燃伤害提高0.2%。最多叠加50层。

spells.description_en: Arcane Blast generates an additional Arcane Charge.
spells.description_zh: 奥术冲击额外生成一层奥术充能。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick deals 20% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: When you use Keg Smash, the remaining cooldown on Breath of Fire is reset.
spells.description_zh: 使用醉酿投会重置火焰之息的剩余冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Keg Smash deals an additional 20% damage to targets affected by Breath of Fire.
spells.description_zh: 醉酿投对受到火焰之息影响的目标造成额外20%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Purifying Brew instantly heals you for 25% of the Staggered damage it clears.
spells.description_zh: 活血酒立即为你恢复生命，相当于醉拳所化解伤害的25%。

spells.description_en: Mortal Strike has a 50% chance to apply a Fatal Mark to your target, stacking up to 5 times. Your next Execute on a target with a Fatal Mark causes the Fatal Mark to deal 96 additional Physical damage per stack.
spells.description_zh: 致死打击有50%的几率对你的目标施加一层致死印记，最多叠加5层。你对带有致死印记的目标所施放的下一个斩杀，会使每层致死印记额外造成96点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: Keg Smash deals 50% additional damage to its primary target, has 1 additional charge, and its range is increased by 10 yards.
spells.description_zh: 醉酿投对其主要目标造成的伤害额外提高50%，获得额外1次使用次数，且射程增加10码。

spells.description_en: Gain up to 15% Mastery based on your current level of Stagger.
spells.description_zh: 根据你当前的醉拳等级，获得最多15%的精通加成。

spells.description_en: Each time you dodge or an enemy misses you, your next Tiger Palm or Spinning Crane Kick deals 100% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 你每次躲闪或未被敌人命中时，下一个猛虎掌或神鹤引项踢造成的伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Each consecutive critical strike you deal increases critical strike damage you deal by 1%, up to 4% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每一次连续的爆击都会使你的爆击伤害提高1%，最多叠加至4%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Enrage increases your haste by 15% and your movement speed by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 激怒使你的急速提高15%，移动速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Bloodthirst and Raging Blow damage increased by 2.5% and critical strike damage increased by a further 2.5%.
spells.description_zh: 嗜血和怒击的伤害提高2.5%，爆击伤害额外提高2.5%。

spells.description_en: Raging Blow has 2 charges and has a 25% chance to instantly reset its own cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 怒击可以使用2次，并有25%的几率立即重置自身的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Rampage has a 75% chance to refund a charge of Raging Blow and increase the damage of your next Raging Blow by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 暴怒有75%的几率返还一层怒击的充能，并使你下一次怒击的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Bloodthirst deals 25% increased damage to enemies who are below 35% health.
spells.description_zh: 嗜血对生命值低于35%的敌人造成的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Bloodthirst critical strikes generate 4 additional Rage and inflict a Gushing Wound that deals 42 Bleed damage over 6 sec and heals you for the damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 嗜血造成爆击时，额外产生4点怒气，并施加龟裂创伤，在6秒内造成42点流血伤害，并恢复等量的生命值。

spells.description_en:
Combustion grants mastery equal to 75% of your Critical Strike stat.

Combustion causes your spells to apply Ignite at 15% increased effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
燃烧使你获得精通，数值相当于你的爆击属性的75%。

燃烧使你的法术施加的点燃效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your Haste is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Breath of Fire deals 100% increased damage, and after using Breath of Fire, you breathe fire 2 additional times, each dealing 7 Fire damage.
spells.description_zh: 火焰之息造成的伤害提高100%，并且在使用火焰之息后，你会额外喷火2次，每次造成7点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: After casting Divine Toll, you instantly cast Holy Shock every 5 sec for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放圣洁鸣钟后，你每5秒会立即施放一次神圣震击，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
10% of damage you deal adds to your active Ignore Pain or the next Ignore Pain you activate.

Your next Ignore Pain can be increased by up to 4,582.
spells.description_zh:
你造成伤害的10%会添加至你当前的无视苦痛或下一个无视苦痛中。

你的下一个无视苦痛的吸收量最多可提高4,582点。

spells.description_en: Devastate, Thunder Clap, Revenge, and Execute have a 25% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Shield Slam.
spells.description_zh: 毁灭打击、雷霆一击、复仇和斩杀有25%的几率重置盾牌猛击的剩余冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Clearcasting has a 3% increased chance to proc.
spells.description_zh: 节能施法的触发几率提高3%。

spells.description_en: Increases Stamina by 5% and your Haste by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 耐力提高5%，急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases Strength by 3% and your critical strike chance by 1%.
spells.description_zh: 力量提高3%，爆击几率提高1%。

spells.description_en: Shield Slam reduces the remaining cooldown of Shield Wall by 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 盾牌猛击使盾墙的剩余冷却时间缩短6秒。

spells.description_en:
Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

Also remove fear effects from group members within 12 yds.
spells.description_zh:
变得狂暴，移除并免疫恐惧、闷棍和瘫痪效果，持续6秒。

同时移除12码内队友的恐惧效果。

spells.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy, causing 206 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
spells.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，造成213点物理伤害，无视护甲。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Gain Strength equal to 5% of your Armor.
spells.description_zh: 获得等同于护甲值5%的力量。

spells.description_en:
Maelstrom Weapon can now stack 5 additional times.

Each Maelstrom Weapon stacks consumed grants Overflowing Maelstrom, reducing the cast time of your next Healing Surge or Chain Heal by 10%, and increasing their healing by 10% up to 10 times. This effect can be accumulated up to 20 times.
spells.description_zh:
漩涡武器现在可以额外叠加5次。

每消耗一层漩涡武器会使你获得溢流漩涡，使下一个治疗之涌或治疗链的施法时间缩短10%，治疗效果提高10%，最多叠加10次。此效果最多可累积20次。

spells.description_en: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning can consume up to 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
spells.description_zh: 闪电箭和闪电链最多可消耗10层漩涡武器。

spells.description_en:
Ignite deals 15% more damage when Combustion is not active.

Fire Blast now spreads an additional 50% of your Ignite.
spells.description_zh:
当燃烧未激活时，点燃造成的伤害提高15%。

火焰冲击现在会额外扩散50%的点燃伤害。

spells.description_en: Thunder Clap affects all targets with Rend, causing them to Bleed for 74 damage over 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 雷霆一击会对所有击中的目标施加撕裂，使其流血并在15秒内造成74点伤害。

spells.description_en: Roar explosively, dealing 86 Physical damage to enemies within 12 yds and cause them to bleed for 98 physical damage over 8 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 发出雷鸣般的吼叫，对12码范围内的敌人造成88点物理伤害，并使敌人流血，在8秒内受到98点物理伤害。目标数量超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Unleash a devastating storm around yourself, dealing 42 Stormstrike damage every 1 sec to nearby enemies for 8 sec.

Increases your chance to activate Windfury Weapon by 50%, and the damage of Windfury Weapon by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
在你周围释放一场毁灭性的风暴，每1秒对附近敌人造成41点风暴打击伤害，持续8秒。

你触发风怒武器的几率提高50%，风怒武器的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Each active weapon imbue increases all Fire, Frost, and Nature damage dealt by 5.0%.
spells.description_zh: 每一种激活的武器灌魔使造成的所有火焰、冰霜和自然伤害提高5.0%。

spells.description_en: Damage from Rend has a chance to generate 5 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 撕裂造成的伤害有几率产生5点怒气。

spells.description_en: Each target hit by Crash Lightning increases the damage of your next Stormstrike by 25%, up to a maximum of 6 stacks.
spells.description_zh: 你的毁灭闪电每击中一个目标，都会使你下一个风暴打击的伤害提高25%，最多叠加6层。

spells.description_en: During Doom Winds or Ascendance, you generate 1 Maelstrom Weapon stack every 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当毁灭之风或升腾效果激活时，每1秒产生1层漩涡武器。

spells.description_en:
Doom Winds and Deeply Rooted Elements last 2 sec longer, and the cooldown of Ascendance is reduced by 60 sec.

During Doom Winds or Ascendance, Stormstrike and Crash Lightning consume up to 10 Maelstrom Weapon to discharge a Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning at 100% effectiveness at your enemy, whichever you most recently used.
spells.description_zh:
毁灭之风和根深蒂固元素的持续时间延长2秒，并且升腾的冷却时间缩短60秒。

在毁灭之风或升腾持续期间，风暴打击和毁灭闪电会消耗最多10层漩涡武器，向你的敌人释放一次100%效果的闪电箭或闪电链，取决于你最近使用的技能。

spells.description_en: Consuming 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon increases the damage of your next Stormstrike or Lava Lash by 25% and causes them to generate a stack of Maelstrom Weapon.
spells.description_zh: 消耗10层漩涡武器会使你的下一个风暴打击或熔岩猛击的伤害提高25%，并使其产生一层漩涡武器。

spells.description_en: Each wave of Arcane Missiles increases the damage of Arcane Barrage by 3%, up to 60%.
spells.description_zh: 每一波奥术飞弹会使奥术弹幕的伤害提高3%，最多提高60%。

spells.description_en: Arcane Charges increase the damage of Arcane Blast and Arcane Barrage by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 奥术充能使奥术冲击和奥术弹幕的伤害额外提高10%。

spells.description_en: Arcane Orb gains 1 additional charge. Arcane Orb damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 奥术宝珠额外获得1层充能。奥术宝珠的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Ferocious Bite deals 16% increased damage and an additional 8% during Tiger's Fury.
spells.description_zh: 凶猛撕咬的伤害提高16%，在猛虎之怒期间额外提高8%。

spells.description_en: Finishing moves have a 6% chance per combo point spent to increase the direct damage of your next Rake, Shred, or Swipe by 50% and make it critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 终结技每消耗一个连击点数，就有6%的几率使你的下一个斜掠、撕碎或横扫造成的直接伤害提高50%，且必定爆击。

spells.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 受到范围攻击伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: When you cast Word of Glory on someone other than yourself, you are also healed for 100% of the amount healed.
spells.description_zh: 你对别人施放荣耀圣令时也会治疗自己，治疗量为100%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Sacrifice by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 牺牲祝福的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: Arcane Barrage has a 4% chance per stack of Arcane Salvo to launch an Arcane Orb in front of you at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 每拥有一层奥术齐射，奥术弹幕就有4%的几率在你前方发射一颗100%效果的奥术宝珠。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Protection by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 保护祝福的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en:
After your Blessing of Sacrifice ends, 50% of the total damage it diverted is added to your next Judgment as bonus damage, or your next Word of Glory as bonus healing.

This effect's bonus damage cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health and its bonus healing cannot exceed 100% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh:
在牺牲祝福结束时，技能所转移伤害总量的50%将在下一次施放审判时造成额外伤害，或者在施放下一次荣耀圣令时产生额外治疗量。

此效果造成的额外伤害不会超过你最大生命值的30% ，并且产生的额外治疗量不会超过你最大生命值的100%。

spells.description_en:
Unleashes your power, dealing 135 Physical damage and an additional 182 Bleed damage over 4 sec to all enemies within 12 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Enrages you and generates 20 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
释放你的力量，造成135点物理伤害，并在4秒内对12码范围内的所有敌人额外造成182点流血伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

使你进入激怒状态，产生20点怒气。

spells.description_en:
Casting Frozen Orb grants 1 stack of Fingers of Frost.

Damaging one or more enemies with Frozen Orb has a 3% chance to grant Fingers of Frost.
spells.description_zh:
施放寒冰宝珠使你获得1层寒冰指。

寒冰宝珠对一个或多个敌人造成伤害时，有3%的几率使你获得寒冰指。

spells.description_en:
Infect the target's blood, dealing 147 Nature damage over 10 sec and gaining 1 use of any Stealth ability. If the target survives its full duration, they suffer an additional 53 damage and you gain 1 additional use of any Stealth ability for 10 sec.

Cooldown reduced by 30 sec if Sepsis does not last its full duration.

Awards 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh:
使目标的血液感染，在10秒内造成147点自然伤害并获得1次任意潜行技能的使用机会。如果目标在持续时间结束后存活，将会承受额外52点伤害，且你在之后的10秒内可以额外使用1次任意潜行技能。

如果败血刃伤在持续时间结束前消失，则冷却时间缩短30秒。

奖励1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: After you spend 20 Holy Power, your next Word of Glory echoes onto a nearby ally at 30% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 在消耗20层神圣能量后，你的下一个荣耀圣令在附近的一名盟友身上产生30%的效果。

spells.description_en: Speed increased by 2% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 加速提高2%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低2%。

spells.description_en: Mastery increased by 2% and Intellect increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高2%，智力提高2%。

spells.description_en: Garrote damage increased by 30%. Garrote generates 2 additional combo points when used from Stealth.
spells.description_zh: 锁喉的伤害提高30%。在潜行状态下使用的锁喉额外产生2个连击点数。

spells.description_en: Armor and critical strike chance increased by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 护甲和爆击几率提高4%。

spells.description_en: Exhilaration now also heals you for an additional 12.0% of your maximum health over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 意气风发现在还会在8秒内额外为你恢复你最大生命值的12.0%。

spells.description_en: Overpower has 2 charges and deals 15% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 压制可以使用2次，造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Release a powerful poison from your weapons and inject it into your target, dealing 51 Nature damage instantly and an additional 71 Nature damage over 14 sec. 

Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to a target affected by Kingsbane, Kingsbane damage increases by 20%, up to 1,000%.

Awards 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh:
释放你武器中的强力毒素并注入目标体内，立即对其造成51点自然伤害，并使其在14秒内额外受到71点自然伤害。

每当你的致命药膏击中受到君王之灾影响的目标时，君王之灾造成的伤害提高20%，最多提高1,000%。

奖励1个连击点数。

spells.description_en:
Learn Concentration Aura, Devotion Aura, and Crusader Aura:

Concentration Aura:
Interrupt and Silence effects on party and raid members within 40 yds are 30% shorter. 

 Devotion Aura:
Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

 Crusader Aura:
Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.
spells.description_zh:
学习专注光环、虔诚光环和十字军光环：

专注光环:
40码范围内的小队及团队成员受到打断和沉默效果的持续时间缩短30%。

 虔诚光环:
使40码范围内的小队和团队成员受到自身虔诚的激励，受到的伤害降低3%。

 十字军光环:
40码范围内的所有小队及团队成员的坐骑速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Empower spells cause time to flow 10% faster for you, increasing movement speed, cooldown recharge rate, and cast speed. Lasts 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 蓄力法术使你的时间流动速度加快10%，提高移动速度、冷却充能速率，以及施法速度。持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Bloodthirst causes your Bleeds to deal 20% additional damage for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 嗜血使你的流血额外造成20%的伤害，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Your Bleed effects deal 25% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的流血效果造成的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Gaining Stealth, Vanish, or Shadow Dance causes your next Shuriken Storm to have 100% increased chance to critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 进入潜行、消失或暗影之舞会使你的下一个袖剑风暴爆击几率提高100%。

spells.description_en: Each stack of Mongoose Fury also increases the damage of Strike as One by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 每层猫鼬之怒都会使羁绊共狩的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: When you use Barkskin or Survival Instincts, absorb 656 damage for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你使用树皮术或生存本能时，获得吸收656点伤害的护盾，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Dire Beast lasts an additional 1 sec and deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 凶暴野兽的持续时间延长1秒，造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Increases the radius of Demoralizing Shout by 5 yards.

Each enemy hit by Thunder Clap reduces the remaining cooldown on Demoralizing Shout by 1.5 sec, up to 4.5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
挫志怒吼的范围提高5码。

雷霆一击每击中一个敌人，都会使挫志怒吼的剩余冷却时间缩短1.5秒，最多缩短4.5秒。

spells.description_en:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
spells.description_zh:
你的主要宠物会获得额外效果。

小鬼：成功施放烧灼驱魔会使目标受到的伤害降低4%，持续5秒。

虚空行者：暗影壁垒的冷却时间缩短30秒。

地狱猎犬：吞噬魔法的冷却时间缩短5秒。

萨亚德：诱惑的冷却时间缩短10秒，并且会使目标快速走向恶魔。

spells.description_en:
Blocking an attack deals 42 Physical damage to the attacker. Critical blocks deal double damage.

Generates high threat.
spells.description_zh:
格挡一次攻击会对攻击者造成42点物理伤害。精确格挡会造成双倍伤害。

产生大量威胁值。

spells.description_en:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
消耗一块灵魂碎片，解锁你法术中的隐藏能力。

恶魔法阵：传送：使你的移动速度提高50%，并且使你免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

恶魔传送门：变为瞬发。

吸取生命：获得与治疗量等量的吸收盾，持续30秒。护盾的吸收总量不超过你最大生命值的30%。

治疗石：使你的治疗石的治疗效果提高30%，使用治疗石还会使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
Charge to an enemy with your shield, granting you Shield Block and dealing 288 Physical damage to it and 93 Physical damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

Also stuns the primary target for 4 sec.

Generates 20 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
举起盾牌冲向一个敌人，获得盾牌格挡并对其造成293点物理伤害，并对10码范围内的所有敌人造成93点物理伤害。

还会使主要目标昏迷4秒。

产生20点怒气。

spells.description_en: Increases Block chance by 8% and your Block value by 16%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的格挡几率提高8%，格挡值提高16%。

spells.description_en: Shield Block lasts 1 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 盾牌格挡的持续时间延长1秒。

spells.description_en: Using Shield Slam increases the damage of Shield Slam by 10% and the block value of your shield by 5% for 16 sec. Stacking up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh: 使用盾牌猛击会使盾牌猛击的伤害提高10%，并且使你的盾牌格挡值提高5%，持续16秒。最多可叠加3次。

spells.description_en: Taunts all enemies within 14 yds to attack you for 6 sec, interrupts all spellcasting within 14 yds and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec. Increases the threat you generate against the target by 800%.
spells.description_zh: 嘲讽14码范围内的所有敌人，使其攻击你，持续6秒。打断14码范围内的所有施法，并使其在6秒内不能施放该系法术。使你对目标造成的威胁值提高800%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the damage dealt by Burning Rush by 10%. Burning Rush increases your movement speed by an additional 20%.
spells.description_zh: 爆燃冲刺造成的伤害降低10%。爆燃冲刺使你的移动速度额外提高20%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Fel Domination by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使邪能统御的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 5% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 1.5%.
spells.description_zh:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的5%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低1.5%。

spells.description_en:
A balanced combat state that increases the critical strike chance of your abilities by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects by 10%. 

Lasts until canceled.
spells.description_zh:
平衡的战斗姿态，使你的技能爆击几率提高3%，并使移动限制效果的时间缩短10%。

效果将一直持续直到取消。

spells.description_en: Hand of Gul'dan has a 5% chance to generate a charge of Demonic Core.
spells.description_zh: 古尔丹之手有5%的几率充能一层恶魔之核。

spells.description_en: Your Dreadstalkers' attacks have a 10% chance to trigger an additional Dreadbite.
spells.description_zh: 你的恐惧猎犬的攻击有10%的几率触发一次额外的恐惧之咬。

spells.description_en:
An aggressive combat state that increases the damage of your auto-attacks by 15% and reduces the duration of Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects on you by 10%.

Lasts until canceled.
spells.description_zh:
进攻性的战斗姿态，使你的自动攻击伤害提高15%，并使你受到的恐惧、闷棍和瘫痪效果持续时间缩短10%。

效果将一直持续直到取消。

spells.description_en:
A defensive combat state that reduces all damage you take by 15% and all damage you deal by 10%.

Lasts until canceled.
spells.description_zh:
防御性的战斗姿态，使你受到的所有伤害降低15%，造成的所有伤害降低10%。

效果一直持续直到主动取消。

spells.description_en: Essence Burst increases the damage of affected spells by 15.0%.
spells.description_zh: 精华迸发使受影响法术的伤害提高15.0%。

spells.description_en: Hurl a brew created from the bones of your enemies at the ground, coating all targets struck for 10 sec. Your abilities have a 50% chance to affect the target a second time at 40% effectiveness as Shadow damage or healing.
spells.description_zh: 投掷由地上敌人的骨头酿成的酒，覆盖被击中的所有目标，持续10秒。你的技能有50%的几率会再次影响目标，造成相当于原效果40%的暗影伤害或治疗量。

spells.description_en: While channeling Disintegrate your Fire Breath on the target deals damage 100% more often.
spells.description_zh: 在引导裂解时，你的火焰吐息对目标造成伤害的频率提高100%。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath's cooldown is reduced by 1 min.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸的冷却时间缩短1分钟。

spells.description_en:
When your health is brought below 30%, you take 80% less damage for 8 sec and healing you receive is increased by 100%.

Cannot occur more than once every 3 min.
spells.description_zh:
当你的生命值降低到30%以下时，你受到的伤害降低80%，持续8秒，并且你受到的治疗效果提高100%。

此效果每3分钟最多触发一次。

spells.description_en: Your Living Flame and Emerald Blossom are 30% more effective on yourself.
spells.description_zh: 你对自己施放活化烈焰和翡翠之花时，效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: Every 250 rage you spend triggers a Violent Outburst, causing your next Shield Slam to deal 200% increased damage, generate 50% more Rage and grant Ignore Pain.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗250点怒气会触发一次怒意迸发，使你的下一次盾牌猛击的伤害提高200%，产生的怒气提高50%，并获得一次无视苦痛。

spells.description_en: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你和你宠物的最大生命值提高5%。

spells.description_en: Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Mortal Strike at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃风暴每攻击2次，你会自动向目标或附近的随机敌人施放一次致死打击，造成100%的普通伤害。

spells.description_en: Overpower has a 35% chance to reset the cooldown of Mortal Strike and reduce the cost of your next Mortal Strike by 33%.
spells.description_zh: 压制有35%的几率重置致死打击的冷却时间，并使你下一次致死打击的怒气消耗降低33%。

spells.description_en: Execute increases the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 35%, stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀使你下一次致死打击的伤害提高35%，最多叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
spells.description_zh: 打破你的恐惧效果需要的伤害量提高60%。

spells.description_en: Avenger's Shield increases the damage of your next Shield of the Righteous by 10% for each target hit by Avenger's Shield, stacking up to 5 times, and increases its radius by 6 yds.
spells.description_zh: 复仇者之盾每击中一个目标，你的下一个正义盾击造成的伤害就会提高10%，最多可叠加5次，同时还会使正义盾击的范围扩大6码。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Unending Resolve by 45 sec.
spells.description_zh: 不灭决心的冷却时间缩短45秒。

spells.description_en: Dark Pact sacrifices only 5% of your current health for the same shield value.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗契约仅会牺牲你当前生命值的5%，获得的护盾值不变。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗契约的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 25% health. 60 sec cooldown.
spells.description_zh:
你为自己召唤的治疗石变为恶魔治疗石，可以在战斗中使用多次。恶魔治疗石无法交易。

恶魔治疗石
立即恢复25%的生命值。 60秒冷却时间。

spells.description_en: After casting Holy Prism, Holy Armament, or Divine Toll, you instantly cast Holy Shock every 5 sec for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放神圣棱镜、神圣军备或圣洁鸣钟后，每5秒你会立即施放一次神圣震击，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Enemies hit by Cone of Cold are frozen in place for 5 sec instead of snared.

When your roots expire or are dispelled, your target is snared by 80%, decaying over 3 sec.
spells.description_zh:
被冰锥术击中的敌人会被冻结在原地而不是被诱捕，持续5秒。

当定身效果结束或被驱散时，你的目标会被减速80%，该效果在3秒内逐渐衰减。

spells.description_en: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.
spells.description_zh: 施放你的护盾会移除所有减速效果。

spells.description_en:
Your Felguard hurls his axe towards the target location, erupting when it lands and dealing 142 Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to nearby enemies.

While unarmed, your Felguard's basic attacks deal damage to all nearby enemies and attacks 50% faster.
spells.description_zh:
你的恶魔卫士将他的战斧扔向目标位置，落地时爆发，每1秒对附近的敌人造成142点暗影烈焰伤害，持续6秒。

你的恶魔卫士没有武器时的普通攻击会对所有附近的敌人造成伤害，攻击速度也会提高50%。

spells.description_en: Barbed Shot has a 25% chance to cause your pet to use its special attack and deal 50% bonus damage.
spells.description_zh: 倒刺射击有25%的几率使你的宠物使用特殊攻击，并造成50%的额外伤害。

spells.description_en: Each time you dodge or an enemy misses you, the remaining cooldown on your Brews is reduced by 0.5 sec. Effect reduced by 50% for each additional recent attacker, up to 5.
spells.description_zh: 你每次躲闪或未被敌人命中时，你的酒类技能剩余的冷却时间就缩短0.5秒。每增加一个最近的攻击者，效果就减少50%，最多5个。

spells.description_en: Your Breath of Fire ignites your right leg in flame for 8 sec, causing your Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick to deal 50% additional damage as Fire damage and refresh the duration of your Breath of Fire on the target.
spells.description_zh: 你的火焰之息会将火焰缠绕在你的右腿上，持续8秒，使你的幻灭踢和神鹤引项踢能够额外造成50%的火焰伤害，并刷新目标身上火焰之息的持续时间。

spells.description_en: Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul deal 5% increased damage, up to 15%, per damage over time effect you have active on the target.
spells.description_zh: 你在目标身上每有一个激活的持续性伤害效果，暗影箭和吸取灵魂对其造成的伤害就会提高5%，最多提高15%。

spells.description_en: Corruption damage is increased by 15%, and each time it deals damage any of your Curses active on the target are extended by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 腐蚀术的伤害提高15%，且每次造成伤害时，你施放在目标身上的诅咒都会延长0.5秒。

spells.description_en:
Wither away all life force of your current target and up to 4 additional targets nearby, causing your primary target to suffer 2,621 Shadow damage and secondary targets to suffer 1,310 Shadow damage over 8 sec.

Damage dealt by Soul Rot heals you for 50% of damage done.
spells.description_zh:
使你当前目标的所有生命之力枯萎，最多可以额外影响附近的4个目标，在8秒内使你的主要目标受到2,621点暗影伤害，次要目标受到1,310点暗影伤害。

灵魂腐化造成的伤害会为你恢复等同于伤害50%的生命值。

spells.description_en: Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its damage is increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 火焰冲击获得额外1层充能，并且其伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick deals an additional 5% damage. Blackout Kick critical hits grant an additional 1 stack of Elusive Brawler.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢额外造成5%伤害。幻灭踢爆击时额外获得1层醉拳大师效果。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike damage of your Destruction spells by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 你的毁灭系法术的爆击伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critical strike and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧和暗影灼烧有100%的几率爆击，并且它们的伤害随你的爆击几率而提高。

spells.description_en: Channel Demonfire fires an additional 2 bolts. Each bolt increases the remaining duration of Immolate on all targets hit by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 引导恶魔之火额外射出2道箭矢，每一道箭矢都会使命中的所有目标身上的献祭持续时间延长0.5秒。

spells.description_en: Avenging Wrath empowers your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn with 25% increased effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 复仇之怒会强化你的下一个荣耀圣令，使其自动激活黎明之光，且效果提高25%。

spells.description_en: Incinerate now generates 100% additional Soul Shard Fragments.
spells.description_zh: 烧尽现在可以额外生成100%的灵魂碎片裂片。

spells.description_en: For the next 30 sec, your Mastery is increased by 9%. Additionally,
spells.description_zh: 在接下来的30秒内，你的精通提高9%。此外，

spells.description_en: Your damaging abilities have a chance to invoke Niuzao, causing him to charge to your target's location and Stomp, dealing 141 Physical damage to your target and reduced damage to secondary targets.
spells.description_zh: 你的伤害性技能有几率召唤砮皂，冲向你的目标位置并施放践踏。对你的目标造成140点物理伤害，并对次要目标造成较少伤害。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick's cooldown is reduced by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢的冷却时间缩短1秒。

spells.description_en: Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, and Incinerate deal 3% increased damage to targets afflicted by Immolate.
spells.description_zh: 混乱之箭，暗影灼烧和烧尽对受到献祭效果影响的目标造成的伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en:
When your Immolate deals periodic damage to a target above 80% health, gain 2% Haste for 10 sec.

Stacks up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh:
当你的献祭对生命值在80%以上的目标造成周期性伤害时，获得2%急速，持续10秒。

该效果最多可叠加3次。

spells.description_en: Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, and Shadowburn always gain at least 70% of the maximum benefit from your Mastery: Chaotic Energies.
spells.description_zh: 混乱之箭、火焰之雨和暗影灼烧总是能够从你的精通：混乱能量中获得至少70%的最大加成。

spells.description_en: Expel Harm's healing is increased by up to 100%, based on your missing health.
spells.description_zh: 移花接木的治疗效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高100%。

spells.description_en: Wing Buffet and Tail Swipe knock enemies further and daze them, reducing movement speed by 70% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 飞翼打击和扫尾的击退距离提高，并使敌人眩晕，使其移动速度降低70%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en:
Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.

Physical attacks against you have a 20% chance to make your next Incinerate instant cast. This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的爆击几率提高2%。

对你发起的物理攻击有20%的几率使你的下一个烧尽变为瞬发。此效果每6秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en:
Your single target spells have a 35% chance to apply Havoc to a nearby enemy for 5.0 sec.

 Havoc
Marks a target with Havoc for 5.0 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.
spells.description_zh:
你的单体目标法术有35%的几率对附近一名敌人施加浩劫，持续5.0秒。

浩劫
用浩劫标记一名敌人，持续5.0秒，使你所有单体法术对浩劫标记的目标造成50%的伤害。

spells.description_en: When you Blackout Kick, your Stagger is reduced by 263, increased by up to 200% based on your missing health.
spells.description_zh: 当你使用幻灭踢时，你的醉拳额外化解263点伤害，此效果基于你损失的生命值最多提高200%。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick's damage increased by 20% and it strikes an additional 2 targets.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢的伤害提高20%并且能够额外攻击2个目标。

spells.description_en: Emerald Blossom and Verdant Embrace instantly heal you for 950 when cast.
spells.description_zh: 翡翠之花和青翠之拥在施放时使你立即恢复950点生命值。

spells.description_en: Beacon of Light transfers an additional 5% of the amount healed.
spells.description_zh: 圣光道标可额外传输5%的治疗量。

spells.description_en: Your Flash of Light heals for an additional 50% when cast on a target affected by your Beacon of Light.
spells.description_zh: 你的圣光闪现会对受你圣光道标影响的目标造成50%的额外治疗。

spells.description_en: Your Leech is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的吸血提高2%。

spells.description_en: Lay on Hands grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec and now ignores healing reduction effects.
spells.description_zh: 圣疗术使目标的护甲值提高30%，持续8秒，且现在会忽视治疗降低效果。

spells.description_en: Blessing of Freedom increases the target's movement speed by 30%. Blessing of Protection and Blessing of Sacrifice reduce the target's damage taken by 15%. These effects linger for 8 sec after the Blessing ends.
spells.description_zh: 自由祝福会使目标的移动速度提高30%。保护祝福和牺牲祝福会使目标受到的伤害降低15%。这些效果在祝福结束后持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Holy Shock and Judgment have a 8% increased critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击和审判的爆击几率提高8%。

spells.description_en: The cooldowns of your loss of control spells are reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你的失控类技能的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: While empowered by Infusion of Light, Flash of Light heals for an additional 20% and Judgment refunds 0.5% of your maximum mana.
spells.description_zh: 在圣光灌注的影响下，圣光闪现的治疗量提高20%，并且审判将返还0.5%的最大法力值。

spells.description_en: Increases Light of Dawn's healing by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 黎明之光的治疗效果提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Your Invigorating Mist healing is increased by 20% and your Enveloping Mist also heals allies with Renewing Mist for 8% of its healing.

The duration of Enveloping Mist is increased by 4 sec while you have a celestial summoned.
spells.description_zh:
振奋之雾的治疗效果提高20%，并且氤氲之雾还会为带有复苏之雾的盟友治疗相当于其治疗量8%的生命值。

召唤天神后，氤氲之雾的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en:
Bless an ally for 30 sec, causing 12% of all healing to be converted into damage onto a nearby enemy and 12% of all damage to be converted into healing onto an injured ally within 40 yds.

Blessing of the Seasons: Turns to Autumn after use.
spells.description_zh:
祝福一名盟友，持续30秒，使所有治疗效果的12%对附近的一名敌人造成伤害，所有伤害的12%对40码内的一名受伤的盟友进行治疗。

四季祝福：使用后转变为秋季。

spells.description_en: Gust of Mists has a 30% chance to do 100% more healing.
spells.description_zh: 迷雾之风有30%的几率产生额外100%的治疗效果。

spells.description_en: Chi Cocoons now apply Enveloping Mist for 4 sec when they expire or are consumed, and Chi-Ji's Gusts of Mists healing is increased by 20% and Yu'lon's Soothing Breath healing is increased by 500%.
spells.description_zh: 真气之茧效果结束或被消耗时还会施加持续4秒的氤氲之雾，赤精的迷雾之风的治疗效果提高20%，玉珑的抚慰之息的治疗效果提高500%。

spells.description_en: While channeling Mana Tea you exhale the breath of Yu'lon, healing up to 5 allies within 15 yards for 342 every 0.4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 引导法力茶时，你能够呼出玉珑之息，每0.4秒为15码内的最多5名盟友恢复350点生命值。

spells.description_en: The duration of Survival of the Fittest is increased by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 优胜劣汰的持续时间延长2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Throw Glaive causes targets to take an additional 80% of damage dealt as Chaos over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 投掷利刃会导致目标在6秒内受到额外的80%伤害，伤害类型为混沌伤害。

spells.description_en:
Each time Immolation Aura deals damage, 35% of the damage dealt by up to 3 critical strikes is gathered as Ragefire.

When Immolation Aura expires you explode, dealing all stored Ragefire damage to nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
献祭光环每次造成伤害时，最多3次爆击伤害的35%会被作为怒焰收集起来。

献祭光环结束时，你会爆炸，储存的所有怒焰会对附近敌人造成伤害。

spells.description_en:
Damaging an enemy before they damage you increases your critical strike chance by 10% for 5 sec.

Vengeful Retreat refreshes your potential to trigger this effect on any enemies you are in combat with.
spells.description_zh:
在敌人对你造成伤害之前先对敌人造成伤害，可使你的爆击几率提高10%，持续5秒。

复仇回避会刷新你的潜能，使这个效果能对任何正与你战斗的敌人触发。

spells.description_en: When you activate Metamorphosis, the cooldowns of Blade Dance and Eye Beam are immediately reset.
spells.description_zh: 激活恶魔变形会立即重置刃舞和眼棱的冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Chaos Nova, Eye Beam, and Immolation Aura gain bonuses when striking 1 target.

 Chaos Nova:
Stun duration increased by 2 sec.

 Eye Beam:
Deals 30% increased damage.

 Immolation Aura:
Always critically strikes.
spells.description_zh:
混乱新星、眼棱和献祭光环击中1个目标时获得加成。

 混乱新星:
昏迷持续时间延长2秒。

 眼棱：
造成的伤害提高30%。

 献祭光环：
总能造成爆击。

spells.description_en: The duration of your active demon form is extended by 0.1 sec per 12 Fury spent.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗12点恶魔之怒，你激活的恶魔形态的持续时间就会延长0.1秒。

spells.description_en: Gain critical strike damage equal to 40% of your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 你的爆击伤害提高，数值等同于你的爆击几率的40%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Invoke Yul'on, the Jade Serpent by 1 min, but decreases its duration to 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使青龙下凡的冷却时间缩短1分钟，但也会使持续时间缩短至12秒。

spells.description_en: The absorb amount of Life Cocoon is increased by 80%.
spells.description_zh: 作茧缚命的吸收量提高80%。

spells.description_en:
After using Thunder Focus Tea, your next spell gives 4% of a stat. Only one stat increase may be active at once:
Enveloping Mist: Critical strike
Renewing Mist: Haste
Rising Sun Kick: Versatility
spells.description_zh:
使用雷光聚神茶后，你的下一个法术会使一项属性提高4%。同一时间内只能激活一种属性提升：
氤氲之雾：爆击
复苏之雾：急速
旭日东升踢：全能

spells.description_en: Purify 5% of your Staggered damage each time you gain 3 sec of Shuffle duration.
spells.description_zh: 你每获得3秒的酒醒入定效果，就会化解5%的醉拳伤害。

spells.description_en: Your Enveloping Mists heal the target for 2,280 each time they take direct damage.
spells.description_zh: 每当氤氲之雾的目标受到直接伤害时，氤氲之雾会为其恢复2,280点生命值。

spells.description_en: Life Cocoon applies Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist to the target.
spells.description_zh: 作茧缚命现在会对目标施放复苏之雾和氤氲之雾。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Revival is reduced by 30 sec and Revival healing increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 还魂术的冷却时间缩短30秒，并且还魂术的治疗量提高15%。

spells.description_en: Allies targeted by Soothing Mist receive 40% more healing from your Enveloping Mist and Renewing Mist effects.
spells.description_zh: 成为抚慰之雾目标的盟友受到你氤氲之雾和复苏之雾的治疗提高40%。

spells.description_en:
Heals all party and raid members within 40 yds for 22,581 and clears them of all harmful Poison and Disease effects. 

Castable while stunned.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
为40码范围内所有小队或团队成员恢复22,707点生命值，并为其移除任何有害中毒和疾病效果。

可以在昏迷时施放。

目标超过5个时治疗效果降低。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的所有伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en:
Replaces Shadow Bolt.

Drains the target's soul, causing 2,117 Shadow damage over 4.5 sec.

Damage is increased by 100% against enemies below 20% health.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies during this effect.
spells.description_zh:
代替暗影箭。

吸取目标的灵魂，在4.5秒内造成2,117点暗影伤害。

对生命值在20%以下的目标造成的伤害提高100%。

如果目标在效果持续期间死亡，产生1个灵魂碎片。

spells.description_en: Increases all damage dealt by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 造成的所有伤害提高2%。

spells.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by you and your target while channeling Soothing Mists by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 引导抚慰之雾时，你和目标受到的所有伤害降低6%。

spells.description_en: Renewing Mist's heal over time effect has a 5.0% chance to apply Enveloping Mist for 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 复苏之雾的持续治疗效果有5.0%的几率施加氤氲之雾，持续2秒。

spells.description_en: Renewing Mist has a 8% chance to immediately spread to an additional target when initially cast or when traveling to a new target.
spells.description_zh: 复苏之雾在最初施放或转移向新目标时有8%的几率立即扩散到额外一个目标身上。

spells.description_en: Tiger Palms strike twice, Blackout Kicks strike an additional 2 targets at 20% effectiveness, and Spinning Crane Kick heals 1 nearby allies for 280% of the damage done.
spells.description_zh: 猛虎掌可以攻击两次，幻灭踢会以20%的效果额外攻击2个目标，神鹤引项踢会为附近的1个盟友恢复生命值，治疗量相当于造成伤害的280%。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick deals 70% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高70%，神鹤引项踢的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Increases all healing taken by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的所有治疗效果提高6%。

spells.description_en:
After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

This effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.
spells.description_zh:
施放旭日东升踢后，你的下一次活血术变为瞬发。

此效果还会使活血术的能量消耗降低75%。

spells.description_en: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 壮胆酒的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Increases your maximum health by an additional 10% and your damage taken is reduced by an additional 10% while Fortifying Brew is active.
spells.description_zh: 壮胆酒激活时，你的最大生命值额外提高10%，受到的伤害额外降低10%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Conflagrate by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧的冷却时间缩短2秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Immolate by 25% and its duration by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 献祭的伤害提高25%，持续时间延长3秒。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick and Enveloping Mist apply Renewing Mist for 6 seconds to an ally within 40 yds.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢和氤氲之雾会为40码范围内的一名盟友施加复苏之雾，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Spinning Crane Kick damage increased by 15% and its radius is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 神鹤引项踢的伤害提高15%，范围扩大15%。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高15%，爆击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Tiger Palm damage increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 猛虎掌造成的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Detox additionally removes all Poison and Disease effects.
spells.description_zh: 清创生血能够移除所有的中毒和疾病效果。

spells.description_en: Rapid Fire increases the damage of your next Aimed Shot by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 急速射击使你下一次瞄准射击的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Fiery Brand also increases Fire damage you deal to the target by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 烈火烙印还会使你对目标造成的火焰伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Execute critical strike chance increased by 5% and Execute immediately refunds an additional 10% of the Rage spent.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀的爆击几率提高5%，立即额外返还消耗怒气的10%。

spells.description_en: Soul Leech also heals you for 8% and your pet for 25% of the absorption it grants.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂榨取还会为你和你的宠物恢复生命值，分别为其产生吸收量的8%和25%。

spells.description_en:
Call upon the Light and gain 15 stacks of Divine Resolve, increasing your maximum health by 1% and reducing your damage taken by 2% per stack for 20 sec. After 5.0 sec, you will begin to lose 1 stack per second, but each 3 Holy Power spent will delay the loss of your next stack by 1 sec.

While active, your damage and healing are increased by 10%, and critical strike chance is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
召唤圣光，获得15层神圣决心，每层使你的最大生命值提高1%，并使你受到的伤害降低2%，持续20秒。5.0秒后，开始每秒失去1层，但每消耗3点神圣能量可使下一层的损失推迟1秒。

激活时，你的伤害和治疗效果提高10%，爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the current health of your target. Lower health targets are healed for more.
spells.description_zh: 基于目标的当前生命值，你的治疗效果最多提高10%。生命值较低的目标会获得更多治疗。

spells.description_en: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 你受到爆击的几率降低2%。你的主要恶魔受到的所有伤害降低8%。

spells.description_en: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用恶魔法阵：传送或你的恶魔传送门会使你受到的所有伤害降低4%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Targets resurrected with Soulstone resurrect with 40% additional health and 80% additional mana.
spells.description_zh: 使用灵魂石复活的目标复活时额外拥有40%的生命值和80%的法力值。

spells.description_en: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 巫妖之躯的持续时间延长2秒，冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Blade Dance causes your next Chaos Strike within 8 sec to have a 14-30% increased critical strike chance and will always refund Fury.
spells.description_zh: 刃舞使你8秒内的下一个混乱打击的爆击几率提高14-30%，而且总会返还恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Vengeful Retreat has a 5 sec reduced cooldown and generates 80 Fury over 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 复仇回避的冷却时间缩短5秒，并在10秒内产生80点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Entering demon form causes your next Chaos Strike to unleash your inner demon, causing it to crash into your target and deal 74 Chaos damage to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 进入恶魔形态会使你的下一个混乱打击释放内心中的恶魔，让它冲向你的目标，对附近的所有敌人造成74点混乱伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Increases maximum health by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 最大生命值提高3%。

spells.description_en: Reduces magic damage taken by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en: You take 10% reduced magic damage while Immolation Aura is active.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环激活时你受到的魔法伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: When Fel Devastation finishes fully channeling, it refreshes 15-30% of its cooldown and refunds 15-30 Fury.
spells.description_zh: 邪能毁灭完全引导结束时，会刷新15-30%的冷却时间，并返还15-30点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: When consuming a Soul Fragment would heal you above full health it shields you instead, up to a maximum of 3,055.
spells.description_zh: 当消耗灵魂残片的治疗效果造成过量治疗时，治疗效果会转而为你提供护盾，最多为3,055点。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of your Sigils by 2 sec and radius by 2 yds.
spells.description_zh: 咒符的持续时间延长2秒，半径扩大2码。

spells.description_en: Your Sigils have 15% reduced cooldowns.
spells.description_zh: 你的咒符冷却时间缩短15%。

spells.description_en: Demon Spikes reduces damage taken by 5% while active.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔尖刺激活时，你受到的伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: Activating Infernal Strike out of combat or within 5 sec of entering combat places a Sigil of Flame at the target location.
spells.description_zh: 在脱离战斗或进入战斗后5秒内激活地狱火撞击，会在目标位置放置一个烈焰咒符。

spells.description_en: While Demon Spikes is active, melee attacks against you cause the attacker to take 10 Physical damage. Generates high threat.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔尖刺激活时，对你发动近战攻击的目标会受到10点物理伤害。产生大量威胁值。

spells.description_en: Fiery Brand has 12 sec reduced cooldown and 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 烈火烙印冷却时间缩短12秒，而且可以额外使用1次。

spells.description_en: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and snares all enemies hit by 50% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 投掷利刃现在可以使用2次并诱捕击中的敌人，使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Darkness by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗的持续时间延长3秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Darkness by 120 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗的冷却时间缩短120秒。

spells.description_en: The healing of Shattered Souls is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 破碎灵魂的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Fel Rush increases your movement speed by 10% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 邪能冲撞使你的移动速度提高10%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Spectral Sight has 5 sec reduced cooldown and no longer reduces movement speed.
spells.description_zh: 幽灵视觉的冷却时间减少5秒且不再降低移动速度。

spells.description_en: Tiger Palm's damage is increased by 100% and reduces the remaining cooldown of your Brews by 0.5 additional sec.
spells.description_zh: 猛虎掌的伤害提高100%，并使你的酒类技能剩余的冷却时间额外缩短0.5秒。

spells.description_en:
Enemies struck by Sigil of Flame, Soul Cleave, and Spirit Bomb are afflicted with Frailty for 8 sec.

You heal for 10% of all damage you deal to targets with Frailty.
spells.description_zh:
被烈焰咒符、灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹命中的敌人会受到脆弱效果的影响，持续8秒。

你对有脆弱效果的目标造成伤害时会恢复生命值，恢复量相当于造成的所有伤害的10%。

spells.description_en: Frailty now also increases all damage you deal to afflicted targets by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 脆弱还会使你对受到影响的目标造成的所有伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Chaos Strike has a 10% chance to trigger a second Chaos Strike.
spells.description_zh: 混乱打击有10%的几率触发第二次混乱打击。

spells.description_en: The final slash of Blade Dance deals an additional 25% damage.
spells.description_zh: 刃舞的最后一击造成的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: The effects of Frailty are doubled.
spells.description_zh: 脆弱的效果翻倍。

spells.description_en: Eye Beam summons an allied Vengeance Demon Hunter who casts Fel Devastation, dealing 91 Fire damage over 2 sec. Dealing damage heals you for up to 61 health.
spells.description_zh: 眼棱会召唤一名复仇恶魔猎手盟友，该盟友会施放邪能毁灭，在2秒内造成90点火焰伤害。造成伤害会使你回复最多60点生命值。

spells.description_en: Striking an enemy with Chaos Strike or Throw Glaive increases Chaos Strike and Throw Glaive damage by 15% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 用混乱打击或投掷利刃击中敌人会使混乱打击和投掷利刃的伤害提高15%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura's damage increases by 10% each time it deals damage.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环每次造成伤害，其伤害就会提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Place a demonic sigil at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Detonates to deal 243 Chaos damage and shatter up to 3 Soul Fragments from enemies affected by the sigil. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
将一枚魔化咒符放置在目标位置，2秒后激活。

引爆咒符会造成238点混沌伤害并从受到影响的敌人身上炸出最多3个灵魂残片。目标多于5个时，造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Critical strike damage of your diseases is increased by 25%
spells.description_zh: 你的疾病的爆击伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Dark Transformation and Army of the Dead summon a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗突变和亡者大军会召唤一名亡者魔导师，向你的敌人投射寒冰箭和暗影箭，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Fire damage increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 火焰伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en:
Each time your Arcane Barrage fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.
spells.description_zh:
每当你的奥术弹幕未能造成爆击时，其爆击几率提高10%。

当受影响的法术造成爆击后，此爆击加成便会移除。

spells.description_en: Dark Transformation empowers your Gargoyle, Abomination, Magus and Lesser Ghouls for 30 sec, increasing their damage by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗突变强化你的石像鬼、憎恶、亡者魔导师和次级食尸鬼，使其伤害提高25%，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Death Coil deals 10% increased damage and causes the target to take an additional 30% of the direct damage dealt over 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 凋零缠绕的伤害提高10%，并使目标在4秒内受到额外伤害，数值相当于其所受直接伤害的30%。

spells.description_en: Dread Plague deals damage to an additional nearby enemy at 75% effectiveness and has a chance to grant you 4 Runic Power.
spells.description_zh: 恐惧瘟疫以75%的效果额外对附近一名敌人造成伤害，并有一定几率使你获得4点符文能量。

spells.description_en: Windfury Weapon has a 100% chance to trigger a third attack.
spells.description_zh: 风怒武器有100%的几率触发第三次攻击。

spells.description_en: When Lava Lash strikes a target affected by your Flame Shock, its cooldown is reduced by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当熔岩猛击击中一个受你的烈焰震击影响的目标时，其冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Celestial Alignment blasts all enemies in a targeted area for 1,000 Astral damage and applies Stellar Flare to them.

Reduces the cooldown of Celestial Alignment by 60 sec.

 Stellar Flare
Burns the target for 135 Astral damage, and then an additional 894 damage over 24 sec. If dispelled, causes 803 damage to the dispeller and blasts them upwards.

Generates 12 Astral Power.
spells.description_zh:
超凡之盟会轰击目标区域里的所有敌人，造成1,012点星界伤害，并对其施加星辰耀斑效果。

超凡之盟的冷却时间缩短60秒。

星辰耀斑
灼烧目标，立即造成134点星界伤害，并在24秒内额外造成894点伤害。如果效果被驱散，则对驱散者造成803点伤害并将其击飞。

产生12点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Leap of Faith by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 信仰飞跃的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Purify additionally removes all Disease effects.
spells.description_zh: 纯净术还会移除所有疾病效果。

spells.description_en: Reduces all magic damage taken by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的所有魔法伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Fade by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 渐隐术的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces your target's physical damage taken by 5% for 15 sec after a critical heal with Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, or Penance.
spells.description_zh: 在你的快速治疗、暗影愈合或苦修产生治疗爆击后，你的目标受到的物理伤害降低5%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Power Word: Radiance by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：耀的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Power Word: Radiance by 30% and causes it to apply Atonement at an additional 10% of its normal duration.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：耀的施法时间缩短30%，并使其施加的救赎效果额外持续正常时间的10%。

spells.description_en: Each Penance bolt extends the duration of Shadow Word: Pain on enemies hit by 1.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每当苦修的箭矢击中敌人，都会使其身上的暗言术：痛持续时间延长1.5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and increases its duration by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：痛的伤害提高8%，持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: Casting Power Word: Shield increases your Haste by 5% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放真言术：盾会使你的急速提高5%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, Power Word: Shield, Penance, and Power Word: Radiance have a 20% increased chance to critically heal.
spells.description_zh: 快速治疗、暗影愈合、真言术：盾、苦修和真言术：耀的爆击几率提高20%。

spells.description_en:
While stealthed, Rake will also stun the target for 4 sec, and deal 60% increased damage for its full duration.

While stealthed, Shred deals 60% increased damage, has double the chance to critically strike, and generates 1 additional combo point.
spells.description_zh:
潜行时，斜掠还会使目标昏迷4秒，并且期间造成的伤害提高60%。

潜行时，撕碎造成的伤害提高60%，爆击几率加倍，并且额外产生1点连击点数。

spells.description_en:
Your Penance bolts increase the absorb of your next Power Word: Shield by 3%.

Stacks up to 10 times.
spells.description_zh:
你的苦修箭矢都会使下一个真言术：盾的吸收量提高3%。

最多叠加10次。

spells.description_en:
Immolation Aura has 10% increased critical strike chance and generates 1-5 Fury when it deals critical damage.

This effect may only occur once per 1 sec.
spells.description_zh:
献祭光环的爆击几率提高10%，并在爆击时产生1-5点恶魔之怒。

此效果每1秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death consume 1 sec of Shadow Word: Pain, dealing damage equal to 300% of the amount consumed.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆和暗言术：灭会使暗言术：痛的持续时间缩短1秒，立即造成相当于该伤害的300%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Swipe damage is increased by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 横扫的伤害提高40%。

spells.description_en: Tiger's Fury's damage bonus is increased by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 猛虎之怒的伤害加成提高6%。

spells.description_en: Increases the amount of damage required to break your Psychic Scream by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 打破你的心灵尖啸需要的伤害量提高25%。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Flash Heal and Prayer of Healing by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 快速治疗和治疗祷言的爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Increases the healing done by your Mastery: Echo of Light by 5% and your Renew by 13%.
spells.description_zh: 你的精通：圣光回响和恢复的治疗效果分别提高5%和13%。

spells.description_en: After damaging or healing a target below 35% health, gain 5% increased damage and healing for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 对生命值低于35%的目标造成伤害或治疗后，你造成的伤害和治疗效果提高5%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Prayer of Mending jumps 2 additional times.
spells.description_zh: 愈合祷言额外弹跳2次。

spells.description_en:
Flash Heal reduces the cast time of your next Prayer of Healing within 20 sec by 30% and increases its healing done by 18%.

Can accumulate up to 4 charges.
spells.description_zh:
快速治疗会使你在接下来20秒内的下一个治疗祷言的施法时间缩短30%，治疗效果提高18%。

最多叠加4次。

spells.description_en:
Prayer of Mending reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Serenity by 4 sec.

Holy Fire reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh:
愈合祷言会使圣言术：静的冷却时间缩短4秒。

神圣之火会使圣言术：罚的冷却时间缩短4秒。

spells.description_en: Rip damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 割裂伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Tiger's Fury lasts 5 additional seconds.
spells.description_zh: 猛虎之怒的持续时间延长5秒。

spells.description_en:
Mind Flay damage increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast by 8%, stacking up to 12 times.

Lasts 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
精神鞭笞造成伤害时使你的心灵震爆的爆击几率提高8%，最多叠加12次。

持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Increases your periodic spell damage by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 你的周期性法术伤害提高6%。

spells.description_en:
Increases your non-periodic Shadow damage by 25% for 20 sec.

Generates 30 Insanity.
spells.description_zh:
使你的非周期性暗影伤害提高25%，持续20秒。

产生30点狂乱值。

spells.description_en: After Spirit of Redemption expires, you will revive at up to 100% health, based on your healing done during Spirit of Redemption. After reviving, you cannot benefit from Spirit of Redemption for 10 min.
spells.description_zh: 在救赎之魂消失后，你将会复活，恢复最多100%的生命值，恢复的生命值由你在救赎之魂状态下产生的治疗量决定。每10分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Hammer of Wrath and Judgment deal 10% additional damage and extend the duration of Avenging Wrath by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 愤怒之锤和审判造成的伤害提高10%，并会使复仇之怒的持续时间延长0.5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast, Mind Flay, and Shadow Word: Death by 4% and increases their critical strike damage by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆、精神鞭笞和暗言术：灭的爆击率提高4%，爆击伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Berserk by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂暴的冷却时间缩短60秒。
