spells.description_en: Fel Devastation heals you for up to 50% more, based on your missing health.
spells.description_zh: 基于你损失的生命值，邪能毁灭的治疗效果最多提高50%。

spells.description_en: Prayer of Mending has a 15% chance to not consume a charge when it jumps to a new target.
spells.description_zh: 愈合祷言跳向新的目标时有15%几率不消耗层数。

spells.description_en:
Demon's Bite and Throw Glaive leave open wounds on your enemies, dealing 25 Chaos damage over 15 sec and increasing damage taken from your Immolation Aura by 35%.

May be applied to up to 3 targets.
spells.description_zh:
恶魔之咬和投掷利刃会在敌人身上留下伤口，在15秒内造成25点混乱伤害，并使你的献祭光环对其造成的伤害提高35%。

最多可对3个目标施加此效果。

spells.description_en: The primary target of Prayer of Healing is healed for 125% more.
spells.description_zh: 治疗祷言的主要目标获得125%额外治疗效果。

spells.description_en: Vampiric Touch deals 20% additional damage and has a chance to generate 1 Insanity each time it deals damage.
spells.description_zh: 吸血鬼之触造成的伤害提高20%，并且每次造成伤害都有几率产生1点狂乱值。

spells.description_en: Prayer of Mending heals 4% more for each bounce remaining.
spells.description_zh: 愈合祷言每有一次剩余弹跳机会，治疗量就提高4%。

spells.description_en:
Cooldown of Die By the Sword, Intervene, Interpose, Spell Reflection, Storm Bolt, and Pummel reduced by 10%.

Successfully interrupting an enemy increases the damage you deal to them by 5% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
剑在人在、援护、截拦掩护、法术反射、风暴之锤和拳击的冷却时间缩短10%。

成功打断敌人会使你对该敌人造成的伤害提高5%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Throw Glaive deals 60% increased damage, reduced by 30% for each previous enemy hit.
spells.description_zh: 投掷利刃造成的伤害提高60%。每击中一个敌人，接下来的伤害就降低30%。

spells.description_en:
Your Shadow Word: Pain damage has a chance to create Shadowy Apparitions that float towards all targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch. 

Critical strikes increase the chance by 100%.
spells.description_zh:
你的暗言术：痛有几率产生暗影幻灵，向所有被你的吸血鬼之触影响的目标飘去。

爆击会使几率提高100%。

spells.description_en:
The cooldown of Touch of Death is reduced by 45 sec.

Touch of Death deals an additional 15% damage.
spells.description_zh:
轮回之触的冷却时间缩短45秒。

轮回之触额外造成15%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Applying Rip to a target also applies a Tear that deals 20% of the new Rip's damage over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 对一个目标施加割裂时，还会施加撕裂效果，在8秒内造成新的割裂的伤害的20%。

spells.description_en: The duration of Zenith is extended by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 乾元之巅的持续时间延长5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases healing by 10% on friendly targets at or below 50% health.
spells.description_zh: 对生命值不高于50%的友方目标所施放的治疗法术，其治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick critical strike chance increased by 10% and critical damage increased by 18%.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢的爆击几率提高10%，爆击伤害提高18%。

spells.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell heals you for 100% of the damage it absorbs.
spells.description_zh: 反魔法护罩为你恢复生命值，相当于其吸收伤害量的100%。

spells.description_en: Blood Shield's duration is increased by 2 sec and it absorbs 20% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 鲜血护盾的持续时间延长2秒，而且吸收伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Fel Rush is reduced by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 邪能冲撞的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: While Blood Shield is active, you deal 8% increased damage and damage taken is reduced by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 鲜血护盾激活时，你造成的伤害提高8%，受到的伤害降低4%。

spells.description_en: Mind Flay damage increased by 15% and Insanity generation increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 精神鞭笞的伤害提高15%，产生的狂乱值提高30%。

spells.description_en: Increases your chance to parry by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 招架几率提高3%。

spells.description_en: You deal 6% more damage and receive 5% more healing while standing in your Death and Decay.
spells.description_zh: 当你站在自己的枯萎凋零中时，造成的伤害提高6%，受到的治疗效果提高5%。

spells.description_en: Enemies affected by Blood Plague take 5% increased damage from you and Death Strike increases the damage of your Blood Plague by 10% for 15 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
spells.description_zh: 你对感染血之疫病的敌人造成的伤害提高5%，此外，灵界打击还会使你血之疫病的伤害提高10%，持续15秒，最多叠加4次。

spells.description_en: After Vampiric Blood expires, you absorb damage equal to 6 times the damage your Blood Plague dealt during Vampiric Blood.
spells.description_zh: 吸血鬼之血结束时，你可以吸收伤害，数值相当于吸血鬼之血持续期间血之疫病造成伤害的6倍。

spells.description_en:
Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec.

You will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.
spells.description_zh:
召唤灵魂，爆发出能量，在4秒内连续快速引导16个德鲁伊法术和技能。

你会根据当前的形态对附近合适的目标施放野性成长、迅捷治愈、月火术、愤怒、愈合、回春术、斜掠和痛击。

spells.description_en: Death's Advance grants an additional 25% movement speed over the first 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 死亡脚步在最初的3秒内会使你额外获得25%的移动速度。

spells.description_en:
Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane
Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

 Convoke the Spirits
Convoke the Spirits' cooldown is reduced by 50% and its duration and number of spells cast is reduced by 25%. Convoke the Spirits has an increased chance to use an exceptional spell or ability.
spells.description_zh:
化身：阿莎曼之灵
化身：阿莎曼之灵的冷却时间缩短30秒。

万灵之召
万灵之召的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短25%，使用的法术数量降低25%。万灵之召使用特殊法术或技能的几率提高。

spells.description_en: Rapid Fire deals 35% additional damage, and Aimed Shot has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Rapid Fire.
spells.description_zh: 急速射击造成35%的额外伤害，并且瞄准射击有15%的几率重置急速射击的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击使目标的自动攻击速度降低5%，持续30秒，最多叠加4次。

spells.description_en: Absorbs are 15% more effective on you.
spells.description_zh: 你的吸收效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Rake also applies Rake to 1 additional nearby target.
spells.description_zh: 斜掠会对附近额外1名目标施加斜掠效果。

spells.description_en: Ferocious Bite also deals 13 damage per combo point spent to all nearby enemies. Spending extra Energy on Ferocious Bite increases damage dealt by up to 100%. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 凶猛撕咬每消耗一个连击点数，还会对附近所有敌人造成13点伤害。凶猛撕咬消耗额外的能量可使造成的伤害最多提高100%。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Tiger's Fury causes your next 3 finishing moves to restore 1 combo point.

Tiger's Fury also increases the periodic damage of your bleeds by an additional 10% for their full duration.
spells.description_zh:
猛虎之怒会使你的下3个终结技恢复1个连击点数。

猛虎之怒还会使你的流血技能的持续性伤害在其整个持续时间内额外提升10%。

spells.description_en: Finishing moves have a 3% chance per combo point spent to grant 10% Haste for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 终结技每消耗一个连击点数，便有3%几率使急速提高10%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Rip damage has a 4.0% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite free and deal the maximum damage.
spells.description_zh: 割裂的伤害有4.0%的几率使你的下一个凶猛撕咬无消耗，并且造成最大伤害。

spells.description_en: Rip and Rake last 25% longer.
spells.description_zh: 割裂和斜掠的持续时间延长25%。

spells.description_en: Kill Command critical damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令的爆击伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: When your Rejuvenation heals a full health target, its duration is increased by 2 sec, up to a maximum total increase of 6 sec per cast.
spells.description_zh: 当你对生命值全满的目标施放回春术时，它的持续时间会延长2秒，每次施放最多可延长6秒。

spells.description_en: Allies protected by your Ironbark also receive 75% of the healing from each of your active Rejuvenations and Ironbark's duration is increased by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 受到你的铁木树皮保护的盟友也会从你所激活的所有回春术中受到75%的治疗，铁木树皮的持续时间增加4秒。

spells.description_en: Wild Growth momentarily shifts your mind into the Emerald Dream, instantly healing all allies affected by your Rejuvenation or Regrowth for 820.
spells.description_zh: 野性成长暂时将你的心灵转移到翡翠梦境之中，立即为身上带有你的回春术或愈合效果的盟友恢复820点生命值。

spells.description_en: Lifebloom stacks every 5 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh: 每5秒叠加一层生命绽放效果，最多叠加3次。

spells.description_en: Clearcast Regrowths heal for an additional 40%.
spells.description_zh: 通过节能施法施放的愈合能够额外造成40%的治疗效果。

spells.description_en: Ysera's Gift now heals every 4 sec and its healing is increased by 8% for each of your active Rejuvenations.
spells.description_zh: 伊瑟拉之赐现在每4秒治疗一次，并且每个激活的回春术都会使其治疗效果提高8%。

spells.description_en: Lifebloom counts for 3 stacks of Mastery: Harmony.
spells.description_zh: 生命绽放可提供3层精通：相生。

spells.description_en: Soul of the Forest now causes your next Rejuvenation or Regrowth to apply to 2 additional allies within 20 yards of the target.
spells.description_zh: 丛林之魂现在会使你的下一个回春术或愈合能够施加给目标20码范围内额外2名盟友。

spells.description_en: When Lifebloom blooms, up to 3 targets within your Efflorescence are healed for 505.
spells.description_zh: 生命绽放进行最终绽放时，可以治疗最多3名拥有你的百花齐放效果的目标，使其恢复505点生命值。

spells.description_en: Increase the chance for Mastery: Enhanced Elements to trigger Windfury and Stormsurge by 150%.
spells.description_zh: 精通：增强元素触发风怒和风暴喷涌的几率提高150%。

spells.description_en: Every 4 casts of Swiftmend grants you Incarnation: Tree of Life for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你每施放4次迅捷治愈，就会获得化身：生命之树效果，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Nature's Cure additionally removes all Curse and Poison effects.
spells.description_zh: 自然之愈还会移除所有诅咒和中毒效果。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你的武器药膏的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Swiftmend no longer consumes a heal over time effect.
spells.description_zh: 迅捷治愈不再消耗持续治疗效果。

spells.description_en:
Shadow Word: Death damage increased by 25%.

Shadow Word: Death gains its damage and talent bonuses against targets below 35% health instead of 20%.
spells.description_zh:
暗言术：灭的伤害提高25%。

暗言术：灭在目标生命值低于35%时获得伤害和天赋加成，不再是20%。

spells.description_en: Your ghoul's attacks have a chance to apply Enfeeble, reducing the enemies movement speed by 30% and the damage they deal to you by 12% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的食尸鬼的攻击有几率施加衰弱效果，使敌人的移动速度降低30%，对你造成的伤害降低12%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。斩杀的爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Mortal Strike and Cleave have a 20% chance to immediately refund 10% of the Rage spent.
spells.description_zh: 致死打击和顺劈斩有20%的几率立即返还消耗怒气的10%。

spells.description_en: Expel Harm's healing increased by 6% and critical strike chance increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 移花接木的治疗效果提高6%，爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Holy Light heals up to 5 targets within 12 yds for 8% of its healing.
spells.description_zh: 圣光术会治疗12码范围内最多5个目标，治疗量为原本的8%。

spells.description_en: Infusion of Light has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 圣光灌注的使用次数增加1次。

spells.description_en: Expel Harm's critical healing is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 移花接木的爆击治疗效果提高50%。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Aura Mastery is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 光环掌握的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Lay on Hands' cooldown is reduced by 1.0 sec per Holy Power spent.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗一层神圣能量，圣疗术的冷却时间就缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: While Enraged, Bloodthirst and Raging Blow deal 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 激怒状态下，嗜血和怒击的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Raging Blow deals 15% increased damage and while Enraged, Raging Blow has a 10% increased chance to instantly reset its own cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 怒击的伤害提高15%。激怒时，怒击立即重置其冷却时间的几率提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Judgment grants an absorb shield on up to 5 injured allies for 8% of the damage done, split evenly among them.

Flash of Light and Holy Light critical strikes reset the cooldown of Judgment.
spells.description_zh:
审判为最多5个受伤的盟友施加吸收盾，吸收量等同于造成伤害的8%，由这些盟友均摊。

圣光闪现和圣光术爆击时，重置审判的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: When empowered by Rime, Howling Blast deals 30% increased damage to your primary target.
spells.description_zh: 被白霜强化时，凛风冲击对主目标的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick has a chance equal to 100% of your haste to trigger a second time, dealing 17 Physical damage and restoring 1 Chi.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢有等同于急速的100%的几率被再次触发，造成17点物理伤害，并恢复1点真气。

spells.description_en: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Shock by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗圣光灌注会使神圣震击冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: You are able to block spells for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你可以格挡法术，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Spinning Crane Kick detonates into a Chi Explosion, dealing 122 Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards, reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 神鹤引项踢会引爆能量并产生真气破，对8码内的所有敌人造成122点自然伤害，目标超过5个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick damage increased by 5% and strikes an additional 2 targets at 80% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢的伤害提高5%并且能够额外攻击2个目标，产生80%的效果。

spells.description_en: Strike with both fists at all enemies in front of you, dealing 529 Physical damage and reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.
spells.description_zh: 用双拳攻击你前方的所有目标，造成529点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。对次要目标造成较低的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch grant you 4 stacks of Thunderfist and an additional stack for each additional enemy struck. 

Thunderfist discharges upon melee strikes, dealing 56 Nature damage.
spells.description_zh:
风领主之击和升龙霸使你获得4层雷霆拳效果，每额外击中一名敌人额外获得一层。

近战攻击会消耗雷霆拳层数，造成56点自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger's damage is increased by 30% and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 白虎下凡的伤害提高30%，冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en:
Your Holy Words summon an image of a Naaru at your side. For 9 sec, whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Naaru will cast a similar spell.

If an image has already been summoned, that image is empowered instead.
spells.description_zh:
你的圣言术法术会在身边召唤一个纳鲁的影像，持续9秒。期间每当你施放一个治疗或伤害法术，纳鲁就会施放一个类似的法术。

如果已经召唤了影像，则会改为强化影像。

spells.description_en:
Rising Sun Kick critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 4 sec.

Spinning Crane Kick reduces the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 0.5 sec for each unique target struck, up to 2.5 sec.

The critical strike chance of Rising Sun Kick is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
旭日东升踢爆击时，怒雷破的冷却时间缩短4秒。

神鹤引项踢每击中一个不同的目标，怒雷破的冷却时间缩短0.5秒，最多缩短2.5秒。

旭日东升踢的爆击几率提高20%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Jadefire Stomp by 10% per target hit by that damage, up to a maximum of 50% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 每命中一名目标，碧火踏的伤害就会提高10%，至多可达50%。

spells.description_en: Cleanse additionally removes all Disease and Poison effects.
spells.description_zh: 清洁术还会移除所有疾病和中毒效果。

spells.description_en: Throw Glaive now costs 25 Fury and throws a second glaive at the target.
spells.description_zh: 投掷利刃现在消耗25点恶魔之怒，而且会向目标投掷第二把利刃。

spells.description_en: For each target hit by Avenger's Shield, gain 3% parry for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 复仇者之盾每命中一个目标，就获得3%的招架，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Ardent Defender increases your maximum health by 20% for its duration, and its effect is no longer canceled when you take fatal damage.
spells.description_zh: 炽热防御者在其持续期间使你的最大生命值提高20%，且不再因承受致命伤害而取消该效果。

spells.description_en: When you consume a Healing Sphere, you clear 5% of your currently Staggered damage.
spells.description_zh: 每当你消耗一颗疗伤珠，就可以化解你身上5%的醉拳伤害。

spells.description_en:
Incarnation: Tree of Life
During Incarnation: Tree of Life, you summon a Grove Guardian every 10 sec. The cooldown of Incarnation: Tree of Life is reduced by 5.0 sec when Grove Guardians fade.

 Convoke the Spirits
Convoke the Spirits' cooldown is reduced by 50% and its duration and number of spells cast is reduced by 25%. Convoke the Spirits has an increased chance to use an exceptional spell or ability.
spells.description_zh:
化身：生命之树
化身：生命之树期间，你每10秒召唤一个林莽卫士。林莽卫士消失时，化身：生命之树的冷却时间缩短5.0秒。

 万灵之召
万灵之召的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短25%，使用的法术数量降低25%。万灵之召使用特殊法术或技能的几率提高。

spells.description_en:
Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc: 
Every 25 Rage you spend reduces the cooldown of Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc by 1 sec.

 Convoke the Spirits: 
Convoke the Spirits' cooldown is reduced by 50% and its duration and number of spells cast is reduced by 25%. Convoke the Spirits has an increased chance to use an exceptional spell or ability.
spells.description_zh:
化身：乌索克的守护者: 
每消耗25点怒气，化身：乌索克的守护者的冷却时间就缩短1秒。

 万灵之召: 
万灵之召的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短25%，使用的法术数量降低25%。万灵之召使用特殊法术或技能的几率提高。

spells.description_en:
Thrash has a 10% chance to trigger an additional Thrash.

Thrash stacks 1 additional time.
spells.description_zh:
痛击有10%的几率额外触发一次痛击。

痛击可以额外叠加1次。

spells.description_en: Drinking a Brew grants you 10% dodge for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用酒类技能时，你获得10%躲闪，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Barkskin and Ironfur by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的树皮术和铁鬃的持续时间延长2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Ironfur increases armor by an additional 15% and Barkskin reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 铁鬃使护甲值额外提高15%，树皮术使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

spells.description_en: Wrath and Starfire have a 20% chance to cause your next Wrath or Starfire cast during an Eclipse to become Astral and deal 75% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 愤怒和星火术有20%的几率使你在日月之蚀期间施放的下一个愤怒或星火术造成星界伤害，并且伤害提高75%。

spells.description_en: Increases your mastery by 2.6%.
spells.description_zh: 你的精通提高2.6%。

spells.description_en: Fel Devastation damage increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 邪能毁灭的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Increases healing done by Flash Heal and Shadow Mend by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使快速治疗和暗影愈合的治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Barbed Shot deals 10% increased damage, and applying Barbed Shot reduces the cooldown of Kill Command by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 倒刺射击的伤害提高10%，施加倒刺射击的效果时会使杀戮命令的冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

spells.description_en: Starsurge has a 20% chance to make Starfall free. Starfall has a 40% chance to make Starsurge free.
spells.description_zh: 星涌术有20%几率使星辰坠落不产生消耗，星辰坠落有40%的几率使星涌术不产生消耗。

spells.description_en: Raging Blow increases the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 怒击使你下一次嗜血的伤害提高5%，最多叠加5次。

spells.description_en: Starsurge and Starfall deal 8% increased damage and their cost is reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 星涌术和星辰坠落造成的伤害提高8%，消耗降低10%。

spells.description_en: You are healed for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.
spells.description_zh: 消失激活后的6秒内，你恢复最大生命值的30%。

spells.description_en:
Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
Reduces the Astral Power cost of Starsurge by 10, and the Astral Power cost of Starfall by 12.

 Convoke the Spirits
Cooldown is reduced by 50% and its duration and number of spells cast is reduced by 25%. Convoke the Spirits has an increased chance to use an exceptional spell or ability.
spells.description_zh:
化身：艾露恩之眷
星涌术消耗的星界能量降低10点，星辰坠落消耗的星界能量降低12点。

万灵之召
冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间和使用的法术数量降低25%。万灵之召使用特殊法术或技能的几率提高。

spells.description_en: Starsurge has a chance to summon the Spirit of Goldrinn, which immediately deals 974 Astral damage to the target.
spells.description_zh: 你的星涌术有几率召唤戈德林之魂，立即对目标造成974点星界伤害。

spells.description_en: Entering Eclipse increases your critical strike chance with Arcane or Nature spells by 20%, decreasing by 2% every 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 进入日月之蚀状态后，你的奥术或自然法术造成爆击的几率提高20%，随后每1秒消退2%。

spells.description_en: Your Moonfire and Sunfire have a chance to summon a Faerie Dragon to assist you in battle for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的月火术和阳炎术有一定几率召唤一个精灵龙为你而战，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Every other Eclipse creates a Fury of Elune at 25% effectiveness that follows your current target for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每进入日月之蚀两次，就会施放一次效果为25%的艾露恩之怒，追击你当前的目标，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: After you use Transcendence: Transfer, you can use Transcendence: Transfer again within 10 sec, ignoring its cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 施放魂体双分：转移后，你可以在10秒内再次施放魂体双分：转移，无视其冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
New Moon, Half Moon, and Full Moon deal 25% increased damage. Full Moon becomes Full Moon once more before resetting to New Moon.

Fury of Elune deals 50% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh:
新月、半月和满月的伤害提高25%。在重置为新月前，满月将再一次变成满月。

艾露恩之怒的伤害提高50%，冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
spells.description_zh: 轮回之触的冷却时间缩短90秒。

spells.description_en:
Devastate deals 20% increased damage and generates 2 Rage.

Devastator deals 10% increased damage and generates 2 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
毁灭打击的伤害提高20%并产生2点怒气。

灭绝者的伤害提高10%并产生2点怒气。

spells.description_en:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
连击点数的上限额外提高1点。

消耗5点连击点数以上的终结技产生的效果得以加强，并且终结技造成的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
连击点数的上限额外提高1点。

消耗5点连击点数以上的终结技产生的效果得以加强，并且终结技造成的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Shadow Dance has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 暗影之舞可以额外使用1次。

spells.description_en: Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 暗影步可以额外使用1次。

spells.description_en:
Increase all damage dealing allies' primary stat by 8.0% of your own and increase your own damage by 20% for 10 sec.

Ebon Might will split its effect when applied to more than 2 other allies.

Eruption, Deep Breath, and your empower spells extend the duration of these effects.
spells.description_zh:
使所有伤害输出型盟友的主属性提高，数值相当于你自身主属性的8.0%，并使你自身造成的伤害提高20%，持续10秒。

当黑檀之力作用于超过2名其他盟友时，效果会被分摊。

喷发、深呼吸和你的蓄力法术可以延长这些效果的持续时间。

spells.description_en: Cause a violent eruption beneath an enemy's feet, dealing 1,064 Volcanic damage split between them and nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 在一名敌人脚下引发剧烈喷发，造成1,064点熔火伤害，由目标和附近的所有敌人均摊。

spells.description_en: Generate full combo points when you gain Adrenaline Rush.
spells.description_zh: 当你获得冲动效果时，产生最大连击点数。

spells.description_en: Afflicting an enemy with a Sigil generates 1 Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh: 对一名敌人施加咒符效果会产生1个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en: Your Living Flame has a 20% chance, and your Azure Strike has a 15% chance, to make your next Eruption cost no Essence.
spells.description_zh: 你的活化烈焰和碧蓝打击分别有20%和15%的几率使你的下一个喷发不消耗精华。

spells.description_en:
Gather earthen power beneath your enemy's feet and send them hurtling upwards, dealing 1,637 Volcanic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Empowering expands the area of effect.

I:   3 yd radius.

II:  6 yd radius.

III: 9 yd radius.
spells.description_zh:
将大地之力汇聚在敌人脚下并将其击飞，对目标和附近的敌人造成1,639点熔火伤害。

蓄力会扩大效果范围。

I：3码范围。

II：6码范围。

III：9码范围。

spells.description_en:
Activating Recklessness generates 50 Rage and while Recklessness is active, Raging Blow and Bloodthirst are upgraded to Crushing Blow and Bloodbath.

 Crushing Blow
Deals increased damage and deals 20% additional critical strike damage.

 Bloodbath
Deals increased damage and wounds the target to suffer 65 Bleed damage over 6 sec. Using Bloodbath on a target affected by Bloodbath extends the bleed by 6 sec.
spells.description_zh:
激活鲁莽产生50点怒气，在鲁莽生效期间，怒击和嗜血将强化为碎甲猛击和浴血奋战。

碎甲猛击
造成的伤害提高，并且额外造成20%的爆击伤害。

浴血奋战
造成的伤害提高，并使目标受伤，在6秒内受到65点流血伤害。对受浴血奋战影响的目标再次使用浴血奋战，会使流血效果延长6秒。

spells.description_en: Shield Wall gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 盾墙可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: Increases maximum Energy by 30. Tiger Palm's Energy cost reduced by 5.
spells.description_zh: 能量上限提高30点，猛虎掌消耗的能量降低5点。

spells.description_en: When Life Cocoon expires, it releases a burst of mist that restores 3,062 health to 3 nearby allies.
spells.description_zh: 作茧缚命效果结束时释放出一股迷雾，为附近的3名盟友恢复3,062点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Draws in all nearby clouds of mist, healing the friendly target and up to 2 nearby allies for 1,584 and an additional 79 per cloud absorbed.

A cloud of mist is generated every 8 sec while in combat.
spells.description_zh:
汇聚附近的云雾，为友方目标以及最多2名附近的盟友恢复1,584点生命值，每吸收一片云雾，额外恢复79点生命值。

在战斗中每8秒产生一片云雾。

spells.description_en: Increases Sheilun's Gift cloud of mist generation to every 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使神龙之赐产生云雾的速度加快至每4秒一片。

spells.description_en: Your Moonfire and Sunfire deal damage 20% more frequently, also increasing the rate that Shooting Stars fall.
spells.description_zh: 你的月火术和阳炎术造成伤害的频率提高20%，还会使坠星坠落的几率提高。

spells.description_en: Casting Regrowth increases your movement speed and healing received by 8% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放愈合使你的移动速度和受到的治疗提高8%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Typhoon by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 台风的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases Typhoon's radius by 20% and its range by 5 yds.
spells.description_zh: 台风的半径扩大20%，距离扩大5码。

spells.description_en: Overpower deals 15% additional damage to targets below 35% health.
spells.description_zh: 压制对生命值低于35%的目标造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Strike with the might of Ursoc, dealing 74 Physical damage to your target and 40 to all other enemies in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 以乌索克的巨力击打，对你的目标造成74点物理伤害，对前方的所有其他敌人造成41点伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Your direct damage melee abilities against enemies afflicted by Moonfire cause them to burn for an additional 20% Arcane damage.
spells.description_zh: 你对受到月火术影响的敌人施放直接近战伤害技能时，会使其燃烧，额外受到20%的奥术伤害。

spells.description_en: Your damage over time effects deal their damage in 20% less time, and your healing over time effects in 15% less time.
spells.description_zh: 你的持续伤害效果造成全部伤害所需时间减少20%，你的持续治疗效果造成全部治疗所需时间减少15%。

spells.description_en:
Volley now also applies Explosive Shot to up to 2 targets hit.

 Explosive Shot
Fires an explosive shot at your target that lasts for 3 sec. Every 1 sec the target burns for 108 Fire damage and explode, dealing 50% of the damage to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
乱射同时对命中的最多2个目标施加爆炸射击。

爆炸射击
向目标射出一发爆炸射击，持续3秒。每1秒目标会因燃烧而受到106点火焰伤害并引发爆炸，对8码内的所有敌人造成相当于该伤害50%的伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。

spells.description_en: Grove Guardians, Efflorescence, and your other summons heal for 30% more.
spells.description_zh: 林莽卫士、百花齐放和你的其他召唤技能的治疗效果提高30%。

spells.description_en:
Blackout Kick has a chance to summon a Healing Sphere.

Healing Sphere:
Summon a Healing Sphere visible only to you. Moving through this Healing Sphere heals you for 113.
spells.description_zh:
幻灭踢有一定几率生成一颗疗伤珠。

疗伤珠：
召唤一个只有你能看到的疗伤珠。穿过疗伤珠时会为你恢复114点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Overpower and Slam damage increased by 5% and critical strike damage increased by 5%.
Critical strike chance of Slam and Overpower increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
压制和猛击的伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。
猛击和压制的爆击几率提高5%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.
spells.description_zh: 减速效果的持续时间缩短30%。

spells.description_en: Each Holy Power spent has a 6% chance to reset the cooldown of Blade of Justice.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗一层神圣能量，有6%的几率重置公正之剑的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Armor increased by 10%, Stamina increased by 5% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 护甲提高10%，耐力提高5%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en:
Templar's Verdict and Blade of Justice deal 10% increased damage.

The range of Blade of Justice is increased to 20 yds.
spells.description_zh:
圣殿骑士的裁决和公正之剑造成的伤害提高10%。

公正之剑的范围延长至20码。

spells.description_en: Crusader Strike and Judgment hit an additional 4 targets but deal 25% reduced damage to secondary targets.
spells.description_zh: 十字军打击和审判额外攻击4个目标，但对次要目标造成的伤害降低25%。

spells.description_en: Your damage over time effects deal 10% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的持续性伤害效果提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Learn to attune yourself to the essence of the Black or Bronze Dragonflights:

Black Attunement: You and your 4 nearest allies have 2% increased maximum health.

Bronze Attunement:You and your 4 nearest allies have 10% increased movement speed.
spells.description_zh:
学习与黑龙或青铜龙军团的精华协调：

黑龙协调：你和最近的4名盟友的最大生命值提高2%。

青铜协调：你和最近的4名盟友的移动速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Divine Storm heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 43.
spells.description_zh: 神圣风暴为你和附近最多2名盟友恢复43点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Judgment deals 10% increased damage and increases your movement speed by 10% for 5 sec.

If you have Greater Judgment, Judgment slows enemies by 30% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
审判造成的伤害提高10%，并使你的移动速度提高10%，持续5秒。

如果你学习了强效审判天赋，审判还会使敌人的移动速度降低30%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Auto-attack speed increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 自动攻击的速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Increases Omen of Clarity's chance to activate Clearcasting to 5% and Clearcasting can stack 1 additional time.
spells.description_zh: 清晰预兆激活节能施法的概率提高5%，节能施法能够额外累积1次。

spells.description_en: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Rebuke casts an extra Crusader Strike.
spells.description_zh: 使用责难成功打断敌人会额外施放一次十字军打击。

spells.description_en:
Fly to the targeted location, exposing a Temporal Wound on enemies in your path for 10 sec.

Removes roots and grants immunity to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying.

 Temporal Wound
15% of damage dealt by allies affected by Ebon Might is copied as additional Arcane damage to enemies after 10 sec.

Damage is reduced if Ebon Might affects more than 2 other allies.
spells.description_zh:
飞向目标位置，使路径中的敌人暴露出时光创伤，持续10秒。

移除定身效果，并在飞行期间免疫移动限制和失控效果。

时光创伤
受到黑檀之力影响的盟友所造成伤害的15%复制到敌人身上，在10秒后造成额外的奥术伤害。

当黑檀之力影响的其他盟友超过2名时效果降低。

spells.description_en: Crusader Strike, Judgment and Blade of Justice deal 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 十字军打击、审判和正义之刃造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Blade of Justice now has 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 公正之剑现在拥有2层充能。

spells.description_en:
Blade of Justice now hits nearby enemies for 20 Holy damage. 

Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
公正之剑现在对附近的敌人造成20点神圣伤害。

目标超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Fatal attacks are diverted into a nearby timeline, preventing the damage, and your death, in this one.

The release of temporal energy restores 12,693 health to you, and 4,047 to 4 nearby allies, over 9 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.

May only occur once every 6 min.
spells.description_zh:
将致命攻击转移至附近的时间线，在本条时间线中阻止伤害并使你免于一死。

释放的时间能量在9秒内为你恢复12,404点生命值，并为附近的4名盟友恢复4,128点生命值。治疗量开始时较高，并会逐渐降低。

每6分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en:
When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.

Cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当你的生命值降低到25%以下时，立即对自己施放一次免费的荣耀圣令，效果为原来的60%。

每60秒最多触发一次。

spells.description_en: Sheilun's Gift heals 2 additional allies and its cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 神龙之赐额外治疗2个盟友，施法时间缩短0.5秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Blade of Justice by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 公正之剑的冷却时间降低2秒。

spells.description_en: Mastery: Highlord's Judgment is 50% more effective on Judgment and Hammer of Wrath. Judgment applies an additional stack of Greater Judgment if it is known.
spells.description_zh: 精通：大领主的审判对审判和愤怒之锤的效果提高50%。如果习得强效审判，审判会额外施加一层强效审判。

spells.description_en: Regrowth's healing over time is increased by 100%, and it also applies to the target of your Lifebloom.
spells.description_zh: 愈合的持续治疗效果提高100%，且其持续治疗效果也会作用于你的生命绽放的目标。

spells.description_en:
Crusader Strike replaces your auto-attacks and deals 83 Physical damage.

Auto-attack speed is decreased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
十字军打击替换你的自动攻击，造成83点物理伤害。

自动攻击速度降低15%。

spells.description_en: Surge forward in time, causing your cooldowns to recover 1,000% faster for 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在时光中跃进，使你的冷却速度加快1,000%，持续2秒。

spells.description_en: Judgment has a 50% increased chance to trigger Mastery: Highlord's Judgment.
spells.description_zh: 审判触发精通：大领主的审判的几率提高50%。

spells.description_en: Wake of Ashes deals significantly reduced damage to secondary targets, but now causes you to lash out 2 extra times for 79 Radiant damage.
spells.description_zh: 灰烬觉醒对次要目标的伤害会显著降低，但现在会使你额外攻击敌人2次，造成79点光辉伤害。

spells.description_en: Judgment now has 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 审判现在可以使用2次。

spells.description_en:
Your auto attacks have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Blade of Justice.

Critical strikes increase the chance by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh:
你的自动攻击有15%的几率重置公正之剑的冷却时间。

爆击使该几率额外提高10%。

spells.description_en: Word of Glory grants 20% bonus armor for 4.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 荣耀圣令额外提供20%的护甲加成，持续4.5秒。

spells.description_en: Crusader Strike and auto-attacks deal 10% increased damage and deal 10% increased critical strike damage.
spells.description_zh: 十字军打击和自动攻击的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Holy Power spending abilities deal 5% increased damage.

After casting Execution Sentence, your next 1 Holy Power ability will refund its Holy Power cost.
spells.description_zh:
消耗神圣能量的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

在施放处决宣判后，你的下1个神圣能量技能将返还其消耗的神圣能量。

spells.description_en: Shield of the Righteous heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 43.
spells.description_zh: 正义盾击会为你和附近最多2名盟友恢复43点生命值。

spells.description_en: You deal 5% increased Holy damage to targets burning from your Expurgation.
spells.description_zh: 你对异端逐除燃烧的目标造成的神圣伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Crusader Strike loses a charge but is now a combo ability.

Templar Strike slashes an enemy for 66 Radiant damage and gets followed up by Templar Slash that deals 74 Radiant damage. Templar Slash always critically strikes.
spells.description_zh:
十字军打击失去一层充能，但现在是一个连击技能。

圣殿骑士打击会斩击一名敌人，造成65点光辉伤害，并接续圣殿骑士斩击，造成76点光辉伤害。圣殿骑士斩击总会爆击。

spells.description_en: Eruption deals 30% more damage per enemy struck, up to 150%.
spells.description_zh: 喷发每击中一个敌人，造成的伤害提高30%，最多提高150%。

spells.description_en:
Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec.

Affects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.
spells.description_zh:
为你和最近的友方治疗者唤起悖论，使你们能够在移动时施法，并使大部分法术的射程提高100%，持续10秒。

如果你的目标不是治疗者，则会影响60码内最近的治疗者。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆额外获得一层充能。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Avenging Wrath or Crusade by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 征伐或复仇之怒的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Your Wrath and Starfire chance to critically strike is increased by 10% and they generate 2 additional Astral Power.
spells.description_zh: 你的愤怒和星火术的爆击几率提高10%，并额外产生2点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Eruption's Essence cost is reduced by 1.
spells.description_zh: 喷发的精华消耗降低1。

spells.description_en: Blistering Scales no longer loses charges and deals 20% more damage.
spells.description_zh: 炽火龙鳞不再消耗充能，造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: The critical strikes of your Holy Power generating abilities grant you 5% Haste for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 产生神圣能量的技能爆击后，你获得5%的急速，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by 4.0% for 12 sec.

Hover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by 25% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh:
黑曜鳞片会激活黑龙协调并强化其效果，使最大生命值提高4.0%，持续12秒。

悬空会激活青铜协调并强化其效果，使移动速度提高25%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: When Rapid Fire finishes channeling, your critical strike chance is increased by 6% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 完成急速射击的引导后，你的爆击几率提高6%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Bestial Wrath causes your Barbed Shot to deal damage 50% faster for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂野怒火使你的倒刺射击造成伤害的速度提高50%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Increases your Shadow Word: Madness damage by 6% and increases your maximum Insanity by 50.
spells.description_zh: 使你的暗言术：癫造成的伤害提高6%，并使你的最大狂乱值提高50点。

spells.description_en: Shadow Apparitions deal 30% increased damage to targets affected by your Shadow Word: Madness.
spells.description_zh: 暗影幻灵对受你的暗言术：癫影响的目标造成的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the Insanity cost of Shadow Word: Madness by 5.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：癫的狂乱值消耗降低5点。

spells.description_en: When cast at an enemy, Living Flame strikes 1 additional enemy for 100% damage.
spells.description_zh: 对敌人施放时，活化烈焰会额外打击1名敌人，造成100%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath grants you Fury of the Aspects for 15 sec after you land, without causing Exhaustion.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸落地后使你获得守护巨龙之怒，持续15秒，而且不会导致筋疲力尽。

spells.description_en: Prescience has a 35% chance to grant Essence Burst.
spells.description_zh: 先知先觉有35%的几率获得精华迸发。

spells.description_en: Eruption reduces the remaining cooldown of Upheaval by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 喷发使地壳激变的剩余冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Upheaval deals 50% increased damage to the primary target, and launches them higher.
spells.description_zh: 地壳激变对主要目标造成的伤害提高50%，并提高击飞高度。

spells.description_en: Consuming Essence Burst grants you 5% Intellect for 6 sec. Stacks up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 消耗精华迸发使你的智力提高5%，持续6秒。最多叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 你的蓄力法术等级上限提高1级，并且达到最高级的速度加快20%。

spells.description_en:
Conjure a pair of Weyrnstones, one for your target ally and one for yourself. Only one ally may bear your Weyrnstone at a time.

A Weyrnstone can be activated by the bearer to transport them to the other Weyrnstone's location, if they are within 100 yds.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一对军营之石，使你和目标盟友各获得一个。同一时间只能有一名盟友佩戴你的军营之石。

只要两块军营之石相距100码内，佩戴者激活军营之石即可传送至另一块军营之石的位置。

spells.description_en: Holy Power spending abilities have a 10% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 10% increased damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 消耗神圣能量的技能有10%的几率会使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能不消耗资源，并且伤害和治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Essence Burst reduces the cast time of Eruption by 40% and increases its damage by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 精华迸发使喷发的施法时间缩短40%，并使其伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Madness by 20% and causes it to deal its damage over 12 sec, but increases its Insanity cost by 5.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：癫的伤害提高20%，并使其在12秒内造成伤害，但消耗的狂乱值提高5点。

spells.description_en: Eruption has a 25% chance to form a mote of diverted essence near you. Allies who comes in contact with the mote gain a random buff from your arsenal.
spells.description_zh: 喷发有25%的几率在你附近形成一个转移精华微粒。接触到微粒的盟友将获得你能提供的一个随机增益效果。

spells.description_en:
Grant an ally the gift of foresight, increasing their critical strike chance by 3% for 18 sec.

Affects the nearest ally within 25 yds, preferring damage dealers with their cooldowns active, if you do not have an ally targeted.
spells.description_zh:
使一名盟友能够先知先觉，令其爆击几率提高3%，持续18秒。

如果你的目标不是盟友，则会影响25码内最近的盟友，优先选择技能正在冷却的伤害输出者。

spells.description_en: Each time Blistering Scales explodes it deals 15% more damage for 12 sec, stacking 10 times.
spells.description_zh: 炽火龙鳞每次爆炸造成的伤害提高15%，持续12秒，最多叠加10次。

spells.description_en: When allies deal damage with Temporal Wounds, they gain a shield for 100% of the damage dealt. Absorption cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 盟友通过时光创伤造成伤害时，会获得相当于造成伤害100%的护盾。吸收量不能超过你最大生命值的30%。

spells.description_en: Breath of Eons reduces enemies' movement speed by 70%, and reduces their attack speed by 50%, for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 亘古吐息使敌人的移动速度降低70%，攻击速度降低50%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath casts an Eruption at the first 3 enemies struck. These Eruptions have a 100% chance to create a Mote of Possibility.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸首次击中3个敌人时施放一次喷发。这些喷发有100%的几率产生一个机遇微粒。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath grants the inferno's blessing for 8 sec to you and a nearby ally, giving their damaging attacks and spells a high chance to deal an additional 1,022 Fire damage.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息会为你和一名附近的盟友施加狱火祝福，持续8秒，使伤害性攻击和法术有很高的几率额外造成1,022点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: While flying during Deep Breath, 100% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在深呼吸期间飞行时，你受到伤害的100%会改为在10秒内生效。

spells.description_en: When cast, Blistering Scales grants the target a shield that absorbs up to 5,700 damage for 30 sec based on their missing health. Lower health targets gain a larger shield.
spells.description_zh: 施放技能时，炽火龙鳞会使目标获得一个吸收护盾，根据其损失的生命值吸收最多5,700点伤害，持续30秒。低生命值目标获得的护盾吸收量较高。

spells.description_en: Emerald Blossom increases targets' healing received by 3% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 翡翠之花使目标受到的治疗效果提高3%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Symbiotic Bloom.
spells.description_zh: 延长黑檀之力的效果也会延长共栖荣花。

spells.description_en: Azure Strike deals 15% increased damage and has a 10% chance per target hit to echo, casting again.
spells.description_zh: 碧蓝打击造成的伤害提高15%，每击中一个目标就有10%的几率触发回响，额外施放一次。

spells.description_en: Eternity Surge's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 永恒之涌的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Eternity Surge deals 15% increased damage to your primary target.
spells.description_zh: 永恒之涌对主目标造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 你的蓄力法术等级上限提高1级，并且达到最高级的速度加快20%。

spells.description_en:
Enchant an ally to appear out of sync with the normal flow of time, reducing threat they generate by 30% for 1 hour. Less effective on tank-specialized allies. 

May only be placed on one target at a time.
spells.description_zh:
为一名盟友施展魔法，使其仿佛与正常的时间流动脱节，产生的威胁值降低30%，持续1小时。对坦克专精的盟友效果较差。

同一时间只能对一个目标生效。

spells.description_en: The cooldowns of your spells are reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术的冷却时间缩短10%。

spells.description_en: Time Skip channels for 1 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 时间跳跃的引导时间延长1秒。

spells.description_en: Upheaval cannot be interrupted, and has an additional 10% chance to critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 地壳激变无法被打断，并且爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Prescience grants the ally a chance for their spells and abilities to echo their damage or healing, dealing 15% of the amount again.
spells.description_zh: 先知先觉有几率使盟友的法术和技能引发回响，再次产生15%的伤害或治疗效果。

spells.description_en: Holy Shock now has 2 charges and it refunds 50% of its mana cost when cast on an enemy.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击现有2次充能，对敌人施放时返还50%的法力值消耗。

spells.description_en:
Judgment has a 100% chance to cast Consecration at the target's location.

The limit on Consecration does not apply to this effect.
spells.description_zh:
审判有100%的几率在目标位置施放奉献。

该效果无视奉献的数量限制。

spells.description_en: Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 1.0% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 10%.
spells.description_zh: 激战时真气的流动令你变得坚毅，在战斗中每3秒获得一层魔法吸收护盾，吸收相当于最大生命值1.0%的伤害，最多叠加至10%。

spells.description_en: Your dodge chance is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的躲闪几率提高5%。

spells.description_en:
While in combat, your Holy Power spenders have a 15% chance to cause your next Judgment to deal 30% increased damage and critically strike.

Activating Avenging Wrath activates Awakening.
spells.description_zh:
在战斗中时，消耗神圣能量的技能有15%的几率使你的下一个审判造成的伤害提高30%且必定爆击。

激活复仇之怒会激活觉醒。

spells.description_en: Arcane Missiles channels 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 奥术飞弹的引导速度提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Shield of the Righteous deals 986 damage to its first target struck.

Shield of the Righteous now has a 35% chance to activate Divine Purpose if talented.
spells.description_zh:
正义盾击对击中的第一个目标造成970点伤害。

如习得神圣意志，正义盾击有35%的几率激活神圣意志。

spells.description_en: Your Holy Words have a 25% chance to cause your next cast of Prayer of Mending to ignore its cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 你的圣言术有25%的几率使你施放的下一个愈合祷言无视冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰屏障现在使受到的所有伤害降低70%，持续6秒，但不再提供免疫效果，阻止移动、攻击或施放法术。不触发公共冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Cast Prismatic Barrier on yourself and 4 allies within 40 yds.
spells.description_zh: 对自己和40码范围内的4名盟友施放棱光护体。

spells.description_en:
You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.

Does not affect allies in combat.
spells.description_zh:
你和40码内的盟友立即进入隐形状态，持续12秒。做出任何动作都会取消此效果。

不影响战斗中的盟友。

spells.description_en: Lay on Hands' cooldown is reduced by 40% and restores 5% of your Mana.
spells.description_zh: 圣疗术的冷却时间缩短40%，并恢复5%的法力值。

spells.description_en: Emerald Blossom no longer has a cooldown, deals 35% increased healing, and increases the duration of your active Ebon Might effects by 1 sec, but costs 3 Essence.
spells.description_zh: 翡翠之花不再有冷却时间，造成的治疗效果提高35%，并使你激活的黑檀之力效果的持续时间延长1秒，但会消耗3点精华。

spells.description_en: Holy Shock refunds up to 10% of its Mana cost and deals up to 50% more healing or damage, based on the target's missing health.
spells.description_zh: 根据目标损失的生命值，神圣震击最多返还消耗法力值的10%，并额外造成最多50%的治疗或伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases the healing of your spells by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 法术的治疗效果提高3%。

spells.description_en:
Flamestrike has a chance equal to 100% of your spell critical strike chance to build up to a Hot Streak.

Flamestrike deals 5% increased damage for each enemy it damages, up to 25%.
spells.description_zh:
烈焰风暴有相当于法术爆击几率100%的几率触发一次炽热连击。

烈焰风暴每伤害一个敌人，造成的伤害提高5%，最多25%。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wild Imp's Fel Firebolt by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 野生小鬼的恶魔火焰箭爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Unstable Affliction by 0.15 sec and increases its damage by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 痛苦无常的施法时间缩短0.15秒，其伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: While Ignite is on 3 or fewer enemies it flares up dealing an additional 30% of its damage to affected targets.
spells.description_zh: 点燃影响的敌人数量不多于3个时，火焰会爆燃，对被影响的目标额外造成30%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Meteor's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 流星的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Summon Infernal increases the damage of your next 8 casts of Chaos Bolt by 25% or your next 8 casts of Rain of Fire by 35%.
spells.description_zh: 召唤地狱火会使你的下8个混乱之箭伤害提高25%，或使你的下8个火焰之雨伤害提高35%。

spells.description_en: Hot Streak increases the amount of Ignite damage from Pyroblast or Flamestrike by an additional 25%.
spells.description_zh: 炽热连击使炎爆术或烈焰风暴的点燃伤害额外提高25%。

spells.description_en:
Your Haste is increased by 3%.

You gain 5% more Haste from all sources of Haste.
spells.description_zh:
你的急速提高3%。

你从所有来源获得的急速属性额外提高5%。

spells.description_en: Holy Shock, Holy Light, and Flash of Light critical healing increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击、圣光术与圣光闪现的爆击治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: Source of Magic increases the target's healing and damage done by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 魔力之源使目标造成的治疗效果和伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en:
Your main hand auto attacks reduce the cooldown on your Brews by 0.50 sec and block your target's chi, dealing 10 additional Nature damage.

After 10 attacks, the next casts Tiger Palm at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
你的主手自动攻击使酒类技能的冷却时间缩短0.50秒，同时阻断目标的真气，额外造成10点自然伤害。

在10次攻击后，下一次施放的猛虎掌会造成100%的效果。

spells.description_en: Ray of Frost deals 30% of its damage to 5 nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜射线对附近的5个敌人造成30%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Divine Hymn by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 神圣赞美诗的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: When you spend extra Energy on Ferocious Bite, the extra damage is increased by 60%.
spells.description_zh: 当你的凶猛撕咬额外消耗能量时，额外伤害提高60%。

spells.description_en:
Ascend into the air and unleash a massive barrage of Penance bolts, causing 22,501 Holy damage to enemies or 53,764 healing to allies over 5.4 sec.

While ascended, gain a shield for 100% of your health. In addition, you are unaffected by knockbacks or crowd control effects.
spells.description_zh:
腾空而起，释放出磅礴的苦修箭雨，在5.4秒内对敌人造成22,340点神圣伤害，或为盟友恢复53,961点生命值。

升空期间，你获得相当于生命值100%的护盾，并且不受击退或控制效果影响。

spells.description_en:
Envenom or Kingsbane apply Caustic Spatter for 10 sec. Limit 1.

Caustic Spatter causes 20% of your Nature damage dealt to splash onto other nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
毒伤或君王之灾会施加腐蚀飞溅，持续10秒。仅能对1个目标施加。

腐蚀飞溅使你造成的20%自然伤害溅射给附近其他敌人，目标超过5个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Mana Tea now channels 50% faster and generates 20% more Mana.
spells.description_zh: 法力茶的引导速度加快50%，恢复的法力值提高20%。

spells.description_en: Increases maximum Energy by 50.
spells.description_zh: 能量上限提高50点。

spells.description_en:
Bleed damage increased by 10%.

Targets below 35% health instantly bleed out and take fatal damage when the remaining Bleed damage you would deal to them exceeds 150% of their remaining health.
spells.description_zh:
流血伤害提高10%。

目标生命值低于35%时，如果你接下来将会造成的剩余流血伤害高于目标剩余生命值的150%，该目标会立即失血而亡。

spells.description_en: Feint has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 佯攻可以额外使用1次。

spells.description_en: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕的冷却时间缩短50%。

spells.description_en: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.
spells.description_zh: 疾跑使移动速度额外提高30%，持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 减速药膏使移动速度额外降低10%。

spells.description_en:
Fury of Elune
Fury of Elune now ends with a flash of energy, blasting nearby enemies for 822 Astral damage.

 Full Moon
Full Moon calls down 2 Minor Moons that deal 733 Astral damage and generate 3 Astral Power.
spells.description_zh:
艾露恩之怒
艾露恩之怒结束时产生一道闪现的能量，轰击周围的敌人，造成822点星界伤害。

满月
满月召唤2个微月，各造成710点星界伤害并产生3点星界能量。

spells.description_en:
Further increases the power of Boundless Moonlight.

 Fury of Elune
The flash of energy now generates 6 Astral Power and its damage is increased by 50%.

 Full Moon
New Moon and Half Moon now also call down 1 Minor Moon.
spells.description_zh:
进一步强化天涯共银辉的效果。

艾露恩之怒
闪现的能量现在会产生6点星界能量，伤害提高50%。

 满月
新月和半月现在还会降下1个微月。

spells.description_en: Kill Command damage is increased by 10%. Barbed Shot lasts 2.0 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令的伤害提高10%。倒刺射击的持续时间延长2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Each time Barbed Shot deals damage, the cooldown of Kill Command is reduced by 0.50 sec.
spells.description_zh: 倒刺射击每造成一次伤害，便使杀戮命令的冷却时间缩短0.50秒。

spells.description_en:
Your Shout abilities have additional effects.

 Battle Shout:
Grants you an additional 3% attack power.

 Rallying Cry:
Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec.

 Piercing Howl:
Radius increased by 100%

 Berserker Shout:
Radius increased by 100%.

 Intimidating Shout:
Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的怒吼技能获得额外效果。

 战斗怒吼：
使你获得额外3%攻击强度。

 集结呐喊：
使你获得额外2%生命值，持续时间延长3秒。

 刺耳怒吼：
范围增加100%。

 狂暴之吼：
范围增加100%。

 破胆怒吼：
冷却时间减少15秒。

spells.description_en:
You gain a stack of Light's Deliverance when you call down an Empyrean Hammer.

While Wake of Ashes and Hammer of Light are unavailable, you consume 60 stacks of Light's Deliverance, empowering yourself to cast Hammer of Light an additional time for free.
spells.description_zh:
当你召下苍穹之锤时获得一层圣光裁决。

灰烬觉醒和圣光之锤都不可用时，你会消耗60层圣光裁决强化自己，使你能够额外施放一次不产生消耗的圣光之锤。

spells.description_en:
Grants access to the following abilities:

 Demonbolt
Send the fiery soul of a fallen demon at the enemy, causing 2,996 Shadowflame damage.

 Demonic Core
When your Wild Imps fade or are imploded, you have a 10% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core. 

When your summoned Dreadstalkers fade away, you have a 100% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core.

Demonic Core reduces the cast time of Demonbolt by 100%. Maximum 4 stacks.
spells.description_zh:
获得以下技能：

 恶魔之箭
向敌人发射死亡恶魔的燃烧之魂，造成3,062点暗影烈焰伤害。

 恶魔之核
当你的野生小鬼消失或爆炸时，你有10%的几率吸收掉它们的生命精华，使你获得一层恶魔之核。

当你召唤的恐惧猎犬消失时，你有100%的几率吸收它们的生命精华，使你获得一层恶魔之核。

恶魔之核可以使恶魔之箭的施法时间降低100%，最多叠加4次。

spells.description_en: Shadow Dance increases attack speed by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影之舞使攻击速度提高25%。

spells.description_en: Increases healing received by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的治疗效果提高8%。

spells.description_en:
Lash out at your target and 2 additional nearby enemies, inflicting 216 Shadow damage and causing them to Bleed for 434 damage over 14 sec.

20% of all damage from Finishing Moves is repeated as Shadow, split evenly among affected enemies.
spells.description_zh:
猛击目标及附近的2个额外敌人，造成222点暗影伤害，并在14秒内造成共计436点流血伤害。

终结技造成的所有伤害的20%将作为暗影伤害再次造成，由所有受影响的敌人平均分摊。

spells.description_en: While Shadow Dance is active, your Shadow Techniques triggers 25% more frequently and generates 1 additional combo point.
spells.description_zh: 在暗影之舞激活期间，你的暗影技巧的触发频率提高25%，并额外产生1个连击点。

spells.description_en: Your damage over time effects deal their damage 25% faster, and your healing over time effects heal 5% faster.
spells.description_zh: 你的持续伤害效果造成伤害的速度加快25%，持续治疗效果造成治疗的速度加快5%。

spells.description_en:
When you cast Starsurge, Rake, Shred, or Frenzied Regeneration you gain Call of the Elder Druid for 15 sec, once every 1 min.

 Call of the Elder Druid
Abilities not associated with your specialization are substantially empowered for 45 sec.

Balance: Cast time of Balance spells reduced by 30% and damage increased by 20%.

Feral: Gain 1 Combo Point every 2 sec while in Cat Form and Physical damage increased by 20%.

Guardian: Bear Form gives an additional 20% Stamina, multiple uses of Ironfur may overlap, and Frenzied Regeneration has 2 charges.

Restoration: Healing increased by 30%, and mana costs reduced by 50%.
spells.description_zh:
施放星涌、斜掠、撕碎或狂暴回复时，获得德鲁伊长者之唤，持续15秒，每1分钟只能触发一次。

 德鲁伊长者之唤
你当前专精之外的其他能力会获得大幅度强化，持续45秒。

平衡：平衡专精法术的施法时间缩短30%，伤害提高20%。

野性：在猎豹形态下每2秒获得1个连击点数。物理伤害提高20%。

守护：熊形态使你额外获得20%的耐力，铁鬃可以重复使用并叠加，狂暴回复可以使用2次。

恢复：治疗效果提高30%，法力值消耗降低50%。

spells.description_en:
Wake of Ashes is replaced with Hammer of Light for 20 sec after it is cast.

 Hammer of Light:
Hammer down your enemy with the power of the Light, dealing 243 Holy damage and 122 Holy damage up to 7 nearby enemies. 

Additionally, calls down Empyrean Hammers from the sky to strike 3 nearby enemies for 16 Holy damage each.

Costs 5 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
施放灰烬觉醒后将其替换为圣光之锤，持续20秒。

圣光之锤：
凝聚圣光之力，挥舞战锤重击敌人，造成239点神圣伤害，并对周围最多7名敌人造成122点神圣伤害。

同时召下苍穹之锤打击周围的3名敌人，对每个目标造成16点神圣伤害。

消耗5层神圣能量。

spells.description_en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat cause your next Fel Rush or Felblade to empower you, increasing damage by 12% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔追击和复仇回避会使你从下一次邪能冲撞或邪能之刃中得到强化，伤害提高12%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en:
Immolation Aura has 1 additional charge, has 6 sec reduced cooldown, and deals Chaos damage instead of Fire.

You can have multiple Immolation Auras active at a time.
spells.description_zh:
献祭光环可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短6秒，并将造成的火焰伤害改为混沌伤害。

你可以同时激活多个献祭光环。

spells.description_en: You deflect incoming attacks while Blade Dancing, absorbing damage up to 15% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 你在刃舞期间偏转受到的攻击，最多吸收相当于最大生命值15%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Damage is increased by 3% while above 50% Health.

Leech is increased by 5% while below 50% Health.
spells.description_zh:
生命值高于50%时，伤害提高3%。

生命值低于50%时，吸血提高5%。

spells.description_en: Increases Versatility by 4% and reduces threat generated by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 全能提高4%，产生的威胁值降低8%。

spells.description_en: Magical damage increased by 3%, and Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 魔法伤害提高3%，受到的物理伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: Between the Eyes and Pistol Shot have 10 yd increased range and deal 20% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 正中眉心和手枪射击的射程增加10码，造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Shuriken Storm increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec when striking 3 or more enemies.
spells.description_zh: 袖剑风暴击中3个或更多敌人时使你的移动速度提高30%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en: Increases Demonbolt damage by 10% and consuming a Demonic Core has a chance to summon a Wild Imp.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔之箭造成的伤害提高10%。消耗一个恶魔之核有几率召唤一只野生小鬼。

spells.description_en: Your finishing moves heal you for 5% of damage done. At full health gain shielding instead, absorbing up to 10% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 你的终结技为你恢复相当于造成伤害5%的生命值。生命值已满时改为获得护盾，吸收量最多为最大生命值的10%。

spells.description_en: Your Chaos damage has a 7.77% chance to be increased by 17%, occurring up to 3 total times.
spells.description_zh: 你的混乱伤害有7.77%的几率提高17%，最多发生3次。

spells.description_en:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.
spells.description_zh:
施放混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧会使你获得敬魔仪式，持续20秒。如果敬魔仪式已经激活，则使其持续时间减少1秒。

敬魔仪式结束时，你获得恶魔法术，使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧召唤一个主宰、混沌之母或深渊领主，对敌人施展一次毁灭性攻击。

spells.description_en: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 主宰对敌人造成伤害时击溃他们的灵魂，使其受到你和你的宠物的伤害提高5%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 5,119 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.
spells.description_zh:
混沌之母强化你的下一个烧尽，使其变为狱火箭。

 狱火箭
射出一支包裹在深渊狱火中的飞箭，对敌方目标造成5,119点火焰伤害，并产生3个灵魂碎片。

spells.description_en:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 9,644 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
召唤深渊领主会使你的下一个混乱之箭变为陨灭。

 陨灭
从扭曲虚空的深处召唤一颗恶魔滋孽的流星，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成9,644点混乱伤害并召唤3个野生小鬼。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Your Grove Guardians cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士每6秒对周围的目标施放月火术。

spells.description_en: Sigil of Flame damage increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 烈焰咒符的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en:
When you parry an attack or have one of your attacks parried, restore 2% of max health and 10 Fury. 

This effect may only occur once every 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当你招架攻击或你的攻击被招架时，恢复2%的最大生命值，并获得10点恶魔之怒。

该效果每5秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en:
Moonfire damage has a chance to call down a Fury of Elune to follow your target for 3 sec.

 Fury of Elune
Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy, dealing 421 Astral damage over 3 sec within its area.

Generates 15 Astral Power over its duration.
spells.description_zh:
月火术的伤害有几率召唤艾露恩之怒追踪你的目标，持续3秒。

 艾露恩之怒
召唤一道纯粹的天界能量追击敌人，在3秒内对区域内的敌人造成414点星界伤害。

在持续期间产生15点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Each of your Grove Guardians increases your healing done by 5% while active.
spells.description_zh: 你每有一个激活的林莽卫士，你造成的治疗效果提高5%。

spells.description_en: Your Grove Guardians increase the healing of your Rejuvenation, Efflorescence, and Lifebloom by 10% while active.
spells.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士激活时使你的回春术、百花齐放和生命绽放的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when casting Demonic Circle: Teleport, increasing your movement speed by 50% and making you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你在施放恶魔法阵：传送时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使你的移动速度提高50%，并且免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Swiftmend and Wild Growth cooldowns reduced by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 迅捷治愈和野性成长的冷却时间缩短1秒。

spells.description_en: Howl of Terror cooldown is reduced by 10 sec and range is increased by 5 yds.
spells.description_zh: 恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短10秒，范围扩大5码。

spells.description_en: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 不灭决心在10秒内为你恢复最大生命值的30%。

spells.description_en: Unending Resolve grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of your maximum health and increases the maximum amount Soul Leech can absorb by 10% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 不灭决心产生相当于最大生命值的10%的灵魂榨取吸收量，并使灵魂榨取的吸收量最大值提高10%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and 10 yard increased range.
spells.description_zh: 投掷利刃可以使用2次，射程延长10码。

spells.description_en: Your Grove Guardians' healing is increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士的治疗量提高30%。

spells.description_en: Your Force of Nature treants have 100% increased health.
spells.description_zh: 你的自然之力的树人生命值提高100%。

spells.description_en: Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的最大法力值提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Wrath and Starfire damage increased by 10%. 

Regrowth, Wild Growth, and Swiftmend healing increased by 9%.
spells.description_zh:
愤怒和星火术的伤害提高10%。

愈合、野性成长和迅捷治愈的治疗效果提高9%。

spells.description_en:
Orbital Strike damage increased by 30%, and damage of Stellar Flares it applies increased by 30%.

Whirling Stars increases the haste you gain during Celestial Alignment by an additional 6%.
spells.description_zh:
轨道打击的伤害提高30%，其施加的星辰耀斑伤害提高30%。

旋荡星辰使你在超凡之盟期间获得的急速额外提高6%。

spells.description_en:
Every 5 Regrowths you cast makes your next Wrath, Starfire, or Entangling Roots instant and increases damage it deals by 100%.

Every 5 Starsurges you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.
spells.description_zh:
每施放5次愈合，你的下一个愤怒、星火术或纠缠根须变为瞬发，且造成的伤害提高100%。

每施放5次星涌术，你的下一个愈合或纠缠根须变为瞬发。

spells.description_en:
Hover now causes you to briefly warp out of existence and appear at your destination. Hover's cooldown is also reduced by 5 sec.

Hover continues to allow Evoker spells to be cast while moving.
spells.description_zh:
悬空现在使你短暂地迁跃到现实之外，并在目标位置出现。悬空的冷却时间缩短5秒。

悬空依然使唤魔师法术可以在移动中施放。

spells.description_en: Free automatic Moonfires from Galactic Guardian generate 5 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 星河守护者自动触发的无消耗月火术产生5点怒气。

spells.description_en: Thrash now deals Arcane damage and its damage is increased by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 痛击现在造成奥术伤害，伤害提高12%。

spells.description_en: Moonfire deals 20% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 月火术造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Enemies damaged by Lunar Beam or Fury of Elune take 6% increased damage from you for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 明月普照或艾露恩之怒使敌人受到来自你的伤害提高6%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Bear Form and Moonkin Form reduce Arcane damage taken by 6% and all other magic damage taken by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 熊形态和枭兽形态使受到的奥术伤害降低6%，受到的其他所有魔法伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en:
Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc increases Arcane damage from spells and abilities by 10% while active.

Increases the duration and number of spells cast by Convoke the Spirits by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
化身：乌索克的守护者激活时使法术和技能的奥术伤害提高10%。

万灵之召的持续时间和施放的法术数量提高25%。

spells.description_en: Enemies affected by Moonfire are slowed by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 受到月火术影响的敌人减速20%。

spells.description_en: Lunar Beam's cooldown is reduced by 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 明月普照的冷却时间缩短20秒。

spells.description_en: All Arcane damage from your spells and abilities is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的所有奥术伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Summon Infernal becomes empowered, dealing 40% increased damage. When your Summon Infernal ends, it fragments into two smaller Infernals at 50% effectiveness that lasts 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 强化召唤地狱火，造成的伤害提高40%。当你的召唤地狱火结束时，它会分裂成两个较小的地狱火，产生50%的效果，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

Mortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.
spells.description_zh:
巨人神力使你的下一个崩摧造成的伤害提高5%，最多叠加5次。

致死打击会产生一层巨人神力，顺劈斩击中3个或更多目标时会产生一层巨人神力。

spells.description_en:
Enemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 20% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times.
spells.description_zh:
受到崩摧影响的敌人受到你造成的伤害最多提高10%，对你造成的伤害最多降低20%，由崩摧消耗的巨人神力层数决定，持续10秒。

巨人神力最多叠加10层。

spells.description_en: Shockwave, Cleave, and Whirlwind deal 5% more damage per target affected up to 5.
spells.description_zh: 每影响一个目标，震荡波、顺劈斩和旋风斩造成的伤害提高5%，最多5个目标。

spells.description_en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你的技能的爆击伤害提高10%，精确格挡所格挡的伤害量提高20%。

spells.description_en: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.
spells.description_zh: 震荡波的昏迷时间延长1秒，昏迷结束后使受影响敌人的移动速度降低40%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Overpower and Execute by 3% per stack.
spells.description_zh: 每层巨人神力使你的压制和斩杀造成的伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en:
You deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage.

Size increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
你造成的伤害提高5%，受到的伤害降低5%。

体型增大5%。

spells.description_en: Damage prevented by each use of Ignore Pain is increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 每次使用无视苦痛吸收的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en:
Mortal Strike and Slam damage increased by 25%.

Cleave and Whirlwind damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
致死打击和猛击的伤害提高25%。

顺劈斩和旋风斩的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 火焰伤害提高4%，你的恶魔造成的伤害提高4%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Lunar Beam by 30% and Fury of Elune by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 明月普照的伤害提高30%，艾露恩之怒的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
spells.description_zh:
恶魔法术使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧伤害提高20%，施法时间缩短50%。

施放混乱之箭会使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外减少1秒。

spells.description_en: Enemies marked by your Havoc take 7% increased damage from your single target spells.
spells.description_zh: 被你的浩劫标记的敌人受到你的单目标法术伤害提高7%。

spells.description_en: Summon Infernal grants Diabolic Ritual and reduces its duration by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤地狱火会触发敬魔仪式，并使其持续时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的地狱火激活时，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外缩短1秒。

spells.description_en:
Exhilaration grants you 3 sec of Survival of the Fittest.

Survival of the Fittest activates Exhilaration at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
意气风发使你获得3秒优胜劣汰。

优胜劣汰会激活意气风发，产生50%的效果。

spells.description_en: While in combat, Disengage will chain the closest target to the ground, causing them to move 40% slower until they move 8 yards away.
spells.description_zh: 在战斗中施放逃脱会用锁链将最近的目标拘束在地，使其移动速度降低40%，直到目标移动到8码以外。

spells.description_en: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 1,086 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 50%, and causing an additional 102 Frostfire damage over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 向敌人施放霜火之箭，造成1,098点霜火伤害，使其移动速度降低50%，并在8秒内额外造成102点霜火伤害。

spells.description_en:
Meteor now also calls down a Comet Storm, dealing 2,753 Frost damage to nearby enemies.

Comet Storm now also calls down a Meteor, dealing 3,804 Fire damage to nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
流星现在还会召唤彗星风暴，对附近敌人造成2,775点冰霜伤害。

彗星风暴现在还会召唤流星，对附近敌人造成3,796点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en:
Ice Block and Ice Cold reset the cooldowns of your Fire spells.

Cauterize resets the cooldown of your Frost spells with a base cooldown shorter than 4 minutes when it activates.
spells.description_zh:
寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰会重置你的火焰法术冷却时间。

当灸灼激活时，会重置基础冷却时间少于4分钟的冰霜法术的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Frostfire Bolt's cast time is reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 霜火之箭的施法时间缩短10%。

spells.description_en:
You melt slightly out of your Ice Block and Ice Cold, allowing you to move slowly during Ice Block and increasing your movement speed over time.

Ice Block and Ice Cold trigger a Blazing Barrier when they end.
spells.description_zh:
你的寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰略微融化，使你能够在寒冰屏障期间缓慢移动，并且移动速度逐渐提高。

寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰效果结束时触发一次烈焰护体。

spells.description_en:
Frostfire Bolt has and additional 5% chance to grant Brain Freeze and its critical strike chance is increased by 15%.

The damage of your Frost spells and Fire spells are increased by 4%.
spells.description_zh:
霜火之箭额外有5%几率触发冰冷智慧，且其爆击几率提高15%。

你的冰霜法术和火焰法术造成的伤害提高4%。

spells.description_en:
Casting Frostfire spells has a 10% chance to activate Frostfire Empowerment, causing your next Frostfire Bolt to be instant cast, deal 60% increased damage, explode for 60% of its damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Damage from Frostfire Empowerment applies 1 stack of Freezing.
spells.description_zh:
施放霜火法术有10%的几率激活霜火增效，使你的下一个霜火之箭变为瞬发，造成60%额外伤害，并对附近敌人引发爆炸，造成其伤害的60%。目标数量超过5个目标时伤害降低。

霜火增效造成的伤害会施加1层冻结效果。

spells.description_en:
Meteor's damage is increased by 25%.

Meteor now grants Frostfire Empowerment.
spells.description_zh:
流星的伤害提高25%。

流星现在会使你获得霜火增效。

spells.description_en: Frostfire Empowerment stacks 1 additional time and it causes Frostfire Bolt to explode for an additional 20% of its damage.
spells.description_zh: 霜火增效可额外叠加1层，并使霜火之箭爆炸造成额外20%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing 1,327 Radiant damage or 2,802 healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.
spells.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后，你的下2个消耗神圣能量的技能会对目标施加晨光，在8秒内造成1,327点光辉伤害或恢复2,802点生命值。

晨光的伤害和治疗效果的8%会辐射给周围的盟友或敌人，目标超过5个时效果降低。

晨光的治疗效果不会转移给圣光道标。

spells.description_en: Critical Strike chance of Holy Shock and Light of Dawn increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击几率提高5%。

spells.description_en: Haste is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Movement speed increased by 5% while above 80% health.

When your health is brought below 35%, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 5 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 1 min.
spells.description_zh:
生命值高于80%时移动速度提高5%。

生命值降至35%时，你的移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。该效果每1分钟只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Dawnlight leaves an Eternal Flame for 6 sec on allies or a Greater Judgment on enemies when it expires or is extended.
spells.description_zh: 晨光的效果结束或被延长时会在盟友身上留下永恒之火，持续6秒，或为敌人施加强效审判。

spells.description_en: Holy Shock and Light of Dawn critical strikes cause the target to be healed for an additional 281 over 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击在4秒内为目标额外恢复281点生命值。

spells.description_en: Dawnlight reduces the movement speed of enemies by 50% and increases the movement speed of allies by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 晨光使敌人的移动速度降低50%，使盟友的移动速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing 82 Radiant damage to enemies or 141 healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 你与30码范围内的晨光产生联结，对穿越光束的敌人造成82点光辉伤害，为穿越光束的盟友恢复141点生命值，目标数量超过5个时效果降低。

spells.description_en: Living Flame is enhanced with Bronze magic, repeating 25% of the damage or healing you dealt to the target in the last 5 sec as Arcane, up to 950.
spells.description_zh: 用青铜龙魔法强化活化烈焰，重复你在过去5秒内对目标造成伤害或治疗量的25%，伤害为奥术伤害，最多950点。

spells.description_en: Hammer of Light instantly calls down 2 Empyrean Hammers on your target when it is cast.
spells.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤时立即对目标降下2把苍穹之锤。

spells.description_en: Light of Dawn and Holy Shock have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 黎明之光和神圣震击有15%的几率再次施放，产生30%的效果。

spells.description_en: Your Holy Power spenders deal 3% additional damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 你的神圣能量消耗技能造成的伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

spells.description_en:
Every 5.0 sec, your next Dawnlight's damage or healing is increased by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.

Morning Star stacks twice as fast while out of combat.
spells.description_zh:
每过5.0秒，你的下一个晨光的伤害或治疗效果提高5%，最多叠加10次。

未进入战斗时，晨星的叠加速度变为两倍。

spells.description_en: Each time you cast an empower spell, unstable time magic reduces its cooldown by up to 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每当你施放一个蓄力法术，不稳定的时光魔法会使其冷却时间缩短最多6秒。

spells.description_en: After casting Hammer of Light, you call down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby target every 2 sec, for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤后，你每2秒召唤一把苍穹之锤打击附近的一个目标，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes grant an additional stack of Colossal Might.
spells.description_zh: 致死打击的爆击额外产生一层巨人神力。

spells.description_en:
When Empyrean Hammer critically strikes, 50% of its damage is dealt to nearby enemies.

Enemies hit by this effect deal 5% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
苍穹之锤爆击时对周围敌人造成伤害，数值相当于其伤害的50%。

受该效果影响的敌人对你造成的伤害降低5%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Upheaval deals 50% additional damage over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 地壳激变在8秒内额外造成50%的伤害。

spells.description_en: For each damage over time effect from Upheaval, gain 3% haste, up to 9%.
spells.description_zh: 每有一个地壳激变的持续伤害效果，急速提高3%，最多9%。

spells.description_en: Crusader Strike, Hammer of Wrath and Blade of Justice extend the duration of Shake the Heavens by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 十字军打击、愤怒之锤和公正之剑使倾天圣威的持续时间延长1秒。

spells.description_en: Tip the Scales overloads you with temporal energy, increasing your haste, movement speed, and cooldown recovery rate by 30%, decreasing over 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 扭转天平会为你注入超量的时空能量，使你的急速、移动速度和冷却恢复速度提高30%，然后在30秒内逐渐降低。

spells.description_en: Prescience cooldown reduced by 2 sec and it grants 1% additional critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 先知先觉的冷却时间缩短2秒，且额外提供1%的暴击几率。

spells.description_en:
Wake of Ashes surrounds you with a Holy barrier for 10% of your maximum health.

Hammer of Light heals you for 5% of your maximum health, increased by 1% for each additional target hit. Any overhealing done with this effect gets converted into a Holy barrier instead.
spells.description_zh:
灰烬觉醒使一道神圣屏障环绕在你的周围，吸收最大生命值10%的伤害。

圣光之锤为你恢复5%的最大生命值，每额外击中一个目标，效果提高1%。该效果造成的过量治疗会转化为神圣屏障。

spells.description_en: Warp reduces damage taken by 20%, starting high and reducing over 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 迁跃使受到的伤害降低20%，效果初始较高，并在3秒内衰减。

spells.description_en: Ebon Might and Prescience gain a chance equal to your critical strike chance to grant 50% additional stats. For Ebon Might, this increase lasts 15.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑檀之力和先知先觉可提供额外50%的属性，几率等同于你的爆击几率。对于黑檀之力，此增幅持续15.0秒。

spells.description_en: Empower spells send up to 3 Chrono Flames to your targets.
spells.description_zh: 蓄力法术会向目标射出最多3股时序烈焰。

spells.description_en:
Non-defensive abilities with a 45 second or longer cooldown grant 5% Intellect for 15 sec.

Essence spells extend the duration by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh:
使用冷却时间为45秒及以上的非防御技能可使智力提高5%，持续15秒。

使用精华法术使持续时间延长1秒。

spells.description_en: Prescience lasts 15% longer.
spells.description_zh: 先知先觉的持续时间延长15%。

spells.description_en: Warp leaves a trail of Motes of Acceleration. Allies who come in contact with a mote gain 20% increased movement speed for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 迁跃会留下加速微粒痕迹，接触到微粒的盟友的移动速度提高20%，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack, stacking up to 4.
spells.description_zh: 你受到的物理伤害降低10%，且每4秒额外降低10%，直到受到一次物理攻击，最多可叠加至4层。

spells.description_en:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

 Holy Bulwark:

While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.

Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

Generates 3 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
让圣光凝聚并显化为一件神圣军备，由你的友方目标持有。

 神圣壁垒：

持有神圣壁垒时，获得一个吸收护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的15.0%，并且每2秒吸收量提高2.0%。持续20秒。

使用后变为圣洁武器。

产生3层神圣能量。

spells.description_en:
Templar's Verdict calls down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby enemy.

While Shake the Heavens is active, this effect calls down an additional Empyrean Hammer.
spells.description_zh:
圣殿骑士的裁决会召唤苍穹之锤砸向附近敌人。

当倾天圣威效果激活时，该效果会额外召唤一个苍穹之锤。

spells.description_en: Empyrean Hammer has a 10% increased chance to critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 苍穹之锤的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Hammer of Light applies Judgment to its targets, and increases your Haste by 12% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 圣光之锤对目标施加审判，并使你的急速提高12%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
If you bestow an Armament upon an ally, you also gain its benefits.

If you bestow an Armament upon yourself, a nearby ally also gains its benefits.
spells.description_zh:
如果你为盟友赋予军备，你也会获得其效果。

如果你为自己赋予军备，附近的一名盟友也会获得其效果。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Holy Armaments is reduced by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣军备的冷却时间缩短20%。

spells.description_en: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.
spells.description_zh: 你激活的光环对具有你的军备的目标产生的效果提高33%。

spells.description_en: When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Infusion of Light.
spells.description_zh: 当你身上的军备消散时，圣疗术的冷却时间缩短15.0秒，并使你获得圣光灌注。

spells.description_en: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗圣光灌注会使神圣军备的冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Divine Toll summons Divine Hammers that spin around you for 8 sec.

Divine Hammer
Strikes all enemies nearby for 50 Holy damage every 2 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
圣洁鸣钟会召唤神圣之锤围绕你旋转，持续8秒。

神圣之锤
每2秒对附近所有敌人造成50点神圣伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术和技能有几率为附近的一名盟友显化一件神圣军备。

spells.description_en:
Casting Judgment increases the damage of Empyrean Hammer by 5% for 10 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
施放审判使苍穹之锤的伤害提高5%，持续10秒。

多层效果可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Divine Steed lasts 2 sec longer and increases your movement speed by an additional 30% for the first 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 神圣马驹的持续时间延长2秒，且在前3秒内，你的移动速度额外提高30%。

spells.description_en: You receive 20% less damage from Blessing of Sacrifice and each time its target takes damage, you gain 4% movement speed up to a maximum of 40%.
spells.description_zh: 你从牺牲祝福中受到的伤害降低20%，每当牺牲祝福的目标受到伤害，你的移动速度提高4%，最多提高40%。

spells.description_en: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.
spells.description_zh: 复仇之怒额外召唤一把圣洁武器，在复仇之怒期间，你的圣洁武器会对目标施放法术，并模仿你施放神圣能量技能。

spells.description_en: Casting a Holy Power ability increases the damage and healing of your next Crusader Strike by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 施放一个消耗神圣能量的技能会使你的下一个十字军打击的伤害和治疗效果提高100%。

spells.description_en:
For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals 760 damage immediately, split across all enemies.

Up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for 30% of the damage amount.
spells.description_zh:
每施放一次消耗神圣能量的技能，你的下一个奉献会立即造成760点伤害，由所有敌人均摊。

最多为附近3名盟友恢复相当于该伤害30%的生命值。

spells.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.

Lasts 1 hour.
spells.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的护甲值提高5%，你的主要属性提高2%。

持续1小时。

spells.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your Stamina by 3% and causing your Holy Power abilities to sometimes unleash a burst of healing around a target.

Lasts 1 hour.
spells.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的耐力提高3%，消耗神圣能量的技能有时会在一个目标周围产生治疗爆发。

持续1小时。
