spells.description_en: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for 430.
spells.description_zh: 审判爆击时在目标周围产生冲击波，为至多5名受伤盟友恢复430点生命值。

spells.description_en: Your Regrowth protects you, reducing damage you take by 8% while your Regrowth is on you.
spells.description_zh: 你的愈合效果会保护你，当你身上有自己的愈合效果时，你受到的伤害降低8%。

spells.description_en: When Grove Guardians are summoned, they grow Dream Petals on your target, healing up to 3 nearby allies for 553.
spells.description_zh: 召唤林莽卫士时，它们会在你的目标身上产生梦境之瓣，为附近的最多3个盟友恢复552点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Deep Breath can now be steered in your desired direction.

In addition, Deep Breath burns targets for 3,576 Volcanic damage over 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.
spells.description_zh:
深呼吸现在可以控制方向。

另外，深呼吸会点燃目标，在12秒内造成3,576点熔火伤害。

多次施放深呼吸会延长此效果的持续时间。

spells.description_en:
Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 5.0% for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击有25%的几率使你的下一个天灾打击变为吸血鬼打击。

吸血鬼打击为你恢复2%的最大生命值，并为你施加鲜血女王的精华，使你的急速提高1.0%，最多提高5.0%，持续20秒。

spells.description_en: Your Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, and Power Word: Shield are 30% more effective when cast on yourself.
spells.description_zh: 在对自己施放时，你的快速治疗、暗影愈合和真言术：盾的效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: Raise Ally revives players at full health and grants you and your ally an absorb shield equal to 20% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 复活盟友现在使玩家以最大生命值复活，并使你和盟友获得一个护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的20%。

spells.description_en:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
死神脚步和幻影步的移动速度加成提高10%。

激活死神脚步或幻影步会使周围4名盟友的移动速度提高20%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 8% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 当你在你的枯萎凋零中时，你受到的物理伤害降低8%，获得吸血鬼打击的几率提高5%。

spells.description_en: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
spells.description_zh: 鲜血女王的精华可以额外叠加2层，每层使你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击的伤害提高5%，扩散的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Your Leech is increased by 2%.

While Lichborne is active, the Leech bonus of this effect is increased by 100%, and it affects 4 allies within 12 yds.
spells.description_zh:
你的吸血提高2%。

巫妖之躯激活时，该效果的吸血加成提高100%，并且可以影响12码内的4名盟友。

spells.description_en:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh:
冰封之韧使你受到的所有伤害额外降低最多20%，由你损失的生命值决定。

消灭可以使你获得经验值或荣誉值的敌人可以使冰封之韧的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and deals 10% of the remaining damage to the enemy.
spells.description_zh: 当吸血鬼打击对受到你疫病影响的敌人造成伤害时，会使该疫病的持续时间延长3.0秒，并对该敌人造成其剩余伤害的10%。

spells.description_en:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击和天灾打击会使目标受到的暗影伤害提高1%，最多5%，持续15秒。

煽动惊恐对吸血鬼打击产生400%的效果。

spells.description_en:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
spells.description_zh:
黑暗突变激活时，你获得萨莱因之赐。

萨莱因之赐使你的鲜血女王的精华效果提高200%，并在效果期间将天灾打击替换为吸血鬼打击。

spells.description_en: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当消耗末日突降时，你获得4%力量加成，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Dream Surge heals 1 additional ally.
spells.description_zh: 梦境涌现额外治疗1个盟友。

spells.description_en:
Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.

Affects Force of Nature, Celestial Alignment, and Convoke the Spirits.
spells.description_zh:
主要技能可用或在最大使用次数时，流逝的时间会在你下次使用该技能后的冷却时间中扣除，最多扣除15秒。

影响自然之力、超凡之盟、和万灵之召。

spells.description_en:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
黑暗突变会召唤一头血兽攻击你的敌人，持续10秒。

每当血兽进行攻击，都会存储造成的一部分伤害。血兽死亡时爆炸，对周围敌人造成相当于积累伤害的15%的伤害，并为死亡骑士恢复等量的生命值。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.
spells.description_zh: 你将造成的所有暗影伤害的10%储存到血兽体内，使其在消失时爆炸并造成额外伤害。

spells.description_en: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.
spells.description_zh: 你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击对生命值低于35%的敌人造成伤害时触发吸血鬼打击的几率提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Mass Disintegrate marks your primary target for destruction for the next 6 sec.

You and your allies have a chance to trigger a Bombardment when attacking marked targets, dealing 1,805 Volcanic damage split amongst all nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
群体裂解将你的主要目标标记为毁灭的对象，持续6秒。

你和盟友攻击被标记的目标时有几率触发一次连环轰炸，造成1,805点熔火伤害，由附近的所有敌人均摊。

spells.description_en: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.
spells.description_zh: 魂体双分现在使你的灵魂与一名盟友绑定，持续1小时。使用魂体双分：转移可以传送到你的盟友的位置。

spells.description_en:
Reaper's Mark initial strike grants Killing Machine.

Reaper's Mark explosion deals up to 30% increased damage based on your target's missing health.
spells.description_zh:
死神印记的初始攻击会使你获得杀戮机器。

死神印记的爆炸造成的伤害最多提高30%，由目标损失的生命值决定。

spells.description_en:
Damaging enemies with Thunder Clap, Raging Blow, or Execute has a 25% chance to also strike one with a lightning bolt, dealing 54 Nature damage.

Lightning Strikes occur 30% more often during Avatar.
spells.description_zh:
雷霆一击、怒击或斩杀对敌人造成伤害时有25%的几率使一道闪电劈向目标，造成55点自然伤害。

闪电打击在天神下凡期间的触发频率提高30%。

spells.description_en:
Stamina increased by 5%.

Victory Rush increases your maximum health by 10% for 5 sec. When this health increase expires, you heal for any amount of the original Victory Rush that healed you in excess of your full health.
spells.description_zh:
耐力提高5%。

乘胜追击使你的最大生命值提高10%，持续5秒。生命值加成消失时为你恢复生命值，数值相当于该次乘胜追击造成的过量治疗。

spells.description_en:
Your auto attack damage is increased by 10%. 

This amount is increased for each stack of Icy Talons you have and it can stack up to 2 additional times.
spells.description_zh:
你的自动攻击伤害提高10%。

每层冰冷之爪都会提高伤害，并且可以额外叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to send out a torrent of ice dealing 49 Frost damage to enemies in front of you.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击爆击有几率打出一道寒冰洪流，对前方的敌人造成49点冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en:
Shield Slam and Bloodthirst have a 35% chance to grant you Thunder Blast, stacking up to 2 charges.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals 80 Stormstrike damage and generates 2 Rage.
spells.description_zh:
盾牌猛击和嗜血有35%的几率使你获得雷霆轰击，最多可叠加2层。

雷霆轰击
你的下一个雷霆一击变为雷霆轰击，造成83点风暴打击伤害并生成2点怒气。

spells.description_en: Lightning Strikes also deal 39 Nature damage to enemies near their target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 闪电打击还会对目标周围的敌人造成39点自然伤害。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Lightning Strikes generate 3 Rage.

Raging Blow and Execute damage increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
闪电打击产生3点怒气。

怒击和斩杀的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Storm Bolt also hits 2 additional nearby targets, stunning them for 2 sec, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 风暴之锤还会击中附近的2个额外目标，使其昏迷2秒，但该技能的冷却时间增加10秒。

spells.description_en: Your attacks trigger Lightning Strikes 30% more often.
spells.description_zh: 你的攻击触发闪电打击的频率提高30%。

spells.description_en: Empower spells cause your next Disintegrate to strike up to 3 targets. When striking fewer than 3 targets, Disintegrate damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.
spells.description_zh: 蓄力法术使你的下一个裂解击中最多3个目标。击中的目标少于3个时，每少一个目标，裂解的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 808 damage to it, and 430 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.
spells.description_zh:
对目标施展一连串精准的强力打击，对其造成798点伤害，对10码内的敌人造成427点伤害。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

引导崩摧时，你受到的伤害降低10%，并且免疫昏迷、击退与强制移动效果。

你可以在引导崩摧时格挡、招架、躲闪和使用特定防御技能。

spells.description_en:
Consuming Killing Machine or Rime has a 25% chance to grant 3 stacks of Icy Talons and increase its maximum stacks by the same amount for 6 sec.

Runic Power spending abilities count as Shadowfrost while Icy Talons is active.
spells.description_zh:
消耗杀戮机器或白霜有25%的几率使你获得3层冰冷之爪，并使其最大层数提高相同层数，持续6秒。

冰冷之爪激活时，你消耗符文能量的技能也被视作暗影冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en:
Stormstrike or Nature damage your abilities deal is increased by 5%. Stormstrike damage ignores Armor.

Thunder Clap damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
你的技能造成的风暴打击或自然伤害提高5%。风暴打击伤害无视护甲。

雷霆一击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Shield Slam damage increased by 15%.

Bloodthirst and Rampage damage increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
盾牌猛击的伤害提高15%。

嗜血和暴怒的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Thunder Blast calls down a Lightning Strike on an enemy it hits.
spells.description_zh: 雷霆轰击会对击中的一名敌人降下闪电打击。

spells.description_en: Lightning Strikes have a 15% chance to make your next 2 Bloodthirsts have no cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 闪电打击有15%的几率使你的下2个嗜血没有冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldowns of Lichborne and Raise Dead by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 巫妖之躯和亡者复生的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en:
Casting Avatar grants you 2 charges of Thunder Blast and resets the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

While Avatar is not active, Lightning Strikes have a 10% chance to grant you Avatar for 4 secs.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals Stormstrike damage.
spells.description_zh:
施放天神下凡使你获得2层雷霆轰击，并会重置雷霆一击的冷却时间。

未激活天神下凡时，闪电打击有10%的几率使你获得天神下凡，持续4秒。

雷霆轰击
你的下一个雷霆一击变为雷霆轰击，造成风暴打击伤害。

spells.description_en: When Reaper's Mark explodes, it deals 20% of the damage dealt to nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 死神印记的爆炸对周围的敌人造成20%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Your spells and abilities have a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick deal an additional 400% damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术和技能有几率使你的下一个神鹤引项踢额外造成400%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Empower spells cause your next Eruption to strike up to 3 targets. When striking less than 3 targets, Eruption damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.
spells.description_zh: 蓄力法术使你的下一个喷发击中最多3个目标。击中的目标少于3个时，每少一个目标，喷发的伤害提高10%。

spells.name_en: Keep Your Feet on the Ground
spells.description_en:
Physical damage taken reduced by 2%.

Thunder Blast reduces damage you take by 8% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
受到的物理伤害降低2%。

雷霆轰击使你受到的伤害降低8%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.
spells.description_zh: 援护目标会使其获得一个吸收魔法伤害的护盾，吸收量相当于你的护甲值的3倍，持续5秒。

spells.description_en:
Rip and Rake damage has a chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 34 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Wild Growth, Regrowth, and Efflorescence healing has a chance to cause Symbiotic Blooms to grow on the target, healing for 834 over 6 sec.

Multiple instances of these can overlap.
spells.description_zh:
割裂和斜掠的伤害有几率使受害者体内长出觅血缠藤，在6秒内造成34点流血伤害。

野性成长、愈合和百花齐放的治疗效果有几率使目标身上长出共生绽华，在6秒内恢复834点生命值。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en:
After you cast Holy Prism or Divine Toll, gain Divine Purpose.

 Divine Purpose
Your next Holy Power spending ability is free and deals 15% increased damage and healing.
spells.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后获得神圣意志。

 神圣意志
你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能变为免费且造成的伤害和治疗提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 81 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.

Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 10 damage per stack.

Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.
spells.description_zh:
恶毒地割裂敌人的灵魂，造成81点暗影冰霜伤害并施加死神印记。

每当你造成暗影或冰霜伤害，叠加一层死神印记。12秒后或叠加至40层时印记爆炸，每层造成10点伤害。

如果目标死亡，死神印记会转移至附近一个未被标记的敌人身上。

spells.description_en:
Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing 33 Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

Wave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.
spells.description_zh:
死神印记会发出多股暗影冰霜能量并将其召回，往返都可对路径中的敌人造成33点暗影冰霜伤害。

灵魂浪潮的爆击使敌人受到的暗影冰霜伤害提高5%，持续15秒，最多叠加2次。灵魂浪潮返程时必定爆击。

spells.description_en:
Damage and healing while in Cat Form increased by 3%.

Moonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
在猎豹形态下伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

月火术和阳炎术的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Bloodseeker Vines and Symbiotic Blooms last 2 additional sec.

When a target afflicted by Bloodseeker Vines dies, the vines jump to a valid nearby target for their remaining duration.
spells.description_zh:
觅血缠藤和共生绽华的持续时间延长2秒。

受到觅血缠藤影响的目标死亡时，缠藤会跳向附近的一个有效目标，持续时间为剩余时间。

spells.description_en:
Each active Bloodseeker Vine increases the damage your abilities deal by 2%.

Each active Symbiotic Bloom increases the healing of your spells by 2%.
spells.description_zh:
每个激活的觅血缠藤使你的技能造成的伤害提高2%。

每个激活的共生绽华使你的法术的治疗效果提高2%。

spells.description_en:
Attacking from Prowl increases the chance for Shred, Rake, and Swipe to critically strike by 8% for 6 sec.

Your periodic heals have a 4% increased chance to critically heal.
spells.description_zh:
从潜行状态下攻击会使撕碎、斜掠和横扫的爆击几率提高8%，持续6秒。

你的周期性治疗效果产生爆击的几率提高4%。

spells.description_en: Enemies pulled into Ursol's Vortex are rooted in place for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
spells.description_zh: 被拖入乌索尔旋风的敌人会被定身3秒。受到伤害可能取消该效果。

spells.description_en: During Barkskin your movement speed is increased by 10% and every second flowers grow beneath your feet that heal up to 3 nearby injured allies for 76.
spells.description_zh: 在树皮术期间，你的移动速度提高10%，每秒都会在脚下绽开鲜花，为附近最多3名受伤的盟友恢复76点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.

Rejuvenation healing increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
割裂和凶猛撕咬的伤害提高5%。

回春术的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 你获得的治疗效果提高4%。

spells.description_en: When an enemy deals direct damage to your Anti-Magic Shell, their cast speed is reduced by 10% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当敌人对你的反魔法护罩造成直接伤害时，使其施法速度降低10%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to its main target, and is now Shadowfrost.

Shadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.
spells.description_zh:
白霜强化的凛风冲击对主要目标的伤害提高60%，现在造成暗影冰霜伤害。

暗影冰霜伤害会施加2层死神印记，爆击时施加4层。

spells.description_en: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的暗影伤害提高6%，你的暗影法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 548 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
spells.description_zh:
如果目标受到了你的枯萎影响，施放混乱之箭和暗影灼烧会使其叠加层数增加1层。

每当枯萎叠加一层时，都有几率开始塌缩，每1秒消耗一层效果对宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

spells.description_en: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的火焰伤害提高6%，你的火焰法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh:
枯萎造成的爆击伤害为215%，而不是通常的200%。

黑化灵魂造成的爆击伤害为225%，而不是通常的200%。

spells.description_en:
Wither damage increased by 25%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
spells.description_zh:
枯萎的伤害提高25%。

每层枯萎使黑化灵魂造成的伤害提高2%。

spells.description_en: Wither deals 30% increased periodic damage but its duration is 15% shorter.
spells.description_zh: 枯萎的持续伤害提高30%，持续时间缩短15%。

spells.description_en: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
spells.description_zh: 枯萎的伤害提高20%。当枯萎通过黑化灵魂获得层数时，有几率再获得一层。

spells.description_en:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 548 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
spells.description_zh:
枯萎叠加至8层后，或者当宿主的生命值降低至20%时，枯萎每1秒对其宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

黑化灵魂造成伤害时，你有一定几率获得碎片动荡。

spells.description_en:
Curse of Weakness is empowered and transforms into Curse of the Satyr.

 Curse of the Satyr
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% and the casting time of all spells by 30% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
spells.description_zh:
虚弱诅咒被强化，转变为萨特诅咒。

 萨特诅咒
使敌人的攻击间隔延长20%，法术施放时间延长30%，持续2分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

spells.description_en: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 当不灭决心激活时，30码范围内的敌人都会受到语言诅咒和虚弱诅咒影响，效果为100%。

spells.description_en: Dark Pact heals you for 781 every 1 sec while active.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗契约激活时每1秒为你恢复781点生命值。

spells.description_en: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health. Soul Leech now absorbs an additional 15% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 献祭你10%的最大生命值。现在灵魂榨取会额外吸收你最大生命值15%的生命。

spells.description_en: Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 35%.
spells.description_zh: 你的愈合对自己的治疗效果提高35%。

spells.description_en: When Bloodseeker Vines or Symbiotic Blooms grow, they have a 30% chance to cause another growth of the same type to immediately grow on a valid nearby target.
spells.description_zh: 当觅血缠藤或共生绽华生长时，它们有30%几率使附近一个有效目标身上的同类型植物立即生长。

spells.description_en: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth causes a Symbiotic Bloom to grow on a target for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放迅捷治愈或野性成长会使一个目标长出一朵共生绽华，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Bloodseeker Vines increase the damage your abilities deal to affected enemies by 4%.

Symbiotic Blooms increase the healing your spells do to affected targets by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
觅血缠藤会使你的技能对受影响的敌人造成的伤害提高4%。

共生绽华会使你的法术对受影响目标的治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en:
When Bloodseeker Vines expire or you use Ferocious Bite on their target they explode in thorns, dealing 30 physical damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

When Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on their target flowers grow around their target, healing them and up to 3 nearby allies for 162.
spells.description_zh:
当觅血缠藤失效或你对其目标施放凶猛撕咬时，发生荆棘爆炸，对附近的敌人造成30点物理伤害。超过5个目标时伤害会降低。

当共生绽华失效或你对其目标施放回春术时，花朵会在目标附近生长，为附近至多3位盟友恢复162点生命值。

spells.description_en: Enrage increases your mastery by 15% and your Leech by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 激怒使你的精通提高15%，吸血提高3%。

spells.description_en: Each Rune spent reduces the magic damage you take by 1.5% and each Rune generated reduces the physical damage you take by 1.5% for 5 sec, up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 每使用一个符文都会使你受到的魔法伤害降低1.5%，每产生一个符文都会使你受到的物理伤害降低1.5%，持续5秒，至多5次。

spells.description_en:
When you suffer a damaging effect equal to 25% of your maximum health, you instantly cast Death Pact at 50% effectiveness. May only occur every 2 min.

When a Reaper's Mark explodes, the cooldowns of this effect and Death Pact are reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当你受到一次相当于最大生命值的25%的伤害时，你会立即施放死亡契约，产生50%的效果。每2分钟只能触发一次。

当死神印记爆炸时，该效果和死亡契约的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en:
Increases the healing done by Prayer of Mending by 15%.

All damage dealt by Smite, Holy Fire and Holy Nova increased by 40%.
spells.description_zh:
愈合祷言的治疗量提高15%。

惩击、神圣之火和神圣新星造成的所有伤害提高40%。

spells.description_en: For 6 sec after casting Leap of Faith you may cast it a second time for free, ignoring its cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 施放信仰飞跃后的6秒内，你可以再施放一次信仰飞跃，不产生消耗且忽略其冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Your Angelic Feathers increase movement speed by an additional 10%.

When an ally walks through your Angelic Feather, you are also granted 100% of its effect.
spells.description_zh:
你的天堂之羽使移动速度额外提高10%。

当盟友经过你的天堂之羽时，你也能获得其100%的效果。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of your Renew by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 你的恢复的持续时间延长40%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Prayer of Mending by 1.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 愈合祷言的冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

spells.description_en: Guardian Spirit lasts an additional 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 守护之魂的持续时间额外延长2秒。

spells.description_en: 3 additional Penance bolts are fired at an enemy within 40 yards when healing an ally with Penance, or fired at an ally within 40 yards when damaging an enemy with Penance.
spells.description_zh: 当用苦修治疗盟友或伤害敌人时，会对40码范围内的一个敌人或对40码范围内的一个盟友额外发射3道苦修箭矢。

spells.description_en:
Casting Prayer of Mending applies Power Word: Shield to your target.

 Power Word: Shield
Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,751 damage.
spells.description_zh:
施放愈合祷言会对目标施加真言术：盾。

 真言术：盾
为一名盟友施加护盾，持续15秒，吸收1,788点伤害。

spells.description_en: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 震荡波还会将敌人击飞，冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en:
When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至35%时，获得复苏之风，在2秒内为你恢复12%的最大生命值。

该效果每60秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.
spells.description_zh: 每层巨人神力使你的撕裂和重伤的伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en:
Backstab and Shadowstrike now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 99 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec.

Fazed enemies take 5% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks.

This effect may occur once every 20 sec.
spells.description_zh:
背刺和暗影打击现在也会用隐秘之刃进行攻击，造成97点伤害。被击中的目标会陷入惊慌，持续10秒。

你对惊慌的敌人造成的伤害增加5%，并且攻击不会被对方招架。

此效果每20秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en:
Deep Breath causes enemies to take 20% increased damage from Bombardments and Essence abilities for 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.
spells.description_zh:
深呼吸使敌人受到的连环轰炸和精华技能的伤害提高20%，持续12秒。

多次施放深呼吸会延长此效果的持续时间。

spells.description_en: Obsidian Scales reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

spells.description_en: Knocking enemies up or backwards reduces their damage done to you by 15% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 将敌人击飞或击退使其对你造成的伤害降低15%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Mass Disintegrate reduces the remaining cooldown of Deep Breath by 1.0 sec for each target struck.
spells.description_zh: 群体裂解每击中一个目标，就会使深呼吸的剩余冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Essence abilities extend Bombardments by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 精华技能会使连环轰炸的时间延长1秒。

spells.description_en: Bombardments have a chance to generate Essence Burst.
spells.description_zh: 连环轰炸有几率生成精华迸发。

spells.description_en: Entering combat grants a charge of Burnout, causing your next Living Flame to cast instantly.
spells.description_zh: 进入战斗可以获得一层燃尽，使你的下一次活化烈焰可以瞬发。

spells.description_en: For each second you are in combat, Azure Strike, Living Flame, and Disintegrate deal 1% increased damage, up to 15%.
spells.description_zh: 当你进入战斗以后，碧蓝打击、活化烈焰以及裂解造成的伤害每秒提高1%，至多15%。

spells.description_en: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.
spells.description_zh: 惊慌的目标对你造成的伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: Feint reduces damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by an additional 10%
spells.description_zh: 佯攻使受到的范围攻击伤害额外降低10%。

spells.description_en: While Hovering, damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 悬空时，受到的范围攻击伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath resets a charge of Hover.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸重置一层悬空的充能。

spells.description_en: Secret Technique applies Fazed to any targets struck.
spells.description_zh: 影分身会对命中的目标施加惊慌。

spells.description_en: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.
spells.description_zh: 可以产生连击点数的攻击对惊慌的目标造成的爆击伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Secret Technique has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 影分身的冷却时间减少10%，并使你接下来的2次隐秘之刃攻击无视其冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Unseen Blade and Secret Technique increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.
spells.description_zh: 隐秘之刃和影分身会使你终结技的伤害提高4%，持续12秒。最多5层。

spells.description_en: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.
spells.description_zh: 切割会额外提供10%的攻击速度，并使你的自动攻击有几率重置你使用隐秘之刃进行攻击的机会。

spells.description_en:
Taking damage from an area-of-effect attack while Feint is active or dodging while Evasion is active refreshes your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.

This effect may only occur once every 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在佯攻时受到范围攻击伤害或在闪避时躲闪会重置你使用隐秘之刃进行攻击的机会。

该效果每5秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Your auto-attacks, Unseen Blade, and Coup de Grace also strike up to 7 nearby enemies for 50% of normal damage while Flawless Form is active.
spells.description_zh: 当无瑕之形激活时，你的自动攻击、隐秘之刃和致命一击也会额外攻击附近最多7个目标，造成50%的普通伤害。

spells.description_en:
After Reaper's Mark explodes, your next 2 Obliterates or Frostscythes cost 1 Rune and summon 2 scythes to strike your enemies.

The first scythe strikes your target for 154 Shadowfrost damage and the second scythe strikes all enemies around your target for 62 Shadowfrost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
在死神印记爆炸后，你的下2次湮灭或冰霜之镰消耗1个符文，并召唤2把镰刀打击你的敌人。

第一把镰刀会对目标造成155点暗影冰霜伤害，第二把镰刀会打击目标周围的所有敌人，造成63点暗影冰霜伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Finishing moves have 12% increased chance to critically strike Fazed targets.
spells.description_zh: 终结技对惊慌的目标的爆击几率提高12%。

spells.description_en: Tricks of the Trade's threat redirect duration is increased to 1 hour.
spells.description_zh: 嫁祸诀窍的威胁转移持续时间延长至1小时。

spells.description_en:
Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown.

Pick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.
spells.description_zh:
致盲和潜伏帷幕的冷却时间缩短10%。

搜索和闷棍的范围提高10码。

spells.description_en: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Eviscerate will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.
spells.description_zh: 使用隐秘之刃打击4次之后，你的下一次刺骨会变成致命一击，被视作消耗了额外5个连击点数，并获得5层无瑕之形。

spells.description_en:
Activating Shadow Blades creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 2 additional times.

Effect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.
spells.description_zh:
激活暗影之刃会创造出一片持续6秒的烟雾，使你在烟雾中发动的攻击可以施加惊慌效果，最多额外叠加2次。

离开烟雾后，该效果仍可维持6秒。

spells.description_en:
Your auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

Ravage
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent. 

1 point: 13 damage, 6 in an arc
2 points: 26 damage, 12 in an arc
3 points: 39 damage, 18 in an arc
4 points: 53 damage, 23 in an arc
5 points: 64 damage, 30 in an arc
spells.description_zh:
你的自动攻击有几率使你的下一次凶猛撕咬变为毁灭。

毁灭
终结技，向你的目标发动弧形范围的斩击，每个连击点数都会对目标造成物理伤害，最多消耗25点额外能量，使该伤害最多提高100%。每消耗一点连击点数都会对你前方的所有敌人造成较低的伤害。

1点：13点伤害，弧形范围内6点伤害
2点：25点伤害，弧形范围内12点伤害
3点：38点伤害，弧形范围内18点伤害
4点：51点伤害，弧形范围内24点伤害
5点：65点伤害，弧形范围内29点伤害

spells.description_en:
Your maximum Energy and Rage are increased by 20.

Frenzied Regeneration also increases your maximum health by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
你的最大能量值和怒气值提高20点。

狂暴回复还会使你的最大生命值提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
猎豹形态下会保留铁鬃和狂暴回复效果。

从熊形态转变为猎豹形态时，你会保留熊形态下80%的护甲和生命加成，持续6秒。

在进入熊形态后的6秒内，你受到伤害的10%会在8秒内转为恢复生命值。

spells.description_en:
Frenzied Regeneration can be cast in Cat Form for 40 Energy.

Bear Form reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

Shred and Swipe damage increased by 10%. Mangle damage increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
狂暴回复可以在猎豹形态下施放，消耗40点能量。

熊形态可以使你受到的魔法伤害降低6%。

撕碎、横扫的伤害提高10%，裂伤的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Mangle grants Feline Potential. When you have 6 stacks, the next time you transform into Cat Form, gain 5 combo points and your next Ferocious Bite or Rip deals 50% increased damage for its full duration.
spells.description_zh: 裂伤会赋予灵猫潜能。当你达到6层，下一次变为猎豹形态时，获得5点连击点数，并且你的下一次凶猛撕咬或割裂期间造成的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Black spells deal 20% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 黑龙法术造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes 35 damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 15%.

Dreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death.
spells.description_zh:
毁灭还会施加流血，在6秒内造成35点伤害，同时削弱目标的力量，使其对你造成的伤害降低15%。

恐惧创痕不会受到生死循环影响。

spells.description_en: Ravage increases your auto-attack speed by 35% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 毁灭会使你的自动攻击速度提高35%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

Your first Mangle after entering combat makes your next Maul become Ravage.
spells.description_zh:
毁灭会使你的敏捷提高8%，铁鬃赋予的护甲提高20%，持续8秒。

你在进入战斗后的第一次裂伤会使下一次重殴变为毁灭。

spells.description_en: Every attack with an Energy cost that you cast extends the duration of your Dreadful Wounds by 0.6 sec, up to 8 additional sec.
spells.description_zh: 你每次施放消耗能量的攻击都会使你的恐惧创痕的持续时间延长0.6秒，至多8秒。

spells.description_en: During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.
spells.description_zh: 狂暴期间，撕碎和横扫有20%的几率使你的下一次凶猛撕咬变为毁灭。

spells.description_en: Maul and Raze damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 重殴和摧折的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Stampeding Roar's duration is increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 狂奔怒吼的持续时间延长25%。

spells.description_en: Mangle damage increased by 10% and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 裂伤的伤害提高10%，爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Sundering Roar is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 碎甲咆哮的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Frost Fever deals its damage 75% faster, and the second scythe of Exterminate applies Frost Fever.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜疫病造成伤害的速度加快75%，并且第二把破灭镰刀会施加冰霜疫病。

spells.description_en:
Consuming 20 Soul Fragments or casting Sigil of Spite converts your next Throw Glaive into Reaver's Glaive.

 Reaver's Glaive: 
Throw a glaive enhanced with the essence of consumed souls at your target, dealing 134 Physical damage and ricocheting to 2 additional enemies.
 
Begins a well-practiced pattern of glaivework, enhancing your next Shear and Soul Cleave.

The enhanced ability you cast first deals 10% increased damage, and the second deals 20% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
消耗20个灵魂残片或施放怨念咒符会将你的下一次投掷利刃转化为收割者战刃。

收割者战刃：
向你的目标投掷融合了吞噬之魂精华的战刃，造成134点物理伤害，并飞向2个额外敌人。

开始施展娴熟的战刃技巧，强化你的下一次裂魂和灵魂裂劈。

你首先施放的强化技能会造成10%的额外伤害，第二个技能会造成20%的额外伤害。

spells.description_en: Soul Cleave deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂裂劈造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Reaver's Glaive generates 20 Fury.
spells.description_zh: 收割者战刃产生20点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Consuming a Soul Fragment causes your next Shear to deal 21 additional Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 消耗一个灵魂残片会使你的下一个裂魂造成21点额外的物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Shear applies Reaver's Mark, which causes the target to take 7% increased damage for 20 sec. Max 2 stacks.

Applies 1 additional stack of Reaver's Mark If cast after Soul Cleave.
spells.description_zh:
受到收割者战刃效果强化时，裂魂会施加收割者印记，使目标受到的伤害提高7%，持续20秒。最多可叠加2次。

如果在灵魂裂劈之后施放，则额外施加1层收割者印记。

spells.description_en: The second enhanced ability in a pattern shatters an additional Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh: 第二个被强化的技能额外割裂一块灵魂残片。

spells.description_en: After consuming both enhancements, gain Thrill of the Fight, increasing the damage of your next Reaver's Glaive by 30% and increasing Haste by 8% for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在消耗两种强化效果后，获得酣战热血，使你的下一个收割者战刃的伤害提高30%，且急速提高8%，持续30秒。

spells.description_en:
Teachings of the Monastery has a 15% chance to refund a charge when consumed. 

The damage of Tiger Palm is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
消耗禅院教诲时有15%几率恢复一层充能。

猛虎掌的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Felblade surrounds you with a Blade Ward, reducing damage taken by 10% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 邪能之刃在你身边环绕，形成一道利刃结界，使你受到的伤害降低10%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en:
When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Soul Cleave casts 3 additional glaive slashes to nearby targets. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

If cast after Shear, cast 6 slashes instead.
spells.description_zh:
受到收割者战刃效果强化时，灵魂裂劈对附近目标额外施放3次战刃斩击。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

如果在裂魂之后施放，则改为施放6次斩击。

spells.description_en:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
spells.description_zh:
黑暗魔法从你的体内喷薄而出，腐化你的灵魂，持续20秒，对受到你的枯萎影响的敌人造成4,808点暗影烈焰伤害，并使其额外叠加6层。

被腐化时，你的急速提高8%，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术会额外叠加1层枯萎。

spells.description_en: Each Soul Fragment you consume shields you for an additional 15% of the amount healed.
spells.description_zh: 你每消耗一个灵魂残片，都会为你额外提供吸收护盾，相当于治疗量的15%。

spells.description_en: Fortifying Brew grants you an absorb shield for 25% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 壮胆酒让你获得最大生命值25%的吸收护盾。

spells.description_en: Expose weaknesses in the target of your Reaver's Mark, causing your Physical damage to any enemy to also deal 30% of the damage dealt to your marked target as Chaos, and sometimes shatter a Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh: 揭露收割者印记目标的弱点，使你对任何敌人造成的物理伤害，同时对被标记目标造成该伤害30%的混乱伤害，有时会剥离一块灵魂残片。

spells.description_en:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 295 Nature damage onto enemies and 21,195 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

You may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.
spells.description_zh:
至尊天神赋予你力量，使你能够在3.6秒内对15码范围内的敌人造成292点自然伤害，并为最多5名受伤的盟友恢复20,954点生命值，超过5个目标后效果降低。

引导期间，你可以移动，但施放其他治疗或伤害法术会取消该效果。

spells.description_en: Using Wild Charge while in Bear Form or Moonkin Form incurs a 3 sec shorter cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 在熊形态或枭兽形态下使用野性冲锋会使冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en:
You heal for 10% of your maximum health instantly when you activate Celestial Conduit and receive 15% less damage for its duration. 

This effect lingers for an additional 8 sec after Celestial Conduit ends.
spells.description_zh:
当你激活天神御身时，立即恢复10%的最大生命值，同时在此期间受到的伤害降低15%。

天神御身结束后此效果还会额外保留8秒。

spells.description_en:
Xuen claws your target for 118 Physical damage, healing a nearby ally for 100% of the damage done.

Invoking a celestial guarantees your next cast activates this effect.
spells.description_zh:
雪怒爪击你的目标，造成118点物理伤害，并为附近的一位盟友恢复伤害量的100%的生命值。

使用任意天神下凡后，下次施放必定激活此效果。

spells.description_en: Reversion healing has a chance to cause your next Living Flame to cast instantly and deal 100% increased healing or damage. Stacks up to 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 逆转的治疗效果有一定几率使你的下一个活化烈焰变为瞬发，并且治疗效果或伤害提高100%。该效果最多可叠加2层。

spells.description_en: Essence Burst increases the effectiveness of your next Essence ability by 35%.
spells.description_zh: 精华迸发使你下一个精华技能的效果提高35%。

spells.description_en: upon Yu'lon to increase the cooldown recovery rate of  by 75% for .
spells.description_zh: 会召唤玉珑，让的冷却回复速度加快75%，持续。

spells.description_en: Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 熔岩爆裂获得额外一层充能，造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Ancestors have a 20% chance to call another Ancestor for 8 sec when they depart.
spells.description_zh: 先祖有20%的几率在离去时召唤另一位先祖，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Using spells with a cast time increases the duration of Spiritwalker's Grace and Spiritwalker's Aegis by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用带有施法时间的法术会使灵魂行者的恩赐和灵魂行者的神盾的持续时间延长1秒，最多可延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Earth Shield has an additional 3 charges and heals you for 25% more.
spells.description_zh: 大地之盾额外获得3层，为你恢复的生命值提高25%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Nature's Guardian by 15 sec and causes it to heal for an additional 10% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 自然守护者的冷却时间缩短15秒，并使其为你额外恢复10%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Ancestors last an additional 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 先祖的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Riptide has a 15% chance to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 激流有15%的几率在你身边召唤一个先祖，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
When an Ancestor departs, they cast Hydrobubble on a nearby injured ally.

 Hydrobubble
Surrounds your target in a protective water bubble for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs the next 1,795 incoming damage, but the absorb amount decays fully over its duration.
spells.description_zh:
先祖离去时会对附近的一个盟友施放水泡。

 源水气泡
用保护性的水泡包裹目标，持续15秒。

该护盾会吸收接下来受到的1,795点伤害，但吸收量会在持续期间衰减耗尽。

spells.description_en: Increases the healing done by Healing Wave, Downpour, and Chain Heal by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 治疗波、倾盆大雨和治疗链的治疗效果提高25%。

spells.description_en:
Increases your maximum mana by 10%.

Tidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh:
你的最大法力值提高10%。

潮汐奔涌现在可以叠加最多3次。

spells.description_en: Your Ancestors' spells are 25% more powerful.
spells.description_zh: 你的先祖的法术效果提高25%。

spells.description_en:
Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.

Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.
spells.description_zh:
生命释放为你召唤一位先祖，持续12秒。

每当你施放治疗或伤害法术，先祖也会施放相似的法术。

spells.description_en: When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Riptide by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤先祖时，激流冷却时间缩短2秒。

spells.description_en:
Your next healing or damaging spell is instant, costs no mana, and deals 10% increased damage and healing.

If you know Nature's Swiftness, it is replaced by Ancestral Swiftness and causes Ancestral Swiftness to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的下一个治疗或伤害法术变成瞬发，不会消耗法力值，并且伤害和治疗效果提高10%。

如果你已学会自然迅捷，它会被先祖迅捷替代，且先祖迅捷会为你召唤一位先祖，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 10% Strength for 8 sec.

Wave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.
spells.description_zh:
如果灵魂迸裂没有击中任何敌人，你获得10%力量，持续8秒。

灵魂浪潮对你死神印记主要目标的效果提高100%。

spells.description_en: Your movement speed is increased by 75% during Celestial Conduit and by 15% for 3 sec after being assisted by any Celestial.
spells.description_zh: 在天神御身期间，你的移动速度提高75%，在任意天神协助后的3秒内，你的移动速度提高15%。

spells.description_en:
You switch between alignments every 8 sec, increasing a corresponding secondary stat by 2%.

Crane Stance:
Haste

Tiger Stance:
Critical Strike

Ox Stance:
Versatility

Serpent Stance: 
Mastery
spells.description_zh:
每8秒，你会在几种谐调间切换，使对应的次要属性提高2%。

朱鹤式：
急速

白虎式：
爆击

玄牛式：
全能

青龙式：
精通

spells.description_en:
Celestial Conduit can be recast once during its duration to call upon all of the August Celestials to assist you at 200% effectiveness.

Unity Within is automatically cast when Celestial Conduit ends if not used before expiration.
spells.description_zh:
天神御身可以在持续期间再施放一次，召唤所有至尊天神协助你，产生200%的效果。

如果在天神御身效果结束时未施放，则会在结束时自动施放众神聚心。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse conjures an Arcane Splinter.

Arcane Splinter:
Conjure raw Arcane magic into a sharp projectile that deals 225 Arcane damage.
spells.description_zh:
施放奥术冲击或奥术脉冲会召唤一个奥术裂片。

奥术裂片：
召唤源生的奥术魔法，凝聚成尖锐的投射物，造成225点奥术伤害。

spells.description_en:
Casting Arcane Surge generates 8 Arcane Splinters.

During Arcane Surge, your chance to conjure an additional Arcane Splinter is increased to 100%.
spells.description_zh:
施放奥术涌动会生成8个奥术裂片。

在奥术涌动期间，额外召唤一个奥术裂片的几率提高至100%。

spells.description_en:
Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

Mograine
Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

Whitemane
Casts Undeath on your target dealing 2 Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

Trollbane
Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

Nazgrim
While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
消耗符文有几率召唤一名天启骑士协助你作战，持续10秒。

莫格莱尼
在他的位置施放枯萎凋零，效果区域会跟随他移动。每次造成伤害时，使你的疾病效果持续时间延长1.0秒。

怀特迈恩
对你的目标施放死灵，每层每3秒造成2点暗影冰霜伤害，持续24秒。死灵造成伤害时叠加一层，无法被刷新。

托尔贝恩
对目标施放寒冰锁链，使其移动速度降低40%，并使其从你受到的伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

纳兹戈林
纳兹戈林激活时，你获得天启征服，使力量提高5%。

spells.description_en: While outdoors you are able to mount your Acherus Deathcharger in combat.
spells.description_zh: 在户外时，你可以在战斗中骑乘阿彻鲁斯死亡战马。

spells.description_en:
Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.

For 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.
spells.description_zh:
召唤你的死亡战马，解除移动限制效果。

在10秒内骑乘死亡战马，使你的移动速度提高100%，不能被减速到正常速度的100%以下，并免疫强制移动和击退效果。

spells.description_en: Essence abilities are enhanced with Flame, dealing 20% of healing or damage done as Fire over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 精华技能被烈焰增强，在8秒内造成治疗或火焰伤害，数值相当于造成治疗或伤害的20%。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath reaches its maximum empower level 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息到达最大蓄力层数的速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: When Scourge Strike damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.
spells.description_zh: 天灾打击对受到死灵影响的敌人造成伤害时，使其叠加1层，并感染附近的另一个敌人。

spells.description_en: The damage of your diseases and Death Coil are increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的疫病技能和凋零缠绕的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 亡者大军和冰霜巨龙之怒会召唤全部4名天启骑士协助你作战，持续20秒。

spells.description_en: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.
spells.description_zh: 你的伤害提高5%，并且位于莫格莱尼的枯萎凋零中时可以获得。

spells.description_en:
If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.

Additionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.
spells.description_zh:
如果有敌人在纳兹戈林激活期间死亡，天启征服的力量加成提高3%。

另外，每消耗一个符文会使该效果提高1%。

spells.description_en: Every 50 Runic Power you spend extends the duration of the Horsemen's aid in combat by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗50点符文能量可以使天启骑士在战斗中助阵的持续时间延长1秒，最多5秒。

spells.description_en: While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your  increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 有2名或更多天启骑士协助你时，你的。

spells.description_en:
While at your aid, the Horsemen will occasionally cast Anti-Magic Shell on you and themselves at 80% effectiveness.

You may only benefit from this effect every 45 sec.
spells.description_zh:
在协助你作战时，天启骑士会周期性对你和自身施放反魔法护罩，产生80%的效果。

你每45秒只能获得该效果一次。

spells.description_en: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.
spells.description_zh: 当你受到伤害时，5%的伤害会转移给每个激活的天启骑士。

spells.description_en:
Disintegrate consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.

Pyre consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.
spells.description_zh:
裂解造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上1.0秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量150%的伤害。

葬火造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上4秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量115%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Scourge Strike shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing 36 Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 天灾打击命中时击碎托尔贝恩的寒冰锁链，对周围的敌人造成36点暗影冰霜伤害，并使其减速40%，持续4秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 天灾打击造成的伤害提高15%，枯萎凋零的冷却时间减少5秒。

spells.description_en:
Enemies damaged by your Arcane Orb conjure 2 Arcane Splinters, up to 4.

Arcane Orb damage is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh:
受到你的奥术宝珠伤害的敌人会召唤出2个奥术裂片，最多4个。

奥术宝珠的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Obsidian Scales also applies to your target or 1 nearby injured ally at 50% value.
spells.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片还会施加给目标或附近1个受伤的盟友，产生50%的效果。

spells.description_en: 40% of the direct damage dealt by an Arcane Splinter is also dealt to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 奥术裂片造成直接伤害的40%的伤害会同时作用于附近的敌人。目标超过5个时伤害会降低。

spells.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting conjures 2 Arcane Splinters.
spells.description_zh: 获得节能施法时，召唤2个奥术裂片。

spells.description_en: Casting Arcane Barrage conjures an Arcane Splinter for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.
spells.description_zh: 在施放奥术弹幕时，每消耗5层奥术齐射，生成一个奥术裂片。

spells.description_en: You have 40% increased movement speed during Alter Time.
spells.description_zh: 在操控时间期间，你的移动速度提高40%。

spells.description_en: While in combat, Blink summons a Mirror Image at your previous location.
spells.description_zh: 在战斗中使用闪现时，会在你原来的位置召唤一个镜像。

spells.description_en: Your attacks against your primary target have a 25% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 293 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 你对主要目标的攻击有25%几率摧垮其防御，并触发一次屠戮者打击，造成290点物理伤害，并赋予你一层处刑者效果，使你的斩杀伤害提高3%，持续12秒。处刑者效果可叠加。

spells.description_en:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
每施放3次屠戮者打击，获得猝死。

使用猝死会加快你的下一个剑刃风暴，使其额外打击1次（最多3次）。剑刃风暴的总持续时间不变。

猝死有100%的几率触发100%效果的掠武风暴。

spells.description_en: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.
spells.description_zh: 猝死造成的伤害的15%为你恢复生命值。

spells.description_en: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.
spells.description_zh: 每层处刑者还会使你的斩杀爆击几率和爆击伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每次打击都会对受影响的所有敌人施加不堪一击，使你对其造成的伤害提高1%，持续20秒，最多叠加5层。

spells.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 致死打击的爆击使你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高20%.

spells.description_en: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 20% additional damage and 20% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 当战术专家重置压制的冷却时间时，你的下一个压制造成的伤害提高20%，爆击伤害提高20%。此效果最多叠加2层。

spells.description_en: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 274 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 当顺劈斩命中3个或更多目标时，你有20%的几率掀起一阵钢铁风暴，打击周围的敌人，造成273点物理伤害并施加不堪一击。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Charge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.
spells.description_zh:
冲锋使你的移动速度提高70%，持续3秒。

冲锋会移除所有移动限制效果，该效果每30秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 英勇飞跃使冲锋的冷却时间缩短5秒，冲锋使英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短2秒。

spells.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每一次攻击额外造成20%的伤害，由所有目标均摊。

spells.description_en: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 压制和斩杀的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
使用猝死会使你的剑刃风暴冷却时间缩短5秒，并根据你拥有的处刑者层数，为你的主要目标施加1层不堪一击效果。

你可以在剑刃风暴期间使用拳击和风暴之锤。

剑刃风暴的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Your Mirror Image summons 1 extra copy of you.
spells.description_zh: 你的镜像额外召唤1个复制体。

spells.description_en:
Your Prismatic Barrier can absorb up to 25% more damage based on your missing health.

Max effectiveness when under 25% health.
spells.description_zh:
你的棱光护体的伤害吸收量最多提高25%，这取决于你损失的生命值。

生命值低于25%时达到最大效果。

spells.description_en: Critical strike chance against targets above 50% health increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 对生命值高于50%的目标的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time is increased by 30%. Dream Breath's heal over time is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续性伤害提高30%。梦境吐息的持续性治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: Hover and Deep Breath travel 40% faster, and Hover travels 40% further.
spells.description_zh: 悬空和深呼吸的飞行速度加快40%，悬空的飞行距离延长40%。

spells.description_en: Vengeful Retreat can be cast a second time within 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 复仇回避可以在3秒内再次施放一次。

spells.description_en: Vengeful Retreat resets the cooldown of Felblade.
spells.description_zh: 复仇回避会重置邪能之刃的冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Arcane Surge damage increased by 30%.

Your chance to gain Clearcasting is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh:
奥术涌动的伤害提高30%。

你获得节能施法的几率提高3%。

spells.description_en: Direct damage from Arcane Splinters reduces the cooldown of Arcane Orb by 0.30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 奥术裂片的直接伤害会使奥术宝珠的冷却时间缩短0.30秒。

spells.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location that creates a Tremor immediately and every 5.4 sec for 42 Flamestrike damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets. Lasts 25 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，立即施放一次震颤，随后每5.4秒施放一次震颤，造成42点烈焰打击伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。持续25秒。

spells.description_en: Throw Glaive deals 7 Physical damage to enemies near its initial target.
spells.description_zh: 投掷利刃对初始目标附近的敌人造成7点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Elemental motes orbit around your Surging Totem. Your abilities consume the motes for enhanced effects. 

Water: Your next Healing Wave also heals an ally inside of your Healing Rain at 50% effectiveness.

Air: The cast time of your next healing spell is reduced by 40%.

Earth: Your next Chain Heal applies Earthliving at 150% effectiveness to all targets hit.
spells.description_zh:
元素微粒在你的涌动图腾周围飞旋，你的技能会消耗微粒并增强效果。

流水：你的下一次治疗波还会治疗你的治疗之雨中的一个盟友，产生50%的效果。

空气：你的下一个治疗法术的施法时间减少40%。

大地：你的下一个治疗链以150%的效果对所有命中的目标施加大地生命。

spells.description_en: Chain Heal now jumps to a nearby totem within 20 yards once it reaches its last target, causing the totem to cast Chain Heal on an injured ally within 30 yards for 852. Jumps to 2 nearby targets within 20 yards.
spells.description_zh: 治疗链弹射到最后一个目标后会跃向20码内的一个图腾，使图腾对30码内的一名受伤的盟友施放治疗链，恢复837点生命值。可跳转到20码内的2名目标。

spells.description_en: Increases the size and radius of your totems by 15%, and the health of your totems by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 图腾的体型和范围扩大15%，图腾的生命值提高30%。

spells.description_en:
Successfully removing a harmful effect with Tremor Totem or Poison Cleansing Totem, or controlling an enemy with Capacitor Totem or Earthgrab Totem reduces the cooldown of the totem used by 5 sec.

Cannot occur more than once every 20 sec per totem.
spells.description_zh:
战栗图腾或清毒图腾成功移除一个有害效果，或者使用电能图腾或陷地图腾控制一名敌人时，你使用的图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

每个图腾每20秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of your Earthliving effect by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的大地生命效果的持续时间延长3秒。

spells.description_en: While Surging Totem is active, your damage and healing done is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 涌动图腾激活时，你造成的伤害和治疗提高3%。

spells.description_en: Surging Totem deals 50% more damage while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active.
spells.description_zh: 在升腾或治疗之潮图腾激活期间，涌动图腾造成的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing 1,833 damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 有图腾激活时，图腾每30秒使你获得一个护盾，吸收1,833点伤害，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the healing done by Surging Totem by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 涌动图腾的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Learn a new weapon imbue, Tidecaller's Guard.

 Tidecaller's Guard
Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
习得一种新的武器灌魔：唤潮者的护卫

 唤潮者的护卫
为你的盾牌注入水元素之力，持续1小时。你造成的治疗效果提高2.0%，你的治疗之泉图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

spells.description_en: When you summon a Healing Tide Totem, Healing Stream Totem, or Spirit Link Totem you cast a free instant Chain Heal at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 你的治疗之潮图腾、治疗之泉图腾或灵魂链接图腾在召唤时会施放一次无消耗且瞬发的治疗链，产生100%的效果。

spells.description_en:
Your Healing Stream Totems heals an additional ally at 30% effectiveness.

Healing Tide Totem healing increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
你的治疗之泉图腾还会治疗第二名盟友，产生30%的效果。

治疗之潮图腾的治疗量提高25%。

spells.description_en: Chain Heals from Lively Totem and Totemic Rebound are 25% more effective.
spells.description_zh: 生机图腾和图腾反弹的治疗链的效果提高25%。

spells.description_en: Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet scorch enemies and blind them with ash, causing their next attack within 4 sec to miss.
spells.description_zh: 扫尾和飞翼打击会灼烧敌人，并以灰烬令其致盲，使他们在4秒内的下一次攻击无法命中。

spells.description_en: The healing and damage of Holy Shock is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击的治疗效果和伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Bestows a vile malediction upon the target, burning the sinew and muscle of its host, dealing 94 Shadowflame damage immediately and an additional 1,572 Shadowflame damage over 18 sec.

Replaces Corruption.
spells.description_zh:
对目标降下恶毒的诅咒，燃烧宿主的经脉与血肉，立即造成94点暗影烈焰伤害，并在接下来的18秒内额外造成1,588点暗影烈焰伤害。

代替腐蚀术。

spells.description_en: Living Flame and Azure Strike have 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when they critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 活化烈焰和碧蓝打击爆击时有额外1次触发精华迸发的机会。

spells.description_en: Your wounds have a small chance to cauterize, healing you for 30% of damage taken. Occurs more often from attacks that deal high damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的伤口有较小的几率灼烧愈合，为你恢复生命值，数值相当于受到伤害的30%。造成较高伤害的攻击触发频率较高。

spells.description_en: Your next Mortal Strike after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃风暴结束后，你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en:
Rising Sun Kick now kicks up a Gust of Mist to heal 2 allies within 40 yds for 0. 

Spinning Crane Kick and Blackout Kick have a chance to kick up a Gust of Mist to heal 1 ally within 40 yds for 0.
spells.description_zh:
旭日东升踢还会踢出迷雾之风，为40码内的2名盟友恢复0点生命值。

神鹤引项踢和幻灭踢有几率踢出迷雾之风，为40码内的1名盟友恢复0点生命值。

spells.description_en: Renewing Mist's heal over time has a chance to cause your next Vivify to also trigger a Zen Pulse on its target and all allies with Renewing Mist, healing them for 615 increased by 6% per Renewing Mist active, up to 30%.
spells.description_zh: 复苏之雾的持续治疗效果有几率使你的下一个活血术对目标和带有你的复苏之雾效果的盟友触发禅意波，为其恢复599点生命值，每个激活的复苏之雾使效果提高6%，最多提高30%。

spells.description_en: After you fully consume Thunder Focus Tea, your next Vivify triggers Zen Pulse.
spells.description_zh: 完全消耗雷光聚神茶后，你的下一个活血术会触发禅意波。

spells.description_en:
When Truth's Wake critically strikes, its duration is extended by 2 sec.

Your other damage over time effects deal 30% increased damage to targets affected by Truth's Wake.
spells.description_zh:
真理觉醒爆击时，其持续时间延长2秒。

你的其他持续性伤害效果对受到真理觉醒影响的目标造成的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Rejuvenation instantly heals your target for 20% of its total periodic effect and Regrowth's duration is increased by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 回春术立即为你的目标恢复其周期性效果总量20%的生命值，愈合的持续时间延长3秒。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 229 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆撕开一道追踪敌人的熵能裂隙，持续8秒。位于路径中的敌人处于范围内时，每0.9秒受到233点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: While above 80% health, Holy Shock's healing is increased 20%, but creates a heal absorb on you for 30% of the amount healed that prevents Beacon of Light from healing you until it has dissipated.
spells.description_zh: 生命值高于80%时，神圣震击的治疗效果提高20%，但会使你受到吸收治疗效果的影响，数值相当于该次治疗量的30%，吸收治疗效果存在期间你无法获得圣光道标的治疗。

spells.description_en:
Light of the Martyr's health threshold is reduced to 70% and increases Holy Shock's healing by an additional 5% for every 5 sec Light of the Martyr is active, stacking up to 3 times.

While below 70% health, the light urgently heals you for 76 every 1 sec.
spells.description_zh:
殉道者之光的生命值阈值降低至70%，并且殉道者之光每激活5秒，都会使神圣震击的治疗效果额外提高5%，最多叠加3次。

生命值低于70%时，圣光会紧急治疗你，每1秒恢复76点生命值。

spells.description_en: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：盾的吸收量提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Each time Penance damages or heals, Entropic Rift is empowered, increasing its damage and size by 10%.

After Entropic Rift ends it collapses, dealing 1,672 Shadow damage split amongst enemy targets within 15 yds.
spells.description_zh:
每当苦修造成伤害或治疗都会强化熵能裂隙，使其造成的伤害和尺寸提高10%。

熵能裂隙结束后会塌缩，造成1,672点暗影伤害，由15码内的所有敌方目标均摊。

spells.description_en:
Casting a damaging spell has a 6% chance to conjure a Spellfire Sphere.

While you're out of combat, you will slowly conjure Spellfire Spheres over time.

 Spellfire Sphere
Increases your spell damage by 1.0%. Stacks up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh:
施放伤害性法术有6%的几率召唤一颗法术火焰宝珠。

脱离战斗时，你会随着时间缓慢地召唤法术火焰宝珠。

 法术火焰宝珠
你的法术伤害提高1.0%，最多叠加3次。

spells.description_en:
When you cast Arcane Surge, summon an Arcane Phoenix to aid you in battle.

  Arcane Phoenix
Your Arcane Phoenix aids you for the duration of your Arcane Surge, casting random Arcane and Fire spells.
spells.description_zh:
当你施放奥术涌动时，召唤一只奥术凤凰协助你作战。

奥术凤凰
你的奥术凤凰会在奥术涌动期间协助你，并随机施放奥术和火焰法术。

spells.description_en:
Stamina increased by 4%.

Stamina in Bear Form is increased by an additional 5%.
spells.description_zh:
耐力提高4%。

在熊形态下耐力额外提高5%。

spells.description_en: Ferocious Bite and Maul damage increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 凶猛撕咬和重殴的伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en: Moonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 月火术和阳炎术的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Survival Instincts and Barkskin reduce damage taken by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 生存本能和树皮术使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

spells.description_en:
Shred, Rake, and Skull Bash can be used in any form and shift you into Cat Form, if necessary. 

Mangle can be used in any form and shifts you into Bear Form. 

Wrath and Starfire shift you into Moonkin Form, if known.
spells.description_zh:
撕碎、斜掠和迎头痛击可以在任意形态下使用，必要时会使你变形为猎豹形态。

裂伤可以在任意形态下使用，并使你变形为熊形态。

如已习得枭兽形态，愤怒和星火术可以使你变形为枭兽形态。

spells.description_en: Casting Arcane Blast, Arcane Pulse, Arcane Barrage, or Prismatic Bolt grants you 0.5% Haste for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 施放奥术冲击、奥术脉冲、奥术弹幕或棱彩飞弹使你获得0.5%的急速，持续6秒。多次效果可重叠。

spells.description_en: The bonuses provided by your Barrier spells persist at 100% effectiveness for an additional 8 sec after your Barrier is removed.
spells.description_zh: 你的屏障法术提供的增益会在屏障移除后以100%的效果额外持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Arcane Barrage deals 5% increased damage to enemies affected by your Touch of the Magi.
spells.description_zh: 奥术弹幕对受大法师之触影响的敌人造成5%额外伤害。

spells.description_en:
When your Arcane Phoenix is summoned, it consumes all your Spellfire Spheres.

Each Sphere consumed increases your spell damage during Arcane Surge by 1% and causes your Arcane Phoenix to cast an exceptional Arcane or Fire spell over its duration.
spells.description_zh:
当你的奥术凤凰被召唤时，会消耗你所有的法术火焰宝珠。

每消耗一个宝珠，在奥术涌动期间你的法术伤害提高1%，并使你的奥术凤凰在持续时间内施放一次卓越的奥术或火焰法术。

spells.description_en:
Arcane Barrage summons 1 Meteorite for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.

 Meteorite
Calls down a meteorite which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 424 Fire damage to all enemies hit, reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
奥术弹幕每消耗5层奥术齐射，就会召唤1颗陨星。

陨星
召唤一颗陨星，3秒后落在目标位置，对击中的所有敌人造成431点火焰伤害。目标超过8个时对所有敌人造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: When you cast Arcane Surge, its duration is extended by 0.8 sec for each Spellfire Sphere you have, up to 2.4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你施放奥术涌动时，每有一个法术火焰宝珠，其持续时间就延长0.8秒，最多2.4秒。

spells.description_en: If you generate a combo point in excess of what you can store, your next Ferocious Bite or Primal Wrath deals 10% increased direct damage.
spells.description_zh: 如果你产生了超出上限的连击点，你的下一个凶猛撕咬或原始之怒造成的直接伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 滚地翻令你身轻如羽，使你可以在5秒内施展一次二段跳，向前冲刺一小段距离，滚地翻的冷却时间提高2秒。

spells.description_en:
Your chance to generate a Spellfire Sphere is increased by 6%.

Spellfire Spheres grant an additional 1% spell damage.
spells.description_zh:
生成法术火焰宝珠的几率提高6%。

法术火焰宝珠额外提供1%法术伤害。

spells.description_en:
A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.

Consuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing 1,342 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
一个恶魔实体寄宿在你的灵魂中，产生灵魂碎片时可以感知其是否为诱人灵魂。

吞噬一个诱人灵魂会释放你的恶魔之魂，对目标周围10码范围内的所有敌人造成1,342点暗影伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
When your Arcane Phoenix expires it empowers you, granting Arcane Soul for 4.0 sec.

Arcane Soul:
Arcane Barrage grants Clearcasting and generates 4 Arcane Charges.

Each cast of Arcane Barrage grants 5 stacks of Arcane Salvo and casting Arcane Barrage does not consume Arcane Salvo.
spells.description_zh:
当你的奥术凤凰消失时，它会强化你，使你获得奥术之魂，持续4.0秒。

奥术之魂：
奥术弹幕会触发节能施法，并产生4层奥术充能。

每次施放奥术弹幕都会获得5层奥术齐射，并且施放奥术弹幕时不会消耗奥术齐射。

spells.description_en: Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影箭的伤害提高20%。能量虹吸使恶魔之箭的伤害额外提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 488 Shadow damage over 10 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.
spells.description_zh:
释放你的恶魔之魂会让恶毒的实体侵蚀目标的灵魂，在10秒内造成488点暗影伤害。

重复施加该效果时，剩余伤害会添加到新的蚀魂之咒中。

spells.description_en: Your Arcane Phoenix has picked up a few tricks, and will Spellsteal when it is summoned and when it expires.
spells.description_zh: 你的奥术凤凰学会了一些新技巧，在被召唤时和消失时都会施放法术吸取。

spells.description_en: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.
spells.description_zh: 你的恶魔之魂对古尔丹之手的主要目标造成的伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en:
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.

Consuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal 914 Shadow damage to your target.
spells.description_zh:
你的恶魔之魂造成的伤害提高10%。

消耗恶魔之核会滋养你体内的恶魔实体，使其现身并对目标造成914点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en:
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.
spells.description_zh:
蚀魂之咒的伤害提高25%，造成伤害的速度加快20%。

消耗恶魔之核会激活命运相连或灵魂盛宴。

spells.description_en: Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.
spells.description_zh: 野生小鬼的伤害提高35%，内爆的野生小鬼产生恶魔之核的几率提高5%。

spells.description_en: Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.
spells.description_zh: 你的召唤恶魔暴君法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其获得3个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。

spells.description_en: Tiger's Fury increases your Haste by 10% and Energy recovery rate by 25% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 猛虎之怒使你的急速提高10%，能量回复速度提高25%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when consuming a Healthstone, increasing its healing by 30% and increasing your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你在消耗治疗石时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使其治疗效果提高30%，并使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗契约的吸收量额外提高，数值相当于牺牲生命值的50%。

spells.description_en:
When you kill a target, its tortured soul is flung into a nearby enemy for 3 sec. This effect inflicts 192 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds every 0.9 sec.

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
当你消灭一个目标后，其饱受磨难的灵魂会砸向附近的一名敌人，持续3秒。该效果每0.9秒对10码内的敌人造成193点暗影伤害。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.
spells.description_zh: 当你消灭一个目标后，你有几率获得一个灵魂碎片，并且必定为诱人灵魂。

spells.description_en: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
spells.description_zh: 邪能统御的冷却时间缩短90秒。

spells.description_en: Halo now centers around you and returns to you after it reaches its maximum distance, healing allies and damaging enemies each time it passes through them.
spells.description_zh: 光晕现在以你为中点，达到最大距离后会返回你的位置，每次穿越都会对盟友进行治疗，对敌人造成伤害。

spells.description_en: Halo damage and healing is increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 光晕的伤害和治疗效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, your Atonement healing is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，你的救赎的治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: Void Blast increases the duration of Entropic Rift by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 虚空冲击使熵能裂隙的持续时间延长1.0秒，最多3秒。

spells.description_en: Summoning an Entropic Rift extends the duration of your 5 shortest Atonements by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一道熵能裂隙，使你持续时间最短的5个救赎效果延长1秒。

spells.description_en: Your heightened reflexes allow you to react swiftly to the presence of enemies, causing you to quickly lunge to the nearest enemy in front of you within 10 yards after you Roll.
spells.description_zh: 敏锐的反应使你能够快速应对附近的敌人，使用滚地翻后会立刻扑向前方10码内最近的敌人。

spells.description_en: Starsurge increases the damage the target takes from your periodic effects and Shooting Stars by 16% for 5 sec. Reapplying this effect extends its duration, up to 20 sec. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 星涌术使目标受到你的周期性伤害和坠星的伤害提高16%，持续5秒。重新施加该效果会延长持续时间，最多20秒。每个目标只能受到一次影响。

spells.description_en: Targets you Roll through are snared by 40% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 滚地翻穿过的目标被诱捕，移动速度降低40%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: When Eclipse ends or when you enter combat, enter a Dreamstate, reducing the cast time of your next 2 Starfires or Wraths by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 日月之蚀结束或当你进入战斗时，陷入迷梦状态，使接下来2个星火术或愤怒的施法时间缩短30%。

spells.description_en:
Casting Wrath has a 12% chance to make your next Starsurge or Starfall free.

Casting Starfire has a 15% chance to make your next Starsurge or Starfall free.
spells.description_zh:
施放愤怒有12%的几率使你的下一个星涌术或星辰坠落不消耗资源。

施放星火术有15%的几率使你的下一个星涌术或星辰坠落不消耗资源。

spells.description_en: Consuming Sentinel's Mark grants you an absorb shield equal to 10.0% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 消耗哨兵印记会使你获得一个护盾，能够吸收相当于你最大生命值10.0%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Kill Command grants an additional 5 Focus and its damage is increased by 20%. 

Maximum Focus increased by 25.
spells.description_zh:
杀戮命令额外产生5点集中值，伤害提高20%。

最大集中值提高25点。

spells.description_en: Every 15 sec, your next Rising Sun Kick or Vivify releases a wave of Chi energy that flows through friends and foes, dealing 6 Nature damage or 20 healing. Bounces up to 7 times to targets within 25 yards.
spells.description_zh: 每过15秒，你的下一个旭日东升踢或活血术会释放一道真气能量波拂过你的盟友和敌人，造成7点自然伤害或恢复20点生命值。可弹射到25码范围内的目标身上，最多弹射7次。

spells.description_en:
Entropic Rift upgrades Smite into Void Blast while it is active.

Void Blast:
Sends a blast of cosmic void energy at the enemy, causing 579 Shadow damage.
spells.description_zh:
熵能裂隙激活时将惩击升级为虚空冲击。

虚空冲击：
向敌人射出一股宇宙虚空能量，造成573点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Magical damage done increased by 5% and healing done increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 造成的魔法伤害提高5%，造成的治疗效果提高5%。

spells.description_en: Increases your Physical damage done by 5% and Avoidance increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你造成的物理伤害提高5%，闪避提高2%。

spells.description_en: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.
spells.description_zh: 分筋错骨现在会移除目标的所有激怒效果。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 平心之环的冷却时间缩短5秒，赤精之歌的施法时间缩短0.5秒。

spells.description_en: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你受到的诱捕效果的持续时间缩短20%。

spells.description_en:
Store vitality from 10% of your damage dealt and 30% of your healing.

For 10 sec after casting Thunder Focus Tea your spells and abilities draw upon the stored vitality to deal 40% additional healing over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
造成伤害的10%和治疗的30%存储为活力。

施放雷光聚神茶后的10秒内，你的法术和技能会消耗存储的活力，造成40%的额外治疗，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
The range of Disable is increased by 5 yds.
 
The duration of Crashing Momentum is increased by 3 sec and its snare now reduces movement speed by an additional 20%.
spells.description_zh:
金刚震的射程延长5码。

迅威压迫的持续时间延长3秒，诱捕效果现在使移动速度额外降低20%。

spells.description_en: Roll and Chi Torpedo travel a small distance further.
spells.description_zh: 滚地翻和真气突的移动距离略微延长。

spells.description_en:
When Aspect of Harmony heals, it has a chance to spread to a nearby ally. When you directly heal an affected target, it has a chance to intensify, withdrawing additional vitality to increase its effect by up to 20%.

Vivify no longer contributes vitality. While Aspect of Harmony is not active, Vivify instead draws on available vitality to deal an additional 100% healing over 8 sec.

Vitality stored by other abilities is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh:
当和谐化身产生治疗时，有一定几率传播给附近的一个盟友。当你直接治疗一个受影响的目标时，有几率增强效果，抽取更多活力，将效果最多提高20%。

活血术不再产生活力。当和谐化身未激活时，活血术改为汲取现有的活力，额外造成100%的治疗，持续8秒。

其他技能储存的活力提高50%。

spells.description_en: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 未进入战斗时，你的移动速度提高15%。

spells.description_en: Starsurge or Starfall increase your current Eclipse's Arcane or Nature damage bonus by an additional 2%, up to 6%.
spells.description_zh: 星涌术或星辰坠落会使日月之蚀当前的奥术或自然伤害加成额外提高2%，最多6%。

spells.description_en: Transcendence: Transfer immediately heals you for 10% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 魂体双分：转移会为你恢复最大生命值的10%。

spells.description_en:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
你会根据当前生命值获得一个额外效果。

生命值高于90%：移动速度提高5%。该效果可与其他相似效果叠加。

生命值在90%与35%之间：受到的伤害降低5%。

生命值低于35%：受到的治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en: Transcendence: Transfer snares targets within 10 yds by 70% for 4 sec when cast.
spells.description_zh: 施放魂体双分：转移时诱捕10码内的目标，使其减速70%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Increases maximum Astral Power by 20. Entering Eclipse reduces the Astral Power cost of your next Starsurge or Starfall by 15.
spells.description_zh: 最大星界能量提高20点。进入日蚀或月蚀时，你的下一个星涌术或星辰坠落的星界能量消耗减少15点。

spells.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, Atonement healing with Void Blast and Penance is 75% more effective.
spells.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，虚空冲击和苦修产生的救赎治疗效果提高75%。

spells.description_en: Your auto attacks have a chance to generate 1-2 Flurry Charges. When you cast Keg Smash, unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing 21 Physical damage per charge.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击有几率产生1-2层疾风拳势。施放醉酿投会释放所有疾风拳势，每层造成21点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: Roll removes a snare effect once every 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 滚地翻每30秒可移除一个诱捕效果。

spells.description_en: Successfully interrupting an enemy reduces the cooldown of Paralysis and Roll by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 成功打断敌人会使分筋错骨和滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: While your Celestial is active, you cannot be slowed below 90% normal movement speed.
spells.description_zh: 当你的天神激活时，你的移动速度不会降低到正常速度的90%以下。

spells.description_en:
Fireball always critically strikes enemies below 30% health.

When Fireball or Scorch damage an enemy below 30% health, Fireball deals 25% increased damage and Scorch deals 250% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
火球术对生命值低于30%的敌人必定造成爆击。

火球术或灼烧对一名生命值低于30%的敌人造成伤害时，火球术的伤害提高25%，灼烧的伤害提高250%。

spells.description_en:
Your spell critical strike chance is increased by 2.5%.

Combustion increases your critical strike damage by 2.5%.
spells.description_zh:
你的爆击几率提高2.5%。

受到燃烧效果影响时，你的爆击伤害提高2.5%。

spells.description_en: When Aspect of Harmony ends, any remaining vitality is expelled as healing over 8 sec, split among nearby targets.
spells.description_zh: 和谐化身结束时，释放剩余的活力，在8秒内造成治疗，由周围的目标均摊。

spells.description_en: During Aspect of Harmony, Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick, and Tiger Palm also withdraw vitality to damage enemies for an additional 20% over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在和谐化身期间，旭日东升踢、幻灭踢和猛虎掌还会消耗活力，在8秒内对敌人造成20%的额外伤害。

spells.description_en: Chi Burst and Chi Wave deal 50% increased damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 真气爆裂和真气波的伤害和治疗效果提高50%。

spells.description_en: Casting a Physical spell or ability increases the damage and healing of your next Fire or Nature spell or ability by 3%, and vice versa. Stacks up to 5.
spells.description_zh: 施放一个物理法术或技能会使你的下一个火焰或自然法术与技能的伤害和治疗效果提高3%，反之亦然。最多叠加5次。

spells.description_en: Thunder Focus Tea has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 雷光聚神茶额外拥有1次充能。

spells.description_en: Chi Burst increases vitality stored by 25% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 真气爆裂使存储的活力提高25%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm contribute 30% additional vitality.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢、幻灭踢和猛虎掌额外产生30%的活力。

spells.description_en: Flurry Strikes have 15% additional chance to critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 疾风乱打的爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Enemies who die within 10 sec of being damaged by a Flurry Strike explode, dealing 35 physical damage to uncontrolled enemies within 8 yds.
spells.description_zh: 在受到疾风乱打伤害后的10秒内死亡的敌人会爆炸，对8码内未受到失控效果影响的敌人造成35点物理伤害。

spells.description_en: Your agility is increased by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 你的敏捷提高4%。

spells.description_en: Haste increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.


Keg Smash damage increased by 35%.
spells.description_zh:
自动攻击的爆击会使疾风拳势层数翻倍。


醉酿投的伤害提高35%。

spells.description_en:
Energy spenders deal an additional 20% damage.
The cooldown of Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is reduced by 25 sec.
spells.description_zh:
消耗能量的技能造成的伤害提高20%。
玄牛下凡的冷却时间缩短25秒。

spells.description_en: Your attacks penetrate 12% armor.
spells.description_zh: 你的攻击穿透12%的护甲。

spells.description_en:
When your health drops below 50%, summon Whirling Steel, increasing your parry chance and avoidance by 15% for 6 sec.

This effect can not occur more than once every 180 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至50%时，召唤钢铁漩涡，使你的招架几率和闪避提高15%，持续6秒。

该效果每180秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: When you dodge or parry an attack, reduce all damage taken by 10% for the next 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你躲闪或招架一次攻击时，接下来6秒内受到的所有伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick deals an additional 30% critical damage.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢造成的爆击伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Casting Enveloping Mist stores 1,140 additional vitality.
spells.description_zh: 施放氤氲之雾会额外储存1,140点活力。

spells.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, you move 20% faster.
spells.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，你的移动速度加快20%。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm deal 15% additional damage to enemies in a line in front of you. Damage reduced above 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢、幻灭踢和猛虎掌对你前方直线范围内的敌人造成15%的额外伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Fortifying Brew grants 20% Stagger.
spells.description_zh: 壮胆酒使醉拳化解量提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Arcane Blast damage increased by 30%.

Arcane Pulse damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
奥术冲击的伤害提高30%。

奥术脉冲的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: When cast on yourself, your single-target healing spells heal for 10% more and restore an additional 570 health over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 对自己施放时，你的单目标治疗法术的治疗效果提高10%，并且在6秒内额外恢复570点生命值。

spells.description_en: Casting Tiger's Lust reduces the remaining cooldown on Roll by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放迅如猛虎使滚地翻的剩余冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Tiger's Lust grants 20% movement speed to up to 2 allies near its target.
spells.description_zh: 迅如猛虎使目标附近的最多2名盟友的移动速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Entropic Rift slows enemies by up to 70%, increased the closer they are to its center.
spells.description_zh: 熵能裂隙使敌人最多减速70%，距离中心越近减速效果越高。

spells.description_en:
Wrath, Starsurge, and Starfire damage increased by 5%. 

Starsurge's cooldown is reduced by 4 sec and its mana cost is reduced by 50%.
spells.description_zh:
愤怒、星涌术和星火术的伤害提高5%。

星涌术的冷却时间缩短4秒，法力值消耗降低50%。

spells.description_en:
When Entropic Rift ends, a Voidwraith is summoned from the collapsed rift for 5 sec.

Voidwraith
Summon a Voidwraith that casts Void Flay from afar. Void Flay deals bonus damage to high health enemies, up to a maximum of 50% if they are full health.
