Generates 0.5% Mana each time the Voidwraith attacks.
spells.description_zh:
熵能裂隙结束时，从坍缩的裂隙召唤一个虚空幽灵，持续5秒。

虚空幽灵
召唤一个虚空幽灵，从远处施放虚空鞭笞。虚空鞭笞对生命值较高的敌人造成额外伤害，最多对满血的敌人造成50%的额外伤害。

虚空幽灵每次攻击产生0.5%的法力值。

spells.description_en:
Fists of Fury's damage is increased by 100% of your haste and Fists of Fury does 10% more damage each time it deals damage, resetting when Fists of Fury ends.

Your auto attack speed is increased by 60% for 8 sec after Fists of Fury ends.
spells.description_zh:
怒雷破的伤害提高，比例相当于你的急速的100%。怒雷破每次造成伤害，都会使其造成的伤害提高10%，并在怒雷破结束时重置。

怒雷破结束后，你的自动攻击速度提高60%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Every 3 sec siphon an amount equal to 4% of your health from an ally within 40 yds if they are higher health than you.
spells.description_zh: 如果40码内有盟友的生命值高于你，每3秒吸取其相当于你生命值的4%的生命值。

spells.description_en:
Casting Pyroblast or Flamestrike while Hot Streak is active has a 6% chance to repeat the spell cast at 50% effectiveness.

This effect counts as consuming Hot Streak.
spells.description_zh:
在炽热连击激活时施放炎爆术或烈焰风暴有6%的几率以50%的效果重复该次法术。

该效果视作消耗了炽热连击。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Rising Sun Kick is reduced by 1.0 sec and the damage of Blackout Kick is increased by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的冷却时间缩短1.0秒，幻灭踢的伤害提高12%。

spells.description_en: When you consume Blackout Kick!, you have a 100% chance to generate 1 Chi.
spells.description_zh: 当你消耗“幻灭踢！”效果时，有100%的几率产生1点真气。

spells.description_en: You have a 100% chance to gain Blackout Kick! after consuming Dance of Chi-Ji.
spells.description_zh: 消耗赤精之舞后，你有100%的几率获得幻灭踢！

spells.description_en: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have a 100% chance to activate Dance of Chi-Ji.
spells.description_zh: 风领主之击和升龙霸有100%的几率激活赤精之舞。

spells.description_en:
Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch grant 4 stacks of Teachings of the Monastery.

Teachings of the Monastery can now stack up to 8 times.
spells.description_zh:
风领主之击和升龙霸产生4层禅院教诲。

禅院教诲现在最多可叠加8次。

spells.description_en: You absorb 3% of all magic damage taken. Absorbing Shadow damage heals you for 100% of the amount absorbed.
spells.description_zh: 吸收你受到的所有魔法伤害的3%。吸收暗影伤害会为你恢复生命值，治疗量相当于吸收量的100%。

spells.description_en: Jadefire Stomp now strikes 1 target, but deals 300% increased damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 碧火踏现在只会击中1个目标，但造成的伤害和治疗效果提高300%。

spells.description_en: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have their cooldowns reduced by 5 sec and their damage is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 风领主之击和升龙霸的冷却时间缩短5秒，伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Your auto attacks have a 30% chance to instead kick your target dealing 169 Physical damage. Damage increased while using a two-handed weapon.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击有30%的几率改为脚踢目标，造成169点物理伤害。使用双手武器时造成的伤害提高。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Death consumes absorb shields from your target, dealing 956 extra damage to them and granting you 1% mana if a shield was present.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：灭吞噬目标的吸收护盾，有护盾存在时对其造成最多970点额外伤害，并使你获得1%的法力值。

spells.description_en: Casting Combustion refreshes up to 1 charge of Fire Blast.
spells.description_zh: 施放燃烧会刷新最多1次火焰冲击使用次数。

spells.description_en:
Your spells and abilities have a chance to activate Flurry of Xuen, unleashing a barrage of deadly swipes to deal 192 Physical damage in a 10 yd cone, damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Invoking Xuen, the White Tiger activates Flurry of Xuen.
spells.description_zh:
你的法术和技能有一定几率激活雪怒之捷，施放一连串致命的挥击，对10码的锥形区域造成192点物理伤害，目标超过5个后伤害降低。

白虎下凡会激活雪怒之捷。

spells.description_en: When a spell consumes Clearcasting, its damage is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 消耗节能施法的法术的伤害提升20%。

spells.description_en:
Void Metamorphosis now also greatly empowers Voidblade and Hungering Slash.

While demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Voidsurge, causing you to explode with Void energy, dealing 2,396 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
虚空变形现在还会大幅强化虚空之刃和饥渴斩击。

恶魔形态激活时，你第一次施放每种强化技能时都会触发一次虚空涌动，使你爆发出虚空能量，对周围的敌人造成2,382点宇宙伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.
spells.description_zh: 混乱新星在其昏迷效果消失后，使敌人减速60%，并使其攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Movement speed increased by 1% per 10 Fury.
spells.description_zh: 每10点恶魔之怒使移动速度提高1%。

spells.description_en:
Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
当虚空涌动仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高50%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低10%。

spells.description_en:
5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec.

Fire damage taken reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
受到的所有非火焰伤害的5%改为视作火焰伤害，持续6秒。

受到的火焰伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Leech granted by Soul Rending increased by 2% and an additional 2% while Void Metamorphosis is active.
spells.description_zh: 由灵魂劈裂获得的吸血提高2%，在虚空变形期间再额外提高2%。

spells.description_en:
Your blades burn with Cosmic energy, causing your Voidblade, Hungering Slash, and Throw Glaive to deal an additional 35% damage as Cosmic damage.

Reap damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
你的利刃燃烧着宇宙能量，使你的虚空之刃、饥渴斩击和投掷利刃造成额外35%的宇宙伤害。

收割的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Entering Void Metamorphosis resets the cooldown of Voidblade and The Hunt.

The Hunt deals 25% increased damage and resets the cooldown of Soul Immolation.
spells.description_zh:
进入虚空变形时，重置虚空之刃和恶魔追击的冷却时间。

恶魔追击的伤害提高25%，并且会重置灵魂献祭的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Mastery: Monster Within's effectiveness by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 在你脱离恶魔形态后，该形态仍以减弱状态持续，使你的精通：内在恶魔的效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: Maximum Fury increased by 20.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔之怒上限提高20点。

spells.description_en: Void Ray applies Student of Suffering to you, increasing Mastery by 10.6% and granting 5 Fury every 2 sec, for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 虚空射线会对你施加苦难修行，精通提高10.6%，并且每2秒产生5点恶魔之怒，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.
spells.description_zh: 饥渴斩击的半径提高2码，并且额外提高50%爆击伤害。

spells.description_en: Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.
spells.description_zh: 不处于恶魔形态时，智力提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Activating Void Metamorphosis greatly empowers The Hunt.

Voidsurge damage is increased by 10% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.
spells.description_zh:
激活虚空变形大幅强化恶魔追击。

恶魔形态激活时，之前每触发过一次虚空涌动，其造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Defensive Stance additionally reduces magic damage you take by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 防御姿态额外使你受到的魔法伤害降低8%。

spells.description_en:
Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 58 Cosmic damage to your target.

For each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
每当一个终结技消耗5个或更多连击点数时，掷出一枚命运硬币。正面会使你的攻击伤害提高10%，持续15秒，或直到你掷出反面为止。反面会对被击中的目标造成59点宇宙伤害。

每次你掷出命运硬币的结果与上一次相同时，正面使造成的伤害额外提高2%，反面造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Soulstone and Create Healthstone by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂石和制造治疗石的施法时间缩短50%。

spells.description_en:
During Arcane Surge, your Arcane Familiar fires 4 bolts instead of 1.

Damage from your Arcane Familiar has a 6% chance to restore 2% of your maximum mana.
spells.description_zh:
在奥术涌动期间，你的奥术魔宠会发射4道魔法箭矢，而不是1道。

你的奥术魔宠造成的伤害有6%的几率为你恢复最大法力值的2%。

spells.description_en: Corruption deals 30% increased damage and its periodic damage heals you for 5% of the damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 腐蚀术的伤害提高30%，并且其周期性伤害会为你恢复所造成伤害的5%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 15% and increases its damage by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影箭的施法时间降低15%，伤害提升40%。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击几率提高5%。

spells.description_en: Increases critical strike damage dealt by Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术和恶魔的伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Casting Halo also causes you to create a Halo around you at 100% effectiveness every 5 sec for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放光晕时，还会在你周围每5秒以100%的效果制造一个光晕，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul have a chance to trigger a Shadow Bolt Volley, dealing 437 Shadow damage to 5 enemies within 10 yards of your current target.
spells.description_zh: 暗影箭和吸取灵魂有一定几率触发暗影箭雨，对你当前目标10码范围内的5个敌人造成508点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: The cast time of Pyroblast and Flamestrike is reduced by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 炎爆术和烈焰风暴的施法时间缩短20%。

spells.description_en: Fatebound Coins flipped by Envenom are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.
spells.description_zh: 通过毒伤掷出的命运硬币有33%更高的几率得到和上一次掷出命运硬币时获得相同的结果。

spells.description_en: Activating Deathmark flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.
spells.description_zh: 激活死亡印记会掷出一枚命运硬币并使其竖立，结果同时算作正面和反面。

spells.description_en: Increases the attack speed of your Dreadstalkers by 10% and their critical strike chance by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的恐惧猎犬攻击速度提高10%，爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Power Word: Fortitude grants you an additional 5% stamina.
spells.description_zh: 真言术：韧使你获得额外5%的耐力。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Dispersion by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消散的持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 10% and increases its damage by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影箭的施法时间降低10%，伤害提升15%。

spells.description_en:
Creating a Halo grants Surge of Light.

 Surge of Light
Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal or Shadow Mend instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.
spells.description_zh:
制造一个光晕会赋予你圣光涌动。

 圣光涌动
你的治疗法术和惩击有8%的几率使你的下一个快速治疗或暗影愈合变为瞬发，且消耗的法力值降低50%。最多可叠加2层。

spells.description_en: Your spells affected by Surge of Light heal for 5% more while Surge of Light is active.
spells.description_zh: 圣光涌动激活期间，你受其影响的法术治疗效果额外提高5%。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your primary demon by 50% of your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 使你的主要恶魔的爆击几率提高，数值等同于你爆击几率的50%。

spells.description_en: Casting Mind Flay: Insanity has a 100% chance to conjure Shadowy Apparitions.
spells.description_zh: 施放精神鞭笞：狂有100%的几率召唤暗影幻灵。

spells.description_en: Creating a Halo increases your healing done by 2% for 10 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
spells.description_zh: 制造光晕使你的治疗效果提高2%，持续10秒，最多叠加4层。

spells.description_en: Halo damage reduces enemy movement speed by 5% for 5 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 光晕的伤害使敌人的移动速度降低5%，持续5秒，最多叠加5层。

spells.description_en: Damaging critical strikes dealt by you and your demons deal 230% damage instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh: 你与恶魔造成的伤害性爆击会造成230%的伤害，而非通常的200%。

spells.description_en: Your damage dealt is increased by 5% while Voidform is active.
spells.description_zh: 在虚空形态激活时，你造成的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Psychic Scream creates an image of you at your location. After 4 sec, the image will let out a Psychic Scream.
spells.description_zh: 心灵尖啸在你的位置创造一个你的幻象。4秒后幻象将释放一次心灵尖啸。

spells.description_en:
Creating a Halo extends the duration of Voidform by 1 sec. If Voidform is not active, up to 6 seconds is stored.

While out of combat or affected by a loss of control effect, the duration of Voidform is paused for up to 20 sec.
spells.description_zh:
创造一个光晕会使虚空形态的持续时间延长1秒。如果虚空形态未激活，最多可存储6秒。

未进入战斗或受到失控效果影响时，虚空形态的持续时间可暂停最多20秒。

spells.description_en: Each Maelstrom Weapon spent has a 2.00% chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.
spells.description_zh: 消耗的每层漩涡武器有2.00%的几率将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature damage spells by 5% and the critical strike damage of your Nature spells by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的伤害性自然法术的爆击几率提高5%，并且使你的自然法术的爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Tempest increases your movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂风怒号使你的移动速度提高20%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en:
Doom Winds summons a Nature Feral Spirit for 12 sec.

Feral Spirit
An Elemental Spirit infused with Nature magic, granting the summoner with 5% increased Nature damage and 5% Physical damage for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
毁灭之风会召唤一只自然野性狼魂，持续12秒。

野性狼魂
被自然魔法灌注的元素之灵，使召唤者的自然伤害提高5%，物理伤害提高5%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Lightning Shield reduces the damage you take by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 闪电之盾使你受到的伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.
spells.description_zh: 你有30%的几率吸收任意所受伤害的10%

spells.description_en: Casting Tempest grants Surging Currents, increasing the effectiveness of your next Chain Heal or Healing Surge by 16%, up to 80%.
spells.description_zh: 施放狂风怒号可获得喷薄之流，使你的下一个治疗链或治疗之涌的效果提高16%，最高80%。

spells.description_en:
Spending Maelstrom Weapon stacks grants you 1% haste for 15 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
消耗漩涡武器层数使你获得1%急速，持续15秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Mutilate, Ambush, and Fan of Knives have a 60% chance to generate 1 additional combo point when they trigger Seal Fate.
spells.description_zh: 毁伤、伏击和刀扇有60%的几率产生1个额外的连击点数（在它们触发封印命运时）。

spells.description_en: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal movement speed while your Fatebound Coin flips have an active streak of at least 2 flips matching the same face.
spells.description_zh: 当你的命运硬币连续掷出至少2次并且结果相同时，你的移动速度不会低于正常速度的70%。

spells.description_en: Grappling Hook may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 抓钩可以在3秒内再次使用一次，没有冷却时间，但总的冷却时间延长5秒。

spells.description_en: Sinister Strike has 5% increased chance to strike an additional time and grant Opportunity and your Fatebound Coins flipped have an additional 5% chance to match the same face as the last flip.
spells.description_zh: 影袭进行额外攻击的几率提高5%，触发可乘之机，并且你在掷出命运硬币时有额外5%的几率与上一次掷出的结果相同。

spells.description_en: When you would be healed above maximum health, you instead convert an amount equal to 40% of your critical strike chance to a heal over time effect.
spells.description_zh: 当你即将受到过量治疗时，你会将等同于你爆击几率40%的过量治疗转化为持续治疗效果。

spells.description_en: You have a 10% chance to not reset your Elusive Brawler stacks after a successful dodge.
spells.description_zh: 成功的躲闪有10%的几率不重置醉拳大师的层数。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的毁灭系法术的爆击几率提高3%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2% and reduces the cast time of your Incinerate spell by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你的火焰法术造成的伤害提高2%，你的烧尽法术的施法时间缩短20%。

spells.description_en: Chains of Ice now also roots enemies for 4 sec but its cooldown is increased to 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰锁链现在还会使敌人定身4秒，但冷却时间延长至12秒。

spells.description_en: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 你受到爆击的几率降低3%，你的护甲提高6%。

spells.description_en: When you would pull an enemy, the damage they deal to you is reduced by 6% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你即将拖动一名敌人时，其对你造成的伤害降低6%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell increases healing received by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 反魔法护罩使受到的治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Magic damage taken is reduced by 8% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低8%，你受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短35%。

spells.description_en: Casting Anti-Magic Shell grants 2 nearby allies a Lesser Anti-Magic Shell that Absorbs up to 148 magic damage and reduces the duration of harmful Magic effects against them by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 施放反魔法护罩会使附近的2名盟友获得一个弱效反魔法护罩，吸收最多148点魔法伤害，并使其受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短50%。

spells.description_en: Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 毁灭闪电和闪电链的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Tiger Palm's chance to activate Blackout Kick! is increased by 75% and Tiger Palm's damage is increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 猛虎掌激活幻灭踢！的几率提高75%，猛虎掌的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: The range of your helpful magics is increased by 5 yards.
spells.description_zh: 你的有益魔法效果的射程延长5码。

spells.description_en: Casting Purifying Brew grants a charge of Ox Stance. When you take damage that is greater than 60% of your current health, a charge is consumed to increase the amount you Stagger.
spells.description_zh: 施放活血酒会获得一层玄牛式。当你受到的伤害量超过你当前生命值的60%时，消耗一层并提高你的醉拳化解量。

spells.description_en: Envenom's effect increases the damage of Envenom by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 毒伤效果使毒伤的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Tempest grants 7% Mastery for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂风怒号使你获得7%的精通，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Tempest causes your next Chain Lightning to be instant cast, deal 40% increased damage, and cast an additional time.

Can accumulate up to 2 charges.
spells.description_zh:
狂风怒号使你的下一个闪电链变为瞬发，造成的伤害提高40%，并额外施放一次。

可以积累最多2层。

spells.description_en: Lightning Bolt, Tempest, and Chain Lightning have a 35% chance to refund 2 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
spells.description_zh: 闪电箭、狂风怒号和闪电链有35%的几率返还2层漩涡武器层数。

spells.description_en:
Gain the effects of the Lightning Rod talent:

 Lightning Rod
Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning make your target a Lightning Rod for 8 sec.
 
Lightning Rods take 10% of all damage you deal with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.
spells.description_zh:
获得引雷针天赋：

 引雷针
闪电箭和闪电链使目标变成引雷针，持续8秒。
 
你的闪电箭和闪电链造成伤害时，引雷针会承受总伤害量的10%。

spells.description_en: Stormstrike has a small chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.
spells.description_zh: 风暴打击有较小几率将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。

spells.description_en:
Your Magus of the Dead Shadow Bolt now fires a volley of Shadow Bolts at up to 8 nearby enemies.

Your Lord of the Dead Frostbolts now chain to 3 additional enemies.
spells.description_zh:
你的亡者魔导师的暗影箭现在会朝附近至多8名敌人射出一阵暗影箭雨。

你的亡者之主的寒冰箭现在会连锁至多3名额外敌人。

spells.description_en: When you fall below 40% health, you gain an absorb for 30% of your recently Purified damage, or a minimum of 8% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你的生命值降低至40%时，你获得一个护盾，吸收量相当于最近净化伤害的30%，至少为你的最大生命值的8%。每15秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Auto-attacks increase auto-attack damage by 3% and movement speed by 1% for 3 sec, stacking up to 10 times.
spells.description_zh: 自动攻击使自动攻击伤害提高3%，移动速度提高1%，持续3秒，最多叠加10次。

spells.description_en: Consuming Sudden Doom summons forth a Lesser Ghoul to assist you for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗末日突降会召唤一个次级食尸鬼来协助你，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Your diseases deal 10% more damage and have a 5% increased chance to critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 你的疾病造成的伤害提高10%，并且爆击几率提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Festering Strike now follows up with a Festering Scythe that costs no Runes.

Festering Scythe
Slashes through all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, dealing 36 Shadow damage and hastening all of your plagues on targets hit to deal damage 35% faster for 25 sec.
spells.description_zh:
脓疮打击现在会紧接着施放一次不消耗符文的脓疮毒镰。

脓疮毒镰
斩击前方14码内的所有敌人，造成36点暗影伤害，并使目标身上所有疫病伤害生效速度加快35%，持续25秒。

spells.description_en: When your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每当你的护体屏障被移除时，使其冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Gloomhound and learns the following ability:

 Gloom Slash
Tooth and claw are drenched in malignant shadow magic, causing the Gloomhound's melee attacks to deal an additional 120 Shadow damage.
spells.description_zh:
你的召唤邪犬变为召唤阴暗恶犬，并习得以下技能：

 阴暗劈裂
尖牙和利爪被恶毒的暗影魔法浸透，使得阴暗恶犬的近战攻击额外造成120点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Charhound and learns the following ability:

 Infernal Presence
Cloaked in the ever-burning flames of the abyss, dealing 60 Fire damage to enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的召唤邪犬变为召唤灼焦恶犬，并习得以下技能：

 狱火气息
身披永燃不灭的深渊烈焰，每0.9秒对10码内的敌人造成60点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: When you remove an effect with Soothe or Remove Corruption, gain a combo point and heal for 4% of your maximum health. If you are at full health an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.
spells.description_zh: 当你使用安抚或清除腐蚀移除一个效果时，获得一个连击点数，并恢复4%的最大生命值。如果你生命值已满，则会改为治疗一个受伤的小队或团队成员。

spells.description_en: Allies affected by your Earthliving effect receive 15% increased healing from you.
spells.description_zh: 受到你的大地生命效果影响的盟友，从你这里获得的治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Swiftmend healing is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 迅捷治愈的治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Each foe struck with Glacial Advance has a chance to transform your next Frost Strike into Frostbane. The chance increases with the number of Razorice stacks on the target.

Frostbane
Start a frozen onslaught that strikes twice, unleashing the chilling essence of winter, dealing 21 Frost damage to all enemies caught in its wake with each strike.

Each enemy struck reduces the damage dealt to the next foe by 5%, down to 40%.
spells.description_zh:
冰川突进每命中一个敌人都有几率将你的下一次冰霜打击变为冰霜灾祸。目标身上叠加的锋锐之霜越多，此几率越高。

冰霜灾祸
发起一套包含两次攻击的冰冻强袭，释放冷冽的寒冬精华，每次打击对路径中的所有敌人造成21点冰霜伤害。

每击中一个敌人都会使下一个敌人受到的伤害降低5%，最多降低至40%。

spells.description_en: Consuming Killing Machine fires a Glacial Advance through your target at 60% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 消耗杀戮机器效果时向目标施放一次冰川突进，产生60%的效果。

spells.description_en: When Howling Blast consumes Rime, 15% of the damage it deals is gathered into the next cast of Remorseless Winter, up to 20 times.
spells.description_zh: 每次凛风冲击消耗白霜时，造成的伤害的15%会积攒到下一次冷酷严冬中，最多积攒20次。

spells.description_en: Your Runic Power spending abilities have a chance to additionally deal 30% of the damage dealt over 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的消耗符文能量的技能有几率在4秒内额外造成30%的伤害。

spells.description_en: While Pillar of Frost is active your auto-attack critical strikes increase its duration by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当冰霜之柱激活时，你的自动攻击爆击会使其持续时间延长1秒，最多可达4秒。

spells.description_en: Activating Recklessness grants a charge of Thunder Blast.
spells.description_zh: 激活鲁莽会获得一次雷霆轰击的充能。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 混乱之箭的伤害提高10%，施法时间缩短0.5秒。

spells.description_en: Cloak of Shadows duration increased by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 暗影斗篷的持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en:
Evasion reduces magical damage taken by 15%. 

Cloak of Shadows reduces physical damage taken by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
闪避使受到的魔法伤害降低15%。

暗影斗篷使受到的物理伤害降低20%。

spells.description_en:
Garrote applies 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to your target, unless Deathstalker's Mark is already active. You learn Mark for Death.

When you spend 5 or more combo points on attacks against a Marked target you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, dealing 54 Plague damage.


Mark for Death
Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.
spells.description_zh:
锁喉会对目标施加3层死亡猎手标记，除非死亡猎手标记已生效。你学会死亡印记。

当你对被标记的目标使用消耗至少5个连击点数的攻击时，你会消耗一层死亡猎手标记，造成54点瘟疫伤害。


死亡印记
将你当前的死亡猎手标记移至目标身上。

spells.description_en: Auto-attacks against Marked targets deal an additional 3 Plague damage.
spells.description_zh: 自动攻击对被标记的目标额外造成3点瘟疫伤害。

spells.description_en: Damage dealt to targets other than your Marked target deals 5% Plague damage to your Marked target.
spells.description_zh: 对非标记目标造成的伤害也会对被标记的目标造成5%的瘟疫伤害。

spells.description_en: After Deathmark expires, gain 30% increased Nature damage for 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 死亡印记效果结束后，造成的自然伤害提高30%，持续30秒。

spells.description_en: Each time you consume a stack of Deathstalker's Mark, reduce the cooldown of Shadowstep by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 每当你消耗一层死亡猎手标记，使暗影步的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en:
When you consume the final Deathstalker's Mark from a target or your target dies, gain 30 Energy and Darkest Night, causing your next Envenom cast with 5 or more combo points to critically strike, deal 35% additional damage, and apply 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to the target if no other Deathstalker's Mark is active.

Envenom cast with Darkest Night does not consume a stack of active Deathstalker's Marks.
spells.description_zh:
当你消耗目标身上的最后一层死亡猎手标记，或目标死亡时，获得30点能量和至黑之夜，使你的下一个以5个或更多连击点数施放的毒伤必定爆击，造成的伤害提高35%，并且在目标身上没有其它死亡猎手标记激活时，对其施加3层死亡猎手标记。

在至黑之夜下施放的毒伤不会消耗已激活的死亡猎手标记层数。

spells.description_en: Shadow Dance additionally increases the damage of your next Eviscerate or Black Powder by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影之舞还会使你的下一个刺骨或黑火药的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Shroud of Concealment duration increased by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕的持续时间延长5秒。

spells.description_en: If you have critically struck with Fan of Knives, increase the critical strike chance of Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest by 10% and critical strike damage by 20% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 如果你的刀扇造成爆击，使你的刀扇和猩红风暴的爆击几率提高10%，爆击伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest deal 30% additional damage while 2 or more enemies are afflicted with Rupture.
spells.description_zh: 当至少有2名敌人受到割裂影响时，刀扇和猩红风暴额外造成30%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
连击点数的上限额外提高1点。

消耗5点连击点数以上的终结技产生的效果得以加强，并且终结技造成的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Arcane Surge's damage is increased by an additional 50% based on your mana spent.
spells.description_zh: 奥术涌动的伤害根据你消耗的法力值额外提高50%。

spells.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell now removes all harmful magical effects when activated, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 反魔法护罩激活时可以移除所有有害魔法效果，但冷却时间延长20秒。

spells.description_en: While Combustion is not active, damage from Ignite has a small chance to make your next Scorch instant, deal 100% increased damage, and deal damage as though your target was below 30% health.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧未激活时，点燃造成伤害时有较小的几率使你的下一个灼烧变为瞬发，伤害提高100%，并且将目标的生命值视作低于30%。

spells.description_en: Damage dealt to targets below 35% health is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 对生命值低于35%的目标造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: At the end of your Fists of Fury channel, you release a Jadefire Stomp, dealing 35 damage to 5 enemies in front of you and increasing your movement speed by 20% for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 怒雷破引导结束时，你会施放一次碧火踏。对你前方的5个敌人造成35点伤害，并在3秒内使你的移动速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Haunt by 35% and reduces its cast time by 0.3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 鬼影缠身的伤害提高35%，施法时间缩短0.3秒。

spells.description_en:
Avenging Wrath is replaced with Radiant Glory.

Radiant Glory
Wake of Ashes activates Avenging Wrath for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
复仇之怒被替换为光辉荣耀。

光辉荣耀
灰烬觉醒激活复仇之怒，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Allies with Renewing Mist receive 6% more healing from you and Renewing Mist's duration is increased by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 具有复苏之雾的盟友受到你的治疗效果提高6%，并且复苏之雾的持续时间提高2秒。

spells.description_en: Arcane Intellect grants you an additional 2% Intellect.
spells.description_zh: 奥术智慧使你的智力额外提高2%。

spells.description_en:
When you would pull an enemy generate 1 charge of Bone Shield.

 Bone Shield
Surrounds you with a barrier of whirling bones, increasing Armor by 110. Each melee attack against you consumes a charge. Lasts 30 sec or until all charges are consumed.
spells.description_zh:
当你拖动一名敌人时，产生1层白骨之盾。

白骨之盾
用旋转的白骨屏障将你包围，使你的护甲值提高110点。每次对你发动的近战攻击都会消耗一层效果。持续30秒或直到所有层数被消耗完毕为止。

spells.description_en: Critical Strike chance increased by 2%. This effect is increased by 100% while Xuen, the White Tiger is active.
spells.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。白虎雪怒激活时，该效果提高100%。

spells.description_en:
Desperate Prayer lasts an additional 10 sec.

Angelic Bulwark's absorption effect is increased by 15% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh:
绝望祷言的持续时间提高10秒。

天使壁垒的吸收效果提高，数值相当于你最大生命值的15%。

spells.description_en:
Consumption now contributes to your Mastery: Blood Shield.

Each time an enemy strikes your Blood Shield, the cooldown of Consumption has chance to be reset.
spells.description_zh:
吞噬现在会对精通：鲜血护盾生效。

每当敌人攻击你的鲜血护盾时，吞噬的冷却时间有几率被重置。

spells.description_en:
Parrying an attack grants you a charge of Bloodied Blade, increasing your Strength by 0.5%, up to 4.0% for 15 sec.

At 8 stacks, your next parry consumes all charges to unleash a Heart Strike at 300% effectiveness, and increases your Strength by 10% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh:
招架一次攻击会为你提供一层染血利刃，使你的力量提高0.5%，最多可叠加至4.0%，持续15秒。

在达到8层时，你的下次招架会消耗所有层数，释放一次300%效果的心脏打击，并在6秒内使你的力量提高10%。

spells.description_en: Upheaval causes an aftershock at its location, dealing 30% of its damage 2 additional times.
spells.description_zh: 地壳激变在其位置引发余震，额外造成2次伤害，伤害量等同于其伤害的30%。

spells.description_en: Critical strikes from your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction have a chance to grant Nightfall.
spells.description_zh: 你的痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击有几率触发夜幕。

spells.description_en: Survival of the Fittest gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 优胜劣汰额外获得一次充能。

spells.description_en: You cannot be slowed below 80% of your normal movement speed while Aspect of the Cheetah is active.
spells.description_zh: 在猎豹守护激活时，你的移动速度不会低于正常移动速度的80%。

spells.description_en: Binding Shot's stun duration is increased by 1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 束缚射击的昏迷效果持续时间延长1秒。

spells.description_en: When a trap triggers, gain 30% increased movement speed for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当陷阱触发时，移动速度提高30%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en: You gain 2% more critical strike from critical strike sources.
spells.description_zh: 你从爆击来源获得的爆击提高2%。

spells.description_en: Flare's radius is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 照明弹的半径提高50%。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Intimidation is reduced by 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 胁迫的冷却时间缩短20秒。

spells.description_en: Feign Death and Aspect of the Turtle removes poison and disease effects from you.
spells.description_zh: 假死和灵龟守护会移除你身上的中毒和疾病效果。

spells.description_en:
Your damage over time effects deal 10% increased damage.

This effect is increased by 50% on targets below 20% health.
spells.description_zh:
你的持续性伤害效果造成的伤害提高10%。

对生命值低于20%的目标，该效果增加50%。

spells.description_en: Haste increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Deep Breath reduces the Essence cost of your next 6 Eruptions by 1.
spells.description_zh: 深呼吸使你的下6个喷发的精华消耗减少1点。

spells.description_en: Kill Command deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
When Misdirection targets your pet, it reduces the damage they take by 50% for 5 sec.

The cooldown of Misdirection is reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当误导目标为你的宠物时，使其受到的伤害减少50%，持续5秒。

误导的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Kill Command deals increased critical strike damage equal to 100% of your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令造成的爆击伤害提高，数值等同于你的爆击几率的100%。

spells.description_en: When your pet attacks critically strike, they cause their target to bleed for 8% of the damage dealt over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你的宠物爆击时，会使目标流血，在6秒内造成爆击伤害的8%。

spells.description_en: Increases the range of most spells by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 大部分法术的射程提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Bestial Wrath causes all active pets to Stomp at 200% effectiveness.

Stomp damage increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh:
狂野怒火会使所有激活的宠物发起践踏，产生200%的效果。

践踏的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en:
Summoning a Dire Beast 8 times sounds the Horn of Valor, summoning either Hati or Fenryr to battle.

Hati
Increases the damage of all your pets by 4%.

Fenryr
Pounces your primary target, inflicting a heavy bleed that deals 280 damage over 8 sec and grants you 4% Haste.
spells.description_zh:
召唤凶暴野兽8次后吹响勇气号角，召唤哈提或芬雷尔参战。

哈提
使你所有宠物的伤害提高4%。

芬雷尔
扑向你的主要目标，使其严重流血，在8秒内造成280点伤害，并使你获得4%急速。

spells.description_en: Gain critical strike damage equal to 25% of your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 你的爆击伤害提高，数值等同于你的爆击几率的25%。

spells.description_en:
Rapid Fire shoots 3 additional shots.

Aimed Shot grants 50% increased movement speed for 2 sec, decaying rapidly over its duration.
spells.description_zh:
急速射击额外发射3发箭弹。

瞄准射击使移动速度提高50%，持续2秒，并且在持续期间迅速衰减。

spells.description_en: Explosive Shot deals 8% increased damage and Volley deals 12% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 爆炸射击造成的伤害提高8%，乱射造成的伤害提高12%。

spells.description_en: Boomstick increases the cooldown recovery rate of Wildfire Bomb by 60% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 爆裂火铳使野火炸弹的冷却回复速度提高60%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Each damage over time effect on a target increases the critical strike damage they receive from you by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 目标身上每有一个持续伤害效果，你对其造成的爆击伤害提高4%。

spells.description_en: Kill Command grants an additional 5 Focus and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令额外产生5点集中值，爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Tranquilizing Shot removes 1 additional Magic effect from up to 2 nearby targets.
spells.description_zh: 宁神射击从附近最多2个目标身上移除1个额外的魔法效果。

spells.description_en: If Tranquilizing Shot removes only an Enrage effect, its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 如果宁神射击只移除了一个激怒效果，其冷却时间减少5秒。

spells.description_en:
Kill Command damage increased by 15%.

Kill Command reduces the cooldown of Wildfire Bomb by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
杀戮命令的伤害提高15%。

杀戮命令会使野火炸弹的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en:
When Demonbolt consumes a Demonic Core it inflicts impending doom upon the target, dealing 1,531 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds of its target after 20 sec or when removed. Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hand of Gul'dan reduces the duration of Doom by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh:
当恶魔之箭消耗一个恶魔之核时，它会让末日降临到目标身上，在20秒后或效果移除时，对目标周围10码范围内的敌人造成1,531点暗影伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

古尔丹之手使末日降临效果的持续时间减少3秒。

spells.description_en: Frozen Orb increases Shatter's damage by 10% for its duration.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰宝珠在持续时间内使碎冰伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Turn Evil's cast time is reduced by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 超度邪恶的施法时间缩短100%。

spells.description_en: Allies with Beacon of Light receive 5% less damage.
spells.description_zh: 受到圣光道标影响的盟友受到的伤害降低5%。

spells.description_en: 50% of Holy Shock's overhealing is converted into an absorb shield. The shield amount cannot exceed 10% of your max health.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击过量治疗的50%会转化为一个吸收护盾。护盾量不能超过你最大生命值的10%。

spells.description_en: Holy Shock has a 12% chance to refund a charge when cast and its healing is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣震击有12%的几率在施放时返还一层充能，并且其治疗效果提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Each wave of Arcane Missiles has a 50% chance to grant you 1 Arcane Charge.

Arcane Missiles damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
每一波奥术飞弹有50%几率使你获得1层奥术充能。

奥术飞弹的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Each wave of Arcane Missiles will consume an Arcane Charge to increase its damage by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 奥术飞弹的每一波都会消耗一层奥术充能，使其造成的伤害提高40%。

spells.description_en: Each wave of Arcane Missiles has a 50% chance to grant 1 additional stack of Arcane Salvo.
spells.description_zh: 每一波奥术飞弹有50%几率使你额外获得1层奥术齐射。

spells.description_en: Reduces Arcane Blast's mana cost by 5% and increases its damage by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 奥术冲击的法力值消耗降低5%，伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 获得节能施法[炽热连击]使你的智力提高1%，持续8秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Judgment heals you for 1,185 and its mana cost is reduced by 30%. 50% of overhealing from this effect is transferred onto 2 allies within 40 yds.
spells.description_zh: 审判为你恢复1,185点生命值，消耗的法力值降低30%。该效果产生的过量治疗的50%转移给40码内的2名盟友。

spells.description_en: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn gain up to 30% additional chance to critically strike, based on their target's current health. Lower health targets are more likely to be critically struck.
spells.description_zh: 荣耀圣令和黎明之光根据目标当前的生命值获得最多30%的额外爆击几率。生命值越低的目标越有可能被爆击。

spells.description_en: 12% of Word of Glory and Light of Dawn's healing is converted into Holy damage that strikes a nearby enemy.
spells.description_zh: 荣耀圣令和黎明之光12%的治疗量转化为神圣伤害，打击一名附近的敌人。

spells.description_en: Wildfire Bomb deals 20% increased critical strike damage.
spells.description_zh: 野火炸弹的爆击伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Healing from Healing Stream Totem reduces Fire, Frost, and Nature damage taken by 6% for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的治疗使受到的火焰、冰霜和自然伤害降低6%，持续3秒。

spells.description_en: Spirit Link Totem reduces damage taken by an additional 5%, and it restores 4,357 health to all nearby allies 1 second after it is dropped. Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂链接图腾使受到的伤害额外降低5%，并在放下1秒后为附近所有盟友恢复4,357点生命值。目标超过5个时治疗量降低。

spells.description_en: When you cast Healing Rain, each ally with your Riptide on them is healed for 1,005.
spells.description_zh: 当你施放治疗之雨时，该区域中每个受到你的激流效果影响的盟友都会恢复1,005点生命值。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Ascendance is reduced by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 升腾的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: Your haste is increased by 25% during Ascendance and its duration is increased by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 升腾激活期间，其持续时间延长3秒，并且你的急速提高25%。

spells.description_en:
When refreshing Earth Shield, your target is healed for 1,038 for each stack of Earth Shield they are missing.

Additionally, Earth Shield can consume charges 1.0 sec faster.
spells.description_zh:
刷新大地之盾时，每层缺少的大地之盾为你的目标恢复1,038点生命值。

此外，大地之盾消耗层数的间隔缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Casting Healing Rain grants a use of Downpour for 16 sec.

 Downpour
A burst of water at your Healing Rain's location heals up to 5 injured allies within 12 yards for 1,219.
spells.description_zh:
施放治疗之雨使你能够在16秒内施放倾盆大雨。

 倾盆大雨
在治疗之雨的位置倾注雨水，为12码内最多5名受伤的盟友恢复1,239点生命值。

spells.description_en: Your critical heals have 215% effectiveness instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh: 你的爆击治疗效果并非通常的200%，而是215%。

spells.description_en:
Causes the earth within 8 yards of your target to tremble and break, dealing 1,443 Nature damage over 6 sec and has a 5% chance to knock the enemy down. Multiple uses of Earthquake may overlap.

This spell is cast at your target.
spells.description_zh:
使你的目标周围8码范围内的大地分崩离析，在6秒内造成1,455点自然伤害，并有5%的几率击倒敌人。多次使用地震术可以叠加。

该法术对目标施放。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的闪电箭和闪电链的施法时间缩短15%。

spells.description_en: Imbue your shield with the element of Lightning for 1 hour, giving Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning a chance to call down 2 Thunderstrikes on your target for 271 Nature damage.
spells.description_zh: 为你的盾牌注入闪电元素，持续1小时，使闪电箭和闪电链有几率对目标触发2次雷霆打击，造成271点自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases the cooldown of Frost Shock by 15 sec, but Frost Shock now freezes targets in place for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使冰霜震击的冷却时间延长15秒，但冰霜震击现在会将目标冻结在原地，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Enemies within 10 yds of your Frost Shock are snared by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 你的冰霜震击使周围10码内的敌人的移动速度降低30%。

spells.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and its movement speed effect lasts an additional 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂风图腾的冷却时间缩短30秒，移动速度加成效果额外持续2秒。

spells.description_en: The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 你的武器和盾牌灌魔效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's movement speed bonus is increased by 10% and now removes snares.
spells.description_zh: 狂风图腾的移动速度加成提高10%，现在会移除诱捕效果。

spells.description_en: Consuming Power of the Maelstrom additionally fires an Elemental Blast at your target at 40% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 消耗漩涡之力会额外对目标施放一次元素冲击，产生40%的效果。

spells.description_en: While Lightning Shield is active, your Nature damage dealt is increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 闪电之盾激活时，你造成的自然伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en:
While a Fire Elemental is active, your Fire damage dealt is increased by 6%.

While a Storm Elemental is active, your Nature damage dealt is increased by 6%.
spells.description_zh:
火元素激活时，你造成的火焰伤害提高6%。

风暴元素激活时，你造成的自然伤害提高6%。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of your Elementals by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的元素的持续时间延长20%。

spells.description_en:
The damage bonus of Spotter's Mark is increased by 20%.

Additionally, your Eagle learns how to Fetch.

 Spotter's Mark
Damaging an enemy with abilities empowered by Precise Shots has a 30% chance to apply Spotter's Mark to the primary target, causing your next Aimed Shot to deal 20% increased damage to the target.
spells.description_zh:
瞭望印记的伤害加成提高20%。

此外，你的雄鹰学会了拾回。

 瞭望印记
使用受弹无虚发强化的技能对敌人造成伤害时，有30%的几率对主要目标施加瞭望印记，使你的下一次瞄准射击对该目标造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: You attempt to finish off a wounded target, dealing 121 Shadow damage and 140 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Only usable on enemies above 80% health or below 20% health.
spells.description_zh: 你尝试终结一个受伤的目标，造成121点暗影伤害，并在8秒内造成140点暗影伤害。只能对生命值高于80%或低于20%的敌人使用。

spells.description_en:
Your Kill Shot is replaced with Black Arrow.

 Black Arrow
You attempt to finish off a wounded target, dealing 121 Shadow damage and 140 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Only usable on enemies above 80% health or below 20% health.
spells.description_zh:
你的夺命射击被替换为黑蚀箭。

 黑蚀箭
你尝试终结一个受伤的目标，造成121点暗影伤害，并在8秒内造成140点暗影伤害。只能对生命值高于80%或低于20%的敌人使用。

spells.description_en:
Bestial Wrath causes you to surrender to darkness, granting you Withering Fire for 10 sec and Deathblow.

 Withering Fire
Casting Black Arrow fires a barrage of 2 additional Black Arrows at nearby targets at 30% effectiveness, prioritizing enemies that aren't affected by Black Arrow's damage over time effect.
spells.description_zh:
狂野怒火使你屈服于黑暗，让你获得凋零射击，持续10秒，并获得夺命打击。

 凋零射击
施放黑蚀箭会以30%的效果向附近目标额外施放2支黑蚀箭，优先攻击未受到黑蚀箭持续伤害影响的敌人。

spells.description_en: Life Cocoon grants up to 5 stacks of Mana Tea and applies 2 stacks of Healing Elixir to its target.
spells.description_zh: 作茧缚命会产生5层法力茶，并为目标施加2层金创药。

spells.description_en:
Ancient Teachings transfers an additional 320% damage to healing.

Your Stamina is increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh:
谆谆古训会额外将320%的伤害转化为治疗。

你的耐力提高8%。

spells.description_en: Kick up a powerful gust of wind, dealing 62 Nature damage in a 25 yd cone to enemies in front of you, split evenly among them. Damage is increased by 6% for each target hit, up to 30%.
spells.description_zh: 掀起一股强劲疾风，对你前方25码锥形范围内的敌人造成62点自然伤害，由所有敌人均摊。每命中一个目标，伤害提高6%，最多提高30%。

spells.description_en: Crackling Jade Lightning's damage is increased by 300% and now chains to 4 additional enemies at 25% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 碎玉闪电的伤害提高300%，并以25%的效果连锁攻击4个额外的敌人。

spells.description_en:
All pet damage increased by 6%.

Dire Beast damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
所有宠物造成的伤害提高6%。

凶暴野兽的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: While in combat, Disengage releases a fan of shadow daggers, dealing 0 Shadow damage per second and reducing affected target's movement speed by 30% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在战斗中施放逃脱会扔出一阵暗影匕首，每秒造成0点暗影伤害并使受影响目标的移动速度降低30%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
Your auto shot now deals Shadow damage, allowing it to bypass armor.

Auto shot damage increased by 100%.
spells.description_zh:
你的自动射击现在造成暗影伤害，可以穿透护甲。

自动射击伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en:
You have a chance to get struck by lightning, increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec. The effectiveness is increased to 100% in outdoor areas.

You call down a Thunderstorm when you Reincarnate.
spells.description_zh:
你有几率被闪电击中，使你的移动速度提高50%，持续5秒。在户外区域时效果提高到100%。

当你复生时会召唤一场雷霆风暴。

spells.description_en:
Casting Black Arrow has a 15% chance to grant Deathblow.

 Deathblow
The cooldown of Kill Shot is reset. Your next Kill Shot can be used on any target, regardless of their current health.
spells.description_zh:
施放黑蚀箭有15%几率获得夺命打击。

 夺命打击
重置夺命射击的冷却时间。你的下一个夺命射击可以作用于任意目标并无视其当前生命值。

spells.description_en: Black Arrow and Bleak Powder critical strike damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 黑蚀箭和黯然火药的爆击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Black Arrow now explodes in a cloud of shadow and sulfur on impact, dealing 87 Shadow damage to all enemies within an 8 yd cone behind the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 黑蚀箭现在会在命中时产生爆炸，生成阴影和硫磺之云，对目标身后8码锥形范围内的所有敌人造成87点暗影伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Stormkeeper by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 风暴守护者的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Lightning Rod by 4 sec and its damage bonus by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 引雷针的持续时间延长4秒，伤害加成提高25%。

spells.description_en: Increases Earth Shock and Earthquake damage by 8% and the stat bonuses granted by Elemental Blast by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 大地震击和地震术的伤害提高8%，元素冲击提供的属性加成提高25%。

spells.description_en: Your auto shot has a 15% chance to also fire a Cobra Shot at your target.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动射击有15%几率对目标额外施放一次眼镜蛇射击。

spells.description_en:
Cobra Shot critical damage dealt increased by 20%.

When Cobra Shot critically strikes, it refunds 10 Focus.
spells.description_zh:
眼镜蛇射击的爆击伤害提高20%。

当眼镜蛇射击爆击时，回复10点集中值。

spells.description_en: Celestial Alignment's cooldown is reduced by 60 seconds and it has two charges.
spells.description_zh: 超凡之盟的冷却时间减少60秒，并拥有两次充能。

spells.description_en:
Sunfire damage has a chance to grow a magical mushroom at a target's location. After 1 sec, the mushroom detonates, dealing 1,010 Nature damage and then an additional 570 Nature damage over 10 sec. Affected targets are slowed by 50%.

Generates up to 20 Astral Power based on targets hit.
spells.description_zh:
阳炎术伤害有几率在目标位置处生长出魔法蘑菇。1秒后，蘑菇会被引爆，造成1,010点自然伤害，并在10秒内额外造成570点自然伤害。受影响的目标被减速50%。

根据命中的目标数量产生最多20点星界能量。

spells.description_en: Casting a free Starsurge or Starfall grants Solstice for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放无消耗的星涌术或星辰坠落会使你获得至日，持续3秒。

spells.description_en:
You automatically cast Blessing of Sacrifice onto an ally within 40 yds when they are below 35% health and you are not in a loss of control effect.

This effect activates 100% of Blessing of Sacrifice's cooldown.
spells.description_zh:
当40码范围内的盟友生命值低于35%且你未处于失控状态时，你会自动对其施放牺牲祝福。

此效果会激活牺牲祝福100%的冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Divine Steed also grants Blessing of Freedom for 3.0 sec.

 Blessing of Freedom:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
神圣马驹还会使你获得自由祝福，持续3.0秒。

 自由祝福:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫任何移动限制效果，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Melee and ranged attackers receive 133 Holy damage each time they strike you during Divine Protection and Divine Shield.
spells.description_zh: 在圣佑术和圣盾术持续期间，近战和远程攻击者每次攻击你时会受到133点神圣伤害。

spells.description_en:
Casting Sundering summons 1 Fire Feral Spirit and Doom Winds summons 1 Nature Feral Spirit by your side for 8 sec.

Feral Spirit
An Elemental Spirit Wolf infused with Fire or Nature magic, granting the summoner with 5% increased Fire or Nature damage and 5% Physical damage for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
施放裂地术会召唤1只火焰野性狼魂，毁灭之风会召唤1只自然野性狼魂在你身边，持续8秒。

野性狼魂
一只注入火焰或自然魔法的元素之灵狼，使召唤者的火焰或自然伤害提高5%，物理伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: The duration of stun effects on you is reduced by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你受到的昏迷效果的持续时间缩短20%。

spells.description_en: Turn Evil now affects 5 additional enemies.
spells.description_zh: 超度邪恶现在会额外影响5个敌人。

spells.description_en: Blessing of Sacrifice now removes and prevents all Poison and Disease effects.
spells.description_zh: 牺牲祝福现在会移除并防止所有中毒和疾病效果。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Blinding Light is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 盲目之光的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Holy Power spending abilities have 2% increased damage and healing.
spells.description_zh: 消耗神圣能量的技能会使你造成的伤害和治疗效果提高2%。

spells.description_en: Divine Steed's cooldown is reduced by 20%, but its duration is reduced by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣马驹的冷却时间降低20%，但持续时间减少40%。

spells.description_en: After Cleanse successfully removes an effect from an ally, they are healed for 2,052.
spells.description_zh: 清洁术成功移除盟友身上的效果后，会为其恢复2,052点生命值。

spells.description_en: 10% of all healing done to you from other sources heals up to 4 nearby allies, divided evenly among them.
spells.description_zh: 你从其他来源受到的全部治疗的10%会治疗最多4个附近的盟友，治疗量在他们之间均摊。

spells.description_en: Flash of Light and Holy Light are 30% more effective on your allies and 40% of the healing done also heals you.
spells.description_zh: 圣光闪现和圣光术对你的盟友的效果提高30%，并有40%的治疗量也会治疗你。

spells.description_en: Divine Protection increases healing taken by 15% for its duration.
spells.description_zh: 圣佑术在持续期间内使你受到的治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your Forbearance's duration is reduced by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的自律持续时间减少10秒。

spells.description_en: The radius of your auras is increased by 20 yds.
spells.description_zh: 你的光环作用范围提高20码。

spells.description_en:
Kill Command has a 20% chance and Barbed Shot has a 50% chance to grant Deathblow.

 Deathblow
The cooldown of Kill Shot is reset. Your next Kill Shot can be used on any target, regardless of their current health.
spells.description_zh:
杀戮命令有20%的几率，倒刺射击有50%的几率触发夺命打击。

夺命打击
夺命射击的冷却时间被重置。你的下一个夺命射击可以作用于任意目标并无视其当前生命值。

spells.description_en:
Find Weakness increases the damage of finishing moves by 5%.

Shadow Dance increases the damage of finishing moves by 5%.

Shadow Blades increases the damage of finishing moves by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
洞悉弱点使终结技伤害提高5%。

暗影之舞使终结技伤害提高5%。

暗影之刃使终结技伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
When you or an ally wielding a Holy Bulwark are healed above maximum health, transfer 100% of the overhealing to your ally.

When you or an ally wielding a Sacred Weapon drop below 40% health, redistribute your health immediately and every 1 sec for 4 sec. May only occur once per cast.
spells.description_zh:
当你或持有神圣壁垒的盟友受到超过最大生命值的治疗时，将100%的过量治疗转移给你的盟友。

当你或持有圣洁武器的盟友生命值低于40%时，立即重新分配你们的生命值，每1秒重复一次，持续4秒。每次施放只能触发一次效果。

spells.description_en: Allies affected by your Blessings have 15% increased movement speed.
spells.description_zh: 受你祝福影响的盟友移动速度提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Divine Steed reduces the cooldown of 4 nearby ally's major movement ability by 3.0 sec.

Your movement speed is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh:
神圣马驹会使4个附近盟友的主要移动技能冷却时间减少3.0秒。

你的移动速度提高3%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Reaper's Mark by 15 sec, but the amount of Obliterates and Frostscythes empowered by Exterminate is reduced by 1.
spells.description_zh: 死神印记的冷却时间减少15秒，但破灭强化的湮灭和冰霜之镰数量减少1次。

spells.description_en: Casting Cobra Shot reduces the cooldown of Barbed Shot by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 眼镜蛇射击会使倒刺射击的冷却时间缩短2秒。

spells.description_en: Enemies struck by Avenger's Shield burn with holy fire, suffering 100% additional Radiant damage over 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 被复仇者之盾击中的敌人会被神圣之火灼烧，在5秒内额外受到100%的光辉伤害。

spells.description_en: Successfully dispelling a harmful effect reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1.0 sec. Effect increased by 100% while wielding a Holy Armament.
spells.description_zh: 成功驱散有害效果会使清洁术的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。装备神圣军备时效果提高100%。

spells.description_en:
Arcane Blast and Arcane Pulse damage increased by 15%.

Casting Touch of the Magi conjures 4 Arcane Splinters.
spells.description_zh:
奥术冲击和奥术脉冲的伤害提高15%。

施放大法师之触会召唤4个奥术裂片。

spells.description_en:
Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing 1,528 Nature damage. Always critically strikes.

Generates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.
spells.description_zh:
立即用炽焰雷霆震击目标及10码内的5个敌人，施加烈焰震击并造成1,530点自然伤害，且必定爆击。

产生1层漩涡武器。

spells.description_en: Healing Wave and Chain Heal increase the initial healing of your next Riptide by 30%, stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 治疗波和治疗链会使下一个激流的初始治疗效果提高30%，最多叠加2次。

spells.description_en:
Kingsbane supercharges 1 combo point.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
spells.description_zh:
君王之灾会使1个连击点数被超荷充能。

当伤害性终结技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，你可以造成相当于额外消耗2个连击点数的效果。

spells.description_en: Swiftmend healing increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 迅捷治愈的治疗效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: Swiftmend cooldown is reduced by 15%, increasing up to 30% on lower health targets.
spells.description_zh: 迅捷治愈的冷却时间缩短15%，目标生命值较低时，最多缩短30%。

spells.description_en: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.
spells.description_zh: 伤害性终极技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，其加成额外提高1。

spells.description_en: After consuming a supercharged combo point, your next Mutilate also strikes the target with an Echoing Reprimand dealing 41 Physical damage.
spells.description_zh: 消耗一个超荷充能的连击点数之后，你的下一个毁伤还会用申斥回响打击目标，造成42点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Trueshot sends your Spotting Eagle into a frenzy, instantly applying Spotter's Mark to your target. 

During Trueshot, your chance to apply Spotter's Mark is increased by 100%.
spells.description_zh:
百发百中使你的瞭望的雄鹰进入狂乱状态，立即为你的目标施加瞭望印记。

在百发百中期间，你施加瞭望印记的几率提高100%。

spells.description_en: Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire now hit 1 additional target for 35% of their damage.
spells.description_zh: 瞄准射击和急速射击现在会额外命中1个目标，造成其正常伤害的35%。

spells.description_en:
Collecting 50 Soul Fragments grants access to Void Metamorphosis.

 Void Metamorphosis
Requires 50 Soul Fragments

You ascend to a higher state of being, substantially empowering your abilities.

While in Void Metamorphosis, your Consume and Reap are enhanced and your Fury will slowly drain. Additionally, Void Ray reduces your Fury drain, deals increased damage, and no longer consumes Fury.
spells.description_zh:
收集50个灵魂残片即可使用虚空变形。

 虚空变形
需要50个灵魂残片

你飞升至更高的境界，大幅强化你的技能。

在虚空变形期间，你的吞噬和收割会得到强化，你的恶魔之怒会缓慢流失。此外，虚空射线会降低你的恶魔之怒流失速度，造成更高的伤害，并且不再消耗恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Your Haste is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: The damage of your auto shot is increased by 25% and its critical strike chance is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动射击伤害提高25%，其爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Damage from Kill Shot increases the damage your target receives from Kill Shot by 3%, stacking up to 10 times.
spells.description_zh: 夺命射击的伤害会使目标受到的夺命射击伤害提高3%，该效果最多可叠加10层。

spells.description_en: Trueshot now also reduces the cast time of Aimed Shot by 40% and reduces the Focus cost of Aimed Shot by 60%.
spells.description_zh: 百发百中现在还会使瞄准射击的施法时间缩短40%，并使其集中值消耗降低60%。

spells.description_en: Explosive Shot lasts 1.0 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 爆炸射击的持续时间延长1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Bulletstorm now affects 1 additional Aimed Shot.
spells.description_zh: 子弹风暴现在会影响1发额外的瞄准射击。

spells.description_en: Gain magical damage reduction equal to 10% of your damage reduction from armor.
spells.description_zh: 获得魔法伤害减免，相当于你护甲提供的伤害减免的10%。

spells.description_en:
Holy Word: Serenity applies 12 sec of Renew to its target.

Holy Word: Sanctify applies 6 sec of Renew to allies it heals.

 Renew
Fill the target with faith in the light, healing for 1,223 over 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
圣言术：静对目标施加12秒的恢复。

圣言术：灵为治疗的盟友施加6秒的恢复。

恢复
令目标满怀对圣光的信仰，在12秒内为其恢复1,223点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Increases the healing done by Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify by 30%.

Increases the radius of Holy Word: Sanctify by 30%.
spells.description_zh:
圣言术：静和圣言术：灵的治疗效果提高30%。

圣言术：灵的作用范围提高30%。

spells.description_en: Sheilun's Gift's healing is increased by 20% and its cast time is reduced by 100%, but it now only heals a single ally.
spells.description_zh: 神龙之赐的治疗效果提高20%，施法时间缩短100%，但现在仅能治疗一个盟友。

spells.description_en:
While in combat, every 30 sec your next Kill Command summons the aid of a Beast.

 Wyvern
A Wyvern descends from the skies, letting out a battle cry that increases the damage of you and your pets by 10% for 12 sec.

 Boar
A Boar charges through your target 1 time, dealing 504 damage to nearby enemies and an additional 420 physical damage to its primary target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

 Bear
A Bear leaps into the fray, rending the flesh of your enemies, dealing 156 damage over 10 sec to up to 8 nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
在战斗中每过30秒，你的下一次杀戮命令将召唤一只野兽的援助。

双足飞龙
一头双足飞龙从天而降，发出战吼，使你和你的宠物的伤害提高10%，持续12秒。

野猪
一只野猪发起冲锋，穿过你的目标1次，对附近敌人造成504点伤害，并对其主要目标额外造成420点物理伤害。目标超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

巨熊
一只巨熊跃入战斗，撕裂敌人的血肉，在10秒内对最多8个附近的敌人造成156点伤害。

spells.description_en:
Kill Command reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.0 sec.

Cobra Shot reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
杀戮命令会使猎群领袖之嚎的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

眼镜蛇射击会使猎群领袖之嚎的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Damage dealt by your pets is increased by 2%.

Barbed Shot damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
你的宠物造成的伤害提高2%。

倒刺射击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Howl of the Pack Leader increases the damage of your Kill Command by 50%.

Summoning a Beast reduces the cooldown of Barbed Shot by 4.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
猎群领袖之嚎使你的杀戮命令伤害提高50%。

召唤野兽会使倒刺射击的冷却时间缩短4.0秒。

spells.description_en: Smite extends the duration of an active Atonement by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 惩击使一个激活的救赎的持续时间延长2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Immediately Power Word: Radiance your target at 150% effectiveness, and causes your next 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance to be instant cast with 40% reduced mana cost.
spells.description_zh: 立即以150%的效果对你的目标施放真言术：耀，并使你的下2次真言术：耀变为瞬发，且法力消耗降低40%。

spells.description_en: When your Bear is summoned, it is joined by 2 Dire Beasts.
spells.description_zh: 在你召唤熊时，会有2头凶暴野兽加入。

spells.description_en: The damage of your Bear's Rend Flesh is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 你的熊的撕裂肉体伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Your pet's attacks increase your Wyvern's damage bonus by 1%, up to 10%.

Casting Kill Command extends the duration of your Wyvern by 0.5 sec, up to 5 additional sec.
spells.description_zh:
宠物的攻击使你的双足飞龙伤害加成提高1%，最多提高10%。

施放杀戮命令使你的双足飞龙的持续时间延长0.5秒，最多延长5秒。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain Spreads to a nearby enemy when you cast Penance on the target.
spells.description_zh: 当你对目标施放苦修时，暗言术：痛会扩散到一个附近的敌人身上。

spells.description_en:
When your Boar deals damage, the damage of your next Cobra Shot is increased by 100%.

Each additional enemy damaged by your Boar causes Cobra Shot to strike 1 additional target, up to 4.
spells.description_zh:
当你的野猪造成伤害时，你下一个眼镜蛇射击的伤害提高100%。

野猪每额外伤害一个敌人，就会使眼镜蛇射击额外攻击1个目标，最多4个目标。

spells.description_en: Your Bleed effects deal 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的流血效果造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Survival of the Fittest now summons a Turtle to aid you, further increasing its damage reduction effect by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 优胜劣汰现在会召唤一只乌龟来援助你，使其伤害减免效果额外提高10%。

spells.description_en: When Disengage removes a movement impairing effect, its cooldown is reduced by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 逃脱移除移动限制效果时，其冷却时间缩短4秒。

spells.description_en: When an enemy is stunned by Binding Shot, it is dragged to Binding Shot's center.
spells.description_zh: 当束缚射击昏迷一名敌人时，会将其拉向束缚射击的中心。

spells.description_en: Casting Bestial Wrath grants Howl of the Pack Leader and causes your next Kill Command to rouse the nearby wildlife into a Stampede, charging your target and dealing 468 Physical damage over 7 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放狂野怒火会获得猎群领袖之嚎，并使你的下一个杀戮命令唤醒附近的野兽进行奔踏，向你的目标冲锋并在7秒内造成475点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Aimed Shot deals 5% increased damage.

Rapid Fire deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
瞄准射击造成的伤害提高5%。

急速射击造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Casting Trueshot or Volley grants Double Tap, causing your next Aimed Shot to fire again at 80% power, or your next Rapid Fire to fire 80% additional shots during its channel.
spells.description_zh: 施放百发百中或乱射时会获得二连发，使下一发瞄准射击以80%的威力额外发射一次，或使下一次急速射击在引导期间额外发射80%的箭弹。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Volley is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 乱射的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Consuming Spotter's Mark reduces the cooldown of Aimed Shot by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗瞭望印记会使瞄准射击的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Rapid Fire grants Precise Shots.
spells.description_zh: 急速射击现在获得弹无虚发效果。

spells.description_en: Explosive Shot can now be used a second time if cast within 3.0 sec. Explosive Shot will incorporate any remaining damage from previous Explosive Shots on your target.
spells.description_zh: 爆炸射击现在可以在施放后的3.0秒内再次使用。爆炸射击会纳入目标身上此前爆炸射击尚未造成的剩余伤害。

spells.description_en:
Rapid Fire damage increased by 10%.

Rapid Fire has a 30% chance to grant the Lock and Load effect.
spells.description_zh:
急速射击的伤害提高10%。

急速射击有30%的几率触发荷枪实弹效果。

spells.description_en:
Requires 100 Fury
Unleash a beam of concentrated void energy, dealing 77 Cosmic damage and consuming 5 Fury every 0.1 sec.

Effect ends after 2.7 sec or upon reaching 0 Fury.
spells.description_zh:
需要100点恶魔之怒
释放一道集中的虚空能量光束，每0.1秒造成76点宇宙伤害并消耗5点恶魔之怒。

在2.7秒后或恶魔之怒达到0点时，效果结束。

spells.description_en:
Your Spotting Eagle descends from the skies, stunning your target for 5 sec.

This ability does not require line of sight when used against players.
spells.description_zh:
你的瞭望的雄鹰从天而降，使目标昏迷5秒。

对玩家使用时，此技能无需视线即可施放。

spells.description_en:
Your Spotting Eagle gains the Cunning specialization, granting you Master's Call and Pathfinding.

 Master's Call
Your pet removes all root and movement impairing effects from itself and a friendly target, and grants immunity to all such effects for 4 sec.

 Pathfinding
Your movement speed is increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh:
使你的瞭望的雄鹰获得狡诈专精，使你获得主人的召唤和寻路。

 主人的召唤
你的宠物移除自己和一个友方目标身上的所有定身及移动限制效果，并在4秒内免疫所有此类效果。

 寻路
移动速度提高8%。

spells.description_en:
Your Spotting Eagle gains the Tenacity specialization, granting you Endurance Training and Air Superiority.

 Endurance Training
You gain 5% increased maximum health.

 Air Superiority
Your Spotting Eagle alerts you to oncoming danger, reducing all damage you take by 3%
spells.description_zh:
使你的瞭望的雄鹰获得坚韧专精，使你获得耐力训练和制空霸权。

 耐力训练
最大生命值提高5%。

 制空霸权
你的瞭望的雄鹰会警示你即将到来的危险，使你受到的所有伤害降低3%。

spells.description_en: Rake, Rip, and Thrash damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 斜掠、割裂和痛击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Physical damage dealt by your abilities increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 技能造成的物理伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Magical damage dealt by your spells increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 法术造成的魔法伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
When a hit deals more than 12% of your maximum health, instantly heal for 10% of your health.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 30 seconds.
spells.description_zh:
当受到超过最大生命值12%的伤害时，立即恢复10%的生命值。

此效果每30秒只能触发一次。

spells.description_en: Trueshot now increases your critical strike chance by an additional 10% and increases your critical strike damage by an additional 20%.
spells.description_zh: 百发百中现在会使你的爆击几率额外提高10%，并使你的爆击伤害额外提高20%。

spells.description_en: Your pet damage is increased by 35% and your pet is 10% larger.
spells.description_zh: 你的宠物伤害提高35%，体型增大10%。

spells.description_en: Form a bond with an ally. Your self-healing also heals your bonded ally for 10% of the amount healed. Your healing to your bonded ally also heals you for 8% of the amount healed.
spells.description_zh: 与一位盟友建立共生。你的自我治疗法术同样为其恢复生命值，恢复量相当于该次治疗量10%。你对其的治疗法术也会为你恢复生命值，恢复量相当于该次治疗量8%。

spells.description_en: Well-Honed Instincts can trigger up to once every 90 sec.
spells.description_zh: 精确本能最多每90秒可触发一次。

spells.description_en:
Periodic damage from Immolate has a 4% chance to fire a Demonfire bolt at 100% increased effectiveness.

Incinerate has a 25% chance to fire a Demonfire bolt at 100% increased effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
献祭的持续伤害有4%几率发射一道恶魔之火箭矢，效果提高100%。

烧尽有25%几率发射一道恶魔之火箭矢，效果提高100%。

spells.description_en:
Calls down a rain of hellfire upon your target, dealing 1,814 Fire damage over 7.1 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at your target.
spells.description_zh:
地狱之火如雨般落在目标位置，在7.1秒内对范围内的敌人造成1,814点火焰伤害。

此法术会对你的目标施放。

spells.description_en:
Your healing is increased by 10% while Apotheosis is active.

Casting Apotheosis causes your next 3 Prayer of Healing casts to be instant and heal for 25% more.
spells.description_zh:
神圣化身期间，你的治疗效果提高10%。

施放神圣化身会使你接下来的3次治疗祷言变成瞬发，并使治疗效果提高25%。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Apotheosis by 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 神圣化身的持续时间延长12秒。

spells.description_en: 5% of healing done with Flash Heal is replicated to 4 injured allies within 40 yards.
spells.description_zh: 快速治疗造成的5%治疗效果会复制到40码内的4个受伤的盟友身上。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Words by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的圣言术的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en:
Consume damage increased by 15%.

Consume generates a Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh:
吞噬的伤害提高15%。

吞噬会产生一个灵魂残片。

spells.name_zh: 暗影牧师11.1职业套装4件套
spells.description_en: Hitting a Jackpot! grants you 5.0 seconds of Power Infusion. Mind Blast and Void Bolt deal 10% increased damage while Power Infusion is active.
spells.description_zh: 赢得头奖！时获得5.0秒的能量灌注。能量灌注期间，心灵震爆和虚空箭的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Shattering enemies inside your Blizzard increases Shatter's area damage by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 粉碎暴风雪范围内的敌人会使粉碎的范围伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Envelop yourself in razor-sharp winds, then lunge forward dealing 156 Nature damage to enemies in your path. Damage reduced beyond 5 enemies.

Hold to increase lunge distance.
spells.description_zh:
将自己包裹在势如刀锋的劲风中，随后猛冲向前，对路径中的敌人造成156点自然伤害。敌人超过5个时伤害降低。

长按可延长冲刺距离。

spells.description_en: When summoned, Dire Beasts gain Beast Cleave at 100% effectiveness for 8.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤时，凶暴野兽获得100%的野兽顺劈效果，持续8.0秒。

spells.description_en: Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.
spells.description_zh: 大地之盾不再消耗充能，且拥有 115%的效能。

spells.description_en: Efflorescence healing increased by 25%, and it now automatically grows beneath your Lifebloom target's feet.
spells.description_zh: 百花齐放的治疗效果提高25%，并且现在会自动在生命绽放的目标脚下生成。

spells.description_en:
Sundering transforms into a single use Primordial Storm for 15 sec after it is cast.

Primordial Storm
Devastate nearby enemies with a Primordial Storm dealing 41 Flamestrike, 41 Froststrike, 42 Stormstrike damage, and unleashing a Lightning Bolt or a Chain Lightning at 150% effectiveness. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Consumes Maelstrom Weapon for increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
施放裂地术后，它会转变为一次性的始源风暴，持续15秒。

始源风暴
用始源风暴摧毁附近的敌人，造成42点烈焰打击伤害、42点冰霜打击伤害、42点风暴打击伤害，并以150%的效果释放一次闪电箭或闪电链。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

消耗漩涡武器以提高伤害。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath deals its damage 15% more often.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成伤害的频率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Disintegrate deals damage 25% more often, but deals 10% less damage.
spells.description_zh: 裂解额外造成伤害的速度加快25%，但造成的伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Blade Dance automatically triggers Throw Glaive on your primary target for 100% damage and each slash has a 50% chance to Throw Glaive an enemy for 35% damage.
spells.description_zh: 刃舞对你的主要目标自动触发投掷利刃，造成100%的伤害，每次斩击有50%的几率对一名敌人施放投掷利刃，造成35%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
While in Void Metamorphosis, every 30 Soul Fragments harvested grants access to Collapsing Star.

 Collapsing Star
Channel an immense amount of void energy into a single, cataclysmic blast, dealing 2,379 Cosmic damage to your target and 1,832 Cosmic damage to all nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While casting Collapsing Star, your Fury drain is significantly reduced.
spells.description_zh:
在虚空变形期间，每收集30个灵魂残片即可使用坍缩之星。

坍缩之星
引导磅礴的虚空能量，汇聚成一次猛烈的冲击，对你的目标造成2,418点宇宙伤害，并对所有附近敌人造成1,831点宇宙伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

施放坍缩之星时，你的恶魔之怒流失速度会大幅降低。

spells.description_en: The cast range of Voidblade, Consume Magic, and Disrupt are increased by 20 yds.
spells.description_zh: 虚空之刃、吞噬魔法和瓦解的施法距离提高20码。

spells.description_en:
Regain access to Call Pet.

While outdoors, your pet deals 15% increased damage and takes 15% reduced damage.
spells.description_zh:
重新获得召唤宠物。

在户外时，你的宠物造成的伤害提高15%，受到的伤害降低15%。

spells.description_en: Upon reaching maximum stacks of Arcane Salvo, your next Arcane Barrage deals 25% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 奥术齐射达到最大层数时，你的下一个奥术弹幕造成的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Damage from Void Ray has a 200% increased chance to generate a Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh: 虚空射线造成伤害时产生灵魂残片的几率提高200%。

spells.description_en:
Fully channeling Void Ray upgrades your Reap to Eradicate.

 Eradicate
Slam your Scythe to the ground, dealing 2,116 Cosmic damage to your primary target and 1,904 to all other enemies within a 25 yd cone in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Eradicate gathers up to 4 nearby souls.
spells.description_zh:
完整引导虚空射线后，你的收割升级为根除。

根除
用你的镰刀猛击地面，对主要目标造成2,116点宇宙伤害，并对你前方25码锥形范围内的所有其他敌人造成1,904点伤害。目标数量超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

根除最多可以收集4个附近的灵魂。

spells.description_en: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth summons a Treant that casts Nourish on that target or a nearby ally periodically, healing for 235. Lasts 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放迅捷治愈或野性成长会召唤一个树人，周期性对目标或附近盟友施放滋养，治疗236点生命值，持续8秒。

spells.description_en:
Summons a massive shadowy appendage to slam the ground, dealing 258 Shadow damage in front of you and 8 yds around your target.

Applies Vampiric Touch to up to 6 enemies, prioritizing ones without Vampiric Touch.

Generates 6 Insanity.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个巨大的暗影触须猛击地面，对你前方和目标周围8码内的敌人造成259点暗影伤害。

对最多6名敌人施加吸血鬼之触，优先选择未受吸血鬼之触影响的目标。

产生6点狂乱值。

spells.description_en: Each Collapsing Star you cast increases the damage of your next Collapsing Star by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你每施放一次坍缩之星，你的下一次坍缩之星的伤害就提高20%。

spells.description_en: Summoned minions last 20% longer and deal an additional 15% damage.
spells.description_zh: 召唤的爪牙持续时间额外延长20%，造成的伤害额外提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Obliterate and Frostscythe consume all Killing Machines to deal 25% increased critical strike damage and grant 1.5% Haste for 8 sec for each stack consumed.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
湮灭和冰霜之镰会消耗所有杀戮机器，每层使造成的爆击伤害提高25%，并且使你的急速提高1.5%，持续8秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Rime empowered Howling Blast unleashes 2 icy blades at its target that deal 8 Frost damage and have 15% chance to grant Killing Machine.
spells.description_zh: 白霜强化的凛风冲击会对目标释放2把冰刃，造成8点冰霜伤害，并有15%的几率使你获得杀戮机器。

spells.description_en:
Frost Strike and Glacial Advance now cause your next Frost Strike and Glacial Advance to deal 15% increased damage and cost 5 more Runic Power. 

This effect stacks until the next Runic Empowerment.
spells.description_zh:
冰霜打击和冰川突进现在使你的下一个冰霜打击和冰川突进造成的伤害提高15%，消耗的符文能量提高5点。

此效果可叠加，直到下一次符文强化。

spells.description_en:
Howling Blast now hits an additional target with maximum effectiveness. 

Rime increases Howling Blast damage done by an additional 75%.
spells.description_zh:
凛风冲击现在额外以最大效能击中一个目标。

白霜使凛风冲击的伤害额外提高75%。

spells.description_en:
Obliterate deals 10% increased damage and has a chance to tether the souls of its target and a nearby enemy to yours.

Frost Strike severs the tethers, dealing 72 Shadowfrost damage to both foes.
spells.description_zh:
湮灭造成的伤害提高10%，并有几率将目标及附近一名敌人的灵魂与你的灵魂捆在一起。

冰霜打击会斩断束缚，对这两个敌人造成72点暗影冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en:
Casting Voidform summons a Mindbender for 10 sec.

 Mindbender
Summons a shadowy fiend to attack your target.

Generates 1 Insanity each time the Mindbender attacks.
spells.description_zh:
施放虚空形态会召唤一个摧心魔，持续10秒。

 摧心魔
召唤一个暗影魔攻击你的目标。

摧心魔每次攻击产生1点狂乱值。

spells.description_en:
Shadow Word: Madness increases your haste during Voidform by 2% and increases its duration by 1.5 sec, stacking up to 5 times. 

When Voidform ends, the haste lingers and decays over 10 sec.
spells.description_zh:
暗言术：癫使你在虚空形态下的急速提高2%，持续时间延长1.5秒，最多可叠加5层。

虚空形态结束时，急速效果会逐渐消退，在10秒内衰减。

spells.description_en:
Beacon of Faith:
Allies with Beacon of Light or Beacon of Faith are healed for 125 every 3 sec.

 Beacon of Virtue:
Beacon of Virtue instantly heals allies for 2,226.
spells.description_zh:
信仰道标：
具有圣光道标或信仰道标的盟友每3秒恢复125点生命值。

美德道标：
美德道标立即为盟友恢复2,226点生命值。

spells.description_en:
Dire Beasts will now obey your Kill Command, dealing its damage at 30% effectiveness.

Bestial Wrath now sends your Dire Beasts into a rage, increasing their damage dealt by 10% for 15 sec. Dire Beasts summoned during a Bestial Wrath will benefit at a reduced duration.
spells.description_zh:
凶暴野兽现在会服从你的杀戮命令，以30%的效果造成伤害。

狂野怒火现在使你的凶暴野兽陷入狂怒，使其造成的伤害提高10%，持续15秒。在狂野怒火期间召唤的凶暴野兽也可以受到增益影响，但影响时间会缩短。

spells.description_en:
You gain a bonus while in each form inspired by the breadth of your Druidic knowledge:

No Form: 4% Magic Damage
Cat Form: 4% Stamina
Bear Form: 5% Movement Speed
Moonkin Form: 3% Area damage taken reduction
spells.description_zh:
在德鲁伊博大精深的学识启发下，你在每一种形态下都能获得一项额外加成：

无形态：4%魔法伤害
猎豹形态：4%耐力
熊形态：5%移动速度
枭兽形态：3%范围伤害减免

spells.description_en: The damage bonus of Precise Shots is increased by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 弹无虚发的伤害加成额外提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.

Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
腐蚀你的食尸鬼，将其进化为畸兽，极大地强化其技能，持续15秒。

凋零缠绕和扩散会使此效果的持续时间延长1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Unleash an eruption of void energy, dealing 103 Cosmic damage and stunning your target and all nearby enemies for 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 释放一次虚空能量喷发，对你的目标和附近所有敌人造成102点宇宙伤害并使其昏迷2秒。

spells.description_en: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.
spells.description_zh: 枯萎凋零造成伤害的速度提高100%。

spells.description_en: Armor increased by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 护甲值提高6%。

spells.description_en: Damage you take from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%. Spell Reflection reduces magic damage taken by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你受到的范围攻击伤害降低2%。法术反射使受到的魔法伤害额外降低10%。

spells.description_en: You have a 8% chance to disrupt magic damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 你有8%的几率瓦解对你造成的魔法伤害，使其造成的伤害降低50%。

spells.description_en: Defensive Stance reduces damage taken by an additional 6%.
spells.description_zh: 防御姿态会使你受到的伤害额外降低6%。

spells.description_en: Execute hits up to 2 additional targets for 70% damage.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀可以击中最多2个额外目标，造成70%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Your attacks have a chance to target a nearby enemy with Ravager for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的攻击有几率对附近的一名敌人使用破坏者，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast deals 150% increased damage, but costs 40% more mana.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆造成的伤害提高150%，但法力消耗提高40%。

spells.description_en:
Bleak Powder now applies Black Arrow's periodic effect to all enemies it damages.

If Bleak Powder damages 2 or more enemies, gain Beast Cleave if talented.
spells.description_zh:
黯然火药现在会将黑蚀箭的周期性伤害施加到所有受到其伤害的敌人身上。

黯然火药对2个或以上的敌人造成伤害时，如习得野兽顺劈则获得其效果。

spells.description_en: Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂残片使你造成的伤害提高1%，持续6秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Bronze healing and absorption increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 青铜龙治疗和吸收效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: After fully channeling Void Ray, the cooldown of Reap is reset and your next Reap will collect up to 6 additional Soul Fragments.
spells.description_zh: 完整引导虚空射线后，重置收割的冷却时间，且你的下一次收割最多可额外收集6个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en: Consuming Rime reduces the cooldown of Empower Rune Weapon by 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 消耗白霜会使符文武器增效的冷却时间缩短6秒。

spells.description_en: Each Soul Fragment gathered by Reap increases its damage by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 收割收集的每个灵魂残片都会使其伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en: Critical strike damage of your minions is increased by 15%
spells.description_zh: 你的仆从的爆击伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
After dealing damage with The Hunt or Voidblade, Voidblade is replaced with Hungering Slash for 6 sec.

 Hungering Slash
Violently slash your scythe around you, dealing 940 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies and generating 10 Fury. Shatters up to 2 Soul Fragments from nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hungering Slash grants a temporary charge of Vengeful Retreat and causes your next Vengeful Retreat within 6 sec to deal an additional 570 Cosmic damage.
spells.description_zh:
使用恶魔追击或虚空之刃造成伤害后，虚空之刃会被饥渴斩击取代，持续6秒。

 饥渴斩击
在你周围猛烈挥舞镰刀，对附近的敌人造成940点宇宙伤害并产生10点恶魔之怒。从附近的敌人身上击碎最多2个灵魂残片。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

饥渴斩击会使你暂时获得一层复仇回避充能，并使你在6秒内施放的下一次复仇回避额外造成570点宇宙伤害。

spells.description_en: Reap gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 收割获得一层额外充能。

spells.description_en: Your empower spells are 10% more effective. While charging a healing empower spell, you cannot be knocked back.
spells.description_zh: 你的蓄力法术效果提高10%。引导治疗蓄力法术时，你无法被击退。

spells.description_en:
You may draw the sun and moon into alignment for 15 sec, empowering either your Nature or Arcane spells. Casting Wrath or Starfire changes what mode of Eclipse will be entered, and the two modes of Eclipse share a button and 32 sec cooldown.

 Eclipse (Solar)
Nature spells deal 15% additional damage and Wrath damage is increased by 40%.

 Eclipse (Lunar)
Arcane spells deal 15% additional damage and Starfire damage is increased by 40%.
spells.description_zh:
使你能够驾驭日月之力，持续15秒，强化你的自然或奥术法术。施放愤怒或星火术将决定进入哪一种日月之蚀，两种状态共享按钮与32秒冷却时间。

日蚀
自然法术额外造成15%伤害，愤怒的伤害提高40%。

月蚀
奥术法术额外造成15%伤害，且星火术的伤害提高40%。

spells.description_en: Moonfire, Sunfire, and Shooting Stars damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 月火术、阳炎术和坠星的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: The cooldowns of Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse are reduced by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 月蚀和日蚀的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Increases Mastery by 3% and reduces the cast time of your Summon Demonic Tyrant and Summon Felguard by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高3%，召唤恶魔暴君和恶魔卫士的施法时间缩短0.5秒。

spells.description_en: Damage from Voidblade and the Hunt increases the damage your target takes from you by 12% for 10 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 虚空之刃和恶魔追击的伤害会使你对目标造成的伤害提高12%，持续10秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: After fully channeling Void Ray, gain 10 Fury.
spells.description_zh: 完整引导虚空射线后，获得10点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Void Ray deals 80% more damage when damaging 3 targets.
spells.description_zh: 虚空射线对3个目标造成伤害时，造成的伤害提高80%。

spells.description_en: Collapsing Star now generates 3 Soul Fragments.
spells.description_zh: 坍缩之星现在会产生3个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en: Entering any Eclipse has a 15% chance to grant the benefits of both Lunar and Solar Eclipse.
spells.description_zh: 进入任何日月之蚀有15%的几率使你同时获得月蚀和日蚀的增益效果。

spells.description_en: Starfall deals its damage 100% faster.
spells.description_zh: 星辰坠落造成伤害的速度提高100%。

spells.description_en: When you exit Eclipse with less than 40 Astral Power, Wrath and Starfire's cast times are reduced by 20% for 15 sec or until you enter an Eclipse.
spells.description_zh: 当你退出日月之蚀状态且星界能量低于40点时，愤怒与星火术的施法时间缩短20%，持续15秒或直到你进入新的日月之蚀状态。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Death deals damage 2 additional times at 15% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：灭会额外造成2次伤害，每次伤害相当于原来的15%。

spells.description_en: Increases the chance for Shadowy Insight to occur by 25%. When consuming Shadowy Insight, Mind Blast generates 1 additional Insanity.
spells.description_zh: 暗影洞察的触发几率提高25%。消耗暗影洞察时，心灵震爆会额外产生1点狂乱值。

spells.description_en: The damage bonus from your Mastery: Shadow Weaving gains 50% additional benefit from Shadow Word: Madness.
spells.description_zh: 你的精通：暗影交织的伤害加成会从暗言术：癫中额外获得50%的加成。

spells.description_en: Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse have one additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 月蚀与日蚀获得一层额外充能。

spells.description_en: Every time Starfall drops a wave of stars, a meteorite also falls on up to 2 targets in its range, each dealing 82 Astral damage.
spells.description_zh: 星辰坠落每次降下一波星辰时，一颗陨星还会落在其范围内最多2个目标上，每个造成84点星界伤害。
