spells.description_en: A strong herbal brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 30% of incoming damage, up to 2,381 total.
spells.description_zh: 灌下一口强劲的草药酒，凝结散逸至体外的真气，使其化为天神守卫，吸收所受伤害量的30%，最多可吸收2,381点伤害。

spells.description_en: Healing Spheres now heal over 10 sec, and their healing is increased by up to 80% based on your missing health.
spells.description_zh: 疗伤珠现在会在10秒内持续提供治疗，治疗效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高80%。

spells.description_en: The effectiveness of your Stagger is increased by up to 15%, based on your missing health.
spells.description_zh: 你的醉拳化解效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Activating Avenging Wrath releases the Light within yourself, healing 5 injured allies instantly and an injured ally every 0.9 sec within 40 yds for 133.

Allies healed also receive 10% increased healing from your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh:
激活复仇之怒，释放你体内的圣光，立即为5名受伤的盟友恢复133点生命值，并且每0.9秒为40码范围内一名受伤的盟友恢复等量的生命值。

受到治疗的盟友从你的圣光术、圣光闪现和神圣震击法术中受到的治疗效果提高10%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
During Avenging Wrath, Judgment is empowered into Hammer of Wrath.

 Hammer of Wrath
Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for 44 Holy damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
spells.description_zh:
在复仇之怒期间，审判被强化为愤怒之锤。

 愤怒之锤
扔出一把神圣之锤，对一名敌人造成43点神圣伤害。

产生1点神圣能量。

spells.description_en: Judgment critical strikes empower your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn at 30% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 审判爆击会使你的下一个荣耀圣令自动触发黎明之光，效果为30%。

spells.description_en:
A pulse of Arcane magic erupts from underneath your target, dealing 2,592 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 1 Arcane Charge for each enemy struck.
spells.description_zh:
自目标脚下迸发一股奥术魔法，对8码内所有敌人造成2,502点奥术伤害。超过5个目标时伤害降低。

每击中一名敌人，便产生1层奥术充能。

spells.description_en:
Avenging Wrath's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, but its duration is reduced by 5.0 sec.

Avenging Crusader's cooldown is reduced by 30.0 sec, but its duration is reduced by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
复仇之怒的冷却时间缩短30秒，但持续时间缩短5.0秒。

复仇十字军的冷却时间缩短30.0秒，但持续时间缩短3.0秒。

spells.description_en: Activating Aura Mastery also casts a Divine Toll at 200% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 激活光环掌握也会施放一次效果为200%的圣洁鸣钟。

spells.description_en:
Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.

For each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 10% reduced damage.
spells.description_zh:
暗影指引你出击，使你的天灾打击伤害提高25%，并使其为你赋予暗影之爪，最多叠加4层。

每层暗影之爪都会使天灾打击额外弹向一名敌人。后续的每次弹射伤害均降低10%。

spells.description_en: Verdant Embrace healing is increased by 40%. In addition, it no longer causes you to leap to your target, instead sending forth a Dream Simulacrum.
spells.description_zh: 青翠之拥的治疗效果提高40%。此外，该技能不再使你跃向目标，而是向前释放一个梦境幻影。

spells.description_en: Verdant Embrace gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 青翠之拥获得一层额外充能。

spells.description_en:
Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing 24 Shadow damage to the target and 16 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
每有一个次级食尸鬼，你的永久食尸鬼造成的伤害提高10%，黑暗突变还会将你的次级食尸鬼的爪击强化为横扫爪击。

横扫爪击
使用畸形的利爪扫击一名敌人，对目标造成24点暗影伤害，并对附近敌人造成16点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Your Lesser Ghouls deal 15% increased damage but last 35% less.
spells.description_zh: 你的次级食尸鬼造成的伤害提高15%，但持续时间缩短35%。

spells.description_en: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn now convert 15% of their healing into an absorb shield instead.
spells.description_zh: 荣耀圣令和黎明之光现在将其15%的治疗量转化为吸收盾。

spells.description_en: While at maximum health, targets with Beacon of Light generate an absorb shield equal to 2% of their health every 3 sec, up to a maximum of 6%.
spells.description_zh: 生命值全满时，带有圣光道标的目标每3秒生成一个吸收护盾，护盾值相当于其生命值的2%，最多不超过6%。

spells.description_en:
Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
腐化会使你的永久食尸鬼陷入邪恶狂乱，攻击速度和能量恢复速度提高25%，持续12秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Light your soul aflame, healing yourself for 24% of your maximum health, generating 30 Fury and shattering 3 Soul Fragments over 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 点燃你的灵魂，恢复24%的最大生命值，同时在5秒内产生30点恶魔之怒并击碎3个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en: Damage taken reduced by up to 10%, increasing as your health decreases.
spells.description_zh: 受到的伤害最多降低10%，此效果随生命值降低而提高。

spells.description_en: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.
spells.description_zh: 愤怒之锤的伤害会随目标的生命值而提高，至多造成50%的额外伤害。目标生命值越低，受到的伤害越高。

spells.description_en: Activating Avenging Wrath calls upon the Light to empower you, causing your next 2 Holy Lights to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.
spells.description_zh: 激活复仇之怒，呼唤圣光强化你，使你下2个圣光术变为瞬发，且法力消耗降低50%。

spells.description_en: Casting Emerald Blossom causes your next Echo to cast on an additional ally within 25 yards at 100% effectiveness. Stacks up to 2 charges.
spells.description_zh: 施放翡翠之花后，你的下一次回响会额外以100%的效果对25码范围内的一名盟友生效。最多可叠加2层。

spells.description_en:
Army of the Dead now summons a Gargoyle into the battlefield to bombard your enemies for 25 sec.

The Gargoyle gains 1% increased damage for every 1 Runic Power you spend and always critically strikes.
spells.description_zh:
亡者大军现在会召唤一只石像鬼飞入战场轰炸你的敌人，持续25秒。

每当你消耗1点符文能量，石像鬼的伤害就提高1%，并且必定爆击。

spells.description_en:
Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

Necrotic Coil
Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing 72 Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and 22 Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

Graveyard
The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing 39 Shadow damage and 18 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
spells.description_zh:
亡者大军汲取亡者之力，将你的凋零缠绕和扩散转化为死灵缠绕和灾殃坟茔，持续30秒。

死灵缠绕
释放一道由亡骨与死灵能量构成的漩涡，对至多3名敌人造成73点暗影打击伤害，并对所有被刺穿的敌人造成22点暗影伤害。

灾殃坟茔
亡者在所有感染了恶性病变的敌人脚下破土而出，造成39点暗影伤害，并对附近敌人造成18点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Collapsing Star always critically strikes.
spells.description_zh: 坍缩之星必定爆击。

spells.description_en: Every soul consumed in Void Metamorphosis grants 0.25% haste, up to 25%.
spells.description_zh: 在虚空变形期间，每吞噬一个灵魂，获得0.25%急速，最多25%。

spells.description_en: Your damaging critical strikes deal 240% damage instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh: 你的伤害技能爆击会造成240%的伤害，而非通常的200%。

spells.description_en:
Scourge Strike now causes your Plagues to erupt at 50% effectiveness.

Clawing Shadows can now stack 1 additional times.
spells.description_zh:
天灾打击现在会以50%的效果引爆你目标身上的瘟疫。

暗影之爪现在可以额外叠加1次。

spells.description_en: Army of the Dead now raises an Abomination for 30 sec to attack enemies while emitting a disease cloud, dealing 12 Plague damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 亡者大军现在会召唤一只持续30秒的憎恶，攻击敌人并释放瘟疫之云，每2秒对附近敌人造成12点瘟疫伤害。

spells.description_en: All diseases deal 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 所有疾病造成的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Increases Tentacle Slam damage by 300%.
spells.description_zh: 触须猛击的伤害提高300%。

spells.description_en: Casting Dream Flight or Stasis increases your healing over time by 50% and causes Living Flame and Reversion to have a 100% increased chance to grant Essence Burst. Lasts 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在施放梦境飞行或静滞后，你的持续治疗效果提高50%，并且活化烈焰和逆转触发精华迸发的几率提高100%。持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Your chance to shatter a Soul Fragment from enemies you damage is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你从伤害的敌人身上击碎灵魂残片的几率提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and their critical strike damage by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 吸血鬼之触和暗言术：痛的爆击率提高8%，爆击伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Thunder Focus Tea summons a Jade Serpent Statue at your location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.
spells.description_zh: 雷光聚神茶在你的位置召唤一座青龙雕像。当你引导抚慰之雾时，青龙雕像也会开始对你的目标引导抚慰之雾，在7.1秒内为其恢复2,128点生命值。

spells.description_en: Your Mastery is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的精通提高2%。

spells.description_en: Vivify healing increased by 15% and Renewing Mist's healing is increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 活血术的治疗效果提高15%，复苏之雾的治疗效果提高30%。

spells.description_en: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.
spells.description_zh: 激活壮胆酒会尽可能将你身上当前激活的所有有害魔法效果返还给施法者。

spells.description_en: Arcane Missiles now damages 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 奥术飞弹现在以50%的效能额外攻击2个目标。

spells.description_en: Casting Arcane Orb fires 2 additional Arcane Orbs at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 施放奥术宝珠会额外发射2个奥术宝珠，效果为原来的50%。

spells.description_en: Casting Touch of the Magi grants Clearcasting.
spells.description_zh: 施放大法师之触会获得节能施法。

spells.description_en: The damage of Arcane Blast and Arcane Pulse are increased by 15%, but their mana costs are increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 奥术冲击和奥术脉冲的伤害提高15%，但其法力消耗提高25%。

spells.description_en:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse grants 2 stacks of Arcane Salvo.

Casting Arcane Orb grants 1 stack of Arcane Salvo.

Casting Prismatic Bolt grants 4 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
spells.description_zh:
施放奥术冲击或奥术脉冲可获得2层奥术齐射。

施放奥术宝珠可获得1层奥术齐射。

施放棱彩飞弹可获得4层奥术齐射。

spells.description_en: Activating Shield Wall increases your maximum health by 30% for 8 sec and instantly heals you for that amount.
spells.description_zh: 激活盾墙会使你的最大生命值提高30%，持续8秒，同时立即为你恢复等量的生命值。

spells.description_en: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.
spells.description_zh: 你的怒吼技能持续时间延长20%。

spells.description_en:
Unleash a furious frenzy, flickering to nearby targets in front of you 5 times and clawing all enemies around them for 5 Physical damage and an additional 37 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Awards 5 combo points.
spells.description_zh:
倾泄出狂暴的怒火，在你前方的邻近目标间闪烁突袭5次，爪击周围所有敌人，造成5点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成37点流血伤害。

奖励5个连击点数。

spells.description_en:
Arcane Salvo damage bonus increased by 2%.

 Arcane Salvo:
Increases the damage of your next Arcane Barrage by 3%.
spells.description_zh:
奥术齐射的伤害加成提高2%。

 奥术齐射：
你的下一个奥术弹幕伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: You are healed for at least 125% of the damage dealt by Refining Fire, increasing to a maximum of 300% as your health decreases.
spells.description_zh: 精炼圣火造成伤害时，会为你提供相当于其伤害至少125%的治疗。随生命值降低，最高可达300%。

spells.description_en: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 镜像的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Blink gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 闪现术获得一层额外充能。

spells.description_en: Ice Barrier gains an additional charge and reduces your physical damage taken by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰护体额外获得一层充能，并使你受到的物理伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Casting Avenger's Shield causes Consecration to deal its damage and healing again immediately at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 施放复仇者之盾会使奉献立即再次造成伤害和治疗，效果为100%。

spells.description_en: Alter Time resets the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer when you return to your original location.
spells.description_zh: 在你返回至初始位置时，操控时间会重置闪现术和闪光术的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Run at high speed toward a target location near your allies, taking 30% of all damage dealt to allies within 3 yards for 8 sec or until you take at least 6,110 damage from this effect.
spells.description_zh: 高速奔向靠近盟友的目标位置，在8秒内为3码范围内的盟友分担30%的所受伤害，或直至你因该效果累计承受至少6,110点伤害为止。

spells.description_en: Upon dropping below 25% health, your past self corrects your timeline, casting Alter Time and instantly returning 20% of your maximum health and healing you for an additional 30% over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 生命值降至25%以下时，你过去的自己会修正你的时间线，施放操控时间，立即为你恢复20%的最大生命值，并在6秒内额外为你恢复30%生命值。

spells.description_en: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术的爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Your Mastery is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高3%。

spells.description_en: Ice Block now has an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰屏障现在额外获得一层充能，冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Void Ray's cooldown during Void Metamorphosis is reduced by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 虚空变形期间，虚空射线的冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Reap and Consume damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 收割和吞噬的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: When Void Metamorphosis expires, for each unused Soul you harvested, gain 5 Fury and increase your damage by 0.50% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 虚空变形结束时，每个已收割但未使用的灵魂会使你获得5点恶魔之怒，且造成的伤害提高0.50%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
Chomp your target, causing 405 Physical damage. Chomp critical strikes deal 3 times normal damage.

Chomp can only be used when you fall below 30% Energy or for 2 seconds afterward.
spells.description_zh:
啃噬目标，造成402点物理伤害。啃噬爆击时造成相当于普通伤害3倍的伤害。

只有在你的能量低于30%，或在随后的2秒内，才能施放啃噬。

spells.description_en: Increases Mastery by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高2%。

spells.description_en:
The duration of Feast of Souls is increased by 1 sec.

 Feast of Souls
Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
灵魂盛宴的持续时间延长1秒。

 灵魂盛宴:
灵魂残片使你造成的伤害提高1%，持续6秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en:
Increases Conflagrate damage by 10%. 

Conflagrate now erupts the target's Immolate, spreading it up to 3 nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
燃烧的伤害提高10%。

燃烧现在会引爆目标的献祭，并将其蔓延至最多3名附近敌人。

spells.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting has a 25% chance to cause your next Arcane Missiles to be Overpowered, causing it to deal 100% increased damage, generate maximum stacks of Arcane Salvo, and strike 3 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 获得节能施法时，有25%的几率过载你的下一个奥术飞弹，使其造成的伤害提高100%，产生最大层数的奥术齐射，并以50%的效果额外打击3个目标。

spells.description_en: Blink's cooldown is reduced by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 闪现术的冷却时间缩短2秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Havoc by 5 sec and increases the damage Havoc victims are dealt by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 浩劫的持续时间延长5秒，并且浩劫的受害者受到的伤害额外提高10%。

spells.description_en: Ferocious Bite's damage to its primary target increased by 8% for each enemy affected by your Rip, up to 6.
spells.description_zh: 对主要目标施放的凶猛撕咬伤害提高8%，每个受到你的割裂影响的敌人都会使此效果提升，最多6个敌人。

spells.description_en: Feral Frenzy's cooldown reduced by 15 sec and its damage is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 野性狂乱的冷却时间缩短15秒，伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: When an enemy afflicted by your Rip dies, gain 10 Energy and your damage dealt is increased by 5% for 8 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 当受你割裂影响的敌人死亡时，获得10点能量，并在8秒内使你造成的伤害提高5%，最多可叠加5层。

spells.description_en: The final slash of Blade Dance consumes 25 Fury when it strikes 3 or more enemies, launching two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing 64 Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 刃舞的最后一次斩击在击中3个或更多敌人时，消耗25点恶魔之怒，投出两把恶魔战刃，产生能量旋风，在3秒内对附近所有敌人造成64点混乱伤害。目标数量超过8个后，造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Damage of your bleeds increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你的流血伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Increases Chaos Bolt damage by 5% and Chaos Bolt now has a 25% chance to make your next Incinerate instant.
spells.description_zh: 混乱之箭的伤害提高5%，并且混乱之箭有25%的几率使你下一个烧尽变为瞬发。

spells.description_en:
Cataclysm now leaves behind a lake of fire that deals 2,281 Fire damage to enemies within it over 8.9 sec.

Immolate deals 20% increased damage to enemies within the lake of fire.
spells.description_zh:
大灾变现在会留下一片烈火之池，在8.9秒内对其中的敌人造成总计2,281点火焰伤害。

献祭对烈火之池中的敌人造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
While in combat, apply a Beacon of the Savior to the lowest health ally within 30 yds that causes your direct healing on others to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed.

Beacon of the Savior transfers to the lowest health ally within 30 yds if it heals a target past maximum health or if an ally drops below 50% health.
spells.description_zh:
在战斗中，对30码内生命值最低的盟友施加救世道标，使你对他人的直接治疗也会治疗该盟友，治疗量为直接治疗量的10%。

如果救世道标的治疗使目标生命值超过最大值，或者有盟友的生命值降至50%以下，则救世道标会转移至30码内生命值最低的盟友身上。

spells.description_en: Increases how quickly Rain of Fire deals damage by 25% and how quickly your Infernal's Immolation deals damage by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 火焰之雨造成伤害的速度提高25%，你的地狱火的献祭造成伤害的速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Rain of Fire has a 20% chance to reduce the cost of your next Rain of Fire within 8 sec by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 火焰之雨有20%的几率使你在8秒内施放的下一个火焰之雨的消耗降低100%。

spells.description_en:
Casting Soul Fire summons an Overfiend.

Opening a Dimensional Rift has a chance to summon an Overfiend instead.

 Summon Overfiend
Generates 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec and casts Chaos Bolt at 80% effectiveness at its summoner's target. Lasts 8 sec.
spells.description_zh:
施放灵魂之火会召唤一个大恶魔。

开启混乱裂隙有几率变为召唤一个大恶魔。

 召唤大恶魔
每1秒产生1个灵魂碎片裂片，并以80%的效果对召唤者的目标施放混乱之箭。持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Consecration deals 100% increased damage when it strikes a single target.
spells.description_zh: 当奉献仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Unleash your glaives and charge to your target, dealing 862 Cosmic damage.
spells.description_zh: 释放你的战刃并冲向目标，造成849点宇宙伤害。

spells.description_en: Critical strikes dealt by Chaos Bolt, Conflagrate, or Incinerate have a 10% chance to make your next cast of Shadowburn within 30 sec cost no Soul Shards and usable on any target regardless of health.
spells.description_zh: 混乱之箭、燃烧或烧尽的爆击有10%的几率使你在30秒内施放的下一个暗影灼烧不消耗灵魂碎片，且可以对任意目标使用，无视其当前生命值。

spells.description_en: Consecration heals you for 375% of the damage it deals.
spells.description_zh: 奉献会为你恢复生命值，相当于其造成伤害的375%。

spells.description_en: While out of combat, Divine Steed grants Shield of the Righteous for its duration and an additional 4.0 sec after it fades.
spells.description_zh: 在战斗外时，神圣马驹会在其持续期间以及效果消失后的额外4.0秒内获得正义盾击效果。

spells.description_en: After casting Arcane Surge, your next Blink will cause a Blast Wave at your previous location, dealing 228 Fire damage, knocking enemies back 8 yds, and slowing them by 70% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在施放奥术涌动后，你的下一个闪现术会在你先前所在位置释放一次冲击波，造成227点火焰伤害，将敌人击退8码，并使其减速70%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: Charge to your target, striking them for 2,302 Cosmic damage, rooting them in place for 1.5 sec and inflicting 1,628 Cosmic damage over 6 sec to up to 5 enemies in your path.
spells.description_zh: 冲向你的目标，对其造成2,326点宇宙伤害，将其定在原地1.5秒，并在6秒内对路径上最多5名敌人造成1,628点宇宙伤害。

spells.description_en: Guardian of Ancient Kings has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 远古列王守卫拥有1层额外充能。

spells.description_en: Judgment chains to 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 审判会弹射至2个额外目标，效果为50%。

spells.description_en:
Increases the healing done by Holy Word: Serenity by 10% and causes it to heal 4 nearby injured allies within 40 yards for 15% of its healing done.

Talents that affect Holy Word: Sanctify instead affect Holy Word: Serenity.
spells.description_zh:
圣言术：静的治疗效果提高10%，并治疗40码范围内4名受伤的盟友，治疗量相当于原治疗量的15%。

原本影响圣言术：灵的天赋效果现在改为影响圣言术：静。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Holy Nova by 400%, its healing by 500%, and its cooldown by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使神圣新星的伤害提高400%，治疗效果提高500%，冷却时间延长30秒。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Soul Immolation is reduced by 30 sec and it gains 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂献祭的冷却时间缩短30秒，并获得1层额外充能。

spells.description_en: Soul Immolation heals for an additional 6% of your health over its duration and its cooldown is reset upon killing an enemy that yields experience or honor.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂献祭在其持续时间内额外为你恢复6%的生命值，并在你击杀一名可获得经验值或荣誉值的敌人后重置冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Reap now generates 10 Fury.
spells.description_zh: 收割现在产生10点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Voidblade damage increased by 100% and Voidblade now generates 20 Fury.
spells.description_zh: 虚空之刃的伤害提高100%，并且现在会产生20点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Casting Prayer of Mending heals your target for 4,643.
spells.description_zh: 施放愈合祷言时会为你的目标恢复4,643点生命值。

spells.description_en: 20% of overhealing done is redistributed to up to 4 nearby injured allies.
spells.description_zh: 你造成的过量治疗的20%会重新分配给附近最多4名受伤的盟友。

spells.description_en: Shatter damage has a 50% increased chance to critically strike.
spells.description_zh: 碎裂的爆击几率提高50%。

spells.description_en:
While in combat, Frost crystallizes around you, generating an Icicle every 5.4 sec. Upon generating 5 Icicles, Frostbolt upgrades to Glacial Spike for its next cast.

 Glacial Spike
Conjures a massive spike of ice that impales your target, dealing 5,446 damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.
spells.description_zh:
在战斗中，冰霜会在你周围凝结，每5.4秒生成一枚冰刺。当你生成5枚冰刺后，你的下一个寒冰箭将升级为冰川尖刺。

 冰川尖刺
召唤一根巨型寒冰尖刺穿刺你的目标，造成5,515点伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续8秒。

施加3层冻结效果。

spells.description_en: Shatter's critical strike damage is increased by 50% of your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 碎裂的爆击伤害提高，相当于你爆击几率的50%。

spells.description_en: Ray of Frost damage increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜射线的伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Cone of Cold now applies 3 stacks of Freezing to up to 5 enemies.
spells.description_zh: 冰锥术现在会对至多5名敌人施加3层冻结。

spells.description_en: Reduces the mana cost of Prayer of Healing by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使治疗祷言的法力消耗降低15%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the mana cost of Flash Heal by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使快速治疗的法力消耗降低15%。

spells.description_en: Increases Shadowy Apparition damage by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影幻灵的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Slash all enemies within 10 yds dealing 38 damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Copy the longest Garrote and Rupture on the enemies you hit onto up to 2 other enemies. 

Awards 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh:
挥砍10码范围内的所有敌人，造成39点伤害。超过5个目标后伤害降低。

将你命中的敌人身上持续时间最长的锁喉和割裂复制到最多2名其他敌人身上。

奖励1个连击点。

spells.description_en: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for 69 Shadow damage and have them explode for 48 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一个次级食尸鬼攻击敌人，造成69点暗影伤害并使其爆炸，对附近的敌人造成48点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en:
Void Metamorphosis requires 15 less souls.

Your Fury drains 25% faster while in Void Metamorphosis.
spells.description_zh:
虚空变形所需的灵魂减少15个。

在虚空变形期间，你的恶魔之怒流失速度加快25%。

spells.description_en: Void Ray and Hungering Slash damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 虚空射线和饥渴斩击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Ray of Frost generates 2 stacks of Fingers of Frost over its duration.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜射线在其引导期间生成2层寒冰指。

spells.description_en: Consuming Brain Freeze has a 100% chance to cause your next Ice Lance to Shatter 4 additional stacks of Freezing.
spells.description_zh: 消耗冰冷智慧有100%几率使你的下一个冰枪术额外粉碎4层冻结。

spells.description_en: The time it takes to generate an Icicle is reduced by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 生成一枚冰刺的时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Frostbolt and Glacial Spike damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰箭和冰川尖刺的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Flurry and Blizzard damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 冰风暴和暴风雪的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Flurry fires 1 additional missile.
spells.description_zh: 冰风暴额外发射1枚飞弹。

spells.description_en:
Casting Ray of Frost replaces your Ray of Frost with Comet Storm, calling down a series of 7 icy comets on and around the target, that deals up to 2,518 Frost damage to all enemies within 8 yds of its impacts.

Each Comet Shatters 1 stack of Freezing.
spells.description_zh:
施放冰霜射线会将你的冰霜射线替换为彗星风暴，召唤连续7颗冰霜彗星落砸向目标及其周围，对冲击点周围8码范围内的所有敌人造成最高2,599点冰霜伤害。

每颗彗星会粉碎1层冻结。

spells.description_en: When Ice Lance Shatters a stack of Freezing, the cooldown of Ray of Frost is reduced by 0.10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冰枪术粉碎一层冻结时，冰霜射线的冷却时间缩短0.10秒。

spells.description_en: Ice Lance Shatters 1 additional stack of Freezing.
spells.description_zh: 冰枪术会额外粉碎1层冻结。

spells.description_en: Increases your Energy regeneration by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 能量回复速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Flurry and Fire Blast now deal Frostfire damage and their damage is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 冰风暴和火焰冲击现在造成霜火伤害，且其伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Your Frost and Fire spells deal 20% increased critical strike damage.

Ice Lance and Pyroblast  have their damage increased by 40%.
spells.description_zh:
冰霜与火焰法术的爆击伤害提高20%。

冰枪术和炎爆术的伤害提高40%。

spells.description_en: The damage of Meteor and Comet Storm is increased.
spells.description_zh: 流星和彗星风暴的伤害提高。

spells.description_en: Increases Cosmic Ripple healing by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使宇宙涟漪的治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Prayer of Mending gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 愈合祷言可以额外使用一次。

spells.description_en:
Rising Sun Kick's critical strike chance is increased by 4% for each nearby enemy, up to 5 enemies.

10% of Rising Sun Kick's damage splashes onto nearby enemies. Damage is reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
每有一个附近的敌人，旭日东升踢的爆击几率就提高4% ，最多受5个敌人影响。

旭日东升踢10%的伤害会溅射到附近的敌人身上。超过5个目标后，伤害降低。

spells.description_en: The damage of Fists of Fury is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 怒雷破的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: You gain 10% more Haste from all sources of Haste.
spells.description_zh: 你从所有来源获得的急速属性额外提高10%。

spells.description_en: When you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, the damage of your next Ambush or Mutilate is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 当你消耗一层死亡猎手标记时，你的下一个伏击或毁伤的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Rupture damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 割裂的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Fan of Knives damage increased by 60%.
spells.description_zh: 刀扇的伤害提高60%。

spells.description_en:
When Frostbolt critically strikes, it applies 1 additional stack of Freezing.

Each stack of Freezing that you Shatter deals 104 damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
寒冰箭爆击时，额外施加1层冻结。

你每粉碎一层冻结，对附近敌人造成104点伤害。超过5个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Ice shards pelt the target area, dealing 1,680 Frost damage over 10.7 sec and reducing movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

This spell is cast at your target.
spells.description_zh:
目标区域骤然落下寒冰碎片，在10.7秒内造成1,677点冰霜伤害，并使敌人的移动速度降低50%，持续3秒。

此法术会对你的目标施放。

spells.description_en: Slicing Winds now generates 1 Chi when cast.
spells.description_zh: 施放切削之风时会生成1点真气。

spells.description_en: Slicing Winds now costs 2 Chi to cast, but its damage is increased by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 切削之风现在需要消耗2点真气，但其伤害提高40%。

spells.description_en:
Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

Coin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.
spells.description_zh:
每投掷7次硬币，就会保留一枚幸运硬币，使你趋向命运，持续12秒。你的敏捷提高4%，命运硬币的伤害和加成效果提高50%，并且硬币投掷结果与上一次相同的几率提高15%。

当你拥有一枚幸运硬币时，投掷硬币不计入寻找幸运硬币的次数。

spells.description_en:
After Invoking Xuen, the White Tiger you may cast Celestial Conduit within 1 min.

 Celestial Conduit:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 292 Nature damage onto enemies and 21,266 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

You may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.
spells.description_zh:
在召唤白虎雪怒后，你可以在1分钟内施放天神御身。

 天神御身:
至尊天神赋予你力量，使你能够在3.6秒内对15码范围内的敌人造成289点自然伤害，并为最多5名受伤的盟友恢复21,420点生命值，超过5个目标后效果降低。

引导期间，你可以移动，但施放其他治疗或伤害法术会取消该效果。

spells.description_en: Envenom has a 15% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.
spells.description_zh: 毒伤有15%的几率掷出3个命运硬币。

spells.description_en: Envenom deals 5% more damage when it consumes 5 or more combo points.
spells.description_zh: 毒伤消耗不低于5点连击点数时，其伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Flipping a Fatebound Coin restores 10 health.
spells.description_zh: 掷出一个命运硬币时恢复10点生命值。

spells.description_en: Gain 5 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 15 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.
spells.description_zh: 每次掷出命运硬币时，获得5点能量。硬币立在边缘时，获得15点能量。

spells.description_en: Caustic Spatter causes an additional 5% of Nature damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.
spells.description_zh: 腐蚀飞溅向已受影响的敌人额外施加5%的自然伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of your spells by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Surge of Light occurs up to 50% more often based on your missing mana.
spells.description_zh: 基于你已损失的法力，圣光涌动的触发几率最多增加50%。

spells.description_en:
Chi costs are reduced by 1 and Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of affected abilities by an additional 1 sec for 15 sec.

Activating Zenith resets the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.
spells.description_zh:
真气消耗降低1点，并且幻灭踢使受影响技能的冷却时间额外缩短1秒，持续15秒。

激活乾元之巅会重置旭日东升踢的剩余冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Call upon Sindragosa's aid in battle for 8 sec, continuously dealing 38 Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you. Consuming Killing Machine or Rime increases the duration by 0.8 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

Grants a charge of Empower Rune Weapon at the start and 2 Runes at the end.
spells.description_zh:
召唤辛达苟萨协助作战，持续8秒，对你前方锥形范围内的敌人每1秒造成38点冰霜伤害。消耗杀戮机器或白霜效果会使持续时间延长0.8秒。对次要目标造成的伤害降低。

施放开始时获得一层符文武器增效充能，结束时恢复2个符文。

spells.description_en: Garrote lasts 6 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 锁喉的持续时间延长6秒。

spells.description_en: All damage you deal is increased by 10% while Deathmark is active.
spells.description_zh: 死亡印记激活时，你造成的所有伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: During Zenith, Blackout Kick generates 1 Chi.
spells.description_zh: 在乾元之巅期间，幻灭踢产生1点真气。

spells.description_en: Applying Envenom while Envenom is already active causes it to increase all damage you deal by 5% in addition to increasing your poison application chance.
spells.description_zh: 在已激活毒伤时再次施加毒伤，除去提升你的施毒几率以外，还会使你造成的所有伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Fists of Fury's Chi cost is reduced by 1, but its damage is reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 怒雷破的真气消耗降低1点，但其伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: Casting Strike of the Windlord or Whirling Dragon Punch grants Blackout Kick!.
spells.description_zh: 施放风领主之击或升龙霸会获得幻灭踢！效果。

spells.description_en: When you apply a Weapon Poison with a single-target attack, you have a 50% chance to strike a nearby enemy for 5 Physical damage and apply the same Weapon Poison to them.
spells.description_zh: 当你使用单目标攻击施加武器药膏时，有50%的几率对附近一名敌人造成5点物理伤害，并对他们施加相同的武器药膏。

spells.description_en: Holy damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Shadow damage and healing done increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 暗影伤害与治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Hypothermia's duration is reduced by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 低温的冷却时间缩短10秒。

spells.description_en: Applying Envenom while Envenom is already active restores 1 combo point.
spells.description_zh: 在毒伤已经激活时再次施加毒伤，会恢复1个连击点数。

spells.description_en: When Kingsbane ends, gain 2% haste for every 5 stacks of increased Kingsbane damage that you had, decreasing by 2% every 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 君王之灾效果结束时，根据其伤害提高的层数，每5层使你获得2%的急速，此效果每2秒降低2%。

spells.description_en: Rupture damage increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 割裂的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Increases Critical Strike chance by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。

spells.description_en:
Elemental damage increased by 10%. 

Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon consumed reduces the cooldown of Stormstrike by 0.3 sec and Lava Lash by 0.3 sec.
spells.description_zh:
元素伤害提高10%。

每消耗一层漩涡武器，可使风暴打击的冷却时间缩短0.3秒，熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短0.3秒。

spells.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的智力提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases your Mastery by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的精通提高2%。

spells.description_en: Fade creates an illusion of you for 4 sec, tricking enemies to attack it instead.
spells.description_zh: 渐隐术会在4秒内制造一个你的幻象，诱使敌人转而攻击它。

spells.description_en: Increases Shadow Word: Madness damage by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：癫的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的圣言术：静和圣言术：灵的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Your healing spells critically strike for 220% of healing done instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh: 你的治疗法术爆击时，造成220%的治疗量，而非通常的200%。

spells.description_en:
After consuming Blackout Kick!, Rising Sun Kick has a 60% chance to become Rushing Wind Kick.

Rushing Wind Kick:
Kick up a powerful gust of wind, dealing 62 Nature damage in a 25 yd cone to enemies in front of you, split evenly among them. Damage is increased by 6% for each target hit, up to 30%.
spells.description_zh:
在消耗幻灭踢！后，旭日东升踢有60%的几率变为疾风呼啸踢。

疾风呼啸踢:
掀起一股强劲疾风，对你前方25码锥形范围内的敌人造成62点自然伤害，由所有敌人均摊。每命中一个目标，伤害提高6%，最多提高30%。

spells.description_en:
You and your pet leap to your target and strike as one, dealing 631 Physical damage. Your pet frees itself from roots when it leaps.

For the next 8 sec, the damage dealt by you and your pet is increased by 20%.

Generates 50 Focus.
spells.description_zh:
你与你的宠物一同跃向目标并发起协同攻击，造成628点物理伤害。宠物在跳跃时会解除定身效果。

在接下来的8秒内，你和你的宠物造成的伤害提高20%。

产生50点集中值。

spells.description_en: Increases Prayer of Mending healing by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 愈合祷言的治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Call shadowy tendrils to constrict enemies when Psychic Scream ends, rooting them in place for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 心灵尖啸结束时，召唤暗影触须束缚敌人，将其定身在原地，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Hand of Gul'dan now empowers 1 of the Wild Imps it summons, increasing its damage dealt by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 古尔丹之手现在会强化其召唤的1个野生小鬼，使其造成的伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Mind Control and Dominate Mind against enemy creatures by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你对敌对生物施展的精神控制和统御意志的持续时间延长15秒。

spells.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的智力提高3%。

spells.description_en: Increases your Stamina by 6%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的耐力提高6%。

spells.description_en: Increases your haste by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的急速提高3%。

spells.description_en: Your demons deal 1.0% increased damage for each demon you control.
spells.description_zh: 你控制的每个恶魔都会使你的恶魔造成的伤害提高1.0%。

spells.description_en: Heal each time you spend Rage, up to 0.8% of your maximum health for 80 Rage spent.
spells.description_zh: 每当你消耗80点怒气，就会为你恢复生命值，最高恢复最大生命值的0.8%。

spells.description_en: Motes of Possibility may now grant Prescience to allies and have a 10% increased chance to activate.
spells.description_zh: 机遇微粒现在可以给予盟友先知先觉，且激活几率提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Your Demonic Tyrant is equipped with armor forged within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. While summoned, your Demonic Tyrant now assaults enemies with powerful melee attacks.

 Burning Cleave
Cleaves the area in front of the caster, inflicting 363 Shadowflame damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
你的恶魔暴君装备了在安托鲁斯锻造的护甲，使其护甲值提高10%。被召唤时，你的恶魔暴君现在会用强大的近战攻击打击敌人。

 炽燃顺劈
劈砍施法者面前区域的敌人，造成365点暗影烈焰伤害。超过8个目标时伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Barkskin increases your maximum health by 20%, but its duration is reduced by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 树皮术使你的最大生命值提高20%，但持续时间减少40%。

spells.description_en: The critical strike damage of your Nature abilities are increased by 40% of your critical strike chance.
spells.description_zh: 你的自然法术的爆击伤害提高，数值相当于你的爆击几率的40%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Smite by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 惩击的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Pain by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：痛的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Critical strikes of your Nature abilities reduce the target's movement speed by 60% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的自然法术爆击会使目标的移动速度降低60%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage and healing of your Holy and Shadow spells by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的神圣和暗影法术的伤害和治疗效果提高2%。

spells.description_en: When you shapeshift out of Bear Form, its benefits to health and armor slowly decay over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你从熊形态切换形态时，生命值和护甲加成效果会在8秒内缓慢衰减。

spells.description_en:
Consuming Tip of the Spear provokes your pet to attack your target, dealing 63 Physical damage.

All damage dealt by your pet is increased by 30%.
spells.description_zh:
消耗利矛之刃会激怒你的宠物，使其攻击目标并造成63点物理伤害。

你的宠物造成的所有伤害提高30%。

spells.description_en: Strike as One damages 2 additional enemies and its damage is increased by 10% for each enemy it strikes beyond the first.
spells.description_zh: 羁绊共狩会额外伤害2名敌人，且除首个目标外每击中一名敌人，其伤害就提高10%。

spells.description_en: Call Dreadstalkers also summons a Vilefiend that assists you in combat for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤恐惧猎犬也会召唤一只邪犬协助你作战，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: Takedown cooldown reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狩魂一击的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Ironfur increases your Mastery by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 铁鬃使你的精通提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Flash Heal is upgraded to Shadow Mend, a stronger heal with a higher mana cost.

 Shadow Mend:
Wraps an ally in shadows which heal for 3,345, but at a price.

The ally will take 163 damage every 1 sec, until they have taken 1,663 total damage from all sources, or leave combat.
spells.description_zh:
快速治疗升级为暗影愈合，治疗效果更强，但法力消耗更高。

 暗影愈合:
将一名盟友包裹在暗影中，为其恢复3,311点生命值，但要支付代价。

此后该盟友将每1秒受到169点伤害，直到其从所有来源受到总计1,654点伤害，或脱离战斗为止。

spells.description_en: Raptor Strike increases the damage of Raptor Strike by 10% for 8 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 猛禽一击使猛禽一击的伤害提高10%，持续8秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Gaining a stack of Mongoose Fury has a 20% chance to increase the damage of your next Raptor Strike by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 获得一层猫鼬之怒时，有20%的几率使你的下一次猛禽一击的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the mana cost of Chain Heal by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使治疗链的法力消耗降低15%。

spells.description_en: Channel the power of the enraged moon to deal 2,432 Arcane damage to your target over 8 sec. Casting Mangle extends its duration by 1.0 sec and generates 8 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 引导狂怒月亮的力量，在8秒内对目标造成2,432点奥术伤害。施放裂伤会使其持续时间延长1.0秒，并产生8点怒气。

spells.description_en: Increases the healing done by Healing Rain by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之雨的治疗效果提高10%，施法时间缩短0.5秒。

spells.description_en: Healing Rain grants an additional use of Downpour.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之雨使你能够额外施放倾盆大雨。

spells.description_en:
Your Boomstick's damage is increased by 40% when striking a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
当你的爆裂火铳仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高40%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低5%。

spells.description_en: Throwing your Wildfire Bomb has a chance to imbue your weapon with flame, causing you and your pet's auto-attacks to deal an additional 14 Fire damage for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 投掷野火炸弹有几率使你的武器附着烈焰，使你和你宠物的自动攻击额外造成14点火焰伤害，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Maul and Raze may consume up to 20 more Rage to deal up to 70% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 重殴和摧折最多会额外消耗20点怒气，额外造成最多70%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Increases Downpour healing by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 倾盆大雨的治疗效果提高20%。

spells.description_en: Mangle has 1 additional charge and when Maul is cast at 80 Rage or above its chance to activate Gore is increased by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 裂伤拥有1层额外充能，并且当使用80点或以上怒气施放重殴时，其触发淤血的几率提高100%。

spells.description_en: Raptor Strike and Kill Command gain 10% increased critical strike chance and 10% increased critical damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 猛禽一击和杀戮命令的爆击几率提高10%，并且造成的爆击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Healing Wave's critical strike chance is increased by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 治疗波的爆击几率提高12%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the mana cost of Healing Wave by 15% and the mana cost of Chain Heal by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 使治疗波的法力消耗降低15%，治疗链的法力消耗降低15%。

spells.description_en: Healing Stream Totem heals 15% more often.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的治疗频率提高15%。

spells.description_en: When Strike as One critically strikes, it bleeds its target for an additional 15 damage over 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当羁绊共狩爆击时，会使目标流血，在5秒内造成额外15点伤害。

spells.description_en: Wildfire Bomb's periodic effect is now a Bleed and grants you and your pet 15 Focus over 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 野火炸弹的周期性伤害现在视为流血效果，并会在3秒内为你和你的宠物产生共计15点集中值。

spells.description_en: All Fire damage dealt is increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 造成的所有火焰伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en:
Consume has a 35% chance to grant 1 stack of Voidfall.

Upon reaching 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes a stack to reach into the Void and call down a meteor strike at your target's location, dealing 672 Cosmic damage to all enemies within 8 yards. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
吞噬有35%的几率获得1层虚落。

达到3层虚落时，收割会消耗1层虚落探入虚空，并在你的目标位置召唤一次流星撞击，对8码内的所有敌人造成667点宇宙伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.
spells.description_zh:
虚空射线的伤害提高15%。

完整引导虚空射线会使你获得1层虚落。

spells.description_en: While at 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes all 3 to rapidly call down that many meteor strikes.
spells.description_zh: 当拥有3层虚落时，收割会消耗所有3层效果，快速召唤同等次数的流星撞击。

spells.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 3% increased movement speed.
spells.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使移动速度提高3%。

spells.description_en: Shift has 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 变换额外获得1次充能。

spells.description_en: Consume generates 2 additional Fury and deals 15% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 吞噬额外产生2点恶魔之怒，造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Awaken memories of past conflicts, causing a Dread Shade to take form nearby.

While active, shades slowly travel toward your target, dealing 24 Nature damage to nearby enemies and mirroring your Thrash casts.
spells.description_zh:
唤醒过往冲突的记忆，使一个恐惧暗影在附近成形。

激活时，暗影会缓慢移向你的目标，对附近敌人造成24点自然伤害，并复制你施放的痛击。

spells.description_en:
Penance has a 25% chance to upgrade Power Word: Shield into Void Shield.

 Void Shield:
Shields 3 allies for 15 sec, absorbing 1,753 damage.
spells.description_zh:
苦修有25%的几率将真言术：盾升级为虚空之盾。

 虚空之盾：
为3名盟友施加护盾，持续15秒，吸收1,747点伤害。

spells.description_en:
Avenging Wrath now grants you 2% Haste.

Each Holy Power spent during Avenging Wrath increases Haste by an additional 2%, up to 20%.
spells.description_zh:
复仇之怒现在使你获得2%的急速。

在复仇之怒期间消耗的每点神圣能量都会使急速额外提高2%，最多20%。

spells.description_en:
Your Eagle is replaced with a Sentinel Owl that applies an enhanced Sentinel's Mark.

Sentinel's Mark
Your next Wildfire Bomb deals 40% increased direct damage to the marked target.
spells.description_zh:
你的雄鹰被替换为一只警戒猫头鹰，会施加一个强化哨兵印记。

哨兵印记
你的下一次野火炸弹对被标记的目标造成的直接伤害提高40%。

spells.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% Haste.
spells.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Activating Void Ray out of combat or within 5 sec of entering combat calls down 3 Voidfall Meteors over its duration.
spells.description_zh: 在脱离战斗或进入战斗后的5秒内激活虚空射线会在其持续时间内召唤3个虚落流星。

spells.description_en: Casting Smite increases the damage of Smite by 25%, stacking 2 times. Lasts 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放惩击会使惩击的伤害提高25%，最多可叠加2层。持续4秒。

spells.description_en: When Sentinel's Mark is consumed, it summons a barrage of 4 lunar missiles, each dealing 70 Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yds.
spells.description_zh: 当哨兵印记被消耗时，会召唤一连串共4发的皎月飞弹，每发对10码内的敌人造成70点奥术伤害。

spells.description_en: Consuming Tip of the Spear grants 2% increased critical strike damage for 10 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 消耗利矛之刃会使爆击伤害提高2%，持续10秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

spells.description_en: Enemies struck by a Voidfall Meteor take an additional 25% damage over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 被虚落流星击中的敌人在8秒内额外受到25%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Roar with earthshattering ferocity, dealing 99 Physical damage, and resetting the cooldown of Thrash and allowing it to stack 5 additional times for 12 sec. 

When Sundering Roar ends, any excess stacks of Thrash immediately deal their remaining damage.
spells.description_zh:
发出震天裂地的咆哮，造成97点物理伤害，并重置痛击的冷却时间，使其在12秒内可额外叠加5次。

碎甲咆哮结束时，所有额外的痛击层数会立即造成其剩余伤害。

spells.description_en: Passive bonuses granted by each stack of Voidfall persist for 8 sec after being consumed.
spells.description_zh: 每层虚落提供的被动加成在被消耗后仍会持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Fire damage dealt increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 造成的火焰伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Collapsing Star and Voidfall meteors deal 30% increased damage when striking a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
当坍缩之星和虚落流星仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高30%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低5%。

spells.description_en:
Consuming Tip of the Spear has a 10% increased chance to summon your Sentinel Owl.

When your Sentinel Owl applies Sentinel's Mark, reduce the cooldown of Wildfire Bomb by 6.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
消耗利矛之刃召唤警戒猫头鹰的几率提高10%。

当你的警戒猫头鹰施加哨兵印记时，野火炸弹的冷却时间缩短6.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Tip of the Spear damage bonus increased by 4%.

Takedown duration increased by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh:
利矛之刃的伤害加成提高4%。

狩魂一击的持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: An additional 15% of Raptor Strike's damage is dealt as Arcane damage over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 猛禽一击在6秒内额外造成15%的伤害，这些伤害视为奥术伤害。

spells.description_en: Sentinel's Mark further increases the damage of Wildfire Bomb by 50%
spells.description_zh: 哨兵印记使野火炸弹的伤害额外提高50%

spells.description_en: Takedown summons your Sentinel Owl and your chance to summon your Sentinel Owl is increased by an additional 10% during Takedown.
spells.description_zh: 狩魂一击会召唤你的警戒猫头鹰，且在狩魂一击期间你召唤警戒猫头鹰的几率额外提高10%

spells.description_en:
Your movement speed is increased by 8%.

Aspect of the Cheetah's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的移动速度提高8%。

猎豹守护的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Enemy detection radius reduced by 10 yds.
spells.description_zh: 敌人侦测范围降低10码。

spells.description_en:
Damaging one or more enemies with your Boomstick grants you 1 stack of Mongoose Fury.

 Mongoose Fury
Raptor Strike damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
爆裂火铳对一个或多个敌人造成伤害时，你获得1层猫鼬之怒。

 猫鼬之怒
猛禽一击的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Combustion's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧的冷却时间缩短60秒。

spells.description_en: Increases Earth Shield healing by 40%.
spells.description_zh: 大地之盾的治疗效果提高40%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Riptide by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 激流的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Combustion grants you 10% increased spell damage plus an additional 20% of your critical strike chance as spell damage.
spells.description_zh: 燃烧期间，你的法术伤害提高10%，并额外将20%的爆击几率转化为法术伤害。

spells.description_en:
The explosion effect of Putrefy extends the duration of your plagues by 3.0 sec and deals 35% of the damage they would deal over that time instantly.

Putrefy now applies your plagues to unaffected targets.
spells.description_zh:
腐化的爆炸效果会使疫病的持续时间延长3.0秒，并立即造成其原定持续时间内35%的伤害。

腐化现可将疫病施加于未受影响的目标。

spells.description_en:
Fire Blast now spreads 50% of your target's Ignite to 1 enemy.

Flamestrike applies 15% more Ignite.
spells.description_zh:
火焰冲击现在会将目标身上50%的灼烧效果扩散至1名敌人。

烈焰风暴施加的点燃效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: Fire Blast damage increased by 10% and it now spreads Ignite to 1 additional target.
spells.description_zh: 火焰冲击的伤害提高10%，并会将点燃扩散至额外1个目标身上。

spells.description_en:
Calls down a pillar of fire on your target, burning all enemies within the area for 1,482 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

This spell is cast at your target.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一根火柱，燃烧区域内的所有敌人，造成1,468点火焰伤害。目标数量超过8个后，造成的伤害降低

此法术会对你的目标施放。

spells.description_en: The enemy closest to the center of Meteor's impact takes 75% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 距离流星撞击中心最近的敌人现在受到的伤害提高75%。

spells.description_en: Casting Pyroblast or Flamestrike has a 8% chance to summon a storm of 5 cinders that pursue your target. Upon reaching your target, each cinder deals 843 Fire damage, applies Ignite at 100% effectiveness, and spreads 50% of your Ignite to up to 1 nearby target.
spells.description_zh: 施放炎爆术或烈焰风暴时，有8%的几率召唤由5枚余烬组成的风暴追击你的目标。每枚余烬命中时会造成795点火焰伤害，以100%的效果施加引燃，并将你的点燃以50%的效果扩散至附近最多1个目标。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Alter Time is reduced by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 操控时间的冷却时间缩短10秒。

spells.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% reduced damage taken.
spells.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使受到的伤害降低2%。

spells.description_en: Gain 3 stacks of Voidfall and reset the cooldown of Reap upon activating Void Metamorphosis.
spells.description_zh: 激活虚空变形时，获得3层虚落并重置收割的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Your first Collapsing Star after casting Void Metamorphosis causes a Cosmic meteor shower to assault the area, dealing 2,248 Cosmic damage over 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在施放虚空变形后，你的第一次坍缩之星会召唤一阵宇宙流星雨袭击该区域，在6秒内造成2,301点宇宙伤害。

spells.description_en: The third Voidfall meteor strike called down in sequence is larger, has 50% increased area, deals 50% increased damage, and generates 1 Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh: 连续召唤的第三次虚落流星撞击规模更大，范围扩大50%，造成的伤害提高50%，并且产生1个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en:
Essence abilities have a chance to infuse your next Reversion with the power of the Green Dragonflight, upgrading it to Merithra's Blessing:

 Merithra's Blessing
Spring a bloom of life from your target, healing them and up to 4 other allies within 30 yards for 855. Blooms may heal your primary target multiple times if no nearby injured allies are present.
spells.description_zh:
精华技能有几率使你下一次逆转注入绿龙军团的力量，将其升级为麦琳瑟拉的祝福：

 麦琳瑟拉的祝福
从你的目标处绽放生命之花，为其和30码内最多4名其他盟友治疗855点生命值。如果附近没有受伤的盟友，绽放可能会多次治疗你的主要目标。

spells.description_en: Adrenaline Rush magnifies your precision and power, increasing the damage your combo point generating abilities and finishers deal by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 冲动会强化你的精准与力量，使你的连击点获取技能与终结技造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Putrefying a Lesser Ghoul has a 100% chance to reanimate it as a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

When you control 3 Magus of the Dead, sacrifice them to summon their Lord of the Dead for 15 sec, casting Frostbolts that chain between 2 enemies. Magus with higher remaining duration grant increased power.
spells.description_zh:
腐化次级食尸鬼时有100%几率将其复活为亡者魔导师，向敌人发射寒冰箭和暗影箭，持续15秒。

当你控制3名亡者魔导师时，牺牲它们召唤亡者之主，持续15秒，发射在2个敌人间弹射的寒冰箭。剩余持续时间越长的魔导师赋予的力量越强。

spells.description_en:
Takedown damage increased by 50% and it now strikes 4 additional nearby targets.

During Takedown, your attack speed is increased by 100%.
spells.description_zh:
狩魂一击的伤害提高50%，并且现在会额外攻击4个附近的目标。

在狩魂一击期间，你的攻击速度提高100%。

spells.description_en: Raptor Strike and Boomstick deal 20% increased critical strike damage.
spells.description_zh: 猛禽一击与爆裂火铳造成的爆击伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Consume the life force of each target afflicted by your damaging periodic effects, dealing 12,764 Shadowflame damage over 2.7 sec.

Damage dealt by Dark Harvest heals you for 50% of damage done.
spells.description_zh:
吞噬每个受你伤害性持续效果影响的目标的生命力，在2.7秒内造成12,764点暗影烈焰伤害。

幽冥收割造成的伤害会为你恢复相当于伤害值50%的生命值。

spells.description_en: Consuming Hot Streak has a 20% chance to grant you a stack of Fired Up, increasing your Fire damage by 2% for 8 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 消耗炽热连击时，有20%的几率获得一层焚烧殆尽，使你的火焰伤害提高2%，持续8秒。多次使用可叠加此效果。

spells.description_en: Touch of the Magi increases the damage your target receives from you by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 大法师之触使你对目标造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your maximum health is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的最大生命值提高5%。

spells.description_en: Aspect of the Cheetah's initial burst of speed is increased by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 猎豹守护的初始速度爆发持续时间延长2.0秒。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Aspect of the Cheetah is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 猎豹守护的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Aspect of the Turtle is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 灵龟守护的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Feign Death is reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 假死的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Intimidation now also stuns nearby enemies for 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 胁迫现在还会使附近敌人昏迷1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Lava Burst deals 10% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 熔岩爆裂额外造成10%伤害。

spells.description_en:
Elemental Resonance
All elemental damage is increased by an additional 2%.

 Thunderstrike Ward
Increases the chance for Thunderstrikes to occur by 30% and increases Thunderstrike damage by 75%.
spells.description_zh:
元素共鸣
所有元素伤害额外提高2%。

 雷霆打击结界
雷霆打击的触发几率提高30%且伤害提高75%。

spells.description_en: All Elemental damage increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 所有元素伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake deal 20% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 大地震击、元素冲击和地震术造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Raptor Strike has a 25% chance to upgrade itself to a Raptor Swipe, dealing 98 Physical damage to all enemies within 15 yds in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh: 猛禽一击有25%的几率升级为猛禽横扫，对你前方15码范围内的所有敌人造成96点物理伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake deal 10% increased damage to targets affected by Flame Shock.
spells.description_zh: 闪电箭、闪电链、大地震击、元素冲击和地震术对受烈焰震击影响的目标造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Breath of Eons summons a version of you from the future to assist you in battle, lasting 20 sec. Your duplicate casts Eruption, Fire Breath, and Upheaval.
spells.description_zh: 亘古吐息会召唤一个来自未来的你协助战斗，持续20秒。你的复制体会施放喷发、火焰吐息和地壳激变。

spells.description_en: Your chance for Sinister Strike to strike twice and grant Opportunity is increased by 10%
spells.description_zh: 你的影袭攻击两次并获得可乘之机的几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Adrenaline Rush's duration is increased by 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冲动的持续时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en: Blade Flurry causes your attacks to hit nearby enemies for an additional 8% of their normal damage.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃乱舞使你的攻击对附近敌人造成额外8%的普通伤害。

spells.description_en:
Voltaic Blaze unleashes volcanic rage, causing your next Lava Burst to also fire at 5 additional targets with your Flame Shock at 80% effectiveness with reduced Maelstrom generation.

Lava Burst damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
流电炽焰释放火山之怒，使你下一次熔岩爆裂同时轰击5个额外目标，这些目标需受到你的烈焰震击影响，效果为80%，且产生的漩涡值降低。

熔岩爆裂伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
The cooldown of Between the Eyes is reduced by 8 sec.

Between the Eyes increases your damage dealt by an additional 1%.
spells.description_zh:
正中眉心的冷却时间缩短8秒。

正中眉心使你造成的伤害额外提高1%。

spells.description_en:
The bonuses granted by your Roll the Bones are stronger.

Bonuses to chance for Sinister Strike to strike twice are 5% greater.
Bonuses to Sinister Strike and Ambush damage are 5% greater.
Bonuses to Restless Blades cooldown reduction are 10% greater.
Jackpot's bonus to critical strike chance is 5% greater.
spells.description_zh:
你的命运骨骰获得的增益效果更强。

影袭攻击两次的几率增益效果提高5%。
影袭和伏击的伤害增益效果提高5%。
无休锋刃的冷却缩减增益效果提高10%。
头奖的爆击几率增益效果提高5%。

spells.description_en: Your auto-attack critical strikes increase the damage and critical strike chance of your next Between the Eyes by 2%, stacking up to 20 times.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击爆击时，你的下一次正中眉心的伤害和爆击几率就会提高2%，最多可叠加20次。

spells.description_en: Sinister Strike and Ambush deal 20% increased damage. They also generate 5 Energy when they grant you Opportunity.
spells.description_zh: 影袭和伏击造成的伤害提高20%。还会在它们触发可乘之机时产生5点能量。

spells.description_en: Between the Eyes increases your damage dealt by an additional 2%.
spells.description_zh: 正中眉心使你造成的伤害额外提高2%。

spells.description_en: Your finishing moves deal 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: After spending 15 combo points, if you spend no combo points for 4 sec, abilities affected by Restless Blades will cool down 200% faster for 5 sec or until you spend a combo point.
spells.description_zh: 在消耗15个连击点数后，如果你在4秒内未消耗连击点数，则受无休锋刃影响的技能的冷却速度提高200%，持续5秒，或直到你消耗一个连击点。

spells.description_en:
Afflicts the target with 1,480 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Multiple uses of this ability may overlap.

If dispelled, deals 20,493 damage to the dispeller and silences them for 4 sec. This damage is increased by 15% per stack on the target.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies while afflicted.
spells.description_zh:
使目标遭受痛苦，在8秒内造成1,480点暗影伤害。多次使用该技能可以叠加。

如果此效果被驱散，对驱散者造成20,493点伤害，并使其沉默4秒。目标身上每有一层此效果，伤害提高15%。

如果目标在效果持续期间死亡，产生1块灵魂碎片。

spells.description_en: Mastery increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases damage dealt by Unstable Affliction and Seed of Corruption by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 痛苦无常和腐蚀之种的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Increases Agony damage by 10% and Agony now hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.
spells.description_zh: 痛楚的伤害提高10%，并且痛楚现在会命中目标附近15码内的其他敌人。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Seed of Corruption by 0.20 sec and increases its damage by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 腐蚀之种的施法时间缩短0.20秒，其伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Casting Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption reduces the cooldown of Dark Harvest by 1.5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 施放痛苦无常或腐蚀之种会使幽冥收割的冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

spells.description_en: Critical strike damage dealt by your abilities and auto-attacks increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的技能和自动攻击造成的爆击伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Agony damage is increased by 10% and starts at 3 stacks.
spells.description_zh: 痛楚的伤害提高10%，并且起始层数为3层。

spells.description_en: When Unstable Affliction expires, it has a 10% chance to reapply itself.
spells.description_zh: 当你的痛苦无常持续时间结束时，有10%几率重新施放。

spells.description_en: Damage dealt by Shadow Bolt has a 20% chance to make your next Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption cost no Soul Shards and cast instantly.
spells.description_zh: 暗影箭造成的伤害有20%的几率使你的下一个痛苦无常或腐蚀之种不消耗灵魂碎片，且变为瞬发。

spells.description_en:
Each time your Phoenix casts a spell, gain 1 stack of Mana Cascade.

Exceptional spells grant 1 additional stack.
spells.description_zh:
每次你的凤凰施放法术时，获得1层法力涌流。

特殊法术额外提供1层。

spells.description_en: Divine Toll casts 2 additional times on your target at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 圣洁鸣钟额外对你的目标施放2次，效果为100%。

spells.description_en: Tip the Scales' cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 扭转天平的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en:
Rising Sun Kick and Vivify have a chance to activate Spiritfont, causing your next Enveloping Mist's cast time to be reduced by 50% and channel Soothing Mist from you onto up to 5 allies at 20% effectiveness for 8 sec.

If Spiritfont's Soothing Mists heal a full health target, they will jump to another injured ally or split its healing into your remaining Soothing Mists.
spells.description_zh:
旭日东升踢和活血术有几率激活灵泉，使你的下一次氤氲之雾的施法时间缩短50%，并为你向最多5名盟友引导抚慰之雾，效果为20%，持续8秒。

如果灵泉的抚慰之雾治疗了一个生命值全满的目标，则会跳跃到另一个受伤的盟友身上，或者将其治疗量分摊到剩余的抚慰之雾中。

spells.description_en:
Arcane Salvo can stack 5 additional times.

Meteorite damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
奥术齐射可额外叠加5次。

陨星的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Healing Stream Totem by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Chrono Flames' maximum damage or healing is increased by 40%, up to 1,330 Arcane.
spells.description_zh: 时序烈焰的最大伤害或治疗效果提高40%，最高可达1,330点奥术效果。

spells.description_en:
Voltaic Blaze generates 2 additional Maelstrom Weapon and has a 30% chance to cause a Fire Nova.

Fire Nova
Erupt a burst of fiery damage from all targets affected by your Flame Shock, dealing 35 Volcanic damage to up to 6 targets within 8 yds of your Flame Shock targets.
spells.description_zh:
流电炽焰额外产生2层漩涡武器，并有30%的几率触发一次火焰新星。

火焰新星
引导烈火在受你烈焰震击影响的所有目标身上爆发，对受影响目标周围8码范围内至多6名敌人造成34点熔火伤害。

spells.description_en:
Each wave of Arcane Missiles has a 10% chance to summon a Meteorite.

When a Meteorite lands, you have a 5% chance to gain Clearcasting.
spells.description_zh:
每一波奥术飞弹有10%的几率召唤一颗陨星。

陨星降落时，你有5%的几率获得节能施法。

spells.description_en: While flying during Deep Breath you are assisted by a squadron of Dracthyr who assault enemies with Pyre, dealing 952 Fire damage to nearby enemies up to 8 times.
spells.description_zh: 在深呼吸飞行期间，你会动员由龙希尔组成的特遣队，使用葬火对目标发起猛攻。对附近的敌人造成951点火焰伤害，最多触发8次。

spells.description_en: Healing Stream Totem and Healing Tide Totem healing has a 8% chance to apply Earthliving to allies it heals.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾和治疗之潮图腾的治疗效果有8%的几率对受到治疗的盟友施加大地生命。

spells.description_en: Slam has a 10% increased chance to trigger Tactician.
spells.description_zh: 猛击触发战术专家的几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Slam's Rage cost is reduced by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 猛击的怒气消耗减少25%。

spells.description_en: Colossus Smash generates 15 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 巨人打击产生15点怒气。

spells.description_en: Colossus Smash grants 6 stacks of Sweeping Strikes.
spells.description_zh: 巨人打击使你获得6层横扫攻击。

spells.description_en: Secondary targets take an additional 20% damage from Sweeping Strikes.
spells.description_zh: 次级目标在横扫攻击中额外受到20%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Colossus Smash immediately grants 1 use of Sudden Death.
spells.description_zh: 巨人打击立即使你获得1次使用猝死的机会。

spells.description_en: Colossus Smash causes your next 2 Cleaves within 20 sec to trigger no cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 巨人打击会使你在20秒内施放的下2次顺劈斩不触发冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Tactician has a 5% increased chance to trigger.
spells.description_zh: 战术专家的触发几率提高5%。

spells.description_en:
Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target.

 Deep Wounds
Causes the target to suffer 50 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.
spells.description_zh:
斩杀对目标造成重伤。

 重伤
使目标在6秒内受到50点流血伤害。如果刷新此效果，所有剩余伤害将添加到新的重伤效果中。

spells.description_en:
Mortal Strike and Slam critical strikes inflict Deep Wounds at 100% effectiveness.

 Deep Wounds
Causes the target to suffer 50 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.
spells.description_zh:
致死打击和猛击的爆击会以100%的效果造成重伤。

 重伤
使目标在6秒内受到50点流血伤害。如果刷新此效果，所有剩余伤害将添加到新的重伤效果中。

spells.description_en:
Direct damage from Arcane Splinters have a 25% chance to grant 1 stack Arcane Salvo.

 Arcane Salvo
Increases the damage of your next Arcane Barrage by 3%.
spells.description_zh:
来自奥术碎片的直接伤害有25%的几率获得1次奥术齐射。

 奥术齐射
你的下一个奥术弹幕伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en:
Casting Arcane Barrage while at 20 or more Arcane Salvo stacks refunds 3 Arcane Salvo stacks.

Arcane Barrage damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
在拥有20层及以上的奥术齐射时，施放奥术弹幕可以返还3层奥术齐射。

奥术弹幕的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your Arcane Familiar has a 50% chance to conjure a Splinter alongside its Arcane Assault.
spells.description_zh: 你的奥术魔宠有50%的几率在施展奥术突袭的同时召唤出一枚碎片。

spells.description_en: Art of War increases the damage of your next Blade of Justice by 80% and can now accumulate an additional time.
spells.description_zh: 战争艺术使你下一次公正之剑的伤害提高80%，且可额外累积一次。

spells.description_en: Casting Unstable Affliction on a target affected by your Unstable Affliction increases your Haste by 5% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 对一个受到痛苦无常影响的目标施放痛苦无常，会使你的急速提高5%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
While Darkglare is active, your Shadow Bolt becomes Malefic Grasp. 

 Malefic Grasp
Binds the target in twilight, dealing 4,003 Shadow damage over 3.6 sec.

When Malefic Grasp deals damage, it causes all of your other periodic Affliction damage effects to instantly deal 30% of their normal periodic damage.
spells.description_zh:
黑眼激活时，你的暗影箭转化为灾难之握。

灾难之握
用暮光束缚目标，在3.6秒内造成4,003点暗影伤害。

灾难之握造成伤害时，会使你所有其他痛苦系持续伤害效果立即造成相当于其正常周期性伤害的30%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Unload a series of 4 shotgun blasts 20 yds in front of you, dealing 851 Physical damage over 2.7 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 使用霰弹枪对前方20码范围内连射4次，在2.7秒内造成851点物理伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Damaging one or more enemies with your Boomstick reduces the cooldown of Wildfire Bomb by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 爆裂火铳对一个或多个敌人造成伤害时，野火炸弹的冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

spells.description_en: Mass Disintegrate strikes 1 additional target.
spells.description_zh: 群体裂解额外攻击1个目标。

spells.description_en: Essence abilities deal 15% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 精华技能会额外造成15%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Empyrean Hammer deals 20% increased critical strike damage and its critical strikes have 50% chance to grant an additional stack of Light's Deliverance.
spells.description_zh: 苍穹之锤造成额外20%的爆击伤害，其爆击有50%几率额外获得一层圣光裁决。

spells.description_en: Blackout Kick deals 20% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.
spells.description_zh: 幻灭踢的伤害提高20%，神鹤引项踢的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Divine Protection reduces damage taken by an additional 10% and casts Shield of Vengeance.

Shield of Vengeance
Creates a barrier of holy light that absorbs 9,165 damage for 10 sec.

When the shield expires, it bursts to inflict Holy damage equal to the total amount absorbed, divided among all nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh:
圣佑术使你受到的伤害额外降低10%并施放复仇之盾。

复仇之盾
制造一个圣光壁垒，吸收9,165点伤害，持续10秒。

当壁垒持续时间结束时会产生爆炸，造成相当于吸收伤害总量的神圣伤害，由附近的所有敌人分摊。

spells.description_en: Activating an Eclipse makes your next Wrath or Starfire instant. The first 3 Starsurges or Starfalls you cast during each Eclipse deal 20% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 激活日月之蚀会使你的下一个愤怒或星火术变为瞬发。每次日月之蚀期间，你施放的前3次星涌术或星辰坠落造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
While in combat, generate 1 Soul Fragment every 12 sec.

While out of combat, you will slowly build towards your Void Metamorphosis, up to 25 Soul Fragments.
spells.description_zh:
在战斗中，每12秒产生1个灵魂残片。

脱离战斗时，你会缓慢地积累虚空变形所需的能量，最多25个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en:
Every 3 Chi spent generates Tigereye Brew. Zenith consumes up to 20 Tigereye Brew stacks to increase your critical strike chance for its duration by 1% per stack.

Generates quickly up to 10 stacks while out of combat and may generate up to a maximum of 30 stacks.
spells.description_zh:
每消耗3点真气都会产生虎眼酒效果。乾元之巅会消耗最多20层虎眼酒，每消耗一层使你在其持续期间的爆击几率提高1%。

在战斗外会快速生成最多10层，最多可产生30层。

spells.description_en:
Perform a powerful off-role ability depending on your currently active shapeshift form.

Non-shapeshifted:
Empowered Wild Growth that heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 10,757 over 7 sec.

Bear Form:
Increase your maximum health by 30% for 20 sec.
spells.description_zh:
根据你当前激活的变形形态施放强大的其他职责技能。

非变形形态：
强效野性成长，在7秒内治疗目标30码范围内最多5名受伤的盟友，恢复10,757点生命值。

熊形态：
使你的最大生命值提高30%，持续20秒。

spells.description_en:
Haunt now calls upon a demonic soul from within the Twisting Nether to haunt your target.

The soul is unstable and ravenous, dealing 3,093 Shadow damage to its host and 3 enemies within 10 yards suffering from your Corruption over its duration.
spells.description_zh:
鬼影缠身现在会从扭曲虚空中召唤一个恶魔灵魂来折磨你的目标。

该灵魂不稳定且贪婪，在其持续时间内会对宿主和10码范围内3个受到你腐蚀术影响的目标造成3,093点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Exploding Keg also causes your next 2 casts of Keg Smash to summon a whirl of flame which spirals outwards, dealing 70 additional Fire damage to each enemy struck.
spells.description_zh: 爆炸酒桶还会使你的下2个醉酿投召唤出一道螺旋向外的火焰旋风，对击中的每个敌人造成70点额外火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Mark of the Wild is 100% more effective on yourself.
spells.description_zh: 你对自己施放野性印记时，效果提高100%。

spells.description_en: Exploding Keg can be reactivated within 20 sec to throw 5 additional kegs at nearby targets, each dealing 70 Physical damage and reducing the cooldown of your Brews by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 爆炸酒桶可以在20秒内再次激活，向附近目标投掷5个额外酒桶，每个酒桶造成70点物理伤害，并使你的酒类技能冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

spells.description_en: Crackling Jade Lightning deals its damage in 75% less time, costs 75% less Energy, and strikes 4 additional targets, but has a 60 sec cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 碎玉闪电造成伤害所需时间缩短75%，能量消耗降低75%，并额外击中4个目标，但有60秒的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: Wildfire Bomb reduces the cooldown of Boomstick by 2.0 sec for each enemy hit, up to 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 野火炸弹每命中一个敌人，就会使爆裂火铳的冷却时间缩短2.0秒，最多缩短10秒。

spells.description_en:
Mastery increased by 3%.

You gain 5% increased Mastery from all Mastery sources.
spells.description_zh:
精通提高3%。

你从所有精通来源获得的精通提高5%。

spells.description_en: Activating Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox instantly grants 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes that trigger on your next attack at 70% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 激活玄牛下凡会立即获得10层疾风乱打，在你的下一次攻击时触发，效果为70%。

spells.description_en: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox's stomp damage increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 玄牛下凡的践踏伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en: Flurry Strikes deal 18 Nature damage to all enemies within 6 yds, reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 疾风乱打对6码内的所有敌人造成18点自然伤害，超过8个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Purifying Brew also surrounds you with protective energies for 15 sec. 

When Staggered damage would be dealt to you, you instead absorb up to 50%, until 210 has been prevented.
spells.description_zh:
活血酒还会用保护性的能量包围你，持续15秒。

当醉拳即将对你造成伤害时，你改为吸收最多50%的伤害，直到防止了210点伤害为止。

spells.description_en: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning deal 20% increased damage and have a 20% chance to refund the Maelstrom Weapon spent.
spells.description_zh: 闪电箭和闪电链的伤害提高20%，并且有20%的几率返还消耗的漩涡武器。

spells.description_en: Heal for 50% of all Fire or Nature damage dealt by your spells and abilities.
spells.description_zh: 你法术和技能造成的所有火焰或自然伤害的50%会为你恢复生命值。

spells.description_en: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift have a chance to trigger Heart of the Jade Serpent for 4 sec at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 活血术和神龙之赐有几率以100%的效果触发青龙之心，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: Heart of the Jade Serpent increases your haste by 10% while active.
spells.description_zh: 青龙之心激活时，你的急速提高10%。

spells.description_en: Each Maelstrom Weapon spent has a 2% chance to cause your next Crash Lightning to ignore its cooldown. The weapon enhancement effect of Crash Lightning may now overlap.
spells.description_zh: 每消耗一层漩涡武器，就有2%%的几率使你的下一个毁灭闪电无视其冷却时间。毁灭闪电的武器强化效果现在可以叠加。

spells.description_en: Prayer of Mending healing has a chance to upgrade your next Flash Heal to Benediction, healing the target for 30% more and causing a Cosmic Ripple.
spells.description_zh: 愈合祷言的治疗效果有几率将你的下一个快速治疗升级为祈福，使该技能对目标的治疗效果提高30%，并引发一次宇宙涟漪。

spells.description_en: Strength of the Black Ox's effect is 400% more effective on your primary target.
spells.description_zh: 玄牛之力的效果对你的主要目标提高400%。

spells.description_en: Casting Glacial Spike also casts a Pyroblast, dealing 3,726 Fire damage.
spells.description_zh: 施放冰川尖刺也会施放炎爆术，造成3,657点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Your Frostfire spells apply Ignite at 10% increased effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 你的霜火法术施加点燃效果，效果提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Meteor and Pyroblast now apply Ignite.

Your Haste is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh:
流星和炎爆术现在会附加点燃效果。

你的急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Shattering an enemy has a 10% chance to summon a Hand of Frost to pursue your target, dealing 2,089 Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Freezing on contact.
spells.description_zh: 粉碎敌人有10%的几率召唤寒冰之手追击你的目标，造成1,750点冰霜伤害，并在接触时附加1层冻结效果。

spells.description_en: Mastery increased by 5%. Double this effect while Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is active.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高5%。玄牛下凡激活时，此效果翻倍。

spells.description_en: Templar's Verdict damage increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 圣殿骑士的裁决的伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Mastery increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高2%。

spells.description_en: Drinking from a Brew increases your movement speed by 15% and your auto-attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 饮用佳酿会使你的移动速度提高15%，自动攻击速度提高10%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en:
Drinking from Brews has a 30% chance to coat you with Celestial Flames for 6 sec. While Celestial Flames is active:

 Special Delivery:
Kegs thrown by Special Delivery are ignited and splash upon landing, dealing 35 Fire damage to up to 5 nearby enemies.

 Rushing Jade Wind:
Rushing Jade Wind becomes a firestorm, increasing its radius by 30% and causing it to deal Fire damage.
spells.description_zh:
使用酒类技能时，有30%的几率使你获得天神烈焰，持续6秒。当天神烈焰激活时：

 特别快递：
特别快递投掷的酒桶会被点燃，在落地时迸裂，对最多5名附近敌人造成35点火焰伤害。

 碧玉疾风：
碧玉疾风变为火焰风暴，半径扩大30%，并造成火焰伤害。

spells.description_en:
Sprout an additional limb, pulling enemies further than 8 yds from you every 1 sec.  

The same enemy can only be pulled once every 4 sec.
spells.description_zh:
额外长出一段附肢，每1秒将距离你8码以上的敌人拉向你的位置。

同一个敌人每4秒只能被拉动一次。

spells.description_en:
When you Ferocious Bite, you have a 15% chance per combo point spent to flicker to an enemy within 30 yds and deliver an Unseen Attack. Unseen Attack damage is reduced if less than 5 combo points and 50 Energy are spent on Ferocious Bite.

 Unseen Slash
Slash the target, dealing 23 Physical damage and an additional 48 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new Bleed.

 Unseen Swipe
Swipe nearby targets, dealing 65 Physical damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
当你施放凶猛撕咬时，每消耗一个连击点数就有15%的几率闪烁到30码内的一个敌人身边，发动一次无形攻击。如果施放凶猛撕咬时消耗的连击点数少于5点且消耗的能量值为50点，无形攻击的伤害则会降低。

 隐匿爪伤
切割目标，造成23点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成48点流血伤害。如果重新施加此效果，任何剩余伤害将添加到新的流血效果中。

 隐秘横扫
横扫附近目标，造成66点物理伤害。超过5个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
When you cast Dancing Rune Weapon, you become enveloped in a blood mist that surrounds you for 8 sec, increasing your Parry by 5%. 

Deals 22 Shadow damage every 1 sec to enemies within 10 yds. Every time it deals damage you gain 2 Runic Power, up to a maximum of 10 Runic Power. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
施放符文刃舞时，你被血腥之雾包围，持续8秒，你的招架提高5%。

每1秒对10码范围内的敌人造成22点暗影伤害。每次它造成伤害你都会获得2点符文能量，最多获得10点符文能量。目标多于8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: When Blood Mist ends it deals 97 Shadow damage to 8 nearby enemies, healing you for 18% of the damage dealt. The damage is increased by 2% for every 1 Runic Power spent while Blood Mist was active.
spells.description_zh: 当血腥之雾结束时，它会对附近的8名敌人造成98点暗影伤害，为你恢复生命值，数值相当于造成伤害的18%。血腥之雾激活时，每消耗1点符文能量，伤害就会提高2%。

spells.description_en: Infusion of Light occurs 100% more often during Avenging Wrath.
spells.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，圣光灌注的触发频率提高100%。

spells.description_en: Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.5 sec when it heals an ally with full health.
spells.description_zh: 晨光治疗生命值全满的盟友时，其持续时间延长0.5秒。

spells.description_en:
Empower the runes in your weapon, reducing the damage you take over the duration and unleashing a devastating attack that deals 218 Shadow damage and consumes up to 75% of your Blood Plague instantly from enemies in front of you.

I: Consumes up to 25% of your Blood Plague. While empowering, your damage taken is reduced by 5% and an additional 8 sec after empowering.

II: Consumes up to 50% of your Blood Plague. While empowering, your damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 4 sec after empowering.

III: Consumes up to 75% of your Blood Plague. While empowering, your damage taken is reduced by 15% and an additional 2 sec after empowering.
spells.description_zh:
强化武器上的符文，降低你在持续期间内受到的伤害，并发动毁灭性的攻击，造成218点暗影伤害，立即从前方的敌人身上吞噬最多75%血之疫病。

I：吞噬最多25%血之疫病。强化期间，你受到的伤害降低5%，并在强化后额外持续8秒。

II：吞噬最多50%血之疫病。强化期间，你受到的伤害降低10%，并在强化后额外持续4秒。

III：吞噬最多75%血之疫病。强化期间，你受到的伤害降低15%，并在强化后额外持续2秒。

spells.description_en: Regrowth heals all other allies with Regrowth for 10% of its healing.
spells.description_zh: 愈合会以10%的效果治疗所有其他带有愈合效果的盟友。

spells.description_en: Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath.
spells.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，晨光的爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of your Felguard's Felstorm is reduced by 10 sec and damage dealt to your primary demon is reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你的恶魔卫士的邪能风暴的冷却时间缩短10秒，你的主要恶魔受到的伤害降低10%。

spells.description_en: When your Wild Imps cast Fel Firebolt, they have 10% chance to instantly cast another Fel Firebolt at 200% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 当你的野生小鬼施放恶魔火焰箭时，有10%的几率立即额外施放一次效果为200%的恶魔火焰箭。

spells.description_en: When an effect from an Idol is activated, conjure Shadowy Apparitions.
spells.description_zh: 神像的效果激活时，召唤暗影幻灵。

spells.description_en: Death Strike hits an additional 2 enemies at 75% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 灵界打击以75%的效果额外攻击2个敌人。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath gains an additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息获得一层额外充能。

spells.description_en: When summoning a Dire Beast, you have a 10% chance to instead summon a Dark Hound that deals significantly increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 召唤凶暴野兽时，你有10%的几率改为召唤一只黑暗猎犬，其造成的伤害显著提高。

spells.description_en:
Bestial Wrath summons a Dark Hound.

For 15 sec after casting Bestial Wrath, Bestial Wrath is replaced with Wailing Arrow.

 Wailing Arrow
Fire an enchanted arrow, dealing 497 Shadow damage to your target and an additional 245 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds of your target. Non-Player targets struck by a Wailing Arrow have their spellcasting interrupted and are silenced for 1 sec.

Grants Deathblow.
spells.description_zh:
狂野怒火召唤一个黑暗猎犬。

施放狂野怒火后的15秒内，狂野怒火会被哀恸箭替代。

 哀恸箭
射出一支魔法箭，对你的目标造成501点暗影伤害，并对目标周围8码范围内的所有敌人额外造成245点暗影伤害。打断被哀恸箭击中的非玩家目标的施法，并使其沉默1秒。

使你获得夺命打击。

spells.description_en:
You fire 2 additional Black Arrows during Withering Fire's barrage.

Beast Cleave and Kill Cleave damage increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
你在凋零射击的弹幕期间额外发射2支黑蚀箭。

野兽顺劈和杀戮顺劈的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Death Strike heals for an additional 20% of its healing over 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 灵界打击在5秒内额外恢复相当于治疗量20%的生命值。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续伤害时间延长4秒。

spells.description_en:
You focus on the target struck by your Devastator, dealing 30% additional Revenge and Execute damage to them.

Only one target can have your focus at a time.
spells.description_zh:
你专注于被你的灭绝者击中的目标，对其额外造成30%的复仇和斩杀伤害。

同一时间只能专注于一个目标。

spells.description_en:
Command your pet to thrash all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 66 Physical damage to them. Damage is increased by 300% if Wild Thrash hits 2 or more enemies.

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
命令你的宠物抽打10码内的所有敌人，对其造成66点物理伤害。如果狂野鞭笞击中2个或更多敌人，则伤害提高300%。

超过8个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息的冷却时间缩短5秒。

spells.description_en: Direct damage from Fire Breath consumes absorb shields from enemies, dealing 4,600 additional Spellfrost damage to them.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成的直接伤害会消耗敌人的吸收护盾，对其额外造成4,609点法术冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en: While Dancing Rune Weapon is active, Parrying an attack has a 100% chance to make your next Heart Strike cost no Runes and deal 150% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 符文刃舞激活期间，招架敌人的攻击有100%的几率使你的下一个心脏打击不消耗符文，并且造成的伤害提高150%。

spells.description_en: Entering an Eclipse summons a Dryad to assist you for 8 sec, casting Starsurge dealing 566 Astral damage and Starfall at 250% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 进入日月之蚀时召唤一个树妖协助你，持续8秒，施放星涌术会造成573点星界伤害，获得250%的星辰坠落效果。

spells.description_en: When Regrowth critically heals, it is 260% effective instead of the usual 200%.
spells.description_zh: 当愈合产生爆击时，其效果为260%，而非通常的200%。

spells.description_en: Casting Ascendance upgrades your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.
spells.description_zh: 施放升腾会将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。

spells.description_en: Kill Command causes your Dark Hound to Shadow Thrash, dealing 73 Shadow damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 杀戮命令使你的黑暗猎犬发动暗影痛击，对最多8名附近的敌人造成73点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Nature damage is increased by 2%
spells.description_zh: 自然伤害提高2%。

spells.description_en: Storm Elemental lasts 2 sec longer, and Stormkeeper generates 10 Maelstrom.
spells.description_zh: 风暴元素的持续时间延长2秒，且风暴守护者产生10点漩涡值。
