spells.description_en: Shuriken Storm has a 15% chance to create a Shadow Clone that repeats the attack for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
spells.description_zh: 袖剑风暴有15%的几率创造一个暗影克隆体，该克隆体会重复这次攻击，造成相当于正常伤害50%的暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Your mastery is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 你的精通提高3%。

spells.description_en: Dryads cause most of your Astral power generation to be increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 树妖使你的大部分星界能量生成提高10。

spells.description_en:
Your auto shot have a very high chance to grants 3 Focus to you and your pet.

Auto shot damage increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh:
你的自动射击有极高的几率为你和你的宠物提供3点集中值。

自动射击伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: The damage bonus from your Wyvern now lasts an additional 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的双足飞龙的伤害加成现在额外持续2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Hogstrider further increases the damage of Cobra Shot by 25% and it now strikes up to 3 additional targets.
spells.description_zh: 猪突猛进使眼镜蛇射击的伤害进一步提高25%，并且现在最多额外攻击3个目标。

spells.description_en: Your Starfall damage is increased by 18% and your Starsurge damage is increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 你的星辰坠落伤害提高18%，星涌术伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en:
For 15 sec after casting Takedown, Takedown is replaced with Moonlight Chakram.

 Moonlight Chakram
Throw a chakram blessed with moonlight at your current target that will rapidly deal 98 Physical damage 7 times, bouncing to other targets if they are nearby.
spells.description_zh:
施放狩魂一击后的15秒内，狩魂一击被替换为月光战轮。

 月光战轮
向你当前的目标投掷一枚受月光祝福的战轮，迅速造成98点物理伤害，共造成7次伤害。如果附近有其他目标，战轮则会在其中进行弹跳。

spells.description_en: Your Moonlight Chakram deals 25% increased damage each time it bounces.
spells.description_zh: 你的月光战轮每弹跳一次，造成的伤害就提高25%。

spells.description_en: When your Moonlight Chakram expires, it summons an explosion of moonlight, dealing 69 Arcane damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh: 当你的月光战轮消失时，会召唤一次月光爆炸，对附近的敌人造成70点奥术伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Increases the attack speed of your active pets by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 使你当前激活的宠物的攻击速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: All bleed damage dealt by you and your pets  increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你和你的宠物造成的所有流血伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Barbed Shot critical strike chance increased by 5%.

Cobra Shot critical strike chance increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
倒刺射击的爆击几率提高5%。

眼镜蛇射击的爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Damage dealt by your pet's Bite, Claw, and Smack increased by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 你的宠物撕咬、爪击和猛击造成的伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Drinking a Brew has a 20% chance to leave you with an Empty Barrel, which is tossed along with your next Keg Smash to deal 105 Physical damage to your target. Ricochets up to 4 times at 80% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 使用酒类技能时，有20%的几率留下一个空酒桶，你的下一次醉酿投会投掷空桶，对目标造成105点物理伤害。最多以80%的效果弹射4次。

spells.description_en: Rampage increases the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 10%, stacking up to 2 times.
spells.description_zh: 暴怒使你下一次嗜血的伤害提高10%，最多叠加2次。

spells.description_en: Bloodthirst critical strikes restore 3% additional health and increase the damage of Raging Blow by 10% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 嗜血的爆击为你额外恢复3%的生命值，并且使怒击的伤害提高10%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: While Improved Whirlwind is active, Rampage's final strike slams the ground, dealing 7 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yds of your target. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets
spells.description_zh: 强化旋风斩激活时，暴怒的终结一击猛砸地面，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成7点物理伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。

spells.description_en: When Raging Blow resets its own cooldown, your auto-attack damage and speed is increased by 30% for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 怒击重置自身的冷却时间时，你的自动攻击的伤害和速度提高30%，持续6秒。

spells.description_en:
When you would sustain fatal damage, you instead fly into an unstoppable rage, becoming unkillable and immune to movement-impairing effects for 8 sec as you seek revenge on your would-be killer.

If you kill your killer in that time, you emerge from your blind rage triumphant, with at least 20% of your max health intact. If you are not victorious, you die.

This effect can only occur once every 5 min and if your killer is alive when you sustain fatal damage.
spells.description_zh:
当你承受致命伤害时，改为以无可阻挡的愤怒向凶手复仇，期间不会被杀死且免疫移动限制效果，持续8秒。

如果你在此期间杀死凶手，则带着至少20%的最大生命值胜利平息愤怒。如果未能复仇，则会死亡。

此效果每5分钟只能触发一次，且仅在你承受致命伤害时凶手仍然存活的情况下生效。

spells.description_en: Nothing will save your target from you. Envenom damage increased by 10%. Envenom restores 2 Energy per combo point spent.
spells.description_zh: 你的目标难逃一死。毒伤伤害提高10%。毒伤每消耗一个连击点数恢复2点能量。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.
spells.description_zh: 寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰的冷却时间缩短30秒。

spells.description_en: Fear duration on you reduced by 20%. This effect is increased to 60% during Avenging Wrath.
spells.description_zh: 你身上的恐惧持续时间缩短20%。在复仇之怒期间，此效果提高至60%。

spells.description_en:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 1.0% per stack.

Blood Plague deals 5% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
每层鲜血女王的精华使你的精通额外提高1.0%。

血之疫病的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor causes you to explode with holy energy, healing up to 5 nearby allies and yourself for 218, split evenly among them.
spells.description_zh: 击杀可以提供经验值或荣誉的敌人会使你爆发出神圣能量，治疗最多5名附近的盟友和你自己，总共恢复218点生命值，由所有人平均分摊。

spells.description_en: Execute generates 5 additional Rage and increases the damage of Rampage by 10% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 斩杀额外产生5点怒气，并使暴怒的伤害提高10%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en:
Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Dancing Rune Weapons by 20% for 8 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spells.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击使你的符文刃舞的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。c1[

多次施加可以重叠生效。[]

spells.description_en: Frostwyrm's Fury deals 100% increased damage to the first enemy it hits and grants you 15% Haste for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 冰霜巨龙之怒对命中的第一个敌人造成的伤害提高100%，并使你获得15%急速，持续12秒。

spells.description_en:
Casting Incinerate has a 10% chance to evoke an echo of the Dark Titan's power.

 Echo of Sargeras
Hurl an ember torn from Nihilam at the target, dealing 712 Shadowflame damage and an additional 617 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
施放烧尽有10%的几率唤起黑暗泰坦之力的回响。

 萨格拉斯的回响
向目标投掷一片从奈兰撕裂而来的余烬，造成712点暗影烈焰伤害，并对10码范围内的所有敌人额外造成617点暗影烈焰伤害。

超过8个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Heart Strike has a chance to make your next Blood Boil empowered, dealing 50% increased damage and echoing after 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 心脏打击有几率强化你的下一个血液沸腾，使其造成的伤害提高50%，并在3秒后重复一次。

spells.description_en: Physical damage increased by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 物理伤害提高12%。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔传送门的施法时间缩短0.5秒，并且你现在可以使用两次恶魔传送门才会触发冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
Eternity Surge additionally releases a Shattering Star at your target that deals 50% more damage per empower level reached.

 Shattering Star
Exhale a bolt of concentrated power from your mouth at the target for 650 Spellfrost damage.
spells.description_zh:
永恒之涌额外向你的目标释放一道碎裂星辰，每达到一个蓄力等级，其造成的伤害就提高50%。

 碎裂星辰
从口中向目标呼出一股浓缩能量，造成664点法术冰霜伤害。

spells.description_en: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 吸取生命的治疗效果也会以400%的效果治疗你的主要恶魔。

spells.description_en: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
spells.description_zh: 施放疲劳诅咒、语言诅咒或虚弱诅咒现在会诅咒目标10码范围内的所有敌人。

spells.description_en: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 死亡缠绕的射程增加10码，并且死亡缠绕现在会额外治疗5%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en: Metamorphosis has 5 sec increased duration and increases the damage of Fracture, Soul Cleave, and Spirit Bomb by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔变形的持续时间延长5秒，并且提高破裂、灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹20%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Increases Shattering Star damage by 35%.

Shattering Stars are exhaled at all of your Eternity Surge targets.
spells.description_zh:
提高碎裂星辰35%的伤害。

碎裂星辰会向你的所有永恒之涌目标散发效果。

spells.description_en:
Reaper's Mark deals 5% increased damage.

Casting Dancing Rune Weapon grants 1 stack of Exterminate with 100% first scythe and 100% second scythe effectiveness.
spells.description_zh:
死神印记造成的伤害提高5%。

施放符文刃舞会给予1层破灭，第一把镰刀效果为100%，第二把镰刀效果为100%。

spells.description_en:
The effectiveness of Permafrost is increased by 100% and Exterminate grants Permafrost equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

Permafrost
Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
spells.description_zh:
永冻的效果提高100%，并且破灭使你获得相当于造成伤害10%的永冻效果。

永冻
自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的50%。

spells.description_en: Between the Eyes has a 45% chance to apply 2 stacks of its bonus to your damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 正中眉心有45%的几率额外获得2层伤害加成效果。

spells.description_en:
Eternity Surge upgrades your next Azure Strike to Azure Sweep, damaging all nearby enemies and dealing 75% additional damage.

 Azure Sweep
Concentrate azure energy into your tail and sweep to release pure magic upon an enemy and nearby targets for 620 Spellfrost damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
永恒之涌将你的下一次碧蓝打击升级为碧蓝横扫，伤害附近的所有敌人，造成75%的额外伤害。

 碧蓝横扫
将碧蓝能量集中于尾部并横扫，对一名敌人及附近目标释放纯粹的魔法，造成620点法术冰霜伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Your Blood Plague critical hits have a chance to reduce the cooldown of your Blood Boil by 0.25 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的血之疫病爆击有几率使血液沸腾的冷却时间缩短0.25秒。

spells.description_en: Spirit Bomb shields you for 10 sec, absorbing 2,444 damage plus 611 for each Soul Fragment consumed.
spells.description_zh: 幽魂炸弹使你获得护盾，持续10秒，可吸收2,444点伤害，并且每消耗一个灵魂残片就可以额外吸收611点伤害。

spells.description_en: Death Strike damage increased by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 灵界打击的伤害提高12%。

spells.description_en: Casting Death Coil or Epidemic orders Whitemane to cast her Death Coil or Epidemic alongside you at 125% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 施放凋零缠绕或扩散会命令怀特迈恩与你一起以125%效果施放凋零缠绕或扩散。

spells.description_en: Black Powder deals increased damage equal to 20% of your Mastery when it spends 5 or more combo points.
spells.description_zh: 当消耗5点或以上的连击点数时，黑火药造成的伤害提高，相当于你的精通的20%。

spells.description_en: Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 黑暗突变会召唤怀特迈恩，持续6秒。

spells.description_en: The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage..
spells.description_zh: 天启骑士施放的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Consuming Essence Burst fires a twin flame, striking your target for 547 Fire damage.
spells.description_zh: 消耗精华迸发会发射一道孪生烈焰，对目标造成547点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: Twin Flame bounces to up to 2 additional targets.
spells.description_zh: 孪生烈焰会弹射到最多2个额外目标。

spells.description_en: Fire Breath has a 50% chance to generate Essence Burst.
spells.description_zh: 火焰吐息有50%的几率产生精华迸发。

spells.description_en: Throwing your Moonlight Chakram reduces the cooldown of Wildfire Bomb by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 投掷月光战轮会使野火炸弹的冷却时间缩短10秒。

spells.description_en:
Deep Breath deals 20% increased damage and can be cast again within 18 sec of being used.

Recall will be available after the second cast if talented.
spells.description_zh:
深呼吸造成的伤害提高20%，并且可以在使用后的18秒内再次施放。

如果学习了相关天赋，第二次施放后可以使用回归。

spells.description_en: The primary target of Chaos Nova is stunned for an additional 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 混乱新星的主要目标被昏迷的持续时间延长2秒。

spells.description_en: Blur gains 1 additional charge.
spells.description_zh: 疾影额外获得1次充能。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura removes 1 Disease effect.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环移除1个疾病效果。

spells.description_en: Attacks and abilities that generate Fury deal 3% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 产生恶魔之怒的攻击和技能造成的伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Attacks and abilities that spend Fury deal 3% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 消耗恶魔之怒的攻击和技能造成的伤害提高3%。

spells.description_en: Interrupting a spell with Disrupt decreases your magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使用瓦解打断一个法术会使你受到的魔法伤害降低15%，持续12秒。

spells.description_en: Any time you would generate one or more Soul Fragments, you have a 2% chance to generate an additional Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh: 每当要产生一个或多个灵魂残片时，你有2%的几率产生一个额外的灵魂残片。

spells.description_en: Glide speed increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 滑翔速度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Immolation Aura removes 1 Curse effect.
spells.description_zh: 献祭光环移除1个诅咒效果。

spells.description_en: Shift grants you a rapidly decaying shield equal to 6% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 变换为你提供一个相当于你最大生命值6%的快速衰减护盾。

spells.description_en: Fully channeling Void Ray increases the damage of its final tick by 300%.
spells.description_zh: 完全引导虚空射线会使其最后一跳的伤害提高300%。

spells.description_en: While no enemies are within 15 yds, you heal for 1,425 every 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你周围15码内没有敌人时，你每3秒获得1,425点治疗。

spells.description_en: Leg Sweep applies Disable for 5.0 sec when it ends.
spells.description_zh: 扫堂腿结束时，会施加5.0秒的金刚震效果。

spells.description_en: After casting Enveloping Mist, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.
spells.description_zh: 施放氤氲之雾后，你的下一个活血术变为瞬发。

spells.description_en: After Detox successfully removes an effect from an ally, their movement speed is increased by 30% for 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 清创生血成功移除一名盟友身上的效果后，其移动速度提高30%，持续5秒。

spells.description_en: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift critical strike chances are increased by 15% on yourself.
spells.description_zh: 对你自己施放时，活血术和神龙之赐的爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your movement speed is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 你的移动速度提高3%。

spells.description_en:
Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 35% and Rain of Fire by 6%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
spells.description_zh:
混乱之箭的伤害提高35%，并且火焰之雨的伤害提高6%。

激活怨毒时，此效果翻倍。

spells.description_en: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
spells.description_zh: 怨毒额外提供4%急速，并且在施放时使激活的枯萎效果额外增加2层。

spells.description_en: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 枯萎的周期性伤害有几率使你获得怨毒，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift trigger a Gust of Mist on yourself.
spells.description_zh: 活血术和神龙之赐会在你自己身上触发一次迷雾之风。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.
spells.description_zh: 死亡契约的冷却时间缩短30秒，在其治疗吸收效果持续期间，你获得的治疗效果提高50%。

spells.description_en: Raise Ally costs 30 less Runic Power.
spells.description_zh: 复活盟友消耗的符文能量减少30点。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain and Entropic Rift deal damage 25% more often.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：痛和熵能裂隙的伤害频率提高25%。

spells.description_en: Voidheart now persists for 8 sec after Entropic Rift ends.
spells.description_zh: 虚空之心现在会在熵能裂隙结束后持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Mind Blast deals 100% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 心灵震爆造成的伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Your auto shot damage is increased by 25%.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动射击伤害提高25%。

spells.description_en: Riptide has a 6% chance to upgrade your next Healing Stream Totem to Stormstream Totem which heals for 10% more, heals 1 additional ally at 100% effectiveness, and heals 2 injured allies for 4,981 healing when used.
spells.description_zh: 激流有6%的几率将你的下一个治疗之泉图腾升级为风暴涌流图腾，使其治疗量提高10%，额外治疗1名盟友，效果为100%，并在使用时为2名受伤的盟友恢复4,999点生命值。

spells.description_en: While you are below 50% health, your Ghoul sacrifices 4% of its maximum health to heal you for 1% of your maximum health every sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你的生命值低于50%时，你的食尸鬼牺牲其最大生命值的4%，每秒为你恢复最大生命值的1%。

spells.description_en: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.
spells.description_zh: 毒刃的能量消耗降低20点，冷却时间缩短15秒，射程增加3码。

spells.description_en:
Judgment has a chance to grant you Vanguard, causing your next Avenger's Shield to leave an echoing bolt of light in a line between you and the initial target, piercing any enemies for up to 150% of the initial damage dealt.

Damage reduced against secondary targets.
spells.description_zh:
审判有几率使你获得先锋效果，使你下一次复仇者之盾在你和初始目标之间的连线上留下一道回响的圣光箭，穿透任何被击中的敌人，造成初始伤害最多150%的伤害。

对次要目标伤害降低。

spells.description_en: Glide speed and height increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 滑翔速度和高度提高10%。

spells.description_en: Increases your Agility by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 敏捷提高3%。

spells.description_en: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高6%。

spells.description_en: Damage taken during Aspect of the Turtle is reduced by an additional 20%.
spells.description_zh: 灵龟守护期间受到的伤害额外降低20%。

spells.description_en: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 你有20%的几率部分闪避任何对你造成的伤害，使其造成的伤害降低20%。

spells.description_en: When your Freezing Trap breaks, the victim's movement speed is reduced by 70% for 4 sec.
spells.description_zh: 当你的冰冻陷阱生效时，受影响者的移动速度降低70%，持续4秒。

spells.description_en: The duration of Master's Call is increased by 2 sec and it increases the movement speed of its target by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 主人的召唤持续时间延长2秒，并且使其目标的移动速度提高20%。

spells.description_en:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 891 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spells.description_zh:
每当你的法术缩短敬魔仪式的持续时间时，你都会召唤一个恶魔邪眼，最多3个。

恶魔邪眼在消耗恶魔法术时会爆炸，对目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成891点火焰伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 304 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.
spells.description_zh:
你的天魔邪眼激活时，现在会每1秒对你的主要恶魔的目标施放天魔凝视。

 天魔凝视
向目标发射一道毁灭性的混乱魔法光束，造成304点混乱伤害。

每个激活的恶魔邪眼会使伤害提高100%。

spells.description_en: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的天魔邪眼观察战场并收集信息，在爆炸时将信息传递给你，每个天魔邪眼都会使你的智力提高2%，持续10秒。

spells.description_en:
Thunder Focus Tea now empowers Enveloping Mist and Rising Sun Kick further.

 Enveloping Mist:
Begins a channel of Soothing Mist onto your target.

 Rising Sun Kick:
Releases a Jadefire Stomp infront of you that transfers damage into Ancient Teachings at 20% effectiveness.

 Jadefire Stomp:
You release a Jadefire Stomp, dealing 35 damage to 5 enemies in front of you.
spells.description_zh:
雷光聚神茶现在会进一步强化氤氲之雾和旭日东升踢。

 氤氲之雾：
开始对你的目标引导抚慰之雾。

 旭日东升踢：
在你面前释放一次碧火踏，以20的效果将伤害转化为谆谆古训效果。

 碧火踏：
你施放一次碧火踏，对你前方的5名敌人造成35点伤害。

spells.description_en: Renewing Mist healing is increased by up to 300% in proportion to its coverage on yourself and your allies.
spells.description_zh: 复苏之雾的治疗效果会根据其覆盖你自身和盟友的比例，最多提高300%。

spells.description_en:
Wing Clip slows an additional 25%.

Concussive Shot slows an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh:
摔绊的减速效果额外提高25%。

震荡射击的减速效果额外提高10%。

spells.description_en: Your Agility is increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 你的敏捷提高3%。

spells.description_en: Defy Fate healing increased by 100% and its cooldown is reduced by 1 min.
spells.description_zh: 驳斥命运的治疗效果提高100%，冷却时间缩短1分钟。

spells.description_en:
Each Succulent Soul consumed has an increasing chance to unleash the Demonic Soul within you, enabling it to assault your enemies for 9 sec.

 Soul Swipe
Strikes nearby enemies with a malevolent claw, dealing 742 Shadow damage to its target and 495 Shadow damage to other enemies in 10 yds.
spells.description_zh:
每消耗一个诱人灵魂，你都有逐渐增高的几率释放你内心的恶魔之魂，使其攻击你的敌人，持续9秒。

 灵魂横扫
用恶毒之爪打击附近的敌人，对其目标造成742点暗影伤害，并对10码范围内的其他敌人造成495点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en:
Increases your Mastery by 2%.

This effect is doubled while the demonic entity is aiding you in combat.
spells.description_zh:
使你的精通提高2%。

当有恶魔实体协助你作战时，此效果翻倍。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Manifested Avarice by 5 sec and increases the damage of Soul Swipe by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 具现贪欲的持续时间延长5秒，并使灵魂横扫的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Damaging attacks that expend Shadow Techniques to generate combo points have a 15% chance per stack expended to create a Shadow Clone that repeats the attack for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
spells.description_zh: 消耗暗影技巧来产生连击点数的伤害性攻击，每消耗一层都有15%的几率创造一个暗影克隆体，该克隆体会重复这次攻击，造成相当于普通伤害50%的暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Voltaic Blaze's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec and its instant damage is increased by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 流电炽焰的冷却时间降低3秒，直接伤害效果提高50%。

spells.description_en: Rampage damage increased by 10% and Rampage makes you go Berserk, increasing your Strength by 3% for 8 sec. Multiple applications of Berserk may overlap.
spells.description_zh: 暴怒的伤害提高10%，并使你进入狂暴状态，力量提高3%，持续8秒。狂暴效果可多次叠加。

spells.description_en: Thunder Clap causes your next Shield Slam to deal 10% additional damage and unleash a wave of force, dealing 69 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you.
spells.description_zh: 雷霆一击使你的下一次盾牌猛击额外造成10%的伤害，并释放出一道冲击波，对你面前的所有敌人造成68点物理伤害。

spells.description_en:
Your single target melee abilities have a chance to upgrade Slam to Heroic Strike.
All modifiers and talents that affect Slam also affect Heroic Strike.
spells.description_zh:
你的单一目标近战技能有几率将猛击升级为英勇打击。
所有影响猛击的效果和天赋同样会影响英勇打击。

spells.description_en: Increases your haste by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的急速提高3%。

spells.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的智力提高3%。

spells.description_en: Spending Rage has a 10% chance to awaken a guardian spirit for 8 sec, which attacks a nearby enemy for 104 when you cast Thrash or Mangle.
spells.description_zh: 消耗怒气有10%的几率唤醒一个持续8秒的守护之魂，当你施放痛击或裂伤时，它会对附近的一个敌人造成104点伤害。

spells.description_en: Damage of your spells and abilities increased by 10%. Elemental Overload damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的伤害提高10%，元素过载伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
spells.description_zh:
暗影之怒的冷却时间缩短15秒，半径增加2码。

恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短5秒，并且现在额外恐惧5个敌人。

spells.description_en:
Lightning Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.

Casting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.
spells.description_zh:
闪电之盾使你的智力提高3%。

施放闪电之盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。

spells.description_en: Mastery increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 精通提高3%。

spells.description_en: Soul Cleave and Spirit Bomb have a chance per soul fragment consumed to grant Untethered Rage, allowing Metamorphosis to be cast without incurring its cooldown and lasting 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹每消耗一个灵魂残片都有几率使你获得无羁邪怒，使你可以施放恶魔变形且不触发冷却时间，持续10秒。

spells.description_en: Your Intellect is increased by 1.0% for each Ancestor active.
spells.description_zh: 每个激活的先祖使你的智力提高1.0%。

spells.description_en: The cast times of Healing Surge, Chain Heal and Lava Burst are reduced by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之涌、治疗链和熔岩爆裂的施法时间缩短10%。

spells.description_en: Increases the chance for Lava Surge to occur by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 熔岩奔腾的触发几率提高20%。

spells.description_en: The rate at which Symbiotic Blooms grow is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 共生绽华的生长速度提高20%。

spells.description_en: Symbiotic Blooms have a 20% chance to trigger Bursting Growth every 2 sec at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 共生绽华每2秒有20%的几率以100%效果触发爆裂增生。

spells.description_en: Your heal over time effects are 6% more effective.
spells.description_zh: 你的持续治疗的效果提高6%。

spells.description_en: Consuming Mana Tea generates 1 cloud of mist.
spells.description_zh: 消耗法力茶生成1团迷雾。

spells.description_en: Increases your Leech by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的吸血提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases your haste by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的急速提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的爆击几率提高2%。

spells.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 使你的智力提高3%。

spells.description_en: Drain Life now channels 100% faster and restores health 100% faster.
spells.description_zh: 吸取生命的引导速度加快100%，恢复生命的速度加快100%。

spells.description_en: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 崩摧的最后一击对所有目标施加100%效果的重伤。

spells.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 致死打击爆击会使你的撕裂和重伤的伤害提高15%，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Mortal Strike by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 崩摧的最后一击使你获得10%的急速，持续10秒，并使你的下一次致死打击的爆击几率提高100%。

spells.description_en: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.
spells.description_zh: 剑刃风暴使你进入战斗沉醉状态，在剑刃风暴结束后，使你获得15%的急速，持续8秒。

spells.description_en: Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.
spells.description_zh: 处刑者的持续时间延长6秒。

spells.description_en: Lightning Strike damage increased by 10% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 闪电打击伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: During Avatar, Thunder Blast extends Avatar's duration by 2.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 在天神下凡期间，雷霆轰击会使天神下凡的持续时间延长2.0秒。

spells.description_en: Spellsteal repeats its effect after 4 sec, but it now has a cooldown of 4.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 法术吸取会在4秒后重复其效果，但现在有4.0秒的冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
After casting Blink, it is replaced with Reflection for 8 sec.

 Reflection
Teleports you back to where you last Blinked. Castable while casting and unaffected by the global cooldown.
spells.description_zh:
施放闪现术后，该技能会被替换为闪回术，持续8秒。

 闪回
将你传送回上一次闪现术的起始位置。此技能可在其它法术的施法过程中施放，且不受公共冷却时间的影响。

spells.description_en: Your mana costs are reduced by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法力消耗降低5%。

spells.description_en: Casting Remove Curse on a friendly target also casts it on yourself, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.
spells.description_zh: 对友方目标施放解除诅咒时，也会对自己施放一次，但其冷却时间延长20秒。

spells.description_en: Counterspell prevents casting for an additional 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 法术反制使目标无法施法的时间额外延长1.0秒。

spells.description_en: The duration of Clearcasting is increased by 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 节能施法的持续时间延长10秒。

spells.description_en: The Hunt empowers your next Eye Beam, increasing damage by 100% and affecting enemies in a wider area.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔追击强化你的下一个眼棱，使其伤害提高100%并影响更大区域的敌人。

spells.description_en: The mana cost of Holy Light is reduced by 10% and its cast time is reduced by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 圣光术的法力值消耗降低10%，施法时间缩短15%。

spells.description_en:
Casting Thunder Focus Tea grants 2 charges of Potential Energy. Your next cast of Tiger Palm or Vivify consumes all charges of Potential Energy to cause a Harmonic Surge.

Harmonic Surge:
For each charge of Potential Energy, deal 836 Nature damage to your target and 836 Nature damage to other nearby enemies, and heal up to 5 allies for 190. Damage reduced above 5 targets.
spells.description_zh:
施放雷光聚神茶会使你获得2层潜在能量。你施放的下一次猛虎掌或活血术会消耗所有潜在能量层数，造成和谐涌动。

和谐涌动：
每拥有一层潜在能量，对你的目标造成836点自然伤害，对附近其他敌人造成836点自然伤害，并为最多5个受伤的盟友恢复190点生命值。目标超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

spells.description_en:
While Avenging Wrath is not active, you gain 5% Mastery.

While Avenging Wrath is active, you gain 30% movement speed.
spells.description_zh:
复仇之怒未激活时，你获得5%精通。

复仇之怒激活时，你获得30%移动速度。

spells.description_en: Casting Keg Smash grants a charge of Potential Energy.
spells.description_zh: 施放醉酿投会使你获得一层潜在能量。

spells.description_en: Holy Light's healing is increased by 30%, but its mana cost is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 圣光术的治疗效果提高30%，但法力值消耗增加20%。

spells.description_en: Unleash Life heals for 30% more and its bonus healing effect is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 生命释放的治疗效果提高30%，并且其额外治疗效果加成提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Blackout Combo:
Increases Tiger Palm damage by an additional 50% and Keg Smash reduces the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 1.0 sec.

  Press the Advantage:
Nature damage dealt by your main hand auto-attacks is increased by 100% and they now reduce the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 0.25 sec.
spells.description_zh:
幻灭连击：
使猛虎掌的伤害额外提高50%，醉酿投使你的酒类技能冷却时间额外缩短1.0秒。

顺水推舟：
你的主手普通攻击造成的自然伤害提高100%，并使你的酒类技能冷却时间额外缩短0.25秒。

spells.description_en: Fire Blast deals 167 additional Fire damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.
spells.description_zh: 火焰冲击对附近最多8名敌人造成额外168点火焰伤害。

spells.description_en: When Combustion expires, all of your active Ignites explode, dealing 75% of their remaining damage.
spells.description_zh: 当燃烧效果结束时，你所有激活的点燃都会爆炸，造成其剩余伤害的75%。

spells.description_en: Gaining Astral Power with Starfire has a 30% chance to launch a Starsurge at a victim at 50% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 星火术产生星界能量时有30%的几率对目标施放星涌术，效果为原来的50%。

spells.description_en: Light of Dawn receives 20% increased benefit from Mastery: Lightbringer.
spells.description_zh: 黎明之光从精通：光明使者获得的增益提高20%。

spells.description_en: Lunar Eclipse increases Arcane damage by an additional 3%.
spells.description_zh: 月蚀使奥术伤害额外提高3%。

spells.description_en:
Starsurge damage increased by 5%. 
Starfall damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh:
星涌术的伤害提高5%。
星辰坠落的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Crusader Strike bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.
spells.description_zh: 施放神圣军备后，你接下来3次施放的十字军打击会对附近一名盟友施加同类的次级军备。

spells.description_en: The healing of Gusts of Mist caused by Renewing Mist is increased by 100%.
spells.description_zh: 复苏之雾引发的迷雾之风的治疗效果提高100%。

spells.description_en: When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening.
spells.description_zh: 当你的神圣壁垒吸收伤害或你的圣洁武器造成伤害或治疗时，你有几率获得觉醒。

spells.description_en: Your auto-attacks are 30% more likely to make your next Maul become Ravage.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击使下一个重殴变为毁灭的几率提高30%。

spells.description_en: Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 神圣军备会以100%的效果激活槌砧战术。

spells.description_en: You have a 18% chance to follow up any single target melee ability with a Twin Claw, dealing 117 Physical damage and generating 5 Rage.
spells.description_zh: 你有18%的几率在任何单目标近战技能后追加一次双重爪击，造成121点物理伤害并产生5点怒气。

spells.description_en: While Dragonrage is active you gain Rising Fury every 6 sec, increasing your haste by 4%, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.description_zh: 狂龙之怒激活时，你每6秒获得冲天怒火，使你的急速提高4%，最多叠加5次。

spells.description_en: Drain Life heals for an additional 200% of damage dealt and grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of damage dealt.
spells.description_zh: 生命吸取的治疗量额外提高所造成伤害的200%，并获得等同于所造成伤害10%的灵魂榨取。

spells.description_en: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂榨取现在可以额外吸收你生命值上限的5%。

spells.description_en: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
spells.description_zh: 治疗石为你恢复额外5%的生命值。

spells.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing the time between their attacks by 100% and reducing their critical strike chance by 10% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其攻击间隔延长100%，爆击几率降低10%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

spells.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing their casting time of all spells by 100% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其所有法术的施法时间延长100%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

spells.description_en: Your Dreadful Wounds increase the damage afflicted enemies take from your Bleed damage over time effects by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 你的恐惧创痕使受影响敌人从你的持续流血伤害效果中受到的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.
spells.description_zh: 狂暴之怒的冷却时间缩短50%，且狂暴之怒会移除所有使移动速度降低的效果。

spells.description_en: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的治疗效果提高3%，所有自我治疗效果额外提高10%。

spells.description_en:
Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards.

Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%.

Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.
spells.description_zh:
你的投掷技能的范围扩大5码。

勇士之矛、碎裂投掷和破裂投掷的伤害提高20%。

碎裂投掷和破裂投掷会使非玩家目标沉默3秒。

spells.description_en:
Dark Transformation grants access to Blightfall.

Blightfall
Consume 100% of your plagues around you and deal 100% of their remaining damage instantly.

Grants 1 charge of Putrefy.
spells.description_zh:
黑暗突变使你能使用瘟疫降临。

瘟疫降临
消耗你周围疾病的100%，立即造成其剩余伤害的100%。

获得1层腐化充能。

spells.description_en: Your pet protects you at all times, reducing the damage you take by 3%. Your pet receives 100% of the damage it mitigates.
spells.description_zh: 你的宠物时刻保护着你，使你受到的伤害降低3%。你的宠物承受其减免伤害的100%。

spells.description_en: Bestial Wrath provokes your pets to tear into your target, causing your target to bleed for 504 damage over 12 sec.
spells.description_zh: 狂野怒火使你的宠物撕咬目标，使目标流血，12秒内造成504点伤害。

spells.description_en: Boomstick's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 爆裂火铳的冷却时间缩短15秒。

spells.description_en: Reaver's Glaive damage is increased by 20% and other Physical-only damage is increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 收割者战刃伤害提高20%，其他纯物理伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Takedown grants 3 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
spells.description_zh: 狩魂一击获得3层利矛之刃效果。

spells.description_en: The Hunt shatters 1 Soul Fragment. Blade Dance and Chaos Strike have a 15% chance to shatter a Soul Fragment.
spells.description_zh: 恶魔追击会粉碎1个灵魂残片。刃舞和混乱打击有15%的几率粉碎一个灵魂残片。

spells.description_en:
Fury of the Aldrachi further empowers Blade Dance when cast after Chaos Strike, increasing slashes to 12.

Reaver's Mark now stacks up to 2 times and further empowers Chaos Strike when cast after Blade Dance, applying an additional stack.
spells.description_zh:
奥达奇之怒在混乱打击之后施放时，会进一步强化刃舞，使劈砍次数增加到12次。

收割者印记现在最多可叠加2层，并且在刃舞之后施放时，会进一步强化混乱打击，并额外施加一层效果。

spells.description_en:
Kill Command grants 1 additional stack of Tip of the Spear.

Tip of the Spear's damage bonus is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh:
杀戮命令额外获得1层利矛之刃。

利矛之刃的伤害加成提高5%。

spells.description_en: Your magical damage is increased by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 你的法术伤害提高8%。

spells.description_en: Power Surge lasts an additional 5 sec.
spells.description_zh: 能量涌动的持续时间延长5秒。

spells.description_en: Void Volley deals 5% increased damage and Shadow Word: Madness casts during Voidform unleash a Void Volley at your target at 25% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 虚空齐射的伤害提高5%，且在虚空形态下施放暗言术：癫时，会向你的目标发射一次效果为25%的虚空齐射。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Death damage increased by 25% and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：灭的伤害提高25%，其冷却时间缩短3秒。

spells.description_en: Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, Plea, and Power Word: Radiance healing increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 快速治疗、暗影愈合、恳求和真言术：耀的治疗量提高15%。

spells.description_en: Atonement healing from Holy spells is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 神圣法术的救赎治疗效果提高15%。

spells.description_en: When Power Word: Shield or Void Shield expires with absorption remaining, it jumps to a nearby injured ally instead. Can only happen once per shield.
spells.description_zh: 当真言术：盾或虚空之盾的效果消失时仍有剩余吸收量，它会改为跳转到附近一名受伤的盟友身上。每个护盾只能跳转一次。

spells.description_en:
Cosmic damage increased by 2%.

Effect is doubled while in demon form.
spells.description_zh:
宇宙伤害提高2%。

在恶魔形态下效果翻倍。

spells.description_en: Soul Immolation has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂献祭有25%的几率在结束后重燃，重新施加其效果。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick gains 40% additional effectiveness from Mastery: Combo Strikes.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢从精通：组合拳获得的效果提高40%。

spells.description_en:
Collapsing Star reduces the cooldown of Voidblade by 10 sec.

Voidblade and The Hunt briefly reduce your Fury drain while in Void Metamorphosis.
spells.description_zh:
坍缩之星使虚空之刃的冷却时间缩短10秒。

在虚空变形期间，虚空之刃和恶魔追击会短暂减少你消耗的恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Hungering Slash and Voidblade's critical strike chance is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 饥渴斩击和虚空之刃的爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Touch of Death now heals you for 60% of its damage done.
spells.description_zh: 轮回之触现在会治疗你该技能造成伤害的60%。

spells.description_en: Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.
spells.description_zh: 进入恶魔形态会使你的下一次虚空涌动在短暂延迟后重复。

spells.description_en: Your damage during Zenith is increased by 5%.
spells.description_zh: 你在乾元之巅期间的伤害提高5%。

spells.description_en: Your melee attack speed is increased by 30%. This bonus is increased to 60% during Zenith.
spells.description_zh: 你的近战攻击速度提高30%。在乾元之巅期间该加成提高至60%。

spells.description_en:
Activating Zenith causes you to release a powerful stomp, dealing 245 Nature damage to nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 2 Chi.
spells.description_zh:
激活乾元之巅会使你释放一次强力践踏，对附近敌人造成245点自然伤害，超过5个目标时伤害降低。

产生2点真气。

spells.description_en:
Voidblade damage increased by 25%.

Hungering Slash deals 50% increased damage to its primary target.
spells.description_zh:
虚空之刃伤害提高25%。

饥渴斩击对其主要目标的伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Your auto attack critical strike chance is increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 你的自动攻击爆击几率提高15%。

spells.description_en: Consume deals 10% increased damage and its cast time is reduced by 0.25 sec.
spells.description_zh: 吞噬造成的伤害提高10%，施法时间缩短0.25秒。

spells.description_en: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox causes Breath of Fire to launch 3 Flurry Strikes.
spells.description_zh: 玄牛下凡会使火焰吐息施放3次疾风乱打。

spells.description_en: Soul Immolation generates an additional 12 Fury over its duration.
spells.description_zh: 灵魂献祭在其持续时间内额外产生12点恶魔之怒。

spells.description_en: Reap's cooldown is reduced by your Haste.
spells.description_zh: 收割的冷却时间随你的急速属性缩短。

spells.description_en: The cooldown of Roll is decreased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 滚地翻的冷却时间减少10%。

spells.description_en: Your critical strike chance is increased by 2%.
spells.description_zh: 你的爆击几率提高2%。

spells.description_en: Movement speed is increased by 50% for the first 8 sec of combat.
spells.description_zh: 战斗开始时的8秒内移动速度提高50%。

spells.description_en: Critical strike damage bonus increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 爆击伤害加成提高20%。

spells.description_en: Deathstalker's Mark has a 30% chance to immediately consume a stack when applied.
spells.description_zh: 施加死亡猎手标记时有30%的几率立即消耗一层效果。

spells.description_en: Deathstalker's Mark deals 40% of its normal damage to all other enemies within 8 yds that are afflicted by Rupture.
spells.description_zh: 死亡猎手标记对8码内的所有其他受到割裂影响的敌人造成其正常伤害的40%。

spells.description_en: Bestial Wrath summons an Animal Companion from your Stable to fight alongside you for 15 sec. The summoned Animal Companion obeys your Kill Command, Wild Thrash, and Stomps alongside your other pets.
spells.description_zh: 狂野怒火从兽栏召唤一只动物伙伴与你并肩作战，持续15秒。召唤的动物伙伴会和其他宠物一样服从你的杀戮命令、狂野鞭笞和践踏。

spells.description_en: Overpower and Slam increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 5%, stacking up to 3 times.
spells.description_zh: 压制和猛击使你下一次致死打击的伤害提高5%，最多可叠加3次。

spells.description_en: Cleave and Whirlwind deal 20% additional damage to targets below 35% health.
spells.description_zh: 顺劈斩和旋风斩对生命值低于35%的目标造成额外20%的伤害。

spells.description_en:
Rapid Fire damage increased by 25%.

Each shot fired from Rapid Fire reduces the cooldown of Aimed Shot by 0.50 sec.
spells.description_zh:
急速射击的伤害提高25%。

急速射击的每发子弹使瞄准射击的冷却时间缩短0.50秒。

spells.description_en:
Celestial Conduit's healing and damage is increased by 100% when striking a single target.

Each addtional target reduces this bonus by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
天神御身仅击中一个目标时，治疗和伤害提高100%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低20%。

spells.description_en:
Lava Burst damage increased by 5%.

Lava Burst and Lava Burst Overload generate 1 additional Maelstrom.
spells.description_zh:
熔岩爆裂的伤害提高5%。

熔岩爆裂和熔岩爆裂过载额外生成1点漩涡值。

spells.description_en: Summoning your Demonic Tyrant leaves open a portal to Argus for 15 sec, causing every 2 casts of Hand of Gul'dan to summon a subjugated demon that serves you for 10 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤你的恶魔暴君会打开一个通往阿古斯的传送门，持续15秒，每施放2次古尔丹之手就会召唤一个被征服的恶魔为你战斗10秒。

spells.description_en: Increases damage dealt by Hand of Gul'dan to its main target by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 使古尔丹之手对其主要目标造成的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
Summons an Imp Lord to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will remove 1 harmful effect from you when summoned. 

Transforms into Singe Magic while on cooldown.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个小鬼领主协助你战斗，持续20秒，并在召唤时为你移除1个有害效果。

在冷却期间转变为烧灼驱魔。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Fel Ravager to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will purge 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy.

Turns into Devour Magic while on cooldown.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个邪能破坏者协助你战斗，持续20秒，同时驱散一名敌人身上的1个增益魔法效果。

在冷却期间转变为吞噬魔法。

spells.description_en: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.
spells.description_zh: 惊慌使承受的伤害额外提高3%。

spells.description_en: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.
spells.description_zh: 隐秘之刃现在每15秒可触发一次，并有25%的几率打击两次。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of your Summon Vilefiend, Grimoire: Imp Lord, and Grimoire: Fel Ravager by 3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 使你的召唤邪犬、魔典：小鬼领主和魔典：邪能破坏者的持续时间延长3秒。

spells.description_en:
Summons a Doomguard to assist you in combat for 12 sec. Consuming a Demonic Core reduces the cooldown of Summon Doomguard by 3 sec.

 Doom Bolt Volley
Sends a volley of malefic bolts at 5 enemies within 40 yds, inflicting 1,590 Shadow damage to each target.
spells.description_zh:
召唤一个末日守卫协助你战斗，持续12秒。消耗一个恶魔之核可使召唤末日守卫的冷却时间缩短3秒。

厄运箭雨
向40码内的5名敌人发射灾厄箭雨，对每个目标造成1,597点暗影伤害。

spells.description_en: Shuriken Storm has 10% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.
spells.description_zh: 袖剑风暴的爆击几率提高10%，并且现在会在可能的情况下触发隐秘之刃。

spells.description_en: Your Demonic Tyrant also empowers you while active, increasing your haste by 8%.
spells.description_zh: 你的恶魔暴君在激活期间还会强化你，使你的急速提高8%。

spells.description_en: Your Demonic Tyrant lasts an additional 5 sec and extends the duration of your Dreadstalkers by 15 sec when summoned.
spells.description_zh: 你的恶魔暴君持续时间额外延长5秒，并在召唤时将你的恐惧猎犬的持续时间延长15秒。

spells.description_en: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 抛出正面使伤害额外提高4%。抛出反面造成的伤害提高12%。

spells.description_en: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.
spells.description_zh: 在连续抛出4次或更多次相同结果的命运硬币后，下一次抛出的硬币结果将与之相同。

spells.description_en: Shield of the Righteous reduces magical damage taken by 12%.
spells.description_zh: 正义盾击使受到的魔法伤害降低12%。

spells.description_en: Call Dreadstalkers costs 1 less Soul Shard and its cast time is reduced by 50%.
spells.description_zh: 召唤恐惧猎犬消耗的灵魂碎片减少1片，其施法时间缩短50%。

spells.description_en: The fangs of your Dreadstalkers are coated in corrosive bile, causing Dreadbite to deal additional damage equal to 50% of damage dealt as Plague damage.
spells.description_zh: 你的恐惧猎犬獠牙沾满腐蚀胆汁，使恐惧之咬造成50%的额外伤害，这些伤害被视为瘟疫伤害。

spells.description_en: Judgment causes its primary target's successful melee attacks against you to grant a Physical absorb shield for 20% of the damage dealt. Limit 1.
spells.description_zh: 审判使其主要目标对你发起的成功近战攻击产生物理吸收护盾，吸收量为所造成伤害的20%。最高1层。

spells.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 爆击几率提高3%。

spells.description_en: Shield of the Righteous consumes up to 2 more Holy Power and deals 50% increased damage for each additional Holy Power consumed.
spells.description_zh: 正义盾击可额外消耗最多2点神圣能量，每消耗一点额外神圣能量，其伤害提高50%。

spells.description_en: Fight through the pain, ignoring 50% of damage taken for 12 sec or until 700 damage has been prevented.
spells.description_zh: 在痛苦中继续战斗，在12秒内无视接下来受到伤害中的50%，直到防止700点伤害。

spells.description_en: Rising Sun Kick's damage is increased by your Mastery rating and Thunder Focus Tea resets its cooldown.
spells.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的伤害会随你的精通等级提高，并且雷光聚神茶会重置其冷却时间。

spells.description_en:
While holding a shield, you have a 15% chance to block incoming spells, reducing their damage by 20%. 

Without a shield, you have a 15% chance to parry incoming melee attacks, reducing their damage by 20%.
spells.description_zh:
有护盾时，你有15%的几率格挡来袭法术，使其伤害降低20%。

未有护盾时，你有15%的几率招架来袭近战攻击，使其伤害降低20%。

spells.description_en: You heal for 3% of all magical damage taken.
spells.description_zh: 你受到的所有魔法伤害的3%将转化为治疗。

spells.description_en: When Surging Shots resets the cooldown of Rapid Fire, the damage of your next Rapid Fire is increased by 20%.
spells.description_zh: 当激涌射击重置急速射击的冷却时间时，你下一次急速射击的伤害提高20%。

spells.description_en:
When Rapid Fire begins and finishes channeling, it releases an Arcane Shot at 100% effectiveness.

If your target is below 20% health, Rapid Fire instead releases Kill Shots.
spells.description_zh:
在开始引导和结束引导急速射击时，会释放一发效果为100%的奥术射击。

如果你的目标生命值低于20%，则急速射击改为释放夺命射击。

spells.description_en: Kill Shot damage increased by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 夺命射击伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Precise Shots now increases the critical strike chance of Arcane Shot and Multi-Shot by 10%
spells.description_zh: 弹无虚发现在使奥术射击和多重射击的爆击几率提高10%。

spells.description_en: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the average health percentage of allies with your Beacon of Light.
spells.description_zh: 基于携带你的圣光道标盟友的平均生命值百分比，你的治疗量最多提高10%。

spells.description_en: Immediately reset the cooldowns of Adrenaline Rush, Between the Eyes, Blade Flurry, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree.
spells.description_zh: 立即重置冲动、正中眉心、剑刃乱舞、刀锋冲刺和影舞步的冷却时间。

spells.description_en: When Frenzied Regeneration would heal you above maximum health, 80% of its excess healing is instead converted to an absorb shield.
spells.description_zh: 当狂暴回复造成过量治疗时，溢出治疗量的80%会转化为吸收护盾。

spells.description_en:
When you take non-periodic damage, you have a chance to gain a charge of Dream Guide. 

When you or a nearby ally drops below 40% health, you consume a charge of Dream Guide to automatically cast Regrowth on them. This Regrowth heals for an additional 100%.
spells.description_zh:
当你受到非周期性伤害时，有几率获得一层梦境向导。

当你或附近盟友的生命值低于40%时，消耗一层梦境向导为其自动施放愈合。该愈合的治疗效果提高100%。

spells.description_en: Voidfall Meteor damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 虚落流星的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain deals 150% increased damage.
spells.description_zh: 暗言术：痛的伤害提高150%。

spells.description_en: Tentacle Slam afflicts your target with Shadow Word: Madness at 25% effectiveness.
spells.description_zh: 触须猛击会以25%的效果对目标施加暗言术：癫。

spells.description_en:
Tentacle Slam deals 50% increased damage and Void Volley deals 15% increased damage.

When Voidform ends, you can cast Void Volley 1 additional time within 30 sec.
spells.description_zh:
触须猛击的伤害提高50%，虚空齐射的伤害提高15%。

虚空形态解除后，你在30秒内可以额外施放1次虚空齐射。

spells.description_en:
Shadowy Apparition damage increased by 10%.

When Shadowy Apparitions deal damage, they extend the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
暗影幻灵的伤害提高10%。

暗影幻灵造成伤害时，你对目标施加的暗言术：痛与吸血鬼之触的持续时间延长1.0秒。

spells.description_en: Secret Technique damage increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 影分身的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Increases damage dealt by Agony and Corruption by 10%.
spells.description_zh: 痛楚和腐蚀术的伤害提高10%。

spells.description_en: Increases the duration of Summon Darkglare by 5.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 召唤黑眼的持续时间延长5.0秒。

spells.description_en: Increases the damage of your Felguard's Felstorm by 20% and its duration by 4.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的恶魔卫士的邪能风暴的伤害提高20%，持续时间延长4.0秒。

spells.description_en: While Blood Shield is active, taking direct damage reflects 38 Shadow damage back to the attacker. Blood Shield can now absorb up to 65% of your maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 鲜血护盾激活时，受到直接伤害会反射38点暗影伤害给攻击者。鲜血护盾现在最多能吸收相当于你最大生命值65%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Your Earth Elemental no longer taunts nearby enemies or generates threat and instead increases your maximum health by 15% while active.
spells.description_zh: 你的土元素不再嘲讽附近敌人或产生威胁值，而是在激活时使你的最大生命值提高15%。

spells.description_en: Your Penance bolts sear the enemy, dealing 20% of its damage over 8 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你的苦修的飞弹会烧灼敌人，在8秒内造成其伤害的20%。

spells.description_en:
Evangelism summons a Mindbender to attack a nearby target for 12 sec.

Generates 0.2% Mana each time the Mindbender attacks.
spells.description_zh:
福音会召唤一个摧心魔攻击一个附近目标，持续12秒。

摧心魔每次攻击时都会产生0.2%的法力值。

spells.description_en: Conjuring one or more Arcane Splinters has a 10% chance to conjure a burst of 8 Arcane Splinters.
spells.description_zh: 召唤一个或多个奥术裂片时，有10%的几率引发8个奥术裂片爆发。

spells.description_en: Renewing Mist's healing is increased by 500% on your lowest health ally with its effect.
spells.description_zh: 复苏之雾对受其影响且生命值最低的盟友的治疗效果提高500%。

spells.description_en: When Shred or Moonfire generate combo points, they have a 25% chance to generate full combo points.
spells.description_zh: 撕碎或月火术产生连击点数时，有25%的几率产生最大连击点数。

spells.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Summon Infernal by 30.0 sec and increases your Mastery by 3%.
spells.description_zh: 召唤地狱火的冷却时间缩短30.0秒，你的精通提高3%。

spells.description_en: Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.
spells.description_zh: 基于目标已损失的生命值比例，你的瘟疫最多额外造成30%伤害。

spells.description_en:
Adorns your Darkglare with armor forged from within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. 

Eye Beam now jumps to up to 4 additional targets within 10 yards and deals 10% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
为你的黑眼装备源自安托鲁斯的战铠，使其护甲值提高10%。

眼棱现在会在10码范围内额外弹射至最多4个目标，并造成10%额外伤害。

spells.description_en: Glacial Spike deals 5% increased damage and applies 2 additional stacks of Freezing.
spells.description_zh: 冰川尖刺造成的伤害提高5%，并额外施加2层冻结效果。

spells.description_en: Glacial Spike no longer applies Freezing, and instead Shatters 5 stacks of Freezing.
spells.description_zh: 冰川尖刺不再施加冻结效果，而是会粉碎5层冻结效果。

spells.description_en:
Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn have a 10% chance to rip open a hole in space and time, opening a random portal that damages your target:

Shadowy Tear
Deals 3,143 Shadow damage over 14 sec.

Unstable Tear
Deals 2,696 Chaos damage over 6 sec.

Chaos Tear
Fires a Chaos Bolt, dealing 1,240 Chaos damage. This Chaos Bolt always critically strikes and your critical strike chance increases its damage.

Generates 10 Soul Shard Fragments.
spells.description_zh:
混乱之箭和暗影灼烧有10%的几率撕裂时空，在你的目标附近开启一个随机传送门，对其造成伤害：

暗影裂隙
在14秒内持续造成3,143点暗影伤害。

不稳定的裂隙
在6秒内造成2,696点混乱伤害。

混乱裂隙
释放混乱之箭，造成1,240点混乱伤害。混乱之箭必定会爆击，并且你的爆击几率会提高其伤害。

生成10块灵魂裂片。﻿

spells.description_en:
Your stances have additional effects.

 Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

 Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.
spells.description_zh:
你的姿态会获得额外效果。

战斗姿态
使你的技能造成的爆击伤害提高3%。

防御姿态
当一次攻击造成的伤害达到你最大生命值的20%或以上时，该次伤害会降低15%。

spells.description_en:
Shadow Clones deal 15% increased damage.

Cheap Shot creates a Shadow Clone to Shadowstrike the target for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.

Kidney Shot creates a Shadow Clone to Eviscerate the target for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
spells.description_zh:
暗影克隆体造成的伤害提高15%。

偷袭会制造一个暗影克隆体，对目标施放暗影打击，造成相当于普通伤害50%的暗影伤害。

肾击会制造一个暗影克隆体，对目标施放刺骨，造成相当于普通伤害50%的暗影伤害。

spells.description_en:
Power Siphon and Implosion summon 1 Imp Gang Boss for every 2 Wild Imps sacrificed. Wild Imps summoned this way gain Unstable Soul.

 Unstable Soul
Increases damage done by 50% and Fel Firebolt now jumps to 4 additional targets.
spells.description_zh:
能量虹吸和内爆每牺牲2个野生小鬼，便召唤出1个小鬼首领。以这种方式被召唤出的野生小鬼会获得动荡的灵魂。﻿

动荡的灵魂
造成的伤害提高50%，恶魔火焰箭现在会额外弹射至4个目标。

spells.description_en: Ice Lance reduces the cooldown of Frozen Orb by 0.5 sec, increased by 0.1 sec for each stack of Freezing Shattered.
spells.description_zh: 冰枪术使寒冰宝珠的冷却时间缩短0.5秒，每粉碎一层冻结额外缩短0.1秒。

spells.description_en:
Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.

Death and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh:
腐化使枯萎凋零的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

枯萎凋零每伤害一个敌人，就会使腐化的冷却时间缩短0.3秒，最多缩短3.0秒。

spells.description_en: Inferno's Blessing's damage is increased by 40%, and your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Inferno's Blessing.
spells.description_zh: 狱火祝福的伤害提高40%，同时你的延长黑檀之力的效果也会延长狱火祝福。

spells.description_en: Living Flame's cast time is reduced by 0.2 sec, and it deals 50% increased damage or healing when it is a non-instant cast.
spells.description_zh: 活化烈焰的施法时间缩短0.2秒，并且当其非瞬发时，造成的伤害或治疗效果提高50%。

spells.description_en: Send out a ripple of temporal energy, absorbing 4,446 damage and applying Echo at 30% effectiveness on your target and up to 4 allies within 40 yds.
spells.description_zh: 发出一道时光能量涟漪，吸收4,446点伤害，以30%的效果为你目标及其40码内最多4名盟友施加回响。

spells.description_en: If the target of your Deathmark dies, Deathmark jumps to a nearby enemy combatant for its remaining duration.
spells.description_zh: 如果你的死亡印记目标死亡，死亡印记将跳转至附近的一名敌方战斗人员身上，并持续其剩余时间。

spells.description_en: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.
spells.description_zh: 当你对可获得经验值或荣誉的目标造成致命一击时，猩红之瓶的冷却时间缩短15秒，且下一次使用时立即恢复5%的最大生命值。

spells.description_en:
Arcane Barrage has a 1% chance per stack of Arcane Salvo consumed to replace your next Arcane Blast with Prismatic Bolt.

 Prismatic Bolt
Devastates the target with overwhelming energy, dealing 16,444 Arcane damage to them and 10,557 Arcane damage to other nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 4 Arcane Charges.
spells.description_zh:
奥术弹幕每消耗一层奥术齐射，就有1%的几率将你的下一次奥术冲击替换为棱彩飞弹。

 棱彩飞弹
以压倒性的能量摧垮目标，对其造成16,682点奥术伤害，并对附近的其他敌人造成10,602点奥术伤害。超过5个目标时造成的伤害降低。

产生4层奥术充能。

spells.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.
spells.description_zh: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低4%。

spells.description_en: Shadow Mend heals for 40% more and applies Atonement for an additional 4 sec, but its cast time is increased by 0.3 sec.
spells.description_zh: 暗影愈合的治疗效果提高40%，并额外施加救赎，持续4秒，但其施法时间延长0.3秒。

spells.description_en: Envenom's damage is increased by 18%, but its duration is reduced by 2 sec.
spells.description_zh: 毒伤的伤害提高18%，但持续时间缩短2秒。

spells.description_en: Restore 100 Energy.
spells.description_zh: 恢复100点能量。

spells.description_en: Whirlwind affects all targets with Rend, causing them to Bleed for 74 damage over 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 旋风斩影响所有带有撕裂的目标，使其流血，在15秒内造成74点伤害。

spells.description_en: Soothing Mist healing increased by 300%, but its mana cost is increased by 200%.
spells.description_zh: 抚慰之雾的治疗效果提高300%，但法力值消耗提高200%。

spells.description_en: Whirlwind deals 50% additional damage when it hits only a single target.
spells.description_zh: 旋风斩仅击中单个目标时，额外造成50%的伤害。

spells.description_en: Explosive Shot has a 100% chance to grant the Lock and Load effect.
spells.description_zh: 爆炸射击有100%的几率触发荷枪实弹效果。

spells.description_en: Word of Glory can no longer critically strike, but its healing is increased by your critical strike chance and 80% of its overhealing done to instead shrouds its target in Light, granting an absorb shield.
spells.description_zh: 荣耀圣令不再能造成爆击，但其治疗效果会根据你的爆击几率提高，并且造成的过量治疗的80%会转而将目标笼罩在圣光中，提供一个吸收护盾。

spells.description_en: 10% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 8 sec. Casting Mirror Image increases this effect to 30% for 15 sec.
spells.description_zh: 你承受的伤害的10%改为在8秒内造成。施放镜像会使该效果提高至30%，持续15秒。

spells.description_en: All single-target damage done by you and your minions grants you and your pet shadowy shields that absorb 3% of the damage dealt for 15 sec, up to 5% of maximum health.
spells.description_zh: 你和你的仆从造成的所有单体伤害会为你和你的宠物提供一个能够吸收伤害的暗影护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的3%，持续15秒，吸收量最多不超过最大生命值的5%。

spells.description_en: Wildfire Bomb damage increased by 15%, critical strike chance increased by 15%, and critical damage dealt increased by 15%.
spells.description_zh: 野火炸弹的伤害提高15%，爆击几率提高15%，爆击伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en:
Increases Drain Life damage by 10% and Siphon Life now increases the damage of Corruption by an additional 10%.

Dark Harvest channels 10% faster and deals 15% increased damage.
spells.description_zh:
使吸取生命的伤害提高10%，生命虹吸现在会使腐蚀术的伤害额外提高10%。

幽冥收割的引导速度加快10%，造成的伤害提高15%。

spells.description_en: Healing Stream Totem extends the duration of your active Riptides by 3.0 sec.
spells.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾会将你已激活的激流的持续时间延长3.0秒。

spells.description_en:
Shadow Bolt and Malefic Grasp damage increased by 10% or 20% if the target is affected by Haunt. 

Dark Harvest damage increased by 10% or 20% if the target is affected by Haunt.
spells.description_zh:
暗影箭和灾难之握造成的伤害提高10%，若目标受到鬼影缠身影响则提高20%。

幽冥收割造成的伤害提高10%，若目标受到鬼影缠身影响则提高20%。

options.description_en:
Shields you with an arcane force, absorbing 9,165 damage and reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 1 min.

The duration of harmful Magic effects against you is reduced by 25%.
options.description_zh:
为你施加奥术护盾，吸收9,165点伤害，使受到的魔法伤害降低15%，持续1分钟。

你身上所有有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短25%。

options.description_en: Alters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.
options.description_zh: 改变时间的结构，当你再次施法，或在10秒之后，你的位置和生命值会回到当前状态。死亡或距离太远会导致法术失效。

options.description_en:
Encases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
一道寒冰屏障笼罩了你，使你在10秒内不会受到任何伤害，但是在这期间你也无法攻击、移动或施法。

引发低温效果，在30秒内不能再次施放寒冰屏障。

nodes.name_zh: 时空漫步 / 时光重组

options.description_en: Alter Time resets the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer when you return to your original location.
options.description_zh: 在你返回至初始位置时，操控时间会重置闪现术和闪光术的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Upon dropping below 25% health, your past self corrects your timeline, casting Alter Time and instantly returning 20% of your maximum health and healing you for an additional 30% over 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 生命值降至25%以下时，你过去的自己会修正你的时间线，施放操控时间，立即为你恢复20%的最大生命值，并在6秒内额外为你恢复30%生命值。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 操控时间的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 操控时间的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Hypothermia's duration is reduced by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 低温的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: Reduces magic damage taken by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低4%。

options.description_en: Reduces magic damage taken by 8%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Arcane Intellect grants you an additional 2% Intellect.
options.description_zh: 奥术智慧使你的智力额外提高2%。

options.description_en:
Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.

Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.
options.description_zh:
在你身边召唤3个持续15秒的镜像，可以施放法术并攻击你的敌人。镜像激活期间，你产生的仇恨值大幅降低。

受到直接伤害将导致你的一个镜像消散。

options.description_en: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.
options.description_zh: 从目标身上窃取一个增益魔法效果。此效果最多持续2分钟。

options.description_en: Counterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术反制的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Enemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take 284 Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 你面前12码锥形区域内的敌人受到282点火焰伤害并陷入迷惑状态，持续4秒。受到伤害会移除此效果。

options.description_en: Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing 180 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 在选中的敌人或盟友周围制造奥术能量脉冲，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成180点奥术伤害，并将其击飞。主要敌方目标将额外受到100%的伤害。

options.description_en: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.
options.description_zh: 从一个友方目标身上移除所有诅咒。

options.description_en: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 镜像的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 镜像的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Spellsteal repeats its effect after 4 sec, but it now has a cooldown of 4.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术吸取会在4秒后重复其效果，但现在有4.0秒的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Teleports you 20 yds forward, unless something is in the way. Unaffected by the global cooldown and castable while casting.
options.description_zh: 将你向前传送20码，路线上有阻挡物则会停止。不受公共冷却时间影响，并可在施法过程中施放。

options.description_en: Blink's cooldown is reduced by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 闪现术的冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en: Counterspell prevents casting for an additional 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术反制使目标无法施法的时间额外延长1.0秒。

options.description_en:
Each time your Arcane Barrage fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.
options.description_zh:
每当你的奥术弹幕未能造成爆击时，其爆击几率提高10%。

当受影响的法术造成爆击后，此爆击加成便会移除。

options.description_en: Casting Remove Curse on a friendly target also casts it on yourself, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 对友方目标施放解除诅咒时，也会对自己施放一次，但其冷却时间延长20秒。

options.description_en: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.
options.description_zh: 使你隐形，无法成为敌人的目标，持续20秒并移除所有威胁值。任何动作都会解除该效果。

nodes.name_zh: 强化冰霜新星 / 寒冰结界

options.description_en: Frost Nova duration is increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 冰霜新星的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Frost Nova now has 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 冰霜新星现在可以使用2次。

options.description_en: The duration of Clearcasting is increased by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 节能施法的持续时间延长10秒。

options.description_en: Increases critical strike chance by 2%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低4%。

options.description_en: Increases Haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Invisibility increases your movement speed by 20% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术使你的移动速度提高20%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Invisibility increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术使你的移动速度提高40%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的法术的爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.
options.description_zh: 获得节能施法[炽热连击]使你的智力提高1%，持续8秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 闪现术和闪光术的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Your mana costs are reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的法力消耗降低5%。

options.description_en: Your Mastery is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高3%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en:
Enemies hit by Cone of Cold are frozen in place for 5 sec instead of snared.

When your roots expire or are dispelled, your target is snared by 80%, decaying over 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
被冰锥术击中的敌人会被冻结在原地而不是被诱捕，持续5秒。

当定身效果结束或被驱散时，你的目标会被减速80%，该效果在3秒内逐渐衰减。

options.description_en: Causes a whirl of icy wind around the enemy, dealing 573 Frost damage to the target and all other enemies within 8 yds, freezing them in place for 2 sec. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 在敌人周围制造一场凛冽的寒风，对目标和8码范围内的所有其他敌人造成581点冰霜伤害，并将其冻结在原地，持续2秒。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of your loss of control spells are reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 使你的失控类技能的冷却时间缩短5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 冰霜之环 / 群体变形

options.description_en:
Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.

When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
在目标位置处召唤一道冰霜之环，持续10秒。进入环内的敌人将瘫痪10秒。目标上限为10个。

当瘫痪效果结束时，敌人会被减速65%，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
Transforms all enemies within 10 yards into sheep, wandering around incapacitated for 15 sec. While affected, the victims cannot take actions but will regenerate health very quickly. Damage will cancel the effect.

Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.
options.description_zh:
将10码范围内的所有敌人变成绵羊，使其在周围到处闲逛，持续15秒。受此法术影响期间，绵羊无法采取行动，但会以极快的速度恢复生命值，任何伤害都会取消此效果。

只对野兽、人形生物和小动物有效。

options.description_en: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.
options.description_zh: 施放你的护盾会移除所有减速效果。

options.description_en:
You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.

Does not affect allies in combat.
options.description_zh:
你和40码内的盟友立即进入隐形状态，持续12秒。做出任何动作都会取消此效果。

不影响战斗中的盟友。

options.description_en: When your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当你的护体屏障被移除时，使其冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障现在使受到的所有伤害降低70%，持续6秒，但不再提供免疫效果，阻止移动、攻击或施放法术。不触发公共冷却时间。

options.description_en: Blink gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 闪现术获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en:
After casting Blink, it is replaced with Reflection for 8 sec.

 Reflection
Teleports you back to where you last Blinked. Castable while casting and unaffected by the global cooldown.
options.description_zh:
施放闪现术后，该技能会被替换为闪回术，持续8秒。

 闪回
将你传送回上一次闪现术的起始位置。此技能可在其它法术的施法过程中施放，且不受公共冷却时间的影响。

options.description_en: Prismatic Barrier gains an additional charge and further reduces magic damage taken by 5%.
options.description_zh: 棱光护体额外获得一层充能，并使受到的魔法伤害进一步降低5%。

options.description_en:
Requires Clearcasting
Launches 5 waves of Arcane Missiles at the enemy over 2.2 sec, causing a total of 2,225 Arcane damage.
options.description_zh:
需要节能施法
在2.2秒内向敌人射出5波奥术飞弹，对其造成总计2,220点奥术伤害。

options.description_en:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse conjures an Arcane Splinter.

Arcane Splinter:
Conjure raw Arcane magic into a sharp projectile that deals 225 Arcane damage.
options.description_zh:
施放奥术冲击或奥术脉冲会召唤一个奥术裂片。

奥术裂片：
召唤源生的奥术魔法，凝聚成尖锐的投射物，造成225点奥术伤害。

options.description_en: Arcane Missiles channels 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 奥术飞弹的引导速度提高20%。

options.description_en: Each wave of Arcane Missiles increases the damage of Arcane Barrage by 3%, up to 60%.
options.description_zh: 每一波奥术飞弹会使奥术弹幕的伤害提高3%，最多提高60%。

options.description_en: Conjuring one or more Arcane Splinters has a 10% chance to conjure a burst of 8 Arcane Splinters.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个或多个奥术裂片时，有10%的几率引发8个奥术裂片爆发。

options.description_en: Casting Arcane Barrage conjures an Arcane Splinter for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.
options.description_zh: 在施放奥术弹幕时，每消耗5层奥术齐射，生成一个奥术裂片。

options.description_en:
Enemies damaged by your Arcane Orb conjure 2 Arcane Splinters, up to 4.

Arcane Orb damage is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh:
受到你的奥术宝珠伤害的敌人会召唤出2个奥术裂片，最多4个。

奥术宝珠的伤害提高50%。

nodes.name_zh: 调和使者 / 变易碎片

options.description_en: Your Arcane Familiar has a 50% chance to conjure a Splinter alongside its Arcane Assault.
options.description_zh: 你的奥术魔宠有50%的几率在施展奥术突袭的同时召唤出一枚碎片。

options.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting conjures 2 Arcane Splinters.
options.description_zh: 获得节能施法时，召唤2个奥术裂片。

options.description_en: Clearcasting can stack up to 2 additional times.
options.description_zh: 节能施法可以额外叠加2次。

options.description_en: 10% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 8 sec. Casting Mirror Image increases this effect to 30% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 你承受的伤害的10%改为在8秒内造成。施放镜像会使该效果提高至30%，持续15秒。

options.description_en: For each Arcane Charge, Arcane Barrage hits 1 additional nearby target for 40% damage.
options.description_zh: 每有一层奥术充能，奥术弹幕就可以额外击中附近的1个目标，对其造成40%的伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 飘忽咒师 / 蓦然回首

options.description_en: You have 40% increased movement speed during Alter Time.
options.description_zh: 在操控时间期间，你的移动速度提高40%。

options.description_en: While in combat, Blink summons a Mirror Image at your previous location.
options.description_zh: 在战斗中使用闪现时，会在你原来的位置召唤一个镜像。

options.description_en: 40% of the direct damage dealt by an Arcane Splinter is also dealt to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 奥术裂片造成直接伤害的40%的伤害会同时作用于附近的敌人。目标超过5个时伤害会降低。

nodes.name_zh: 反馈壁垒 / 幻形幻象

options.description_en:
Your Prismatic Barrier can absorb up to 25% more damage based on your missing health.

Max effectiveness when under 25% health.
options.description_zh:
你的棱光护体的伤害吸收量最多提高25%，这取决于你损失的生命值。

生命值低于25%时达到最大效果。

options.description_en: Your Mirror Image summons 1 extra copy of you.
options.description_zh: 你的镜像额外召唤1个复制体。

options.description_en:
Direct damage from Arcane Splinters have a 25% chance to grant 1 stack Arcane Salvo.

 Arcane Salvo
Increases the damage of your next Arcane Barrage by 3%.
options.description_zh:
来自奥术碎片的直接伤害有25%的几率获得1次奥术齐射。

 奥术齐射
你的下一个奥术弹幕伤害提高3%。

options.description_en:
A pulse of Arcane magic erupts from underneath your target, dealing 2,523 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 1 Arcane Charge for each enemy struck.
options.description_zh:
自目标脚下迸发一股奥术魔法，对8码内所有敌人造成2,551点奥术伤害。超过5个目标时伤害降低。

每击中一名敌人，便产生1层奥术充能。

options.description_en:
Expend all of your current mana to annihilate your enemy target and nearby enemies for up to 3,844 Arcane damage based on Mana spent. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

For the next 15 sec, your Mana regeneration is increased by 425% and spell damage is increased by 35%.

Generates Clearcasting.
options.description_zh:
消耗你当前的所有法力，歼灭你的目标和附近的敌人，根据消耗的法力值，造成最多3,844点奥术伤害。目标超过8个时伤害会降低。

在接下来的15秒内，你的法力恢复速度提高425%，法术伤害提高35%。

产生节能施法。

options.description_en:
Launches an Arcane Orb forward from your position, traveling up to 40 yds, dealing 1,247 Arcane damage to enemies it passes through.

Grants 1 Arcane Charge when cast and every time it deals damage.
options.description_zh:
从你的位置向前射出一颗奥术宝珠，最多行进40码，对其触碰到的敌人造成1,257点奥术伤害。

施放时获得一层奥术充能，每造成一次伤害获得一层奥术充能。

options.description_en:
Arcane Surge damage increased by 30%.

Your chance to gain Clearcasting is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh:
奥术涌动的伤害提高30%。

你获得节能施法的几率提高3%。

options.description_en:
Arcane Blast and Arcane Pulse damage increased by 15%.

Casting Touch of the Magi conjures 4 Arcane Splinters.
options.description_zh:
奥术冲击和奥术脉冲的伤害提高15%。

施放大法师之触会召唤4个奥术裂片。

options.description_en: Direct damage from Arcane Splinters reduces the cooldown of Arcane Orb by 0.30 sec.
options.description_zh: 奥术裂片的直接伤害会使奥术宝珠的冷却时间缩短0.30秒。

options.description_en:
Casting Arcane Barrage while at 20 or more Arcane Salvo stacks refunds 3 Arcane Salvo stacks.

Arcane Barrage damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh:
在拥有20层及以上的奥术齐射时，施放奥术弹幕可以返还3层奥术齐射。

奥术弹幕的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Arcane Pulse has a 50% chance to repeat its explosion at 30% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 奥术脉冲有50%的几率以30%的效果重复一次爆炸。

options.description_en: Causes your next 2 Arcane Blasts to be instant cast.
options.description_zh: 使你的下2个奥术冲击变为瞬发。

options.description_en: Arcane Missiles and Evocation can now be channeled while moving.
options.description_zh: 奥术飞弹和唤醒现在可以在移动中引导。

options.description_en: Arcane Surge's damage is increased by an additional 50% based on your mana spent.
options.description_zh: 奥术涌动的伤害根据你消耗的法力值额外提高50%。

options.description_en: Casting Arcane Intellect summons a Familiar that attacks your enemies and increases your maximum mana by 10% for 1 hour.
options.description_zh: 施放奥术智慧会召唤一个魔宠攻击你的敌人，并使你的最大法力值提高10%，持续1小时。

options.description_en: Arcane Orb gains 1 additional charge. Arcane Orb damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 奥术宝珠额外获得1层充能。奥术宝珠的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en:
Casting Arcane Surge generates 8 Arcane Splinters.

During Arcane Surge, your chance to conjure an additional Arcane Splinter is increased to 100%.
options.description_zh:
施放奥术涌动会生成8个奥术裂片。

在奥术涌动期间，额外召唤一个奥术裂片的几率提高至100%。

options.description_en: Upon reaching maximum stacks of Arcane Salvo, your next Arcane Barrage deals 25% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 奥术齐射达到最大层数时，你的下一个奥术弹幕造成的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Arcane Missiles fires 2 additional missiles.
options.description_zh: 奥术飞弹额外发射2枚飞弹。

options.description_en:
Applies Touch of the Magi to your current target, accumulating 20% of the damage you deal to the target for 12 sec, and then exploding for that amount of Arcane damage to the target and reduced damage to all nearby enemies.

Generates 4 Arcane Charges.
options.description_zh:
对你当前的目标施加大法师之触，将你在12秒内对目标造成伤害的20%积累起来，然后发生爆炸，对目标造成相当于积累量的奥术伤害，并对所有附近的敌人造成较少的伤害。

产生4层奥术充能.

options.description_en:
During Arcane Surge, your Arcane Familiar fires 4 bolts instead of 1.

Damage from your Arcane Familiar has a 6% chance to restore 2% of your maximum mana.
options.description_zh:
在奥术涌动期间，你的奥术魔宠会发射4道魔法箭矢，而不是1道。

你的奥术魔宠造成的伤害有6%的几率为你恢复最大法力值的2%。

options.description_en:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse grants 2 stacks of Arcane Salvo.

Casting Arcane Orb grants 1 stack of Arcane Salvo.

Casting Prismatic Bolt grants 4 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
options.description_zh:
施放奥术冲击或奥术脉冲可获得2层奥术齐射。

施放奥术宝珠可获得1层奥术齐射。

施放棱彩飞弹可获得4层奥术齐射。

options.description_en:
Casting a damaging spell has a 6% chance to conjure a Spellfire Sphere.

While you're out of combat, you will slowly conjure Spellfire Spheres over time.

 Spellfire Sphere
Increases your spell damage by 1.0%. Stacks up to 3 times.
options.description_zh:
施放伤害性法术有6%的几率召唤一颗法术火焰宝珠。

脱离战斗时，你会随着时间缓慢地召唤法术火焰宝珠。

 法术火焰宝珠
你的法术伤害提高1.0%，最多叠加3次。

options.description_en: Reduces Arcane Blast's mana cost by 5% and increases its damage by 8%.
options.description_zh: 奥术冲击的法力值消耗降低5%，伤害提高8%。

options.description_en: Your Haste is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你的急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Arcane Missiles now damages 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 奥术飞弹现在以50%的效能额外攻击2个目标。

options.description_en: Arcane Missiles now damages 4 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 奥术飞弹现在以50%的效能额外攻击4个目标。

nodes.name_zh: 艾格文秘术 / 奥能回响

options.description_en: Casting Touch of the Magi grants Clearcasting.
options.description_zh: 施放大法师之触会获得节能施法。

options.description_en: Direct damage you deal to enemies affected by Touch of the Magi, causes an explosion that deals 41 Arcane damage to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 你对受大法师之触效果影响的敌人所造成的直接伤害会引发爆炸，对附近所有敌人造成42点奥术伤害。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Arcane Barrage deals 8% increased damage per target it hits beyond the first.
options.description_zh: 奥术弹幕每额外击中一个目标，造成的伤害就提高8%。

options.description_en: Arcane Blast generates an additional Arcane Charge.
options.description_zh: 奥术冲击额外生成一层奥术充能。

options.description_en: Casting Arcane Blast, Arcane Pulse, Arcane Barrage, or Prismatic Bolt grants you 0.5% Haste for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh: 施放奥术冲击、奥术脉冲、奥术弹幕或棱彩飞弹使你获得0.5%的急速，持续6秒。多次效果可重叠。

options.description_en:
When you cast Arcane Surge, summon an Arcane Phoenix to aid you in battle.

  Arcane Phoenix
Your Arcane Phoenix aids you for the duration of your Arcane Surge, casting random Arcane and Fire spells.
options.description_zh:
当你施放奥术涌动时，召唤一只奥术凤凰协助你作战。

奥术凤凰
你的奥术凤凰会在奥术涌动期间协助你，并随机施放奥术和火焰法术。

options.description_en:
Arcane Blast damage increased by 30%.

Arcane Pulse damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
奥术冲击的伤害提高30%。

奥术脉冲的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en:
Arcane Barrage summons 1 Meteorite for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.

 Meteorite
Calls down a meteorite which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 425 Fire damage to all enemies hit, reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
奥术弹幕每消耗5层奥术齐射，就会召唤1颗陨星。

陨星
召唤一颗陨星，3秒后落在目标位置，对击中的所有敌人造成428点火焰伤害。目标超过8个时对所有敌人造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Increases your mana regeneration by 1,500% for 2.7 sec.
options.description_zh: 使你的法力回复速度提高1,500%，持续2.7秒。

options.description_en: Arcane Barrage grants you 2.0% of your maximum mana per Arcane Charge spent.
options.description_zh: 奥术弹幕每消耗一层奥术充能，就为你恢复2.0%的最大法力值。
