在你身边召唤3个持续15秒的镜像，可以施放法术并攻击你的敌人。镜像激活期间，你产生的仇恨值大幅降低。

受到直接伤害将导致你的一个镜像消散。

options.description_en: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.
options.description_zh: 从目标身上窃取一个增益魔法效果。此效果最多持续2分钟。

options.description_en: Counterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术反制的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Enemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take 286 Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 你面前12码锥形区域内的敌人受到285点火焰伤害并陷入迷惑状态，持续4秒。受到伤害会移除此效果。

options.description_en: Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing 178 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 在选中的敌人或盟友周围制造奥术能量脉冲，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成175点奥术伤害，并将其击飞。主要敌方目标将额外受到100%的伤害。

options.description_en: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.
options.description_zh: 从一个友方目标身上移除所有诅咒。

options.description_en: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 镜像的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 镜像的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Spellsteal repeats its effect after 4 sec, but it now has a cooldown of 4.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术吸取会在4秒后重复其效果，但现在有4.0秒的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Teleports you 20 yds forward, unless something is in the way. Unaffected by the global cooldown and castable while casting.
options.description_zh: 将你向前传送20码，路线上有阻挡物则会停止。不受公共冷却时间影响，并可在施法过程中施放。

options.description_en: Blink's cooldown is reduced by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 闪现术的冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en: Counterspell prevents casting for an additional 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术反制使目标无法施法的时间额外延长1.0秒。

options.description_en:
Each time your Arcane Barrage fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.
options.description_zh:
每当你的奥术弹幕未能造成爆击时，其爆击几率提高10%。

当受影响的法术造成爆击后，此爆击加成便会移除。

options.description_en: Casting Remove Curse on a friendly target also casts it on yourself, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 对友方目标施放解除诅咒时，也会对自己施放一次，但其冷却时间延长20秒。

options.description_en: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.
options.description_zh: 使你隐形，无法成为敌人的目标，持续20秒并移除所有威胁值。任何动作都会解除该效果。

nodes.name_zh: 强化冰霜新星 / 寒冰结界

options.description_en: Frost Nova duration is increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 冰霜新星的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Frost Nova now has 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 冰霜新星现在可以使用2次。

options.description_en: The duration of Clearcasting is increased by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 节能施法的持续时间延长10秒。

options.description_en: Increases critical strike chance by 2%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低4%。

options.description_en: Increases Haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Invisibility increases your movement speed by 20% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术使你的移动速度提高20%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Invisibility increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术使你的移动速度提高40%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的法术的爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.
options.description_zh: 获得节能施法[炽热连击]使你的智力提高1%，持续8秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 闪现术和闪光术的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Your mana costs are reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的法力消耗降低5%。

options.description_en: Your Mastery is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高3%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en:
Enemies hit by Cone of Cold are frozen in place for 5 sec instead of snared.

When your roots expire or are dispelled, your target is snared by 80%, decaying over 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
被冰锥术击中的敌人会被冻结在原地而不是被诱捕，持续5秒。

当定身效果结束或被驱散时，你的目标会被减速80%，该效果在3秒内逐渐衰减。

options.description_en: Causes a whirl of icy wind around the enemy, dealing 577 Frost damage to the target and all other enemies within 8 yds, freezing them in place for 2 sec. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 在敌人周围制造一场凛冽的寒风，对目标和8码范围内的所有其他敌人造成585点冰霜伤害，并将其冻结在原地，持续2秒。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of your loss of control spells are reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 使你的失控类技能的冷却时间缩短5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 冰霜之环 / 群体变形

options.description_en:
Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.

When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
在目标位置处召唤一道冰霜之环，持续10秒。进入环内的敌人将瘫痪10秒。目标上限为10个。

当瘫痪效果结束时，敌人会被减速65%，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
Transforms all enemies within 10 yards into sheep, wandering around incapacitated for 15 sec. While affected, the victims cannot take actions but will regenerate health very quickly. Damage will cancel the effect.

Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.
options.description_zh:
将10码范围内的所有敌人变成绵羊，使其在周围到处闲逛，持续15秒。受此法术影响期间，绵羊无法采取行动，但会以极快的速度恢复生命值，任何伤害都会取消此效果。

只对野兽、人形生物和小动物有效。

options.description_en: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.
options.description_zh: 施放你的护盾会移除所有减速效果。

options.description_en:
You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.

Does not affect allies in combat.
options.description_zh:
你和40码内的盟友立即进入隐形状态，持续12秒。做出任何动作都会取消此效果。

不影响战斗中的盟友。

options.description_en: When your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当你的护体屏障被移除时，使其冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障现在使受到的所有伤害降低70%，持续6秒，但不再提供免疫效果，阻止移动、攻击或施放法术。不触发公共冷却时间。

options.description_en: Blink gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 闪现术获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en:
After casting Blink, it is replaced with Reflection for 8 sec.

 Reflection
Teleports you back to where you last Blinked. Castable while casting and unaffected by the global cooldown.
options.description_zh:
施放闪现术后，该技能会被替换为闪回术，持续8秒。

 闪回
将你传送回上一次闪现术的起始位置。此技能可在其它法术的施法过程中施放，且不受公共冷却时间的影响。

options.description_en: Blazing Barrier gains an additional charge and cauterizes your wounds, healing you for 15% of the damage it absorbs.
options.description_zh: 烈焰护体额外获得一层充能，并会烧灼你的伤口，为你恢复相当于其吸收伤害量的15%的生命值。

options.description_en: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 2,711 Fire damage.
options.description_zh: 发射一颗巨大的烈焰巨石，造成2,687点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 1,091 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 50%, and causing an additional 102 Frostfire damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 向敌人施放霜火之箭，造成1,103点霜火伤害，使其移动速度降低50%，并在8秒内额外造成102点霜火伤害。

options.description_en:
Blasts the enemy, critically striking for 824 Fire damage.

Castable while casting other spells.
options.description_zh:
冲击敌人，造成必定爆击的824点火焰伤害。

可以在施放其它法术时施放。

options.description_en: Your Fireball and Pyroblast spells always deal a critical strike when the target is above 90% health.
options.description_zh: 你的火球术和炎爆术对生命值在90%以上的目标总会产生爆击。

options.description_en:
Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 1,474 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
options.description_zh:
召唤一根火柱，燃烧区域内的所有敌人，造成1,431点火焰伤害。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低

该法术对指定位置施放。

options.description_en:
Calls down a pillar of fire on your target, burning all enemies within the area for 1,433 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

This spell is cast at your target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一根火柱，燃烧区域内的所有敌人，造成1,470点火焰伤害。目标数量超过8个后，造成的伤害降低

此法术会对你的目标施放。

options.description_en:
You melt slightly out of your Ice Block and Ice Cold, allowing you to move slowly during Ice Block and increasing your movement speed over time.

Ice Block and Ice Cold trigger a Blazing Barrier when they end.
options.description_zh:
你的寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰略微融化，使你能够在寒冰屏障期间缓慢移动，并且移动速度逐渐提高。

寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰效果结束时触发一次烈焰护体。

options.description_en:
Casting Frostfire spells has a 10% chance to activate Frostfire Empowerment, causing your next Frostfire Bolt to be instant cast, deal 60% increased damage, explode for 60% of its damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Damage from Frostfire Empowerment applies 1 stack of Freezing.
options.description_zh:
施放霜火法术有10%的几率激活霜火增效，使你的下一个霜火之箭变为瞬发，造成60%额外伤害，并对附近敌人引发爆炸，造成其伤害的60%。目标数量超过5个目标时伤害降低。

霜火增效造成的伤害会施加1层冻结效果。

nodes.name_zh: 元素亲和 / 焰霜相依

options.description_en:
Ice Block and Ice Cold reset the cooldowns of your Fire spells.

Cauterize resets the cooldown of your Frost spells with a base cooldown shorter than 4 minutes when it activates.
options.description_zh:
寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰会重置你的火焰法术冷却时间。

当灸灼激活时，会重置基础冷却时间少于4分钟的冰霜法术的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Casting Glacial Spike also casts a Pyroblast, dealing 3,748 Fire damage.
options.description_zh: 施放冰川尖刺也会施放炎爆术，造成3,760点火焰伤害。

options.description_en:
Fire Blast now spreads 50% of your target's Ignite to 1 enemy.

Flamestrike applies 15% more Ignite.
options.description_zh:
火焰冲击现在会将目标身上50%的灼烧效果扩散至1名敌人。

烈焰风暴施加的点燃效果提高15%。

options.description_en:
Engulfs you in flames for 10 sec, increasing your spells' critical strike chance by 100%.

Castable while casting other spells.
options.description_zh:
火焰将你笼罩起来，持续10秒，使你的法术爆击几率提高100%。

可在施放其他法术时施放。

options.description_en:
Flamestrike has a chance equal to 100% of your spell critical strike chance to build up to a Hot Streak.

Flamestrike deals 5% increased damage for each enemy it damages, up to 25%.
options.description_zh:
烈焰风暴有相当于法术爆击几率100%的几率触发一次炽热连击。

烈焰风暴每伤害一个敌人，造成的伤害提高5%，最多25%。

options.description_en: Flurry and Fire Blast now deal Frostfire damage and their damage is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 冰风暴和火焰冲击现在造成霜火伤害，且其伤害提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 热能调控 / 剧烈温差

options.description_en: Frostfire Bolt's cast time is reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 霜火之箭的施法时间缩短10%。

options.description_en: Frostfire Empowerment stacks 1 additional time and it causes Frostfire Bolt to explode for an additional 20% of its damage.
options.description_zh: 霜火增效可额外叠加1层，并使霜火之箭爆炸造成额外20%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Your Frost and Fire spells deal 20% increased critical strike damage.

Ice Lance and Pyroblast  have their damage increased by 40%.
options.description_zh:
冰霜与火焰法术的爆击伤害提高20%。

冰枪术和炎爆术的伤害提高40%。

options.description_en: Your Frostfire spells apply Ignite at 10% increased effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 你的霜火法术施加点燃效果，效果提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its damage is increased by 25%.
options.description_zh: 火焰冲击获得额外1层充能，并且其伤害提高25%。

options.description_en:
Fatal damage instead brings you to 35% health and then burns you for 28% of your maximum health over 6 sec.

While burning, movement slowing effects are suppressed and your movement speed is increased by 150%.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 6 min.
options.description_zh:
原本致命的伤害会使你的生命值达到35%，并在之后的6秒内燃烧28%的最大生命值。

燃烧期间，抑制所有使你的移动速度减慢的效果，并使你的移动速度提高150%。

该效果每6分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Calls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 3,843 Fire damage to all enemies, and burns the ground, dealing 1,754 Fire damage over 4 sec to all enemies in the area.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
召唤一颗流星，3秒后落在目标位置，对所有敌人造成3,850点火焰伤害。同时还会灼烧大地，在4秒内对该区域内的所有敌人造成1,754点火焰伤害。

目标超过8个时伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Frostfire Bolt has and additional 5% chance to grant Brain Freeze and its critical strike chance is increased by 15%.

The damage of your Frost spells and Fire spells are increased by 4%.
options.description_zh:
霜火之箭额外有5%几率触发冰冷智慧，且其爆击几率提高15%。

你的冰霜法术和火焰法术造成的伤害提高4%。

options.description_en:
Meteor's damage is increased by 25%.

Meteor now grants Frostfire Empowerment.
options.description_zh:
流星的伤害提高25%。

流星现在会使你获得霜火增效。

options.description_en: The damage of Meteor and Comet Storm is increased.
options.description_zh: 流星和彗星风暴的伤害提高。

options.description_en:
Meteor and Pyroblast now apply Ignite.

Your Haste is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh:
流星和炎爆术现在会附加点燃效果。

你的急速提高2%。

options.description_en:
Scorches an enemy for 422 Fire damage.

When cast on a target below 30% health, Scorch is a guaranteed critical strike.

Castable while moving.
options.description_zh:
灼烧敌人，对其造成429点火焰伤害。

对生命值低于30%的目标施放时，灼烧必定爆击。

可在移动中施放。

options.description_en: Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 2.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 火焰冲击获得额外1层充能，冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

options.description_en: Combustion's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 燃烧的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en:
Your spells have a 4% increased chance to deal a critical strike.

You gain 10% more of the Critical Strike stat from all sources.
options.description_zh:
你的法术造成爆击的几率提高4%。

通过任何渠道获得的爆击属性提高10%。

options.description_en:
Your spells have a 8% increased chance to deal a critical strike.

You gain 20% more of the Critical Strike stat from all sources.
options.description_zh:
你的法术造成爆击的几率提高8%。

通过任何渠道获得的爆击属性提高20%。

options.description_en: The enemy closest to the center of Meteor's impact takes 75% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 距离流星撞击中心最近的敌人现在受到的伤害提高75%。

options.description_en:
Meteor now also calls down a Comet Storm, dealing 2,782 Frost damage to nearby enemies.

Comet Storm now also calls down a Meteor, dealing 3,740 Fire damage to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh:
流星现在还会召唤彗星风暴，对附近敌人造成2,705点冰霜伤害。

彗星风暴现在还会召唤流星，对附近敌人造成3,741点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: While Combustion is not active, damage from Ignite has a small chance to make your next Scorch instant, deal 100% increased damage, and deal damage as though your target was below 30% health.
options.description_zh: 燃烧未激活时，点燃造成伤害时有较小的几率使你的下一个灼烧变为瞬发，伤害提高100%，并且将目标的生命值视作低于30%。

options.description_en:
Fireball always critically strikes enemies below 30% health.

When Fireball or Scorch damage an enemy below 30% health, Fireball deals 25% increased damage and Scorch deals 250% increased damage.
options.description_zh:
火球术对生命值低于30%的敌人必定造成爆击。

火球术或灼烧对一名生命值低于30%的敌人造成伤害时，火球术的伤害提高25%，灼烧的伤害提高250%。

options.description_en: Damaging an enemy with Fireball, Pyroblast, or Flamestrike increases the damage it receives from Ignite by 0.2%. Stacks up to 50 times.
options.description_zh: 用火球术、炎爆术或烈焰风暴对敌人造成伤害后会使其受到的点燃伤害提高0.2%。最多叠加50层。

options.description_en: All Fire damage dealt increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 所有火焰伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: Meteor's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 流星的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en:
Casting a damaging spell has a 6% chance to conjure a Spellfire Sphere.

While you're out of combat, you will slowly conjure Spellfire Spheres over time.

 Spellfire Sphere
Increases your spell damage by 1.0%. Stacks up to 3 times.
options.description_zh:
施放伤害性法术有6%的几率召唤一颗法术火焰宝珠。

脱离战斗时，你会随着时间缓慢地召唤法术火焰宝珠。

 法术火焰宝珠
你的法术伤害提高1.0%，最多叠加3次。

options.description_en: Fire Blast deals 169 additional Fire damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 火焰冲击对附近最多8名敌人造成额外170点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: While Ignite is on 3 or fewer enemies it flares up dealing an additional 30% of its damage to affected targets.
options.description_zh: 点燃影响的敌人数量不多于3个时，火焰会爆燃，对被影响的目标额外造成30%的伤害。

options.description_en: Casting Combustion refreshes up to 1 charge of Fire Blast.
options.description_zh: 施放燃烧会刷新最多1次火焰冲击使用次数。

options.description_en: Casting Combustion refreshes up to 2 charges of Fire Blast.
options.description_zh: 施放燃烧会刷新最多2次火焰冲击使用次数。

options.description_en: Damage dealt to targets below 35% health is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 对生命值低于35%的目标造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Hot Streak increases the amount of Ignite damage from Pyroblast or Flamestrike by an additional 25%.

为你施加寒冰护盾，吸收10,692点伤害，持续1分钟。

对你进行近战攻击的攻击者的移动速度降低50%。

options.description_en: Alters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.
options.description_zh: 改变时间的结构，当你再次施法，或在10秒之后，你的位置和生命值会回到当前状态。死亡或距离太远会导致法术失效。

options.description_en:
Encases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
一道寒冰屏障笼罩了你，使你在10秒内不会受到任何伤害，但是在这期间你也无法攻击、移动或施法。

引发低温效果，在30秒内不能再次施放寒冰屏障。

nodes.name_zh: 时空漫步 / 时光重组

options.description_en: Alter Time resets the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer when you return to your original location.
options.description_zh: 在你返回至初始位置时，操控时间会重置闪现术和闪光术的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Upon dropping below 25% health, your past self corrects your timeline, casting Alter Time and instantly returning 20% of your maximum health and healing you for an additional 30% over 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 生命值降至25%以下时，你过去的自己会修正你的时间线，施放操控时间，立即为你恢复20%的最大生命值，并在6秒内额外为你恢复30%生命值。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 操控时间的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 操控时间的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Hypothermia's duration is reduced by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 低温的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: Reduces magic damage taken by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低4%。

options.description_en: Reduces magic damage taken by 8%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Arcane Intellect grants you an additional 2% Intellect.
options.description_zh: 奥术智慧使你的智力额外提高2%。

options.description_en:
Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.

Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.
options.description_zh:
在你身边召唤3个持续15秒的镜像，可以施放法术并攻击你的敌人。镜像激活期间，你产生的仇恨值大幅降低。

受到直接伤害将导致你的一个镜像消散。

options.description_en: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.
options.description_zh: 从目标身上窃取一个增益魔法效果。此效果最多持续2分钟。

options.description_en: Counterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术反制的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Enemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take 285 Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 你面前12码锥形区域内的敌人受到286点火焰伤害并陷入迷惑状态，持续4秒。受到伤害会移除此效果。

options.description_en: Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing 179 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 在选中的敌人或盟友周围制造奥术能量脉冲，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成179点奥术伤害，并将其击飞。主要敌方目标将额外受到100%的伤害。

options.description_en: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.
options.description_zh: 从一个友方目标身上移除所有诅咒。

options.description_en: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 镜像的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Mirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 镜像的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Spellsteal repeats its effect after 4 sec, but it now has a cooldown of 4.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术吸取会在4秒后重复其效果，但现在有4.0秒的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Teleports you 20 yds forward, unless something is in the way. Unaffected by the global cooldown and castable while casting.
options.description_zh: 将你向前传送20码，路线上有阻挡物则会停止。不受公共冷却时间影响，并可在施法过程中施放。

options.description_en: Blink's cooldown is reduced by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 闪现术的冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en: Counterspell prevents casting for an additional 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 法术反制使目标无法施法的时间额外延长1.0秒。

options.description_en:
Each time your Arcane Barrage fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.
options.description_zh:
每当你的奥术弹幕未能造成爆击时，其爆击几率提高10%。

当受影响的法术造成爆击后，此爆击加成便会移除。

options.description_en: Casting Remove Curse on a friendly target also casts it on yourself, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 对友方目标施放解除诅咒时，也会对自己施放一次，但其冷却时间延长20秒。

options.description_en: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.
options.description_zh: 使你隐形，无法成为敌人的目标，持续20秒并移除所有威胁值。任何动作都会解除该效果。

nodes.name_zh: 强化冰霜新星 / 寒冰结界

options.description_en: Frost Nova duration is increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 冰霜新星的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Frost Nova now has 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 冰霜新星现在可以使用2次。

options.description_en: The duration of Clearcasting is increased by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 节能施法的持续时间延长10秒。

options.description_en: Increases critical strike chance by 2%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低4%。

options.description_en: Increases Haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Invisibility increases your movement speed by 20% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术使你的移动速度提高20%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Invisibility increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术使你的移动速度提高40%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 隐形术的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的法术的爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.
options.description_zh: 获得节能施法[炽热连击]使你的智力提高1%，持续8秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 闪现术和闪光术的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Your mana costs are reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的法力消耗降低5%。

options.description_en: Your Mastery is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高3%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en:
Enemies hit by Cone of Cold are frozen in place for 5 sec instead of snared.

When your roots expire or are dispelled, your target is snared by 80%, decaying over 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
被冰锥术击中的敌人会被冻结在原地而不是被诱捕，持续5秒。

当定身效果结束或被驱散时，你的目标会被减速80%，该效果在3秒内逐渐衰减。

options.description_en: Causes a whirl of icy wind around the enemy, dealing 595 Frost damage to the target and all other enemies within 8 yds, freezing them in place for 2 sec. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 在敌人周围制造一场凛冽的寒风，对目标和8码范围内的所有其他敌人造成575点冰霜伤害，并将其冻结在原地，持续2秒。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of your loss of control spells are reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 使你的失控类技能的冷却时间缩短5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 冰霜之环 / 群体变形

options.description_en:
Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.

When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
在目标位置处召唤一道冰霜之环，持续10秒。进入环内的敌人将瘫痪10秒。目标上限为10个。

当瘫痪效果结束时，敌人会被减速65%，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
Transforms all enemies within 10 yards into sheep, wandering around incapacitated for 15 sec. While affected, the victims cannot take actions but will regenerate health very quickly. Damage will cancel the effect.

Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.
options.description_zh:
将10码范围内的所有敌人变成绵羊，使其在周围到处闲逛，持续15秒。受此法术影响期间，绵羊无法采取行动，但会以极快的速度恢复生命值，任何伤害都会取消此效果。

只对野兽、人形生物和小动物有效。

options.description_en: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.
options.description_zh: 施放你的护盾会移除所有减速效果。

options.description_en:
You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.

Does not affect allies in combat.
options.description_zh:
你和40码内的盟友立即进入隐形状态，持续12秒。做出任何动作都会取消此效果。

不影响战斗中的盟友。

options.description_en: When your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当你的护体屏障被移除时，使其冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.
options.description_zh: 寒冰屏障现在使受到的所有伤害降低70%，持续6秒，但不再提供免疫效果，阻止移动、攻击或施放法术。不触发公共冷却时间。

options.description_en: Blink gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 闪现术获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en:
After casting Blink, it is replaced with Reflection for 8 sec.

 Reflection
Teleports you back to where you last Blinked. Castable while casting and unaffected by the global cooldown.
options.description_zh:
施放闪现术后，该技能会被替换为闪回术，持续8秒。

 闪回
将你传送回上一次闪现术的起始位置。此技能可在其它法术的施法过程中施放，且不受公共冷却时间的影响。

options.description_en: Ice Barrier gains an additional charge and reduces your physical damage taken by 10%.
options.description_zh: 寒冰护体额外获得一层充能，并使你受到的物理伤害降低10%。

options.description_en:
Quickly fling a shard of ice at the target, dealing 781 Frost damage.

Shatters 4 stacks of Freezing.
options.description_zh:
迅速向目标发射一枚寒冰碎片，造成768点冰霜伤害。

粉碎4层冻结效果。

options.description_en: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 1,087 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 50%, and causing an additional 102 Frostfire damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 向敌人施放霜火之箭，造成1,077点霜火伤害，使其移动速度降低50%，并在8秒内额外造成102点霜火伤害。

options.description_en:
Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse conjures an Arcane Splinter.

Arcane Splinter:
Conjure raw Arcane magic into a sharp projectile that deals 225 Arcane damage.
options.description_zh:
施放奥术冲击或奥术脉冲会召唤一个奥术裂片。

奥术裂片：
召唤源生的奥术魔法，凝聚成尖锐的投射物，造成225点奥术伤害。

options.description_en:
Ice shards pelt the target area, dealing 1,640 Frost damage over 10.7 sec and reducing movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

This spell is cast at a selected location
options.description_zh:
目标区域骤然落下寒冰碎片，在10.7秒内造成1,656点冰霜伤害，并使敌人的移动速度降低50%，持续3秒。

该法术对指定位置施放。

options.description_en:
Ice shards pelt the target area, dealing 1,628 Frost damage over 10.7 sec and reducing movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

This spell is cast at your target.
options.description_zh:
目标区域骤然落下寒冰碎片，在10.7秒内造成1,657点冰霜伤害，并使敌人的移动速度降低50%，持续3秒。

此法术会对你的目标施放。

options.description_en:
Frostbolt has a 15% chance to grant a charge of Fingers of Frost.

Fingers of Frost causes your next Ice Lance to deal Shatter damage equal to 4 stacks of Freezing and does not consume Freezing stacks.

Maximum 2 charges.
options.description_zh:
寒冰箭有15%几率提供一层寒冰指。

寒冰指使你的下一个冰枪术造成相当于4层冻结效果的粉碎伤害，并且不消耗冻结层数。

最多叠加2层。

options.description_en:
You melt slightly out of your Ice Block and Ice Cold, allowing you to move slowly during Ice Block and increasing your movement speed over time.

Ice Block and Ice Cold trigger a Blazing Barrier when they end.
options.description_zh:
你的寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰略微融化，使你能够在寒冰屏障期间缓慢移动，并且移动速度逐渐提高。

寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰效果结束时触发一次烈焰护体。

options.description_en:
Casting Frostfire spells has a 10% chance to activate Frostfire Empowerment, causing your next Frostfire Bolt to be instant cast, deal 60% increased damage, explode for 60% of its damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Damage from Frostfire Empowerment applies 1 stack of Freezing.
options.description_zh:
施放霜火法术有10%的几率激活霜火增效，使你的下一个霜火之箭变为瞬发，造成60%额外伤害，并对附近敌人引发爆炸，造成其伤害的60%。目标数量超过5个目标时伤害降低。

霜火增效造成的伤害会施加1层冻结效果。

nodes.name_zh: 元素亲和 / 焰霜相依

options.description_en:
Ice Block and Ice Cold reset the cooldowns of your Fire spells.

Cauterize resets the cooldown of your Frost spells with a base cooldown shorter than 4 minutes when it activates.
options.description_zh:
寒冰屏障和深寒凝冰会重置你的火焰法术冷却时间。

当灸灼激活时，会重置基础冷却时间少于4分钟的冰霜法术的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Casting Glacial Spike also casts a Pyroblast, dealing 3,744 Fire damage.
options.description_zh: 施放冰川尖刺也会施放炎爆术，造成3,752点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Conjuring one or more Arcane Splinters has a 10% chance to conjure a burst of 8 Arcane Splinters.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个或多个奥术裂片时，有10%的几率引发8个奥术裂片爆发。

options.description_en: Casting Arcane Barrage conjures an Arcane Splinter for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.
options.description_zh: 在施放奥术弹幕时，每消耗5层奥术齐射，生成一个奥术裂片。

options.description_en:
Enemies damaged by your Arcane Orb conjure 2 Arcane Splinters, up to 4.

Arcane Orb damage is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh:
受到你的奥术宝珠伤害的敌人会召唤出2个奥术裂片，最多4个。

奥术宝珠的伤害提高50%。

nodes.name_zh: 调和使者 / 变易碎片

options.description_en: Your Arcane Familiar has a 50% chance to conjure a Splinter alongside its Arcane Assault.
options.description_zh: 你的奥术魔宠有50%的几率在施展奥术突袭的同时召唤出一枚碎片。

options.description_en: Gaining Clearcasting conjures 2 Arcane Splinters.
options.description_zh: 获得节能施法时，召唤2个奥术裂片。

options.description_en:
When Frostbolt critically strikes, it applies 1 additional stack of Freezing.

Each stack of Freezing that you Shatter deals 104 damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
寒冰箭爆击时，额外施加1层冻结。

你每粉碎一层冻结，对附近敌人造成104点伤害。超过5个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en:
While in combat, Frost crystallizes around you, generating an Icicle every 5.4 sec. Upon generating 5 Icicles, Frostbolt upgrades to Glacial Spike for its next cast.

 Glacial Spike
Conjures a massive spike of ice that impales your target, dealing 5,365 damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.
options.description_zh:
在战斗中，冰霜会在你周围凝结，每5.4秒生成一枚冰刺。当你生成5枚冰刺后，你的下一个寒冰箭将升级为冰川尖刺。

 冰川尖刺
召唤一根巨型寒冰尖刺穿刺你的目标，造成5,557点伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续8秒。

施加3层冻结效果。

options.description_en: Flurry and Fire Blast now deal Frostfire damage and their damage is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 冰风暴和火焰冲击现在造成霜火伤害，且其伤害提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 热能调控 / 剧烈温差

options.description_en: Frostfire Bolt's cast time is reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 霜火之箭的施法时间缩短10%。

options.description_en: Frostfire Empowerment stacks 1 additional time and it causes Frostfire Bolt to explode for an additional 20% of its damage.
options.description_zh: 霜火增效可额外叠加1层，并使霜火之箭爆炸造成额外20%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Your Frost and Fire spells deal 20% increased critical strike damage.

Ice Lance and Pyroblast  have their damage increased by 40%.
options.description_zh:
冰霜与火焰法术的爆击伤害提高20%。

冰枪术和炎爆术的伤害提高40%。

options.description_en: Your Frostfire spells apply Ignite at 10% increased effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 你的霜火法术施加点燃效果，效果提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 飘忽咒师 / 蓦然回首

options.description_en: You have 40% increased movement speed during Alter Time.
options.description_zh: 在操控时间期间，你的移动速度提高40%。

options.description_en: While in combat, Blink summons a Mirror Image at your previous location.
options.description_zh: 在战斗中使用闪现时，会在你原来的位置召唤一个镜像。

options.description_en: 40% of the direct damage dealt by an Arcane Splinter is also dealt to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 奥术裂片造成直接伤害的40%的伤害会同时作用于附近的敌人。目标超过5个时伤害会降低。

nodes.name_zh: 反馈壁垒 / 幻形幻象

options.description_en:
Your Prismatic Barrier can absorb up to 25% more damage based on your missing health.

Max effectiveness when under 25% health.
options.description_zh:
你的棱光护体的伤害吸收量最多提高25%，这取决于你损失的生命值。

生命值低于25%时达到最大效果。

options.description_en: Your Mirror Image summons 1 extra copy of you.
options.description_zh: 你的镜像额外召唤1个复制体。

options.description_en:
Direct damage from Arcane Splinters have a 25% chance to grant 1 stack Arcane Salvo.

 Arcane Salvo
Increases the damage of your next Arcane Barrage by 3%.
options.description_zh:
来自奥术碎片的直接伤害有25%的几率获得1次奥术齐射。

 奥术齐射
你的下一个奥术弹幕伤害提高3%。

options.description_en:
Unleash a flurry of ice, striking the target 3 times for a total of 1,645 Frost damage.

Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.
options.description_zh:
释放寒冰风暴，打击敌人3次，总共造成1,594点冰霜伤害。

施加3层冻结效果。

nodes.name_zh: 急速冷却 / 冰川壁垒

options.description_en: Resets the cooldown of your Ice Barrier, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Cold, and Ice Block.
options.description_zh: 重置你的寒冰护体、冰霜新星、冰锥术、深寒凝冰和寒冰屏障的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Ice Block now has an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

强化你选择的光环，持续8秒。

虔诚光环：伤害减免提高至12%。

十字军光环：骑乘速度加成提高至60%。

专注光环：受影响的盟友免疫打断和沉默效果。

options.description_en: Mastery: Lightbringer now increases your healing based on the target's proximity to either you or your Beacon of Light, whichever is closer.
options.description_zh: 精通：光明使者现在将按照目标距离你或你的圣光道标中较近的一方的距离提高治疗量。

options.description_en:
After you cast Holy Prism or Divine Toll, gain Divine Purpose.

 Divine Purpose
Your next Holy Power spending ability is free and deals 15% increased damage and healing.
options.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后获得神圣意志。

 神圣意志
你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能变为免费且造成的伤害和治疗提高15%。

options.description_en: Infusion of Light occurs 100% more often during Avenging Wrath.
options.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，圣光灌注的触发频率提高100%。

options.description_en: Light of Dawn and Holy Shock have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 黎明之光和神圣震击有15%的几率再次施放，产生30%的效果。

options.description_en: Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath.
options.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，晨光的爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn gain up to 30% additional chance to critically strike, based on their target's current health. Lower health targets are more likely to be critically struck.
options.description_zh: 荣耀圣令和黎明之光根据目标当前的生命值获得最多30%的额外爆击几率。生命值越低的目标越有可能被爆击。

options.description_en: Activating Aura Mastery also casts a Divine Toll at 200% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 激活光环掌握也会施放一次效果为200%的圣洁鸣钟。

options.description_en: Light of Dawn receives 20% increased benefit from Mastery: Lightbringer.
options.description_zh: 黎明之光从精通：光明使者获得的增益提高20%。

options.description_en: Holy Shock, Holy Light, and Flash of Light critical healing increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击、圣光术与圣光闪现的爆击治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_en: You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing 82 Radiant damage to enemies or 141 healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 你与30码范围内的晨光产生联结，对穿越光束的敌人造成82点光辉伤害，为穿越光束的盟友恢复141点生命值，目标数量超过5个时效果降低。

nodes.name_zh: 恻隐时刻 / 壮丽圣光

options.description_en: Your Flash of Light heals for an additional 50% when cast on a target affected by your Beacon of Light.
options.description_zh: 你的圣光闪现会对受你圣光道标影响的目标造成50%的额外治疗。

options.description_en: Holy Light heals up to 5 targets within 12 yds for 8% of its healing.
options.description_zh: 圣光术会治疗12码范围内最多5个目标，治疗量为原本的8%。

options.description_en: The mana cost of Holy Light is reduced by 10% and its cast time is reduced by 15%.
options.description_zh: 圣光术的法力值消耗降低10%，施法时间缩短15%。

nodes.name_zh: 不屈精神 / 提尔的保护

options.description_en: The cooldown of Aura Mastery is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 光环掌握的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Aura Mastery also increases all healing received by party or raid members within 40 yards by 10%.
options.description_zh: 光环掌握现在将使40码内的小队和团队成员受到的所有治疗量提高10%。

options.description_en: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Shock by 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗圣光灌注会使神圣震击冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

options.description_en: While above 80% health, Holy Shock's healing is increased 20%, but creates a heal absorb on you for 30% of the amount healed that prevents Beacon of Light from healing you until it has dissipated.
options.description_zh: 生命值高于80%时，神圣震击的治疗效果提高20%，但会使你受到吸收治疗效果的影响，数值相当于该次治疗量的30%，吸收治疗效果存在期间你无法获得圣光道标的治疗。

options.description_en:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

 Holy Bulwark:

While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.

Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

Generates 3 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
让圣光凝聚并显化为一件神圣军备，由你的友方目标持有。

 神圣壁垒：

持有神圣壁垒时，获得一个吸收护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的15.0%，并且每2秒吸收量提高2.0%。持续20秒。

使用后变为圣洁武器。

产生3层神圣能量。

options.description_en:
Judgment has a 100% chance to cast Consecration at the target's location.

The limit on Consecration does not apply to this effect.
options.description_zh:
审判有100%的几率在目标位置施放奉献。

该效果无视奉献的数量限制。

options.description_en: When an ally with your Beacon of Light is damaged, they absorb the next 85 damage, increasing by up to 300% based on their current health. Lower health allies are shielded for more.
options.description_zh: 当一名受到你圣光道标影响的盟友受到伤害时，会吸收接下来受到的85点伤害，吸收量最多提高当前生命值的300%。生命值越低的盟友获得的护盾越多。

options.description_en: Allies with Beacon of Light receive 5% less damage.
options.description_zh: 受到圣光道标影响的盟友受到的伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: 50% of Holy Shock's overhealing is converted into an absorb shield. The shield amount cannot exceed 10% of your max health.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击过量治疗的50%会转化为一个吸收护盾。护盾量不能超过你最大生命值的10%。

options.description_en:
Shield of the Righteous deals 970 damage to its first target struck.

Shield of the Righteous now has a 35% chance to activate Divine Purpose if talented.
options.description_zh:
正义盾击对击中的第一个目标造成969点伤害。

如习得神圣意志，正义盾击有35%的几率激活神圣意志。

nodes.name_en: Rite of Sanctification / Rite of Adjuration
nodes.name_zh: 圣言祭礼 / 恳求祭礼

options.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.

Lasts 1 hour.
options.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的护甲值提高5%，你的主要属性提高2%。

持续1小时。

options.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your Stamina by 3% and causing your Holy Power abilities to sometimes unleash a burst of healing around a target.

Lasts 1 hour.
options.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的耐力提高3%，消耗神圣能量的技能有时会在一个目标周围产生治疗爆发。

持续1小时。

options.description_en:
If you bestow an Armament upon an ally, you also gain its benefits.

If you bestow an Armament upon yourself, a nearby ally also gains its benefits.
options.description_zh:
如果你为盟友赋予军备，你也会获得其效果。

如果你为自己赋予军备，附近的一名盟友也会获得其效果。

nodes.name_zh: 神恩指引 / 圣眷在握

options.description_en:
For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals 760 damage immediately, split across all enemies.

Up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for 30% of the damage amount.
options.description_zh:
每施放一次消耗神圣能量的技能，你的下一个奉献会立即造成760点伤害，由所有敌人均摊。

最多为附近3名盟友恢复相当于该伤害30%的生命值。

options.description_en: Casting a Holy Power ability increases the damage and healing of your next Crusader Strike by 100%.
options.description_zh: 施放一个消耗神圣能量的技能会使你的下一个十字军打击的伤害和治疗效果提高100%。

options.description_en: After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Crusader Strike bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.
options.description_zh: 施放神圣军备后，你接下来3次施放的十字军打击会对附近一名盟友施加同类的次级军备。

options.description_en: 12% of Word of Glory and Light of Dawn's healing is converted into Holy damage that strikes a nearby enemy.
options.description_zh: 荣耀圣令和黎明之光12%的治疗量转化为神圣伤害，打击一名附近的敌人。

options.description_en: Holy Shock reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 1.5 sec and Crusader Strike reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 1.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击使审判的冷却时间缩短1.5秒，十字军打击使审判的冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

options.description_en: Lay on Hands' cooldown is reduced by 40% and restores 5% of your Mana.
options.description_zh: 圣疗术的冷却时间缩短40%，并恢复5%的法力值。

options.description_en: Beacon of Light transfers an additional 5% of the amount healed.
options.description_zh: 圣光道标可额外传输5%的治疗量。

options.description_en: While at maximum health, targets with Beacon of Light generate an absorb shield equal to 2% of their health every 3 sec, up to a maximum of 6%.
options.description_zh: 生命值全满时，带有圣光道标的目标每3秒生成一个吸收护盾，护盾值相当于其生命值的2%，最多不超过6%。

options.description_en: Increases Light of Dawn's healing by 5%.
options.description_zh: 黎明之光的治疗效果提高5%。

options.description_en: Increases Light of Dawn's healing by 10%.
options.description_zh: 黎明之光的治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: While empowered by Infusion of Light, Flash of Light heals for an additional 20% and Judgment refunds 0.5% of your maximum mana.
options.description_zh: 在圣光灌注的影响下，圣光闪现的治疗量提高20%，并且审判将返还0.5%的最大法力值。

options.description_en: Holy Shock and Judgment have a 8% increased critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击和审判的爆击几率提高8%。

options.description_en:
Light of the Martyr's health threshold is reduced to 70% and increases Holy Shock's healing by an additional 5% for every 5 sec Light of the Martyr is active, stacking up to 3 times.

While below 70% health, the light urgently heals you for 76 every 1 sec.
options.description_zh:
殉道者之光的生命值阈值降低至70%，并且殉道者之光每激活5秒，都会使神圣震击的治疗效果额外提高5%，最多叠加3次。

生命值低于70%时，圣光会紧急治疗你，每1秒恢复76点生命值。

options.description_en: When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Infusion of Light.
options.description_zh: 当你身上的军备消散时，圣疗术的冷却时间缩短15.0秒，并使你获得圣光灌注。

nodes.name_zh: 神圣鼓舞 / 先兆之备

options.description_en: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能有几率为附近的一名盟友显化一件神圣军备。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Holy Armaments is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 神圣军备的冷却时间缩短20%。

nodes.name_zh: 权令责难 / 战火淬炼

options.description_en: Successfully dispelling a harmful effect reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1.0 sec. Effect increased by 100% while wielding a Holy Armament.
options.description_zh: 成功驱散有害效果会使清洁术的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。装备神圣军备时效果提高100%。

options.description_en:
When you or an ally wielding a Holy Bulwark are healed above maximum health, transfer 100% of the overhealing to your ally.

When you or an ally wielding a Sacred Weapon drop below 40% health, redistribute your health immediately and every 1 sec for 4 sec. May only occur once per cast.
options.description_zh:
当你或持有神圣壁垒的盟友受到超过最大生命值的治疗时，将100%的过量治疗转移给你的盟友。

当你或持有圣洁武器的盟友生命值低于40%时，立即重新分配你们的生命值，每1秒重复一次，持续4秒。每次施放只能触发一次效果。

options.description_en: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for 430.
options.description_zh: 审判爆击时在目标周围产生冲击波，为至多5名受伤盟友恢复430点生命值。

nodes.name_en: Beacon of Faith / Beacon of Virtue
nodes.name_zh: 信仰道标 / 美德道标

options.description_en: Mark a second target as a Beacon, mimicking the effects of Beacon of Light. Your heals will now heal both of your Beacons, but at 30% reduced effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 将另一个目标设成道标，效果形同圣光道标。你的治疗现在同时影响两个道标，但效果会降低30%。

options.description_en:
Apply a Beacon of Light to your target and 4 injured allies within 30 yds for 9 sec.

All affected allies will be healed for 10% of the amount of your other healing done.
options.description_zh:
对你的目标和30码范围内的4名受伤的盟友施放一个圣光道标，持续9秒。

所有受到影响的盟友都会同时受到你对其他目标造成的治疗的10%。

options.description_en: Judgment critical strikes empower your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn at 30% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 审判爆击会使你的下一个荣耀圣令自动触发黎明之光，效果为30%。

options.description_en:
Judgment grants an absorb shield on up to 5 injured allies for 8% of the damage done, split evenly among them.

Flash of Light and Holy Light critical strikes reset the cooldown of Judgment.
options.description_zh:
审判为最多5个受伤的盟友施加吸收盾，吸收量等同于造成伤害的8%，由这些盟友均摊。

圣光闪现和圣光术爆击时，重置审判的冷却时间。

nodes.name_zh: 复仇之怒 / 复仇十字军

options.description_en: Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 20% for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤圣光之力，成为惩戒的化身，你的伤害、治疗效果和爆击几率提高20%，持续20秒。

options.description_en:
You become the ultimate crusader of light, for 15 sec. Auto-attack damage is increased by 1,000%, Judgment and Crusader Strike heal up to 5 injured allies within 40 yds for 55% of the damage done, split evenly among them.

This spell is replaced with Crusader Strike while active.

Crusader Strike:
Strike the target for 49 Physical damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
你化身成为圣光的终极战士，持续15秒。自动攻击伤害提高1,000%，审判和十字军打击会治疗40码范围内最多5名受伤的盟友，治疗量相当于技能造成伤害的55%，由这些盟友均摊。

此法术激活时会被十字军打击替代。

十字军打击：
打击目标，造成49点物理伤害。

产生1层神圣能量。

options.description_en: Holy Shock refunds up to 10% of its Mana cost and deals up to 50% more healing or damage, based on the target's missing health.
options.description_zh: 根据目标损失的生命值，神圣震击最多返还消耗法力值的10%，并额外造成最多50%的治疗或伤害。

options.description_en: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.
options.description_zh: 你激活的光环对具有你的军备的目标产生的效果提高33%。

options.description_en: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗圣光灌注会使神圣军备的冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

options.description_en: When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening.
options.description_zh: 当你的神圣壁垒吸收伤害或你的圣洁武器造成伤害或治疗时，你有几率获得觉醒。

options.description_en: Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 神圣军备会以100%的效果激活槌砧战术。

options.description_en:
Beacon of Faith:
Allies with Beacon of Light or Beacon of Faith are healed for 125 every 3 sec.

 Beacon of Virtue:
Beacon of Virtue instantly heals allies for 2,226.
options.description_zh:
信仰道标：
具有圣光道标或信仰道标的盟友每3秒恢复125点生命值。

美德道标：
美德道标立即为盟友恢复2,226点生命值。

options.description_en:
While Avenging Wrath is not active, you gain 5% Mastery.

While Avenging Wrath is active, you gain 30% movement speed.
options.description_zh:
复仇之怒未激活时，你获得5%精通。

复仇之怒激活时，你获得30%移动速度。

options.description_en: Avenging Wrath and Avenging Crusader have 25% increased duration.
options.description_zh: 复仇之怒和复仇十字军的持续时间延长25%。

options.description_en:
While in combat, your Holy Power spenders have a 15% chance to cause your next Judgment to deal 30% increased damage and critically strike.

Activating Avenging Wrath activates Awakening.
options.description_zh:
在战斗中时，消耗神圣能量的技能有15%的几率使你的下一个审判造成的伤害提高30%且必定爆击。

激活复仇之怒会激活觉醒。

options.description_en:
Avenging Wrath's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, but its duration is reduced by 4.0 sec.

Avenging Crusader's cooldown is reduced by 7.5 sec, but its duration is reduced by 2.5 sec.
options.description_zh:
复仇之怒的冷却时间缩短15秒，但持续时间缩短4.0秒。

复仇十字军的冷却时间缩短7.5秒，但持续时间缩短2.5秒。

options.description_en:
Avenging Wrath's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, but its duration is reduced by 8.0 sec.

Avenging Crusader's cooldown is reduced by 15.0 sec, but its duration is reduced by 5.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
复仇之怒的冷却时间缩短30秒，但持续时间缩短8.0秒。

复仇十字军的冷却时间缩短15.0秒，但持续时间缩短5.0秒。

options.description_en: Judgment heals you for 1,185 and its mana cost is reduced by 30%. 50% of overhealing from this effect is transferred onto 2 allies within 40 yds.
options.description_zh: 审判为你恢复1,185点生命值，消耗的法力值降低30%。该效果产生的过量治疗的50%转移给40码内的2名盟友。

options.description_en: Holy Light's healing is increased by 30%, but its mana cost is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 圣光术的治疗效果提高30%，但法力值消耗增加20%。

options.description_en: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.
options.description_zh: 复仇之怒额外召唤一把圣洁武器，在复仇之怒期间，你的圣洁武器会对目标施放法术，并模仿你施放神圣能量技能。

options.description_en: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the average health percentage of allies with your Beacon of Light.
options.description_zh: 基于携带你的圣光道标盟友的平均生命值百分比，你的治疗量最多提高10%。

options.description_en: Holy Shock has a 12% chance to refund a charge when cast and its healing is increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击有12%的几率在施放时返还一层充能，并且其治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: Word of Glory and Light of Dawn now convert 15% of their healing into an absorb shield instead.
options.description_zh: 荣耀圣令和黎明之光现在将其15%的治疗量转化为吸收盾。

nodes.name_zh: 提尔的拯救 / 神性之手

options.description_en:
Activating Avenging Wrath releases the Light within yourself, healing 5 injured allies instantly and an injured ally every 0.9 sec within 40 yds for 133.

Allies healed also receive 10% increased healing from your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells for 12 sec.
options.description_zh:
激活复仇之怒，释放你体内的圣光，立即为5名受伤的盟友恢复133点生命值，并且每0.9秒为40码范围内一名受伤的盟友恢复等量的生命值。

受到治疗的盟友从你的圣光术、圣光闪现和神圣震击法术中受到的治疗效果提高10%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Activating Avenging Wrath calls upon the Light to empower you, causing your next 2 Holy Lights to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.
options.description_zh: 激活复仇之怒，呼唤圣光强化你，使你下2个圣光术变为瞬发，且法力消耗降低50%。

options.description_en: Infusion of Light has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 圣光灌注的使用次数增加1次。

options.description_en:
While in combat, apply a Beacon of the Savior to the lowest health ally within 30 yds that causes your direct healing on others to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed.

Beacon of the Savior transfers to the lowest health ally within 30 yds if it heals a target past maximum health or if an ally drops below 50% health.
options.description_zh:
在战斗中，对30码内生命值最低的盟友施加救世道标，使你对他人的直接治疗也会治疗该盟友，治疗量为直接治疗量的10%。

如果救世道标的治疗使目标生命值超过最大值，或者有盟友的生命值降至50%以下，则救世道标会转移至30码内生命值最低的盟友身上。

options.description_en:
If you bestow an Armament upon an ally, you also gain its benefits.

If you bestow an Armament upon yourself, a nearby ally also gains its benefits.
options.description_zh:
如果你为盟友赋予军备，你也会获得其效果。

如果你为自己赋予军备，附近的一名盟友也会获得其效果。

options.description_en: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗圣光灌注会使神圣军备的冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

options.description_en: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.
options.description_zh: 复仇之怒额外召唤一把圣洁武器，在复仇之怒期间，你的圣洁武器会对目标施放法术，并模仿你施放神圣能量技能。

nodes.name_zh: 神圣鼓舞 / 先兆之备

options.description_en: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能有几率为附近的一名盟友显化一件神圣军备。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Holy Armaments is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 神圣军备的冷却时间缩短20%。

nodes.name_zh: 权令责难 / 战火淬炼

options.description_en: Successfully dispelling a harmful effect reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1.0 sec. Effect increased by 100% while wielding a Holy Armament.
options.description_zh: 成功驱散有害效果会使清洁术的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。装备神圣军备时效果提高100%。

options.description_en:
When you or an ally wielding a Holy Bulwark are healed above maximum health, transfer 100% of the overhealing to your ally.

When you or an ally wielding a Sacred Weapon drop below 40% health, redistribute your health immediately and every 1 sec for 4 sec. May only occur once per cast.
options.description_zh:
当你或持有神圣壁垒的盟友受到超过最大生命值的治疗时，将100%的过量治疗转移给你的盟友。

当你或持有圣洁武器的盟友生命值低于40%时，立即重新分配你们的生命值，每1秒重复一次，持续4秒。每次施放只能触发一次效果。

nodes.name_en: Rite of Sanctification / Rite of Adjuration
nodes.name_zh: 圣言祭礼 / 恳求祭礼

options.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.

Lasts 1 hour.
options.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的护甲值提高5%，你的主要属性提高2%。

持续1小时。

options.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your Stamina by 3% and causing your Holy Power abilities to sometimes unleash a burst of healing around a target.

Lasts 1 hour.
options.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的耐力提高3%，消耗神圣能量的技能有时会在一个目标周围产生治疗爆发。

持续1小时。

options.description_en:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

 Holy Bulwark:

While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.

Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

Generates 3 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
让圣光凝聚并显化为一件神圣军备，由你的友方目标持有。

 神圣壁垒：

持有神圣壁垒时，获得一个吸收护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的15.0%，并且每2秒吸收量提高2.0%。持续20秒。

使用后变为圣洁武器。

产生3层神圣能量。

options.description_en:
For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals 760 damage immediately, split across all enemies.

Up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for 30% of the damage amount.
options.description_zh:
每施放一次消耗神圣能量的技能，你的下一个奉献会立即造成760点伤害，由所有敌人均摊。

最多为附近3名盟友恢复相当于该伤害30%的生命值。

options.description_en: Casting a Holy Power ability increases the damage and healing of your next Crusader Strike by 100%.

options.description_zh: 当你身上的军备消散时，圣疗术的冷却时间缩短15.0秒，并使你获得圣光灌注。

options.description_en: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.
options.description_zh: 你激活的光环对具有你的军备的目标产生的效果提高33%。

options.description_en: When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening.
options.description_zh: 当你的神圣壁垒吸收伤害或你的圣洁武器造成伤害或治疗时，你有几率获得觉醒。

options.description_en: After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Crusader Strike bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.
options.description_zh: 施放神圣军备后，你接下来3次施放的十字军打击会对附近一名盟友施加同类的次级军备。

options.description_en: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for 430.
options.description_zh: 审判爆击时在目标周围产生冲击波，为至多5名受伤盟友恢复430点生命值。

options.description_en: Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.

Generates 3 Holy Power.

让圣光凝聚并显化为一件神圣军备，由你的友方目标持有。

产生3层神圣能量。

 Divine Purpose

options.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后获得神圣意志。

 神圣意志
你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能变为免费且造成的伤害和治疗提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 安瑟的祝福 / 余辉不散

options.description_en: The healing and damage of Holy Shock is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击的治疗效果和伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Dawnlight leaves an Eternal Flame for 6 sec on allies or a Greater Judgment on enemies when it expires or is extended.
options.description_zh: 晨光的效果结束或被延长时会在盟友身上留下永恒之火，持续6秒，或为敌人施加强效审判。

options.description_en: Holy Shock and Light of Dawn critical strikes cause the target to be healed for an additional 281 over 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击在4秒内为目标额外恢复281点生命值。

Every 5.0 sec, your next Dawnlight's damage or healing is increased by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.

Morning Star stacks twice as fast while out of combat.
options.description_zh:
每过5.0秒，你的下一个晨光的伤害或治疗效果提高5%，最多叠加10次。

未进入战斗时，晨星的叠加速度变为两倍。

options.description_en: Your Holy Power spenders deal 3% additional damage and healing.
options.description_zh: 你的神圣能量消耗技能造成的伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

options.description_en: Critical Strike chance of Holy Shock and Light of Dawn increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击几率提高5%。

options.description_zh: 黎明之光和神圣震击有15%的几率再次施放，产生30%的效果。

options.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，圣光灌注的触发频率提高100%。

Heals an ally for 1,436 and an additional 465 over 16 sec.

options.description_zh:
为一名盟友恢复1,436点生命值，并在16秒内额外恢复465点。

对自己施放时治疗效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Dawnlight reduces the movement speed of enemies by 50% and increases the movement speed of allies by 20%.
options.description_zh: 晨光使敌人的移动速度降低50%，使盟友的移动速度提高20%。

Movement speed increased by 5% while above 80% health.

When your health is brought below 35%, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 5 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 1 min.
options.description_zh:
生命值高于80%时移动速度提高5%。

生命值降至35%时，你的移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。该效果每1分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing 1,327 Radiant damage or 2,802 healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.
options.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后，你的下2个消耗神圣能量的技能会对目标施加晨光，在8秒内造成1,327点光辉伤害或恢复2,802点生命值。

晨光的伤害和治疗效果的8%会辐射给周围的盟友或敌人，目标超过5个时效果降低。

晨光的治疗效果不会转移给圣光道标。

options.description_en: You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing 82 Radiant damage to enemies or 141 healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 你与30码范围内的晨光产生联结，对穿越光束的敌人造成82点光辉伤害，为穿越光束的盟友恢复141点生命值，目标数量超过5个时效果降低。

options.description_en: Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.5 sec when it heals an ally with full health.
options.description_zh: 晨光治疗生命值全满的盟友时，其持续时间延长0.5秒。

options.description_en: Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath.
options.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，晨光的爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Haste is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高5%。

options.description_en:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
治疗一个友方目标，数值相当于你的最大生命值的100%。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律效果，持续30秒。

options.description_en:
Learn Concentration Aura, Devotion Aura, and Crusader Aura:

Concentration Aura:
Interrupt and Silence effects on party and raid members within 40 yds are 30% shorter. 

 Devotion Aura:
Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

 Crusader Aura:
Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.
options.description_zh:
学习专注光环、虔诚光环和十字军光环：

专注光环:
40码范围内的小队及团队成员受到打断和沉默效果的持续时间缩短30%。

 虔诚光环:
使40码范围内的小队和团队成员受到自身虔诚的激励，受到的伤害降低3%。

 十字军光环:
40码范围内的所有小队及团队成员的坐骑速度提高20%。

options.description_en:
During Avenging Wrath, Judgment is empowered into Hammer of Wrath.

 Hammer of Wrath
Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for 44 Holy damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
在复仇之怒期间，审判被强化为愤怒之锤。

 愤怒之锤
扔出一把神圣之锤，对一名敌人造成43点神圣伤害。

产生1点神圣能量。

options.description_en: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects.
options.description_zh: 净化一个友方目标，移除所有中毒效果和疾病效果。

options.description_en: Lay on Hands grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec and now ignores healing reduction effects.
options.description_zh: 圣疗术使目标的护甲值提高30%，持续8秒，且现在会忽视治疗降低效果。

options.description_en: Hammer of Justice's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 制裁之锤的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 向四面八方发出耀眼的光芒，使10码范围内的敌人暂时失明，并使其迷惑地游荡，持续6秒。伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en: The power of the Light compels an Undead, Aberration, or Demon target to flee for up to 40 sec. Damage may break the effect. Lesser creatures have a chance to be destroyed. Only one target can be turned at a time.
options.description_zh: 圣光的力量迫使一个亡灵、畸变怪或恶魔目标逃跑，最多迷惑40秒。受到伤害后可能会打破这一效果。小型生物有几率被消灭。同一时间只能对一个目标施放。

options.description_en: After Cleanse successfully removes an effect from an ally, they are healed for 2,052.
options.description_zh: 清洁术成功移除盟友身上的效果后，会为其恢复2,052点生命值。

options.description_en: After Cleanse successfully removes an effect from an ally, they are healed for 4,104.
options.description_zh: 清洁术成功移除盟友身上的效果后，会为其恢复4,104点生命值。

options.description_en: After you spend 20 Holy Power, your next Word of Glory echoes onto a nearby ally at 30% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 在消耗20层神圣能量后，你的下一个荣耀圣令在附近的一名盟友身上产生30%的效果。

When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.

Cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降低到25%以下时，立即对自己施放一次免费的荣耀圣令，效果为原来的60%。

每60秒最多触发一次。

options.description_en: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.
options.description_zh: 跃上战马，移动速度提高100%，持续3秒。可以在室内或战斗中使用。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Blinding Light is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 盲目之光的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en:
Judgment causes the target to take 20% increased damage from your next Holy Power ability.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
审判使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能对目标造成的伤害提高20%。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_zh: 超度邪恶的施法时间缩短100%。

options.description_zh: 超度邪恶现在会额外影响5个敌人。

options.description_zh: 你的自律持续时间减少10秒。

options.description_zh: 你的光环作用范围提高20码。

options.description_zh:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其所受伤害降低30%，降低伤害的100%由你来承担。

options.description_zh: 审判现在有2次使用次数，且大十字军同时会使审判的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Consecration deals 100% increased damage when it strikes a single target.
options.description_zh: 当奉献仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Consecration lasts 2 sec longer and its damage is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 奉献的持续时间延长2秒，伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Consecration lasts 2 sec longer and its damage is increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 奉献的持续时间延长2秒，伤害提高30%。

nodes.name_en: Rite of Sanctification / Rite of Adjuration
nodes.name_zh: 圣言祭礼 / 恳求祭礼

options.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.

Lasts 1 hour.
options.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的护甲值提高5%，你的主要属性提高2%。

持续1小时。

options.description_en:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your Stamina by 3% and causing your Holy Power abilities to sometimes unleash a burst of healing around a target.

Lasts 1 hour.
options.description_zh:
为武器注入圣光之力，使你的耐力提高3%，消耗神圣能量的技能有时会在一个目标周围产生治疗爆发。

持续1小时。

options.description_en:
If you bestow an Armament upon an ally, you also gain its benefits.

If you bestow an Armament upon yourself, a nearby ally also gains its benefits.
options.description_zh:
如果你为盟友赋予军备，你也会获得其效果。

如果你为自己赋予军备，附近的一名盟友也会获得其效果。

nodes.name_zh: 神恩指引 / 圣眷在握

options.description_en:
For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals 760 damage immediately, split across all enemies.

Up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for 30% of the damage amount.
options.description_zh:
每施放一次消耗神圣能量的技能，你的下一个奉献会立即造成760点伤害，由所有敌人均摊。

最多为附近3名盟友恢复相当于该伤害30%的生命值。

options.description_en: Casting a Holy Power ability increases the damage and healing of your next Crusader Strike by 100%.
options.description_zh: 施放一个消耗神圣能量的技能会使你的下一个十字军打击的伤害和治疗效果提高100%。

options.description_en: After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Crusader Strike bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.
options.description_zh: 施放神圣军备后，你接下来3次施放的十字军打击会对附近一名盟友施加同类的次级军备。

nodes.name_zh: 飞舞之盾 / 专注敌意

options.description_en: Avenger's Shield jumps to 2 additional targets.
options.description_zh: 复仇者之盾会额外跳向2个目标。

options.description_en: When Avenger's Shield strikes a single enemy, it deals 100% additional Holy damage.
options.description_zh: 复仇者之盾只打击一个目标时，额外造成100%的神圣伤害。

options.description_en: Empowers you with the spirit of ancient kings, reducing all damage you take by 50% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 你被远古列王的灵魂赋予了力量，受到的所有伤害降低50%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: While in your Consecration and for 4.0 sec after leaving it, your damage taken is reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 当你在奉献范围内，以及离开奉献的4.0秒内，你受到的伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Infusion of Light.
options.description_zh: 当你身上的军备消散时，圣疗术的冷却时间缩短15.0秒，并使你获得圣光灌注。

nodes.name_zh: 神圣鼓舞 / 先兆之备

options.description_en: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能有几率为附近的一名盟友显化一件神圣军备。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Holy Armaments is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 神圣军备的冷却时间缩短20%。

nodes.name_zh: 权令责难 / 战火淬炼

options.description_en: Successfully dispelling a harmful effect reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1.0 sec. Effect increased by 100% while wielding a Holy Armament.
options.description_zh: 成功驱散有害效果会使清洁术的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。装备神圣军备时效果提高100%。

options.description_en:
When you or an ally wielding a Holy Bulwark are healed above maximum health, transfer 100% of the overhealing to your ally.

When you or an ally wielding a Sacred Weapon drop below 40% health, redistribute your health immediately and every 1 sec for 4 sec. May only occur once per cast.
options.description_zh:
当你或持有神圣壁垒的盟友受到超过最大生命值的治疗时，将100%的过量治疗转移给你的盟友。

当你或持有圣洁武器的盟友生命值低于40%时，立即重新分配你们的生命值，每1秒重复一次，持续4秒。每次施放只能触发一次效果。

options.description_en: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for 430.
options.description_zh: 审判爆击时在目标周围产生冲击波，为至多5名受伤盟友恢复430点生命值。

nodes.name_zh: 逆境搏力 / 十字军的决心

options.description_en: For each target hit by Avenger's Shield, gain 3% parry for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 复仇者之盾每命中一个目标，就获得3%的招架，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Enemies hit by Avenger's Shield deal 10% reduced melee damage to you for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 被复仇者之盾击中的敌人对你造成的近战伤害降低10%，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
Each enemy hit by Avenger's Shield reduces the remaining cooldown on Guardian of Ancient Kings by 1.0 sec.

When you drop below 30% health, you become infused with Guardian of Ancient Kings for 4 sec. This cannot occur again for 45 sec.
options.description_zh:
复仇者之盾每击中一个敌人，就会使远古列王守卫剩余的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

当你的生命值降至30%以下时，你会受到远古列王守卫的护持，持续4秒。此效果在45秒内不能再次触发。

options.description_en: Guardian of Ancient Kings has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 远古列王守卫拥有1层额外充能。

options.description_en: When you cast Word of Glory on someone other than yourself, you are also healed for 100% of the amount healed.
options.description_zh: 你对别人施放荣耀圣令时也会治疗自己，治疗量为100%。

options.description_en: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.
options.description_zh: 你激活的光环对具有你的军备的目标产生的效果提高33%。

options.description_en: Consuming Infusion of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗圣光灌注会使神圣军备的冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

options.description_en: When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening.
options.description_zh: 当你的神圣壁垒吸收伤害或你的圣洁武器造成伤害或治疗时，你有几率获得觉醒。

options.description_en: Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 神圣军备会以100%的效果激活槌砧战术。

options.description_en: Avenger's Shield deals 10% increased damage to its primary target.
options.description_zh: 复仇者之盾对主目标的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Avenger's Shield deals 20% increased damage to its primary target.
options.description_zh: 复仇者之盾对主目标的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en:
Call upon the Light and gain 15 stacks of Divine Resolve, increasing your maximum health by 1% and reducing your damage taken by 2% per stack for 20 sec. After 5.0 sec, you will begin to lose 1 stack per second, but each 3 Holy Power spent will delay the loss of your next stack by 1 sec.

While active, your damage and healing are increased by 10%, and critical strike chance is increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
召唤圣光，获得15层神圣决心，每层使你的最大生命值提高1%，并使你受到的伤害降低2%，持续20秒。5.0秒后，开始每秒失去1层，但每消耗3点神圣能量可使下一层的损失推迟1秒。

激活时，你的伤害和治疗效果提高10%，爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Hammer of Wrath and Judgment deal 5% additional damage and extend the duration of Avenging Wrath by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 愤怒之锤和审判造成的伤害提高5%，并会使复仇之怒的持续时间延长0.5秒。

options.description_en: Hammer of Wrath and Judgment deal 10% additional damage and extend the duration of Avenging Wrath by 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 愤怒之锤和审判造成的伤害提高10%，并会使复仇之怒的持续时间延长1.0秒。

options.description_en: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.
options.description_zh: 复仇之怒额外召唤一把圣洁武器，在复仇之怒期间，你的圣洁武器会对目标施放法术，并模仿你施放神圣能量技能。

options.description_en: Judgment chains to 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 审判会弹射至2个额外目标，效果为50%。

options.description_en: Judgment causes its primary target's successful melee attacks against you to grant a Physical absorb shield for 20% of the damage dealt. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 审判使其主要目标对你发起的成功近战攻击产生物理吸收护盾，吸收量为所造成伤害的20%。最高1层。

options.description_en: Avenger's Shield increases the damage of your next Shield of the Righteous by 10% for each target hit by Avenger's Shield, stacking up to 5 times, and increases its radius by 6 yds.
options.description_zh: 复仇者之盾每击中一个目标，你的下一个正义盾击造成的伤害就会提高10%，最多可叠加5次，同时还会使正义盾击的范围扩大6码。

options.description_en: During Divine Shield, all targets within 15 yds are taunted.
options.description_zh: 在圣盾术期间，15码范围内的所有敌人都会被嘲讽。

options.description_en: Avenging Wrath and Sentinel have 50% reduced cooldown and 40% reduced duration.
options.description_zh: 复仇之怒和戒卫的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短40%。

options.description_en:
Judgment has a chance to grant you Vanguard, causing your next Avenger's Shield to leave an echoing bolt of light in a line between you and the initial target, piercing any enemies for up to 150% of the initial damage dealt.

Damage reduced against secondary targets.
options.description_zh:
审判有几率使你获得先锋效果，使你下一次复仇者之盾在你和初始目标之间的连线上留下一道回响的圣光箭，穿透任何被击中的敌人，造成初始伤害最多150%的伤害。

对次要目标伤害降低。

options.description_en:
When Empyrean Hammer critically strikes, 50% of its damage is dealt to nearby enemies.

Enemies hit by this effect deal 5% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
苍穹之锤爆击时对周围敌人造成伤害，数值相当于其伤害的50%。

受该效果影响的敌人对你造成的伤害降低5%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Crusader Strike, Hammer of Wrath and Blade of Justice extend the duration of Shake the Heavens by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 十字军打击、愤怒之锤和公正之剑使倾天圣威的持续时间延长1秒。

options.description_en:
Wake of Ashes surrounds you with a Holy barrier for 10% of your maximum health.

Hammer of Light heals you for 5% of your maximum health, increased by 1% for each additional target hit. Any overhealing done with this effect gets converted into a Holy barrier instead.
options.description_zh:
灰烬觉醒使一道神圣屏障环绕在你的周围，吸收最大生命值10%的伤害。

圣光之锤为你恢复5%的最大生命值，每额外击中一个目标，效果提高1%。该效果造成的过量治疗会转化为神圣屏障。

options.description_en:
Wake of Ashes is replaced with Hammer of Light for 20 sec after it is cast.

 Hammer of Light:
Hammer down your enemy with the power of the Light, dealing 245 Holy damage and 123 Holy damage up to 7 nearby enemies. 

Additionally, calls down Empyrean Hammers from the sky to strike 3 nearby enemies for 16 Holy damage each.

Costs 5 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
施放灰烬觉醒后将其替换为圣光之锤，持续20秒。

圣光之锤：
凝聚圣光之力，挥舞战锤重击敌人，造成239点神圣伤害，并对周围最多7名敌人造成121点神圣伤害。

同时召下苍穹之锤打击周围的3名敌人，对每个目标造成16点神圣伤害。

消耗5层神圣能量。

nodes.name_zh: 亲如手足 / 冷酷战驹

options.description_en: You receive 20% less damage from Blessing of Sacrifice and each time its target takes damage, you gain 4% movement speed up to a maximum of 40%.
options.description_zh: 你从牺牲祝福中受到的伤害降低20%，每当牺牲祝福的目标受到伤害，你的移动速度提高4%，最多提高40%。

options.description_en: Divine Steed lasts 2 sec longer and increases your movement speed by an additional 30% for the first 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 神圣马驹的持续时间延长2秒，且在前3秒内，你的移动速度额外提高30%。

options.description_en:
You gain a stack of Light's Deliverance when you call down an Empyrean Hammer.

While Wake of Ashes and Hammer of Light are unavailable, you consume 60 stacks of Light's Deliverance, empowering yourself to cast Hammer of Light an additional time for free.
options.description_zh:
当你召下苍穹之锤时获得一层圣光裁决。

灰烬觉醒和圣光之锤都不可用时，你会消耗60层圣光裁决强化自己，使你能够额外施放一次不产生消耗的圣光之锤。

options.description_en: Hammer of Light instantly calls down 2 Empyrean Hammers on your target when it is cast.
options.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤时立即对目标降下2把苍穹之锤。

options.description_en:
Templar's Verdict calls down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby enemy.

While Shake the Heavens is active, this effect calls down an additional Empyrean Hammer.
options.description_zh:
圣殿骑士的裁决会召唤苍穹之锤砸向附近敌人。

当倾天圣威效果激活时，该效果会额外召唤一个苍穹之锤。

options.description_en: Empyrean Hammer has a 10% increased chance to critically strike.
options.description_zh: 苍穹之锤的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en:
Casting Judgment increases the damage of Empyrean Hammer by 5% for 10 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
施放审判使苍穹之锤的伤害提高5%，持续10秒。

多层效果可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: Hammer of Light applies Judgment to its targets, and increases your Haste by 12% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 圣光之锤对目标施加审判，并使你的急速提高12%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: After casting Hammer of Light, you call down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby target every 2 sec, for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤后，你每2秒召唤一把苍穹之锤打击附近的一个目标，持续8秒。

nodes.name_en: Divine Exaction / Seal of the Templar
nodes.name_zh: 神圣之征 / 圣殿骑士圣印

options.description_en: Divine Toll casts 2 additional times on your target at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 圣洁鸣钟额外对你的目标施放2次，效果为100%。

options.description_en: Templar's Verdict damage increased by 25%.
options.description_zh: 圣殿骑士的裁决的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Empyrean Hammer deals 20% increased critical strike damage and its critical strikes have 50% chance to grant an additional stack of Light's Deliverance.
options.description_zh: 苍穹之锤造成额外20%的爆击伤害，其爆击有50%几率额外获得一层圣光裁决。

Divine Toll summons Divine Hammers that spin around you for 8 sec.

Divine Hammer
Strikes all enemies nearby for 51 Holy damage every 2 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
圣洁鸣钟会召唤神圣之锤围绕你旋转，持续8秒。

神圣之锤
每2秒对附近所有敌人造成51点神圣伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。
