options.description_zh: 你激活的光环对具有你的军备的目标产生的效果提高33%。

options.description_en: When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening.
options.description_zh: 当你的神圣壁垒吸收伤害或你的圣洁武器造成伤害或治疗时，你有几率获得觉醒。

options.description_en: After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Crusader Strike bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.
options.description_zh: 施放神圣军备后，你接下来3次施放的十字军打击会对附近一名盟友施加同类的次级军备。

options.description_en: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, healing to up to 5 injuried allies for 430.
options.description_zh: 审判爆击时在目标周围产生冲击波，为至多5名受伤盟友恢复430点生命值。

options.description_en: Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 神圣军备会以100%的效果激活槌砧战术。

options.description_en:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

 Holy Bulwark:

While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.

Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

Generates 3 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
让圣光凝聚并显化为一件神圣军备，由你的友方目标持有。

 神圣壁垒：

持有神圣壁垒时，获得一个吸收护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的15.0%，并且每2秒吸收量提高2.0%。持续20秒。

使用后变为圣洁武器。

产生3层神圣能量。

options.description_en:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
治疗一个友方目标，数值相当于你的最大生命值的100%。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律效果，持续30秒。

options.description_en:
Learn Concentration Aura, Devotion Aura, and Crusader Aura:

Concentration Aura:
Interrupt and Silence effects on party and raid members within 40 yds are 30% shorter. 

 Devotion Aura:
Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

 Crusader Aura:
Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.
options.description_zh:
学习专注光环、虔诚光环和十字军光环：

专注光环:
40码范围内的小队及团队成员受到打断和沉默效果的持续时间缩短30%。

 虔诚光环:
使40码范围内的小队和团队成员受到自身虔诚的激励，受到的伤害降低3%。

 十字军光环:
40码范围内的所有小队及团队成员的坐骑速度提高20%。

options.description_en:
During Avenging Wrath, Judgment is empowered into Hammer of Wrath.

 Hammer of Wrath
Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for 44 Holy damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
在复仇之怒期间，审判被强化为愤怒之锤。

 愤怒之锤
扔出一把神圣之锤，对一名敌人造成44点神圣伤害。

产生1点神圣能量。

options.description_en: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects.
options.description_zh: 净化一个友方目标，移除所有中毒效果和疾病效果。

options.description_en: Lay on Hands grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec and now ignores healing reduction effects.
options.description_zh: 圣疗术使目标的护甲值提高30%，持续8秒，且现在会忽视治疗降低效果。

options.description_en: Hammer of Justice's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 制裁之锤的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 向四面八方发出耀眼的光芒，使10码范围内的敌人暂时失明，并使其迷惑地游荡，持续6秒。伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en: The power of the Light compels an Undead, Aberration, or Demon target to flee for up to 40 sec. Damage may break the effect. Lesser creatures have a chance to be destroyed. Only one target can be turned at a time.
options.description_zh: 圣光的力量迫使一个亡灵、畸变怪或恶魔目标逃跑，最多迷惑40秒。受到伤害后可能会打破这一效果。小型生物有几率被消灭。同一时间只能对一个目标施放。

options.description_en: After Cleanse successfully removes an effect from an ally, they are healed for 2,052.
options.description_zh: 清洁术成功移除盟友身上的效果后，会为其恢复2,052点生命值。

options.description_en: After Cleanse successfully removes an effect from an ally, they are healed for 4,104.
options.description_zh: 清洁术成功移除盟友身上的效果后，会为其恢复4,104点生命值。

options.description_en: After you spend 20 Holy Power, your next Word of Glory echoes onto a nearby ally at 30% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 在消耗20层神圣能量后，你的下一个荣耀圣令在附近的一名盟友身上产生30%的效果。

options.description_en:
The cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced up to 60%, based on the target's missing health.

Word of Glory's healing is increased by up to 100% on yourself, based on your missing health.
options.description_zh:
圣疗术的冷却时间最多缩短60%，数值取决于目标失去的生命值。

荣耀圣令对自身的治疗的治疗效果最多提高100%，数值取决于你失去的生命值。

options.description_en:
When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.

Cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降低到25%以下时，立即对自己施放一次免费的荣耀圣令，效果为原来的60%。

每60秒最多触发一次。

options.description_en: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.
options.description_zh: 跃上战马，移动速度提高100%，持续3秒。可以在室内或战斗中使用。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Blinding Light is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 盲目之光的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en:
Judgment causes the target to take 20% increased damage from your next Holy Power ability.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
审判使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能对目标造成的伤害提高20%。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

nodes.name_zh: 扭转邪恶 / 抵御邪恶

options.description_en: Turn Evil's cast time is reduced by 100%.
options.description_zh: 超度邪恶的施法时间缩短100%。

options.description_en: Turn Evil now affects 5 additional enemies.
options.description_zh: 超度邪恶现在会额外影响5个敌人。

options.description_en: Your Forbearance's duration is reduced by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的自律持续时间减少10秒。

options.description_en:
Divine Protection reduces damage taken by an additional 10% and casts Shield of Vengeance.

Shield of Vengeance
Creates a barrier of holy light that absorbs 9,165 damage for 10 sec.

When the shield expires, it bursts to inflict Holy damage equal to the total amount absorbed, divided among all nearby enemies.
options.description_zh:
圣佑术使你受到的伤害额外降低10%并施放复仇之盾。

复仇之盾
制造一个圣光壁垒，吸收9,165点伤害，持续10秒。

当壁垒持续时间结束时会产生爆炸，造成相当于吸收伤害总量的神圣伤害，由附近的所有敌人分摊。

options.description_en: Divine Steed now has 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 神圣马驹现在可使用2次。

options.description_en: Divine Steed's cooldown is reduced by 20%, but its duration is reduced by 40%.
options.description_zh: 神圣马驹的冷却时间降低20%，但持续时间减少40%。

nodes.name_en: Steed of Liberty / Blessing of Freedom
nodes.name_zh: 自由之驹 / 自由祝福

options.description_en:
Divine Steed also grants Blessing of Freedom for 3.0 sec.

 Blessing of Freedom:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
神圣马驹还会使你获得自由祝福，持续3.0秒。

 自由祝福:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫任何移动限制效果，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫任何移动限制效果，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 打断施法并使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。

options.description_en: Speed increased by 2% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 2%.
options.description_zh: 加速提高2%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低2%。

options.description_en: Speed increased by 4% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.
options.description_zh: 加速提高4%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低4%。

options.description_en: Instantly cast Holy Shock, Avenger's Shield, or Judgment on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.
options.description_zh: 立即对30码范围内最多5个目标施放神圣震击、复仇者之盾或审判。

options.description_en: Blessing of Freedom increases movement speed by 30%, and you gain Blessing of Freedom when cast on a friendly target.
options.description_zh: 自由祝福使移动速度提高30%，并使你在对一名友方目标施放自由祝福时获得自由祝福。

options.description_en: Armor increased by 10%, Stamina increased by 5% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%.
options.description_zh: 护甲提高10%，耐力提高5%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。

options.description_en: Armor increased by 20%, Stamina increased by 10% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 6%.
options.description_zh: 护甲提高20%，耐力提高10%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低6%。

options.description_en: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Rebuke casts an extra Crusader Strike.
options.description_zh: 使用责难成功打断敌人会额外施放一次十字军打击。

options.description_en: The radius of your auras is increased by 20 yds.
options.description_zh: 你的光环作用范围提高20码。

options.description_en: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor causes you to explode with holy energy, healing up to 5 nearby allies and yourself for 218, split evenly among them.
options.description_zh: 击杀可以提供经验值或荣誉的敌人会使你爆发出神圣能量，治疗最多5名附近的盟友和你自己，总共恢复218点生命值，由所有人平均分摊。

options.description_en:
Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.

Last 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.
options.description_zh:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其所受伤害降低30%，降低伤害的100%由你来承担。

持续12秒，或直到转移的伤害使你的生命值降至20%以下为止。

nodes.name_zh: 圣洁共鸣 / 急促祷告

options.description_en: After casting Divine Toll, you instantly cast Holy Shock every 5 sec for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放圣洁鸣钟后，你每5秒会立即施放一次神圣震击，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Divine Toll's, Holy Armament's, and Holy Prism's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 圣洁鸣钟、神圣军备和神圣棱镜的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
祝福一名小队或团队成员，使其免疫所有物理伤害和有害效果，持续10秒。

无法对有自律效果的目标使用。造成自律，持续30秒。

options.description_en: Fear duration on you reduced by 20%. This effect is increased to 60% during Avenging Wrath.
options.description_zh: 你身上的恐惧持续时间缩短20%。在复仇之怒期间，此效果提高至60%。

options.description_en: Your Consecration is 15% larger, and enemies within it have 50% reduced movement speed.
options.description_zh: 你的奉献的影响范围扩大15%，且会使范围内的敌人移动速度降低50%。

options.description_en: Armor and critical strike chance increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 护甲和爆击几率提高4%。

nodes.name_zh: 正义牺牲 / 牺牲报偿

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Sacrifice by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 牺牲祝福的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en:
After your Blessing of Sacrifice ends, 50% of the total damage it diverted is added to your next Judgment as bonus damage, or your next Word of Glory as bonus healing.

This effect's bonus damage cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health and its bonus healing cannot exceed 100% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh:
在牺牲祝福结束时，技能所转移伤害总量的50%将在下一次施放审判时造成额外伤害，或者在施放下一次荣耀圣令时产生额外治疗量。

此效果造成的额外伤害不会超过你最大生命值的30% ，并且产生的额外治疗量不会超过你最大生命值的100%。

nodes.name_zh: 圣洁力量 / 神圣意志

options.description_en: Holy Power spending abilities have 2% increased damage and healing.
options.description_zh: 消耗神圣能量的技能会使你造成的伤害和治疗效果提高2%。

options.description_en: Holy Power spending abilities have a 10% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 10% increased damage and healing.
options.description_zh: 消耗神圣能量的技能有10%的几率会使你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能不消耗资源，并且伤害和治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Protection by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 保护祝福的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Lay on Hands by 30%.
options.description_zh: 使你的圣盾术、圣佑术和圣疗术的冷却时间缩短30%。

options.description_en: Divine Storm heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 43.
options.description_zh: 神圣风暴为你和附近最多2名盟友恢复43点生命值。

options.description_en:
Divine Steed reduces the cooldown of 4 nearby ally's major movement ability by 3.0 sec.

Your movement speed is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh:
神圣马驹会使4个附近盟友的主要移动技能冷却时间减少3.0秒。

你的移动速度提高3%。

nodes.name_zh: 无悔牺牲 / 正义保护

options.description_en:
You automatically cast Blessing of Sacrifice onto an ally within 40 yds when they are below 35% health and you are not in a loss of control effect.

This effect activates 100% of Blessing of Sacrifice's cooldown.
options.description_zh:
当40码范围内的盟友生命值低于35%且你未处于失控状态时，你会自动对其施放牺牲祝福。

此效果会激活牺牲祝福100%的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Blessing of Sacrifice now removes and prevents all Poison and Disease effects.
options.description_zh: 牺牲祝福现在会移除并防止所有中毒和疾病效果。

options.description_en: Allies are healed for 7,541 when you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Sacrifice on them.
options.description_zh: 当你对盟友施放保护祝福或牺牲祝福时，同时使其获得7,625点治疗。

options.description_en: Allies affected by your Blessings have 15% increased movement speed.
options.description_zh: 受你祝福影响的盟友移动速度提高15%。

options.description_en: Divine Protection increases healing taken by 15% for its duration.
options.description_zh: 圣佑术在持续期间内使你受到的治疗效果提高15%。

options.description_en:
Removing harmful effects with Divine Shield heals you for 10% for each effect removed.  This heal cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Divine Shield may now be cast while Forbearance is active.
options.description_zh:
圣盾术每移除一个有害效果，就会为你恢复10%的生命值。该治疗的治疗量不会超过你最大生命值的30%。

处于自律效果时仍可施放圣盾术。

options.description_en: Word of Glory grants 20% bonus armor for 4.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 荣耀圣令额外提供20%的护甲加成，持续4.5秒。

options.description_en: The duration of stun effects on you is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你受到的昏迷效果的持续时间缩短20%。

options.description_en: Mastery increased by 2% and Intellect increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高2%，智力提高2%。

options.description_en: Mastery increased by 4% and Intellect increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高4%，智力提高4%。

options.description_en: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 25% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.
options.description_zh: 愤怒之锤的伤害会随目标的生命值而提高，至多造成25%的额外伤害。目标生命值越低，受到的伤害越高。

options.description_en: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.
options.description_zh: 愤怒之锤的伤害会随目标的生命值而提高，至多造成50%的额外伤害。目标生命值越低，受到的伤害越高。

options.description_en: Melee and ranged attackers receive 133 Holy damage each time they strike you during Divine Protection and Divine Shield.
options.description_zh: 在圣佑术和圣盾术持续期间，近战和远程攻击者每次攻击你时会受到133点神圣伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 辉金之道 / 无私治愈

options.description_en: Consecration heals you and 5 allies within it for 2 every 0.9 sec.
options.description_zh: 奉献每0.9秒为你和站在其中的5名盟友恢复2点生命值。

options.description_en: Flash of Light and Holy Light are 30% more effective on your allies and 40% of the healing done also heals you.
options.description_zh: 圣光闪现和圣光术对你的盟友的效果提高30%，并有40%的治疗量也会治疗你。

options.description_en: While you are above 85% health, 5% of all damage taken by allies within 20 yds is redirected to you, up to a maximum of 1,527 every 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 当20码内的盟友受到伤害时，如果你的生命值在85%以上，所受伤害的5%将转移到你身上，每5秒最多转移1,527点伤害。

options.description_en: 10% of all healing done to you from other sources heals up to 4 nearby allies, divided evenly among them.
options.description_zh: 你从其他来源受到的全部治疗的10%会治疗最多4个附近的盟友，治疗量在他们之间均摊。

options.description_en: Damage taken reduced by up to 10%, increasing as your health decreases.
options.description_zh: 受到的伤害最多降低10%，此效果随生命值降低而提高。

options.description_en:
Wake of Ashes is replaced with Hammer of Light for 20 sec after it is cast.

 Hammer of Light:
Hammer down your enemy with the power of the Light, dealing 241 Holy damage and 121 Holy damage up to 7 nearby enemies. 

Additionally, calls down Empyrean Hammers from the sky to strike 3 nearby enemies for 16 Holy damage each.

Costs 5 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
施放灰烬觉醒后将其替换为圣光之锤，持续20秒。

圣光之锤：
凝聚圣光之力，挥舞战锤重击敌人，造成243点神圣伤害，并对周围最多7名敌人造成123点神圣伤害。

同时召下苍穹之锤打击周围的3名敌人，对每个目标造成16点神圣伤害。

消耗5层神圣能量。

options.description_en:
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing 1,327 Radiant damage or 2,802 healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.
options.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后，你的下2个消耗神圣能量的技能会对目标施加晨光，在8秒内造成1,327点光辉伤害或恢复2,802点生命值。

晨光的伤害和治疗效果的8%会辐射给周围的盟友或敌人，目标超过5个时效果降低。

晨光的治疗效果不会转移给圣光道标。

options.description_en:
Pierce an enemy with a blade of light, dealing 66 Holy damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
options.description_zh:
用圣光的利刃刺穿一名敌人，对目标造成67点神圣伤害。

产生1层神圣能量。

options.description_en: Hammer of Light instantly calls down 2 Empyrean Hammers on your target when it is cast.
options.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤时立即对目标降下2把苍穹之锤。

options.description_en: After casting Hammer of Light, you call down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby target every 2 sec, for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤后，你每2秒召唤一把苍穹之锤打击附近的一个目标，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
When Empyrean Hammer critically strikes, 50% of its damage is dealt to nearby enemies.

Enemies hit by this effect deal 5% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.
options.description_zh:

You gain a stack of Light's Deliverance when you call down an Empyrean Hammer.

While Wake of Ashes and Hammer of Light are unavailable, you consume 60 stacks of Light's Deliverance, empowering yourself to cast Hammer of Light an additional time for free.
options.description_zh:
当你召下苍穹之锤时获得一层圣光裁决。

灰烬觉醒和圣光之锤都不可用时，你会消耗60层圣光裁决强化自己，使你能够额外施放一次不产生消耗的圣光之锤。

options.description_en: Hammer of Light instantly calls down 2 Empyrean Hammers on your target when it is cast.
options.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤时立即对目标降下2把苍穹之锤。

options.description_en:
Templar's Verdict calls down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby enemy.

While Shake the Heavens is active, this effect calls down an additional Empyrean Hammer.
options.description_zh:
圣殿骑士的裁决会召唤苍穹之锤砸向附近敌人。

当倾天圣威效果激活时，该效果会额外召唤一个苍穹之锤。

options.description_en: Empyrean Hammer has a 10% increased chance to critically strike.
options.description_zh: 苍穹之锤的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en:
Casting Judgment increases the damage of Empyrean Hammer by 5% for 10 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
施放审判使苍穹之锤的伤害提高5%，持续10秒。

多层效果可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: Hammer of Light applies Judgment to its targets, and increases your Haste by 12% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 圣光之锤对目标施加审判，并使你的急速提高12%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: After casting Hammer of Light, you call down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby target every 2 sec, for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放圣光之锤后，你每2秒召唤一把苍穹之锤打击附近的一个目标，持续8秒。

nodes.name_en: Divine Exaction / Seal of the Templar
nodes.name_zh: 神圣之征 / 圣殿骑士圣印

options.description_en: Divine Toll casts 2 additional times on your target at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 圣洁鸣钟额外对你的目标施放2次，效果为100%。

options.description_en: Templar's Verdict damage increased by 25%.
options.description_zh: 圣殿骑士的裁决的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Empyrean Hammer deals 20% increased critical strike damage and its critical strikes have 50% chance to grant an additional stack of Light's Deliverance.
options.description_zh: 苍穹之锤造成额外20%的爆击伤害，其爆击有50%几率额外获得一层圣光裁决。

options.description_en:
Divine Toll summons Divine Hammers that spin around you for 8 sec.

Divine Hammer
Strikes all enemies nearby for 50 Holy damage every 2 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
圣洁鸣钟会召唤神圣之锤围绕你旋转，持续8秒。

神圣之锤
每2秒对附近所有敌人造成50点神圣伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
After you cast Holy Prism or Divine Toll, gain Divine Purpose.

 Divine Purpose
Your next Holy Power spending ability is free and deals 15% increased damage and healing.
options.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后获得神圣意志。

 神圣意志
你的下一个消耗神圣能量的技能变为免费且造成的伤害和治疗提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 安瑟的祝福 / 余辉不散

options.description_en: The healing and damage of Holy Shock is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击的治疗效果和伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Dawnlight leaves an Eternal Flame for 6 sec on allies or a Greater Judgment on enemies when it expires or is extended.
options.description_zh: 晨光的效果结束或被延长时会在盟友身上留下永恒之火，持续6秒，或为敌人施加强效审判。

options.description_en: Holy Shock and Light of Dawn critical strikes cause the target to be healed for an additional 281 over 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击在4秒内为目标额外恢复281点生命值。

options.description_en:
Every 5.0 sec, your next Dawnlight's damage or healing is increased by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.

Morning Star stacks twice as fast while out of combat.
options.description_zh:
每过5.0秒，你的下一个晨光的伤害或治疗效果提高5%，最多叠加10次。

未进入战斗时，晨星的叠加速度变为两倍。

options.description_en: Your Holy Power spenders deal 3% additional damage and healing.
options.description_zh: 你的神圣能量消耗技能造成的伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

options.description_en: Critical Strike chance of Holy Shock and Light of Dawn increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Light of Dawn and Holy Shock have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 黎明之光和神圣震击有15%的几率再次施放，产生30%的效果。

options.description_en: Infusion of Light occurs 100% more often during Avenging Wrath.
options.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，圣光灌注的触发频率提高100%。

options.description_en:
Heals an ally for 1,436 and an additional 465 over 16 sec.

Healing increased by 25% when cast on self.
options.description_zh:
为一名盟友恢复1,436点生命值，并在16秒内额外恢复465点。

对自己施放时治疗效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Dawnlight reduces the movement speed of enemies by 50% and increases the movement speed of allies by 20%.
options.description_zh: 晨光使敌人的移动速度降低50%，使盟友的移动速度提高20%。

options.description_en:
Movement speed increased by 5% while above 80% health.

When your health is brought below 35%, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 5 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 1 min.
options.description_zh:
生命值高于80%时移动速度提高5%。

生命值降至35%时，你的移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。该效果每1分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing 1,327 Radiant damage or 2,802 healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.
options.description_zh:
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后，你的下2个消耗神圣能量的技能会对目标施加晨光，在8秒内造成1,327点光辉伤害或恢复2,802点生命值。

晨光的伤害和治疗效果的8%会辐射给周围的盟友或敌人，目标超过5个时效果降低。

晨光的治疗效果不会转移给圣光道标。

options.description_en: You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing 82 Radiant damage to enemies or 141 healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 你与30码范围内的晨光产生联结，对穿越光束的敌人造成82点光辉伤害，为穿越光束的盟友恢复141点生命值，目标数量超过5个时效果降低。

options.description_en: Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.5 sec when it heals an ally with full health.
options.description_zh: 晨光治疗生命值全满的盟友时，其持续时间延长0.5秒。

options.description_en: Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath.
options.description_zh: 在复仇之怒期间，晨光的爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Haste is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高5%。

options.description_en:
A balanced combat state that increases the critical strike chance of your abilities by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects by 10%. 

Lasts until canceled.
options.description_zh:
平衡的战斗姿态，使你的技能爆击几率提高3%，并使移动限制效果的时间缩短10%。

效果将一直持续直到取消。

options.description_en:
A defensive combat state that reduces all damage you take by 15% and all damage you deal by 10%.

Lasts until canceled.
options.description_zh:
防御性的战斗姿态，使你受到的所有伤害降低15%，造成的所有伤害降低10%。

效果一直持续直到主动取消。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 移动速度提高5%。

options.description_en:
Your auto-attacks generate 10% more Rage.

Killing an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的自动攻击会额外产生10%的怒气。

消灭一名敌人会立即产生5点怒气，并使你的移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 82 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 震击8码范围内的所有敌人，造成84点物理伤害并使其移动速度降低20%，持续10秒。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

options.description_en: Leech increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 吸血提高3%。

options.description_en:
Instantly attack the target, causing 20 damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.
options.description_zh:
立即攻击目标，造成20点伤害，并为你恢复30%的最大生命值。

杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人，将重置胜利在望的冷却时间并使其不消耗怒气。

options.description_en: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 8 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
options.description_zh: 朝目标区域腾空跃起，同时以毁灭性的力量重击地面，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成8点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Thunder Clap's radius is increased by 50% and it reduces affected target's movement speed by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 雷霆一击的范围扩大50%，并且使受影响目标的移动速度额外降低20%。

options.description_en: Hurls your weapon at an enemy, causing 10 Physical damage and stunning for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 将你的武器掷向一名敌人，造成10点物理伤害并使其昏迷4秒。

options.description_en: Wounds the target, causing 44 Physical damage instantly and an additional 74 Bleed damage over 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 重伤目标，立即造成44点物理伤害，并在随后的15秒内额外造成74点流血伤害。

options.description_en:
Restores 6% health every 1 sec when you have not taken damage for 5 sec.

Restores 2% health every 1 sec while you are below 35% health. The amount restored increases the closer you are to death.
options.description_zh:
当你在5秒以内没有受到任何伤害时，每1秒恢复6%的生命值。

当你的生命值降至35%以下时，每1秒恢复2%的生命值。生命值越低，恢复量越高。

options.description_en: Mortal Strike and Cleave have a 20% chance to immediately refund 10% of the Rage spent.
options.description_zh: 致死打击和顺劈斩有20%的几率立即返还消耗怒气的10%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 15 sec and Heroic Leap also increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短15秒，并且在落地之后还会使你的移动速度提高70%，持续3秒。

options.description_en:
When you take any damage, heal for 2.0% of your maximum health. 

This can only occur once every 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你受到任何伤害时，恢复2.0%的最大生命值。

该效果每10秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Run at high speed toward an ally, intercepting all melee and ranged attacks against them for 6 sec while they remain within 10 yds.
options.description_zh: 高速冲向一位盟友，只要该盟友在10码范围内，就可以为该盟友拦截所有的近战和远程攻击，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Run at high speed toward a target location near your allies, taking 30% of all damage dealt to allies within 3 yards for 8 sec or until you take at least 6,110 damage from this effect.
options.description_zh: 高速奔向靠近盟友的目标位置，在8秒内为3码范围内的盟友分担30%的所受伤害，或直至你因该效果累计承受至少6,110点伤害为止。

options.description_en: Sends a wave of force in a frontal cone, causing 7 damage and stunning all enemies within 10 yards for 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 向前方锥形区域释放一道能量波，造成7点伤害，并使10码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续2秒。

options.description_en: Maximum Rage increased by 30.
options.description_zh: 怒气值上限提高30点。

options.description_en:
Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec.

Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.
options.description_zh:
释放集结呐喊，使40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员的当前生命值和最大生命值提高10%，持续10秒。

不在团队中时，获得的生命值提高50%。

options.description_en: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 受到的治疗效果提高3%，所有自我治疗效果额外提高10%。

options.description_en: Raise your weapon, reflecting the first spell cast on you and reducing magic damage you take by 20% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 举起你的武器，反射第一个对你施放的法术，同时使你受到的魔法伤害降低20%，持续5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 破裂投掷 / 碎裂投掷

options.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy, causing 211 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
options.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，造成212点物理伤害，无视护甲。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

options.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy,  removing any magical immunities and causing 209 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
options.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，移除魔法免疫效果并造成206点无视护甲的物理伤害。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

options.description_en: Shockwave's range increased by 6 yards and when it strikes at least 3 targets its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 震荡波的范围提高6码，击中至少3个目标时冷却时间缩短15秒。

nodes.name_zh: 狂暴之吼 / 无所畏惧

options.description_en:
Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

Also remove fear effects from group members within 12 yds.
options.description_zh:
变得狂暴，移除并免疫恐惧、闷棍和瘫痪效果，持续6秒。

同时移除12码内队友的恐惧效果。

options.description_en: Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.
options.description_zh: 狂暴之怒的冷却时间缩短50%，且狂暴之怒会移除所有使移动速度降低的效果。

nodes.name_zh: 破胆怒吼 / 刺耳怒吼

options.description_en:
Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.
Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh:
使目标敌人因恐惧而畏缩，并使你8码范围内的所有敌人逃离你，敌人移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。
受到伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en:
Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Spurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
诱捕12码范围内的所有敌人，使其移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。

鼓舞6码范围内的所有盟友，使其移动速度提高30%，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
Cooldown of Die By the Sword, Intervene, Interpose, Spell Reflection, Storm Bolt, and Pummel reduced by 10%.

Successfully interrupting an enemy increases the damage you deal to them by 5% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
剑在人在、援护、截拦掩护、法术反射、风暴之锤和拳击的冷却时间缩短10%。

成功打断敌人会使你对该敌人造成的伤害提高5%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Gain Strength equal to 5% of your Armor.
options.description_zh: 获得等同于护甲值5%的力量。

options.description_en: Gain Strength equal to 10% of your Armor.
options.description_zh: 获得等同于护甲值10%的力量。

options.description_en: Charge gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 冲锋可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 5% and Armor increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高5%。护甲提高5%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 10% and Armor increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高10%。护甲提高10%。

options.description_en: Slam, Whirlwind, and Cleave deal 10% more damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.
options.description_zh: 猛击、旋风斩和顺劈斩造成的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards.

Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%.

Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的投掷技能的范围扩大5码。

勇士之矛、碎裂投掷和破裂投掷的伤害提高20%。

碎裂投掷和破裂投掷会使非玩家目标沉默3秒。

options.description_en: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.
options.description_zh: 你的怒吼技能持续时间延长20%。

options.description_en: Mortal Strike deals an additional 5% damage and deals 5% increased critical strike damage.
options.description_zh: 致死打击伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。斩杀的爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 2% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。斩杀的爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: While wielding two-handed weapons your damage is increased by 3% and damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%.
options.description_zh: 装备双手武器时，你的伤害提高3%，受到的范围伤害减少2%。

options.description_en: While wielding two-handed weapons your damage is increased by 6% and damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 4%.
options.description_zh: 装备双手武器时，你的伤害提高6%，受到的范围伤害减少4%。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 1% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 急速提高1%。你的自动攻击爆击会使你的自动攻击速度提高10%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 2% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 20% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。你的自动攻击爆击会使你的自动攻击速度提高20%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 每消耗20点怒气用于攻击，就会使天神下凡和巨人打击的剩余冷却时间缩短1秒。

options.description_en:
Throw a spear at the target location, chaining all enemies in the area to the spear's location and dealing 82 Physical damage instantly and an additional 128 Physical damage over 6 sec. 

While the spear is active, activating this ability will cause you to leap to the spear, dealing 16 Physical damage to all targets.

All damage dealt reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 10 Rage.
options.description_zh:
向目标位置投掷一柄长枪，将区域内所有敌人束缚在长枪周围，立即造成84点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成128点物理伤害。

长枪激活时，再次使用此技能将使你跃向长枪，对所有目标造成16点物理伤害。

目标数量超过5时造成的所有伤害降低。

产生10点怒气。

options.description_en:
Your stances have additional effects.

 Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

 Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.
options.description_zh:
你的姿态会获得额外效果。

战斗姿态
使你的技能造成的爆击伤害提高3%。

防御姿态
当一次攻击造成的伤害达到你最大生命值的20%或以上时，该次伤害会降低15%。

options.description_en:
Your Shout abilities have additional effects.

 Battle Shout:
Grants you an additional 3% attack power.

 Rallying Cry:
Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec.

 Piercing Howl:
Radius increased by 100%

 Berserker Shout:
Radius increased by 100%.

 Intimidating Shout:
Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的怒吼技能获得额外效果。

 战斗怒吼：
使你获得额外3%攻击强度。

 集结呐喊：
使你获得额外2%生命值，持续时间延长3秒。

 刺耳怒吼：
范围增加100%。

 狂暴之吼：
范围增加100%。

 破胆怒吼：
冷却时间减少15秒。

options.description_en: Your attacks against your primary target have a 25% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 298 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.
options.description_zh: 你对主要目标的攻击有25%几率摧垮其防御，并触发一次屠戮者打击，造成295点物理伤害，并赋予你一层处刑者效果，使你的斩杀伤害提高3%，持续12秒。处刑者效果可叠加。

options.description_en: A vicious strike that deals 182 Physical damage and reduces the effectiveness of healing on the target by 50% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 一次残忍的突袭，对目标造成181点物理伤害，并使其受到的治疗效果降低50%，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
每施放3次屠戮者打击，获得猝死。

使用猝死会加快你的下一个剑刃风暴，使其额外打击1次（最多3次）。剑刃风暴的总持续时间不变。

猝死有100%的几率触发100%效果的掠武风暴。

options.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每次打击都会对受影响的所有敌人施加不堪一击，使你对其造成的伤害提高1%，持续20秒，最多叠加5层。

nodes.name_zh: 冷酷追杀 / 奋勇矫健

options.description_en:
Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Charge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
冲锋使你的移动速度提高70%，持续3秒。

冲锋会移除所有移动限制效果，该效果每30秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 英勇飞跃使冲锋的冷却时间缩短5秒，冲锋使英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴使你进入战斗沉醉状态，在剑刃风暴结束后，使你获得15%的急速，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Overpower the enemy, dealing 133 Physical damage. Cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
options.description_zh: 压制敌人，造成135点物理伤害。无法被格挡、躲闪或招架。

options.description_en: Your attacks have a chance to make your next Execute cost no Rage, be usable on any target regardless of their health, and deal damage as if you spent 40 Rage.
options.description_zh: 你的攻击有一定几率使你的下一个斩杀不消耗怒气，可无视生命值高低对任意目标施放，并造成相当于你消耗40点怒气时的伤害。

options.description_en: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.
options.description_zh: 猝死造成的伤害的15%为你恢复生命值。

nodes.name_zh: 剔灭风暴 / 残暴终结

options.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每一次攻击额外造成20%的伤害，由所有目标均摊。

options.description_en: Your next Mortal Strike after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴结束后，你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高50%。

nodes.name_zh: 凶悍追击 / 趁虚而入

options.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.
options.description_zh: 致死打击的爆击使你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高20%.

options.description_en: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 20% additional damage and 20% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.
options.description_zh: 当战术专家重置压制的冷却时间时，你的下一个压制造成的伤害提高20%，爆击伤害提高20%。此效果最多叠加2层。

options.description_en: Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 处刑者的持续时间延长6秒。

nodes.name_zh: 残暴动力 / 无视苦痛

options.description_en: You are healed for 85% of the Bleed damage dealt by Rend and Deep Wounds.
options.description_zh: 撕裂和重伤为你恢复生命值，相当于造成的流血伤害的85%。

options.description_en: Fight through the pain, ignoring 50% of damage taken for 12 sec or until 700 damage has been prevented.
options.description_zh: 在痛苦中继续战斗，在12秒内无视接下来受到伤害中的50%，直到防止700点伤害。

options.description_en: Increases your parry chance by 100% and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 使你的招架几率提高100%，并使你受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.
options.description_zh: 每层处刑者还会使你的斩杀爆击几率和爆击伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 266 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 当顺劈斩命中3个或更多目标时，你有20%的几率掀起一阵钢铁风暴，打击周围的敌人，造成276点物理伤害并施加不堪一击。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 压制和斩杀的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Mortal Strike at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴每攻击2次，你会自动向目标或附近的随机敌人施放一次致死打击，造成100%的普通伤害。

options.description_en: Damage from Rend has a chance to generate 5 Rage.
options.description_zh: 撕裂造成的伤害有几率产生5点怒气。

options.description_en: Overpower has 2 charges and deals 15% more damage.
options.description_zh: 压制可以使用2次，造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Execute no longer has a cooldown and if your foe survives, 10% of the Rage spent is refunded.
options.description_zh: 斩杀不再有冷却时间。如果你的敌人存活下来，将返还10%的怒气消耗。

options.description_en: If Cleave or Whirlwind hits 3 or more targets you also Slam your primary target. This Slam deals 50% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 如果顺劈斩或旋风斩命中了至少3个目标，你还会对你的主要目标施放猛击。此次猛击额外造成50%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
使用猝死会使你的剑刃风暴冷却时间缩短5秒，并根据你拥有的处刑者层数，为你的主要目标施加1层不堪一击效果。

你可以在剑刃风暴期间使用拳击和风暴之锤。

剑刃风暴的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en:
You have a 30% chance to gain a charge of Overpower when you use an attack that has a Rage cost.
This effect applies even if that ability's Rage cost has been reduced to zero.
options.description_zh:
每当你使用消耗怒气的攻击时，都有30%的几率获得一层压制充能。
即使该技能的怒气消耗已降至零，此效果仍然适用。

options.description_en: Smash the ground and shatter the armor of all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 108 Physical damage and increasing damage you deal to them by 30% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 猛击地面并粉碎10码范围内所有敌人的护甲，造成107点物理伤害，并使你对其造成的伤害提高30%，持续10秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

options.description_en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的技能的爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 799 damage to it, and 432 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.
options.description_zh:
对目标施展一连串精准的强力打击，对其造成807点伤害，对10码内的敌人造成430点伤害。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

引导崩摧时，你受到的伤害降低10%，并且免疫昏迷、击退与强制移动效果。

你可以在引导崩摧时格挡、招架、躲闪和使用特定防御技能。

nodes.name_zh: 野蛮之力 / 高超效率

options.description_en: Slam has a 10% increased chance to trigger Tactician.
options.description_zh: 猛击触发战术专家的几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Slam's Rage cost is reduced by 25%.
options.description_zh: 猛击的怒气消耗减少25%。

options.description_zh: 压制对生命值低于35%的目标造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Cleave and Whirlwind deal 20% additional damage to targets below 35% health.
options.description_zh: 顺劈斩和旋风斩对生命值低于35%的目标造成额外20%的伤害。

Overpower and Slam damage increased by 5% and critical strike damage increased by 5%.
Critical strike chance of Slam and Overpower increased by 5%.
options.description_zh:
压制和猛击的伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_zh:
压制和猛击的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高10%。
猛击和压制的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_zh: 巨人打击产生15点怒气。

options.description_zh: 巨人打击使你获得6层横扫攻击。

options.description_zh: 致死打击、顺劈斩和斩杀的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高10%。

Strikes all enemies in front of you for 82 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

If you know Rend, inflicts Rend on all targets.
options.description_zh:
横扫你面前的所有敌人，造成81点物理伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。

若你已习得撕裂，则对所有目标施加撕裂效果。

options.description_en: Secondary targets take an additional 20% damage from Sweeping Strikes.
options.description_zh: 次级目标在横扫攻击中额外受到20%的伤害。

options.description_en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你的技能的爆击伤害提高10%，精确格挡所格挡的伤害量提高20%。

options.description_en:
Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

Mortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.
options.description_zh:
巨人神力使你的下一个崩摧造成的伤害提高5%，最多叠加5次。

致死打击会产生一层巨人神力，顺劈斩击中3个或更多目标时会产生一层巨人神力。

options.description_en: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.
options.description_zh: 震荡波的昏迷时间延长1秒，昏迷结束后使受影响敌人的移动速度降低40%，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 震荡波还会将敌人击飞，冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 崩摧的最后一击对所有目标施加100%效果的重伤。

options.description_zh: 压制和猛击使你下一次致死打击的伤害提高5%，最多可叠加3次。

Overpower's impact causes a seismic wave, dealing 49 damage to all enemies in a 10 yd line around your target. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Dreadnaught benefits from all effects that modify Overpower's damage.
options.description_zh:
压制会引起地震波，对目标周围10码直线上的所有敌人造成48点伤害。目标超过5个后伤害降低。

悍勇无畏会从所有能影响压制伤害的效果中获益。

Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target.

 Deep Wounds

options.description_zh:
斩杀对目标造成重伤。

 重伤

options.description_zh: 巨人打击立即使你获得1次使用猝死的机会。

options.description_zh: 巨人打击会使你在20秒内施放的下2次顺劈斩不触发冷却时间。

options.description_zh: 斩杀可以对生命值低于35%的目标使用。

options.description_zh: 每次使用无视苦痛吸收的伤害提高30%。

化作一股具有毁灭性力量的旋转风暴，打击附近所有目标，在5.4秒内造成667点物理伤害。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

致死打击和猛击的爆击会以100%的效果造成重伤。

 重伤
使目标在6秒内受到50点流血伤害。如果刷新此效果，所有剩余伤害将添加到新的重伤效果中。

options.description_en: Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing damage you take from area of effect attacks by 5% for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 化身为巨人，使你造成的所有伤害提高20%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低5%持续20秒。

options.description_en:
Your single target melee abilities have a chance to upgrade Slam to Heroic Strike.
All modifiers and talents that affect Slam also affect Heroic Strike.
options.description_zh:
你的单一目标近战技能有几率将猛击升级为英勇打击。
所有影响猛击的效果和天赋同样会影响英勇打击。

options.description_en: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.
options.description_zh: 每层处刑者还会使你的斩杀爆击几率和爆击伤害提高3%。

nodes.name_zh: 剔灭风暴 / 残暴终结

options.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每一次攻击额外造成20%的伤害，由所有目标均摊。

options.description_en: Your next Mortal Strike after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴结束后，你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高50%。

nodes.name_zh: 凶悍追击 / 趁虚而入

options.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.
options.description_zh: 致死打击的爆击使你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高20%.

options.description_en: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 20% additional damage and 20% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.
options.description_zh: 当战术专家重置压制的冷却时间时，你的下一个压制造成的伤害提高20%，爆击伤害提高20%。此效果最多叠加2层。

options.description_en:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
每施放3次屠戮者打击，获得猝死。

使用猝死会加快你的下一个剑刃风暴，使其额外打击1次（最多3次）。剑刃风暴的总持续时间不变。

猝死有100%的几率触发100%效果的掠武风暴。

nodes.name_zh: 冷酷追杀 / 奋勇矫健

options.description_en:
Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Charge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
冲锋使你的移动速度提高70%，持续3秒。

冲锋会移除所有移动限制效果，该效果每30秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 英勇飞跃使冲锋的冷却时间缩短5秒，冲锋使英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 压制和斩杀的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 267 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 当顺劈斩命中3个或更多目标时，你有20%的几率掀起一阵钢铁风暴，打击周围的敌人，造成269点物理伤害并施加不堪一击。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每次打击都会对受影响的所有敌人施加不堪一击，使你对其造成的伤害提高1%，持续20秒，最多叠加5层。

options.description_en: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.
options.description_zh: 猝死造成的伤害的15%为你恢复生命值。

options.description_en: Your attacks against your primary target have a 25% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 293 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.
options.description_zh: 你对主要目标的攻击有25%几率摧垮其防御，并触发一次屠戮者打击，造成291点物理伤害，并赋予你一层处刑者效果，使你的斩杀伤害提高3%，持续12秒。处刑者效果可叠加。

options.description_en:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
使用猝死会使你的剑刃风暴冷却时间缩短5秒，并根据你拥有的处刑者层数，为你的主要目标施加1层不堪一击效果。

你可以在剑刃风暴期间使用拳击和风暴之锤。

剑刃风暴的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Mortal Strike at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴每攻击2次，你会自动向目标或附近的随机敌人施放一次致死打击，造成100%的普通伤害。

options.description_en: Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 处刑者的持续时间延长6秒。

options.description_en: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴使你进入战斗沉醉状态，在剑刃风暴结束后，使你获得15%的急速，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.
options.description_zh: 震荡波的昏迷时间延长1秒，昏迷结束后使受影响敌人的移动速度降低40%，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 震荡波还会将敌人击飞，冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en:
Enemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 20% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times.
options.description_zh:
受到崩摧影响的敌人受到你造成的伤害最多提高10%，对你造成的伤害最多降低20%，由崩摧消耗的巨人神力层数决定，持续10秒。

巨人神力最多叠加10层。

options.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes grant an additional stack of Colossal Might.
options.description_zh: 致死打击的爆击额外产生一层巨人神力。

options.description_en:
Mortal Strike and Slam damage increased by 25%.

Cleave and Whirlwind damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh:
致死打击和猛击的伤害提高25%。

顺劈斩和旋风斩的伤害提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 以一敌众 / 动脉出血

options.description_en: Shockwave, Cleave, and Whirlwind deal 5% more damage per target affected up to 5.
options.description_zh: 每影响一个目标，震荡波、顺劈斩和旋风斩造成的伤害提高5%，最多5个目标。

options.description_en: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.
options.description_zh: 每层巨人神力使你的撕裂和重伤的伤害提高3%。

options.description_en:
You deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage.

Size increased by 5%.
options.description_zh:
你造成的伤害提高5%，受到的伤害降低5%。

体型增大5%。

options.description_en: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Overpower and Execute by 3% per stack.
options.description_zh: 每层巨人神力使你的压制和斩杀造成的伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你的技能的爆击伤害提高10%，精确格挡所格挡的伤害量提高20%。

nodes.name_en: No Stranger to Pain / Veteran Vitality
nodes.name_zh: 苦痛常客 / 百战活力

options.description_en: Damage prevented by each use of Ignore Pain is increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 每次使用无视苦痛吸收的伤害提高30%。

options.description_en:
When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至35%时，获得复苏之风，在2秒内为你恢复12%的最大生命值。

该效果每60秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 802 damage to it, and 433 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.
options.description_zh:
对目标施展一连串精准的强力打击，对其造成802点伤害，对10码内的敌人造成431点伤害。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

引导崩摧时，你受到的伤害降低10%，并且免疫昏迷、击退与强制移动效果。

你可以在引导崩摧时格挡、招架、躲闪和使用特定防御技能。

options.description_en:
Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

Mortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.
options.description_zh:
巨人神力使你的下一个崩摧造成的伤害提高5%，最多叠加5次。

致死打击会产生一层巨人神力，顺劈斩击中3个或更多目标时会产生一层巨人神力。

options.description_en: Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Mortal Strike by 100%.
options.description_zh: 崩摧的最后一击使你获得10%的急速，持续10秒，并使你的下一次致死打击的爆击几率提高100%。

options.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 致死打击爆击会使你的撕裂和重伤的伤害提高15%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 崩摧的最后一击对所有目标施加100%效果的重伤。

options.description_en:
An aggressive combat state that increases the damage of your auto-attacks by 15% and reduces the duration of Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects on you by 10%.

Lasts until canceled.
options.description_zh:
进攻性的战斗姿态，使你的自动攻击伤害提高15%，并使你受到的恐惧、闷棍和瘫痪效果持续时间缩短10%。

效果将一直持续直到取消。

options.description_en:
A defensive combat state that reduces all damage you take by 15% and all damage you deal by 10%.

Lasts until canceled.
options.description_zh:
防御性的战斗姿态，使你受到的所有伤害降低15%，造成的所有伤害降低10%。

效果一直持续直到主动取消。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 移动速度提高5%。

options.description_en:
Your auto-attacks generate 10% more Rage.

Killing an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的自动攻击会额外产生10%的怒气。

消灭一名敌人会立即产生5点怒气，并使你的移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 82 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 震击8码范围内的所有敌人，造成83点物理伤害并使其移动速度降低20%，持续10秒。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

options.description_en: Leech increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 吸血提高3%。

options.description_en:
Instantly attack the target, causing 20 damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.
options.description_zh:
立即攻击目标，造成20点伤害，并为你恢复30%的最大生命值。

杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人，将重置胜利在望的冷却时间并使其不消耗怒气。

options.description_en: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 8 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
options.description_zh: 朝目标区域腾空跃起，同时以毁灭性的力量重击地面，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成8点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Thunder Clap's radius is increased by 50% and it reduces affected target's movement speed by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 雷霆一击的范围扩大50%，并且使受影响目标的移动速度额外降低20%。

options.description_en: Hurls your weapon at an enemy, causing 9 Physical damage and stunning for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 将你的武器掷向一名敌人，造成10点物理伤害并使其昏迷4秒。

options.description_en: Whirlwind affects all targets with Rend, causing them to Bleed for 74 damage over 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 旋风斩影响所有带有撕裂的目标，使其流血，在15秒内造成74点伤害。

options.description_en:
Restores 6% health every 1 sec when you have not taken damage for 5 sec.

Restores 2% health every 1 sec while you are below 35% health. The amount restored increases the closer you are to death.
options.description_zh:
当你在5秒以内没有受到任何伤害时，每1秒恢复6%的生命值。

当你的生命值降至35%以下时，每1秒恢复2%的生命值。生命值越低，恢复量越高。

options.description_en: Mortal Strike and Cleave have a 20% chance to immediately refund 10% of the Rage spent.
options.description_zh: 致死打击和顺劈斩有20%的几率立即返还消耗怒气的10%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 15 sec and Heroic Leap also increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短15秒，并且在落地之后还会使你的移动速度提高70%，持续3秒。

options.description_en:
When you take any damage, heal for 2.0% of your maximum health. 

This can only occur once every 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你受到任何伤害时，恢复2.0%的最大生命值。

该效果每10秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Run at high speed toward an ally, intercepting all melee and ranged attacks against them for 6 sec while they remain within 10 yds.
options.description_zh: 高速冲向一位盟友，只要该盟友在10码范围内，就可以为该盟友拦截所有的近战和远程攻击，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Run at high speed toward a target location near your allies, taking 30% of all damage dealt to allies within 3 yards for 8 sec or until you take at least 6,110 damage from this effect.
options.description_zh: 高速奔向靠近盟友的目标位置，在8秒内为3码范围内的盟友分担30%的所受伤害，或直至你因该效果累计承受至少6,110点伤害为止。

options.description_en: Sends a wave of force in a frontal cone, causing 7 damage and stunning all enemies within 10 yards for 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 向前方锥形区域释放一道能量波，造成7点伤害，并使10码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续2秒。

options.description_en: Maximum Rage increased by 30.
options.description_zh: 怒气值上限提高30点。

options.description_en:
Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec.

Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.
options.description_zh:
释放集结呐喊，使40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员的当前生命值和最大生命值提高10%，持续10秒。

不在团队中时，获得的生命值提高50%。

options.description_en: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 受到的治疗效果提高3%，所有自我治疗效果额外提高10%。

options.description_en: Raise your weapon, reflecting the first spell cast on you and reducing magic damage you take by 20% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 举起你的武器，反射第一个对你施放的法术，同时使你受到的魔法伤害降低20%，持续5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 破裂投掷 / 碎裂投掷

options.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy, causing 207 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
options.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，造成211点物理伤害，无视护甲。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

options.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy,  removing any magical immunities and causing 212 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
options.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，移除魔法免疫效果并造成209点无视护甲的物理伤害。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

options.description_en: Shockwave's range increased by 6 yards and when it strikes at least 3 targets its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 震荡波的范围提高6码，击中至少3个目标时冷却时间缩短15秒。

nodes.name_zh: 狂暴之吼 / 无所畏惧

options.description_en:
Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

Also remove fear effects from group members within 12 yds.
options.description_zh:
变得狂暴，移除并免疫恐惧、闷棍和瘫痪效果，持续6秒。

同时移除12码内队友的恐惧效果。

options.description_en: Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.
options.description_zh: 狂暴之怒的冷却时间缩短50%，且狂暴之怒会移除所有使移动速度降低的效果。

nodes.name_zh: 破胆怒吼 / 刺耳怒吼

options.description_en:
Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.
Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh:
使目标敌人因恐惧而畏缩，并使你8码范围内的所有敌人逃离你，敌人移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。
受到伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en:
Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Spurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
诱捕12码范围内的所有敌人，使其移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。

鼓舞6码范围内的所有盟友，使其移动速度提高30%，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
Cooldown of Die By the Sword, Intervene, Interpose, Spell Reflection, Storm Bolt, and Pummel reduced by 10%.

Successfully interrupting an enemy increases the damage you deal to them by 5% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
剑在人在、援护、截拦掩护、法术反射、风暴之锤和拳击的冷却时间缩短10%。

成功打断敌人会使你对该敌人造成的伤害提高5%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Gain Strength equal to 5% of your Armor.
options.description_zh: 获得等同于护甲值5%的力量。

options.description_en: Gain Strength equal to 10% of your Armor.
options.description_zh: 获得等同于护甲值10%的力量。

options.description_en: Charge gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 冲锋可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 5% and Armor increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高5%。护甲提高5%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 10% and Armor increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高10%。护甲提高10%。

options.description_en: Slam, Whirlwind, and Cleave deal 10% more damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.
options.description_zh: 猛击、旋风斩和顺劈斩造成的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards.

Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%.

Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的投掷技能的范围扩大5码。

勇士之矛、碎裂投掷和破裂投掷的伤害提高20%。

碎裂投掷和破裂投掷会使非玩家目标沉默3秒。

options.description_en: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.
options.description_zh: 你的怒吼技能持续时间延长20%。

options.description_en: Mortal Strike deals an additional 5% damage and deals 5% increased critical strike damage.
options.description_zh: 致死打击伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。斩杀的爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 2% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。斩杀的爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: While dual wielding your damage is increased by 3% and movement speed is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 装备双持武器时，你的伤害提高3%，移动速度提高2%。

options.description_en: While dual wielding your damage is increased by 6% and movement speed is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 装备双持武器时，你的伤害提高6%，移动速度提高4%。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 1% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 急速提高1%。你的自动攻击爆击会使你的自动攻击速度提高10%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 2% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 20% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。你的自动攻击爆击会使你的自动攻击速度提高20%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 每消耗20点怒气用于攻击，就会使天神下凡和巨人打击的剩余冷却时间缩短1秒。

options.description_en:
Throw a spear at the target location, chaining all enemies in the area to the spear's location and dealing 84 Physical damage instantly and an additional 128 Physical damage over 6 sec. 

While the spear is active, activating this ability will cause you to leap to the spear, dealing 16 Physical damage to all targets.

All damage dealt reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 10 Rage.
options.description_zh:
向目标位置投掷一柄长枪，将区域内所有敌人束缚在长枪周围，立即造成82点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成128点物理伤害。

长枪激活时，再次使用此技能将使你跃向长枪，对所有目标造成16点物理伤害。

目标数量超过5时造成的所有伤害降低。

产生10点怒气。

options.description_en:
Your stances have additional effects.

 Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

 Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.
options.description_zh:
你的姿态会获得额外效果。

战斗姿态
使你的技能造成的爆击伤害提高3%。

防御姿态
当一次攻击造成的伤害达到你最大生命值的20%或以上时，该次伤害会降低15%。

options.description_en:
Your Shout abilities have additional effects.

 Battle Shout:
Grants you an additional 3% attack power.

 Rallying Cry:
Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec.

 Piercing Howl:
Radius increased by 100%

 Berserker Shout:
Radius increased by 100%.

 Intimidating Shout:
Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的怒吼技能获得额外效果。

 战斗怒吼：
使你获得额外3%攻击强度。

 集结呐喊：
使你获得额外2%生命值，持续时间延长3秒。

 刺耳怒吼：
范围增加100%。

 狂暴之吼：
范围增加100%。

 破胆怒吼：
冷却时间减少15秒。

options.description_en:
Damaging enemies with Thunder Clap, Raging Blow, or Execute has a 25% chance to also strike one with a lightning bolt, dealing 54 Nature damage.

Lightning Strikes occur 30% more often during Avatar.
options.description_zh:
雷霆一击、怒击或斩杀对敌人造成伤害时有25%的几率使一道闪电劈向目标，造成53点自然伤害。

闪电打击在天神下凡期间的触发频率提高30%。

options.description_en: Your attacks against your primary target have a 25% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 294 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.
options.description_zh: 你对主要目标的攻击有25%几率摧垮其防御，并触发一次屠戮者打击，造成300点物理伤害，并赋予你一层处刑者效果，使你的斩杀伤害提高3%，持续12秒。处刑者效果可叠加。

options.description_en:
Assault the target in a bloodthirsty craze, dealing 150 Physical damage and restoring 3% of your health.

Generates 8 Rage and has a 30% chance to Enrage you.
options.description_zh:
在嗜血的狂乱中攻击目标，造成146点物理伤害，并为你恢复3%的生命值。

产生8点怒气，并且有30%几率使你进入激怒状态。

options.description_en:
Stormstrike or Nature damage your abilities deal is increased by 5%. Stormstrike damage ignores Armor.

Thunder Clap damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
你的技能造成的风暴打击或自然伤害提高5%。风暴打击伤害无视护甲。

雷霆一击的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Lightning Strikes also deal 39 Nature damage to enemies near their target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 闪电打击还会对目标周围的敌人造成39点自然伤害。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Shield Slam damage increased by 15%.

Bloodthirst and Rampage damage increased by 25%.
options.description_zh:
盾牌猛击的伤害提高15%。

嗜血和暴怒的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Avatar increases the damage of Thunder Clap by 50% and reduces its cooldown by 50%.
options.description_zh: 天神下凡使雷霆一击的伤害提高50%，冷却时间缩短50%。

options.description_en:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
每施放3次屠戮者打击，获得猝死。

使用猝死会加快你的下一个剑刃风暴，使其额外打击1次（最多3次）。剑刃风暴的总持续时间不变。

猝死有100%的几率触发100%效果的掠武风暴。

options.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每次打击都会对受影响的所有敌人施加不堪一击，使你对其造成的伤害提高1%，持续20秒，最多叠加5层。

nodes.name_zh: 冷酷追杀 / 奋勇矫健

options.description_en:
Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Charge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
冲锋使你的移动速度提高70%，持续3秒。

冲锋会移除所有移动限制效果，该效果每30秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 英勇飞跃使冲锋的冷却时间缩短5秒，冲锋使英勇飞跃的冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴使你进入战斗沉醉状态，在剑刃风暴结束后，使你获得15%的急速，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
A mighty blow with both weapons that deals a total of 76 Physical damage.

Generates 12 Rage.
options.description_zh:
用两把武器发动一次强力打击，总计造成75点物理伤害。

产生12点怒气值。

options.description_en:
Shield Slam and Bloodthirst have a 35% chance to grant you Thunder Blast, stacking up to 2 charges.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals 82 Stormstrike damage and generates 2 Rage.
options.description_zh:
盾牌猛击和嗜血有35%的几率使你获得雷霆轰击，最多可叠加2层。

雷霆轰击
你的下一个雷霆一击变为雷霆轰击，造成81点风暴打击伤害并生成2点怒气。

nodes.name_zh: 风暴众锤 / 风暴护盾

options.description_en: Storm Bolt also hits 2 additional nearby targets, stunning them for 2 sec, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 风暴之锤还会击中附近的2个额外目标，使其昏迷2秒，但该技能的冷却时间增加10秒。

options.description_en: Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.
options.description_zh: 援护目标会使其获得一个吸收魔法伤害的护盾，吸收量相当于你的护甲值的3倍，持续5秒。

nodes.name_en: Keep Your Feet on the Ground / Steadfast as the Peaks
nodes.name_zh: 脚踏实地 / 千钧之峰

options.name_en: Keep Your Feet on the Ground
options.description_en:
Physical damage taken reduced by 2%.

Thunder Blast reduces damage you take by 8% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
受到的物理伤害降低2%。

雷霆轰击使你受到的伤害降低8%，持续5秒。

options.description_en:
Stamina increased by 5%.

Victory Rush increases your maximum health by 10% for 5 sec. When this health increase expires, you heal for any amount of the original Victory Rush that healed you in excess of your full health.
options.description_zh:
耐力提高5%。

乘胜追击使你的最大生命值提高10%，持续5秒。生命值加成消失时为你恢复生命值，数值相当于该次乘胜追击造成的过量治疗。

options.description_en: Lightning Strike damage increased by 10% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 闪电打击伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.
options.description_zh: 猝死造成的伤害的15%为你恢复生命值。

nodes.name_zh: 剔灭风暴 / 残暴终结

options.description_en: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴的每一次攻击额外造成20%的伤害，由所有目标均摊。

options.description_en: Your next Mortal Strike after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴结束后，你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高50%。

nodes.name_zh: 凶悍追击 / 趁虚而入

options.description_en: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.
options.description_zh: 致死打击的爆击使你的下一个致死打击的伤害提高20%.

options.description_en: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 20% additional damage and 20% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.
options.description_zh: 当战术专家重置压制的冷却时间时，你的下一个压制造成的伤害提高20%，爆击伤害提高20%。此效果最多叠加2层。

options.description_en: Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 处刑者的持续时间延长6秒。

options.description_en: Your attacks have a chance to make your next Execute cost no Rage, be usable on any target regardless of their health, and deal damage as if you spent 40 Rage.
options.description_zh: 你的攻击有一定几率使你的下一个斩杀不消耗怒气，可无视生命值高低对任意目标施放，并造成相当于你消耗40点怒气时的伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 狂乱之怒 / 怒意生威

options.description_en: Enrage increases your haste by 15% and your movement speed by 10%.
options.description_zh: 激怒使你的急速提高15%，移动速度提高10%。

options.description_en: Enrage increases your mastery by 15% and your Leech by 3%.
options.description_zh: 激怒使你的精通提高15%，吸血提高3%。

options.description_en: Execute no longer costs Rage and now generates 20 Rage.
options.description_zh: 斩杀不再消耗怒气值，并会产生20点怒气值。

nodes.name_zh: 断空霹雳 / 惊霆感应

options.description_en: Thunder Blast calls down a Lightning Strike on an enemy it hits.
options.description_zh: 雷霆轰击会对击中的一名敌人降下闪电打击。

options.description_en: Activating Recklessness grants a charge of Thunder Blast.
options.description_zh: 激活鲁莽会获得一次雷霆轰击的充能。

nodes.name_zh: 召云聚雷 / 托里姆之威

options.description_en: Your attacks trigger Lightning Strikes 30% more often.
options.description_zh: 你的攻击触发闪电打击的频率提高30%。

options.description_en:
Lightning Strikes generate 3 Rage.

Raging Blow and Execute damage increased by 25%.
options.description_zh:
闪电打击产生3点怒气。

怒击和斩杀的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Lightning Strikes have a 15% chance to make your next 2 Bloodthirsts have no cooldown.
options.description_zh: 闪电打击有15%的几率使你的下2个嗜血没有冷却时间。

options.description_en: During Avatar, Thunder Blast extends Avatar's duration by 2.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 在天神下凡期间，雷霆轰击会使天神下凡的持续时间延长2.0秒。

options.description_en: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.
options.description_zh: 每层处刑者还会使你的斩杀爆击几率和爆击伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 269 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 当顺劈斩命中3个或更多目标时，你有20%的几率掀起一阵钢铁风暴，打击周围的敌人，造成272点物理伤害并施加不堪一击。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 压制和斩杀的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Mortal Strike at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.
options.description_zh: 剑刃风暴每攻击2次，你会自动向目标或附近的随机敌人施放一次致死打击，造成100%的普通伤害。

options.description_en: While Enraged, your auto-attacks can no longer miss.
options.description_zh: 激怒状态下你的自动攻击不会出现未命中。

options.description_en: Reduces damage taken by 30% and Bloodthirst restores an additional 20% health for 8 sec. Usable while stunned or incapacitated.
options.description_zh: 受到的伤害降低30%，嗜血为你恢复的生命值提高20%，持续8秒。可以在昏迷或瘫痪时使用。

options.description_en: You take 10% reduced damage while Enrage is active.
options.description_zh: 激怒激活时受到的伤害降低10%。

options.description_en:
Whirlwind causes your next 4 single-target attacks to strike up to 4 additional targets for 65% damage.

Whirlwind generates an additional 1 Rage per target hit. Maximum 8 Rage.
options.description_zh:
旋风斩会使你接下来的4个单目标攻击额外击中最多4个目标，造成65%的伤害。

旋风斩每击中一个目标会额外产生1点怒气值。最大8点怒气值。

options.description_en:
Casting Avatar grants you 2 charges of Thunder Blast and resets the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

While Avatar is not active, Lightning Strikes have a 10% chance to grant you Avatar for 4 secs.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals Stormstrike damage.
options.description_zh:
施放天神下凡使你获得2层雷霆轰击，并会重置雷霆一击的冷却时间。

未激活天神下凡时，闪电打击有10%的几率使你获得天神下凡，持续4秒。

雷霆轰击
你的下一个雷霆一击变为雷霆轰击，造成风暴打击伤害。

options.description_en:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
使用猝死会使你的剑刃风暴冷却时间缩短5秒，并根据你拥有的处刑者层数，为你的主要目标施加1层不堪一击效果。

你可以在剑刃风暴期间使用拳击和风暴之锤。

剑刃风暴的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Execute is usable on targets below 35% health and its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 斩杀现在可以对生命值低于35%的目标使用，冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

options.description_en: Bloodthirst always Enrages you the first time you strike a target and it has a 15% increased chance to trigger Enrage.
options.description_zh: 你首次击中一个目标时，嗜血总会使你进入激怒状态，并且会使触发激怒的几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Enraged Regeneration lasts 3 sec longer and instantly heals for 10% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 狂怒回复的持续时间延长3秒，并立即回复10%的最大生命值。

options.description_en:
Unleash a series of 4 brutal strikes for a total of 104 Physical damage.

Enrages you.
options.description_zh:
释放一连串共计4次的残暴打击，造成总共103点物理伤害。

使你激怒。

options.description_en: Raging Blow has 2 charges and has a 25% chance to instantly reset its own cooldown.
options.description_zh: 怒击可以使用2次，并有25%的几率立即重置自身的冷却时间。

options.description_en: While Improved Whirlwind is active, Rampage's final strike slams the ground, dealing 7 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yds of your target. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets
options.description_zh: 强化旋风斩激活时，暴怒的终结一击猛砸地面，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成7点物理伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。

options.description_en:
Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target.

 Deep Wounds
Causes the target to suffer 50 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.
options.description_zh:
斩杀对目标造成重伤。

 重伤
使目标在6秒内受到50点流血伤害。如果刷新此效果，所有剩余伤害将添加到新的重伤效果中。

options.description_en: Bloodthirst and Raging Blow damage increased by 2.5% and critical strike damage increased by a further 2.5%.
options.description_zh: 嗜血和怒击的伤害提高2.5%，爆击伤害额外提高2.5%。

options.description_en: Bloodthirst and Raging Blow damage increased by 5.0% and critical strike damage increased by a further 5.0%.
options.description_zh: 嗜血和怒击的伤害提高5.0%，爆击伤害额外提高5.0%。

options.description_en: Rampage increases the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 10%, stacking up to 2 times.
options.description_zh: 暴怒使你下一次嗜血的伤害提高10%，最多叠加2次。

options.description_en:
When you would sustain fatal damage, you instead fly into an unstoppable rage, becoming unkillable and immune to movement-impairing effects for 8 sec as you seek revenge on your would-be killer.

If you kill your killer in that time, you emerge from your blind rage triumphant, with at least 20% of your max health intact. If you are not victorious, you die.

This effect can only occur once every 5 min and if your killer is alive when you sustain fatal damage.
options.description_zh:
当你承受致命伤害时，改为以无可阻挡的愤怒向凶手复仇，期间不会被杀死且免疫移动限制效果，持续8秒。

如果你在此期间杀死凶手，则带着至少20%的最大生命值胜利平息愤怒。如果未能复仇，则会死亡。

此效果每5分钟只能触发一次，且仅在你承受致命伤害时凶手仍然存活的情况下生效。

options.description_en: Rampage has a 75% chance to refund a charge of Raging Blow and increase the damage of your next Raging Blow by 20%.
options.description_zh: 暴怒有75%的几率返还一层怒击的充能，并使你下一次怒击的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: While Enraged, Bloodthirst and Raging Blow deal 5% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 激怒状态下，嗜血和怒击的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: While Enraged, Bloodthirst and Raging Blow deal 10% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 激怒状态下，嗜血和怒击的伤害提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 血肉顺劈 / 削切利刃

options.description_en: Whirlwind deals 50% additional damage when it hits 3 or more targets.
options.description_zh: 当旋风斩击中3个或更多目标时，该技能额外造成50%的伤害。

options.description_en: Whirlwind deals 50% additional damage when it hits only a single target.
options.description_zh: 旋风斩仅击中单个目标时，额外造成50%的伤害。

options.description_en: Bloodthirst critical strikes generate 4 additional Rage and inflict a Gushing Wound that deals 42 Bleed damage over 6 sec and heals you for the damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 嗜血造成爆击时，额外产生4点怒气，并施加龟裂创伤，在6秒内造成42点流血伤害，并恢复等量的生命值。

options.description_en: Bloodthirst critical strikes restore 3% additional health and increase the damage of Raging Blow by 10% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 嗜血的爆击为你额外恢复3%的生命值，并且使怒击的伤害提高10%，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Go berserk, increasing all Rage generation by 50% and granting your abilities 20% increased critical strike chance for 12 sec.
