nodes.name_zh: 破裂投掷 / 碎裂投掷

options.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy, causing 214 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
options.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，造成211点物理伤害，无视护甲。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

options.description_en: Hurl your weapon at the enemy,  removing any magical immunities and causing 209 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.
options.description_zh: 向敌人投掷你的武器，移除魔法免疫效果并造成210点无视护甲的物理伤害。最多对吸收护盾造成额外500%的伤害。

options.description_en: Shockwave's range increased by 6 yards and when it strikes at least 3 targets its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 震荡波的范围提高6码，击中至少3个目标时冷却时间缩短15秒。

nodes.name_zh: 狂暴之吼 / 无所畏惧

options.description_en:
Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

Also remove fear effects from group members within 12 yds.
options.description_zh:
变得狂暴，移除并免疫恐惧、闷棍和瘫痪效果，持续6秒。

同时移除12码内队友的恐惧效果。

options.description_en: Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.
options.description_zh: 狂暴之怒的冷却时间缩短50%，且狂暴之怒会移除所有使移动速度降低的效果。

nodes.name_zh: 破胆怒吼 / 刺耳怒吼

options.description_en:
Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.
Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh:
使目标敌人因恐惧而畏缩，并使你8码范围内的所有敌人逃离你，敌人移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。
受到伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en:
Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Spurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
诱捕12码范围内的所有敌人，使其移动速度降低70%，持续8秒。

鼓舞6码范围内的所有盟友，使其移动速度提高30%，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
Cooldown of Die By the Sword, Intervene, Interpose, Spell Reflection, Storm Bolt, and Pummel reduced by 10%.

Successfully interrupting an enemy increases the damage you deal to them by 5% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
剑在人在、援护、截拦掩护、法术反射、风暴之锤和拳击的冷却时间缩短10%。

成功打断敌人会使你对该敌人造成的伤害提高5%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Gain Strength equal to 5% of your Armor.
options.description_zh: 获得等同于护甲值5%的力量。

options.description_en: Gain Strength equal to 10% of your Armor.
options.description_zh: 获得等同于护甲值10%的力量。

options.description_en: Charge gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 冲锋可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 5% and Armor increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高5%。护甲提高5%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 10% and Armor increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高10%。护甲提高10%。

options.description_en: Slam, Whirlwind, and Cleave deal 10% more damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.
options.description_zh: 猛击、旋风斩和顺劈斩造成的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards.

Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%.

Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的投掷技能的范围扩大5码。

勇士之矛、碎裂投掷和破裂投掷的伤害提高20%。

碎裂投掷和破裂投掷会使非玩家目标沉默3秒。

options.description_en: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.
options.description_zh: 你的怒吼技能持续时间延长20%。

options.description_en: Mortal Strike deals an additional 5% damage and deals 5% increased critical strike damage.
options.description_zh: 致死打击伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。斩杀的爆击伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 2% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。斩杀的爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: While wielding one-handed weapons your damage is increased by 3% and Leech increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 装备单手武器时，你的伤害提高3%，吸血提高2%。

options.description_en: While wielding one-handed weapons your damage is increased by 6% and Leech increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 装备单手武器时，你的伤害提高6%，吸血提高4%。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 1% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 急速提高1%。你的自动攻击爆击会使你的自动攻击速度提高10%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 2% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 20% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。你的自动攻击爆击会使你的自动攻击速度提高20%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 每消耗20点怒气用于攻击，就会使天神下凡和巨人打击的剩余冷却时间缩短1秒。

options.description_en:
Throw a spear at the target location, chaining all enemies in the area to the spear's location and dealing 84 Physical damage instantly and an additional 128 Physical damage over 6 sec. 

While the spear is active, activating this ability will cause you to leap to the spear, dealing 16 Physical damage to all targets.

All damage dealt reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 10 Rage.
options.description_zh:
向目标位置投掷一柄长枪，将区域内所有敌人束缚在长枪周围，立即造成84点物理伤害，并在6秒内额外造成128点物理伤害。

长枪激活时，再次使用此技能将使你跃向长枪，对所有目标造成16点物理伤害。

目标数量超过5时造成的所有伤害降低。

产生10点怒气。

options.description_en:
Your stances have additional effects.

 Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

 Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.
options.description_zh:
你的姿态会获得额外效果。

战斗姿态
使你的技能造成的爆击伤害提高3%。

防御姿态
当一次攻击造成的伤害达到你最大生命值的20%或以上时，该次伤害会降低15%。

options.description_en:
Your Shout abilities have additional effects.

 Battle Shout:
Grants you an additional 3% attack power.

 Rallying Cry:
Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec.

 Piercing Howl:
Radius increased by 100%

 Berserker Shout:
Radius increased by 100%.

 Intimidating Shout:
Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的怒吼技能获得额外效果。

 战斗怒吼：
使你获得额外3%攻击强度。

 集结呐喊：
使你获得额外2%生命值，持续时间延长3秒。

 刺耳怒吼：
范围增加100%。

 狂暴之吼：
范围增加100%。

 破胆怒吼：
冷却时间减少15秒。

options.description_en:
Damaging enemies with Thunder Clap, Raging Blow, or Execute has a 25% chance to also strike one with a lightning bolt, dealing 54 Nature damage.

Lightning Strikes occur 30% more often during Avatar.
options.description_zh:
雷霆一击、怒击或斩杀对敌人造成伤害时有25%的几率使一道闪电劈向目标，造成53点自然伤害。

闪电打击在天神下凡期间的触发频率提高30%。

options.description_en: Fight through the pain, ignoring 50% of damage taken for 12 sec sec or until 564 damage has been prevented.
options.description_zh: 在痛苦中继续战斗，无视接下来受到伤害中的50%，持续12秒秒。或者直到防止564点伤害。

options.description_en:
Stormstrike or Nature damage your abilities deal is increased by 5%. Stormstrike damage ignores Armor.

Thunder Clap damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
你的技能造成的风暴打击或自然伤害提高5%。风暴打击伤害无视护甲。

雷霆一击的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Lightning Strikes also deal 39 Nature damage to enemies near their target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 闪电打击还会对目标周围的敌人造成39点自然伤害。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Shield Slam damage increased by 15%.

Bloodthirst and Rampage damage increased by 25%.
options.description_zh:
盾牌猛击的伤害提高15%。

嗜血和暴怒的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Avatar increases the damage of Thunder Clap by 50% and reduces its cooldown by 50%.
options.description_zh: 天神下凡使雷霆一击的伤害提高50%，冷却时间缩短50%。

options.description_en: Demoralizes all enemies within 10 yards, reducing the damage they deal to you by 20% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 使10码内的所有敌人士气下降，对你造成的伤害降低25%，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Swing in a wide arc, dealing 101 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Your successful dodges, parries, and auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Revenge cost no Rage.
options.description_zh:
横扫一个宽阔的弧面，对你面前的所有敌人造成98点物理伤害。目标数量超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

你成功进行躲闪、招架或自动攻击时，有几率使你的下一次复仇不消耗怒气。

options.description_en:
Shield Slam and Bloodthirst have a 35% chance to grant you Thunder Blast, stacking up to 2 charges.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals 82 Stormstrike damage and generates 2 Rage.
options.description_zh:
盾牌猛击和嗜血有35%的几率使你获得雷霆轰击，最多可叠加2层。

雷霆轰击
你的下一个雷霆一击变为雷霆轰击，造成83点风暴打击伤害并生成2点怒气。

nodes.name_zh: 风暴众锤 / 风暴护盾

options.description_en: Storm Bolt also hits 2 additional nearby targets, stunning them for 2 sec, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 风暴之锤还会击中附近的2个额外目标，使其昏迷2秒，但该技能的冷却时间增加10秒。

options.description_en: Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.
options.description_zh: 援护目标会使其获得一个吸收魔法伤害的护盾，吸收量相当于你的护甲值的3倍，持续5秒。

nodes.name_en: Keep Your Feet on the Ground / Steadfast as the Peaks
nodes.name_zh: 脚踏实地 / 千钧之峰

options.name_en: Keep Your Feet on the Ground
options.description_en:
Physical damage taken reduced by 2%.

Thunder Blast reduces damage you take by 8% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
受到的物理伤害降低2%。

雷霆轰击使你受到的伤害降低8%，持续5秒。

options.description_en:
Stamina increased by 5%.

Victory Rush increases your maximum health by 10% for 5 sec. When this health increase expires, you heal for any amount of the original Victory Rush that healed you in excess of your full health.
options.description_zh:
耐力提高5%。

乘胜追击使你的最大生命值提高10%，持续5秒。生命值加成消失时为你恢复生命值，数值相当于该次乘胜追击造成的过量治疗。

options.description_en: Lightning Strike damage increased by 10% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 闪电打击伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Using Shield Slam increases the damage of Shield Slam by 10% and the block value of your shield by 5% for 16 sec. Stacking up to 3 times.
options.description_zh: 使用盾牌猛击会使盾牌猛击的伤害提高10%，并且使你的盾牌格挡值提高5%，持续16秒。最多可叠加3次。

options.description_en: Armor increased by 6%.
options.description_zh: 护甲值提高6%。

options.description_en: Defensive Stance additionally reduces magic damage you take by 8%.
options.description_zh: 防御姿态额外使你受到的魔法伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Your auto-attacks deal an additional 45 Physical damage and have a 25% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Shield Slam.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击额外造成45点物理伤害，并有25%的几率重置盾牌猛击的剩余冷却时间。

nodes.name_zh: 断空霹雳 / 惊霆感应

options.description_en: Thunder Blast calls down a Lightning Strike on an enemy it hits.
options.description_zh: 雷霆轰击会对击中的一名敌人降下闪电打击。

options.description_en: Activating Recklessness grants a charge of Thunder Blast.
options.description_zh: 激活鲁莽会获得一次雷霆轰击的充能。

nodes.name_zh: 召云聚雷 / 托里姆之威

options.description_en: Your attacks trigger Lightning Strikes 30% more often.
options.description_zh: 你的攻击触发闪电打击的频率提高30%。

options.description_en:
Lightning Strikes generate 3 Rage.

Raging Blow and Execute damage increased by 25%.
options.description_zh:
闪电打击产生3点怒气。

怒击和斩杀的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Lightning Strikes have a 15% chance to make your next 2 Bloodthirsts have no cooldown.
options.description_zh: 闪电打击有15%的几率使你的下2个嗜血没有冷却时间。

options.description_en: During Avatar, Thunder Blast extends Avatar's duration by 2.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 在天神下凡期间，雷霆轰击会使天神下凡的持续时间延长2.0秒。

options.description_en: Taunts all enemies within 14 yds to attack you for 6 sec, interrupts all spellcasting within 14 yds and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec. Increases the threat you generate against the target by 800%.
options.description_zh: 嘲讽14码范围内的所有敌人，使其攻击你，持续6秒。打断14码范围内的所有施法，并使其在6秒内不能施放该系法术。使你对目标造成的威胁值提高800%。

options.description_en: Devastate, Thunder Clap, Revenge, and Execute have a 25% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Shield Slam.
options.description_zh: 毁灭打击、雷霆一击、复仇和斩杀有25%的几率重置盾牌猛击的剩余冷却时间。

options.description_en:
You focus on the target struck by your Devastator, dealing 30% additional Revenge and Execute damage to them.

Only one target can have your focus at a time.
options.description_zh:
你专注于被你的灭绝者击中的目标，对其额外造成30%的复仇和斩杀伤害。

同一时间只能专注于一个目标。

options.description_en:
Casting Avatar grants you 2 charges of Thunder Blast and resets the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

While Avatar is not active, Lightning Strikes have a 10% chance to grant you Avatar for 4 secs.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals Stormstrike damage.
options.description_zh:
施放天神下凡使你获得2层雷霆轰击，并会重置雷霆一击的冷却时间。

未激活天神下凡时，闪电打击有10%的几率使你获得天神下凡，持续4秒。

雷霆轰击
你的下一个雷霆一击变为雷霆轰击，造成风暴打击伤害。

options.description_en:
10% of damage you deal adds to your active Ignore Pain or the next Ignore Pain you activate.

Your next Ignore Pain can be increased by up to 4,582.
options.description_zh:
你造成伤害的10%会添加至你当前的无视苦痛或下一个无视苦痛中。

你的下一个无视苦痛的吸收量最多可提高4,582点。

options.description_en:
Devastate deals 20% increased damage and generates 2 Rage.

Devastator deals 10% increased damage and generates 2 Rage.
options.description_zh:
毁灭打击的伤害提高20%并产生2点怒气。

灭绝者的伤害提高10%并产生2点怒气。

options.description_en: Reduces all damage you take by 40% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 你受到的所有伤害降低40%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Damage from Rend has a chance to generate 5 Rage.
options.description_zh: 撕裂造成的伤害有几率产生5点怒气。

options.description_en:
Your dodges, parries, and auto-attacks make your Revenge cost no Rage 20% more frequently and increase the damage your free Revenges deal by 15%. 

Revenge increases the damage of your next Thunder Clap by 8%.
options.description_zh:
你的躲闪、招架和自动攻击使你的复仇不消耗怒气的几率提高20%，并使不消耗怒气的复仇造成的伤害提高15%。

复仇使你下一次雷霆一击的伤害提高8%。

options.description_en:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 804 damage to it, and 423 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.
options.description_zh:
对目标施展一连串精准的强力打击，对其造成802点伤害，对10码内的敌人造成426点伤害。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

引导崩摧时，你受到的伤害降低10%，并且免疫昏迷、击退与强制移动效果。

你可以在引导崩摧时格挡、招架、躲闪和使用特定防御技能。

options.description_en: You have a 8% chance to disrupt magic damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 50%.
options.description_zh: 你有8%的几率瓦解对你造成的魔法伤害，使其造成的伤害降低50%。

options.description_en: Damage you take from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%. Spell Reflection reduces magic damage taken by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 你受到的范围攻击伤害降低2%。法术反射使受到的魔法伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en:
Increases the radius of Demoralizing Shout by 5 yards.

Each enemy hit by Thunder Clap reduces the remaining cooldown on Demoralizing Shout by 1.5 sec, up to 4.5 sec.
options.description_zh:
挫志怒吼的范围提高5码。

雷霆一击每击中一个敌人，都会使挫志怒吼的剩余冷却时间缩短1.5秒，最多缩短4.5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 护卫神盾 / 磐固壁垒

options.description_en: Shield Wall gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 盾墙可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Shield Slam reduces the remaining cooldown of Shield Wall by 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 盾牌猛击使盾墙的剩余冷却时间缩短6秒。

options.description_en: Activating Shield Wall increases your maximum health by 30% for 8 sec and instantly heals you for that amount.
options.description_zh: 激活盾墙会使你的最大生命值提高30%，持续8秒，同时立即为你恢复等量的生命值。

options.description_en: Your Bleed effects deal 25% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 你的流血效果造成的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Your attacks have a chance to make your next Execute cost no Rage, be usable on any target regardless of their health, and deal damage as if you spent 40 Rage.
options.description_zh: 你的攻击有一定几率使你的下一个斩杀不消耗怒气，可无视生命值高低对任意目标施放，并造成相当于你消耗40点怒气时的伤害。

options.description_en: Shield Slam deals 15% increased damage and reduces enemies' damage against you by 3% for 9 sec. Multiple punishments may overlap.
options.description_zh: 盾牌猛击造成的伤害提高15%，并使敌人对你造成的伤害降低3%，持续9秒。多重惩罚可以叠加。

options.description_en: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你的技能的爆击伤害提高10%，精确格挡所格挡的伤害量提高20%。

options.description_en:
Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

Mortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.
options.description_zh:
巨人神力使你的下一个崩摧造成的伤害提高5%，最多叠加5次。

options.description_en: Celestial bodies align, maintaining both Eclipses and granting 10% haste for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 调动星体，同时开始日蚀和月蚀，使急速提高10%，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Solar Eclipse increases Wrath's Astral Power generation by 40% and Lunar Eclipse increases Starfire's Astral Power generation by 40%.
options.description_zh: 日蚀状态下，愤怒产生的星界能量提高40%；月蚀状态下，星火术产生的星界能量提高40%。

options.description_en: When Grove Guardians are summoned, they grow Dream Petals on your target, healing up to 3 nearby allies for 547.

nodes.name_zh: 向日蘑菇 / 野性蘑菇

options.description_en:
Sunfire damage has a chance to grow a magical mushroom at a target's location. After 1 sec, the mushroom detonates, dealing 1,010 Nature damage and then an additional 570 Nature damage over 10 sec. Affected targets are slowed by 50%.

Generates up to 20 Astral Power based on targets hit.
options.description_zh:
阳炎术伤害有几率在目标位置处生长出魔法蘑菇。1秒后，蘑菇会被引爆，造成1,010点自然伤害，并在10秒内额外造成570点自然伤害。受影响的目标被减速50%。

根据命中的目标数量产生最多20点星界能量。

options.description_en:
Grow a magical mushroom at the target enemy's location. After 1 sec, the mushroom detonates, dealing 1,211 Nature damage and then an additional 684 Nature damage over 10 sec. Affected targets are slowed by 50%.

Generates up to 20 Astral Power based on targets hit.
options.description_zh:
在目标位置处生长出魔法蘑菇。1秒后，蘑菇会被引爆，造成1,211点自然伤害，并在10秒内额外造成684点自然伤害。受影响的目标被减速50%。

根据命中的目标数量产生最多20点星界能量。

nodes.name_zh: 自然的优雅 / 艾露恩的挑战

options.description_en: When Eclipse ends or when you enter combat, enter a Dreamstate, reducing the cast time of your next 2 Starfires or Wraths by 30%.
options.description_zh: 日月之蚀结束或当你进入战斗时，陷入迷梦状态，使接下来2个星火术或愤怒的施法时间缩短30%。

options.description_en: When you exit Eclipse with less than 40 Astral Power, Wrath and Starfire's cast times are reduced by 20% for 15 sec or until you enter an Eclipse.
options.description_zh: 当你退出日月之蚀状态且星界能量低于40点时，愤怒与星火术的施法时间缩短20%，持续15秒或直到你进入新的日月之蚀状态。

options.description_en: Starsurge increases the damage the target takes from your periodic effects and Shooting Stars by 16% for 5 sec. Reapplying this effect extends its duration, up to 20 sec. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 星涌术使目标受到你的周期性伤害和坠星的伤害提高16%，持续5秒。重新施加该效果会延长持续时间，最多20秒。每个目标只能受到一次影响。

nodes.name_zh: 旋荡星辰 / 轨道打击

options.description_en: Celestial Alignment's cooldown is reduced by 60 seconds and it has two charges.
options.description_zh: 超凡之盟的冷却时间减少60秒，并拥有两次充能。

options.description_en:
Celestial Alignment blasts all enemies in a targeted area for 1,014 Astral damage and applies Stellar Flare to them.

Reduces the cooldown of Celestial Alignment by 60 sec.

 Stellar Flare
Burns the target for 139 Astral damage, and then an additional 894 damage over 24 sec. If dispelled, causes 803 damage to the dispeller and blasts them upwards.

Generates 12 Astral Power.
options.description_zh:
超凡之盟会轰击目标区域里的所有敌人，造成1,024点星界伤害，并对其施加星辰耀斑效果。

超凡之盟的冷却时间缩短60秒。

星辰耀斑
灼烧目标，立即造成134点星界伤害，并在24秒内额外造成894点伤害。如果效果被驱散，则对驱散者造成803点伤害并将其击飞。

产生12点星界能量。

options.description_en:
Casting Wrath has a 12% chance to make your next Starsurge or Starfall free.

Casting Starfire has a 15% chance to make your next Starsurge or Starfall free.
options.description_zh:
施放愤怒有12%的几率使你的下一个星涌术或星辰坠落不消耗资源。

施放星火术有15%的几率使你的下一个星涌术或星辰坠落不消耗资源。

options.description_en: Every time Starfall drops a wave of stars, a meteorite also falls on up to 2 targets in its range, each dealing 84 Astral damage.
options.description_zh: 星辰坠落每次降下一波星辰时，一颗陨星还会落在其范围内最多2个目标上，每个造成82点星界伤害。

options.description_en: Your Grove Guardians cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士每6秒对周围的目标施放月火术。

options.description_en: Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的最大法力值提高5%。

options.description_en: Your Regrowth protects you, reducing damage you take by 8% while your Regrowth is on you.
options.description_zh: 你的愈合效果会保护你，当你身上有自己的愈合效果时，你受到的伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Entering an Eclipse summons a Dryad to assist you for 8 sec, casting Starsurge dealing 573 Astral damage and Starfall at 250% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 进入日月之蚀时召唤一个树妖协助你，持续8秒，施放星涌术会造成570点星界伤害，获得250%的星辰坠落效果。

options.description_en: Your Moonfire and Sunfire deal damage 13% more frequently, also increasing the rate that Shooting Stars fall.
options.description_zh: 你的月火术和阳炎术造成伤害的频率提高13%，还会使坠星坠落的几率提高。

options.description_en: Your Moonfire and Sunfire deal damage 25% more frequently, also increasing the rate that Shooting Stars fall.
options.description_zh: 你的月火术和阳炎术造成伤害的频率提高25%，还会使坠星坠落的几率提高。

options.description_en: Moonfire, Sunfire, and Shooting Stars damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 月火术、阳炎术和坠星的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse are reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 月蚀和日蚀的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Casting a free Starsurge or Starfall grants Solstice for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放无消耗的星涌术或星辰坠落会使你获得至日，持续3秒。

options.description_en:
Starsurge and Starfall grant you 2% Haste for 20 sec or until you enter a new Eclipse.

Stacks up to 3 times. Gaining a stack does not refresh the duration.
options.description_zh:
星涌术和星辰坠落使你获得2%急速，持续20秒，或直到你进入新的日月之蚀状态。

可叠加3次。叠加层数不会刷新持续时间。

options.description_en:
Starsurge and Starfall grant you 4% Haste for 20 sec or until you enter a new Eclipse.

Stacks up to 3 times. Gaining a stack does not refresh the duration.
options.description_zh:
星涌术和星辰坠落使你获得4%急速，持续20秒，或直到你进入新的日月之蚀状态。

可叠加3次。叠加层数不会刷新持续时间。

options.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士激活时使你的回春术、百花齐放和生命绽放的治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_zh: 你的自然之力的树人生命值提高100%。

旋荡星辰使你在超凡之盟期间获得的急速额外提高6%。

options.description_zh: 进入日月之蚀状态后，你的奥术或自然法术造成爆击的几率提高10%，随后每1秒消退1%。

options.description_zh: 进入任何日月之蚀有30%的几率使你同时获得月蚀和日蚀的增益效果。

options.description_zh: 星涌术有20%几率使星辰坠落不产生消耗，星辰坠落有40%的几率使星涌术不产生消耗。

options.description_zh: 梦境涌现额外治疗1个盟友。

Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.

options.description_zh:
主要技能可用或在最大使用次数时，流逝的时间会在你下次使用该技能后的冷却时间中扣除，最多扣除15秒。

影响自然之力、超凡之盟、和万灵之召。

Every 5 Regrowths you cast makes your next Wrath, Starfire, or Entangling Roots instant and increases damage it deals by 100%.

Every 5 Starsurges you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.
options.description_zh:
每施放5次愈合，你的下一个愤怒、星火术或纠缠根须变为瞬发，且造成的伤害提高100%。

每施放5次星涌术，你的下一个愈合或纠缠根须变为瞬发。

options.description_en: Your Starfall damage is increased by 18% and your Starsurge damage is increased by 8%.
options.description_zh: 你的星辰坠落伤害提高18%，星涌术伤害提高8%。

options.description_en: Every other Eclipse creates a Fury of Elune at 25% effectiveness that follows your current target for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 每进入日月之蚀两次，就会施放一次效果为25%的艾露恩之怒，追击你当前的目标，持续8秒。

options.description_zh: 每召唤第30颗坠星就会对其目标施放一次满月，效果为普通满月的50%。

options.description_en:
An improved Moonkin Form that grants both Eclipses, any learned Celestial Alignment bonuses, and 10% critical strike chance.

Lasts 20 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this improved Moonkin Form for its duration.
options.description_zh:
一种强化的枭兽形态，能够给予你日月之蚀和习得的超凡之盟效果，并使你的爆击几率提高10%。

持续20秒。你可以在持续期间在其他形态与强化的枭兽形态之间切换。

Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec.

You will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.
options.description_zh:
召唤灵魂，爆发出能量，在4秒内连续快速引导16个德鲁伊法术和技能。

options.description_zh:
召唤一道纯粹的天界能量追击敌人，在8秒内对区域内的敌人造成最多1,094点星界伤害。对次要目标造成较低的伤害。

options.description_zh: 立即恢复50点能量，并且使你所有攻击造成的伤害在其持续时间内提高15%。持续10秒。

Rip and Rake damage has a chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 34 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

割裂和斜掠的伤害有几率使受害者体内长出觅血缠藤，在6秒内造成34点流血伤害。

野性成长、愈合和百花齐放的治疗效果有几率使目标身上长出共生绽华，在6秒内恢复834点生命值。

options.description_zh: 如果你产生了超出上限的连击点，你的下一个凶猛撕咬或原始之怒造成的直接伤害提高10%。

Finishing move that deals instant damage and applies Rip to all enemies within 10 yards. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 11 plus Rip for 4 sec

   3 points: 21 plus Rip for 8 sec
   4 points: 27 plus Rip for 10 sec
   5 points: 33 plus Rip for 12 sec
options.description_zh:
终结技，立即造成伤害，并对10码范围内的所有敌人施加割裂效果。根据连击点数决定持续时间：

   1点：造成11点伤害，割裂效果持续4秒
   2点：造成16点伤害，割裂效果持续6秒
   3点：造成22点伤害，割裂效果持续8秒
   4点：造成27点伤害，割裂效果持续10秒
   5点：造成32点伤害，割裂效果持续12秒

Damage and healing while in Cat Form increased by 3%.

你的自动攻击有几率使你的下一次凶猛撕咬变为毁灭。

毁灭

Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent.

options.description_zh:
尖锐的刺藤保护着你，每次受到攻击时吸收并反弹最多8点伤害。

当树皮术激活时，刺藤还会每1秒对附近所有敌人造成2点自然伤害。

options.description_en: Mangle generates 5 more Rage and deals 25% more damage.
options.description_zh: 裂伤额外提高25%的伤害，并额外产生5点怒气值。

options.description_en: When Frenzied Regeneration would heal you above maximum health, 80% of its excess healing is instead converted to an absorb shield.
options.description_zh: 当狂暴回复造成过量治疗时，溢出治疗量的80%会转化为吸收护盾。

nodes.name_zh: 强化鬃毛 / 鬃毛倒竖

options.description_en: Ironfur increases armor by an additional 15% and Barkskin reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 铁鬃使护甲值额外提高15%，树皮术使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Bristle your fur, causing you to generate Rage based on damage taken for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 鬃毛倒竖，使你根据受到的伤害恢复怒气，持续8秒。

nodes.name_en: Gift of an Ancient Guardian / Guardian of Elune
nodes.name_zh: 远古守卫赠礼 / 艾露恩的卫士

options.description_en: Ironfur increases your Mastery by 5%.
options.description_zh: 铁鬃使你的精通提高5%。

options.description_en: Mangle increases the duration of your next Ironfur by 3 sec, or the healing of your next Frenzied Regeneration by 20%.
options.description_zh: 裂伤会使你的下一个铁鬃的持续时间延长3秒，或使下一次狂暴回复恢复的生命值提高20%。

nodes.name_zh: 乌索尔的坚韧 / 血污毛皮

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Barkskin and Ironfur by 2.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的树皮术和铁鬃的持续时间延长2.0秒。

options.description_en:
Ironfur has a 20% chance to make your next Maul or Ravage free.

Maul and Ravage have a 10% chance to make your next Ironfur free.
options.description_zh:
铁鬃有20%的几率使你的下一次重殴或毁灭不消耗怒气。

重殴和毁灭有10%的几率使你的下一个铁鬃不消耗怒气。

options.description_en: Gain magical damage reduction equal to 10% of your damage reduction from armor.
options.description_zh: 获得魔法伤害减免，相当于你护甲提供的伤害减免的10%。

options.description_en:
Your auto-attacks have a chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.

Ravage
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent. 

1 point: 13 damage, 6 in an arc
2 points: 26 damage, 12 in an arc
3 points: 40 damage, 17 in an arc
4 points: 52 damage, 23 in an arc
5 points: 65 damage, 30 in an arc
options.description_zh:
你的自动攻击有几率使你的下一次凶猛撕咬变为毁灭。

毁灭
终结技，向你的目标发动弧形范围的斩击，每个连击点数都会对目标造成物理伤害，最多消耗25点额外能量，使该伤害最多提高100%。每消耗一点连击点数都会对你前方的所有敌人造成较低的伤害。

1点：13点伤害，弧形范围内6点伤害
2点：27点伤害，弧形范围内12点伤害
3点：39点伤害，弧形范围内18点伤害
4点：53点伤害，弧形范围内24点伤害
5点：66点伤害，弧形范围内29点伤害

nodes.name_zh: 狂乱撕扯 / 狂野蛮兽

options.description_en: Each stack of Thrash reduces the target's damage to you by 3% and increases your damage to them by 2%.
options.description_zh: 每一层痛击都会使目标对你造成的伤害降低3%，而你对目标造成的伤害提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases the damage and radius of Thrash by 25%.
options.description_zh: 痛击的范围与伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Strike with the might of Ursoc, dealing 74 Physical damage to your target and 40 to all other enemies in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 以乌索克的巨力击打，对你的目标造成74点物理伤害，对前方的所有其他敌人造成39点伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Summons a beam of lunar light at your target's location, dealing 14 Arcane damage each second to your target and 14 to up to 5 other enemies within 8 yd. 

Lunar Beam also increases your mastery by 18%, and heals you for 991 over 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
在你的目标位置召唤一道月光，每秒对你的目标造成14点奥术伤害，并对8码内最多5名其他敌人造成14点伤害。

明月普照还使你的精通提高18%，并在8秒内为你恢复966点生命值。

options.description_en:
Your maximum Energy and Rage are increased by 20.

Frenzied Regeneration also increases your maximum health by 10%.
options.description_zh:
你的最大能量值和怒气值提高20点。

狂暴回复还会使你的最大生命值提高10%。

options.description_en:
Ravage also inflicts a Bleed that causes 35 damage over 6 sec and saps its victims' strength, reducing damage they deal to you by 15%.

Dreadful Wound is not affected by Circle of Life and Death.
options.description_zh:
毁灭还会施加流血，在6秒内造成35点伤害，同时削弱目标的力量，使其对你造成的伤害降低15%。

恐惧创痕不会受到生死循环影响。

options.description_en: Maul and Raze damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 重殴和摧折的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Your auto-attacks are 30% more likely to make your next Maul become Ravage.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击使下一个重殴变为毁灭的几率提高30%。

options.description_en: Thrash and Maul grant you an absorb shield for 35% of the damage dealt for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 痛击和重殴使你获得一个吸收护盾，吸收量相当于其造成伤害的35%，持续15秒。

options.description_en:
Thrash has a 10% chance to trigger an additional Thrash.

Thrash stacks 1 additional time.
options.description_zh:
痛击有10%的几率额外触发一次痛击。

痛击可以额外叠加1次。

options.description_en:
Thrash has a 20% chance to trigger an additional Thrash.

Thrash stacks 2 additional times.
options.description_zh:
痛击有20%的几率额外触发一次痛击。

痛击可以额外叠加2次。

options.description_en: Thrash also generates 3 Rage each time it deals damage, on up to 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 痛击每次造成伤害时还会使你产生3点怒气，最多5个目标。

options.description_en: Your direct damage melee abilities against enemies afflicted by Moonfire cause them to burn for an additional 20% Arcane damage.
options.description_zh: 你对受到月火术影响的敌人施放直接近战伤害技能时，会使其燃烧，额外受到20%的奥术伤害。

options.description_en: While in Bear Form, you deal 15% increased Arcane damage.
options.description_zh: 在熊形态下，你造成的奥术伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: While in Bear Form, you deal 30% increased Arcane damage.
options.description_zh: 在熊形态下，你造成的奥术伤害提高30%。

nodes.name_zh: 双生月火 / 赤红之月

options.description_en: Moonfire deals 8% increased damage and also hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.
options.description_zh: 月火术造成的伤害提高8%，同时还会攻击目标周围15码内的另一个敌人。

options.description_en: Channel the power of the enraged moon to deal 2,432 Arcane damage to your target over 8 sec. Casting Mangle extends its duration by 1.0 sec and generates 8 Rage.
options.description_zh: 引导狂怒月亮的力量，在8秒内对目标造成2,432点奥术伤害。施放裂伤会使其持续时间延长1.0秒，并产生8点怒气。

options.description_en:
Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
猎豹形态下会保留铁鬃和狂暴回复效果。

从熊形态转变为猎豹形态时，你会保留熊形态下80%的护甲和生命加成，持续6秒。

在进入熊形态后的6秒内，你受到伤害的10%会在8秒内转为恢复生命值。

options.description_en: Your Dreadful Wounds increase the damage afflicted enemies take from your Bleed damage over time effects by 15%.
options.description_zh: 你的恐惧创痕使受影响敌人从你的持续流血伤害效果中受到的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Stampeding Roar's duration is increased by 25%.
options.description_zh: 狂奔怒吼的持续时间延长25%。

nodes.name_zh: 无情攻势 / 灭绝打击

options.description_en: Ravage increases your auto-attack speed by 35% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 毁灭会使你的自动攻击速度提高35%，持续6秒。

options.description_en:
Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

Your first Mangle after entering combat makes your next Maul become Ravage.
options.description_zh:
毁灭会使你的敏捷提高8%，铁鬃赋予的护甲提高20%，持续8秒。

你在进入战斗后的第一次裂伤会使下一次重殴变为毁灭。

options.description_en: Mangle has 1 additional charge and when Maul is cast at 80 Rage or above its chance to activate Gore is increased by 100%.
options.description_zh: 裂伤拥有1层额外充能，并且当使用80点或以上怒气施放重殴时，其触发淤血的几率提高100%。

nodes.name_en: Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc / Convoke the Spirits
nodes.name_zh: 化身：乌索克的守护者 / 万灵之召

options.description_en:
An improved Bear Form that grants the benefits of Berserk, causes Mangle to hit up to 3 targets, and increases maximum health by 30%.

Lasts 30 sec. You may freely shapeshift in and out of this improved Bear Form for its duration.
options.description_zh:
一种强化的熊形态，能够给予你狂暴效果，使裂伤最多可以击中3个目标，并且最大生命值提高30%。

持续30秒。持续期间内，你可以在其他形态与强化的熊形态之间自由切换。

options.description_en:
Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec.

You will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.
options.description_zh:
召唤灵魂，爆发出能量，在4秒内连续快速引导16个德鲁伊法术和技能。

你会根据当前的形态对附近合适的目标施放野性成长、迅捷治愈、月火术、愤怒、愈合、回春术、斜掠和痛击。

options.description_en: While in Bear Form, you are healed for 18% of all Arcane damage done.
options.description_zh: 在熊形态下，你能为自己恢复生命值，其数值相当于你所造成奥术伤害的18%。

nodes.name_zh: 强化变形 / 狂风奔涌

options.description_en:
Frenzied Regeneration can be cast in Cat Form for 40 Energy.

Bear Form reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

Shred and Swipe damage increased by 10%. Mangle damage increased by 25%.
options.description_zh:
狂暴回复可以在猎豹形态下施放，消耗40点能量。

熊形态可以使你受到的魔法伤害降低6%。

撕碎、横扫的伤害提高10%，裂伤的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Mangle grants Feline Potential. When you have 6 stacks, the next time you transform into Cat Form, gain 5 combo points and your next Ferocious Bite or Rip deals 50% increased damage for its full duration.
options.description_zh: 裂伤会赋予灵猫潜能。当你达到6层，下一次变为猎豹形态时，获得5点连击点数，并且你的下一次凶猛撕咬或割裂期间造成的伤害提高50%。

options.description_en: Every attack with an Energy cost that you cast extends the duration of your Dreadful Wounds by 0.6 sec, up to 8 additional sec.
options.description_zh: 你每次施放消耗能量的攻击都会使你的恐惧创痕的持续时间延长0.6秒，至多8秒。

nodes.name_en: Strike for the Heart / Tear Down the Mighty
nodes.name_zh: 直取要害 / 不畏强敌

options.description_en: Mangle damage increased by 10% and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 裂伤的伤害提高10%，爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Sundering Roar is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 碎甲咆哮的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: You have a 18% chance to follow up any single target melee ability with a Twin Claw, dealing 118 Physical damage and generating 5 Rage.
options.description_zh: 你有18%的几率在任何单目标近战技能后追加一次双重爪击，造成118点物理伤害并产生5点怒气。

options.description_en: Maul and Raze may consume up to 20 more Rage to deal up to 70% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 重殴和摧折最多会额外消耗20点怒气，额外造成最多70%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Roar with earthshattering ferocity, dealing 97 Physical damage, and resetting the cooldown of Thrash and allowing it to stack 5 additional times for 12 sec. 

When Sundering Roar ends, any excess stacks of Thrash immediately deal their remaining damage.
options.description_zh:
发出震天裂地的咆哮，造成98点物理伤害，并重置痛击的冷却时间，使其在12秒内可额外叠加5次。

碎甲咆哮结束时，所有额外的痛击层数会立即造成其剩余伤害。

options.description_en:
Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc: 
Every 25 Rage you spend reduces the cooldown of Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc by 1 sec.

 Convoke the Spirits: 
Convoke the Spirits' cooldown is reduced by 50% and its duration and number of spells cast is reduced by 25%. Convoke the Spirits has an increased chance to use an exceptional spell or ability.
options.description_zh:
化身：乌索克的守护者: 
每消耗25点怒气，化身：乌索克的守护者的冷却时间就缩短1秒。

 万灵之召: 
万灵之召的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短25%，使用的法术数量降低25%。万灵之召使用特殊法术或技能的几率提高。

options.description_en:
Awaken memories of past conflicts, causing a Dread Shade to take form nearby.

While active, shades slowly travel toward your target, dealing 24 Nature damage to nearby enemies and mirroring your Thrash casts.
options.description_zh:
唤醒过往冲突的记忆，使一个恐惧暗影在附近成形。

激活时，暗影会缓慢移向你的目标，对附近敌人造成24点自然伤害，并复制你施放的痛击。

options.description_en:
Your damage has a 5% chance to trigger a free automatic Moonfire on that target.

 Moonfire:
When this occurs, the next Moonfire you cast generates 8 Rage, and deals 300% increased direct damage.

 Red Moon:
When this occurs, you gain 1 charge of Lunar Wrath. Each 20 Rage you spend while Red Moon is active consumes a stack to deal 380 additional Arcane damage to its target and heal you for 494.
options.description_zh:
你的伤害有5%的几率在目标身上自动触发一次没有消耗的月火术。

 月火术：
当此效果发生时，你施放的下一个月火术产生8点怒气，并额外造成300%的直接伤害。

 赤红之月：
当此效果发生时，你获得1层月神之怒。在赤红之月激活期间，每消耗20点怒气会消耗一层该效果，对其目标造成380点额外奥术伤害，并为你治疗494点生命值。

options.description_en: During Berserk, Shred, and Swipe have a 20% chance to make your next Ferocious Bite become Ravage.
options.description_zh: 狂暴期间，撕碎和横扫有20%的几率使你的下一次凶猛撕咬变为毁灭。

options.description_en: Spending Rage has a 10% chance to awaken a guardian spirit for 8 sec, which attacks a nearby enemy for 105 when you cast Thrash or Mangle.
options.description_zh: 消耗怒气有10%的几率唤醒一个持续8秒的守护之魂，当你施放痛击或裂伤时，它会对附近的一个敌人造成105点伤害。

Ravage
Finishing move that slashes through your target in a wide arc, dealing Physical damage per combo point to your target and consuming up to 25 additional Energy to increase that damage by up to 100%. Hits all other enemies in front of you for reduced damage per combo point spent.

5 points: 64 damage, 30 in an arc

Ironfur and Frenzied Regeneration persist in Cat Form.

When transforming from Bear to Cat Form, you retain 80% of your Bear Form armor and health for 6 sec.

For 6 sec after entering Bear Form, you heal for 10% of damage taken over 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
猎豹形态下会保留铁鬃和狂暴回复效果。

从熊形态转变为猎豹形态时，你会保留熊形态下80%的护甲和生命加成，持续6秒。

在进入熊形态后的6秒内，你受到伤害的10%会在8秒内转为恢复生命值。

options.description_zh: 毁灭会使你的自动攻击速度提高35%，持续6秒。

Ravage increases your Agility by 8% and the armor granted by Ironfur by 20% for 8 sec.

options.description_zh:
毁灭会使你的敏捷提高8%，铁鬃赋予的护甲提高20%，持续8秒。

你在进入战斗后的第一次裂伤会使下一次重殴变为毁灭。

nodes.name_en: The Light of Elune / Astral Insight
nodes.name_zh: 艾露恩之光 / 星界洞察

options.description_en:
Moonfire damage has a chance to call down a Fury of Elune to follow your target for 3 sec.

 Fury of Elune
Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy, dealing 411 Astral damage over 3 sec within its area.

Generates 15 Astral Power over its duration.
options.description_zh:
月火术的伤害有几率召唤艾露恩之怒追踪你的目标，持续3秒。

 艾露恩之怒
召唤一道纯粹的天界能量追击敌人，在3秒内对区域内的敌人造成415点星界伤害。

在持续期间产生15点星界能量。

options.description_en:
Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc increases Arcane damage from spells and abilities by 10% while active.

Increases the duration and number of spells cast by Convoke the Spirits by 25%.
options.description_zh:
化身：乌索克的守护者激活时使法术和技能的奥术伤害提高10%。

万灵之召的持续时间和施放的法术数量提高25%。

options.description_en: All Arcane damage from your spells and abilities is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的所有奥术伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: Lunar Beam's cooldown is reduced by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 明月普照的冷却时间缩短20秒。

options.description_en:
Further increases the power of Boundless Moonlight.

 Fury of Elune
The flash of energy now generates 6 Astral Power and its damage is increased by 50%.

 Full Moon
New Moon and Half Moon now also call down 1 Minor Moon.
options.description_zh:
进一步强化天涯共银辉的效果。

艾露恩之怒
闪现的能量现在会产生6点星界能量，伤害提高50%。

 满月
新月和半月现在还会降下1个微月。

options.description_en: Moonfire deals 20% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 月火术造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Thrash now deals Arcane damage and its damage is increased by 12%.
options.description_zh: 痛击现在造成奥术伤害，伤害提高12%。

options.description_en: Bear Form and Moonkin Form reduce Arcane damage taken by 6% and all other magic damage taken by 3%.
options.description_zh: 熊形态和枭兽形态使受到的奥术伤害降低6%，受到的其他所有魔法伤害降低3%。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of Lunar Beam by 30% and Fury of Elune by 15%.
options.description_zh: 明月普照的伤害提高30%，艾露恩之怒的伤害提高15%。

options.description_zh: 受到月火术影响的敌人减速20%。

options.description_zh: 在熊形态或枭兽形态下使用野性冲锋会使冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Free automatic Moonfires from Galactic Guardian generate 5 Rage.
options.description_zh: 星河守护者自动触发的无消耗月火术产生5点怒气。

options.description_en: Enemies damaged by Lunar Beam or Fury of Elune take 6% increased damage from you for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 明月普照或艾露恩之怒使敌人受到来自你的伤害提高6%，持续6秒。

Fury of Elune
Fury of Elune now ends with a flash of energy, blasting nearby enemies for 822 Astral damage.

 Full Moon
Full Moon calls down 2 Minor Moons that deal 703 Astral damage and generate 3 Astral Power.
options.description_zh:
艾露恩之怒
艾露恩之怒结束时产生一道闪现的能量，轰击周围的敌人，造成822点星界伤害。

满月
满月召唤2个微月，各造成722点星界伤害并产生3点星界能量。

options.description_en:
Starsurge damage increased by 5%. 
Starfall damage increased by 10%.

options.description_en: Rake, Rip, and Thrash damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 斜掠、割裂和痛击的伤害提高10%。

耐力提高4%。

在熊形态下耐力额外提高5%。

options.description_en: Launch a surge of stellar energies at the target, dealing 786 Astral damage.
options.description_zh: 向目标发射汹涌的星界能量，造成797点星界伤害。

Finishing move that causes Bleed damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.

   2 points: 12 over 2 sec

   4 points: 20 over 3 sec
   5 points: 24 over 4 sec
options.description_zh:
终结技，使目标持续受到流血伤害。连击点数越多，持续时间越长。

   1点：在1秒内造成8点伤害

   3点：在3秒内造成16点伤害
   4点：在3秒内造成20点伤害
   5点：在4秒内造成24点伤害

options.description_zh: 狂暴回复和树皮术会使所有受到的治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_zh: 自然之愈还会移除所有诅咒和中毒效果。

Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing the damage of your spells by 10% and your armor by 125%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.
options.description_zh:
变形进入枭兽形态，使你的法术伤害提高10%，护甲值提高125%，并免疫变形效果。

变形可以解除你身上的移动限制效果。

Finishing move that causes Physical damage and stuns the target. Damage and duration increased per combo point:

   1 point  : 5 damage, 1 sec
   2 points: 10 damage, 2 sec
   3 points: 15 damage, 3 sec
   4 points: 20 damage, 4 sec
   5 points: 25 damage, 5 sec
options.description_zh:
终结技，造成物理伤害并使目标昏迷。根据连击点数决定伤害量和昏迷持续时间：

   1点：5点伤害，1秒
   2点：10点伤害，2秒
   3点：15点伤害，3秒
   4点：20点伤害，4秒
   5点：26点伤害，5秒

options.description_en: Physical damage and Armor increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 物理伤害和护甲提高3%。

options.description_zh: 物理伤害和护甲提高6%。

options.description_zh: 护甲提高124点，持续7秒。

options.description_en: Barkskin's duration is increased by 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 树皮术的持续时间延长4秒。

options.description_en: Magical damage and healing increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 法术伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

options.description_zh: 法术伤害和治疗效果提高6%。

options.description_zh: 一束月光灼烧敌人，造成80点自然伤害，并在18秒内额外造成705点自然伤害。

While in Cat Form, when you critically strike with an attack that generates a combo point, you gain an additional combo point. Damage over time cannot trigger this effect.

Mangle critical strike damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
在猎豹形态下，当一个产生连击点数的攻击造成爆击时，你会额外获得一个连击点数。持续性伤害效果不会触发该效果。

裂伤的爆击伤害提高20%。

options.description_zh: 受到的所有伤害降低4%。

options.description_zh: 你获得的治疗效果提高4%。

options.description_zh: 使你的所有法术的射程提高5码。

options.description_zh: 飞向附近一个盟友的位置。

options.description_zh: 变形进入猎豹形态，并使你的移动速度提高200%，在之后的5秒内加速效果逐渐降低。

options.description_zh: 将敌方目标吹上天空，使其迷惑，但也无法被攻击，最多持续5秒。德鲁伊在同一时间内只能对一个目标使用旋风。

When a hit deals more than 12% of your maximum health, instantly heal for 10% of your health.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 30 seconds.
options.description_zh:
当受到超过最大生命值12%的伤害时，立即恢复10%的生命值。

此效果每30秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Wrath, Starsurge, and Starfire damage increased by 5%. 

Starsurge's cooldown is reduced by 4 sec and its mana cost is reduced by 50%.
options.description_zh:
愤怒、星涌术和星火术的伤害提高5%。

options.description_zh: 当你使用树皮术或生存本能时，获得吸收656点伤害的护盾，持续15秒。

options.description_zh: 当你使用树皮术或生存本能时，获得吸收1,312点伤害的护盾，持续15秒。

options.description_zh:
回春术的持续时间延长3秒。

对自身施放愈合的持续时间延长3秒。

options.description_zh: 用猛烈的台风冲击你前方15码内的目标，将其击退，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。在任何形态下都可以使用该技能。

熊形态：全能
枭兽形态：精通

options.description_zh: 月火术和阳炎术的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases Typhoon's radius by 20% and its range by 5 yds.
options.description_zh: 台风的半径扩大20%，距离扩大5码。

options.description_zh: 变为熊形态并召唤乌索尔之魂，发出震耳的咆哮，使10码范围内的所有敌人瘫痪3秒。伤害可能解除该效果。

options.description_zh: 召唤乌索克之魂使目标昏迷4秒。这个技能可以在所有形态下使用。

options.description_zh: 在变为熊形态之后的4秒内，你的生命值和护甲提高15%。

options.description_zh: 狂奔怒吼的冷却时间缩短60秒。

nodes.name_zh: 荒野之环 / 天堂之环

options.description_en: Physical damage dealt by your abilities increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 技能造成的物理伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Magical damage dealt by your spells increased by 5%.

在德鲁伊博大精深的学识启发下，你在每一种形态下都能获得一项额外加成：

options.description_zh: 施放愈合使你的移动速度和受到的治疗提高8%，持续6秒。

options.description_zh: 施放愈合使你的移动速度和受到的治疗提高16%，持续6秒。

Mangle can be used in any form and shifts you into Bear Form. 

Wrath and Starfire shift you into Moonkin Form, if known.

撕碎、斜掠和迎头痛击可以在任意形态下使用，必要时会使你变形为猎豹形态。

裂伤可以在任意形态下使用，并使你变形为熊形态。

Non-shapeshifted:
Empowered Wild Growth that heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 10,757 over 7 sec.

Bear Form:
Increase your maximum health by 30% for 20 sec.

根据你当前激活的变形形态施放强大的其他职责技能。

强效野性成长，在7秒内治疗目标30码范围内最多5名受伤的盟友，恢复10,757点生命值。

熊形态：
使你的最大生命值提高30%，持续20秒。

在15秒内为目标恢复1,715点生命值。当生命绽放效果结束、被驱散或在快结束时被刷新，会立即为目标恢复851点生命值。

同一时间可以在一个目标身上激活。

options.description_en:
Rip and Rake damage has a chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 34 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Wild Growth, Regrowth, and Efflorescence healing has a chance to cause Symbiotic Blooms to grow on the target, healing for 834 over 6 sec.

Multiple instances of these can overlap.
options.description_zh:
割裂和斜掠的伤害有几率使受害者体内长出觅血缠藤，在6秒内造成34点流血伤害。

野性成长、愈合和百花齐放的治疗效果有几率使目标身上长出共生绽华，在6秒内恢复834点生命值。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: Consume a Regrowth, Wild Growth, or Rejuvenation effect to instantly heal an ally for 3,847. Healing is increased by 40% of the consumed heal over time effect.
options.description_zh: 吞噬一个愈合、野性成长或回春术效果，立即为一名盟友恢复3,977点生命值。治疗效果提高，数值相当于被吞噬的持续治疗效果剩余总量的40%。

options.description_en: Your next Regrowth, Rebirth, or Entangling Roots is instant, free, castable in all forms, and heals for an additional 60%.
options.description_zh: 你的下一个愈合、复生或纠缠根须变为瞬发、不消耗资源、可以在所有形态下施放并且治疗量提高60%。

options.description_en: Your healing over time from Lifebloom has a 4% chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Regrowth cost no mana.
options.description_zh: 生命绽放的持续治疗效果有4%的几率使你获得节能施法效果，你的下1个愈合不消耗法力值。

options.description_en:
Damage and healing while in Cat Form increased by 3%.

Moonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
在猎豹形态下伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

月火术和阳炎术的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Attacking from Prowl increases the chance for Shred, Rake, and Swipe to critically strike by 8% for 6 sec.

Your periodic heals have a 4% increased chance to critically heal.
options.description_zh:
从潜行状态下攻击会使撕碎、斜掠和横扫的爆击几率提高8%，持续6秒。

你的周期性治疗效果产生爆击的几率提高4%。

options.description_en:
Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.

Rejuvenation healing increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
割裂和凶猛撕咬的伤害提高5%。

回春术的治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: The rate at which Symbiotic Blooms grow is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 共生绽华的生长速度提高20%。

nodes.name_zh: 翡翠灌注 / 欣欣向荣

options.description_en: Swiftmend no longer consumes a heal over time effect.
options.description_zh: 迅捷治愈不再消耗持续治疗效果。

options.description_en: Swiftmend now has 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 迅捷治愈现在可以使用2次。

nodes.name_zh: 过度生长 / 季节变迁

options.description_en: Nature's Swiftness causes your next Regrowth to apply Lifebloom, Rejuvenation, and Wild Growth effects to an ally.
options.description_zh: 自然迅捷使你下一个愈合为盟友施加生命绽放、回春术和野性成长效果。

options.description_en: Nature's Swiftness's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 自然迅捷的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Regrowth's initial heal has a 40% increased chance for a critical effect if the target is already affected by Regrowth.
options.description_zh: 如果目标已经受到愈合影响，则愈合的初始治疗的爆击几率提高40%。

options.description_en: When you remove an effect with Soothe or Remove Corruption, gain a combo point and heal for 4% of your maximum health. If you are at full health an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.
options.description_zh: 当你使用安抚或清除腐蚀移除一个效果时，获得一个连击点数，并恢复4%的最大生命值。如果你生命值已满，则会改为治疗一个受伤的小队或团队成员。

nodes.name_zh: 纠缠旋风 / 万华疾行

options.description_en: Enemies pulled into Ursol's Vortex are rooted in place for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 被拖入乌索尔旋风的敌人会被定身3秒。受到伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en: During Barkskin your movement speed is increased by 10% and every second flowers grow beneath your feet that heal up to 3 nearby injured allies for 76.
options.description_zh: 在树皮术期间，你的移动速度提高10%，每秒都会在脚下绽开鲜花，为附近最多3名受伤的盟友恢复76点生命值。

nodes.name_zh: 自然牵绊 / 祥和体质

options.description_en: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你获得的治疗效果提高4%。

options.description_en: Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 35%.
options.description_zh: 你的愈合对自己的治疗效果提高35%。

options.description_en:
When Bloodseeker Vines expire or you use Ferocious Bite on their target they explode in thorns, dealing 30 physical damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

When Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on their target flowers grow around their target, healing them and up to 3 nearby allies for 163.
options.description_zh:
当觅血缠藤失效或你对其目标施放凶猛撕咬时，发生荆棘爆炸，对附近的敌人造成30点物理伤害。超过5个目标时伤害会降低。

当共生绽华失效或你对其目标施放回春术时，花朵会在目标附近生长，为附近至多3位盟友恢复158点生命值。

options.description_en: Swiftmend increases the healing of your next Regrowth or Rejuvenation by 60%.
options.description_zh: 迅捷治愈会使你的下一个愈合或回春术的治疗效果提高60%。

options.description_en: Increases Omen of Clarity's chance to activate Clearcasting to 5% and Clearcasting can stack 1 additional time.
options.description_zh: 清晰预兆激活节能施法的概率提高5%，节能施法能够额外累积1次。

nodes.name_zh: 坚毅兴荣 / 根须网道

options.description_en:
Bloodseeker Vines and Symbiotic Blooms last 2 additional sec.

When a target afflicted by Bloodseeker Vines dies, the vines jump to a valid nearby target for their remaining duration.
options.description_zh:
觅血缠藤和共生绽华的持续时间延长2秒。

受到觅血缠藤影响的目标死亡时，缠藤会跳向附近的一个有效目标，持续时间为剩余时间。

options.description_en:
Each active Bloodseeker Vine increases the damage your abilities deal by 2%.

Each active Symbiotic Bloom increases the healing of your spells by 2%.
options.description_zh:
每个激活的觅血缠藤使你的技能造成的伤害提高2%。

每个激活的共生绽华使你的法术的治疗效果提高2%。

options.description_en: Your heal over time effects are 6% more effective.
options.description_zh: 你的持续治疗的效果提高6%。

options.description_en: When Bloodseeker Vines or Symbiotic Blooms grow, they have a 30% chance to cause another growth of the same type to immediately grow on a valid nearby target.
options.description_zh: 当觅血缠藤或共生绽华生长时，它们有30%几率使附近一个有效目标身上的同类型植物立即生长。

options.description_en: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth causes a Symbiotic Bloom to grow on a target for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放迅捷治愈或野性成长会使一个目标长出一朵共生绽华，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Symbiotic Blooms have a 20% chance to trigger Bursting Growth every 2 sec at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 共生绽华每2秒有20%的几率以100%效果触发爆裂增生。

options.description_en: Grows a healing blossom at the target location, restoring 218 health to three injured allies within 10 yards every 1.8 sec for 30 sec. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置处生长出一片治疗之花，每1.8秒为10码范围内3个受伤的盟友恢复223点生命值，持续30秒。同一时间只能放置1个百花齐放。

options.description_en:
Heals all allies within 40 yards for 19,786 over 5.4 sec. Healing decreased beyond 5 targets.

Roots form around you while channeling, absorbing up to 60% of your health in damage and preventing knockbacks.
options.description_zh:
在5.4秒内为40码范围内的所有盟友恢复19,847点生命值。超过5个目标时治疗效果降低。

引导时根须缠绕周身，吸收相当于你生命值60%的伤害，并防止被击退。

options.description_en: The target's skin becomes as tough as Ironwood, reducing damage taken by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 目标的皮肤变得像铁木一样坚韧，受到的所有伤害降低20%，持续12秒。

options.description_en:
Bloodseeker Vines increase the damage your abilities deal to affected enemies by 4%.

Symbiotic Blooms increase the healing your spells do to affected targets by 20%.
options.description_zh:
觅血缠藤会使你的技能对受影响的敌人造成的伤害提高4%。

共生绽华会使你的法术对受影响目标的治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_en: When Grove Guardians are summoned, they grow Dream Petals on your target, healing up to 3 nearby allies for 566.
options.description_zh: 召唤林莽卫士时，它们会在你的目标身上产生梦境之瓣，为附近的最多3个盟友恢复549点生命值。

options.description_en: You can apply Rejuvenation twice to the same target.
options.description_zh: 你可以对同一目标施加两次回春术。

options.description_en: Efflorescence healing increased by 25%, and it now automatically grows beneath your Lifebloom target's feet.
options.description_zh: 百花齐放的治疗效果提高25%，并且现在会自动在生命绽放的目标脚下生成。

options.description_en: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth summons a Treant that casts Nourish on that target or a nearby ally periodically, healing for 230. Lasts 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放迅捷治愈或野性成长会召唤一个树人，周期性对目标或附近盟友施放滋养，治疗230点生命值，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Tranquility extends the duration of all of your heal over time effects by 2 sec every 0.9 sec.
options.description_zh: 宁静每0.9秒使你所有的持续治疗效果持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Clearcast Regrowths heal for an additional 40%.
options.description_zh: 通过节能施法施放的愈合能够额外造成40%的治疗效果。

options.description_en: Wild Growth heals 2 additional targets.
options.description_zh: 野性成长额外治疗2个目标。

nodes.name_zh: 石木树皮 / 强化铁木树皮

options.description_en: Ironbark increases healing from your heal over time effects by 20%.
options.description_zh: 铁木树皮会使你的持续治疗法术的治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Ironbark's cooldown is reduced by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 铁木树皮的冷却时间缩短20秒。

options.description_en: Your Grove Guardians cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士每6秒对周围的目标施放月火术。

options.description_en: Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的最大法力值提高5%。

options.description_en: Your Regrowth protects you, reducing damage you take by 8% while your Regrowth is on you.
options.description_zh: 你的愈合效果会保护你，当你身上有自己的愈合效果时，你受到的伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Entering an Eclipse summons a Dryad to assist you for 8 sec, casting Starsurge dealing 566 Astral damage and Starfall at 250% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 进入日月之蚀时召唤一个树妖协助你，持续8秒，施放星涌术会造成568点星界伤害，获得250%的星辰坠落效果。

options.description_en: Swiftmend cooldown is reduced by 15%, increasing up to 30% on lower health targets.
options.description_zh: 迅捷治愈的冷却时间缩短15%，目标生命值较低时，最多缩短30%。

options.description_en: Regrowth's healing over time is increased by 100%, and it also applies to the target of your Lifebloom.
options.description_zh: 愈合的持续治疗效果提高100%，且其持续治疗效果也会作用于你的生命绽放的目标。

options.description_en: Rejuvenation healing is increased by up to 30%, and Tranquility healing is increased by up to 30%, healing for more on low-health targets.
options.description_zh: 对低生命值目标的治疗效果提高，回春术最多提高30%，宁静最多提高30%。

options.description_en: Rejuvenation healing is increased by up to 60%, and Tranquility healing is increased by up to 60%, healing for more on low-health targets.
options.description_zh: 对低生命值目标的治疗效果提高，回春术最多提高60%，宁静最多提高60%。

options.description_en: Grove Guardians, Efflorescence, and your other summons heal for 30% more.
options.description_zh: 林莽卫士、百花齐放和你的其他召唤技能的治疗效果提高30%。

options.description_en: Soul of the Forest now causes your next Rejuvenation or Regrowth to apply to 2 additional allies within 20 yards of the target.
options.description_zh: 丛林之魂现在会使你的下一个回春术或愈合能够施加给目标20码范围内额外2名盟友。

options.description_en: When Rejuvenation heals a target below 30% health, they are instantly healed for 115.
options.description_zh: 当回春术治疗一个生命值低于30%的目标时，会立即为其治疗115点生命值。

options.description_en: When Rejuvenation heals a target below 60% health, they are instantly healed for 115.
options.description_zh: 当回春术治疗一个生命值低于60%的目标时，会立即为其治疗115点生命值。

options.description_en: Wild Growth's healing falls off 30% less over time.
options.description_zh: 野性成长的治疗效果随时间衰减的幅度降低30%。

options.description_en: Wild Growth's healing falls off 60% less over time.
options.description_zh: 野性成长的治疗效果随时间衰减的幅度降低60%。

options.description_en: Swiftmend healing increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 迅捷治愈的治疗效果提高30%。

options.description_en: Allies protected by your Ironbark also receive 75% of the healing from each of your active Rejuvenations and Ironbark's duration is increased by 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 受到你的铁木树皮保护的盟友也会从你所激活的所有回春术中受到75%的治疗，铁木树皮的持续时间增加4秒。

nodes.name_en: Power of Nature / Durability of Nature
nodes.name_zh: 自然之威 / 自然耐性

options.description_en: Your Grove Guardians increase the healing of your Rejuvenation, Efflorescence, and Lifebloom by 10% while active.
options.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士激活时使你的回春术、百花齐放和生命绽放的治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: Your Force of Nature treants have 100% increased health.
options.description_zh: 你的自然之力的树人生命值提高100%。

options.description_en: Swiftmend healing is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 迅捷治愈的治疗效果提高20%。

nodes.name_zh: 林地启示 / 持久魔效

options.description_en:
Wrath and Starfire damage increased by 10%. 

Regrowth, Wild Growth, and Swiftmend healing increased by 9%.
options.description_zh:
愤怒和星火术的伤害提高10%。

愈合、野性成长和迅捷治愈的治疗效果提高9%。

options.description_en:
Orbital Strike damage increased by 30%, and damage of Stellar Flares it applies increased by 30%.

Whirling Stars increases the haste you gain during Celestial Alignment by an additional 6%.
options.description_zh:
轨道打击的伤害提高30%，其施加的星辰耀斑伤害提高30%。

旋荡星辰使你在超凡之盟期间获得的急速额外提高6%。

options.description_en: Dryads cause most of your Astral power generation to be increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 树妖使你的大部分星界能量生成提高10。

options.description_en: Heals you for 3% of your maximum health every 5 sec. If you are at full health, an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.
options.description_zh: 每5秒为你恢复3%的最大生命值。如果你的生命值已满，则会治疗一个受伤的团队或小队成员。

nodes.name_en: Incarnation: Tree of Life / Convoke the Spirits
nodes.name_zh: 化身：生命之树 / 万灵之召

options.description_en:
Shapeshift into the Tree of Life, instantly Regrowthing 3 nearby injured allies, increasing healing done by 10%, increasing armor by 120%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects. Functionality of Rejuvenation, Wild Growth, Regrowth, Entangling Roots, and Wrath is enhanced.

Lasts 30 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this form for its duration.
options.description_zh:
进入生命之树形态，立即对附近3个受伤的盟友施放愈合，治疗效果提高10%，护甲值提高120%，并免疫变形效果。得到强化的法术：回春术、野性成长、愈合、纠缠根须和愤怒。

持续30秒。你可以在持续期间在其他形态与生命之树之间切换。

options.description_en:
Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec.

You will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.
options.description_zh:
召唤灵魂，爆发出能量，在4秒内连续快速引导16个德鲁伊法术和技能。

你会根据当前的形态对附近合适的目标施放野性成长、迅捷治愈、月火术、愤怒、愈合、回春术、斜掠和痛击。

options.description_en:
When you cast Starsurge, Rake, Shred, or Frenzied Regeneration you gain Call of the Elder Druid for 15 sec, once every 1 min.

 Call of the Elder Druid
Abilities not associated with your specialization are substantially empowered for 45 sec.

Balance: Cast time of Balance spells reduced by 30% and damage increased by 20%.

Feral: Gain 1 Combo Point every 2 sec while in Cat Form and Physical damage increased by 20%.

Guardian: Bear Form gives an additional 20% Stamina, multiple uses of Ironfur may overlap, and Frenzied Regeneration has 2 charges.

Restoration: Healing increased by 30%, and mana costs reduced by 50%.
options.description_zh:
施放星涌、斜掠、撕碎或狂暴回复时，获得德鲁伊长者之唤，持续15秒，每1分钟只能触发一次。

 德鲁伊长者之唤
你当前专精之外的其他能力会获得大幅度强化，持续45秒。

平衡：平衡专精法术的施法时间缩短30%，伤害提高20%。

野性：在猎豹形态下每2秒获得1个连击点数。物理伤害提高20%。

守护：熊形态使你额外获得20%的耐力，铁鬃可以重复使用并叠加，狂暴回复可以使用2次。

恢复：治疗效果提高30%，法力值消耗降低50%。

options.description_en: When Regrowth critically heals, it is 260% effective instead of the usual 200%.
options.description_zh: 当愈合产生爆击时，其效果为260%，而非通常的200%。

nodes.name_zh: 丰裕之花 / 万物复苏

options.description_en: Your Grove Guardians' healing is increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 你的林莽卫士的治疗量提高30%。

options.description_en: Swiftmend and Wild Growth cooldowns reduced by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 迅捷治愈和野性成长的冷却时间缩短1秒。

nodes.name_en: Power of the Dream / Control of the Dream
nodes.name_zh: 梦境之力 / 梦境掌控

options.description_en: Dream Surge heals 1 additional ally.
options.description_zh: 梦境涌现额外治疗1个盟友。

options.description_en:
Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.

Affects Force of Nature, Celestial Alignment, and Convoke the Spirits.
options.description_zh:
主要技能可用或在最大使用次数时，流逝的时间会在你下次使用该技能后的冷却时间中扣除，最多扣除15秒。

影响自然之力、超凡之盟、和万灵之召。

options.description_en:
Every 5 Regrowths you cast makes your next Wrath, Starfire, or Entangling Roots instant and increases damage it deals by 100%.

Every 5 Starsurges you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.
options.description_zh:
每施放5次愈合，你的下一个愤怒、星火术或纠缠根须变为瞬发，且造成的伤害提高100%。

每施放5次星涌术，你的下一个愈合或纠缠根须变为瞬发。

options.description_en: Your Starfall damage is increased by 18% and your Starsurge damage is increased by 8%.
options.description_zh: 你的星辰坠落伤害提高18%，星涌术伤害提高8%。

nodes.name_zh: 跃动活力 / 变形大师

options.description_en: Your damage over time effects deal their damage 25% faster, and your healing over time effects heal 5% faster.
options.description_zh: 你的持续伤害效果造成伤害的速度加快25%，持续治疗效果造成治疗的速度加快5%。

options.description_en:
Your abilities are amplified based on your current shapeshift form, granting an additional effect.

Wrath, Starfire, and Starsurge deal 30% additional damage and generate 324 Mana.

Bear Form
Ironfur grants 30% additional armor and generates 375 Mana.

 Cat Form
Rip, Ferocious Bite, and Maim deal 60% additional damage and generate 1,500 Mana when cast with 5 combo points.
options.description_zh:
你的技能受到当前变形形态强化并获得额外效果。 

愤怒、星火术和星涌术额外造成30%的伤害，并恢复324点法力值。

熊形态
铁鬃额外获得30%的护甲并恢复375点法力值。

options.description_en:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 81 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.

Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 10 damage per stack.

Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.

恶毒地割裂敌人的灵魂，造成81点暗影冰霜伤害并施加死神印记。

每当你造成暗影或冰霜伤害，叠加一层死神印记。12秒后或叠加至40层时印记爆炸，每层造成10点伤害。

Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing 34 Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

options.description_zh:
死神印记会发出多股暗影冰霜能量并将其召回，往返都可对路径中的敌人造成34点暗影冰霜伤害。

永冻

冰封之韧使你受到的所有伤害额外降低最多20%，由你损失的生命值决定。
