options.description_zh:
你的自动攻击有几率召唤一只血虫。

血虫会在15秒内攻击你的目标，造成少量伤害，然后在你身边爆炸，为你恢复生命，数值相当于你所损失的生命值的15%。

如果你的血量降至50%以下，你的血虫会立即产生爆炸并治疗你。

options.description_en:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变激活时，你获得萨莱因之赐。

萨莱因之赐使你的鲜血女王的精华效果提高200%，并在效果期间将天灾打击替换为吸血鬼打击。

nodes.name_zh: 血魔之握 / 憎恶附肢

options.description_en: Shadowy tendrils coil around all enemies within 15 yards of a hostile or friendly target, pulling them to the target's location and Silencing them for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 暗影触须会缠绕一个敌方或友方目标15码范围内的所有敌人，并将他们拉向目标的所在位置，并沉默3秒。

options.description_en:
Sprout an additional limb, pulling enemies further than 8 yds from you every 1 sec.  

The same enemy can only be pulled once every 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
额外长出一段附肢，每1秒将距离你8码以上的敌人拉向你的位置。

同一个敌人每4秒只能被拉动一次。

options.description_en: Bone Shield increases your Haste by 10% and it can stack 2 additional times.
options.description_zh: 白骨之盾使你的急速提高10%，可以额外叠加2次。

options.description_en: Dancing Rune Weapon's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and now generates 5 Bone Shield charges.
options.description_zh: 符文刃舞的冷却时间缩短30秒，并且现在会产生5层白骨之盾。

options.description_en: Death Strike hits an additional 2 enemies at 75% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击以75%的效果额外攻击2个敌人。

options.description_en:
Your Blood Plague and Death and Decay deal damage 15% more often.

Additionally, your Blood Plague leeches 85% more Health.
options.description_zh:
你的血之疫病和枯萎凋零造成伤害的几率提高15%。

你的血之疫病会额外吸取85%的生命值。

options.description_en: Heart Strike has a chance to make your next Blood Boil empowered, dealing 50% increased damage and echoing after 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 心脏打击有几率强化你的下一个血液沸腾，使其造成的伤害提高50%，并在3秒后重复一次。

options.description_en: Death Strike heals for an additional 20% of its healing over 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击在5秒内额外恢复相当于治疗量20%的生命值。

options.description_en: Summons 1 additional copy of Dancing Rune Weapon and increases its duration by 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 激活符文刃舞会额外召唤出1把符文武器，此外，符文刃舞的持续时间延长4秒。

options.description_en: Death Strike's healing is increased by 5% and grants you 15% Leech for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击的治疗效果提高5%，并使你获得15%的吸血，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell heals you for 100% of the damage it absorbs.
options.description_zh: 反魔法护罩为你恢复生命值，相当于其吸收伤害量的100%。

options.description_en: Your Blood Plague critical hits have a chance to reduce the cooldown of your Blood Boil by 0.25 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的血之疫病爆击有几率使血液沸腾的冷却时间缩短0.25秒。

options.description_en: While Blood Shield is active, taking direct damage reflects 37 Shadow damage back to the attacker. Blood Shield can now absorb up to 65% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 鲜血护盾激活时，受到直接伤害会反射39点暗影伤害给攻击者。鲜血护盾现在最多能吸收相当于你最大生命值65%的伤害。

options.description_en: Blood Shield's duration is increased by 2 sec and it absorbs 20% more damage.
options.description_zh: 鲜血护盾的持续时间延长2秒，而且吸收伤害提高20%。

options.description_en:
Parrying an attack grants you a charge of Bloodied Blade, increasing your Strength by 0.5%, up to 4.0% for 15 sec.

At 8 stacks, your next parry consumes all charges to unleash a Heart Strike at 300% effectiveness, and increases your Strength by 10% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh:
招架一次攻击会为你提供一层染血利刃，使你的力量提高0.5%，最多可叠加至4.0%，持续15秒。

在达到8层时，你的下次招架会消耗所有层数，释放一次300%效果的心脏打击，并在6秒内使你的力量提高10%。

options.description_en: Enemies affected by Blood Plague take 5% increased damage from you and Death Strike increases the damage of your Blood Plague by 10% for 15 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
options.description_zh: 你对感染血之疫病的敌人造成的伤害提高5%，此外，灵界打击还会使你血之疫病的伤害提高10%，持续15秒，最多叠加4次。

options.description_en:
When you cast Dancing Rune Weapon, you become enveloped in a blood mist that surrounds you for 8 sec, increasing your Parry by 5%. 

Deals 22 Shadow damage every 1 sec to enemies within 10 yds. Every time it deals damage you gain 2 Runic Power, up to a maximum of 10 Runic Power. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
施放符文刃舞时，你被血腥之雾包围，持续8秒，你的招架提高5%。

每1秒对10码范围内的敌人造成22点暗影伤害。每次它造成伤害你都会获得2点符文能量，最多获得10点符文能量。目标多于8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: You deal 6% more damage and receive 5% more healing while standing in your Death and Decay.
options.description_zh: 当你站在自己的枯萎凋零中时，造成的伤害提高6%，受到的治疗效果提高5%。

options.description_en: While Blood Shield is active, you deal 8% increased damage and damage taken is reduced by 4%.
options.description_zh: 鲜血护盾激活时，你造成的伤害提高8%，受到的伤害降低4%。

options.description_en:
Empower the runes in your weapon, reducing the damage you take over the duration and unleashing a devastating attack that deals 218 Shadow damage and consumes up to 75% of your Blood Plague instantly from enemies in front of you.

I: Consumes up to 25% of your Blood Plague. While empowering, your damage taken is reduced by 5% and an additional 8 sec after empowering.

II: Consumes up to 50% of your Blood Plague. While empowering, your damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 4 sec after empowering.

III: Consumes up to 75% of your Blood Plague. While empowering, your damage taken is reduced by 15% and an additional 2 sec after empowering.
options.description_zh:
强化武器上的符文，降低你在持续期间内受到的伤害，并发动毁灭性的攻击，造成218点暗影伤害，立即从前方的敌人身上吞噬最多75%血之疫病。

I：吞噬最多25%血之疫病。强化期间，你受到的伤害降低5%，并在强化后额外持续8秒。

II：吞噬最多50%血之疫病。强化期间，你受到的伤害降低10%，并在强化后额外持续4秒。

III：吞噬最多75%血之疫病。强化期间，你受到的伤害降低15%，并在强化后额外持续2秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown on Vampiric Blood by 2.0 sec per 10 Runic Power spent.
options.description_zh: 每消耗10点符文能量，便使吸血鬼之血的冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

options.description_en: When Blood Mist ends it deals 98 Shadow damage to 8 nearby enemies, healing you for 18% of the damage dealt. The damage is increased by 2% for every 1 Runic Power spent while Blood Mist was active.
options.description_zh: 当血腥之雾结束时，它会对附近的8名敌人造成96点暗影伤害，为你恢复生命值，数值相当于造成伤害的18%。血腥之雾激活时，每消耗1点符文能量，伤害就会提高2%。

options.description_en:
An unholy pact that prevents fatal damage, instead absorbing incoming healing equal to the damage prevented, lasting 3 sec.

If any healing absorption remains when this effect expires, you will die. This effect may only occur every 4 min.
options.description_zh:
当你遭受致命伤害时，邪恶契约可保你免于一死，转而吸收随后获得的治疗量，数值相当于被阻挡的伤害量，持续3秒。

该效果结束时，如果没有吸收足够的治疗量，你就会死亡。该效果每4分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Consumption now contributes to your Mastery: Blood Shield.

Each time an enemy strikes your Blood Shield, the cooldown of Consumption has chance to be reset.
options.description_zh:
吞噬现在会对精通：鲜血护盾生效。

每当敌人攻击你的鲜血护盾时，吞噬的冷却时间有几率被重置。

options.description_en: After Vampiric Blood expires, you absorb damage equal to 6 times the damage your Blood Plague dealt during Vampiric Blood.
options.description_zh: 吸血鬼之血结束时，你可以吸收伤害，数值相当于吸血鬼之血持续期间血之疫病造成伤害的6倍。

options.description_en: While Dancing Rune Weapon is active, Parrying an attack has a 100% chance to make your next Heart Strike cost no Runes and deal 150% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 符文刃舞激活期间，招架敌人的攻击有100%的几率使你的下一个心脏打击不消耗符文，并且造成的伤害提高150%。

options.description_en: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and deals 10% of the remaining damage to the enemy.
options.description_zh: 当吸血鬼打击对受到你疫病影响的敌人造成伤害时，会使该疫病的持续时间延长3.0秒，并对该敌人造成其剩余伤害的10%。

options.description_en:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击和天灾打击会使目标受到的暗影伤害提高1%，最多5%，持续15秒。

煽动惊恐对吸血鬼打击产生400%的效果。

options.description_en: Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.
options.description_zh: 基于目标已损失的生命值比例，你的瘟疫最多额外造成30%伤害。

options.description_en:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变会召唤一头血兽攻击你的敌人，持续10秒。

每当血兽进行攻击，都会存储造成的一部分伤害。血兽死亡时爆炸，对周围敌人造成相当于积累伤害的15%的伤害，并为死亡骑士恢复等量的生命值。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 8% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 当你在你的枯萎凋零中时，你受到的物理伤害降低8%，获得吸血鬼打击的几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.
options.description_zh: 枯萎凋零造成伤害的速度提高100%。

options.description_en:
Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 5.0% for 20 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击有25%的几率使你的下一个天灾打击变为吸血鬼打击。

吸血鬼打击为你恢复2%的最大生命值，并为你施加鲜血女王的精华，使你的急速提高1.0%，最多提高5.0%，持续20秒。

options.description_en:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变激活时，你获得萨莱因之赐。

萨莱因之赐使你的鲜血女王的精华效果提高200%，并在效果期间将天灾打击替换为吸血鬼打击。

nodes.name_en: Pact of the San'layn / Sanguine Scent
nodes.name_zh: 萨莱因之契 / 腥红气息

options.description_en: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.
options.description_zh: 你将造成的所有暗影伤害的10%储存到血兽体内，使其在消失时爆炸并造成额外伤害。

options.description_en: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.
options.description_zh: 你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击对生命值低于35%的敌人造成伤害时触发吸血鬼打击的几率提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 吸血光环 / 血腥之韧

options.description_en:
Your Leech is increased by 2%.

While Lichborne is active, the Leech bonus of this effect is increased by 100%, and it affects 4 allies within 12 yds.
options.description_zh:
你的吸血提高2%。

巫妖之躯激活时，该效果的吸血加成提高100%，并且可以影响12码内的4名盟友。

options.description_en:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
冰封之韧使你受到的所有伤害额外降低最多20%，由你损失的生命值决定。

消灭可以使你获得经验值或荣誉值的敌人可以使冰封之韧的冷却时间缩短3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 返世新血 / 吸血鬼之速

options.description_en: Raise Ally revives players at full health and grants you and your ally an absorb shield equal to 20% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 复活盟友现在使玩家以最大生命值复活，并使你和盟友获得一个护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的20%。

options.description_en:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
死神脚步和幻影步的移动速度加成提高10%。

激活死神脚步或幻影步会使周围4名盟友的移动速度提高20%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
options.description_zh: 鲜血女王的精华可以额外叠加2层，每层使你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击的伤害提高5%，扩散的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Dancing Rune Weapons by 20% for 8 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击使你的符文刃舞的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。c1[

多次施加可以重叠生效。[]

options.description_en:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 1.0% per stack.

Blood Plague deals 5% increased damage.
options.description_zh:
每层鲜血女王的精华使你的精通额外提高1.0%。

血之疫病的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 当消耗末日突降时，你获得4%力量加成，持续5秒。

options.description_en:
If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 10% Strength for 8 sec.

Wave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.
options.description_zh:
如果灵魂迸裂没有击中任何敌人，你获得10%力量，持续8秒。

灵魂浪潮对你死神印记主要目标的效果提高100%。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark initial strike grants Killing Machine.

Reaper's Mark explosion deals up to 30% increased damage based on your target's missing health.
options.description_zh:
死神印记的初始攻击会使你获得杀戮机器。

死神印记的爆炸造成的伤害最多提高30%，由目标损失的生命值决定。

nodes.name_en: Pact of the Deathbringer / Rune Carved Plates
nodes.name_zh: 死亡使者契约 / 符刻坚甲

options.description_en:
When you suffer a damaging effect equal to 25% of your maximum health, you instantly cast Death Pact at 50% effectiveness. May only occur every 2 min.

When a Reaper's Mark explodes, the cooldowns of this effect and Death Pact are reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你受到一次相当于最大生命值的25%的伤害时，你会立即施放死亡契约，产生50%的效果。每2分钟只能触发一次。

当死神印记爆炸时，该效果和死亡契约的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Each Rune spent reduces the magic damage you take by 1.5% and each Rune generated reduces the physical damage you take by 1.5% for 5 sec, up to 5 times.
options.description_zh: 每使用一个符文都会使你受到的魔法伤害降低1.5%，每产生一个符文都会使你受到的物理伤害降低1.5%，持续5秒，至多5次。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing 33 Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

Wave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.
options.description_zh:
死神印记会发出多股暗影冰霜能量并将其召回，往返都可对路径中的敌人造成34点暗影冰霜伤害。

灵魂浪潮的爆击使敌人受到的暗影冰霜伤害提高5%，持续15秒，最多叠加2次。灵魂浪潮返程时必定爆击。

options.description_en:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to its main target, and is now Shadowfrost.

Shadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.
options.description_zh:
白霜强化的凛风冲击对主要目标的伤害提高60%，现在造成暗影冰霜伤害。

暗影冰霜伤害会施加2层死神印记，爆击时施加4层。

nodes.name_zh: 死亡信使 / 反斥之盾

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldowns of Lichborne and Raise Dead by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 巫妖之躯和亡者复生的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: When an enemy deals direct damage to your Anti-Magic Shell, their cast speed is reduced by 10% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当敌人对你的反魔法护罩造成直接伤害时，使其施法速度降低10%，持续6秒。

nodes.name_zh: 黑暗之爪 / 死神强袭

options.description_en:
Consuming Killing Machine or Rime has a 25% chance to grant 3 stacks of Icy Talons and increase its maximum stacks by the same amount for 6 sec.

Runic Power spending abilities count as Shadowfrost while Icy Talons is active.
options.description_zh:
消耗杀戮机器或白霜有25%的几率使你获得3层冰冷之爪，并使其最大层数提高相同层数，持续6秒。

冰冷之爪激活时，你消耗符文能量的技能也被视作暗影冰霜伤害。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Reaper's Mark by 15 sec, but the amount of Obliterates and Frostscythes empowered by Exterminate is reduced by 1.
options.description_zh: 死神印记的冷却时间减少15秒，但破灭强化的湮灭和冰霜之镰数量减少1次。

options.description_en: Frost Fever deals its damage 75% faster, and the second scythe of Exterminate applies Frost Fever.
options.description_zh: 冰霜疫病造成伤害的速度加快75%，并且第二把破灭镰刀会施加冰霜疫病。

options.description_en: When Reaper's Mark explodes, it deals 20% of the damage dealt to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 死神印记的爆炸对周围的敌人造成20%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 81 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.

Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 10 damage per stack.

Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.
options.description_zh:
恶毒地割裂敌人的灵魂，造成81点暗影冰霜伤害并施加死神印记。

每当你造成暗影或冰霜伤害，叠加一层死神印记。12秒后或叠加至40层时印记爆炸，每层造成10点伤害。

如果目标死亡，死神印记会转移至附近一个未被标记的敌人身上。

options.description_en:
After Reaper's Mark explodes, your next 2 Obliterates or Frostscythes cost 1 Rune and summon 2 scythes to strike your enemies.

The first scythe strikes your target for 153 Shadowfrost damage and the second scythe strikes all enemies around your target for 62 Shadowfrost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
在死神印记爆炸后，你的下2次湮灭或冰霜之镰消耗1个符文，并召唤2把镰刀打击你的敌人。

第一把镰刀会对目标造成155点暗影冰霜伤害，第二把镰刀会打击目标周围的所有敌人，造成62点暗影冰霜伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark deals 5% increased damage.

Casting Dancing Rune Weapon grants 1 stack of Exterminate with 100% first scythe and 100% second scythe effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
死神印记造成的伤害提高5%。

施放符文刃舞会给予1层破灭，第一把镰刀效果为100%，第二把镰刀效果为100%。

options.description_en: Death Strike damage increased by 12%.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击的伤害提高12%。

options.description_en:
The effectiveness of Permafrost is increased by 100% and Exterminate grants Permafrost equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

Permafrost
Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh:
永冻的效果提高100%，并且破灭使你获得相当于造成伤害10%的永冻效果。

永冻
自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的50%。

options.description_en: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 冻结自己的血液，对昏迷效果免疫，受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 54 Physical damage and heals you for 20.00% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 将黑暗的力量灌注到武器中，造成53点物理伤害，并为你恢复之前5秒内所受伤害的20.00%，至少恢复7.0%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个食尸鬼为你作战。你一次最多只能召唤一个食尸鬼。持续1分钟。

options.description_en: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
options.description_zh: 自动攻击有一定几率产生3点符文能量。

options.description_en: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击的消耗减少10点，且治疗效果提高60%。

options.description_en: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 以极寒的能量攻击目标的心智，打断目标施法，并且使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。

options.description_en:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh:
致盲你前方锥形区域的目标，使其迷惑地乱走，持续5秒。伤害会解除该效果。

当致盲冰雨结束时，敌人会减速50%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Absorbs are 15% more effective on you.
options.description_zh: 你的吸收效果提高15%。

options.description_en: Absorbs are 30% more effective on you.
options.description_zh: 你的吸收效果提高30%。

options.description_en: Death's Advance grants an additional 25% movement speed over the first 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 死亡脚步在最初的3秒内会使你额外获得25%的移动速度。

options.description_en:
Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

While active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.
options.description_zh:
汲取暗影界的力量，解除所有定身效果并使你的移动速度提高70%，持续4秒。任何行动都会取消此效果。

在此期间，任何效果都不会使你的移动速度减速至正常的170%以下。

options.description_en: Increases Haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases Haste by 4%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高4%。

options.description_en: Dominates the target undead creature up to level 71, forcing it to do your bidding for 5 min.
options.description_zh: 控制等级不高于71的目标亡灵生物，迫使其听从你的命令，持续5分钟。

options.description_en: Your ghoul's attacks have a chance to apply Enfeeble, reducing the enemies movement speed by 30% and the damage they deal to you by 12% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的食尸鬼的攻击有几率施加衰弱效果，使敌人的移动速度降低30%，对你造成的伤害降低12%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用心灵冰冻成功打断敌人会产生10点符文能量，并使其冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Chains of Ice affects 1 additional nearby enemy.
options.description_zh: 寒冰锁链额外影响1个附近的敌人。

options.description_en: Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的50%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高20%。

options.description_en: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 制造死亡契约，为你恢复50%的最大生命值，但会吸收治疗效果，数值相当于最大生命值的30%，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的疾病效果有几率削弱你的敌人，使你对其造成的伤害提高6%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: While you are below 50% health, your Ghoul sacrifices 4% of its maximum health to heal you for 1% of your maximum health every sec.
options.description_zh: 当你的生命值低于50%时，你的食尸鬼牺牲其最大生命值的4%，每秒为你恢复最大生命值的1%。

options.description_en: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
options.description_zh: 消耗符文能量的技能会使你的近战攻击速度提高6%，持续10秒，最多叠加3次。

options.description_en: Raise Ally costs 30 less Runic Power.
options.description_zh: 复活盟友消耗的符文能量减少30点。

options.description_en: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
options.description_zh: 制造一个反魔法领域，持续6秒，使小队或团队成员受到的魔法伤害降低15%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.
options.description_zh: 死亡契约的冷却时间缩短30秒，在其治疗吸收效果持续期间，你获得的治疗效果提高50%。

options.description_en: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你的符文熔铸的效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Chains of Ice now also roots enemies for 4 sec but its cooldown is increased to 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰锁链现在还会使敌人定身4秒，但冷却时间延长至12秒。

options.description_en: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 将敌方目标举到空中，用黑暗能量扼住他们的咽喉，使其昏迷5秒。

options.description_en:
Increases the range of Death Grip by 10 yds.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Death Grip.
options.description_zh:
死亡之握的射程提高10码。

在你杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人后，立即重置死亡之握的冷却时间。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Anti-Magic Zone is reduced by 60 sec and its duration is increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 反魔法领域的冷却时间缩短60秒，持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.
options.description_zh: 反魔法护罩的冷却时间缩短20秒，持续时间和吸收量提高40%。

options.description_en: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.
options.description_zh: 枯萎凋零使其范围内的所有敌人移动速度降低90%，此效果每秒衰减10%。

options.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。受到失控效果影响时，该加成额外提高6%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Increases Leech by 3%.
options.description_zh: 吸血提高3%。

options.description_en: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 巫妖之躯的持续时间延长2秒，冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell increases healing received by 15%.
options.description_zh: 反魔法护罩使受到的治疗效果提高15%。

options.description_en: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击使目标的自动攻击速度降低5%，持续30秒，最多叠加4次。

options.description_en: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.
options.description_zh: 你受到爆击的几率降低3%，你的护甲提高6%。

options.description_en:
When you fall below 30% health you drain 42 health from nearby enemies, the damage you take is reduced by 10% and your Death Strike cost is reduced by 10 for 8 sec.

Can only occur every 2 min.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至30%以下时，你会从附近的敌人身上吸取42点生命值，并使你受到的伤害降低10%，你的灵界打击的消耗降低10点，持续8秒。

每2分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 3% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗一枚符文有几率使你的力量提高3%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 6% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗一枚符文有几率使你的力量提高6%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: When you would pull an enemy, the damage they deal to you is reduced by 6% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你即将拖动一名敌人时，其对你造成的伤害降低6%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 生命值低于30%时，受到的伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 35%.
options.description_zh: 生命值低于30%时，受到的伤害降低35%。

options.description_en: Magic damage taken is reduced by 8% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低8%，你受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短35%。

options.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell now removes all harmful magical effects when activated, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 反魔法护罩激活时可以移除所有有害魔法效果，但冷却时间延长20秒。

options.description_en: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 死神脚步，枯萎凋零和死亡之握额外获得1次充能。

options.description_en: Casting Anti-Magic Shell grants 2 nearby allies a Lesser Anti-Magic Shell that Absorbs up to 148 magic damage and reduces the duration of harmful Magic effects against them by 50%.
options.description_zh: 施放反魔法护罩会使附近的2名盟友获得一个弱效反魔法护罩，吸收最多148点魔法伤害，并使其受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短50%。

options.description_en:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 81 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.

Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 10 damage per stack.

Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.
options.description_zh:
恶毒地割裂敌人的灵魂，造成81点暗影冰霜伤害并施加死神印记。

每当你造成暗影或冰霜伤害，叠加一层死神印记。12秒后或叠加至40层时印记爆炸，每层造成10点伤害。

如果目标死亡，死神印记会转移至附近一个未被标记的敌人身上。

options.description_en: Chill your weapon with icy power and quickly strike the enemy, dealing 58 Frost damage.
options.description_zh: 使用寒冰之力附魔你的武器并快速打击敌人，造成59点冰霜伤害。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing 34 Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

Wave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.
options.description_zh:
死神印记会发出多股暗影冰霜能量并将其召回，往返都可对路径中的敌人造成33点暗影冰霜伤害。

灵魂浪潮的爆击使敌人受到的暗影冰霜伤害提高5%，持续15秒，最多叠加2次。灵魂浪潮返程时必定爆击。

options.description_en: Frost Fever deals its damage 75% faster, and the second scythe of Exterminate applies Frost Fever.
options.description_zh: 冰霜疫病造成伤害的速度加快75%，并且第二把破灭镰刀会施加冰霜疫病。

options.description_en:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to its main target, and is now Shadowfrost.

Shadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.
options.description_zh:
白霜强化的凛风冲击对主要目标的伤害提高60%，现在造成暗影冰霜伤害。

暗影冰霜伤害会施加2层死神印记，爆击时施加4层。

options.description_en:
The effectiveness of Permafrost is increased by 100% and Exterminate grants Permafrost equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

Permafrost
Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh:
永冻的效果提高100%，并且破灭使你获得相当于造成伤害10%的永冻效果。

永冻
自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的50%。

options.description_en: A brutal attack that deals 32 Physical and 33 Frost damage.
options.description_zh: 一次凶蛮打击，造成32点物理伤害和32点冰霜伤害。

options.description_en:
Blast the target with a frigid wind, dealing 15 Frost damage to that foe, and reduced damage to all other enemies within 10 yards, infecting all targets with Frost Fever.

 Frost Fever
A disease that deals 117 Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.
options.description_zh:
以刺骨的寒风冲击目标，对目标造成15点冰霜伤害，对10码内的所有其他敌人造成较低的伤害，并使所有目标感染冰霜疫病。

 冰霜疫病
疾病效果，在24秒内造成117点冰霜伤害，每次造成伤害时有几率使死亡骑士获得4点符文能量。

options.description_en: When Reaper's Mark explodes, it deals 20% of the damage dealt to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 死神印记的爆炸对周围的敌人造成20%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark initial strike grants Killing Machine.

Reaper's Mark explosion deals up to 30% increased damage based on your target's missing health.
options.description_zh:
死神印记的初始攻击会使你获得杀戮机器。

死神印记的爆炸造成的伤害最多提高30%，由目标损失的生命值决定。

nodes.name_en: Pact of the Deathbringer / Rune Carved Plates
nodes.name_zh: 死亡使者契约 / 符刻坚甲

options.description_en:
When you suffer a damaging effect equal to 25% of your maximum health, you instantly cast Death Pact at 50% effectiveness. May only occur every 2 min.

When a Reaper's Mark explodes, the cooldowns of this effect and Death Pact are reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你受到一次相当于最大生命值的25%的伤害时，你会立即施放死亡契约，产生50%的效果。每2分钟只能触发一次。

当死神印记爆炸时，该效果和死亡契约的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Each Rune spent reduces the magic damage you take by 1.5% and each Rune generated reduces the physical damage you take by 1.5% for 5 sec, up to 5 times.
options.description_zh: 每使用一个符文都会使你受到的魔法伤害降低1.5%，每产生一个符文都会使你受到的物理伤害降低1.5%，持续5秒，至多5次。

options.description_en: Death Strike damage increased by 12%.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击的伤害提高12%。

options.description_en: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to make your next Obliterate deal Frost damage and critically strike, or make your next Frostscythe critically strike for 4 times the normal damage.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击爆击时有一定几率使你的下一个湮灭造成冰霜伤害且必定暴击，或使下一次冰霜之镰必定暴击且造成4倍的普通伤害。

options.description_en: Drain the will of your enemy to empower your rune weapon, dealing 91 Shadowfrost damage and reduced damage to enemies nearby, gaining 40 Runic Power, and grants you Killing Machine.
options.description_zh: 汲取敌人的意志来强化你的符文武器，对目标造成91点暗影冰霜伤害，对附近敌人造成较少伤害，获得40点符文能量，并获得杀戮机器效果。

options.description_en:
A sweeping attack that strikes all enemies in front of you for 17 Frost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. 

Consumes Killing Machine to have its critical strikes deal 4 times the normal damage.
options.description_zh:
一次横扫攻击，打击你前方所有的敌人，造成16点冰霜伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

消耗杀戮机器使爆击造成4倍的普通伤害。

options.description_en:
If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 10% Strength for 8 sec.

Wave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.
options.description_zh:
如果灵魂迸裂没有击中任何敌人，你获得10%力量，持续8秒。

灵魂浪潮对你死神印记主要目标的效果提高100%。

nodes.name_zh: 黑暗之爪 / 死神强袭

options.description_en:
Consuming Killing Machine or Rime has a 25% chance to grant 3 stacks of Icy Talons and increase its maximum stacks by the same amount for 6 sec.

Runic Power spending abilities count as Shadowfrost while Icy Talons is active.
options.description_zh:
消耗杀戮机器或白霜有25%的几率使你获得3层冰冷之爪，并使其最大层数提高相同层数，持续6秒。

冰冷之爪激活时，你消耗符文能量的技能也被视作暗影冰霜伤害。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Reaper's Mark by 15 sec, but the amount of Obliterates and Frostscythes empowered by Exterminate is reduced by 1.
options.description_zh: 死神印记的冷却时间减少15秒，但破灭强化的湮灭和冰霜之镰数量减少1次。

nodes.name_zh: 死亡信使 / 反斥之盾

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldowns of Lichborne and Raise Dead by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 巫妖之躯和亡者复生的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: When an enemy deals direct damage to your Anti-Magic Shell, their cast speed is reduced by 10% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当敌人对你的反魔法护罩造成直接伤害时，使其施法速度降低10%，持续6秒。

施放符文刃舞会给予1层破灭，第一把镰刀效果为100%，第二把镰刀效果为100%。

options.description_en: Consuming Killing Machine fires a Glacial Advance through your target at 60% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 消耗杀戮机器效果时向目标施放一次冰川突进，产生60%的效果。

options.description_en: Increases Frost Strike and Glacial Advance damage by 10%.
options.description_zh: 冰霜打击和冰川突进的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases Frost Strike and Glacial Advance damage by 20%.
options.description_zh: 冰霜打击和冰川突进的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Consuming Rime reduces the cooldown of Empower Rune Weapon by 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗白霜会使符文武器增效的冷却时间缩短6秒。

Increases your maximum Runic Power by 10.

Increases Rune regeneration rate by 8%.
options.description_zh:
你的符文能量上限提高10点。

符文回复速度提高8%。

options.description_en:
Increases your maximum Runic Power by 20.

Increases Rune regeneration rate by 15%.
options.description_zh:
你的符文能量上限提高20点。

符文回复速度提高15%。

options.description_en: Remorseless Winter damage is increased by 35%. The first time Remorseless Winter deals damage to 3 different enemies, you gain Rime.
options.description_zh: 冷酷严冬的伤害提高35%。冷酷严冬首次对3名不同的敌人造成伤害后，你获得白霜效果。

options.description_en:
After Reaper's Mark explodes, your next 2 Obliterates or Frostscythes cost 1 Rune and summon 2 scythes to strike your enemies.

The first scythe strikes your target for 153 Shadowfrost damage and the second scythe strikes all enemies around your target for 63 Shadowfrost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
在死神印记爆炸后，你的下2次湮灭或冰霜之镰消耗1个符文，并召唤2把镰刀打击你的敌人。

第一把镰刀会对目标造成154点暗影冰霜伤害，第二把镰刀会打击目标周围的所有敌人，造成63点暗影冰霜伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Gain Inexorable Assault every 4 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Obliterate consumes up to 3 stacks, dealing an additional 9 Frost damage for each stack consumed.
options.description_zh:
每4秒获得酷寒突袭，最多叠加5次。

湮灭消耗最多3层酷寒突袭，每消耗一层额外造成9点冰霜伤害。

options.description_en:
Obliterate deals 10% increased damage and has a chance to tether the souls of its target and a nearby enemy to yours.

Frost Strike severs the tethers, dealing 72 Shadowfrost damage to both foes.
options.description_zh:
湮灭造成的伤害提高10%，并有几率将目标及附近一名敌人的灵魂与你的灵魂捆在一起。

冰霜打击会斩断束缚，对这两个敌人造成72点暗影冰霜伤害。

options.description_en: The power of frost increases your Strength by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 冰霜的能量使你的力量提高20%，持续12秒。

options.description_en:
Frost Strike and Glacial Advance now cause your next Frost Strike and Glacial Advance to deal 15% increased damage and cost 5 more Runic Power. 

This effect stacks until the next Runic Empowerment.
options.description_zh:
冰霜打击和冰川突进现在使你的下一个冰霜打击和冰川突进造成的伤害提高15%，消耗的符文能量提高5点。

此效果可叠加，直到下一次符文强化。

options.description_en: Each Rune spent during Remorseless Winter increases its damage by 10%, and extends its duration by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 冷酷严冬期间每消耗一个符文，就会使冷酷严冬造成的伤害提高10%，并使其持续时间延长0.5秒。

options.description_en:
Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

Mograine
Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

Whitemane
Casts Undeath on your target dealing 2 Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

Trollbane
Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

Nazgrim
While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.
options.description_zh:
消耗符文有几率召唤一名天启骑士协助你作战，持续10秒。

莫格莱尼
在他的位置施放枯萎凋零，效果区域会跟随他移动。每次造成伤害时，使你的疾病效果持续时间延长1.0秒。

怀特迈恩
对你的目标施放死灵，每层每3秒造成2点暗影冰霜伤害，持续24秒。死灵造成伤害时叠加一层，无法被刷新。

托尔贝恩
对目标施放寒冰锁链，使其移动速度降低40%，并使其从你受到的伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

纳兹戈林
纳兹戈林激活时，你获得天启征服，使力量提高5%。

options.description_en: Consuming the Killing Machine effect has a 20% chance to grant you 1 Rune.
options.description_zh: 消耗杀戮机器的效果时有20%的几率使你获得1枚符文。

options.description_en: Frost Strike and Glacial Advance have a 15% increased chance to trigger Rime and Howling Blast generates 8 Runic Power while Rime is active.
options.description_zh: 冰霜打击和冰川突进有额外15%的几率触发白霜，当白霜激活时，凛风冲击会产生8点符文能量。

options.description_en: When Pillar of Frost expires, your Strength is increased by 8% for 6 sec. This effect lasts 2 sec longer, up to 20 sec, for each Obliterate and Frostscythe critical strike during Pillar of Frost.
options.description_zh: 冰霜之柱持续结束时，使你的力量提高8%，持续6秒。冰霜之柱期间每次湮灭或冰霜之镰造成爆击，就会使效果延长2秒，最多延长20秒。

options.description_en:
Pillar of Frost now summons a Remorseless Winter that lasts 4 sec longer.

Each enemy Remorseless Winter damages grants you 5% Mastery, up to 26% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh:
冰霜之柱现在会召唤一场持续时间延长4秒的冷酷严冬。

冷酷严冬每伤害一个敌人都会使你获得5%精通，最多26%，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Runic Empowerment has a 25% chance to refund 1 additional Rune.
options.description_zh: 符文强化有25%几率额外返还1个符文。

nodes.name_en: On a Paler Horse / Death Charge
nodes.name_zh: 告死苍驹 / 死亡冲锋

options.description_en: While outdoors you are able to mount your Acherus Deathcharger in combat.
options.description_zh: 在户外时，你可以在战斗中骑乘阿彻鲁斯死亡战马。

options.description_en:
Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.

For 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.
options.description_zh:
召唤你的死亡战马，解除移动限制效果。

在10秒内骑乘死亡战马，使你的移动速度提高100%，不能被减速到正常速度的100%以下，并免疫强制移动和击退效果。

options.description_en: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.
options.description_zh: 你的伤害提高5%，并且位于莫格莱尼的枯萎凋零中时可以获得。

nodes.name_en: Horsemen's Aid / Pact of the Apocalypse
nodes.name_zh: 天启骑士的援助 / 天启契约

options.description_en:
While at your aid, the Horsemen will occasionally cast Anti-Magic Shell on you and themselves at 80% effectiveness.

You may only benefit from this effect every 45 sec.
options.description_zh:
在协助你作战时，天启骑士会周期性对你和自身施放反魔法护罩，产生80%的效果。

你每45秒只能获得该效果一次。

options.description_en: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.
options.description_zh: 当你受到伤害时，5%的伤害会转移给每个激活的天启骑士。

options.description_en: Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变会召唤怀特迈恩，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Rime empowered Howling Blast unleashes 2 icy blades at its target that deal 8 Frost damage and have 15% chance to grant Killing Machine.
options.description_zh: 白霜强化的凛风冲击会对目标释放2把冰刃，造成8点冰霜伤害，并有15%的几率使你获得杀戮机器。

options.description_en: When Howling Blast consumes Rime, 15% of the damage it deals is gathered into the next cast of Remorseless Winter, up to 20 times.
options.description_zh: 每次凛风冲击消耗白霜时，造成的伤害的15%会积攒到下一次冷酷严冬中，最多积攒20次。

options.description_en: Summons a frostwyrm who breathes on all enemies within 40 yd in front of you, dealing 102 Frost damage, stunning enemies for 3 sec, and slowing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤一头冰霜巨龙，向前方40码内所有敌人发动吐息，造成105点冰霜伤害，使敌人昏迷3秒，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 50% increased damage to secondary targets.

Remorseless Winter deals 6% increased damage to enemies it hits, stacking up to 10 times.
options.description_zh:
受白霜强化的凛风冲击会对次要目标额外造成50%伤害。

冷酷严冬对命中的敌人造成的伤害提高6%，最多叠加10层。

options.description_en:
Howling Blast now hits an additional target with maximum effectiveness. 

Rime increases Howling Blast damage done by an additional 75%.
options.description_zh:
凛风冲击现在额外以最大效能击中一个目标。

白霜使凛风冲击的伤害额外提高75%。

options.description_en: When Scourge Strike damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击对受到死灵影响的敌人造成伤害时，使其叠加1层，并感染附近的另一个敌人。

options.description_en:
If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.

Additionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.
options.description_zh:
如果有敌人在纳兹戈林激活期间死亡，天启征服的力量加成提高3%。

另外，每消耗一个符文会使该效果提高1%。

options.description_en: Scourge Strike shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing 36 Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击命中时击碎托尔贝恩的寒冰锁链，对周围的敌人造成36点暗影冰霜伤害，并使其减速40%，持续4秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

options.description_en: Casting Death Coil or Epidemic orders Whitemane to cast her Death Coil or Epidemic alongside you at 125% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 施放凋零缠绕或扩散会命令怀特迈恩与你一起以125%效果施放凋零缠绕或扩散。

options.description_en: Consuming Killing Machine grants 1% critical strike chance for 10 sec, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks your next Killing Machine consumes the stacks and grants you 10% increased Frost damage for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗杀戮机器效果会提供1%的爆击几率，持续10秒，最多叠加5层。叠加至5层时，你的下一个杀戮机器会消耗所有层数，使你的冰霜伤害提高10%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Consuming Killing Machine grants 1% critical strike chance for 10 sec, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks your next Killing Machine consumes the stacks and grants you 20% increased Frost damage for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗杀戮机器效果会提供1%的爆击几率，持续10秒，最多叠加5层。叠加至5层时，你的下一个杀戮机器会消耗所有层数，使你的冰霜伤害提高20%，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
Your auto attack damage is increased by 10%. 

This amount is increased for each stack of Icy Talons you have and it can stack up to 2 additional times.
options.description_zh:
你的自动攻击伤害提高10%。

每层冰冷之爪都会提高伤害，并且可以额外叠加2次。

options.description_en: Casting Howling Blast with Rime active causes jagged icicles to fall on enemies nearby your target, applying Razorice and dealing 8 Frost damage.
options.description_zh: 白霜激活时施放凛风冲击会使锐利的冰块砸向目标附近的敌人，施加锋锐之霜效果，造成7点冰霜伤害。

options.description_en: When empowered by Rime, Howling Blast deals 30% increased damage to your primary target.
options.description_zh: 被白霜强化时，凛风冲击对主目标的伤害提高30%。

options.description_en: When empowered by Rime, Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to your primary target.
options.description_zh: 被白霜强化时，凛风冲击对主目标的伤害提高60%。

options.description_en: The damage of your diseases and Death Coil are increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的疫病技能和凋零缠绕的伤害提高5%。

nodes.name_en: Fury of the Horsemen / A Feast of Souls
nodes.name_zh: 天启骑士之怒 / 飨魂

options.description_en: Every 50 Runic Power you spend extends the duration of the Horsemen's aid in combat by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 每消耗50点符文能量可以使天启骑士在战斗中助阵的持续时间延长1秒，最多5秒。

options.description_en: While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your  increased damage.
options.description_zh: 有2名或更多天启骑士协助你时，你的。

options.description_en: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击造成的伤害提高15%，枯萎凋零的冷却时间减少5秒。

options.description_en: The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage..
options.description_zh: 天启骑士施放的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
During Pillar of Frost, Frost Strike and Howling Blast always grant Killing Machine and have a 20% chance to generate a Rune.

Additionally during Pillar of Frost, Empower Rune Weapon causes your next Obliterate or Frostscythe to cost no Runes.
options.description_zh:
冰霜之柱期间，冰霜打击和凛风冲击必定触发杀戮机器，并有20%几率产生一个符文。

此外，冰霜之柱期间，符文武器增效使你的下一个湮灭或冰霜之镰不消耗符文。

options.description_en: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to send out a torrent of ice dealing 49 Frost damage to enemies in front of you.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击爆击有几率打出一道寒冰洪流，对前方的敌人造成49点冰霜伤害。

options.description_en:
When Frost Strike damages an enemy with 5 stacks of Razorice it will consume them to deal an additional 115% damage.

Frostbane consumes the Razorice on your main target to deal an additional 300% damage.
options.description_zh:
如果目标身上已经有了5层锋锐之霜效果，冰霜打击会消耗这些效果，并造成115%的额外伤害。

霜噬会消耗你主要目标身上的锋锐之霜，额外造成300%的伤害。

options.description_en: Your Runic Power spending abilities have a chance to additionally deal 30% of the damage dealt over 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的消耗符文能量的技能有几率在4秒内额外造成30%的伤害。

options.description_en: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 亡者大军和冰霜巨龙之怒会召唤全部4名天启骑士协助你作战，持续20秒。

options.description_en:
Obliterate and Frostscythe consume all Killing Machines to deal 25% increased critical strike damage and grant 1.5% Haste for 8 sec for each stack consumed.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
湮灭和冰霜之镰会消耗所有杀戮机器，每层使造成的爆击伤害提高25%，并且使你的急速提高1.5%，持续8秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: While Pillar of Frost is active your auto-attack critical strikes increase its duration by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 当冰霜之柱激活时，你的自动攻击爆击会使其持续时间延长1秒，最多可达4秒。

options.description_en:
Each foe struck with Glacial Advance has a chance to transform your next Frost Strike into Frostbane. The chance increases with the number of Razorice stacks on the target.

Frostbane
Start a frozen onslaught that strikes twice, unleashing the chilling essence of winter, dealing 21 Frost damage to all enemies caught in its wake with each strike.

Each enemy struck reduces the damage dealt to the next foe by 5%, down to 40%.
options.description_zh:
冰川突进每命中一个敌人都有几率将你的下一次冰霜打击变为冰霜灾祸。目标身上叠加的锋锐之霜越多，此几率越高。

冰霜灾祸
发起一套包含两次攻击的冰冻强袭，释放冷冽的寒冬精华，每次打击对路径中的所有敌人造成21点冰霜伤害。

每击中一个敌人都会使下一个敌人受到的伤害降低5%，最多降低至40%。

options.description_en:
Call upon Sindragosa's aid in battle for 8 sec, continuously dealing 38 Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you. Consuming Killing Machine or Rime increases the duration by 0.8 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

Grants a charge of Empower Rune Weapon at the start and 2 Runes at the end.
options.description_zh:
召唤辛达苟萨协助作战，持续8秒，对你前方锥形范围内的敌人每1秒造成39点冰霜伤害。消耗杀戮机器或白霜效果会使持续时间延长0.8秒。对次要目标造成的伤害降低。

施放开始时获得一层符文武器增效充能，结束时恢复2个符文。

options.description_en: Frostwyrm's Fury deals 100% increased damage to the first enemy it hits and grants you 15% Haste for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 冰霜巨龙之怒对命中的第一个敌人造成的伤害提高100%，并使你获得15%急速，持续12秒。

怀特迈恩
对你的目标施放死灵，每层每3秒造成2点暗影冰霜伤害，持续24秒。死灵造成伤害时叠加一层，无法被刷新。

托尔贝恩
对目标施放寒冰锁链，使其移动速度降低40%，并使其从你受到的伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

纳兹戈林
纳兹戈林激活时，你获得天启征服，使力量提高5%。

options.description_en: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.
options.description_zh: 你的伤害提高5%，并且位于莫格莱尼的枯萎凋零中时可以获得。

options.description_en: The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage..
options.description_zh: 天启骑士施放的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Casting Death Coil or Epidemic orders Whitemane to cast her Death Coil or Epidemic alongside you at 125% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 施放凋零缠绕或扩散会命令怀特迈恩与你一起以125%效果施放凋零缠绕或扩散。

options.description_en: Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变会召唤怀特迈恩，持续6秒。

options.description_en:
If no enemies are struck by Soul Rupture, you gain 10% Strength for 8 sec.

Wave of Souls is 100% more effective on the main target of your Reaper's Mark.
options.description_zh:
如果灵魂迸裂没有击中任何敌人，你获得10%力量，持续8秒。

灵魂浪潮对你死神印记主要目标的效果提高100%。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark initial strike grants Killing Machine.

Reaper's Mark explosion deals up to 30% increased damage based on your target's missing health.
options.description_zh:
死神印记的初始攻击会使你获得杀戮机器。

死神印记的爆炸造成的伤害最多提高30%，由目标损失的生命值决定。

nodes.name_en: Pact of the Deathbringer / Rune Carved Plates
nodes.name_zh: 死亡使者契约 / 符刻坚甲

options.description_en:
When you suffer a damaging effect equal to 25% of your maximum health, you instantly cast Death Pact at 50% effectiveness. May only occur every 2 min.

When a Reaper's Mark explodes, the cooldowns of this effect and Death Pact are reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你受到一次相当于最大生命值的25%的伤害时，你会立即施放死亡契约，产生50%的效果。每2分钟只能触发一次。

当死神印记爆炸时，该效果和死亡契约的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Each Rune spent reduces the magic damage you take by 1.5% and each Rune generated reduces the physical damage you take by 1.5% for 5 sec, up to 5 times.
options.description_zh: 每使用一个符文都会使你受到的魔法伤害降低1.5%，每产生一个符文都会使你受到的物理伤害降低1.5%，持续5秒，至多5次。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark sends forth bursts of Shadowfrost energy and back, dealing 34 Shadowfrost damage both ways to all enemies caught in its path.

Wave of Souls critical strikes cause enemies to take 5% increased Shadowfrost damage for 15 sec, stacking up to 2 times, and it is always a critical strike on its way back.
options.description_zh:
死神印记会发出多股暗影冰霜能量并将其召回，往返都可对路径中的敌人造成33点暗影冰霜伤害。

灵魂浪潮的爆击使敌人受到的暗影冰霜伤害提高5%，持续15秒，最多叠加2次。灵魂浪潮返程时必定爆击。

options.description_en:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 60% increased damage to its main target, and is now Shadowfrost.

Shadowfrost damage applies 2 stacks to Reaper's Mark and 4 stacks when it is a critical strike.
options.description_zh:
白霜强化的凛风冲击对主要目标的伤害提高60%，现在造成暗影冰霜伤害。

暗影冰霜伤害会施加2层死神印记，爆击时施加4层。

nodes.name_zh: 死亡信使 / 反斥之盾

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldowns of Lichborne and Raise Dead by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 巫妖之躯和亡者复生的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: When an enemy deals direct damage to your Anti-Magic Shell, their cast speed is reduced by 10% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当敌人对你的反魔法护罩造成直接伤害时，使其施法速度降低10%，持续6秒。

nodes.name_zh: 黑暗之爪 / 死神强袭

options.description_en:
Consuming Killing Machine or Rime has a 25% chance to grant 3 stacks of Icy Talons and increase its maximum stacks by the same amount for 6 sec.

Runic Power spending abilities count as Shadowfrost while Icy Talons is active.
options.description_zh:
消耗杀戮机器或白霜有25%的几率使你获得3层冰冷之爪，并使其最大层数提高相同层数，持续6秒。

冰冷之爪激活时，你消耗符文能量的技能也被视作暗影冰霜伤害。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Reaper's Mark by 15 sec, but the amount of Obliterates and Frostscythes empowered by Exterminate is reduced by 1.
options.description_zh: 死神印记的冷却时间减少15秒，但破灭强化的湮灭和冰霜之镰数量减少1次。

options.description_en: Frost Fever deals its damage 75% faster, and the second scythe of Exterminate applies Frost Fever.
options.description_zh: 冰霜疫病造成伤害的速度加快75%，并且第二把破灭镰刀会施加冰霜疫病。

options.description_en: When Reaper's Mark explodes, it deals 20% of the damage dealt to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 死神印记的爆炸对周围的敌人造成20%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 81 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.

Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 10 damage per stack.

Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.
options.description_zh:
恶毒地割裂敌人的灵魂，造成81点暗影冰霜伤害并施加死神印记。

每当你造成暗影或冰霜伤害，叠加一层死神印记。12秒后或叠加至40层时印记爆炸，每层造成10点伤害。

如果目标死亡，死神印记会转移至附近一个未被标记的敌人身上。

options.description_en:
After Reaper's Mark explodes, your next 2 Obliterates or Frostscythes cost 1 Rune and summon 2 scythes to strike your enemies.

The first scythe strikes your target for 154 Shadowfrost damage and the second scythe strikes all enemies around your target for 62 Shadowfrost damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
在死神印记爆炸后，你的下2次湮灭或冰霜之镰消耗1个符文，并召唤2把镰刀打击你的敌人。

第一把镰刀会对目标造成152点暗影冰霜伤害，第二把镰刀会打击目标周围的所有敌人，造成61点暗影冰霜伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Reaper's Mark deals 5% increased damage.

Casting Dancing Rune Weapon grants 1 stack of Exterminate with 100% first scythe and 100% second scythe effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
死神印记造成的伤害提高5%。

施放符文刃舞会给予1层破灭，第一把镰刀效果为100%，第二把镰刀效果为100%。

options.description_en: Death Strike damage increased by 12%.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击的伤害提高12%。

options.description_en:
The effectiveness of Permafrost is increased by 100% and Exterminate grants Permafrost equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

Permafrost
Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh:
永冻的效果提高100%，并且破灭使你获得相当于造成伤害10%的永冻效果。

永冻
自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的50%。

options.description_en: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 冻结自己的血液，对昏迷效果免疫，受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 52 Physical damage and heals you for 20.00% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 将黑暗的力量灌注到武器中，造成54点物理伤害，并为你恢复之前5秒内所受伤害的20.00%，至少恢复7.0%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个食尸鬼为你作战。你一次最多只能召唤一个食尸鬼。持续1分钟。

options.description_en: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
options.description_zh: 自动攻击有一定几率产生3点符文能量。

options.description_en: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.
options.description_zh: 灵界打击的消耗减少10点，且治疗效果提高60%。

options.description_en: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 以极寒的能量攻击目标的心智，打断目标施法，并且使该系法术在5秒内无法施放。

options.description_en:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh:
致盲你前方锥形区域的目标，使其迷惑地乱走，持续5秒。伤害会解除该效果。

当致盲冰雨结束时，敌人会减速50%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Absorbs are 15% more effective on you.
options.description_zh: 你的吸收效果提高15%。

options.description_en: Absorbs are 30% more effective on you.
options.description_zh: 你的吸收效果提高30%。

options.description_en: Death's Advance grants an additional 25% movement speed over the first 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 死亡脚步在最初的3秒内会使你额外获得25%的移动速度。

options.description_en:
Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

While active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.
options.description_zh:
汲取暗影界的力量，解除所有定身效果并使你的移动速度提高70%，持续4秒。任何行动都会取消此效果。

在此期间，任何效果都不会使你的移动速度减速至正常的170%以下。

options.description_en: Increases Haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases Haste by 4%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高4%。

options.description_en: Dominates the target undead creature up to level 71, forcing it to do your bidding for 5 min.
options.description_zh: 控制等级不高于71的目标亡灵生物，迫使其听从你的命令，持续5分钟。

options.description_en: Your ghoul's attacks have a chance to apply Enfeeble, reducing the enemies movement speed by 30% and the damage they deal to you by 12% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的食尸鬼的攻击有几率施加衰弱效果，使敌人的移动速度降低30%，对你造成的伤害降低12%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用心灵冰冻成功打断敌人会产生10点符文能量，并使其冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Chains of Ice affects 1 additional nearby enemy.
options.description_zh: 寒冰锁链额外影响1个附近的敌人。

options.description_en: Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 自动攻击伤害使你获得吸收护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的50%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高20%。

options.description_en: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 制造死亡契约，为你恢复50%的最大生命值，但会吸收治疗效果，数值相当于最大生命值的30%，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的疾病效果有几率削弱你的敌人，使你对其造成的伤害提高6%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: While you are below 50% health, your Ghoul sacrifices 4% of its maximum health to heal you for 1% of your maximum health every sec.
options.description_zh: 当你的生命值低于50%时，你的食尸鬼牺牲其最大生命值的4%，每秒为你恢复最大生命值的1%。

options.description_en: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
options.description_zh: 消耗符文能量的技能会使你的近战攻击速度提高6%，持续10秒，最多叠加3次。

options.description_en: Raise Ally costs 30 less Runic Power.
options.description_zh: 复活盟友消耗的符文能量减少30点。

options.description_en: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
options.description_zh: 制造一个反魔法领域，持续6秒，使小队或团队成员受到的魔法伤害降低15%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.
options.description_zh: 死亡契约的冷却时间缩短30秒，在其治疗吸收效果持续期间，你获得的治疗效果提高50%。

options.description_en: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你的符文熔铸的效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Chains of Ice now also roots enemies for 4 sec but its cooldown is increased to 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 寒冰锁链现在还会使敌人定身4秒，但冷却时间延长至12秒。

options.description_en: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 将敌方目标举到空中，用黑暗能量扼住他们的咽喉，使其昏迷5秒。

options.description_en:
Increases the range of Death Grip by 10 yds.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Death Grip.
options.description_zh:
死亡之握的射程提高10码。

在你杀死一个可为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人后，立即重置死亡之握的冷却时间。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Anti-Magic Zone is reduced by 60 sec and its duration is increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 反魔法领域的冷却时间缩短60秒，持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.
options.description_zh: 反魔法护罩的冷却时间缩短20秒，持续时间和吸收量提高40%。

options.description_en: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.
options.description_zh: 枯萎凋零使其范围内的所有敌人移动速度降低90%，此效果每秒衰减10%。

options.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 受到的范围攻击伤害降低3%。受到失控效果影响时，该加成额外提高6%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Increases Leech by 3%.
options.description_zh: 吸血提高3%。

options.description_en: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 巫妖之躯的持续时间延长2秒，冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell increases healing received by 15%.
options.description_zh: 反魔法护罩使受到的治疗效果提高15%。

options.description_en: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击使目标的自动攻击速度降低5%，持续30秒，最多叠加4次。

options.description_en: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.
options.description_zh: 你受到爆击的几率降低3%，你的护甲提高6%。

options.description_en:
When you fall below 30% health you drain 42 health from nearby enemies, the damage you take is reduced by 10% and your Death Strike cost is reduced by 10 for 8 sec.

Can only occur every 2 min.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至30%以下时，你会从附近的敌人身上吸取42点生命值，并使你受到的伤害降低10%，你的灵界打击的消耗降低10点，持续8秒。

每2分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 3% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗一枚符文有几率使你的力量提高3%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 6% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗一枚符文有几率使你的力量提高6%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: When you would pull an enemy, the damage they deal to you is reduced by 6% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你即将拖动一名敌人时，其对你造成的伤害降低6%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 生命值低于30%时，受到的伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 35%.
options.description_zh: 生命值低于30%时，受到的伤害降低35%。

options.description_en: Magic damage taken is reduced by 8% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低8%，你受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短35%。

options.description_en: Anti-Magic Shell now removes all harmful magical effects when activated, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 反魔法护罩激活时可以移除所有有害魔法效果，但冷却时间延长20秒。

options.description_en: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 死神脚步，枯萎凋零和死亡之握额外获得1次充能。

options.description_en: Casting Anti-Magic Shell grants 2 nearby allies a Lesser Anti-Magic Shell that Absorbs up to 148 magic damage and reduces the duration of harmful Magic effects against them by 50%.
options.description_zh: 施放反魔法护罩会使附近的2名盟友获得一个弱效反魔法护罩，吸收最多148点魔法伤害，并使其受到的有害魔法效果的持续时间缩短50%。

options.description_en:
Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

Dread Plague
A malicious plague that deals 153 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Explodes for 64 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

Virulent Plague
An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing 71 Shadow damage over 24 sec.
options.description_zh:
使目标同时感染恐惧瘟疫和恶性病变。

恐惧瘟疫
一种恶性瘟疫，在24秒内造成153点暗影伤害。宿主死亡时会爆炸，对附近敌人造成64点暗影伤害，并感染其中一名敌人。一次只能施加于1个宿主。

恶性病变
一种传染性瘟疫，会扩散到附近所有敌人身上，在24秒内造成71点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 5.0% for 20 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击有25%的几率使你的下一个天灾打击变为吸血鬼打击。

吸血鬼打击为你恢复2%的最大生命值，并为你施加鲜血女王的精华，使你的急速提高1.0%，最多提高5.0%，持续20秒。

options.description_en:
An unholy strike that deals 48 Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.

Applies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.
options.description_zh:
一次邪恶的打击，造成47点暗影伤害，并引爆目标身上的瘟疫，以35%效果额外爆发一次伤害。

施放恶性瘟疫，或将其传播至附近的一名敌人。

options.description_en: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 恐惧瘟疫有35%几率使你心智亢奋，使你的下一个凋零缠绕或扩散减少15点符文能量消耗，伤害提高35%。

nodes.name_zh: 返世新血 / 吸血鬼之速

options.description_en: Raise Ally revives players at full health and grants you and your ally an absorb shield equal to 20% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 复活盟友现在使玩家以最大生命值复活，并使你和盟友获得一个护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的20%。

options.description_en:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
死神脚步和幻影步的移动速度加成提高10%。

激活死神脚步或幻影步会使周围4名盟友的移动速度提高20%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 8% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 当你在你的枯萎凋零中时，你受到的物理伤害降低8%，获得吸血鬼打击的几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.
options.description_zh: 枯萎凋零造成伤害的速度提高100%。

nodes.name_zh: 吸血光环 / 血腥之韧

options.description_en:
Your Leech is increased by 2%.

While Lichborne is active, the Leech bonus of this effect is increased by 100%, and it affects 4 allies within 12 yds.
options.description_zh:
你的吸血提高2%。

巫妖之躯激活时，该效果的吸血加成提高100%，并且可以影响12码内的4名盟友。

options.description_en:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
冰封之韧使你受到的所有伤害额外降低最多20%，由你损失的生命值决定。

消灭可以使你获得经验值或荣誉值的敌人可以使冰封之韧的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 1.0% per stack.

Blood Plague deals 5% increased damage.
options.description_zh:
每层鲜血女王的精华使你的精通额外提高1.0%。

血之疫病的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.

For each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 10% reduced damage.
options.description_zh:
暗影指引你出击，使你的天灾打击伤害提高25%，并使其为你赋予暗影之爪，最多叠加4层。

每层暗影之爪都会使天灾打击额外弹向一名敌人。后续的每次弹射伤害均降低10%。

options.description_en: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for 69 Shadow damage and have them explode for 48 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个次级食尸鬼攻击敌人，造成69点暗影伤害并使其爆炸，对附近的敌人造成48点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.

Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
腐蚀你的食尸鬼，将其进化为畸兽，极大地强化其技能，持续15秒。

凋零缠绕和扩散会使此效果的持续时间延长1.0秒。

options.description_en: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and deals 10% of the remaining damage to the enemy.
options.description_zh: 当吸血鬼打击对受到你疫病影响的敌人造成伤害时，会使该疫病的持续时间延长3.0秒，并对该敌人造成其剩余伤害的10%。

options.description_en: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
options.description_zh: 鲜血女王的精华可以额外叠加2层，每层使你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击的伤害提高5%，扩散的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变会召唤一头血兽攻击你的敌人，持续10秒。

每当血兽进行攻击，都会存储造成的一部分伤害。血兽死亡时爆炸，对周围敌人造成相当于积累伤害的15%的伤害，并为死亡骑士恢复等量的生命值。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 当消耗末日突降时，你获得4%力量加成，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Your diseases deal 10% more damage and have a 5% increased chance to critically strike.
options.description_zh: 你的疾病造成的伤害提高10%，并且爆击几率提高5%。

nodes.name_zh: 疫病掌控 / 墓穴精通

options.description_en: Critical strike damage of your diseases is increased by 25%
options.description_zh: 你的疾病的爆击伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Critical strike damage of your minions is increased by 15%
options.description_zh: 你的仆从的爆击伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: When your Lesser Ghouls expire, they explode in viscera, dealing 14 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
options.description_zh: 当你的次级食尸鬼消失时，他们的内脏会发生爆炸，对附近的敌人造成15点暗影伤害。

options.description_en: Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.
options.description_zh: 基于目标已损失的生命值比例，你的瘟疫最多额外造成30%伤害。

options.description_en:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击和天灾打击会使目标受到的暗影伤害提高1%，最多5%，持续15秒。

煽动惊恐对吸血鬼打击产生400%的效果。

nodes.name_en: Pact of the San'layn / Sanguine Scent
nodes.name_zh: 萨莱因之契 / 腥红气息

options.description_en: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.
options.description_zh: 你将造成的所有暗影伤害的10%储存到血兽体内，使其在消失时爆炸并造成额外伤害。

options.description_en: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.
options.description_zh: 你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击对生命值低于35%的敌人造成伤害时触发吸血鬼打击的几率提高15%。

options.description_en:
Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Dancing Rune Weapons by 20% for 8 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击使你的符文刃舞的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。c1[

多次施加可以重叠生效。[]

options.description_en: Plagues deal 15% more damage over time in 75% of their duration.
options.description_zh: 疫病在持续时间的前75%内造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en:
Festering Strike now follows up with a Festering Scythe that costs no Runes.

Festering Scythe
Slashes through all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, dealing 35 Shadow damage and hastening all of your plagues on targets hit to deal damage 35% faster for 25 sec.
options.description_zh:
脓疮打击现在会紧接着施放一次不消耗符文的脓疮毒镰。

脓疮毒镰
斩击前方14码内的所有敌人，造成36点暗影伤害，并使目标身上所有疫病伤害生效速度加快35%，持续25秒。

options.description_en: Dread Plague deals damage to an additional nearby enemy at 75% effectiveness and has a chance to grant you 4 Runic Power.
options.description_zh: 恐惧瘟疫以75%的效果额外对附近一名敌人造成伤害，并有一定几率使你获得4点符文能量。

options.description_en:
Rupture the soul of your enemy, dealing 155 Shadowfrost damage and causing the foe to take 20% increased damage from your diseases and minions for 8 sec.

Only usable on enemies below 35% maximum health.

Consumes up to 3 Lesser Ghoul stacks to summon them instantly.
options.description_zh:
撕裂敌人的灵魂，造成158点暗影冰霜伤害，并使该敌人受到你的疾病和仆从造成的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

只能对最大生命值低于35%的敌人使用。

消耗最多3层次级食尸鬼层数并立即将其召唤出来。

options.description_en: Dark Transformation and Army of the Dead summon a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变和亡者大军会召唤一名亡者魔导师，向你的敌人投射寒冰箭和暗影箭，持续15秒。

options.description_en: The infected claws of your ghouls have a chance to sicken the foe, dealing 5 Shadow damage over 12 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.
options.description_zh: 食尸鬼受感染的爪子有几率使敌人染病，在12秒内造成5点暗影伤害。再次施加时，任何剩余伤害都会添加到新效果中。

options.description_en:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变激活时，你获得萨莱因之赐。

萨莱因之赐使你的鲜血女王的精华效果提高200%，并在效果期间将天灾打击替换为吸血鬼打击。

options.description_en:
Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

Mograine
Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

Whitemane
Casts Undeath on your target dealing 2 Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

Trollbane
Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

Nazgrim
While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.
options.description_zh:
消耗符文有几率召唤一名天启骑士协助你作战，持续10秒。

莫格莱尼
在他的位置施放枯萎凋零，效果区域会跟随他移动。每次造成伤害时，使你的疾病效果持续时间延长1.0秒。

怀特迈恩
对你的目标施放死灵，每层每3秒造成2点暗影冰霜伤害，持续24秒。死灵造成伤害时叠加一层，无法被刷新。

托尔贝恩
对目标施放寒冰锁链，使其移动速度降低40%，并使其从你受到的伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

纳兹戈林
纳兹戈林激活时，你获得天启征服，使力量提高5%。

options.description_en:
Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.

Death and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
腐化使枯萎凋零的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

枯萎凋零每伤害一个敌人，就会使腐化的冷却时间缩短0.3秒，最多缩短3.0秒。

options.description_en: Death Coil deals 10% increased damage and causes the target to take an additional 30% of the direct damage dealt over 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 凋零缠绕的伤害提高10%，并使目标在4秒内受到额外伤害，数值相当于其所受直接伤害的30%。

options.description_en:
Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies.

 Death Orders
Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing 11 Shadow damage to your target.

 Epidemic Orders
Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing 2 Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
召唤或强化次级食尸鬼，组成一支由8名成员组成的亡者大军，持续30秒。激活时，召唤次级食尸鬼会改为根据附近敌人执行命令。

死亡命令
次级食尸鬼与你一同攻击，对目标造成11点暗影伤害。

疫病命令
次级食尸鬼爆裂出内脏，对附近敌人造成2点暗影伤害。超过5个目标时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Scourge Strike, Festering Strike, and Death Coil deal 30% additional damage to enemies below 35% health.

Dark Transformation resets Soul Reaper's cooldown and allows it to be used on any target.
options.description_zh:
天灾打击、脓疮打击和凋零缠绕对生命值低于35%的敌人额外造成30%的伤害。

黑暗突变会重置灵魂收割的冷却时间，并允许对任何目标使用。

options.description_en:
Your Magus of the Dead Shadow Bolt now fires a volley of Shadow Bolts at up to 8 nearby enemies.

Your Lord of the Dead Frostbolts now chain to 3 additional enemies.
options.description_zh:
你的亡者魔导师的暗影箭现在会朝附近至多8名敌人射出一阵暗影箭雨。

你的亡者之主的寒冰箭现在会连锁至多3名额外敌人。

options.description_en: Dark Transformation increases the attack speed and damage of you and your Monstrosity by 5% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变使你与你畸兽的攻击速度与伤害提高5%，持续15秒。

nodes.name_en: On a Paler Horse / Death Charge
nodes.name_zh: 告死苍驹 / 死亡冲锋

options.description_en: While outdoors you are able to mount your Acherus Deathcharger in combat.
options.description_zh: 在户外时，你可以在战斗中骑乘阿彻鲁斯死亡战马。

options.description_en:
Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.

For 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.
options.description_zh:
召唤你的死亡战马，解除移动限制效果。

在10秒内骑乘死亡战马，使你的移动速度提高100%，不能被减速到正常速度的100%以下，并免疫强制移动和击退效果。

options.description_en: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.
options.description_zh: 你的伤害提高5%，并且位于莫格莱尼的枯萎凋零中时可以获得。

nodes.name_en: Horsemen's Aid / Pact of the Apocalypse
nodes.name_zh: 天启骑士的援助 / 天启契约

options.description_en:
While at your aid, the Horsemen will occasionally cast Anti-Magic Shell on you and themselves at 80% effectiveness.

You may only benefit from this effect every 45 sec.
options.description_zh:
在协助你作战时，天启骑士会周期性对你和自身施放反魔法护罩，产生80%的效果。

你每45秒只能获得该效果一次。

options.description_en: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.
options.description_zh: 当你受到伤害时，5%的伤害会转移给每个激活的天启骑士。

options.description_en: Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变会召唤怀特迈恩，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Diseased enemies take 1% increased damage from you per disease they are affected by.
options.description_zh: 你对感染疾病的敌人造成的伤害提高，每有一个疾病效果，就提高1%。

options.description_en:
Sudden Doom triggers 30% more often and can accumulate up to 2 charges.

Summoning a Lesser Ghoul with Scourge Strike reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 2.5 sec.
options.description_zh:
末日突降的触发几率提高30%，最多可积累2次充能。

以天灾打击召唤出一只次级食尸鬼时，腐化的冷却时间缩短2.5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 培育憎恶 / 召唤石像鬼

options.description_en: Army of the Dead now raises an Abomination for 30 sec to attack enemies while emitting a disease cloud, dealing 12 Plague damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 亡者大军现在会召唤一只持续30秒的憎恶，攻击敌人并释放瘟疫之云，每2秒对附近敌人造成12点瘟疫伤害。

options.description_en:
Army of the Dead now summons a Gargoyle into the battlefield to bombard your enemies for 25 sec.

The Gargoyle gains 1% increased damage for every 1 Runic Power you spend and always critically strikes.
options.description_zh:
亡者大军现在会召唤一只石像鬼飞入战场轰炸你的敌人，持续25秒。

每当你消耗1点符文能量，石像鬼的伤害就提高1%，并且必定爆击。

options.description_en:
Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
腐化会使你的永久食尸鬼陷入邪恶狂乱，攻击速度和能量恢复速度提高25%，持续12秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en:
Raise Dead summons an additional skeletal archer at your command that shoots Blighted Arrows.

Blighted Arrow
An unholy arrow that deals 11 Shadow damage. When consuming Sudden Doom, your Death Coil commands your archer to fire an additional Blighted Arrow at 80% effectiveness. Epidemic will instead cause Blighted Arrow to ricochet and hit up to 5 additional targets.
options.description_zh:
亡者复生会额外召唤一个骷髅射手听从你的命令并发射枯萎箭矢。

枯萎箭矢
进行一次邪恶射击，造成11点暗影伤害。消耗末日突降时，你的凋零缠绕会命令射手以80%效果额外射出一发枯萎箭矢。扩散会使枯萎箭矢进行弹射，并最多额外命中5个目标。

options.description_en: When Scourge Strike damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击对受到死灵影响的敌人造成伤害时，使其叠加1层，并感染附近的另一个敌人。

options.description_en:
If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.

Additionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.
options.description_zh:
如果有敌人在纳兹戈林激活期间死亡，天启征服的力量加成提高3%。

另外，每消耗一个符文会使该效果提高1%。

options.description_en: Scourge Strike shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing 36 Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击命中时击碎托尔贝恩的寒冰锁链，对周围的敌人造成36点暗影冰霜伤害，并使其减速40%，持续4秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

options.description_en: Casting Death Coil or Epidemic orders Whitemane to cast her Death Coil or Epidemic alongside you at 125% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 施放凋零缠绕或扩散会命令怀特迈恩与你一起以125%效果施放凋零缠绕或扩散。

options.description_en:
The explosion effect of Putrefy extends the duration of your plagues by 3.0 sec and deals 35% of the damage they would deal over that time instantly.

Putrefy now applies your plagues to unaffected targets.
options.description_zh:
腐化的爆炸效果会使疫病的持续时间延长3.0秒，并立即造成其原定持续时间内35%的伤害。

腐化现可将疫病施加于未受影响的目标。

options.description_en: Putrefy deals 20% increased damage, has 2 additional charges and consumes up to 2 available charges.
options.description_zh: 腐化的伤害提高20%，获得额外2次充能，并最多消耗2层可用充能。

options.description_en: Consuming Sudden Doom summons forth a Lesser Ghoul to assist you for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗末日突降会召唤一个次级食尸鬼来协助你，持续8秒。

options.description_en: The damage of your diseases and Death Coil are increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的疫病技能和凋零缠绕的伤害提高5%。

nodes.name_en: Fury of the Horsemen / A Feast of Souls
nodes.name_zh: 天启骑士之怒 / 飨魂

options.description_en: Every 50 Runic Power you spend extends the duration of the Horsemen's aid in combat by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 每消耗50点符文能量可以使天启骑士在战斗中助阵的持续时间延长1秒，最多5秒。

options.description_en: While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your  increased damage.
options.description_zh: 有2名或更多天启骑士协助你时，你的。

options.description_en: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击造成的伤害提高15%，枯萎凋零的冷却时间减少5秒。

options.description_en: The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage..
options.description_zh: 天启骑士施放的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Scourge Strike now causes your Plagues to erupt at 50% effectiveness.

Clawing Shadows can now stack 1 additional times.
options.description_zh:
天灾打击现在会以50%的效果引爆你目标身上的瘟疫。

暗影之爪现在可以额外叠加1次。

options.description_en:
Scourge Strike now causes your Plagues to erupt at 70% effectiveness.

Clawing Shadows can now stack 2 additional times.
options.description_zh:
天灾打击现在会以70%的效果引爆你目标身上的瘟疫。
