options.description_en: Dark Transformation empowers your Gargoyle, Abomination, Magus and Lesser Ghouls for 30 sec, increasing their damage by 10%.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变强化你的石像鬼、憎恶、亡者魔导师和次级食尸鬼，使其伤害提高10%，持续30秒。

options.description_en: Dark Transformation empowers your Gargoyle, Abomination, Magus and Lesser Ghouls for 30 sec, increasing their damage by 20%.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变强化你的石像鬼、憎恶、亡者魔导师和次级食尸鬼，使其伤害提高20%，持续30秒。

options.description_en: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 亡者大军和冰霜巨龙之怒会召唤全部4名天启骑士协助你作战，持续20秒。

options.description_en:
Dark Transformation grants access to Blightfall.

Blightfall
Consume 100% of your plagues around you and deal 100% of their remaining damage instantly.

Grants 1 charge of Putrefy.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变使你能使用瘟疫降临。

瘟疫降临
消耗你周围疾病的100%，立即造成其剩余伤害的100%。

获得1层腐化充能。

options.description_en:
Putrefying a Lesser Ghoul has a 100% chance to reanimate it as a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

When you control 3 Magus of the Dead, sacrifice them to summon their Lord of the Dead for 15 sec, casting Frostbolts that chain between 2 enemies. Magus with higher remaining duration grant increased power.
options.description_zh:
腐化次级食尸鬼时有100%几率将其复活为亡者魔导师，向敌人发射寒冰箭和暗影箭，持续15秒。

当你控制3名亡者魔导师时，牺牲它们召唤亡者之主，持续15秒，发射在2个敌人间弹射的寒冰箭。剩余持续时间越长的魔导师赋予的力量越强。

options.description_en:
Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing 24 Shadow damage to the target and 16 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh:
每有一个次级食尸鬼，你的永久食尸鬼造成的伤害提高10%，黑暗突变还会将你的次级食尸鬼的爪击强化为横扫爪击。

横扫爪击
使用畸形的利爪扫击一名敌人，对目标造成24点暗影伤害，并对附近敌人造成16点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

Necrotic Coil
Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing 71 Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and 23 Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

Graveyard
The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing 39 Shadow damage and 18 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
options.description_zh:
亡者大军汲取亡者之力，将你的凋零缠绕和扩散转化为死灵缠绕和灾殃坟茔，持续30秒。

死灵缠绕
释放一道由亡骨与死灵能量构成的漩涡，对至多3名敌人造成72点暗影打击伤害，并对所有被刺穿的敌人造成22点暗影伤害。

灾殃坟茔
亡者在所有感染了恶性病变的敌人脚下破土而出，造成39点暗影伤害，并对附近敌人造成18点暗影伤害。

options.description_en: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and deals 10% of the remaining damage to the enemy.
options.description_zh: 当吸血鬼打击对受到你疫病影响的敌人造成伤害时，会使该疫病的持续时间延长3.0秒，并对该敌人造成其剩余伤害的10%。

options.description_en:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击和天灾打击会使目标受到的暗影伤害提高1%，最多5%，持续15秒。

煽动惊恐对吸血鬼打击产生400%的效果。

options.description_en: Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.
options.description_zh: 基于目标已损失的生命值比例，你的瘟疫最多额外造成30%伤害。

options.description_en:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变会召唤一头血兽攻击你的敌人，持续10秒。

每当血兽进行攻击，都会存储造成的一部分伤害。血兽死亡时爆炸，对周围敌人造成相当于积累伤害的15%的伤害，并为死亡骑士恢复等量的生命值。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 8% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 当你在你的枯萎凋零中时，你受到的物理伤害降低8%，获得吸血鬼打击的几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.
options.description_zh: 枯萎凋零造成伤害的速度提高100%。

options.description_en:
Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 5.0% for 20 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击有25%的几率使你的下一个天灾打击变为吸血鬼打击。

吸血鬼打击为你恢复2%的最大生命值，并为你施加鲜血女王的精华，使你的急速提高1.0%，最多提高5.0%，持续20秒。

options.description_en:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
options.description_zh:
黑暗突变激活时，你获得萨莱因之赐。

萨莱因之赐使你的鲜血女王的精华效果提高200%，并在效果期间将天灾打击替换为吸血鬼打击。

nodes.name_en: Pact of the San'layn / Sanguine Scent
nodes.name_zh: 萨莱因之契 / 腥红气息

options.description_en: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.
options.description_zh: 你将造成的所有暗影伤害的10%储存到血兽体内，使其在消失时爆炸并造成额外伤害。

options.description_en: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.
options.description_zh: 你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击对生命值低于35%的敌人造成伤害时触发吸血鬼打击的几率提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 吸血光环 / 血腥之韧

options.description_en:
Your Leech is increased by 2%.

While Lichborne is active, the Leech bonus of this effect is increased by 100%, and it affects 4 allies within 12 yds.
options.description_zh:
你的吸血提高2%。

巫妖之躯激活时，该效果的吸血加成提高100%，并且可以影响12码内的4名盟友。

options.description_en:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
冰封之韧使你受到的所有伤害额外降低最多20%，由你损失的生命值决定。

消灭可以使你获得经验值或荣誉值的敌人可以使冰封之韧的冷却时间缩短3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 返世新血 / 吸血鬼之速

options.description_en: Raise Ally revives players at full health and grants you and your ally an absorb shield equal to 20% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 复活盟友现在使玩家以最大生命值复活，并使你和盟友获得一个护盾，吸收量相当于你最大生命值的20%。

options.description_en:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
死神脚步和幻影步的移动速度加成提高10%。

激活死神脚步或幻影步会使周围4名盟友的移动速度提高20%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
options.description_zh: 鲜血女王的精华可以额外叠加2层，每层使你的凋零缠绕和灵界打击的伤害提高5%，扩散的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Dancing Rune Weapons by 20% for 8 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
吸血鬼打击使你的符文刃舞的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。c1[

多次施加可以重叠生效。[]

options.description_en:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 1.0% per stack.

Blood Plague deals 5% increased damage.
options.description_zh:
每层鲜血女王的精华使你的精通额外提高1.0%。

血之疫病的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 当消耗末日突降时，你获得4%力量加成，持续5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 天启骑士的援助 / 天启契约

options.description_en:
While at your aid, the Horsemen will occasionally cast Anti-Magic Shell on you and themselves at 80% effectiveness.

You may only benefit from this effect every 45 sec.
options.description_zh:
在协助你作战时，天启骑士会周期性对你和自身施放反魔法护罩，产生80%的效果。

你每45秒只能获得该效果一次。

options.description_en: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.
options.description_zh: 当你受到伤害时，5%的伤害会转移给每个激活的天启骑士。

options.description_en: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 亡者大军和冰霜巨龙之怒会召唤全部4名天启骑士协助你作战，持续20秒。

options.description_zh: 每消耗50点符文能量可以使天启骑士在战斗中助阵的持续时间延长1秒，最多5秒。

options.description_en: While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your  increased damage.
options.description_zh: 有2名或更多天启骑士协助你时，你的。

options.description_zh: 你的疫病技能和凋零缠绕的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: When Scourge Strike damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击对受到死灵影响的敌人造成伤害时，使其叠加1层，并感染附近的另一个敌人。

options.description_en: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击造成的伤害提高15%，枯萎凋零的冷却时间减少5秒。

options.description_en:
If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.

Additionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.
options.description_zh:
如果有敌人在纳兹戈林激活期间死亡，天启征服的力量加成提高3%。

另外，每消耗一个符文会使该效果提高1%。

nodes.name_en: On a Paler Horse / Death Charge
nodes.name_zh: 告死苍驹 / 死亡冲锋

options.description_en: While outdoors you are able to mount your Acherus Deathcharger in combat.
options.description_zh: 在户外时，你可以在战斗中骑乘阿彻鲁斯死亡战马。

options.description_en:
Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.

For 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.
options.description_zh:
召唤你的死亡战马，解除移动限制效果。

在10秒内骑乘死亡战马，使你的移动速度提高100%，不能被减速到正常速度的100%以下，并免疫强制移动和击退效果。

options.description_en: Scourge Strike shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing 36 Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 天灾打击命中时击碎托尔贝恩的寒冰锁链，对周围的敌人造成36点暗影冰霜伤害，并使其减速40%，持续4秒。目标超过8个时伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

Mograine
Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

Whitemane
Casts Undeath on your target dealing 2 Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

Trollbane
Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

Nazgrim
While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.
options.description_zh:
消耗符文有几率召唤一名天启骑士协助你作战，持续10秒。

莫格莱尼
在他的位置施放枯萎凋零，效果区域会跟随他移动。每次造成伤害时，使你的疾病效果持续时间延长1.0秒。

怀特迈恩
对你的目标施放死灵，每层每3秒造成2点暗影冰霜伤害，持续24秒。死灵造成伤害时叠加一层，无法被刷新。

托尔贝恩
对目标施放寒冰锁链，使其移动速度降低40%，并使其从你受到的伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

纳兹戈林
纳兹戈林激活时，你获得天启征服，使力量提高5%。

options.description_en: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.
options.description_zh: 你的伤害提高5%，并且位于莫格莱尼的枯萎凋零中时可以获得。

options.description_en: The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage..
options.description_zh: 天启骑士施放的技能造成的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Casting Death Coil or Epidemic orders Whitemane to cast her Death Coil or Epidemic alongside you at 125% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 施放凋零缠绕或扩散会命令怀特迈恩与你一起以125%效果施放凋零缠绕或扩散。

options.description_en: Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗突变会召唤怀特迈恩，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Exhilaration now also heals you for an additional 12.0% of your maximum health over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 意气风发现在还会在8秒内额外为你恢复你最大生命值的12.0%。

options.description_en: Reduces all damage you and your pet take by 30% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 使你和你的宠物受到的所有伤害降低30%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Disengage also frees you from all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 逃脱还会移除所有移动限制效果，并使你的移动速度提高50%，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Exhilaration's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 意气风发的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Exhilaration's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 意气风发的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_zh: 优胜劣汰额外获得一次充能。

options.description_en: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 受到范围攻击伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Mend Pet heals for an additional 25% of your pet's health over its duration, and has a 25% chance to dispel a magic effect each time it heals your pet.
options.description_zh: 治疗宠物在持续时间内额外为你的宠物恢复25%的生命值，并且每次治疗你的宠物时有25%的几率驱散一个魔法效果。

options.description_en: Your Agility is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 你的敏捷提高3%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Aspect of the Cheetah is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 猎豹守护的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 眩晕目标，使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Your auto shot damage is increased by 25%.
options.description_zh: 你的自动射击伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Interrupts spellcasting, preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 打断目标施法，并使其在5秒内无法施放任何该系法术。

options.description_en: You gain 2% more critical strike from critical strike sources.
options.description_zh: 你从爆击来源获得的爆击提高2%。

options.description_en: You gain 4% more critical strike from critical strike sources.
options.description_zh: 你从爆击来源获得的爆击提高4%。

options.description_en: Removes 1 Enrage and 1 Magic effect from an enemy target.
options.description_zh: 从一个敌方目标身上移除1个激怒效果和1个魔法效果。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 移动速度提高4%。

options.description_en: When Counter Shot interrupts a cast, gain 30 Focus.
options.description_zh: 当反制射击中断一次施法，获得30点集中值。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Feign Death is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 假死的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Feign Death is reduced by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 假死的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_zh: 在30秒内，你接下来造成的所有威胁值会误导给指定的小队或团队成员，持续8秒。

options.description_zh: 宁神射击从附近最多2个目标身上移除1个额外的魔法效果。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 2%.

options.description_zh: 你从爆击来源获得的爆击提高4%。

options.description_zh: 移动速度提高4%。

options.description_zh: 假死的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_zh: 宁神射击从附近最多2个目标身上移除1个额外的魔法效果。

options.description_zh: 向目标位置发射一个焦油陷阱，当第一个敌人靠近时在其周围制造一个半径8码的焦油池，持续30秒。所有敌人在作用范围内时移动速度降低50%，最多1个。陷阱可存在1分钟。

options.description_zh: 恐吓一头野兽，使其因恐慌而逃跑，最多持续20秒。任何伤害都有可能打断这个效果。每个猎人在同一时间内只能恐吓一头野兽。

options.description_en: Your maximum health is increased by 5%.

options.description_zh: 你的最大生命值提高10%。

options.description_zh: 你和你的宠物与周围的环境融为一体，获得潜行，持续1分钟。当在伪装状态下时，你每1秒会恢复2%的最大生命值。

options.description_en:
When Misdirection targets your pet, it reduces the damage they take by 50% for 5 sec.

The cooldown of Misdirection is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
当误导目标为你的宠物时，使其受到的伤害减少50%，持续5秒。

误导的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_zh: 杀戮命令造成的伤害提高10%。

Your Spotting Eagle descends from the skies, stunning your target for 5 sec.

你的瞭望的雄鹰从天而降，使目标昏迷5秒。

对玩家使用时，此技能无需视线即可施放。

Wing Clip slows an additional 25%.

摔绊的减速效果额外提高25%。

震荡射击的减速效果额外提高10%。

options.description_zh: 优胜劣汰的持续时间延长2.0秒。

options.description_en: Aspect of the Cheetah's initial burst of speed is increased by 2.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 猎豹守护的初始速度爆发持续时间延长2.0秒。

options.description_en: Fires a magical projectile, tethering the enemy and any other enemies within 5 yds for 10 sec, stunning them for 3 sec if they move more than 5 yds from the arrow.
options.description_zh: 射出一支魔法箭矢，束缚敌人及其5码范围内的其他任意敌人，持续10秒。如果目标离开箭矢5码范围外，则会昏迷3秒。

options.description_en: Your movement speed is increased by 30% anytime you have not attacked for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当你有3秒不攻击时，会使你的移动速度提高30%。

options.description_en: When a trap triggers, gain 30% increased movement speed for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 当陷阱触发时，移动速度提高30%，持续3秒。

options.description_zh: 当你的冰冻陷阱生效时，受影响者的移动速度降低70%，持续4秒。

options.description_zh: 当束缚射击昏迷一名敌人时，会将其拉向束缚射击的中心。

options.description_zh: 假死和灵龟守护会移除你身上的中毒和疾病效果。

Instructs your pet to protect a friendly target, reducing their damage taken by 15%, but 50% of all damage taken by that target is transferred to your pet. 

Lasts 10 sec or until your pet's health drops below 25%.

命令你的宠物保护一名盟友，使其受到的伤害降低15%，但受保护目标受到伤害的50%会转移给你的宠物。

持续10秒，或直到你宠物的生命值低于25%。

options.description_en: Your pet protects you at all times, reducing the damage you take by 3%. Your pet receives 100% of the damage it mitigates.
options.description_zh: 你的宠物时刻保护着你，使你受到的伤害降低3%。你的宠物承受其减免伤害的100%。

Your damage over time effects deal 10% increased damage.

This effect is increased by 50% on targets below 20% health.
options.description_zh:
你的持续性伤害效果造成的伤害提高10%。

对生命值低于20%的目标，该效果增加50%。

Your Eagle is replaced with a Sentinel Owl that applies an enhanced Sentinel's Mark.

Sentinel's Mark

你的雄鹰被替换为一只警戒猫头鹰，会施加一个强化哨兵印记。

哨兵印记
你的下一次野火炸弹对被标记的目标造成的直接伤害提高40%。

Your Kill Shot is replaced with Black Arrow.

You attempt to finish off a wounded target, dealing 121 Shadow damage and 140 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Only usable on enemies above 80% health or below 20% health.

你的夺命射击被替换为黑蚀箭。

Your auto shot now deals Shadow damage, allowing it to bypass armor.

你的自动射击现在造成暗影伤害，可以穿透护甲。

options.description_zh: 消耗哨兵印记会使你获得一个护盾，能够吸收相当于你最大生命值10.0%的伤害。

消耗利矛之刃召唤警戒猫头鹰的几率提高10%。

Kill Command has a 20% chance and Barbed Shot has a 50% chance to grant Deathblow.

杀戮命令有20%的几率，倒刺射击有50%的几率触发夺命打击。

options.description_zh: 猛禽一击在6秒内额外造成15%的伤害，这些伤害视为奥术伤害。

For 15 sec after casting Takedown, Takedown is replaced with Moonlight Chakram.

 Moonlight Chakram
Throw a chakram blessed with moonlight at your current target that will rapidly deal 100 Physical damage 7 times, bouncing to other targets if they are nearby.

施放狩魂一击后的15秒内，狩魂一击被替换为月光战轮。

向你当前的目标投掷一枚受月光祝福的战轮，迅速造成99点物理伤害，共造成7次伤害。如果附近有其他目标，战轮则会在其中进行弹跳。

options.description_zh: 召唤凶暴野兽时，你有10%的几率改为召唤一只黑暗猎犬，其造成的伤害显著提高。

options.description_en:
Shoot a stream of 7 shots at your target over 1.8 sec, dealing a total of 260 Physical damage. Usable while moving.

Each shot generates 3 Focus.
options.description_zh:
在1.8秒内，朝你的目标射出7支箭矢，总共造成258点物理伤害。可在移动时使用。

每支箭矢可产生3点集中值。

options.description_en:
Aimed Shot causes your next Arcane Shot or Multi-Shot to deal 50% more damage and cost 60% less Focus.

Precise Shots benefits Kill Shot's damage at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
瞄准射击使你的下一次奥术射击或多重射击造成的伤害额外提高50%，集中值消耗降低60%。

弹无虚发以100%的效果为夺命射击提供伤害加成。

Casting Black Arrow has a 15% chance to grant Deathblow.

 Deathblow

options.description_zh:
施放黑蚀箭有15%几率获得夺命打击。

 夺命打击
重置夺命射击的冷却时间。你的下一个夺命射击可以作用于任意目标并无视其当前生命值。

options.description_zh: 夺命射击伤害提高10%。

options.description_zh: 消耗利矛之刃会使爆击伤害提高2%，持续10秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: Fire damage dealt increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 造成的火焰伤害提高5%。

利矛之刃的伤害加成提高4%。

狩魂一击的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_zh:
意气风发使你获得3秒优胜劣汰。

优胜劣汰会激活意气风发，产生50%的效果。

options.description_zh: 在战斗中施放逃脱会用锁链将最近的目标拘束在地，使其移动速度降低40%，直到目标移动到8码以外。

options.description_zh: 在战斗中施放逃脱会扔出一阵暗影匕首，每秒造成0点暗影伤害并使受影响目标的移动速度降低30%，持续6秒。

Kill Command grants an additional 5 Focus and its damage is increased by 20%. 

Maximum Focus increased by 25.

杀戮命令额外产生5点集中值，伤害提高20%。

最大集中值提高25点。

Bestial Wrath summons a Dark Hound.

For 15 sec after casting Bestial Wrath, Bestial Wrath is replaced with Wailing Arrow.

 Wailing Arrow
Fire an enchanted arrow, dealing 487 Shadow damage to your target and an additional 245 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds of your target. Non-Player targets struck by a Wailing Arrow have their spellcasting interrupted and are silenced for 1 sec.

Grants Deathblow.
options.description_zh:
狂野怒火召唤一个黑暗猎犬。

施放狂野怒火后的15秒内，狂野怒火会被哀恸箭替代。

射出一支魔法箭，对你的目标造成493点暗影伤害，并对目标周围8码范围内的所有敌人额外造成245点暗影伤害。打断被哀恸箭击中的非玩家目标的施法，并使其沉默1秒。

使你获得夺命打击。

options.description_zh: 当你的月光战轮消失时，会召唤一次月光爆炸，对附近的敌人造成69点奥术伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_zh: 投掷月光战轮会使野火炸弹的冷却时间缩短10秒。

瞭望印记的伤害加成提高20%。

Regain access to Call Pet.

重新获得召唤宠物。

在户外时，你的宠物造成的伤害提高15%，受到的伤害降低15%。

Beast Cleave and Kill Cleave damage increased by 5%.

你在凋零射击的弹幕期间额外发射2支黑蚀箭。

野兽顺劈和杀戮顺劈的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain periodic damage has a chance to cause your next Mind Blast to be instant and ignore its cooldown.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：痛的周期性伤害有几率使你的下一次心灵震爆变为瞬发并忽略其冷却时间。

options.description_en: Increases your Shadow Word: Madness damage by 6% and increases your maximum Insanity by 50.
options.description_zh: 使你的暗言术：癫造成的伤害提高6%，并使你的最大狂乱值提高50点。

options.description_en:
Bombards your target with a Void Volley and twists your Shadowform with void magic, increasing your spell damage by 20% for 20 sec. 

During Voidform, Void Volley replaces this spell and can be used up to 3 times.

 Void Volley
Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for 362 Shadow damage.

Generates 10 Insanity.
options.description_zh:
以虚空齐射轰炸目标，并以虚空魔法扭曲你的暗影形态，使你的法术伤害提高20%，持续20秒。

虚空形态下，虚空齐射将取代此法术，最多可使用3次。

 虚空齐射
释放一股纯粹虚空能量汇集的齐射，向你的目标发射10发飞弹，并向你目标10码范围内所有敌人额外发射1发飞弹，每发造成362点暗影伤害。

产生10点狂乱值。

options.description_en:
Shadowy Apparition damage increased by 10%.

When Shadowy Apparitions deal damage, they extend the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
暗影幻灵的伤害提高10%。

暗影幻灵造成伤害时，你对目标施加的暗言术：痛与吸血鬼之触的持续时间延长1.0秒。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of Mind Flay by 25%.
options.description_zh: 精神鞭笞的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: Halo now centers around you and returns to you after it reaches its maximum distance, healing allies and damaging enemies each time it passes through them.
options.description_zh: 光晕现在以你为中点，达到最大距离后会返回你的位置，每次穿越都会对盟友进行治疗，对敌人造成伤害。

options.description_en:
Shadow Word: Death has a 40% chance to summon a Shadowfiend for 5 sec when damaging targets below 20% health.

 Shadowfiend
Summons a Shadowfiend to attack your target for 5 sec.

Generates 0.5% mana each time the Shadowfiend attacks.
options.description_zh:
暗言术：灭对生命值低于20%的目标造成伤害时有40%的几率召唤一个暗影魔，持续5秒。

暗影魔
召唤一个暗影魔攻击目标，持续5秒。

暗影魔每次攻击产生0.5%的法力值。

options.description_en: Increases the chance for Shadowy Insight to occur by 25%. When consuming Shadowy Insight, Mind Blast generates 1 additional Insanity.
options.description_zh: 暗影洞察的触发几率提高25%。消耗暗影洞察时，心灵震爆会额外产生1点狂乱值。

options.description_en: Vampiric Touch deals 20% additional damage and has a chance to generate 1 Insanity each time it deals damage.
options.description_zh: 吸血鬼之触造成的伤害提高20%，并且每次造成伤害都有几率产生1点狂乱值。

nodes.name_zh: 强化虚空形态 / 远古疯狂

options.description_en: Voidform increases your spell damage by an additonal 5% and grants 2 additional uses of Void Volley.
options.description_zh: 虚空形态使你的法术伤害额外提高5%，并赋予虚空齐射2次额外使用次数。

options.description_en:
Shadow Word: Madness increases your haste during Voidform by 2% and increases its duration by 1.5 sec, stacking up to 5 times. 

When Voidform ends, the haste lingers and decays over 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
暗言术：癫使你在虚空形态下的急速提高2%，持续时间延长1.5秒，最多可叠加5层。

虚空形态结束时，急速效果会逐渐消退，在10秒内衰减。

options.description_en:
Shadowy Apparitions that float towards your primary target explode, dealing 532 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
暗影幻灵飘向你的主要目标后爆炸，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成532点暗影伤害。

超过5个目标后伤害递减。

options.description_en: Increases your periodic spell damage by 6%.
options.description_zh: 你的周期性法术伤害提高6%。

options.description_en:
Mind Flay damage increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast by 8%, stacking up to 12 times.

Lasts 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
精神鞭笞造成伤害时使你的心灵震爆的爆击几率提高8%，最多叠加12次。

持续10秒。

nodes.name_zh: 无路可逃 / 黑暗能量

options.description_en: Entropic Rift slows enemies by up to 70%, increased the closer they are to its center.
options.description_zh: 熵能裂隙使敌人最多减速70%，距离中心越近减速效果越高。

options.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, you move 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，你的移动速度加快20%。

options.description_en:
Entropic Rift upgrades Smite into Void Blast while it is active.

Void Blast:
Sends a blast of cosmic void energy at the enemy, causing 569 Shadow damage.
options.description_zh:
熵能裂隙激活时将惩击升级为虚空冲击。

虚空冲击：
向敌人射出一股宇宙虚空能量，造成578点暗影伤害。

options.description_en: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 真言术：盾的吸收量提高20%。

options.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, your Atonement healing is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，你的救赎的治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Summoned minions last 20% longer and deal an additional 15% damage.
options.description_zh: 召唤的爪牙持续时间额外延长20%，造成的伤害额外提高15%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast, Mind Flay, and Shadow Word: Death by 4% and increases their critical strike damage by 20%.
options.description_zh: 心灵震爆、精神鞭笞和暗言术：灭的爆击率提高4%，爆击伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast, Mind Flay, and Shadow Word: Death by 8% and increases their critical strike damage by 40%.
options.description_zh: 心灵震爆、精神鞭笞和暗言术：灭的爆击率提高8%，爆击伤害提高40%。

nodes.name_zh: 心灵之眼 / 扭曲现实

options.description_en: Reduces the Insanity cost of Shadow Word: Madness by 5.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：癫的狂乱值消耗降低5点。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Madness by 20% and causes it to deal its damage over 12 sec, but increases its Insanity cost by 5.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：癫的伤害提高20%，并使其在12秒内造成伤害，但消耗的狂乱值提高5点。

options.description_en: Shadow Apparitions deal 30% increased damage to targets affected by your Shadow Word: Madness.
options.description_zh: 暗影幻灵对受你的暗言术：癫影响的目标造成的伤害提高30%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and their critical strike damage by 20%.
options.description_zh: 吸血鬼之触和暗言术：痛的爆击率提高8%，爆击伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain by 15% and their critical strike damage by 40%.
options.description_zh: 吸血鬼之触和暗言术：痛的爆击率提高15%，爆击伤害提高40%。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Death consumes absorb shields from your target, dealing 968 extra damage to them and granting you 1% mana if a shield was present.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：灭吞噬目标的吸收护盾，有护盾存在时对其造成最多964点额外伤害，并使你获得1%的法力值。

nodes.name_zh: 虚空增效 / 黑化视界

options.description_en: Summoning an Entropic Rift extends the duration of your 5 shortest Atonements by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤一道熵能裂隙，使你持续时间最短的5个救赎效果延长1秒。

options.description_en: Void Blast increases the duration of Entropic Rift by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 虚空冲击使熵能裂隙的持续时间延长1.0秒，最多3秒。

options.description_en:
When Entropic Rift ends, a Voidwraith is summoned from the collapsed rift for 5 sec.

Voidwraith
Summon a Voidwraith that casts Void Flay from afar. Void Flay deals bonus damage to high health enemies, up to a maximum of 50% if they are full health.

Generates 0.5% Mana each time the Voidwraith attacks.
options.description_zh:
熵能裂隙结束时，从坍缩的裂隙召唤一个虚空幽灵，持续5秒。

虚空幽灵
召唤一个虚空幽灵，从远处施放虚空鞭笞。虚空鞭笞对生命值较高的敌人造成额外伤害，最多对满血的敌人造成50%的额外伤害。

虚空幽灵每次攻击产生0.5%的法力值。

options.description_en: Voidheart now persists for 8 sec after Entropic Rift ends.
options.description_zh: 虚空之心现在会在熵能裂隙结束后持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Casting Voidform summons a Mindbender for 10 sec.

 Mindbender
Summons a shadowy fiend to attack your target.

Generates 1 Insanity each time the Mindbender attacks.
options.description_zh:
施放虚空形态会召唤一个摧心魔，持续10秒。

 摧心魔
召唤一个暗影魔攻击你的目标。

摧心魔每次攻击产生1点狂乱值。

options.description_en:
Shadow Word: Death damage increased by 25%.

Shadow Word: Death gains its damage and talent bonuses against targets below 35% health instead of 20%.
options.description_zh:
暗言术：灭的伤害提高25%。

暗言术：灭在目标生命值低于35%时获得伤害和天赋加成，不再是20%。

options.description_en:
If a target dies within 7 sec after being struck by Shadow Word: Death, generate 8 Insanity.

When Shadow Word: Death fails to kill a target below 20% health, its cooldown is reset. Cannot occur more than once every 10 sec.
options.description_zh:
如果目标在受到你的暗言术：灭影响后的7秒内被消灭，你会获得8点狂乱值。

如果暗言术：灭没能消灭生命值低于20%的目标，重置其冷却时间。每10秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Mind Blast has a 8% chance to make your next Shadow Word: Madness cost no Insanity and deal 20% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 心灵震爆有8%的几率使你的下一个暗言术：癫不消耗狂乱值，并额外造成20%的伤害。

options.description_en: Your Shadowy Apparitions deal 15% increased damage and have a chance to generate 1 Insanity.
options.description_zh: 你的暗影幻灵的伤害提高15%，并有几率产生1点狂乱值。

options.description_en: Tentacle Slam afflicts your target with Shadow Word: Madness at 25% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 触须猛击会以25%的效果对目标施加暗言术：癫。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain and Entropic Rift deal damage 25% more often.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：痛和熵能裂隙的伤害频率提高25%。

options.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, Atonement healing with Void Blast and Penance is 75% more effective.
options.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，虚空冲击和苦修产生的救赎治疗效果提高75%。

nodes.name_zh: 虚空抽取 / 怀抱暗影

options.description_en: Every 3 sec siphon an amount equal to 4% of your health from an ally within 40 yds if they are higher health than you.
options.description_zh: 如果40码内有盟友的生命值高于你，每3秒吸取其相当于你生命值的4%的生命值。

options.description_en: You absorb 3% of all magic damage taken. Absorbing Shadow damage heals you for 100% of the amount absorbed.
options.description_zh: 吸收你受到的所有魔法伤害的3%。吸收暗影伤害会为你恢复生命值，治疗量相当于吸收量的100%。

options.description_en: Mind Blast deals 100% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 心灵震爆造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death cause your Shadowfiend, Mindbender, and Voidwraith to teleport behind your target, slashing up to 5 nearby enemies for 319 Shadow damage and extending their durations by 0.7 sec.
options.description_zh: 心灵震爆和暗言术：灭会使你的暗影魔、摧心魔和虚空幽灵传送至目标身后，对附近至多5名敌人发动斩击，造成319点暗影伤害，并使它们的持续时间延长0.7秒。

options.description_en: The damage bonus from your Mastery: Shadow Weaving gains 25% additional benefit from Shadow Word: Madness.
options.description_zh: 你的精通：暗影交织的伤害加成会从暗言术：癫中额外获得25%的加成。

options.description_en: The damage bonus from your Mastery: Shadow Weaving gains 50% additional benefit from Shadow Word: Madness.
options.description_zh: 你的精通：暗影交织的伤害加成会从暗言术：癫中额外获得50%的加成。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Death deals damage 2 additional times at 15% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：灭会额外造成2次伤害，每次伤害相当于原来的15%。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Madness causes your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch to deal damage 40% faster on all targets for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：癫使你的暗言术：痛和吸血鬼之触对所有目标造成伤害的速度提高40%，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Madness causes your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch to deal damage 80% faster on all targets for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：癫使你的暗言术：痛和吸血鬼之触对所有目标造成伤害的速度提高80%，持续3秒。

options.description_en:
Your Shadow Word: Pain damage has a chance to create Shadowy Apparitions that float towards all targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch. 

Critical strikes increase the chance by 100%.
options.description_zh:
你的暗言术：痛有几率产生暗影幻灵，向所有被你的吸血鬼之触影响的目标飘去。

爆击会使几率提高100%。

options.description_en: While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Shadow Word: Madness, and Vampiric Touch active on the same target, your Mind Blast, Void Torrent, Mind Flay, and Void Volley deal 13% more damage.
options.description_zh: 当暗言术：痛、暗言术：癫和吸血鬼之触同时作用于同一个目标时，你的心灵震爆、虚空洪流、精神鞭笞和虚空齐射会额外造成13%的伤害。

options.description_en: While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Shadow Word: Madness, and Vampiric Touch active on the same target, your Mind Blast, Void Torrent, Mind Flay, and Void Volley deal 25% more damage.
options.description_zh: 当暗言术：痛、暗言术：癫和吸血鬼之触同时作用于同一个目标时，你的心灵震爆、虚空洪流、精神鞭笞和虚空齐射会额外造成25%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Tentacle Slam deals 50% increased damage and Void Volley deals 15% increased damage.

When Voidform ends, you can cast Void Volley 1 additional time within 30 sec.
options.description_zh:
触须猛击的伤害提高50%，虚空齐射的伤害提高15%。

虚空形态解除后，你在30秒内可以额外施放1次虚空齐射。

options.description_en:
Each time Penance damages or heals, Entropic Rift is empowered, increasing its damage and size by 10%.

After Entropic Rift ends it collapses, dealing 1,672 Shadow damage split amongst enemy targets within 15 yds.
options.description_zh:
每当苦修造成伤害或治疗都会强化熵能裂隙，使其造成的伤害和尺寸提高10%。

熵能裂隙结束后会塌缩，造成1,672点暗影伤害，由15码内的所有敌方目标均摊。

options.description_en: While Shadowfiend, Mindbender, or Voidwraith are active, your haste is increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 暗影魔、摧心魔或虚空幽灵激活时，你的急速提高10%。

options.description_en:
You create Horrific Visions when casting harmful spells on enemies.

At 50 stacks of Horrific Visions, your target sees a nightmare, dealing 691 Shadow damage and granting you 2 Insanity over 3 sec.

At 100 stacks, your target witnesses a vision of N'Zoth, dealing 2,618 Shadow damage and granting you 6 Insanity over 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
你对敌人施放有害法术时创造惊魂幻象。

惊魂幻象达到50层时，你的目标会看到噩梦，受到691点暗影伤害，并在3秒内为你产生2点狂乱值。

达到100层时，你的目标会见证恩佐斯的幻象，受到2,618点暗影伤害，并在3秒内为你产生6点狂乱值。

options.description_en:
After conjuring Shadowy Apparitions, gain a stack of Idol of Yogg-Saron. At 20 stacks, you summon a Thing from Beyond that casts Void Spike at nearby enemies for 20 sec.

 Void Spike
Hurls a bolt of dark magic, dealing 358 Shadow damage and 187 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
在生成暗影幻灵后获得一层尤格-萨隆的神像。叠加至20层后，你会召唤一个彼岸之物，对附近的敌人施放虚空之刺，持续20秒。

 虚空之刺
向目标射出一支黑暗魔法箭，造成351点暗影伤害，并对该目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成193点暗影伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Mind Flay has a chance to spawn a Void Tendril that channels Mind Flay or Void Lasher that channels Mind Sear at your target.

 Mind Flay
Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 1,202 Shadow damage over 10 sec and slowing their movement speed by 30%.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.

 Mind Sear
Corrosive shadow energy radiates from the target, dealing 828 Shadow damage over 10 sec to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.
options.description_zh:
精神鞭笞有几率召唤一个虚空触须，对你的目标引导精神鞭笞；或是召唤一个虚空鞭笞者，对你的目标引导精神灼烧。

精神鞭笞
用暗影能量攻击目标的精神，在10秒内造成1,217点暗影伤害，并使移动速度降低30%。

持续期间产生5点狂乱值。

 精神灼烧
从目标身上散发出腐蚀暗影能量，在10秒内对其周围10范围内的所有敌人造成828点暗影伤害。目标数量超过5个时，造成的伤害降低。

在持续期间产生5点狂乱值。

options.description_en: When an effect from an Idol is activated, conjure Shadowy Apparitions.
options.description_zh: 神像的效果激活时，召唤暗影幻灵。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Death consumes absorb shields from your target, dealing 979 extra damage to them and granting you 1% mana if a shield was present.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：灭吞噬目标的吸收护盾，有护盾存在时对其造成最多950点额外伤害，并使你获得1%的法力值。

options.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, Atonement healing with Void Blast and Penance is 75% more effective.
options.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，虚空冲击和苦修产生的救赎治疗效果提高75%。

options.description_en: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 真言术：盾的吸收量提高20%。

options.description_en:
Channel a torrent of void energy into the target, dealing 3,970 Shadow damage over 3 sec and tearing open an Entropic Rift.

 Entropic Rift
Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 231 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.

Generates 24 Insanity over the duration.
options.description_zh:
对目标引导一股虚空能量流，在3秒内造成3,945点暗影伤害，并撕开一道熵能裂隙。

 熵能裂隙
心灵震爆撕开一道追踪敌人的熵能裂隙，持续8秒。位于路径中的敌人处于范围内时，每0.9秒受到228点暗影伤害。

持续过程中产生24点狂乱值。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Pain and Entropic Rift deal damage 25% more often.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：痛和熵能裂隙的伤害频率提高25%。

熵能裂隙结束后会塌缩，造成1,672点暗影伤害，由15码内的所有敌方目标均摊。

nodes.name_zh: 虚空增效 / 黑化视界

options.description_en: Summoning an Entropic Rift extends the duration of your 5 shortest Atonements by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤一道熵能裂隙，使你持续时间最短的5个救赎效果延长1秒。

options.description_en: Void Blast increases the duration of Entropic Rift by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 虚空冲击使熵能裂隙的持续时间延长1.0秒，最多3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 虚空抽取 / 怀抱暗影

options.description_en: Every 3 sec siphon an amount equal to 4% of your health from an ally within 40 yds if they are higher health than you.
options.description_zh: 如果40码内有盟友的生命值高于你，每3秒吸取其相当于你生命值的4%的生命值。

options.description_en: You absorb 3% of all magic damage taken. Absorbing Shadow damage heals you for 100% of the amount absorbed.
options.description_zh: 吸收你受到的所有魔法伤害的3%。吸收暗影伤害会为你恢复生命值，治疗量相当于吸收量的100%。

options.description_en:
Entropic Rift upgrades Smite into Void Blast while it is active.

Void Blast:
Sends a blast of cosmic void energy at the enemy, causing 565 Shadow damage.
options.description_zh:
熵能裂隙激活时将惩击升级为虚空冲击。

虚空冲击：
向敌人射出一股宇宙虚空能量，造成581点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
When Entropic Rift ends, a Voidwraith is summoned from the collapsed rift for 5 sec.

Voidwraith
Summon a Voidwraith that casts Void Flay from afar. Void Flay deals bonus damage to high health enemies, up to a maximum of 50% if they are full health.

Generates 0.5% Mana each time the Voidwraith attacks.
options.description_zh:
熵能裂隙结束时，从坍缩的裂隙召唤一个虚空幽灵，持续5秒。

虚空幽灵
召唤一个虚空幽灵，从远处施放虚空鞭笞。虚空鞭笞对生命值较高的敌人造成额外伤害，最多对满血的敌人造成50%的额外伤害。

虚空幽灵每次攻击产生0.5%的法力值。

options.description_en: Mind Blast deals 100% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 心灵震爆造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Voidheart now persists for 8 sec after Entropic Rift ends.
options.description_zh: 虚空之心现在会在熵能裂隙结束后持续8秒。

options.description_en: While Entropic Rift is active, your Atonement healing is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 熵能裂隙激活时，你的救赎的治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 232 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.
options.description_zh: 心灵震爆撕开一道追踪敌人的熵能裂隙，持续8秒。位于路径中的敌人处于范围内时，每0.9秒受到226点暗影伤害。

options.description_en: Creating a Halo increases your healing done by 2% for 10 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
options.description_zh: 制造光晕使你的治疗效果提高2%，持续10秒，最多叠加4层。

options.description_en: Your damage dealt is increased by 5% while Voidform is active.
options.description_zh: 在虚空形态激活时，你造成的伤害提高5%。

nodes.name_zh: 能量压缩 / 持续效能

options.description_en: Halo damage and healing is increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 光晕的伤害和治疗效果提高30%。

options.description_en:
Creating a Halo extends the duration of Voidform by 1 sec. If Voidform is not active, up to 6 seconds is stored.

While out of combat or affected by a loss of control effect, the duration of Voidform is paused for up to 20 sec.
options.description_zh:
创造一个光晕会使虚空形态的持续时间延长1秒。如果虚空形态未激活，最多可存储6秒。

未进入战斗或受到失控效果影响时，虚空形态的持续时间可暂停最多20秒。

options.description_en: Power Surge lasts an additional 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 能量涌动的持续时间延长5秒。

options.description_en: Casting Halo also causes you to create a Halo around you at 100% effectiveness every 5 sec for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放光晕时，还会在你周围每5秒以100%的效果制造一个光晕，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Casting Mind Flay: Insanity has a 100% chance to conjure Shadowy Apparitions.
options.description_zh: 施放精神鞭笞：狂有100%的几率召唤暗影幻灵。

nodes.name_zh: 振荡脉冲 / 无尽尖叫

options.description_en: Halo damage reduces enemy movement speed by 5% for 5 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
options.description_zh: 光晕的伤害使敌人的移动速度降低5%，持续5秒，最多叠加5层。

options.description_en: Psychic Scream creates an image of you at your location. After 4 sec, the image will let out a Psychic Scream.
options.description_zh: 心灵尖啸在你的位置创造一个你的幻象。4秒后幻象将释放一次心灵尖啸。

options.description_en: Your spells affected by Surge of Light heal for 5% more while Surge of Light is active.
options.description_zh: 圣光涌动激活期间，你受其影响的法术治疗效果额外提高5%。

options.description_en: Creates a ring of Shadow energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 602 and dealing 546 Shadow damage to enemies. Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.
options.description_zh: 在你周围制造一个暗影能量之环，迅速扩散到半径40码的范围，为盟友恢复最多607点生命，并对敌人造成542点暗影伤害。目标数量超过6个后造成的治疗量降低。

options.description_en:
Creating a Halo grants Surge of Light.

 Surge of Light
Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal or Shadow Mend instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.
options.description_zh:
制造一个光晕会赋予你圣光涌动。

 圣光涌动
你的治疗法术和惩击有8%的几率使你的下一个快速治疗或暗影愈合变为瞬发，且消耗的法力值降低50%。最多可叠加2层。

options.description_en: Halo now centers around you and returns to you after it reaches its maximum distance, healing allies and damaging enemies each time it passes through them.
options.description_zh: 光晕现在以你为中点，达到最大距离后会返回你的位置，每次穿越都会对盟友进行治疗，对敌人造成伤害。

options.description_en:
Creates a ring of Holy energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 605 and dealing 540 Holy damage to enemies.

Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.
options.description_zh:
在你周围制造一个神圣能量之环，迅速扩散到半径40码的范围，为盟友恢复最多625点生命，并对敌人造成541点神圣伤害。

目标数量超过6个后造成的治疗量降低。

options.description_en: Shadow Word: Death damage increased by 25% and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 暗言术：灭的伤害提高25%，其冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Increases Shadowy Apparition damage by 10%.
options.description_zh: 暗影幻灵的伤害提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 至高真言 / 强效升变

options.description_en: Power Word: Fortitude grants you an additional 5% stamina.
options.description_zh: 真言术：韧使你获得额外5%的耐力。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Dispersion by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 消散的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Void Volley deals 5% increased damage and Shadow Word: Madness casts during Voidform unleash a Void Volley at your target at 25% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 虚空齐射的伤害提高5%，且在虚空形态下施放暗言术：癫时，会向你的目标发射一次效果为25%的虚空齐射。

options.description_en:
Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

Awards 1 combo point.
options.description_zh:
使用你的副手进行攻击，造成2点物理伤害，驱散所有激怒效果，并对目标施放浓缩形态的激活的非致命药膏。

奖励1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 使目标失明并迷惑地乱转，持续1分钟。任何伤害都可能打断此效果。只能对一个目标使用。

options.description_en: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 提供短暂的魔法免疫，并立即移除所有的有害法术效果。斗篷激活期间，抵抗所有有害法术效果，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.
options.description_zh: 毒刃的能量消耗降低20点，冷却时间缩短15秒，射程增加3码。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 移动速度提高15%。

options.description_en:
Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Must be in front of your target.

Awards 1 combo point.
options.description_zh:
凿击敌方目标，令其瘫痪4秒。伤害可能打断此效果。

只能在目标的前方施放。

奖励1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 致盲的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短70%，并会对周围的所有敌人生效。

options.description_en: Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 暗影步可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 潜行或暗影之舞激活时，你的移动速度提高20%。

options.description_en: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.
options.description_zh: 武器药膏的非伤害性效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
options.description_zh: 闪避还会使受到的伤害降低20%。佯攻还会使受到的非范围类伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Fatal attacks instead reduce you to 7% of your maximum health. For 3 sec afterward, you take 85% reduced damage. Cannot trigger more often than once per 6 min.
options.description_zh: 原本致命的攻击转而使你的生命值降到最大生命值的7%。之后的3秒内，你受到的伤害降低85%。该效果每6分钟只能触发一次。

nodes.name_zh: 嫁祸诀窍 / 劈头棒击

options.description_en: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 从30秒内的下一次伤害性攻击开始，将你产生的所有威胁值转移给选中的小队或团队成员，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.
options.description_zh: 在致盲或闷棍效果结束后的6秒内，敌人的伤害和治疗效果降低30%。

options.description_en: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.
options.description_zh: 现在致伤药膏可以额外叠加2次。

options.description_en: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.
options.description_zh: 佯攻和猩红之瓶的能量消耗降低10点。

options.description_en: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 受到的物理伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Increases your Agility by 3%.
options.description_zh: 敏捷提高3%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 使疾跑的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 减速药膏使移动速度额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 躲闪几率提高100%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.
options.description_zh: 你从猩红之瓶、治疗药水和治疗石获得的治疗效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的武器药膏的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.
options.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕的冷却时间缩短50%。

options.description_en: Feint has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 佯攻可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.
options.description_zh: 疾跑使移动速度额外提高30%，持续时间延长4秒。

nodes.name_zh: 迟钝药膏 / 萎缩药膏

options.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给一件武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其反应迟钝，攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.0% for 1 min.
options.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给你的武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其造成的伤害降低4.0%，持续1分钟。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.
options.description_zh: 使你产生连击点数的攻击的爆击几率提高5%。

options.description_en: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.
options.description_zh: 当你对可获得经验值或荣誉的目标造成致命一击时，猩红之瓶的冷却时间缩短15秒，且下一次使用时立即恢复5%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高6%。

options.description_en: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.
options.description_zh: 减速效果的持续时间缩短30%。

options.description_en: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你有20%的几率部分闪避任何对你造成的伤害，使其造成的伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.
options.description_zh: 切割使攻击速度额外提高，数值相当于你的急速的100%。

nodes.name_zh: 强化伏击 / 精打细算

options.description_en: Ambush generates 1 additional combo point.
options.description_zh: 伏击额外产生1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.
options.description_zh: 终结技的能量消耗降低6%。

options.description_en: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.0% Leech.
options.description_zh: 为你的致命药膏添加吸血效果，使你的吸血提高3.0%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 2%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 切割激活时，每3秒为你恢复最多1%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 1.5%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高1.5%。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 3.0%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高3.0%。

options.description_en: You are healed for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.
options.description_zh: 消失激活后的6秒内，你恢复最大生命值的30%。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.
options.description_zh: 使你的能量值上限提高50点，能量回复加快5%。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 100 and Energy regeneration by 10%.
options.description_zh: 使你的能量值上限提高100点，能量回复加快10%。

options.description_en:
Kingsbane supercharges 1 combo point.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
options.description_zh:
君王之灾会使1个连击点数被超荷充能。

当伤害性终结技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，你可以造成相当于额外消耗2个连击点数的效果。

options.description_en:
Kingsbane supercharges 2 combo points.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
options.description_zh:
君王之灾会使2个连击点数被超荷充能。

当伤害性终结技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，你可以造成相当于额外消耗2个连击点数的效果。

options.description_en:
Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 3 sec after Stealth breaks.

Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 3 sec after Stealth breaks.
options.description_zh:
脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的技能仍可继续使用。

脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的战斗增益仍可保留。

options.description_en:
Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 6 sec after Stealth breaks.

Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 6 sec after Stealth breaks.
options.description_zh:
脱离潜行状态后的6秒内，原本需要潜行的技能仍可继续使用。

脱离潜行状态后的6秒内，原本需要潜行的战斗增益仍可保留。

options.description_en:
Restore 100 Energy.

When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.
options.description_zh:
恢复100点能量。

当能量低于30点时，喝下一杯蓟叶茶。

options.description_en: Restore 100 Energy.
options.description_zh: 恢复100点能量。

options.description_en: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.
options.description_zh: 产生连击点的攻击爆击时，会使你下一个终结技的爆击几率提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 申斥回响 / 强制增压

options.description_en: After consuming a supercharged combo point, your next Mutilate also strikes the target with an Echoing Reprimand dealing 42 Physical damage.
options.description_zh: 消耗一个超荷充能的连击点数之后，你的下一个毁伤还会用申斥回响打击目标，造成41点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.
options.description_zh: 伤害性终极技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，其加成额外提高1。

options.description_en:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
options.description_zh:
连击点数的上限额外提高1点。

消耗5点连击点数以上的终结技产生的效果得以加强，并且终结技造成的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Vanish has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 消失可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en:
Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 59 Cosmic damage to your target.

For each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.
options.description_zh:
每当一个终结技消耗5个或更多连击点数时，掷出一枚命运硬币。正面会使你的攻击伤害提高10%，持续15秒，或直到你掷出反面为止。反面会对被击中的目标造成59点宇宙伤害。

每次你掷出命运硬币的结果与上一次相同时，正面使造成的伤害额外提高2%，反面造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Garrote applies 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to your target, unless Deathstalker's Mark is already active. You learn Mark for Death.

When you spend 5 or more combo points on attacks against a Marked target you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, dealing 54 Plague damage.


Mark for Death
Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.
options.description_zh:
锁喉会对目标施加3层死亡猎手标记，除非死亡猎手标记已生效。你学会死亡印记。

当你对被标记的目标使用消耗至少5个连击点数的攻击时，你会消耗一层死亡猎手标记，造成54点瘟疫伤害。


死亡印记
将你当前的死亡猎手标记移至目标身上。

options.description_en: Nothing will save your target from you. Envenom damage increased by 10%. Envenom restores 2 Energy per combo point spent.
options.description_zh: 你的目标难逃一死。毒伤伤害提高10%。毒伤每消耗一个连击点数恢复2点能量。

options.description_en: Mutilate, Ambush, and Fan of Knives have a 60% chance to generate 1 additional combo point when they trigger Seal Fate.
options.description_zh: 毁伤、伏击和刀扇有60%的几率产生1个额外的连击点数（在它们触发封印命运时）。

nodes.name_zh: 金袋满盈 / 命数已定

options.description_en: Envenom has a 15% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.
options.description_zh: 毒伤有15%的几率掷出3个命运硬币。

options.description_en: Sinister Strike has 5% increased chance to strike an additional time and grant Opportunity and your Fatebound Coins flipped have an additional 5% chance to match the same face as the last flip.
options.description_zh: 影袭进行额外攻击的几率提高5%，触发可乘之机，并且你在掷出命运硬币时有额外5%的几率与上一次掷出的结果相同。

options.description_en: Envenom deals 5% more damage when it consumes 5 or more combo points.
options.description_zh: 毒伤消耗不低于5点连击点数时，其伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Activating Deathmark flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.
options.description_zh: 激活死亡印记会掷出一枚命运硬币并使其竖立，结果同时算作正面和反面。

options.description_en: Fatebound Coins flipped by Envenom are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.
options.description_zh: 通过毒伤掷出的命运硬币有33%更高的几率得到和上一次掷出命运硬币时获得相同的结果。

options.description_en:
Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 58 Cosmic damage to your target.

For each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.
options.description_zh:
每当一个终结技消耗5个或更多连击点数时，掷出一枚命运硬币。正面会使你的攻击伤害提高10%，持续15秒，或直到你掷出反面为止。反面会对被击中的目标造成58点宇宙伤害。

每次你掷出命运硬币的结果与上一次相同时，正面使造成的伤害额外提高2%，反面造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

Coin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.
options.description_zh:
每投掷7次硬币，就会保留一枚幸运硬币，使你趋向命运，持续12秒。你的敏捷提高4%，命运硬币的伤害和加成效果提高50%，并且硬币投掷结果与上一次相同的几率提高15%。

当你拥有一枚幸运硬币时，投掷硬币不计入寻找幸运硬币的次数。

options.description_en: Gain 5 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 15 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.
options.description_zh: 每次掷出命运硬币时，获得5点能量。硬币立在边缘时，获得15点能量。

nodes.name_zh: 命不可违 / 绝命降临

options.description_en: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal movement speed while your Fatebound Coin flips have an active streak of at least 2 flips matching the same face.
options.description_zh: 当你的命运硬币连续掷出至少2次并且结果相同时，你的移动速度不会低于正常速度的70%。

options.description_en: Grappling Hook may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 抓钩可以在3秒内再次使用一次，没有冷却时间，但总的冷却时间延长5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 天选者盛宴 / 挑战命运

options.description_en: Flipping a Fatebound Coin restores 10 health.
options.description_zh: 掷出一个命运硬币时恢复10点生命值。

options.description_en: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.
options.description_zh: 你有30%的几率吸收任意所受伤害的10%

options.description_en: Caustic Spatter causes an additional 5% of Nature damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.
options.description_zh: 腐蚀飞溅向已受影响的敌人额外施加5%的自然伤害。

options.description_en: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.
options.description_zh: 抛出正面使伤害额外提高4%。抛出反面造成的伤害提高12%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高3%。

options.description_en: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.
options.description_zh: 在连续抛出4次或更多次相同结果的命运硬币后，下一次抛出的硬币结果将与之相同。

nodes.name_zh: 虚渺斗篷 / 诱导转向

options.description_en: Cloak of Shadows duration increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 暗影斗篷的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en:
Evasion reduces magical damage taken by 15%. 

Cloak of Shadows reduces physical damage taken by 20%.
options.description_zh:
闪避使受到的魔法伤害降低15%。

暗影斗篷使受到的物理伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Rupture damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 割裂的伤害提高20%。

nodes.name_zh: 徘徊黑暗 / 致胜符记

options.description_en: After Deathmark expires, gain 30% increased Nature damage for 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 死亡印记效果结束后，造成的自然伤害提高30%，持续30秒。

options.description_en: Shadow Dance additionally increases the damage of your next Eviscerate or Black Powder by 15%.
options.description_zh: 暗影之舞还会使你的下一个刺骨或黑火药的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Fan of Knives damage increased by 60%.
options.description_zh: 刀扇的伤害提高60%。

options.description_en: Damage dealt to targets other than your Marked target deals 5% Plague damage to your Marked target.
options.description_zh: 对非标记目标造成的伤害也会对被标记的目标造成5%的瘟疫伤害。

options.description_en: Each time you consume a stack of Deathstalker's Mark, reduce the cooldown of Shadowstep by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当你消耗一层死亡猎手标记，使暗影步的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Shroud of Concealment duration increased by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕的持续时间延长5秒。

nodes.name_en: Momentum of Despair / Follow the Blood
nodes.name_zh: 绝望追击 / 觅血寻踪

options.description_en: If you have critically struck with Fan of Knives, increase the critical strike chance of Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest by 10% and critical strike damage by 20% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 如果你的刀扇造成爆击，使你的刀扇和猩红风暴的爆击几率提高10%，爆击伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest deal 30% additional damage while 2 or more enemies are afflicted with Rupture.
options.description_zh: 当至少有2名敌人受到割裂影响时，刀扇和猩红风暴额外造成30%的伤害。

options.description_en: Auto-attacks against Marked targets deal an additional 3 Plague damage.
options.description_zh: 自动攻击对被标记的目标额外造成3点瘟疫伤害。

options.description_en: When you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, the damage of your next Ambush or Mutilate is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh: 当你消耗一层死亡猎手标记时，你的下一个伏击或毁伤的伤害提高50%。

options.description_en:
Garrote applies 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to your target, unless Deathstalker's Mark is already active. You learn Mark for Death.

When you spend 5 or more combo points on attacks against a Marked target you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, dealing 54 Plague damage.


Mark for Death
Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.
options.description_zh:
锁喉会对目标施加3层死亡猎手标记，除非死亡猎手标记已生效。你学会死亡印记。

当你对被标记的目标使用消耗至少5个连击点数的攻击时，你会消耗一层死亡猎手标记，造成54点瘟疫伤害。


死亡印记
将你当前的死亡猎手标记移至目标身上。

options.description_en:
When you consume the final Deathstalker's Mark from a target or your target dies, gain 30 Energy and Darkest Night, causing your next Envenom cast with 5 or more combo points to critically strike, deal 35% additional damage, and apply 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to the target if no other Deathstalker's Mark is active.

Envenom cast with Darkest Night does not consume a stack of active Deathstalker's Marks.
options.description_zh:
当你消耗目标身上的最后一层死亡猎手标记，或目标死亡时，获得30点能量和至黑之夜，使你的下一个以5个或更多连击点数施放的毒伤必定爆击，造成的伤害提高35%，并且在目标身上没有其它死亡猎手标记激活时，对其施加3层死亡猎手标记。

在至黑之夜下施放的毒伤不会消耗已激活的死亡猎手标记层数。

options.description_en: Deathstalker's Mark deals 40% of its normal damage to all other enemies within 8 yds that are afflicted by Rupture.
options.description_zh: 死亡猎手标记对8码内的所有其他受到割裂影响的敌人造成其正常伤害的40%。

options.description_en: Deathstalker's Mark has a 30% chance to immediately consume a stack when applied.
options.description_zh: 施加死亡猎手标记时有30%的几率立即消耗一层效果。

options.description_en: Critical strike damage bonus increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆击伤害加成提高20%。

options.description_en:
Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

Awards 1 combo point.
options.description_zh:
使用你的副手进行攻击，造成2点物理伤害，驱散所有激怒效果，并对目标施放浓缩形态的激活的非致命药膏。

奖励1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 使目标失明并迷惑地乱转，持续1分钟。任何伤害都可能打断此效果。只能对一个目标使用。

options.description_en: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 提供短暂的魔法免疫，并立即移除所有的有害法术效果。斗篷激活期间，抵抗所有有害法术效果，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.
options.description_zh: 毒刃的能量消耗降低20点，冷却时间缩短15秒，射程增加3码。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 移动速度提高15%。

options.description_en:
Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Must be in front of your target.

Awards 1 combo point.
options.description_zh:
凿击敌方目标，令其瘫痪4秒。伤害可能打断此效果。

只能在目标的前方施放。

奖励1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 致盲的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短70%，并会对周围的所有敌人生效。

options.description_en: Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 暗影步可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 潜行或暗影之舞激活时，你的移动速度提高20%。

options.description_en: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.
options.description_zh: 武器药膏的非伤害性效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
options.description_zh: 闪避还会使受到的伤害降低20%。佯攻还会使受到的非范围类伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Fatal attacks instead reduce you to 7% of your maximum health. For 3 sec afterward, you take 85% reduced damage. Cannot trigger more often than once per 6 min.
options.description_zh: 原本致命的攻击转而使你的生命值降到最大生命值的7%。之后的3秒内，你受到的伤害降低85%。该效果每6分钟只能触发一次。

nodes.name_zh: 嫁祸诀窍 / 劈头棒击

options.description_en: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 从30秒内的下一次伤害性攻击开始，将你产生的所有威胁值转移给选中的小队或团队成员，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.
options.description_zh: 在致盲或闷棍效果结束后的6秒内，敌人的伤害和治疗效果降低30%。

options.description_en: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.
options.description_zh: 现在致伤药膏可以额外叠加2次。

options.description_en: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.
options.description_zh: 佯攻和猩红之瓶的能量消耗降低10点。

options.description_en: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 受到的物理伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Increases your Agility by 3%.
options.description_zh: 敏捷提高3%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 使疾跑的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 减速药膏使移动速度额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 躲闪几率提高100%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.
options.description_zh: 你从猩红之瓶、治疗药水和治疗石获得的治疗效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的武器药膏的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.
options.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕的冷却时间缩短50%。

options.description_en: Feint has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 佯攻可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.
options.description_zh: 疾跑使移动速度额外提高30%，持续时间延长4秒。

nodes.name_zh: 迟钝药膏 / 萎缩药膏

options.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给一件武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其反应迟钝，攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.0% for 1 min.
options.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给你的武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其造成的伤害降低4.0%，持续1分钟。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.
options.description_zh: 使你产生连击点数的攻击的爆击几率提高5%。

options.description_en: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.
options.description_zh: 当你对可获得经验值或荣誉的目标造成致命一击时，猩红之瓶的冷却时间缩短15秒，且下一次使用时立即恢复5%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高6%。

options.description_en: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.
options.description_zh: 减速效果的持续时间缩短30%。

options.description_en: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你有20%的几率部分闪避任何对你造成的伤害，使其造成的伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.
options.description_zh: 切割使攻击速度额外提高，数值相当于你的急速的100%。

nodes.name_zh: 强化伏击 / 精打细算

options.description_en: Ambush generates 1 additional combo point.
options.description_zh: 伏击额外产生1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.
options.description_zh: 终结技的能量消耗降低6%。

options.description_en: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.0% Leech.
options.description_zh: 为你的致命药膏添加吸血效果，使你的吸血提高3.0%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 2%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 切割激活时，每3秒为你恢复最多1%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 1.5%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高1.5%。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 3.0%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高3.0%。

options.description_en: You are healed for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.
options.description_zh: 消失激活后的6秒内，你恢复最大生命值的30%。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.
options.description_zh: 使你的能量值上限提高50点，能量回复加快5%。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 100 and Energy regeneration by 10%.
options.description_zh: 使你的能量值上限提高100点，能量回复加快10%。

options.description_en:
Kingsbane supercharges 1 combo point.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
options.description_zh:
君王之灾会使1个连击点数被超荷充能。

当伤害性终结技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，你可以造成相当于额外消耗2个连击点数的效果。

options.description_en:
Kingsbane supercharges 2 combo points.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
options.description_zh:
君王之灾会使2个连击点数被超荷充能。

当伤害性终结技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，你可以造成相当于额外消耗2个连击点数的效果。

options.description_en:
Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 3 sec after Stealth breaks.

Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 3 sec after Stealth breaks.
options.description_zh:
脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的技能仍可继续使用。

脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的战斗增益仍可保留。

options.description_en:
Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 6 sec after Stealth breaks.

Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 6 sec after Stealth breaks.
options.description_zh:
脱离潜行状态后的6秒内，原本需要潜行的技能仍可继续使用。

脱离潜行状态后的6秒内，原本需要潜行的战斗增益仍可保留。

options.description_en:
Restore 100 Energy.

When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.
options.description_zh:
恢复100点能量。

当能量低于30点时，喝下一杯蓟叶茶。

options.description_en: Restore 100 Energy.
options.description_zh: 恢复100点能量。

options.description_en: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.
options.description_zh: 产生连击点的攻击爆击时，会使你下一个终结技的爆击几率提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 申斥回响 / 强制增压

options.description_en: After consuming a supercharged combo point, your next Mutilate also strikes the target with an Echoing Reprimand dealing 42 Physical damage.
options.description_zh: 消耗一个超荷充能的连击点数之后，你的下一个毁伤还会用申斥回响打击目标，造成40点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.
options.description_zh: 伤害性终极技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，其加成额外提高1。

options.description_en:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.
