options.description_en: Immediately reset the cooldowns of Adrenaline Rush, Between the Eyes, Blade Flurry, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree.
options.description_zh: 立即重置冲动、正中眉心、剑刃乱舞、刀锋冲刺和影舞步的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Between the Eyes has a 45% chance to apply 2 stacks of its bonus to your damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 正中眉心有45%的几率额外获得2层伤害加成效果。

options.description_en: Unseen Blade and Secret Technique increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.
options.description_zh: 隐秘之刃和影分身会使你终结技的伤害提高4%，持续12秒。最多5层。

options.description_en: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Eviscerate will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.
options.description_zh: 使用隐秘之刃打击4次之后，你的下一次刺骨会变成致命一击，被视作消耗了额外5个连击点数，并获得5层无瑕之形。

nodes.name_zh: 云雾笼罩 / 胆大包天

options.description_en:
Activating Shadow Blades creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 2 additional times.

Effect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.
options.description_zh:
激活暗影之刃会创造出一片持续6秒的烟雾，使你在烟雾中发动的攻击可以施加惊慌效果，最多额外叠加2次。

离开烟雾后，该效果仍可维持6秒。

options.description_en: Finishing moves have 12% increased chance to critically strike Fazed targets.
options.description_zh: 终结技对惊慌的目标的爆击几率提高12%。

options.description_en: Secret Technique has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.
options.description_zh: 影分身的冷却时间减少10%，并使你接下来的2次隐秘之刃攻击无视其冷却时间。

options.description_en: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.
options.description_zh: 可以产生连击点数的攻击对惊慌的目标造成的爆击伤害提高50%。

options.description_en: Your auto-attacks, Unseen Blade, and Coup de Grace also strike up to 7 nearby enemies for 50% of normal damage while Flawless Form is active.
options.description_zh: 当无瑕之形激活时，你的自动攻击、隐秘之刃和致命一击也会额外攻击附近最多7个目标，造成50%的普通伤害。

options.description_en: Secret Technique applies Fazed to any targets struck.
options.description_zh: 影分身会对命中的目标施加惊慌。

nodes.name_zh: 诡计多端 / 不必多疑

options.description_en: Tricks of the Trade's threat redirect duration is increased to 1 hour.
options.description_zh: 嫁祸诀窍的威胁转移持续时间延长至1小时。

options.description_en:
Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown.

Pick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.
options.description_zh:
致盲和潜伏帷幕的冷却时间缩短10%。

搜索和闷棍的范围提高10码。

nodes.name_zh: 千刀万剐 / 闪烁打击

options.description_en: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.
options.description_zh: 切割会额外提供10%的攻击速度，并使你的自动攻击有几率重置你使用隐秘之刃进行攻击的机会。

options.description_en:
Taking damage from an area-of-effect attack while Feint is active or dodging while Evasion is active refreshes your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.

This effect may only occur once every 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
在佯攻时受到范围攻击伤害或在闪避时躲闪会重置你使用隐秘之刃进行攻击的机会。

该效果每5秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Backstab and Shadowstrike now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 97 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec.

Fazed enemies take 5% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks.

This effect may occur once every 20 sec.
options.description_zh:
背刺和暗影打击现在也会用隐秘之刃进行攻击，造成97点伤害。被击中的目标会陷入惊慌，持续10秒。

你对惊慌的敌人造成的伤害增加5%，并且攻击不会被对方招架。

此效果每20秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.
options.description_zh: 惊慌的目标对你造成的伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Feint reduces damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by an additional 10%
options.description_zh: 佯攻使受到的范围攻击伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Shuriken Storm has 10% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.
options.description_zh: 袖剑风暴的爆击几率提高10%，并且现在会在可能的情况下触发隐秘之刃。

options.description_en: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.
options.description_zh: 隐秘之刃现在每15秒可触发一次，并有25%的几率打击两次。

options.description_en: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.
options.description_zh: 惊慌使承受的伤害额外提高3%。

options.description_en: Mutilate, Ambush, and Fan of Knives have a 60% chance to generate 1 additional combo point when they trigger Seal Fate.
options.description_zh: 毁伤、伏击和刀扇有60%的几率产生1个额外的连击点数（在它们触发封印命运时）。

nodes.name_zh: 金袋满盈 / 命数已定

options.description_en: Envenom has a 15% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.
options.description_zh: 毒伤有15%的几率掷出3个命运硬币。

options.description_en: Sinister Strike has 5% increased chance to strike an additional time and grant Opportunity and your Fatebound Coins flipped have an additional 5% chance to match the same face as the last flip.
options.description_zh: 影袭进行额外攻击的几率提高5%，触发可乘之机，并且你在掷出命运硬币时有额外5%的几率与上一次掷出的结果相同。

options.description_en: Envenom deals 5% more damage when it consumes 5 or more combo points.
options.description_zh: 毒伤消耗不低于5点连击点数时，其伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Activating Deathmark flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.
options.description_zh: 激活死亡印记会掷出一枚命运硬币并使其竖立，结果同时算作正面和反面。

options.description_en: Fatebound Coins flipped by Envenom are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.
options.description_zh: 通过毒伤掷出的命运硬币有33%更高的几率得到和上一次掷出命运硬币时获得相同的结果。

options.description_en:
Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 60 Cosmic damage to your target.

For each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.
options.description_zh:
每当一个终结技消耗5个或更多连击点数时，掷出一枚命运硬币。正面会使你的攻击伤害提高10%，持续15秒，或直到你掷出反面为止。反面会对被击中的目标造成58点宇宙伤害。

每次你掷出命运硬币的结果与上一次相同时，正面使造成的伤害额外提高2%，反面造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

Coin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.
options.description_zh:
每投掷7次硬币，就会保留一枚幸运硬币，使你趋向命运，持续12秒。你的敏捷提高4%，命运硬币的伤害和加成效果提高50%，并且硬币投掷结果与上一次相同的几率提高15%。

当你拥有一枚幸运硬币时，投掷硬币不计入寻找幸运硬币的次数。

options.description_en: Gain 5 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 15 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.
options.description_zh: 每次掷出命运硬币时，获得5点能量。硬币立在边缘时，获得15点能量。

nodes.name_zh: 命不可违 / 绝命降临

options.description_en: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal movement speed while your Fatebound Coin flips have an active streak of at least 2 flips matching the same face.
options.description_zh: 当你的命运硬币连续掷出至少2次并且结果相同时，你的移动速度不会低于正常速度的70%。

options.description_en: Grappling Hook may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 抓钩可以在3秒内再次使用一次，没有冷却时间，但总的冷却时间延长5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 天选者盛宴 / 挑战命运

options.description_en: Flipping a Fatebound Coin restores 10 health.
options.description_zh: 掷出一个命运硬币时恢复10点生命值。

options.description_en: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.
options.description_zh: 你有30%的几率吸收任意所受伤害的10%

options.description_en: Caustic Spatter causes an additional 5% of Nature damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.
options.description_zh: 腐蚀飞溅向已受影响的敌人额外施加5%的自然伤害。

options.description_en: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.
options.description_zh: 抛出正面使伤害额外提高4%。抛出反面造成的伤害提高12%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高3%。

options.description_en: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.
options.description_zh: 在连续抛出4次或更多次相同结果的命运硬币后，下一次抛出的硬币结果将与之相同。

options.description_en:
Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

Awards 1 combo point.
options.description_zh:
使用你的副手进行攻击，造成2点物理伤害，驱散所有激怒效果，并对目标施放浓缩形态的激活的非致命药膏。

奖励1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 使目标失明并迷惑地乱转，持续1分钟。任何伤害都可能打断此效果。只能对一个目标使用。

options.description_en: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 提供短暂的魔法免疫，并立即移除所有的有害法术效果。斗篷激活期间，抵抗所有有害法术效果，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.
options.description_zh: 毒刃的能量消耗降低20点，冷却时间缩短15秒，射程增加3码。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 移动速度提高15%。

options.description_en:
Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Must be in front of your target.

Awards 1 combo point.
options.description_zh:
凿击敌方目标，令其瘫痪4秒。伤害可能打断此效果。

只能在目标的前方施放。

奖励1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 致盲的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短70%，并会对周围的所有敌人生效。

options.description_en: Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 暗影步可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 潜行或暗影之舞激活时，你的移动速度提高20%。

options.description_en: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.
options.description_zh: 武器药膏的非伤害性效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
options.description_zh: 闪避还会使受到的伤害降低20%。佯攻还会使受到的非范围类伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Fatal attacks instead reduce you to 7% of your maximum health. For 3 sec afterward, you take 85% reduced damage. Cannot trigger more often than once per 6 min.
options.description_zh: 原本致命的攻击转而使你的生命值降到最大生命值的7%。之后的3秒内，你受到的伤害降低85%。该效果每6分钟只能触发一次。

nodes.name_zh: 嫁祸诀窍 / 劈头棒击

options.description_en: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 从30秒内的下一次伤害性攻击开始，将你产生的所有威胁值转移给选中的小队或团队成员，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.
options.description_zh: 在致盲或闷棍效果结束后的6秒内，敌人的伤害和治疗效果降低30%。

options.description_en: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.
options.description_zh: 现在致伤药膏可以额外叠加2次。

options.description_en: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.
options.description_zh: 佯攻和猩红之瓶的能量消耗降低10点。

options.description_en: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
options.description_zh: 受到的物理伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Increases your Agility by 3%.
options.description_zh: 敏捷提高3%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 使疾跑的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 减速药膏使移动速度额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 躲闪几率提高100%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.
options.description_zh: 你从猩红之瓶、治疗药水和治疗石获得的治疗效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的武器药膏的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.
options.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕的冷却时间缩短50%。

options.description_en: Feint has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 佯攻可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.
options.description_zh: 疾跑使移动速度额外提高30%，持续时间延长4秒。

nodes.name_zh: 迟钝药膏 / 萎缩药膏

options.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 15% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给一件武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其反应迟钝，攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.0% for 1 min.
options.description_zh: 使用非致命药膏给你的武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其造成的伤害降低4.0%，持续1分钟。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.
options.description_zh: 使你产生连击点数的攻击的爆击几率提高5%。

options.description_en: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.
options.description_zh: 当你对可获得经验值或荣誉的目标造成致命一击时，猩红之瓶的冷却时间缩短15秒，且下一次使用时立即恢复5%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高6%。

options.description_en: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.
options.description_zh: 减速效果的持续时间缩短30%。

options.description_en: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你有20%的几率部分闪避任何对你造成的伤害，使其造成的伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.
options.description_zh: 切割使攻击速度额外提高，数值相当于你的急速的100%。

nodes.name_zh: 强化伏击 / 精打细算

options.description_en: Ambush generates 1 additional combo point.
options.description_zh: 伏击额外产生1个连击点数。

options.description_en: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.
options.description_zh: 终结技的能量消耗降低6%。

options.description_en: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.0% Leech.
options.description_zh: 为你的致命药膏添加吸血效果，使你的吸血提高3.0%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 1%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高1%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance increased by 2%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆击几率提高2%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 切割激活时，每3秒为你恢复最多1%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 1.5%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高1.5%。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 3.0%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高3.0%。

options.description_en: You are healed for 30% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.
options.description_zh: 消失激活后的6秒内，你恢复最大生命值的30%。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.
options.description_zh: 使你的能量值上限提高50点，能量回复加快5%。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 100 and Energy regeneration by 10%.
options.description_zh: 使你的能量值上限提高100点，能量回复加快10%。

options.description_en:
Kingsbane supercharges 1 combo point.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
options.description_zh:
君王之灾会使1个连击点数被超荷充能。

当伤害性终结技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，你可以造成相当于额外消耗2个连击点数的效果。

options.description_en:
Kingsbane supercharges 2 combo points.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
options.description_zh:
君王之灾会使2个连击点数被超荷充能。

当伤害性终结技消耗超荷充能的连击点数时，你可以造成相当于额外消耗2个连击点数的效果。

options.description_en:
Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 3 sec after Stealth breaks.

Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 3 sec after Stealth breaks.
options.description_zh:
脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的技能仍可继续使用。

脱离潜行状态后的3秒内，原本需要潜行的战斗增益仍可保留。

options.description_en:
Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 6 sec after Stealth breaks.

Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 6 sec after Stealth breaks.
options.description_zh:
脱离潜行状态后的6秒内，原本需要潜行的技能仍可继续使用。

脱离潜行状态后的6秒内，原本需要潜行的战斗增益仍可保留。

options.description_en:
Restore 100 Energy.

When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.
options.description_zh:
恢复100点能量。

当能量低于30点时，喝下一杯蓟叶茶。

options.description_en: Restore 100 Energy.
options.description_zh: 恢复100点能量。

options.description_en: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.
options.description_zh: 产生连击点的攻击爆击时，会使你下一个终结技的爆击几率提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 申斥回响 / 强制增压

options.description_en: After consuming a supercharged combo point, your next Mutilate also strikes the target with an Echoing Reprimand dealing 41 Physical damage.
options.description_zh: 消耗一个超荷充能的连击点数之后，你的下一个毁伤还会用申斥回响打击目标，造成41点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.

options.description_en: After activating Shadow Dance, your next 2 attacks that generate combo points deal 35% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 激活暗影之舞后，你的下2次产生连击点数的攻击造成的伤害提高35%。

options.description_en: While Shadow Dance is active, your Shadow Techniques triggers 25% more frequently and generates 1 additional combo point.
options.description_zh: 在暗影之舞激活期间，你的暗影技巧的触发频率提高25%，并额外产生1个连击点。

options.description_en: While Shadow Dance is active, each different attack that generates or spends combo points lashes out at the target, dealing 147 Shadow damage.
options.description_zh: 暗影之舞激活期间，每个产生或消耗连击点的不同技能都会对目标发起鞭笞，造成148点暗影伤害。

options.description_en: Remaining out of combat for 6 sec increases the duration of your next Shadow Dance by 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 未进入战斗6秒后，你的下一个暗影之舞的持续时间延长4秒。

options.description_en:
Your weapon poisons have 10% increased application chance and now deal damage as Shadow instead of Nature.

Shadow damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
你的武器药膏生效几率提高10%，且现在由自然伤害变为暗影伤害。

造成的暗影伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Damaging attacks that expend Shadow Techniques to generate combo points have a 15% chance per stack expended to create a Shadow Clone that repeats the attack for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
options.description_zh: 消耗暗影技巧来产生连击点数的伤害性攻击，每消耗一层都有15%的几率创造一个暗影克隆体，该克隆体会重复这次攻击，造成相当于普通伤害50%的暗影伤害。

options.description_en: Unseen Blade and Secret Technique increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.
options.description_zh: 隐秘之刃和影分身会使你终结技的伤害提高4%，持续12秒。最多5层。

options.description_en: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Eviscerate will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.
options.description_zh: 使用隐秘之刃打击4次之后，你的下一次刺骨会变成致命一击，被视作消耗了额外5个连击点数，并获得5层无瑕之形。

nodes.name_zh: 云雾笼罩 / 胆大包天

options.description_en:
Activating Shadow Blades creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 2 additional times.

Effect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.
options.description_zh:
激活暗影之刃会创造出一片持续6秒的烟雾，使你在烟雾中发动的攻击可以施加惊慌效果，最多额外叠加2次。

离开烟雾后，该效果仍可维持6秒。

options.description_en: Finishing moves have 12% increased chance to critically strike Fazed targets.
options.description_zh: 终结技对惊慌的目标的爆击几率提高12%。

options.description_en: Secret Technique has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.
options.description_zh: 影分身的冷却时间减少10%，并使你接下来的2次隐秘之刃攻击无视其冷却时间。

options.description_en: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.
options.description_zh: 可以产生连击点数的攻击对惊慌的目标造成的爆击伤害提高50%。

options.description_en: Your auto-attacks, Unseen Blade, and Coup de Grace also strike up to 7 nearby enemies for 50% of normal damage while Flawless Form is active.
options.description_zh: 当无瑕之形激活时，你的自动攻击、隐秘之刃和致命一击也会额外攻击附近最多7个目标，造成50%的普通伤害。

options.description_en: Secret Technique applies Fazed to any targets struck.
options.description_zh: 影分身会对命中的目标施加惊慌。

nodes.name_zh: 诡计多端 / 不必多疑

options.description_en: Tricks of the Trade's threat redirect duration is increased to 1 hour.
options.description_zh: 嫁祸诀窍的威胁转移持续时间延长至1小时。

options.description_en:
Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown.

Pick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.
options.description_zh:
致盲和潜伏帷幕的冷却时间缩短10%。

搜索和闷棍的范围提高10码。

nodes.name_zh: 千刀万剐 / 闪烁打击

options.description_en: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.
options.description_zh: 切割会额外提供10%的攻击速度，并使你的自动攻击有几率重置你使用隐秘之刃进行攻击的机会。

options.description_en:
Taking damage from an area-of-effect attack while Feint is active or dodging while Evasion is active refreshes your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.

This effect may only occur once every 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
在佯攻时受到范围攻击伤害或在闪避时躲闪会重置你使用隐秘之刃进行攻击的机会。

该效果每5秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Backstab and Shadowstrike now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 98 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec.

Fazed enemies take 5% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks.

This effect may occur once every 20 sec.
options.description_zh:
背刺和暗影打击现在也会用隐秘之刃进行攻击，造成98点伤害。被击中的目标会陷入惊慌，持续10秒。

你对惊慌的敌人造成的伤害增加5%，并且攻击不会被对方招架。

此效果每20秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.
options.description_zh: 惊慌的目标对你造成的伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Feint reduces damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by an additional 10%
options.description_zh: 佯攻使受到的范围攻击伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Shuriken Storm has 10% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.
options.description_zh: 袖剑风暴的爆击几率提高10%，并且现在会在可能的情况下触发隐秘之刃。

options.description_en: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.
options.description_zh: 隐秘之刃现在每15秒可触发一次，并有25%的几率打击两次。

options.description_en: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.
options.description_zh: 惊慌使承受的伤害额外提高3%。

nodes.name_zh: 虚渺斗篷 / 诱导转向

options.description_en: Cloak of Shadows duration increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 暗影斗篷的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en:
Evasion reduces magical damage taken by 15%. 

Cloak of Shadows reduces physical damage taken by 20%.
options.description_zh:
闪避使受到的魔法伤害降低15%。

暗影斗篷使受到的物理伤害降低20%。

options.description_en: Rupture damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 割裂的伤害提高20%。

nodes.name_zh: 徘徊黑暗 / 致胜符记

options.description_en: After Deathmark expires, gain 30% increased Nature damage for 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 死亡印记效果结束后，造成的自然伤害提高30%，持续30秒。

options.description_en: Shadow Dance additionally increases the damage of your next Eviscerate or Black Powder by 15%.
options.description_zh: 暗影之舞还会使你的下一个刺骨或黑火药的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Fan of Knives damage increased by 60%.
options.description_zh: 刀扇的伤害提高60%。

options.description_en: Damage dealt to targets other than your Marked target deals 5% Plague damage to your Marked target.
options.description_zh: 对非标记目标造成的伤害也会对被标记的目标造成5%的瘟疫伤害。

options.description_en: Each time you consume a stack of Deathstalker's Mark, reduce the cooldown of Shadowstep by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当你消耗一层死亡猎手标记，使暗影步的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Shroud of Concealment duration increased by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 潜伏帷幕的持续时间延长5秒。

nodes.name_en: Momentum of Despair / Follow the Blood
nodes.name_zh: 绝望追击 / 觅血寻踪

options.description_en: If you have critically struck with Fan of Knives, increase the critical strike chance of Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest by 10% and critical strike damage by 20% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 如果你的刀扇造成爆击，使你的刀扇和猩红风暴的爆击几率提高10%，爆击伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest deal 30% additional damage while 2 or more enemies are afflicted with Rupture.
options.description_zh: 当至少有2名敌人受到割裂影响时，刀扇和猩红风暴额外造成30%的伤害。

options.description_en: Auto-attacks against Marked targets deal an additional 3 Plague damage.
options.description_zh: 自动攻击对被标记的目标额外造成3点瘟疫伤害。

options.description_en: When you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, the damage of your next Ambush or Mutilate is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh: 当你消耗一层死亡猎手标记时，你的下一个伏击或毁伤的伤害提高50%。

options.description_en:
Garrote applies 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to your target, unless Deathstalker's Mark is already active. You learn Mark for Death.

When you spend 5 or more combo points on attacks against a Marked target you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, dealing 54 Plague damage.


Mark for Death
Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.
options.description_zh:
锁喉会对目标施加3层死亡猎手标记，除非死亡猎手标记已生效。你学会死亡印记。

当你对被标记的目标使用消耗至少5个连击点数的攻击时，你会消耗一层死亡猎手标记，造成54点瘟疫伤害。


死亡印记
将你当前的死亡猎手标记移至目标身上。

options.description_en:
When you consume the final Deathstalker's Mark from a target or your target dies, gain 30 Energy and Darkest Night, causing your next Envenom cast with 5 or more combo points to critically strike, deal 35% additional damage, and apply 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to the target if no other Deathstalker's Mark is active.

Envenom cast with Darkest Night does not consume a stack of active Deathstalker's Marks.
options.description_zh:
当你消耗目标身上的最后一层死亡猎手标记，或目标死亡时，获得30点能量和至黑之夜，使你的下一个以5个或更多连击点数施放的毒伤必定爆击，造成的伤害提高35%，并且在目标身上没有其它死亡猎手标记激活时，对其施加3层死亡猎手标记。

在至黑之夜下施放的毒伤不会消耗已激活的死亡猎手标记层数。

options.description_en: Deathstalker's Mark deals 40% of its normal damage to all other enemies within 8 yds that are afflicted by Rupture.
options.description_zh: 死亡猎手标记对8码内的所有其他受到割裂影响的敌人造成其正常伤害的40%。

options.description_en: Deathstalker's Mark has a 30% chance to immediately consume a stack when applied.
options.description_zh: 施加死亡猎手标记时有30%的几率立即消耗一层效果。

options.description_en: Critical strike damage bonus increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆击伤害加成提高20%。

options.description_en: Heals the friendly target for 884, then jumps up to 20 yards to heal the 3 most injured nearby allies. Healing is reduced by 30% with each jump.
options.description_zh: 为友方目标恢复898点生命值，然后跳跃到最多20码范围内受伤最重的3名盟友进行治疗。治疗效果每跳一次就会降低30%。

options.description_en: Hurls molten lava at the target, dealing 695 Fire damage. Lava Burst will always critically strike if the target is affected by Flame Shock and its damage is increased by your critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 向目标投掷炽热的岩浆，造成688点火焰伤害。如果目标受到烈焰震击的影响，熔岩爆裂将必定爆击，其伤害随你的爆击几率提高。

options.description_en: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 443 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Affects 3 total targets
options.description_zh: 向敌人投掷一发闪电箭，造成441点自然伤害，然后跃向附近的其他敌人。总共影响3个目标。

options.description_en:
Protects the target with an earthen shield, increasing your healing on them by 20% and healing them for 326 when they take damage. This heal can only occur once every 3 sec. Maximum 9 charges.

Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman.
options.description_zh:
用大地之盾保护目标，使你对其造成的治疗效果提高20%，在其受到伤害时为其恢复340点生命值。这个治疗效果每3秒只能触发一次。最多拥有9层充能。

同一时间只能在一个目标身上施放大地之盾。萨满祭司在同一时间只能激活一种元素护盾。

options.description_en: Cleanse Spirit, Wind Shear, Purge, and totem casts no longer cancel Ghost Wolf.
options.description_zh: 施放净化灵魂、风剪、净化术和图腾不再会取消幽魂之狼效果。

options.description_en: Increases all Fire and Frost damage you deal by 3%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的所有火焰和冰霜伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: While transformed into a Ghost Wolf, you gain 5% increased movement speed and 5% damage reduction every 1 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
options.description_zh: 当变形为幽魂之狼形态时，每过1秒，你的移动速度就会提高5%，伤害减免提高5%，最多叠加4次。

options.description_en: Ghost Wolf removes snares and increases your movement speed by an additional 25% for the first 3 sec. May only occur once every 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 幽魂之狼会移除诱捕效果，且在前3秒内，你的移动速度额外提高25%。每20秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Chills the target with frost, causing 276 Frost damage and reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 用寒冷的冰霜冲击目标，造成273点冰霜伤害并使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。

options.description_en:
Increases the number of Elemental Shields you can have active on yourself by 1.

You can have Earth Shield on yourself and one ally at the same time.
options.description_zh:
你身上可激活的元素护盾种类提高1种。

你可以在自己和一名盟友身上同时拥有大地之盾。

options.description_en: Removes all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 60% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 移除所有的移动限制效果，并使你的移动速度提高60%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: A gust of wind hurls you forward.
options.description_zh: 一股强风吹动你向前。

options.description_en: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 将部分身体移入元素位面，使受到的伤害降低40%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: When your health is brought below 35%, you instantly heal for 40% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你的生命值降低到35%以下时，立即为你恢复40%的最大生命值。每45秒最多触发一次。

nodes.name_zh: 凝霜缠身 / 极地雪暴

options.description_en: Increases the cooldown of Frost Shock by 15 sec, but Frost Shock now freezes targets in place for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 使冰霜震击的冷却时间延长15秒，但冰霜震击现在会将目标冻结在原地，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Enemies within 10 yds of your Frost Shock are snared by 30%.
options.description_zh: 你的冰霜震击使周围10码内的敌人的移动速度降低30%。

options.description_en:
Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that heals an injured party or raid member within 40 yards for 256 every 1.8 sec.

If you already know Healing Stream Totem, instead gain 1 additional charge of Healing Stream Totem.
options.description_zh:
在你的脚下召唤一个图腾，持续15秒。每1.8秒为40码范围内一名受伤的小队或团队成员恢复262点生命值。

如果你已经习得了治疗之泉图腾，则治疗之泉图腾会获得1次额外的使用次数。

options.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 3% and the movement speed bonus of Ghost Wolf by an additional 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的移动速度提高3%，并且幽魂之狼的移动速度额外提高5%。

options.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 6% and the movement speed bonus of Ghost Wolf by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的移动速度提高6%，并且幽魂之狼的移动速度额外提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 位面旅行者 / 星界壁垒

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 星界转移的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Astral Shift reduces damage taken by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 星界转移使受到的伤害额外降低20%。

options.description_en:
Stamina increased by 8%.

While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 50% faster.
options.description_zh:
耐力提高8%。

当你的生命值全满时，复生的冷却速度提高50%。

options.description_en:
Stamina increased by 15%.

While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 100% faster.
options.description_zh:
耐力提高15%。

当你的生命值全满时，复生的冷却速度提高100%。

options.description_en: Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 以强风冲击干扰目标的专注，打断施法并使其在4秒内无法施放该系的法术。

options.description_en: Healing from Healing Stream Totem reduces Fire, Frost, and Nature damage taken by 6% for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的治疗使受到的火焰、冰霜和自然伤害降低6%，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 20 sec. The totem pulses every 2 sec, rooting all enemies within 8 yards for 8 sec. Enemies previously rooted by the totem instead suffer 50% movement speed reduction.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续20秒。该图腾每2秒作用一次，使8码范围内的所有敌人定身，持续8秒。已经受其影响的敌人不会再被图腾定身，但移动速度降低50%。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and explodes after 2 sec, stunning all enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，从周围的空气中聚集电能，在2秒之后爆炸，使周围8码内的敌人昏迷3秒。

options.description_en: Mastery increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高3%。

options.description_en: The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 你的武器和盾牌灌魔效果提高30%。

options.description_en: Interrupting a spell with Wind Shear reduces all spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用风剪打断法术时，受到的所有法术伤害降低15%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Your Healing Surge is 25% more effective on yourself.
options.description_zh: 你对自己施放治疗之涌时，效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.
options.description_zh: 移除一个友方目标身上所有诅咒效果。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短20秒。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续15秒，使经过图腾附近10码范围内的盟友移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个巨型土元素保护你和你的盟友，产生大量威胁值并周期性嘲讽敌人，持续30秒。

nodes.name_zh: 净化术 / 强效净化术

options.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.
options.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除1个有益魔法效果。

options.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial Magic effects.
options.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除2个有益的魔法效果。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高4%。

options.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and its movement speed effect lasts an additional 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 狂风图腾的冷却时间缩短30秒，移动速度加成效果额外持续2秒。

options.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's movement speed bonus is increased by 10% and now removes snares.
options.description_zh: 狂风图腾的移动速度加成提高10%，现在会移除诱捕效果。

options.description_en: Your Earth Elemental no longer taunts nearby enemies or generates threat and instead increases your maximum health by 15% while active.
options.description_zh: 你的土元素不再嘲讽附近敌人或产生威胁值，而是在激活时使你的最大生命值提高15%。

options.description_zh: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短20秒。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续15秒，使经过图腾附近10码范围内的盟友移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个巨型土元素保护你和你的盟友，产生大量威胁值并周期性嘲讽敌人，持续30秒。

nodes.name_zh: 净化术 / 强效净化术

options.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.
options.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除1个有益魔法效果。

options.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial Magic effects.
options.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除2个有益的魔法效果。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高4%。

options.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and its movement speed effect lasts an additional 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 狂风图腾的冷却时间缩短30秒，移动速度加成效果额外持续2秒。

options.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's movement speed bonus is increased by 10% and now removes snares.
options.description_zh: 狂风图腾的移动速度加成提高10%，现在会移除诱捕效果。

options.description_en: Your Earth Elemental no longer taunts nearby enemies or generates threat and instead increases your maximum health by 15% while active.
options.description_zh: 你的土元素不再嘲讽附近敌人或产生威胁值，而是在激活时使你的最大生命值提高15%。

options.description_en: Transforms the enemy into a frog for 1 min. While hexed, the victim is incapacitated, and cannot attack or cast spells. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.
options.description_zh: 将敌人变成一只青蛙，持续1分钟。受妖术影响期间目标将瘫痪，不能攻击或施法。任何伤害都有可能打断该效果。只能影响一个目标。只能对人型生物和野兽使用。

options.description_en: Calls upon the guidance of the spirits for 15 sec, permitting movement while casting Shaman spells. Castable while casting.
options.description_zh: 召唤灵魂保护你，持续15秒。可以在施放萨满法术的过程中移动。此法术可以在施放其它法术时施放。

options.description_en: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.
options.description_zh: 将你所放置的图腾迁移到指定位置。

options.description_en: Reduces all magic damage taken by 8%.
options.description_zh: 受到的所有魔法伤害降低8%。

options.description_en:
Increases the radius of your totem effects by 15%.

Increases the duration of your Earthbind and Earthgrab Totems by 10 sec.

Increases the duration of your Healing Stream, Tremor, Poison Cleansing, and Wind Rush Totems by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的图腾的有效范围提高15%。

你的地缚图腾和陷地图腾的持续时间延长10秒。

你的治疗之泉、战栗、清毒、和狂风图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

nodes.name_zh: 恩赐之魂 / 灵魂行者的神盾

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Spiritwalker's Grace by 30 sec and increases your movement speed by 20% while it is active.
options.description_zh: 使灵魂行者的恩赐的冷却时间缩短30秒，激活时使你的移动速度提高20%。

options.description_en: When you cast Spiritwalker's Grace, you become immune to Silence and Interrupt effects for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放灵魂行者的恩赐之后，你会免疫沉默及打断效果，持续5秒。

options.description_en:
Your Lava Burst casts restore 22 mana to you and 4 allies nearest to you within 40 yards.

Allies can only benefit from one Shaman's Mana Spring effect at a time, prioritizing healers.
options.description_zh:
你施放的熔岩爆裂会为你和你40码范围内最近的4名盟友恢复22点法力值。

盟友只能从一名萨满的法力之泉效果中获益，并会优先以治疗者为目标。

nodes.name_zh: 战栗图腾 / 清毒图腾

options.description_en: Summons a totem at your feet that shakes the ground around it for 10 sec, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party and raid members within 30 yards.
options.description_zh: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续10秒。该图腾会震动附近的地面，移除30码范围内所有小队和团队成员的恐惧、魅惑和睡眠效果。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at your feet that removes all Poison effects from a nearby party or raid member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续6秒。每1.5秒为附近30码范围内的一名小队或团队成员移除所有中毒效果。

nodes.name_zh: 塞拉赞恩的韧性 / 活性结界

options.description_en: Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.
options.description_zh: 大地之盾不再消耗充能，且拥有 115%的效能。

options.description_en:
When refreshing Earth Shield, your target is healed for 1,038 for each stack of Earth Shield they are missing.

Additionally, Earth Shield can consume charges 1.0 sec faster.
options.description_zh:
刷新大地之盾时，每层缺少的大地之盾为你的目标恢复1,038点生命值。

此外，大地之盾消耗层数的间隔缩短1.0秒。

options.description_en:
Your Hex target is slowed by 70% during Hex and for 6 sec after it ends.

Reduces the cooldown of Hex by 15 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的目标受到妖术效果影响时，移动速度降低70%，在妖术效果结束后，减速还会持续6秒。

妖术的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Your next healing or damaging Nature spell is instant cast and costs no mana.
options.description_zh: 你的下一个治疗或伤害性自然法术变为瞬发，且不消耗法力值。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of most totems by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 大部分图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en:
Lightning Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.

Casting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.
options.description_zh:
闪电之盾使你的智力提高3%。

施放闪电之盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。

options.description_en:
When you deal damage with a melee weapon, you have a chance to generate Maelstrom Weapon, stacking up to 5 times. 

Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon reduces the cast time of your next Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning by 20% and increases its damage by 20%.
options.description_zh:
当你用近战武器造成伤害时，有一定几率生成一层漩涡武器，至多可叠加5层。

每层漩涡武器会使你的下一个闪电箭或闪电链的施法时间缩短20%，造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location that creates a Tremor immediately and every 5.4 sec for 43 Flamestrike damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets. Lasts 25 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，立即施放一次震颤，随后每5.4秒施放一次震颤，造成43点烈焰打击伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。持续25秒。

options.description_en: Imbue your main-hand weapon with the element of Wind for 1 hour. Each main-hand attack has a 15% chance to trigger two extra attacks, dealing 9 Physical damage each.
options.description_zh: 将风元素灌注进你的主手武器之中，持续1小时。每次主手武器攻击都有15%的几率触发两次额外攻击，每次造成9点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, increasing the damage of your Fire spells by 5.0%.
options.description_zh: 为你的武器注入火元素的力量，持续1小时，并使你的火焰法术伤害提高5.0%。

options.description_en: Chain Heal now jumps to a nearby totem within 20 yards once it reaches its last target, causing the totem to cast Chain Heal on an injured ally within 30 yards for 842. Jumps to 2 nearby targets within 20 yards.
options.description_zh: 治疗链弹射到最后一个目标后会跃向20码内的一个图腾，使图腾对30码内的一名受伤的盟友施放治疗链，恢复825点生命值。可跳转到20码内的2名目标。

nodes.name_zh: 增效核心 / 涌动超载

options.description_en: While Surging Totem is active, your damage and healing done is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 涌动图腾激活时，你造成的伤害和治疗提高3%。

options.description_en: Surging Totem deals 50% more damage while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active.
options.description_zh: 在升腾或治疗之潮图腾激活期间，涌动图腾造成的伤害提高50%。

options.description_en: When you summon a Healing Tide Totem, Healing Stream Totem, or Spirit Link Totem you cast a free instant Chain Heal at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 你的治疗之潮图腾、治疗之泉图腾或灵魂链接图腾在召唤时会施放一次无消耗且瞬发的治疗链，产生100%的效果。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Healing Stream Totem by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Windfury has a 10% additional chance to trigger and its damage is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh: 风怒触发几率额外提高10%，伤害提高50%。

options.description_en:
Electrocutes all enemies in front of you, dealing 64 Nature damage. 

Enhances your weapons for 12 sec, causing Stormstrike and Lava Lash to discharge 34 Nature damage split between up to 5 enemies in front of you.
options.description_zh:
对前方所有敌人施放电击，造成64点自然伤害。

你的武器将受到强化，持续12秒，使风暴打击和熔岩猛击还能造成34点自然伤害，由你前方最多5个目标平均分摊。

options.description_en: Lava Lash cooldown reduced by 6.0 sec, and if Lava Lash is used against a target affected by your Flame Shock, Flame Shock will be spread to up to 5 nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短6.0秒，而且对受你烈焰震击影响的目标使用熔岩猛击时，烈焰震击将扩散至附近最多5个敌人身上。

nodes.name_zh: 巨型图腾 / 迅捷召回

options.description_en: Increases the size and radius of your totems by 15%, and the health of your totems by 30%.
options.description_zh: 图腾的体型和范围扩大15%，图腾的生命值提高30%。

options.description_en:
Successfully removing a harmful effect with Tremor Totem or Poison Cleansing Totem, or controlling an enemy with Capacitor Totem or Earthgrab Totem reduces the cooldown of the totem used by 5 sec.

Cannot occur more than once every 20 sec per totem.
options.description_zh:
战栗图腾或清毒图腾成功移除一个有害效果，或者使用电能图腾或陷地图腾控制一名敌人时，你使用的图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

每个图腾每20秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing 1,833 damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 有图腾激活时，图腾每30秒使你获得一个护盾，吸收1,833点伤害，持续30秒。

options.description_en:
Your Healing Stream Totems heals an additional ally at 30% effectiveness.

Healing Tide Totem healing increased by 25%.
options.description_zh:
你的治疗之泉图腾还会治疗第二名盟友，产生30%的效果。

治疗之潮图腾的治疗量提高25%。

options.description_en: Mastery increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高2%。

options.description_en: Windfury Weapon has a 100% chance to trigger a third attack.
options.description_zh: 风怒武器有100%的几率触发第三次攻击。

options.description_en:
Maelstrom Weapon can now stack 5 additional times.

Each Maelstrom Weapon stacks consumed grants Overflowing Maelstrom, reducing the cast time of your next Healing Surge or Chain Heal by 10%, and increasing their healing by 10% up to 10 times. This effect can be accumulated up to 20 times.
options.description_zh:
漩涡武器现在可以额外叠加5次。

每消耗一层漩涡武器会使你获得溢流漩涡，使下一个治疗之涌或治疗链的施法时间缩短10%，治疗效果提高10%，最多叠加10次。此效果最多可累积20次。

options.description_en: When Lava Lash strikes a target affected by your Flame Shock, its cooldown is reduced by 2.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 当熔岩猛击击中一个受你的烈焰震击影响的目标时，其冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of your Earthliving effect by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的大地生命效果的持续时间延长3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 脉冲蓄容 / 辅助灌魔

options.description_en: Increases the healing done by Surging Totem by 10%.
options.description_zh: 涌动图腾的治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en:
Learn a new weapon imbue, Tidecaller's Guard.

 Tidecaller's Guard
Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
习得一种新的武器灌魔：唤潮者的护卫

 唤潮者的护卫
为你的盾牌注入水元素之力，持续1小时。你造成的治疗效果提高2.0%，你的治疗之泉图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

nodes.name_zh: 图腾协同 / 大地奔涌

options.description_en: Chain Heals from Lively Totem and Totemic Rebound are 25% more effective.
options.description_zh: 生机图腾和图腾反弹的治疗链的效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Allies affected by your Earthliving effect receive 15% increased healing from you.
options.description_zh: 受到你的大地生命效果影响的盟友，从你这里获得的治疗效果提高15%。

options.description_en: Healing Stream Totem and Healing Tide Totem healing has a 8% chance to apply Earthliving to allies it heals.
options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾和治疗之潮图腾的治疗效果有8%的几率对受到治疗的盟友施加大地生命。

options.description_en:
Stormstrike has an additional charge.

Stormsurge now also causes your next Stormstrike to deal 25% additional damage as Nature damage, stacking up to 2 times.
options.description_zh:
风暴打击额外获得一次使用次数。

风暴喷涌还会使你的下一个风暴打击额外造成25%的自然伤害，最多叠加2次。

options.description_en: The critical strike damage of your Nature abilities are increased by 40% of your critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术的爆击伤害提高，数值相当于你的爆击几率的40%。

options.description_en: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning can consume up to 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
options.description_zh: 闪电箭和闪电链最多可消耗10层漩涡武器。

options.description_en: Increases your attack speed by 15% for your next 3 melee swings after dealing a critical strike with a spell or ability.
options.description_zh: 在你的法术或技能爆击后，使你下3次近战攻击的攻击速度提高15%。

options.description_en:
Melee auto-attacks with Flametongue Weapon active have a 5% chance to reduce the cooldown of Lava Lash by 25% and increase the damage of Lava Lash by 20% for 8 sec.

May not occur during an active Hot Hand.
options.description_zh:
灌注火舌武器激活时的自动攻击有5%的几率使熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短25%，并使熔岩猛击的伤害提高20%，持续8秒。

不会在灼热之手触发期间触发效果。

options.description_en:
Melee auto-attacks with Flametongue Weapon active have a 5% chance to reduce the cooldown of Lava Lash by 50% and increase the damage of Lava Lash by 40% for 8 sec.

May not occur during an active Hot Hand.
options.description_zh:
灌注火舌武器激活时的自动攻击有5%的几率使熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短50%，并使熔岩猛击的伤害提高40%，持续8秒。

不会在灼热之手触发期间触发效果。

options.description_en:
Elemental motes orbit around your Surging Totem. Your abilities consume the motes for enhanced effects. 

Water: Your next Healing Wave also heals an ally inside of your Healing Rain at 50% effectiveness.

Air: The cast time of your next healing spell is reduced by 40%.

Earth: Your next Chain Heal applies Earthliving at 150% effectiveness to all targets hit.
options.description_zh:
元素微粒在你的涌动图腾周围飞旋，你的技能会消耗微粒并增强效果。

流水：你的下一次治疗波还会治疗你的治疗之雨中的一个盟友，产生50%的效果。

空气：你的下一个治疗法术的施法时间减少40%。

大地：你的下一个治疗链以150%的效果对所有命中的目标施加大地生命。

options.description_en: Each Maelstrom Weapon spent has a 2.00% chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.
options.description_zh: 消耗的每层漩涡武器有2.00%的几率将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。

options.description_en: Increase the chance for Mastery: Enhanced Elements to trigger Windfury and Stormsurge by 150%.
options.description_zh: 精通：增强元素触发风怒和风暴喷涌的几率提高150%。

options.description_en:
Elemental damage increased by 10%. 

Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon consumed reduces the cooldown of Stormstrike by 0.3 sec and Lava Lash by 0.3 sec.
options.description_zh:
元素伤害提高10%。

每消耗一层漩涡武器，可使风暴打击的冷却时间缩短0.3秒，熔岩猛击的冷却时间缩短0.3秒。

options.description_en:
Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing 1,544 Nature damage. Always critically strikes.

Generates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.
options.description_zh:
立即用炽焰雷霆震击目标及10码内的5个敌人，施加烈焰震击并造成1,540点自然伤害，且必定爆击。

产生1层漩涡武器。

options.description_en:
Spending Maelstrom Weapon stacks grants you 1% haste for 15 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
消耗漩涡武器层数使你获得1%急速，持续15秒。

多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature damage spells by 5% and the critical strike damage of your Nature spells by 5%.
options.description_zh: 使你的伤害性自然法术的爆击几率提高5%，并且使你的自然法术的爆击伤害提高5%。

nodes.name_zh: 雷电导管 / 电能震击

options.description_en:
You have a chance to get struck by lightning, increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec. The effectiveness is increased to 100% in outdoor areas.

You call down a Thunderstorm when you Reincarnate.
options.description_zh:
你有几率被闪电击中，使你的移动速度提高50%，持续5秒。在户外区域时效果提高到100%。

当你复生时会召唤一场雷霆风暴。

options.description_en: Tempest increases your movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 狂风怒号使你的移动速度提高20%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Storm Elemental lasts 2 sec longer, and Stormkeeper generates 10 Maelstrom.
options.description_zh: 风暴元素的持续时间延长2秒，且风暴守护者产生10点漩涡值。

options.description_en: Chain Lightning now jumps to 2 additional targets and deals 10% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 闪电链现在会额外跃向2个目标，且伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Each target hit by Crash Lightning increases the damage of your next Stormstrike by 25%, up to a maximum of 6 stacks.
options.description_zh: 你的毁灭闪电每击中一个目标，都会使你下一个风暴打击的伤害提高25%，最多叠加6层。

options.description_en: Stormstrike has a 20% chance to strike the target an additional time for 40% of normal damage. This effect can chain off of itself.
options.description_zh: 风暴打击有20%几率额外攻击目标一次，造成40%的伤害。此效果可以由其本身触发。

options.description_en: Critical strikes of your Nature abilities reduce the target's movement speed by 60% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术爆击会使目标的移动速度降低60%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Each active weapon imbue increases all Fire, Frost, and Nature damage dealt by 5.0%.
options.description_zh: 每一种激活的武器灌魔使造成的所有火焰、冰霜和自然伤害提高5.0%。

options.description_en:
Voltaic Blaze generates 2 additional Maelstrom Weapon and has a 30% chance to cause a Fire Nova.

Fire Nova
Erupt a burst of fiery damage from all targets affected by your Flame Shock, dealing 35 Volcanic damage to up to 6 targets within 8 yds of your Flame Shock targets.
options.description_zh:
流电炽焰额外产生2层漩涡武器，并有30%的几率触发一次火焰新星。

火焰新星
引导烈火在受你烈焰震击影响的所有目标身上爆发，对受影响目标周围8码范围内至多6名敌人造成35点熔火伤害。

options.description_en: Lava Lash and Sundering increases the damage of Flame Shock on its target by 100% for 20 sec.

options.description_en: Tempest grants 7% Mastery for 6 sec.

Tempest causes your next Chain Lightning to be instant cast, deal 40% increased damage, and cast an additional time.

Can accumulate up to 2 charges.

狂风怒号使你的下一个闪电链变为瞬发，造成的伤害提高40%，并额外施放一次。

可以积累最多2层。

options.description_en:
Doom Winds summons a Nature Feral Spirit for 12 sec.

Feral Spirit
An Elemental Spirit infused with Nature magic, granting the summoner with 5% increased Nature damage and 5% Physical damage for 12 sec.
options.description_zh:
毁灭之风会召唤一只自然野性狼魂，持续12秒。

野性狼魂
被自然魔法灌注的元素之灵，使召唤者的自然伤害提高5%，物理伤害提高5%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Nature damage is increased by 2%
options.description_zh: 自然伤害提高2%。

options.description_en: Stormstrike and Lava Lash unleash a Chain Lightning at 100% effectiveness that deals 20% reduced damage with each jump.
options.description_zh: 风暴打击和熔岩猛击会释放一道100%效果的闪电链，每次跳跃伤害降低20%。

options.description_en:
Unleash a devastating storm around yourself, dealing 42 Stormstrike damage every 1 sec to nearby enemies for 8 sec.

Increases your chance to activate Windfury Weapon by 50%, and the damage of Windfury Weapon by 20%.
options.description_zh:
在你周围释放一场毁灭性的风暴，每1秒对附近敌人造成42点风暴打击伤害，持续8秒。

你触发风怒武器的几率提高50%，风怒武器的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Shatters a line of earth in front of you with your main hand weapon, causing 88 Flamestrike damage to any enemy hit.
options.description_zh: 用主手武器击碎前方直线上的大地，对被击中的敌人造成90点烈焰打击伤害。

options.description_en: Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 毁灭闪电和闪电链的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en:
Gain the effects of the Lightning Rod talent:

 Lightning Rod
Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning make your target a Lightning Rod for 8 sec.
 
Lightning Rods take 10% of all damage you deal with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.
options.description_zh:
获得引雷针天赋：

 引雷针
闪电箭和闪电链使目标变成引雷针，持续8秒。
 
你的闪电箭和闪电链造成伤害时，引雷针会承受总伤害量的10%。

nodes.name_zh: 自然之护 / 喷薄之流

options.description_en: Lightning Shield reduces the damage you take by 3%.
options.description_zh: 闪电之盾使你受到的伤害降低3%。

options.description_en: Casting Tempest grants Surging Currents, increasing the effectiveness of your next Chain Heal or Healing Surge by 16%, up to 80%.
options.description_zh: 施放狂风怒号可获得喷薄之流，使你的下一个治疗链或治疗之涌的效果提高16%，最高80%。

options.description_en: Casting Ascendance upgrades your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.
options.description_zh: 施放升腾会将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。

options.description_en: Consuming 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon increases the damage of your next Stormstrike or Lava Lash by 25% and causes them to generate a stack of Maelstrom Weapon.
options.description_zh: 消耗10层漩涡武器会使你的下一个风暴打击或熔岩猛击的伤害提高25%，并使其产生一层漩涡武器。

options.description_en: Stormstrike damage is increased by 20%, and Stormstrike and Lava Lash have a 100% chance to generate 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.
options.description_zh: 风暴打击的伤害提高20%。风暴打击和熔岩猛击有100%的几率产生1层漩涡武器。

options.description_en: During Doom Winds or Ascendance, you generate 1 Maelstrom Weapon stack every 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 当毁灭之风或升腾效果激活时，每1秒产生1层漩涡武器。

options.description_en: During Doom Winds or Ascendance, you generate 2 Maelstrom Weapon stacks every 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 当毁灭之风或升腾效果激活时，每1秒产生2层漩涡武器。

options.description_en:
Casting Sundering summons 1 Fire Feral Spirit and Doom Winds summons 1 Nature Feral Spirit by your side for 8 sec.

Feral Spirit
An Elemental Spirit Wolf infused with Fire or Nature magic, granting the summoner with 5% increased Fire or Nature damage and 5% Physical damage for 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
施放裂地术会召唤1只火焰野性狼魂，毁灭之风会召唤1只自然野性狼魂在你身边，持续8秒。

野性狼魂
一只注入火焰或自然魔法的元素之灵狼，使召唤者的火焰或自然伤害提高5%，物理伤害提高5%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Casting Sundering grants you 15% Haste for 12 sec, and generates 5 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
options.description_zh: 裂地术使你的急速提高15%并产生5层漩涡武器，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Stormstrike has a small chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.
options.description_zh: 风暴打击有较小几率将你的下一个闪电箭升级为狂风怒号。

options.description_en: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning deal 20% increased damage and have a 20% chance to refund the Maelstrom Weapon spent.
options.description_zh: 闪电箭和闪电链的伤害提高20%，并且有20%的几率返还消耗的漩涡武器。

每消耗一层漩涡武器有0.6%的几率激活升腾，持续6.0秒。

转化成空气升腾者形态，持续15秒，施放毁灭之风。风暴打击的冷却时间和消耗降低60%，并将自动攻击和风暴打击变成风切，无视护甲，攻击距离为30码。

options.description_en:
Transform into an Air Ascendant for 15 sec and unleash Doom Winds, reducing the cooldown and cost of Stormstrike by 60%, and transforming your auto attack and Stormstrike into Wind attacks which bypass armor and have a 30 yd range.

Maelstrom Weapon spenders have a 0.5% chance to unleash Doom Winds per Maelstrom Weapon spent while Ascendance is not active.
options.description_zh:
转化成空气升腾者形态，持续15秒并施放毁灭之风，使风暴打击的冷却时间和消耗降低60%，并将自动攻击和风暴打击变成风切，无视护甲，攻击距离为30码。

未激活升腾效果时，消耗漩涡武器的技能每消耗一层漩涡武器，就有0.5%的几率施放毁灭之风。

options.description_en:
Doom Winds and Deeply Rooted Elements last 2 sec longer, and the cooldown of Ascendance is reduced by 60 sec.

During Doom Winds or Ascendance, Stormstrike and Crash Lightning consume up to 10 Maelstrom Weapon to discharge a Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning at 100% effectiveness at your enemy, whichever you most recently used.
options.description_zh:
毁灭之风和根深蒂固元素的持续时间延长2秒，并且升腾的冷却时间缩短60秒。

在毁灭之风或升腾持续期间，风暴打击和毁灭闪电会消耗最多10层漩涡武器，向你的敌人释放一次100%效果的闪电箭或闪电链，取决于你最近使用的技能。

options.description_en:
Sundering transforms into a single use Primordial Storm for 15 sec after it is cast.

Primordial Storm
Devastate nearby enemies with a Primordial Storm dealing 41 Flamestrike, 42 Froststrike, 41 Stormstrike damage, and unleashing a Lightning Bolt or a Chain Lightning at 150% effectiveness. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Consumes Maelstrom Weapon for increased damage.
options.description_zh:
施放裂地术后，它会转变为一次性的始源风暴，持续15秒。

始源风暴
用始源风暴摧毁附近的敌人，造成41点烈焰打击伤害、41点冰霜打击伤害、41点风暴打击伤害，并以150%的效果释放一次闪电箭或闪电链。目标超过5个时伤害降低。

消耗漩涡武器以提高伤害。

options.description_en: Each Maelstrom Weapon spent has a 2% chance to cause your next Crash Lightning to ignore its cooldown. The weapon enhancement effect of Crash Lightning may now overlap.
options.description_zh: 每消耗一层漩涡武器，就有2%%的几率使你的下一个毁灭闪电无视其冷却时间。毁灭闪电的武器强化效果现在可以叠加。

nodes.name_zh: 巨型图腾 / 迅捷召回

options.description_en: Increases the size and radius of your totems by 15%, and the health of your totems by 30%.
options.description_zh: 图腾的体型和范围扩大15%，图腾的生命值提高30%。

options.description_en:
Successfully removing a harmful effect with Tremor Totem or Poison Cleansing Totem, or controlling an enemy with Capacitor Totem or Earthgrab Totem reduces the cooldown of the totem used by 5 sec.

Cannot occur more than once every 20 sec per totem.
options.description_zh:
战栗图腾或清毒图腾成功移除一个有害效果，或者使用电能图腾或陷地图腾控制一名敌人时，你使用的图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

每个图腾每20秒只能触发一次。

nodes.name_zh: 脉冲蓄容 / 辅助灌魔

options.description_en: Increases the healing done by Surging Totem by 10%.
options.description_zh: 涌动图腾的治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en:
Learn a new weapon imbue, Tidecaller's Guard.

 Tidecaller's Guard
Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
习得一种新的武器灌魔：唤潮者的护卫

 唤潮者的护卫
为你的盾牌注入水元素之力，持续1小时。你造成的治疗效果提高2.0%，你的治疗之泉图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of your Earthliving effect by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的大地生命效果的持续时间延长3秒。

options.description_en:
Your Healing Stream Totems heals an additional ally at 30% effectiveness.

Healing Tide Totem healing increased by 25%.
options.description_zh:
你的治疗之泉图腾还会治疗第二名盟友，产生30%的效果。

治疗之潮图腾的治疗量提高25%。

nodes.name_zh: 增效核心 / 涌动超载

options.description_en: While Surging Totem is active, your damage and healing done is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 涌动图腾激活时，你造成的伤害和治疗提高3%。

options.description_en: Surging Totem deals 50% more damage while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active.
options.description_zh: 在升腾或治疗之潮图腾激活期间，涌动图腾造成的伤害提高50%。

options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，立即施放一次震颤，随后每5.4秒施放一次震颤，造成43点烈焰打击伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。持续25秒。

Elemental motes orbit around your Surging Totem. Your abilities consume the motes for enhanced effects. 

Water: Your next Healing Wave also heals an ally inside of your Healing Rain at 50% effectiveness.

Air: The cast time of your next healing spell is reduced by 40%.

Earth: Your next Chain Heal applies Earthliving at 150% effectiveness to all targets hit.
options.description_zh:
元素微粒在你的涌动图腾周围飞旋，你的技能会消耗微粒并增强效果。

流水：你的下一次治疗波还会治疗你的治疗之雨中的一个盟友，产生50%的效果。

空气：你的下一个治疗法术的施法时间减少40%。

大地：你的下一个治疗链以150%的效果对所有命中的目标施加大地生命。

options.description_zh: 生机图腾和图腾反弹的治疗链的效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Allies affected by your Earthliving effect receive 15% increased healing from you.
options.description_zh: 受到你的大地生命效果影响的盟友，从你这里获得的治疗效果提高15%。

options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾和治疗之潮图腾的治疗效果有8%的几率对受到治疗的盟友施加大地生命。

options.description_zh: 精通提高2%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Healing Stream Totem by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_zh: 向目标投掷炽热的岩浆，造成696点火焰伤害。如果目标受到烈焰震击的影响，熔岩爆裂将必定爆击，其伤害随你的爆击几率提高。

options.description_en:

options.description_zh:

options.description_en: Cleanse Spirit, Wind Shear, Purge, and totem casts no longer cancel Ghost Wolf.
options.description_zh: 施放净化灵魂、风剪、净化术和图腾不再会取消幽魂之狼效果。

options.description_en: Increases all Fire and Frost damage you deal by 3%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的所有火焰和冰霜伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: While transformed into a Ghost Wolf, you gain 5% increased movement speed and 5% damage reduction every 1 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
options.description_zh: 当变形为幽魂之狼形态时，每过1秒，你的移动速度就会提高5%，伤害减免提高5%，最多叠加4次。

options.description_en: Ghost Wolf removes snares and increases your movement speed by an additional 25% for the first 3 sec. May only occur once every 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 幽魂之狼会移除诱捕效果，且在前3秒内，你的移动速度额外提高25%。每20秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Chills the target with frost, causing 279 Frost damage and reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 用寒冷的冰霜冲击目标，造成269点冰霜伤害并使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。

options.description_en:
Increases the number of Elemental Shields you can have active on yourself by 1.

You can have Earth Shield on yourself and one ally at the same time.
options.description_zh:
你身上可激活的元素护盾种类提高1种。

你可以在自己和一名盟友身上同时拥有大地之盾。

options.description_en: Removes all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 60% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 移除所有的移动限制效果，并使你的移动速度提高60%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: A gust of wind hurls you forward.
options.description_zh: 一股强风吹动你向前。

options.description_en: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 将部分身体移入元素位面，使受到的伤害降低40%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: When your health is brought below 35%, you instantly heal for 40% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你的生命值降低到35%以下时，立即为你恢复40%的最大生命值。每45秒最多触发一次。

nodes.name_zh: 凝霜缠身 / 极地雪暴

options.description_en: Increases the cooldown of Frost Shock by 15 sec, but Frost Shock now freezes targets in place for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 使冰霜震击的冷却时间延长15秒，但冰霜震击现在会将目标冻结在原地，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Enemies within 10 yds of your Frost Shock are snared by 30%.
options.description_zh: 你的冰霜震击使周围10码内的敌人的移动速度降低30%。

options.description_en:
Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that heals an injured party or raid member within 40 yards for 258 every 1.8 sec.

If you already know Healing Stream Totem, instead gain 1 additional charge of Healing Stream Totem.
options.description_zh:
在你的脚下召唤一个图腾，持续15秒。每1.8秒为40码范围内一名受伤的小队或团队成员恢复251点生命值。

如果你已经习得了治疗之泉图腾，则治疗之泉图腾会获得1次额外的使用次数。

options.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 3% and the movement speed bonus of Ghost Wolf by an additional 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的移动速度提高3%，并且幽魂之狼的移动速度额外提高5%。

options.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 6% and the movement speed bonus of Ghost Wolf by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的移动速度提高6%，并且幽魂之狼的移动速度额外提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 位面旅行者 / 星界壁垒

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 星界转移的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Astral Shift reduces damage taken by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 星界转移使受到的伤害额外降低20%。

options.description_en:
Stamina increased by 8%.

While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 50% faster.
options.description_zh:
耐力提高8%。

当你的生命值全满时，复生的冷却速度提高50%。

options.description_en:
Stamina increased by 15%.

While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 100% faster.
options.description_zh:
耐力提高15%。

当你的生命值全满时，复生的冷却速度提高100%。

options.description_en: Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 以强风冲击干扰目标的专注，打断施法并使其在4秒内无法施放该系的法术。

options.description_en: Healing from Healing Stream Totem reduces Fire, Frost, and Nature damage taken by 6% for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的治疗使受到的火焰、冰霜和自然伤害降低6%，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 20 sec. The totem pulses every 2 sec, rooting all enemies within 8 yards for 8 sec. Enemies previously rooted by the totem instead suffer 50% movement speed reduction.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续20秒。该图腾每2秒作用一次，使8码范围内的所有敌人定身，持续8秒。已经受其影响的敌人不会再被图腾定身，但移动速度降低50%。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and explodes after 2 sec, stunning all enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，从周围的空气中聚集电能，在2秒之后爆炸，使周围8码内的敌人昏迷3秒。

options.description_en: Mastery increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高3%。

options.description_en: The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 你的武器和盾牌灌魔效果提高30%。

options.description_en: Interrupting a spell with Wind Shear reduces all spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用风剪打断法术时，受到的所有法术伤害降低15%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Your Healing Surge is 25% more effective on yourself.
options.description_zh: 你对自己施放治疗之涌时，效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Purify Spirit additionally removes all Curse effects.
options.description_zh: 净化灵魂会额外移除所有诅咒效果。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短20秒。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续15秒，使经过图腾附近10码范围内的盟友移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个巨型土元素保护你和你的盟友，产生大量威胁值并周期性嘲讽敌人，持续30秒。

nodes.name_zh: 净化术 / 强效净化术

options.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.
options.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除1个有益魔法效果。

options.description_en: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial Magic effects.
options.description_zh: 净化敌方目标，移除2个有益的魔法效果。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高4%。

options.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and its movement speed effect lasts an additional 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 狂风图腾的冷却时间缩短30秒，移动速度加成效果额外持续2秒。

options.description_en: Wind Rush Totem's movement speed bonus is increased by 10% and now removes snares.
options.description_zh: 狂风图腾的移动速度加成提高10%，现在会移除诱捕效果。

options.description_en: Your Earth Elemental no longer taunts nearby enemies or generates threat and instead increases your maximum health by 15% while active.
options.description_zh: 你的土元素不再嘲讽附近敌人或产生威胁值，而是在激活时使你的最大生命值提高15%。

options.description_en: Transforms the enemy into a frog for 1 min. While hexed, the victim is incapacitated, and cannot attack or cast spells. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.
options.description_zh: 将敌人变成一只青蛙，持续1分钟。受妖术影响期间目标将瘫痪，不能攻击或施法。任何伤害都有可能打断该效果。只能影响一个目标。只能对人型生物和野兽使用。

options.description_en: Calls upon the guidance of the spirits for 15 sec, permitting movement while casting Shaman spells. Castable while casting.
options.description_zh: 召唤灵魂保护你，持续15秒。可以在施放萨满法术的过程中移动。此法术可以在施放其它法术时施放。

options.description_en: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.
options.description_zh: 将你所放置的图腾迁移到指定位置。

options.description_en: Reduces all magic damage taken by 8%.
options.description_zh: 受到的所有魔法伤害降低8%。

options.description_en:
Increases the radius of your totem effects by 15%.

Increases the duration of your Earthbind and Earthgrab Totems by 10 sec.

Increases the duration of your Healing Stream, Tremor, Poison Cleansing, and Wind Rush Totems by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的图腾的有效范围提高15%。

你的地缚图腾和陷地图腾的持续时间延长10秒。

你的治疗之泉、战栗、清毒、和狂风图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

nodes.name_zh: 恩赐之魂 / 灵魂行者的神盾

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Spiritwalker's Grace by 30 sec and increases your movement speed by 20% while it is active.
options.description_zh: 使灵魂行者的恩赐的冷却时间缩短30秒，激活时使你的移动速度提高20%。

options.description_en: When you cast Spiritwalker's Grace, you become immune to Silence and Interrupt effects for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放灵魂行者的恩赐之后，你会免疫沉默及打断效果，持续5秒。

options.description_en:
Your Lava Burst casts restore 22 mana to you and 4 allies nearest to you within 40 yards.

Allies can only benefit from one Shaman's Mana Spring effect at a time, prioritizing healers.
options.description_zh:
你施放的熔岩爆裂会为你和你40码范围内最近的4名盟友恢复22点法力值。

盟友只能从一名萨满的法力之泉效果中获益，并会优先以治疗者为目标。

nodes.name_zh: 战栗图腾 / 清毒图腾

options.description_en: Summons a totem at your feet that shakes the ground around it for 10 sec, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party and raid members within 30 yards.
options.description_zh: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续10秒。该图腾会震动附近的地面，移除30码范围内所有小队和团队成员的恐惧、魅惑和睡眠效果。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at your feet that removes all Poison effects from a nearby party or raid member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续6秒。每1.5秒为附近30码范围内的一名小队或团队成员移除所有中毒效果。

nodes.name_zh: 塞拉赞恩的韧性 / 活性结界

options.description_en: Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.
options.description_zh: 大地之盾不再消耗充能，且拥有 115%的效能。

options.description_en:
When refreshing Earth Shield, your target is healed for 1,038 for each stack of Earth Shield they are missing.

Additionally, Earth Shield can consume charges 1.0 sec faster.
options.description_zh:
刷新大地之盾时，每层缺少的大地之盾为你的目标恢复1,038点生命值。

此外，大地之盾消耗层数的间隔缩短1.0秒。

options.description_en:
Your Hex target is slowed by 70% during Hex and for 6 sec after it ends.

Reduces the cooldown of Hex by 15 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的目标受到妖术效果影响时，移动速度降低70%，在妖术效果结束后，减速还会持续6秒。

妖术的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Your next healing or damaging Nature spell is instant cast and costs no mana.
options.description_zh: 你的下一个治疗或伤害性自然法术变为瞬发，且不消耗法力值。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of most totems by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 大部分图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en:
Lightning Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.

Casting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.
options.description_zh:
闪电之盾使你的智力提高3%。

施放闪电之盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。

options.description_en:
Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.

Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.
options.description_zh:
生命释放为你召唤一位先祖，持续12秒。

每当你施放治疗或伤害法术，先祖也会施放相似的法术。

options.description_en: Restorative waters wash over a friendly target, healing them for 2,234 and an additional 2,036 over 18 sec.
options.description_zh: 恢复之水洗刷一名友方目标，为其恢复2,258点生命值，并在18秒内额外恢复2,036点生命值。

options.description_en: Summons a totem at the target location that creates a Tremor immediately and every 5.4 sec for 43 Flamestrike damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets. Lasts 25 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，立即施放一次震颤，随后每5.4秒施放一次震颤，造成42点烈焰打击伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。持续25秒。

nodes.name_zh: 潜在智慧 / 万古情谊

options.description_en: Your Ancestors' spells are 25% more powerful.
options.description_zh: 你的先祖的法术效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Ancestors have a 20% chance to call another Ancestor for 8 sec when they depart.
options.description_zh: 先祖有20%的几率在离去时召唤另一位先祖，持续8秒。

nodes.name_zh: 听从我的召唤 / 例行交流

options.description_en: Ancestors last an additional 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 先祖的持续时间延长4秒。

options.description_en: Riptide has a 15% chance to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 激流有15%的几率在你身边召唤一个先祖，持续8秒。

options.description_zh: 熔岩爆裂获得额外一层充能，造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Your Intellect is increased by 1.0% for each Ancestor active.
options.description_zh: 每个激活的先祖使你的智力提高1.0%。

Blanket the target area in healing rains, restoring 1,075 health to up to 6 allies over 18 sec.

You can only have one Healing Rain active at a time.
options.description_zh:
用治疗之雨覆盖目标区域，为最多6个盟友恢复1,078点生命值，持续18秒。

你一次只能激活一个治疗之雨。

options.description_en:
Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that heals an injured party or raid member within 40 yards for 251 every 1.8 sec.

If you already know Healing Stream Totem, instead gain 1 additional charge of Healing Stream Totem.
options.description_zh:
在你的脚下召唤一个图腾，持续15秒。每1.8秒为40码范围内一名受伤的小队或团队成员恢复260点生命值。

如果你已经习得了治疗之泉图腾，则治疗之泉图腾会获得1次额外的使用次数。

options.description_en: Chain Heal now jumps to a nearby totem within 20 yards once it reaches its last target, causing the totem to cast Chain Heal on an injured ally within 30 yards for 858. Jumps to 2 nearby targets within 20 yards.
options.description_zh: 治疗链弹射到最后一个目标后会跃向20码内的一个图腾，使图腾对30码内的一名受伤的盟友施放治疗链，恢复834点生命值。可跳转到20码内的2名目标。

nodes.name_zh: 增效核心 / 涌动超载

options.description_en: While Surging Totem is active, your damage and healing done is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh: 涌动图腾激活时，你造成的伤害和治疗提高3%。

options.description_en: Surging Totem deals 50% more damage while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active.
options.description_zh: 在升腾或治疗之潮图腾激活期间，涌动图腾造成的伤害提高50%。

options.description_en: When you summon a Healing Tide Totem, Healing Stream Totem, or Spirit Link Totem you cast a free instant Chain Heal at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 你的治疗之潮图腾、治疗之泉图腾或灵魂链接图腾在召唤时会施放一次无消耗且瞬发的治疗链，产生100%的效果。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Healing Stream Totem by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的冷却时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Riptide by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤先祖时，激流冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en:
Increases your maximum mana by 10%.

Tidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.
options.description_zh:
你的最大法力值提高10%。

潮汐奔涌现在可以叠加最多3次。

options.description_en: Using spells with a cast time increases the duration of Spiritwalker's Grace and Spiritwalker's Aegis by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用带有施法时间的法术会使灵魂行者的恩赐和灵魂行者的神盾的持续时间延长1秒，最多可延长4秒。

options.description_en: The cast times of Healing Surge, Chain Heal and Lava Burst are reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 治疗之涌、治疗链和熔岩爆裂的施法时间缩短10%。

options.description_en: Increases the healing done by Healing Rain by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 治疗之雨的治疗效果提高10%，施法时间缩短0.5秒。

options.description_en: Deal 383 Nature damage every 1.8 sec to up to 5 enemies inside of your Healing Rain.
options.description_zh: 每1.8秒，对你的治疗之雨中最多5个敌人造成379点自然伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 升腾 / 治疗之潮图腾

options.description_en:
Immediately heals for 4,885 split between allies within 20 yds and transforms into a Water Ascendant for 15 sec.

While ascended, Chain Heal jumps to 3 additional allies with 10% healing reduced for all jumps, Healing Wave always critical heals and heals 1 additional ally at 50% effectiveness, and the mana cost of Chain Heal and Healing Wave is reduced by 25%.
options.description_zh:
立即为20码内的盟友恢复总计4,992点生命值，由受影响的盟友分摊，并转化成流水升腾者形态，持续15秒。

升腾状态下，治疗链可以额外跳向3个目标，且所有跳跃的治疗效果降低10%；治疗波必定产生暴击，且会额外治疗1个目标，效果为初始目标的50%；此外，治疗链和治疗波的法力消耗降低25%。

options.description_en:
Summons a totem at your feet for 10 sec, which pulses every 1.8 sec, healing all party or raid members within 40 yards for 1,961.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
在你的脚下召唤一个图腾，持续10秒。该图腾每1.8秒作用一次，为40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员恢复1,921点生命值。

目标超过5个时治疗量降低。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Healing Stream Totem by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 治疗之泉图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 巨型图腾 / 迅捷召回

options.description_en: Increases the size and radius of your totems by 15%, and the health of your totems by 30%.
options.description_zh: 图腾的体型和范围扩大15%，图腾的生命值提高30%。

options.description_en:
Successfully removing a harmful effect with Tremor Totem or Poison Cleansing Totem, or controlling an enemy with Capacitor Totem or Earthgrab Totem reduces the cooldown of the totem used by 5 sec.

Cannot occur more than once every 20 sec per totem.
options.description_zh:
战栗图腾或清毒图腾成功移除一个有害效果，或者使用电能图腾或陷地图腾控制一名敌人时，你使用的图腾的冷却时间缩短5秒。

每个图腾每20秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing 1,833 damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 有图腾激活时，图腾每30秒使你获得一个护盾，吸收1,833点伤害，持续30秒。

options.description_en:
Your Healing Stream Totems heals an additional ally at 30% effectiveness.
