options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Nature's Guardian by 15 sec and causes it to heal for an additional 10% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 自然守护者的冷却时间缩短15秒，并使其为你额外恢复10%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Earth Shield has an additional 3 charges and heals you for 25% more.
options.description_zh: 大地之盾额外获得3层，为你恢复的生命值提高25%。

options.description_en:
Increases your maximum mana by 10%.

Tidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.
options.description_zh:
你的最大法力值提高10%。

潮汐奔涌现在可以叠加最多3次。

options.description_en: Using spells with a cast time increases the duration of Spiritwalker's Grace and Spiritwalker's Aegis by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用带有施法时间的法术会使灵魂行者的恩赐和灵魂行者的神盾的持续时间延长1秒，最多可延长4秒。

nodes.name_zh: 潜在智慧 / 万古情谊

options.description_en: Your Ancestors' spells are 25% more powerful.
options.description_zh: 你的先祖的法术效果提高25%。

options.description_en: Ancestors have a 20% chance to call another Ancestor for 8 sec when they depart.
options.description_zh: 先祖有20%的几率在离去时召唤另一位先祖，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 熔岩爆裂获得额外一层充能，造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
When an Ancestor departs, they cast Hydrobubble on a nearby injured ally.

 Hydrobubble
Surrounds your target in a protective water bubble for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs the next 1,795 incoming damage, but the absorb amount decays fully over its duration.
options.description_zh:
先祖离去时会对附近的一个盟友施放水泡。

 源水气泡
用保护性的水泡包裹目标，持续15秒。

该护盾会吸收接下来受到的1,795点伤害，但吸收量会在持续期间衰减耗尽。

options.description_en: Increases the healing done by Healing Wave, Downpour, and Chain Heal by 25%.
options.description_zh: 治疗波、倾盆大雨和治疗链的治疗效果提高25%。

nodes.name_zh: 听从我的召唤 / 例行交流

options.description_en: Ancestors last an additional 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 先祖的持续时间延长4秒。

options.description_en: Riptide has a 15% chance to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 激流有15%的几率在你身边召唤一个先祖，持续8秒。

options.description_en: When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Riptide by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤先祖时，激流冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en:
Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.

Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.
options.description_zh:
生命释放为你召唤一位先祖，持续12秒。

每当你施放治疗或伤害法术，先祖也会施放相似的法术。

options.description_en:
Your next healing or damaging spell is instant, costs no mana, and deals 10% increased damage and healing.

If you know Nature's Swiftness, it is replaced by Ancestral Swiftness and causes Ancestral Swiftness to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的下一个治疗或伤害法术变成瞬发，不会消耗法力值，并且伤害和治疗效果提高10%。

如果你已学会自然迅捷，它会被先祖迅捷替代，且先祖迅捷会为你召唤一位先祖，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Increases the chance for Lava Surge to occur by 20%.
options.description_zh: 熔岩奔腾的触发几率提高20%。

options.description_en: The cast times of Healing Surge, Chain Heal and Lava Burst are reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 治疗之涌、治疗链和熔岩爆裂的施法时间缩短10%。

options.description_en: Your Intellect is increased by 1.0% for each Ancestor active.
options.description_zh: 每个激活的先祖使你的智力提高1.0%。

options.description_en: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
options.description_zh: 你下一次召唤小鬼、虚空行者、夜魔、魅魔、地狱猎犬或恶魔卫士不消耗能量，施法时间缩短90%。

options.description_en: All single-target damage done by you and your minions grants you and your pet shadowy shields that absorb 3% of the damage dealt for 15 sec, up to 5% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 你和你的仆从造成的所有单体伤害会为你和你的宠物提供一个能够吸收伤害的暗影护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的3%，持续15秒，吸收量最多不超过最大生命值的5%。

options.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 50%, but also damages you for 4% of your maximum health every 1 sec. Movement impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until canceled.
options.description_zh: 使你的移动速度提高50%，但每1秒会对你造成4%最大生命值的伤害。期间移动限制效果不会让你的移动速度降低到正常移动速度的100%以下，持续直到主动取消。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Fel Domination by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 使邪能统御的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.1% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 5% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 45%.
options.description_zh:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.1%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的5%。

你的护甲值提高45%。

options.description_en:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
options.description_zh:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.2%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的10%。

你的护甲值提高90%。

options.description_en:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 5% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 1.5%.
options.description_zh:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的5%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低1.5%。

options.description_en:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
options.description_zh:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的10%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低3.0%。

options.description_en: Reduces the damage dealt by Burning Rush by 10%. Burning Rush increases your movement speed by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆燃冲刺造成的伤害降低10%。爆燃冲刺使你的移动速度额外提高20%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
options.description_zh: 打破你的恐惧效果需要的伤害量提高60%。

options.description_en: Your Fear causes the target to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.
options.description_zh: 你的恐惧术将使受影响的目标在原地战栗而不是仓惶地逃跑。

options.description_en: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你和你宠物的最大生命值提高5%。

options.description_en: Banishes an enemy Demon, Aberration, or Elemental, preventing any action for 30 sec. Limit 1. Casting Banish again on the target will cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 放逐一个敌方恶魔、畸变怪或元素生物，使其无法行动，持续30秒。只能对一个目标使用。再次对目标施放放逐术会取消该效果。

options.description_en:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续12秒。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en:
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
强迫目标使用恶魔语，使其所有法术的施放时间延长30%，持续1分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 吸取生命的治疗效果也会以400%的效果治疗你的主要恶魔。

options.description_en: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 使敌方目标因恐惧而逃跑，瘫痪3秒，并为你恢复20%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
options.description_zh:
召唤一道持续15分钟的恶魔法阵。施放恶魔法阵：传送可将你传送到恶魔法阵的位置，并移除所有减速效果。

你还学会了：

 恶魔法阵：传送
将你传送到你的恶魔法阵并移除所有移动减速效果。

options.description_en: Increases your haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 死亡缠绕的射程增加10码，并且死亡缠绕现在会额外治疗5%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 950 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
options.description_zh: 牺牲你当前生命值的20%，为你施加护盾抵挡伤害。该护盾可吸收相当于已牺牲生命值的200%以及额外的950点伤害，持续20秒。可在遭受控制限制效果时施放。

options.description_en: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
options.description_zh: 施放疲劳诅咒、语言诅咒或虚弱诅咒现在会诅咒目标10码范围内的所有敌人。

options.description_en: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
options.description_zh: 治疗石为你恢复额外5%的生命值。

options.description_en: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用恶魔法阵：传送或你的恶魔传送门会使你受到的所有伤害降低4%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取现在可以额外吸收你生命值上限的5%。

options.description_en:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
options.description_zh:
你的主要宠物会获得额外效果。

小鬼：成功施放烧灼驱魔会使目标受到的伤害降低4%，持续5秒。

虚空行者：暗影壁垒的冷却时间缩短30秒。

地狱猎犬：吞噬魔法的冷却时间缩短5秒。

萨亚德：诱惑的冷却时间缩短10秒，并且会使目标快速走向恶魔。

options.description_en: Drain Life now channels 100% faster and restores health 100% faster.
options.description_zh: 吸取生命的引导速度加快100%，恢复生命的速度加快100%。

nodes.name_zh: 恶魔灵液 / 契约供体

options.description_en: Dark Pact sacrifices only 5% of your current health for the same shield value.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约仅会牺牲你当前生命值的5%，获得的护盾值不变。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
options.description_zh: 使你的智力提高3%。

options.description_en: Increases your Leech by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的吸血提高2%。

options.description_en: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
options.description_zh: 你受到爆击的几率降低2%。你的主要恶魔受到的所有伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Drain Life heals for an additional 200% of damage dealt and grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 生命吸取的治疗量额外提高所造成伤害的200%，并获得等同于所造成伤害10%的灵魂榨取。

nodes.name_zh: 意志的力量 / 黑暗协约

options.description_en: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心会使你受到的伤害额外降低15%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Unending Resolve by 45 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心的冷却时间缩短45秒。

options.description_en: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 在两个位置分别召唤一个恶魔传送门。使用者激活传送门后会立即被传送到另一个传送门。每名玩家每90秒只能使用一次恶魔传送门。

nodes.name_zh: 恐惧嚎叫 / 暗影之怒

options.description_en: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 施放出恐怖的嚎叫，使附近10码内的5名敌人在恐惧中逃走，并使其陷入迷惑，持续20秒。受到伤害可能取消此效果。

options.description_en: Stuns all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 使8码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Soulstone and Create Healthstone by 50%.
options.description_zh: 灵魂石和制造治疗石的施法时间缩短50%。

options.description_en:
5% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh:
你所受伤害的5%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高3%。

options.description_en:
10% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 6%.
options.description_zh:
你所受伤害的10%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高6%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
options.description_zh: 恶魔传送门的施法时间缩短0.5秒，并且你现在可以使用两次恶魔传送门才会触发冷却时间。

options.description_en: Soul Leech also heals you for 8% and your pet for 25% of the absorption it grants.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取还会为你和你的宠物恢复生命值，分别为其产生吸收量的8%和25%。

options.description_en: Soul Leech also heals you for 15% and your pet for 50% of the absorption it grants.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取还会为你和你的宠物恢复生命值，分别为其产生吸收量的15%和50%。

options.description_en:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
options.description_zh:
暗影之怒的冷却时间缩短15秒，半径增加2码。

恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短5秒，并且现在额外恐惧5个敌人。

options.description_en:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 25% health. 60 sec cooldown.
options.description_zh:
你为自己召唤的治疗石变为恶魔治疗石，可以在战斗中使用多次。恶魔治疗石无法交易。

恶魔治疗石
立即恢复25%的生命值。 60秒冷却时间。

options.description_en:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh:
消耗一块灵魂碎片，解锁你法术中的隐藏能力。

恶魔法阵：传送：使你的移动速度提高50%，并且使你免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

恶魔传送门：变为瞬发。

吸取生命：获得与治疗量等量的吸收盾，持续30秒。护盾的吸收总量不超过你最大生命值的30%。

治疗石：使你的治疗石的治疗效果提高30%，使用治疗石还会使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

nodes.name_en: Blight of Weakness / Blight of Tongues
nodes.name_zh: 虚弱灾厄 / 语言灾厄

options.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing the time between their attacks by 100% and reducing their critical strike chance by 10% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其攻击间隔延长100%，爆击几率降低10%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

options.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing their casting time of all spells by 100% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其所有法术的施法时间延长100%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

options.description_en:
Bestows a vile malediction upon the target, burning the sinew and muscle of its host, dealing 95 Shadowflame damage immediately and an additional 1,598 Shadowflame damage over 18 sec.

Replaces Corruption.
options.description_zh:
对目标降下恶毒的诅咒，燃烧宿主的经脉与血肉，立即造成94点暗影烈焰伤害，并在接下来的18秒内额外造成1,580点暗影烈焰伤害。

代替腐蚀术。

options.description_en:
A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.

Consuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing 1,342 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
一个恶魔实体寄宿在你的灵魂中，产生灵魂碎片时可以感知其是否为诱人灵魂。

吞噬一个诱人灵魂会释放你的恶魔之魂，对目标周围10码范围内的所有敌人造成1,342点暗影伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Inflicts increasing agony on the target, causing up to 2,854 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Damage starts low and increases over the duration. Refreshing Agony maintains its current damage level.

Agony damage sometimes generates 1 Soul Shard.
options.description_zh:
使目标受到越来越深的痛楚，在18秒内造成最多2,854点暗影伤害。该伤害在初期较低，但随着持续时间会不断提高。在目标身上刷新痛楚时会保持其当前的伤害。

痛楚造成伤害有几率产生1块灵魂碎片。

options.description_en: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的火焰伤害提高6%，你的火焰法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 548 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
options.description_zh:
如果目标受到了你的枯萎影响，施放混乱之箭和暗影灼烧会使其叠加层数增加1层。

每当枯萎叠加一层时，都有几率开始塌缩，每1秒消耗一层效果对宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

options.description_en: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的暗影伤害提高6%，你的暗影法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en:
Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 35% and Rain of Fire by 6%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
options.description_zh:
混乱之箭的伤害提高35%，并且火焰之雨的伤害提高6%。

激活怨毒时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭的伤害提高20%。能量虹吸使恶魔之箭的伤害额外提高20%。

options.description_en:
Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 488 Shadow damage over 10 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.
options.description_zh:
释放你的恶魔之魂会让恶毒的实体侵蚀目标的灵魂，在10秒内造成488点暗影伤害。

重复施加该效果时，剩余伤害会添加到新的蚀魂之咒中。

options.description_en: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔之魂对古尔丹之手的主要目标造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en:
Each Succulent Soul consumed has an increasing chance to unleash the Demonic Soul within you, enabling it to assault your enemies for 9 sec.

 Soul Swipe
Strikes nearby enemies with a malevolent claw, dealing 742 Shadow damage to its target and 495 Shadow damage to other enemies in 10 yds.
options.description_zh:
每消耗一个诱人灵魂，你都有逐渐增高的几率释放你内心的恶魔之魂，使其攻击你的敌人，持续9秒。

 灵魂横扫
用恶毒之爪打击附近的敌人，对其目标造成742点暗影伤害，并对10码范围内的其他敌人造成495点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Afflicts the target with 1,480 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Multiple uses of this ability may overlap.

If dispelled, deals 20,493 damage to the dispeller and silences them for 4 sec. This damage is increased by 15% per stack on the target.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies while afflicted.
options.description_zh:
使目标遭受痛苦，在8秒内造成1,480点暗影伤害。多次使用该技能可以叠加。

如果此效果被驱散，对驱散者造成20,493点伤害，并使其沉默4秒。目标身上每有一层此效果，伤害提高15%。

如果目标在效果持续期间死亡，产生1块灵魂碎片。

options.description_en:
Embeds a demon seed in the enemy target that will explode after 10.7 sec, dealing 884 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards and applying Corruption to them. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

The seed will detonate early if the target is hit by other detonations, or takes 190 damage from your spells.
options.description_zh:
将恶魔之种嵌入敌人身体，10.7秒后爆炸，对10码范围内所有施法者的敌人造成906点暗影伤害，并对其施放腐蚀术。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

如果目标被其他腐蚀之种的爆炸击中，或从你的法术中受到190点伤害，则会提前引爆。

nodes.name_en: Curse of the Satyr / Aura of Enfeeblement
nodes.name_zh: 萨特诅咒 / 虚弱光环

options.description_en:
Curse of Weakness is empowered and transforms into Curse of the Satyr.

 Curse of the Satyr
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% and the casting time of all spells by 30% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
虚弱诅咒被强化，转变为萨特诅咒。

 萨特诅咒
使敌人的攻击间隔延长20%，法术施放时间延长30%，持续2分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 当不灭决心激活时，30码范围内的敌人都会受到语言诅咒和虚弱诅咒影响，效果为100%。

nodes.name_zh: 怨怒祭仪 / 冷心策略

options.description_en: Wither deals 30% increased periodic damage but its duration is 15% shorter.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的持续伤害提高30%，持续时间缩短15%。

options.description_en: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的伤害提高20%。当枯萎通过黑化灵魂获得层数时，有几率再获得一层。

nodes.name_zh: 瑟雷姆的坚韧 / 邪蹄诡图

options.description_en: Dark Pact heals you for 781 every 1 sec while active.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约激活时每1秒为你恢复781点生命值。

options.description_en: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health. Soul Leech now absorbs an additional 15% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 献祭你10%的最大生命值。现在灵魂榨取会额外吸收你最大生命值15%的生命。

options.description_en: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的周期性伤害有几率使你获得怨毒，持续8秒。

nodes.name_en: Gorebound Fortitude / Friends In Dark Places
nodes.name_zh: 血缚之韧 / 黑暗中的朋友

options.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when consuming a Healthstone, increasing its healing by 30% and increasing your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 你在消耗治疗石时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使其治疗效果提高30%，并使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约的吸收量额外提高，数值相当于牺牲生命值的50%。

nodes.name_zh: 命运相连 / 灵魂盛宴

options.description_en:
When you kill a target, its tortured soul is flung into a nearby enemy for 3 sec. This effect inflicts 195 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds every 0.9 sec.

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
当你消灭一个目标后，其饱受磨难的灵魂会砸向附近的一名敌人，持续3秒。该效果每0.9秒对10码内的敌人造成191点暗影伤害。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 当你消灭一个目标后，你有几率获得一个灵魂碎片，并且必定为诱人灵魂。

nodes.name_zh: 永恒奴役 / 血魔的决心

options.description_en: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 邪能统御的冷却时间缩短90秒。

options.description_en: Targets resurrected with Soulstone resurrect with 40% additional health and 80% additional mana.
options.description_zh: 使用灵魂石复活的目标复活时额外拥有40%的生命值和80%的法力值。

options.description_en:
Increases your Mastery by 2%.

This effect is doubled while the demonic entity is aiding you in combat.
options.description_zh:
使你的精通提高2%。

当有恶魔实体协助你作战时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en:
Corruption damage has a chance to cause your next Shadow Bolt or Malefic Grasp to deal 25% increased damage. 

Shadow Bolt is instant cast and Malefic Grasp channels 50% faster when affected.
options.description_zh:
腐蚀术的伤害有一定几率使你的下一次暗影箭或灾难之握造成25%的额外伤害。

受此影响时，暗影箭变为瞬发，灾难之握的引导速度提升50%。

options.description_en:
A ghostly soul haunts a single target, dealing 2,729 Shadow damage and increasing your damage dealt to the target by 16% for 18 sec.

If the target dies, Haunt's cooldown is reset.
options.description_zh:
鬼魂纠缠一个目标，造成2,734点暗影伤害，并使你对该目标造成的伤害提高16%，持续18秒。

如果目标死亡，重置鬼影缠身的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Increases Agony damage by 10% and Agony now hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.
options.description_zh: 痛楚的伤害提高10%，并且痛楚现在会命中目标附近15码内的其他敌人。

options.description_en:
Wither damage increased by 25%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
枯萎的伤害提高25%。

每层枯萎使黑化灵魂造成的伤害提高2%。

options.description_en:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 548 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
options.description_zh:
枯萎叠加至8层后，或者当宿主的生命值降低至20%时，枯萎每1秒对其宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

黑化灵魂造成伤害时，你有一定几率获得碎片动荡。

options.description_en:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
options.description_zh:
枯萎造成的爆击伤害为215%，而不是通常的200%。

黑化灵魂造成的爆击伤害为225%，而不是通常的200%。

options.description_en: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
options.description_zh: 怨毒额外提供4%急速，并且在施放时使激活的枯萎效果额外增加2层。

options.description_en:
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.

Consuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal 914 Shadow damage to your target.
options.description_zh:
你的恶魔之魂造成的伤害提高10%。

消耗恶魔之核会滋养你体内的恶魔实体，使其现身并对目标造成914点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.
options.description_zh:
蚀魂之咒的伤害提高25%，造成伤害的速度加快20%。

消耗恶魔之核会激活命运相连或灵魂盛宴。

options.description_en: Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.
options.description_zh: 野生小鬼的伤害提高35%，内爆的野生小鬼产生恶魔之核的几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Manifested Avarice by 5 sec and increases the damage of Soul Swipe by 10%.
options.description_zh: 具现贪欲的持续时间延长5秒，并使灵魂横扫的伤害提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 强化暗影箭 / 吸取灵魂

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 15% and increases its damage by 40%.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭的施法时间降低15%，伤害提升40%。

options.description_en:
Replaces Shadow Bolt.

Drains the target's soul, causing 2,117 Shadow damage over 4.5 sec.

Damage is increased by 100% against enemies below 20% health.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies during this effect.
options.description_zh:
代替暗影箭。

吸取目标的灵魂，在4.5秒内造成2,117点暗影伤害。

对生命值在20%以下的目标造成的伤害提高100%。

如果目标在效果持续期间死亡，产生1个灵魂碎片。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of Haunt by 35% and reduces its cast time by 0.3 sec.
options.description_zh: 鬼影缠身的伤害提高35%，施法时间缩短0.3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 绝对腐蚀 / 生命虹吸

options.description_en:
Corruption is now permanent and deals 15% increased damage.

Duration reduced to 24 sec against players.
options.description_zh:
腐蚀术变为永久效果，造成的伤害提高15%。

对玩家的持续时间缩短至24秒。

options.description_en: Corruption deals 30% increased damage and its periodic damage heals you for 5% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 腐蚀术的伤害提高30%，并且其周期性伤害会为你恢复所造成伤害的5%。

options.description_en:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
黑暗魔法从你的体内喷薄而出，腐化你的灵魂，持续20秒，对受到你的枯萎影响的敌人造成4,808点暗影烈焰伤害，并使其额外叠加6层。

被腐化时，你的急速提高8%，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术会额外叠加1层枯萎。

options.description_en: Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 你的召唤恶魔暴君法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其获得3个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul have a chance to trigger a Shadow Bolt Volley, dealing 495 Shadow damage to 5 enemies within 10 yards of your current target.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭和吸取灵魂有一定几率触发暗影箭雨，对你当前目标10码范围内的5个敌人造成517点暗影伤害。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul deal 5% increased damage, up to 15%, per damage over time effect you have active on the target.
options.description_zh: 你在目标身上每有一个激活的持续性伤害效果，暗影箭和吸取灵魂对其造成的伤害就会提高5%，最多提高15%。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul deal 10% increased damage, up to 30%, per damage over time effect you have active on the target.
options.description_zh: 你在目标身上每有一个激活的持续性伤害效果，暗影箭和吸取灵魂对其造成的伤害就会提高10%，最多提高30%。

options.description_en: Your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction deal damage 10% faster.
options.description_zh: 你的痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常造成伤害的速度提高10%。

options.description_en: Your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction deal damage 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 你的痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常造成伤害的速度提高20%。

options.description_en:
Consume the life force of each target afflicted by your damaging periodic effects, dealing 12,764 Shadowflame damage over 2.7 sec.

Damage dealt by Dark Harvest heals you for 50% of damage done.
options.description_zh:
吞噬每个受你伤害性持续效果影响的目标的生命力，在2.7秒内造成12,764点暗影烈焰伤害。

幽冥收割造成的伤害会为你恢复相当于伤害值50%的生命值。

options.description_en: Mastery increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高2%。

options.description_en:
Summons a Darkglare from the Twisting Nether that increases the damage of your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 20% while active.

The Darkglare will serve you for 20 sec, blasting its target for 1,830 Shadow damage, increased by 10% for every damage over time effect you have active on their current target.
options.description_zh:
从扭曲虚空召唤一只黑眼，激活期间使你的痛楚，腐蚀术和痛苦无常的伤害提高20%。

黑眼会为你效命，持续20秒，冲击目标，造成1,823点暗影伤害。你在其当前目标身上每有一个持续伤害效果激活，就会使此伤害提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 召唤者之拥 / 牺牲魔典

options.description_en: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和恶魔的伤害提高3%。

options.description_en:
Sacrifices your demon pet for power, gaining its command demon ability, and causing your spells to sometimes also deal 140 additional Shadow damage.

Lasts until canceled or until you summon a demon pet.
options.description_zh:
牺牲你的恶魔宠物来获得力量，获得它的恶魔掌控技能，并使你的法术有时会额外造成141点暗影伤害。

持续直到主动取消或者直到你召唤出一个恶魔宠物为止。

options.description_en: Casting Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption reduces the cooldown of Dark Harvest by 1.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放痛苦无常或腐蚀之种会使幽冥收割的冷却时间缩短1.5秒。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 5%.
options.description_zh: 痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Agony damage is increased by 10% and starts at 3 stacks.
options.description_zh: 痛楚的伤害提高10%，并且起始层数为3层。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Summon Darkglare by 5.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤黑眼的持续时间延长5.0秒。

options.description_en:
While Darkglare is active, your Shadow Bolt becomes Malefic Grasp. 

 Malefic Grasp
Binds the target in twilight, dealing 4,003 Shadow damage over 3.6 sec.

When Malefic Grasp deals damage, it causes all of your other periodic Affliction damage effects to instantly deal 30% of their normal periodic damage.
options.description_zh:
黑眼激活时，你的暗影箭转化为灾难之握。

灾难之握
用暮光束缚目标，在3.6秒内造成4,003点暗影伤害。

灾难之握造成伤害时，会使你所有其他痛苦系持续伤害效果立即造成相当于其正常周期性伤害的30%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Adorns your Darkglare with armor forged from within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. 

Eye Beam now jumps to up to 4 additional targets within 10 yards and deals 10% increased damage.
options.description_zh:
为你的黑眼装备源自安托鲁斯的战铠，使其护甲值提高10%。

眼棱现在会在10码范围内额外弹射至最多4个目标，并造成10%额外伤害。

options.description_en: Corruption damage is increased by 15%, and each time it deals damage any of your Curses active on the target are extended by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 腐蚀术的伤害提高15%，且每次造成伤害时，你施放在目标身上的诅咒都会延长0.5秒。

options.description_en: Increases critical strike damage dealt by Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 15%.
options.description_zh: 痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Damage dealt by Shadow Bolt has a 20% chance to make your next Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption cost no Soul Shards and cast instantly.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭造成的伤害有20%的几率使你的下一个痛苦无常或腐蚀之种不消耗灵魂碎片，且变为瞬发。

options.description_en: Increases damage dealt by Agony and Corruption by 10%.
options.description_zh: 痛楚和腐蚀术的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases damage dealt by Unstable Affliction and Seed of Corruption by 5%.
options.description_zh: 痛苦无常和腐蚀之种的伤害提高5%。

options.description_en:
Shadow Bolt and Malefic Grasp damage increased by 10% or 20% if the target is affected by Haunt. 

Dark Harvest damage increased by 10% or 20% if the target is affected by Haunt.
options.description_zh:
暗影箭和灾难之握造成的伤害提高10%，若目标受到鬼影缠身影响则提高20%。

幽冥收割造成的伤害提高10%，若目标受到鬼影缠身影响则提高20%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Unstable Affliction by 0.15 sec and increases its damage by 5%.
options.description_zh: 痛苦无常的施法时间缩短0.15秒，其伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Unstable Affliction by 0.30 sec and increases its damage by 10%.
options.description_zh: 痛苦无常的施法时间缩短0.30秒，其伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Critical strikes from your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction have a chance to grant Nightfall.
options.description_zh: 你的痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击有几率触发夜幕。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Seed of Corruption by 0.20 sec and increases its damage by 5%.
options.description_zh: 腐蚀之种的施法时间缩短0.20秒，其伤害提高5%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Seed of Corruption by 0.40 sec and increases its damage by 10%.
options.description_zh: 腐蚀之种的施法时间缩短0.40秒，其伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: When Unstable Affliction expires, it has a 10% chance to reapply itself.
options.description_zh: 当你的痛苦无常持续时间结束时，有10%几率重新施放。

options.description_en: Casting Unstable Affliction on a target affected by your Unstable Affliction increases your Haste by 5% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 对一个受到痛苦无常影响的目标施放痛苦无常，会使你的急速提高5%，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Agony, Corruption, Unstable Affliction, Seed of Corruption, and Shadow Bolt deal up to 40% increased damage on targets below 35% health. Damage increase is higher against lower health targets.
options.description_zh: 痛楚、腐蚀术、痛苦无常、腐蚀之种和暗影箭对生命值低于35%的目标额外造成最多40%的伤害。对生命值越低的目标造成的伤害越高。

options.description_en:
Increases Drain Life damage by 10% and Siphon Life now increases the damage of Corruption by an additional 10%.

Dark Harvest channels 10% faster and deals 15% increased damage.
options.description_zh:
使吸取生命的伤害提高10%，生命虹吸现在会使腐蚀术的伤害额外提高10%。

幽冥收割的引导速度加快10%，造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Seed of Corruption now embeds demon seeds into 2 additional nearby enemies at 50% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 腐蚀之种现在会以50%的效果向附近额外的2个敌人身上植入恶魔之种。

options.description_en:
Haunt now calls upon a demonic soul from within the Twisting Nether to haunt your target.

The soul is unstable and ravenous, dealing 3,093 Shadow damage to its host and 3 enemies within 10 yards suffering from your Corruption over its duration.
options.description_zh:
鬼影缠身现在会从扭曲虚空中召唤一个恶魔灵魂来折磨你的目标。

该灵魂不稳定且贪婪，在其持续时间内会对宿主和10码范围内3个受到你腐蚀术影响的目标造成3,093点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.

Consuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal 914 Shadow damage to your target.
options.description_zh:
你的恶魔之魂造成的伤害提高10%。

消耗恶魔之核会滋养你体内的恶魔实体，使其现身并对目标造成914点暗影伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 命运相连 / 灵魂盛宴

options.description_en:
When you kill a target, its tortured soul is flung into a nearby enemy for 3 sec. This effect inflicts 190 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds every 0.9 sec.

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
当你消灭一个目标后，其饱受磨难的灵魂会砸向附近的一名敌人，持续3秒。该效果每0.9秒对10码内的敌人造成192点暗影伤害。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 当你消灭一个目标后，你有几率获得一个灵魂碎片，并且必定为诱人灵魂。

nodes.name_zh: 永恒奴役 / 血魔的决心

options.description_en: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 邪能统御的冷却时间缩短90秒。

options.description_en: Targets resurrected with Soulstone resurrect with 40% additional health and 80% additional mana.
options.description_zh: 使用灵魂石复活的目标复活时额外拥有40%的生命值和80%的法力值。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭的伤害提高20%。能量虹吸使恶魔之箭的伤害额外提高20%。

options.description_en: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔之魂对古尔丹之手的主要目标造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.
options.description_zh: 野生小鬼的伤害提高35%，内爆的野生小鬼产生恶魔之核的几率提高5%。

options.description_en:
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.
options.description_zh:
蚀魂之咒的伤害提高25%，造成伤害的速度加快20%。

消耗恶魔之核会激活命运相连或灵魂盛宴。

options.description_en:
Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 488 Shadow damage over 10 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.
options.description_zh:
释放你的恶魔之魂会让恶毒的实体侵蚀目标的灵魂，在10秒内造成488点暗影伤害。

重复施加该效果时，剩余伤害会添加到新的蚀魂之咒中。

nodes.name_en: Gorebound Fortitude / Friends In Dark Places
nodes.name_zh: 血缚之韧 / 黑暗中的朋友

options.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when consuming a Healthstone, increasing its healing by 30% and increasing your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 你在消耗治疗石时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使其治疗效果提高30%，并使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约的吸收量额外提高，数值相当于牺牲生命值的50%。

options.description_en:
A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.

Consuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing 1,342 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
一个恶魔实体寄宿在你的灵魂中，产生灵魂碎片时可以感知其是否为诱人灵魂。

吞噬一个诱人灵魂会释放你的恶魔之魂，对目标周围10码范围内的所有敌人造成1,342点暗影伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 你的召唤恶魔暴君法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其获得3个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Manifested Avarice by 5 sec and increases the damage of Soul Swipe by 10%.
options.description_zh: 具现贪欲的持续时间延长5秒，并使灵魂横扫的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Increases your Mastery by 2%.

This effect is doubled while the demonic entity is aiding you in combat.
options.description_zh:
使你的精通提高2%。

当有恶魔实体协助你作战时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en:
Each Succulent Soul consumed has an increasing chance to unleash the Demonic Soul within you, enabling it to assault your enemies for 9 sec.

 Soul Swipe
Strikes nearby enemies with a malevolent claw, dealing 742 Shadow damage to its target and 495 Shadow damage to other enemies in 10 yds.
options.description_zh:
每消耗一个诱人灵魂，你都有逐渐增高的几率释放你内心的恶魔之魂，使其攻击你的敌人，持续9秒。

 灵魂横扫
用恶毒之爪打击附近的敌人，对其目标造成742点暗影伤害，并对10码范围内的其他敌人造成495点暗影伤害。

nodes.name_en: Curse of the Satyr / Aura of Enfeeblement
nodes.name_zh: 萨特诅咒 / 虚弱光环

options.description_en:
Curse of Weakness is empowered and transforms into Curse of the Satyr.

 Curse of the Satyr
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% and the casting time of all spells by 30% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
虚弱诅咒被强化，转变为萨特诅咒。

 萨特诅咒
使敌人的攻击间隔延长20%，法术施放时间延长30%，持续2分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 当不灭决心激活时，30码范围内的敌人都会受到语言诅咒和虚弱诅咒影响，效果为100%。

options.description_en:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 548 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
options.description_zh:
枯萎叠加至8层后，或者当宿主的生命值降低至20%时，枯萎每1秒对其宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

黑化灵魂造成伤害时，你有一定几率获得碎片动荡。

options.description_en:
Wither damage increased by 25%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
枯萎的伤害提高25%。

每层枯萎使黑化灵魂造成的伤害提高2%。

nodes.name_zh: 瑟雷姆的坚韧 / 邪蹄诡图

options.description_en: Dark Pact heals you for 781 every 1 sec while active.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约激活时每1秒为你恢复781点生命值。

options.description_en: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health. Soul Leech now absorbs an additional 15% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 献祭你10%的最大生命值。现在灵魂榨取会额外吸收你最大生命值15%的生命。

options.description_en:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 548 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
options.description_zh:
如果目标受到了你的枯萎影响，施放混乱之箭和暗影灼烧会使其叠加层数增加1层。

每当枯萎叠加一层时，都有几率开始塌缩，每1秒消耗一层效果对宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

options.description_en:
Bestows a vile malediction upon the target, burning the sinew and muscle of its host, dealing 94 Shadowflame damage immediately and an additional 1,564 Shadowflame damage over 18 sec.

Replaces Corruption.
options.description_zh:
对目标降下恶毒的诅咒，燃烧宿主的经脉与血肉，立即造成93点暗影烈焰伤害，并在接下来的18秒内额外造成1,601点暗影烈焰伤害。

代替腐蚀术。

options.description_en:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
黑暗魔法从你的体内喷薄而出，腐化你的灵魂，持续20秒，对受到你的枯萎影响的敌人造成4,808点暗影烈焰伤害，并使其额外叠加6层。

被腐化时，你的急速提高8%，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术会额外叠加1层枯萎。

options.description_en:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
options.description_zh:
枯萎造成的爆击伤害为215%，而不是通常的200%。

黑化灵魂造成的爆击伤害为225%，而不是通常的200%。

options.description_en: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的暗影伤害提高6%，你的暗影法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的火焰伤害提高6%，你的火焰法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 怨怒祭仪 / 冷心策略

options.description_en: Wither deals 30% increased periodic damage but its duration is 15% shorter.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的持续伤害提高30%，持续时间缩短15%。

options.description_en: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的伤害提高20%。当枯萎通过黑化灵魂获得层数时，有几率再获得一层。

options.description_en: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
options.description_zh: 怨毒额外提供4%急速，并且在施放时使激活的枯萎效果额外增加2层。

options.description_en: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的周期性伤害有几率使你获得怨毒，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 35% and Rain of Fire by 6%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
options.description_zh:
混乱之箭的伤害提高35%，并且火焰之雨的伤害提高6%。

激活怨毒时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
options.description_zh: 你下一次召唤小鬼、虚空行者、夜魔、魅魔、地狱猎犬或恶魔卫士不消耗能量，施法时间缩短90%。

options.description_en: All single-target damage done by you and your minions grants you and your pet shadowy shields that absorb 3% of the damage dealt for 15 sec, up to 5% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 你和你的仆从造成的所有单体伤害会为你和你的宠物提供一个能够吸收伤害的暗影护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的3%，持续15秒，吸收量最多不超过最大生命值的5%。

options.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 50%, but also damages you for 4% of your maximum health every 1 sec. Movement impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until canceled.
options.description_zh: 使你的移动速度提高50%，但每1秒会对你造成4%最大生命值的伤害。期间移动限制效果不会让你的移动速度降低到正常移动速度的100%以下，持续直到主动取消。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Fel Domination by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 使邪能统御的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.1% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 5% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 45%.
options.description_zh:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.1%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的5%。

你的护甲值提高45%。

options.description_en:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
options.description_zh:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.2%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的10%。

你的护甲值提高90%。

options.description_en:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 5% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 1.5%.
options.description_zh:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的5%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低1.5%。

options.description_en:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
options.description_zh:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的10%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低3.0%。

options.description_en: Reduces the damage dealt by Burning Rush by 10%. Burning Rush increases your movement speed by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆燃冲刺造成的伤害降低10%。爆燃冲刺使你的移动速度额外提高20%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
options.description_zh: 打破你的恐惧效果需要的伤害量提高60%。

options.description_en: Your Fear causes the target to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.
options.description_zh: 你的恐惧术将使受影响的目标在原地战栗而不是仓惶地逃跑。

options.description_en: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你和你宠物的最大生命值提高5%。

options.description_en: Banishes an enemy Demon, Aberration, or Elemental, preventing any action for 30 sec. Limit 1. Casting Banish again on the target will cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 放逐一个敌方恶魔、畸变怪或元素生物，使其无法行动，持续30秒。只能对一个目标使用。再次对目标施放放逐术会取消该效果。

options.description_en:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续12秒。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en:
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
强迫目标使用恶魔语，使其所有法术的施放时间延长30%，持续1分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 吸取生命的治疗效果也会以400%的效果治疗你的主要恶魔。

options.description_en: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 使敌方目标因恐惧而逃跑，瘫痪3秒，并为你恢复20%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
options.description_zh:
召唤一道持续15分钟的恶魔法阵。施放恶魔法阵：传送可将你传送到恶魔法阵的位置，并移除所有减速效果。

你还学会了：

 恶魔法阵：传送
将你传送到你的恶魔法阵并移除所有移动减速效果。

options.description_en: Increases your haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 死亡缠绕的射程增加10码，并且死亡缠绕现在会额外治疗5%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 950 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
options.description_zh: 牺牲你当前生命值的20%，为你施加护盾抵挡伤害。该护盾可吸收相当于已牺牲生命值的200%以及额外的950点伤害，持续20秒。可在遭受控制限制效果时施放。

options.description_en: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
options.description_zh: 施放疲劳诅咒、语言诅咒或虚弱诅咒现在会诅咒目标10码范围内的所有敌人。

options.description_en: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
options.description_zh: 治疗石为你恢复额外5%的生命值。

options.description_en: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用恶魔法阵：传送或你的恶魔传送门会使你受到的所有伤害降低4%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取现在可以额外吸收你生命值上限的5%。

options.description_en:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
options.description_zh:
你的主要宠物会获得额外效果。

小鬼：成功施放烧灼驱魔会使目标受到的伤害降低4%，持续5秒。

虚空行者：暗影壁垒的冷却时间缩短30秒。

地狱猎犬：吞噬魔法的冷却时间缩短5秒。

萨亚德：诱惑的冷却时间缩短10秒，并且会使目标快速走向恶魔。

options.description_en: Drain Life now channels 100% faster and restores health 100% faster.
options.description_zh: 吸取生命的引导速度加快100%，恢复生命的速度加快100%。

nodes.name_zh: 恶魔灵液 / 契约供体

options.description_en: Dark Pact sacrifices only 5% of your current health for the same shield value.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约仅会牺牲你当前生命值的5%，获得的护盾值不变。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
options.description_zh: 使你的智力提高3%。

options.description_en: Increases your Leech by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的吸血提高2%。

options.description_en: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
options.description_zh: 你受到爆击的几率降低2%。你的主要恶魔受到的所有伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Drain Life heals for an additional 200% of damage dealt and grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 生命吸取的治疗量额外提高所造成伤害的200%，并获得等同于所造成伤害10%的灵魂榨取。

nodes.name_zh: 意志的力量 / 黑暗协约

options.description_en: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心会使你受到的伤害额外降低15%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Unending Resolve by 45 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心的冷却时间缩短45秒。

options.description_en: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 在两个位置分别召唤一个恶魔传送门。使用者激活传送门后会立即被传送到另一个传送门。每名玩家每90秒只能使用一次恶魔传送门。

nodes.name_zh: 恐惧嚎叫 / 暗影之怒

options.description_en: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 施放出恐怖的嚎叫，使附近10码内的5名敌人在恐惧中逃走，并使其陷入迷惑，持续20秒。受到伤害可能取消此效果。

options.description_en: Stuns all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 使8码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Soulstone and Create Healthstone by 50%.
options.description_zh: 灵魂石和制造治疗石的施法时间缩短50%。

options.description_en:
5% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh:
你所受伤害的5%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高3%。

options.description_en:
10% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 6%.
options.description_zh:
你所受伤害的10%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高6%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
options.description_zh: 恶魔传送门的施法时间缩短0.5秒，并且你现在可以使用两次恶魔传送门才会触发冷却时间。

options.description_en: Soul Leech also heals you for 8% and your pet for 25% of the absorption it grants.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取还会为你和你的宠物恢复生命值，分别为其产生吸收量的8%和25%。

options.description_en: Soul Leech also heals you for 15% and your pet for 50% of the absorption it grants.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取还会为你和你的宠物恢复生命值，分别为其产生吸收量的15%和50%。

options.description_en:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
options.description_zh:
暗影之怒的冷却时间缩短15秒，半径增加2码。

恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短5秒，并且现在额外恐惧5个敌人。

options.description_en:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 25% health. 60 sec cooldown.
options.description_zh:
你为自己召唤的治疗石变为恶魔治疗石，可以在战斗中使用多次。恶魔治疗石无法交易。

恶魔治疗石
立即恢复25%的生命值。 60秒冷却时间。

options.description_en:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh:
消耗一块灵魂碎片，解锁你法术中的隐藏能力。

恶魔法阵：传送：使你的移动速度提高50%，并且使你免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

恶魔传送门：变为瞬发。

吸取生命：获得与治疗量等量的吸收盾，持续30秒。护盾的吸收总量不超过你最大生命值的30%。

治疗石：使你的治疗石的治疗效果提高30%，使用治疗石还会使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

nodes.name_en: Blight of Weakness / Blight of Tongues
nodes.name_zh: 虚弱灾厄 / 语言灾厄

options.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing the time between their attacks by 100% and reducing their critical strike chance by 10% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其攻击间隔延长100%，爆击几率降低10%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

options.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing their casting time of all spells by 100% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其所有法术的施法时间延长100%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

options.description_en:
A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.

Consuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing 1,342 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
一个恶魔实体寄宿在你的灵魂中，产生灵魂碎片时可以感知其是否为诱人灵魂。

吞噬一个诱人灵魂会释放你的恶魔之魂，对目标周围10码范围内的所有敌人造成1,342点暗影伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Calls down a demonic meteor full of Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target.

Deals up to 570 Shadowflame damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summons 3 Wild Imps.
options.description_zh:
召唤一枚装满野生小鬼的恶魔流星，爆炸后攻击敌人。

命中时对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成最多585点暗影烈焰伤害，并召唤3个野生小鬼。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭的伤害提高20%。能量虹吸使恶魔之箭的伤害额外提高20%。

options.description_en:
Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 488 Shadow damage over 10 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.
options.description_zh:
释放你的恶魔之魂会让恶毒的实体侵蚀目标的灵魂，在10秒内造成488点暗影伤害。

重复施加该效果时，剩余伤害会添加到新的蚀魂之咒中。

options.description_en: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔之魂对古尔丹之手的主要目标造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en:
Each Succulent Soul consumed has an increasing chance to unleash the Demonic Soul within you, enabling it to assault your enemies for 9 sec.

 Soul Swipe
Strikes nearby enemies with a malevolent claw, dealing 742 Shadow damage to its target and 495 Shadow damage to other enemies in 10 yds.
options.description_zh:
每消耗一个诱人灵魂，你都有逐渐增高的几率释放你内心的恶魔之魂，使其攻击你的敌人，持续9秒。

 灵魂横扫
用恶毒之爪打击附近的敌人，对其目标造成742点暗影伤害，并对10码范围内的其他敌人造成495点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Grants access to the following abilities:

 Demonbolt
Send the fiery soul of a fallen demon at the enemy, causing 3,010 Shadowflame damage.

 Demonic Core
When your Wild Imps fade or are imploded, you have a 10% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core. 

When your summoned Dreadstalkers fade away, you have a 100% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core.

Demonic Core reduces the cast time of Demonbolt by 100%. Maximum 4 stacks.
options.description_zh:
获得以下技能：

 恶魔之箭
向敌人发射死亡恶魔的燃烧之魂，造成2,992点暗影烈焰伤害。

 恶魔之核
当你的野生小鬼消失或爆炸时，你有10%的几率吸收掉它们的生命精华，使你获得一层恶魔之核。

当你召唤的恐惧猎犬消失时，你有100%的几率吸收它们的生命精华，使你获得一层恶魔之核。

恶魔之核可以使恶魔之箭的施法时间降低100%，最多叠加4次。

options.description_en: Summons 2 ferocious Dreadstalkers to attack the target for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤2只凶猛的恐惧猎犬攻击目标，持续12秒。

nodes.name_en: Gorebound Fortitude / Friends In Dark Places
nodes.name_zh: 血缚之韧 / 黑暗中的朋友

options.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when consuming a Healthstone, increasing its healing by 30% and increasing your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 你在消耗治疗石时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使其治疗效果提高30%，并使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约的吸收量额外提高，数值相当于牺牲生命值的50%。

nodes.name_zh: 命运相连 / 灵魂盛宴

options.description_en:
When you kill a target, its tortured soul is flung into a nearby enemy for 3 sec. This effect inflicts 192 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds every 0.9 sec.

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
当你消灭一个目标后，其饱受磨难的灵魂会砸向附近的一名敌人，持续3秒。该效果每0.9秒对10码内的敌人造成196点暗影伤害。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 当你消灭一个目标后，你有几率获得一个灵魂碎片，并且必定为诱人灵魂。

nodes.name_zh: 永恒奴役 / 血魔的决心

options.description_en: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 邪能统御的冷却时间缩短90秒。

options.description_en: Targets resurrected with Soulstone resurrect with 40% additional health and 80% additional mana.
options.description_zh: 使用灵魂石复活的目标复活时额外拥有40%的生命值和80%的法力值。

options.description_en:
Increases your Mastery by 2%.

This effect is doubled while the demonic entity is aiding you in combat.
options.description_zh:
使你的精通提高2%。

当有恶魔实体协助你作战时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en: Increases damage dealt by Hand of Gul'dan to its main target by 20%.
options.description_zh: 使古尔丹之手对其主要目标造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的智力提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases your Mastery by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的精通提高2%。

options.description_en: When your Dreadstalkers charge into battle, their Dreadbite attack now hits all targets within 8 yards and deals 10% more damage.
options.description_zh: 当你的恐惧猎犬冲进战场时，恐惧之咬造成的伤害提高10%，且会攻击8码内的所有目标。

options.description_en:
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.

Consuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal 914 Shadow damage to your target.
options.description_zh:
你的恶魔之魂造成的伤害提高10%。

消耗恶魔之核会滋养你体内的恶魔实体，使其现身并对目标造成914点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.
options.description_zh:
蚀魂之咒的伤害提高25%，造成伤害的速度加快20%。

消耗恶魔之核会激活命运相连或灵魂盛宴。

options.description_en: Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.
options.description_zh: 野生小鬼的伤害提高35%，内爆的野生小鬼产生恶魔之核的几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Manifested Avarice by 5 sec and increases the damage of Soul Swipe by 10%.
options.description_zh: 具现贪欲的持续时间延长5秒，并使灵魂横扫的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wild Imp's Fel Firebolt by 15%.
options.description_zh: 野生小鬼的恶魔火焰箭爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Demonic forces suck 6 of your Wild Imps toward the target, and then cause them to violently explode, dealing 511 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
options.description_zh: 恶魔之力将你的6只野生小鬼吸引到目标周围，然后使其发生强烈的爆炸，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成517点暗影烈焰伤害。

options.description_en: Instantly sacrifice up to 2 Wild Imps, generating 2 charges of Demonic Core that cause Demonbolt to deal 30% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 立刻牺牲最多2个野生小鬼，获得2层恶魔之核。恶魔之核可以使恶魔之箭额外造成30%的伤害。

options.description_en: Summons a Felguard under your command as a powerful melee combatant.
options.description_zh: 召唤一个恶魔卫士为你作战，恶魔卫士是强大的近战斗士。

options.description_en: Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 你的召唤恶魔暴君法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其获得3个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。

options.description_en: When your Wild Imps cast Fel Firebolt, they have 10% chance to instantly cast another Fel Firebolt at 200% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 当你的野生小鬼施放恶魔火焰箭时，有10%的几率立即额外施放一次效果为200%的恶魔火焰箭。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 10% and increases its damage by 15%.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭的施法时间降低10%，伤害提升15%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 20% and increases its damage by 30%.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭的施法时间降低20%，伤害提升30%。

options.description_en: Your Dreadstalkers' attacks have a 10% chance to trigger an additional Dreadbite.
options.description_zh: 你的恐惧猎犬的攻击有10%的几率触发一次额外的恐惧之咬。

options.description_en: Your Dreadstalkers' attacks have a 20% chance to trigger an additional Dreadbite.
options.description_zh: 你的恐惧猎犬的攻击有20%的几率触发一次额外的恐惧之咬。

options.description_en: The cooldown of your Felguard's Felstorm is reduced by 10 sec and damage dealt to your primary demon is reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔卫士的邪能风暴的冷却时间缩短10秒，你的主要恶魔受到的伤害降低10%。

options.description_en:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.
options.description_zh:
施放混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧会使你获得敬魔仪式，持续20秒。如果敬魔仪式已经激活，则使其持续时间减少1秒。

敬魔仪式结束时，你获得恶魔法术，使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧召唤一个主宰、混沌之母或深渊领主，对敌人施展一次毁灭性攻击。

options.description_en: Hand of Gul'dan now empowers 1 of the Wild Imps it summons, increasing its damage dealt by 100%.
options.description_zh: 古尔丹之手现在会强化其召唤的1个野生小鬼，使其造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Damaging critical strikes dealt by you and your demons deal 230% damage instead of the usual 200%.
options.description_zh: 你与恶魔造成的伤害性爆击会造成230%的伤害，而非通常的200%。

options.description_en: You passively summon a Wild Imp to fight for you every 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 你每12秒自动召唤一个野生小鬼为你而战。

options.description_en:
Summon a Demonic Tyrant that damages your target for 15 sec. 

Damage dealt by Demonic Tyrant is increased by 10% for each Wild Imp and Dreadstalker active.
options.description_zh:
召唤一个恶魔暴君攻击目标，持续15秒。

每存在一个野生小鬼和恐惧猎犬，恶魔暴君造成的伤害就提高10%。

options.description_en: The fangs of your Dreadstalkers are coated in corrosive bile, causing Dreadbite to deal additional damage equal to 50% of damage dealt as Plague damage.
options.description_zh: 你的恐惧猎犬獠牙沾满腐蚀胆汁，使恐惧之咬造成50%的额外伤害，这些伤害被视为瘟疫伤害。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your primary demon by 50% of your critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 使你的主要恶魔的爆击几率提高，数值等同于你爆击几率的50%。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of your Felguard's Felstorm by 20% and its duration by 4.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔卫士的邪能风暴的伤害提高20%，持续时间延长4.0秒。

options.description_en: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 主宰对敌人造成伤害时击溃他们的灵魂，使其受到你和你的宠物的伤害提高5%，持续15秒。

options.description_en:
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
options.description_zh:
恶魔法术使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧伤害提高20%，施法时间缩短50%。

施放混乱之箭会使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外减少1秒。

options.description_en:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 5,119 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.
options.description_zh:
混沌之母强化你的下一个烧尽，使其变为狱火箭。

 狱火箭
射出一支包裹在深渊狱火中的飞箭，对敌方目标造成5,119点火焰伤害，并产生3个灵魂碎片。

options.description_en:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 891 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
每当你的法术缩短敬魔仪式的持续时间时，你都会召唤一个恶魔邪眼，最多3个。

恶魔邪眼在消耗恶魔法术时会爆炸，对目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成891点火焰伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en: Increases Demonbolt damage by 10% and consuming a Demonic Core has a chance to summon a Wild Imp.
options.description_zh: 恶魔之箭造成的伤害提高10%。消耗一个恶魔之核有几率召唤一只野生小鬼。

options.description_en: Your Demonic Tyrant also empowers you while active, increasing your haste by 8%.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔暴君在激活期间还会强化你，使你的急速提高8%。

options.description_en:
Your Demonic Tyrant is equipped with armor forged within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. While summoned, your Demonic Tyrant now assaults enemies with powerful melee attacks.

 Burning Cleave
Cleaves the area in front of the caster, inflicting 367 Shadowflame damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
你的恶魔暴君装备了在安托鲁斯锻造的护甲，使其护甲值提高10%。被召唤时，你的恶魔暴君现在会用强大的近战攻击打击敌人。

 炽燃顺劈
劈砍施法者面前区域的敌人，造成364点暗影烈焰伤害。超过8个目标时伤害降低。

options.description_en: Increases the attack speed of your Dreadstalkers by 10% and their critical strike chance by 15%.
options.description_zh: 使你的恐惧猎犬攻击速度提高10%，爆击几率提高15%。

nodes.name_zh: 刻魂法阵 / 安尼赫兰的咆哮

options.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when casting Demonic Circle: Teleport, increasing your movement speed by 50% and making you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 你在施放恶魔法阵：传送时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使你的移动速度提高50%，并且免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Howl of Terror cooldown is reduced by 10 sec and range is increased by 5 yds.
options.description_zh: 恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短10秒，范围扩大5码。

nodes.name_zh: 科善的暴虐 / 炼狱装置

options.description_en: Summon Infernal grants Diabolic Ritual and reduces its duration by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤地狱火会触发敬魔仪式，并使其持续时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
options.description_zh: 你的地狱火激活时，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外缩短1秒。

nodes.name_zh: 狱火活力 / 狱火壁垒

options.description_en: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心在10秒内为你恢复最大生命值的30%。

options.description_en: Unending Resolve grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of your maximum health and increases the maximum amount Soul Leech can absorb by 10% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心产生相当于最大生命值的10%的灵魂榨取吸收量，并使灵魂榨取的吸收量最大值提高10%，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 304 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.
options.description_zh:
你的天魔邪眼激活时，现在会每1秒对你的主要恶魔的目标施放天魔凝视。

 天魔凝视
向目标发射一道毁灭性的混乱魔法光束，造成304点混乱伤害。

每个激活的恶魔邪眼会使伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Hand of Gul'dan has a 8% chance to generate a charge of Demonic Core.
options.description_zh: 古尔丹之手有8%的几率充能一层恶魔之核。

options.description_en: Hand of Gul'dan has a 15% chance to generate a charge of Demonic Core.
options.description_zh: 古尔丹之手有15%的几率充能一层恶魔之核。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt and Demonbolt deal 2% additional damage per demon you have summoned.
options.description_zh: 你每召唤了一个恶魔，就会使暗影箭和恶魔之箭造成的伤害提高2%。

options.description_en: Your Demonic Tyrant lasts an additional 5 sec and extends the duration of your Dreadstalkers by 15 sec when summoned.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔暴君持续时间额外延长5秒，并在召唤时将你的恐惧猎犬的持续时间延长15秒。

options.description_en: Increases Mastery by 3% and reduces the cast time of your Summon Demonic Tyrant and Summon Felguard by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 精通提高3%，召唤恶魔暴君和恶魔卫士的施法时间缩短0.5秒。

options.description_en: Call Dreadstalkers costs 1 less Soul Shard and its cast time is reduced by 50%.
options.description_zh: 召唤恐惧猎犬消耗的灵魂碎片减少1片，其施法时间缩短50%。

options.description_en: Call Dreadstalkers costs 2 less Soul Shards and its cast time is reduced by 100%.
options.description_zh: 召唤恐惧猎犬消耗的灵魂碎片减少2片，其施法时间缩短100%。

options.description_en: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 火焰伤害提高4%，你的恶魔造成的伤害提高4%。

options.description_en: Summon Infernal becomes empowered, dealing 40% increased damage. When your Summon Infernal ends, it fragments into two smaller Infernals at 50% effectiveness that lasts 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 强化召唤地狱火，造成的伤害提高40%。当你的召唤地狱火结束时，它会分裂成两个较小的地狱火，产生50%的效果，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Enemies marked by your Havoc take 7% increased damage from your single target spells.
options.description_zh: 被你的浩劫标记的敌人受到你的单目标法术伤害提高7%。

options.description_en: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的天魔邪眼观察战场并收集信息，在爆炸时将信息传递给你，每个天魔邪眼都会使你的智力提高2%，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
When Demonbolt consumes a Demonic Core it inflicts impending doom upon the target, dealing 1,531 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds of its target after 20 sec or when removed. Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hand of Gul'dan reduces the duration of Doom by 3 sec.
options.description_zh:
当恶魔之箭消耗一个恶魔之核时，它会让末日降临到目标身上，在20秒后或效果移除时，对目标周围10码范围内的敌人造成1,531点暗影伤害。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

古尔丹之手使末日降临效果的持续时间减少3秒。

options.description_en: Your demons deal 1.0% increased damage for each demon you control.
options.description_zh: 你控制的每个恶魔都会使你的恶魔造成的伤害提高1.0%。

nodes.name_en: Grimoire: Imp Lord / Grimoire: Fel Ravager
nodes.name_zh: 魔典：小鬼领主 / 魔典：邪能破坏者

options.description_en:
Summons an Imp Lord to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will remove 1 harmful effect from you when summoned. 

Transforms into Singe Magic while on cooldown.
options.description_zh:
召唤一个小鬼领主协助你战斗，持续20秒，并在召唤时为你移除1个有害效果。

在冷却期间转变为烧灼驱魔。

options.description_en:
Summons a Fel Ravager to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will purge 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy.

Turns into Devour Magic while on cooldown.
options.description_zh:
召唤一个邪能破坏者协助你战斗，持续20秒，同时驱散一名敌人身上的1个增益魔法效果。

在冷却期间转变为吞噬魔法。

options.description_en: Call Dreadstalkers also summons a Vilefiend that assists you in combat for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤恐惧猎犬也会召唤一只邪犬协助你作战，持续15秒。

options.description_en:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 9,644 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
召唤深渊领主会使你的下一个混乱之箭变为陨灭。

 陨灭
从扭曲虚空的深处召唤一颗恶魔滋孽的流星，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成9,644点混乱伤害并召唤3个野生小鬼。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Summons a Doomguard to assist you in combat for 12 sec. Consuming a Demonic Core reduces the cooldown of Summon Doomguard by 3 sec.

 Doom Bolt Volley
Sends a volley of malefic bolts at 5 enemies within 40 yds, inflicting 1,551 Shadow damage to each target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一个末日守卫协助你战斗，持续12秒。消耗一个恶魔之核可使召唤末日守卫的冷却时间缩短3秒。

厄运箭雨
向40码内的5名敌人发射灾厄箭雨，对每个目标造成1,568点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Power Siphon and Implosion summon 1 Imp Gang Boss for every 2 Wild Imps sacrificed. Wild Imps summoned this way gain Unstable Soul.

 Unstable Soul
Increases damage done by 50% and Fel Firebolt now jumps to 4 additional targets.
options.description_zh:
能量虹吸和内爆每牺牲2个野生小鬼，便召唤出1个小鬼首领。以这种方式被召唤出的野生小鬼会获得动荡的灵魂。﻿

动荡的灵魂
造成的伤害提高50%，恶魔火焰箭现在会额外弹射至4个目标。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of your Summon Vilefiend, Grimoire: Imp Lord, and Grimoire: Fel Ravager by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 使你的召唤邪犬、魔典：小鬼领主和魔典：邪能破坏者的持续时间延长3秒。

nodes.name_en: Mark of Shatug / Mark of F'harg
nodes.name_zh: 沙图格的印记 / 法尔格的印记

options.description_en:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Gloomhound and learns the following ability:

 Gloom Slash
Tooth and claw are drenched in malignant shadow magic, causing the Gloomhound's melee attacks to deal an additional 120 Shadow damage.
options.description_zh:
你的召唤邪犬变为召唤阴暗恶犬，并习得以下技能：

 阴暗劈裂
尖牙和利爪被恶毒的暗影魔法浸透，使得阴暗恶犬的近战攻击额外造成120点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Charhound and learns the following ability:

 Infernal Presence
Cloaked in the ever-burning flames of the abyss, dealing 60 Fire damage to enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的召唤邪犬变为召唤灼焦恶犬，并习得以下技能：

 狱火气息
身披永燃不灭的深渊烈焰，每0.9秒对10码内的敌人造成60点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Summoning your Demonic Tyrant leaves open a portal to Argus for 15 sec, causing every 2 casts of Hand of Gul'dan to summon a subjugated demon that serves you for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤你的恶魔暴君会打开一个通往阿古斯的传送门，持续15秒，每施放2次古尔丹之手就会召唤一个被征服的恶魔为你战斗10秒。

options.description_en:
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.

Consuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal 914 Shadow damage to your target.
options.description_zh:
你的恶魔之魂造成的伤害提高10%。

消耗恶魔之核会滋养你体内的恶魔实体，使其现身并对目标造成914点暗影伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 命运相连 / 灵魂盛宴

options.description_en:
When you kill a target, its tortured soul is flung into a nearby enemy for 3 sec. This effect inflicts 189 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds every 0.9 sec.

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
当你消灭一个目标后，其饱受磨难的灵魂会砸向附近的一名敌人，持续3秒。该效果每0.9秒对10码内的敌人造成191点暗影伤害。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 当你消灭一个目标后，你有几率获得一个灵魂碎片，并且必定为诱人灵魂。

nodes.name_zh: 永恒奴役 / 血魔的决心

options.description_en: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 邪能统御的冷却时间缩短90秒。

options.description_en: Targets resurrected with Soulstone resurrect with 40% additional health and 80% additional mana.
options.description_zh: 使用灵魂石复活的目标复活时额外拥有40%的生命值和80%的法力值。

options.description_en: Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 暗影箭的伤害提高20%。能量虹吸使恶魔之箭的伤害额外提高20%。

options.description_en: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.
options.description_zh: 你的恶魔之魂对古尔丹之手的主要目标造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.
options.description_zh: 野生小鬼的伤害提高35%，内爆的野生小鬼产生恶魔之核的几率提高5%。

options.description_en:
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.
options.description_zh:
蚀魂之咒的伤害提高25%，造成伤害的速度加快20%。

消耗恶魔之核会激活命运相连或灵魂盛宴。

options.description_en:
Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 488 Shadow damage over 10 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.
options.description_zh:
释放你的恶魔之魂会让恶毒的实体侵蚀目标的灵魂，在10秒内造成488点暗影伤害。

重复施加该效果时，剩余伤害会添加到新的蚀魂之咒中。

nodes.name_en: Gorebound Fortitude / Friends In Dark Places
nodes.name_zh: 血缚之韧 / 黑暗中的朋友

options.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when consuming a Healthstone, increasing its healing by 30% and increasing your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 你在消耗治疗石时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使其治疗效果提高30%，并使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约的吸收量额外提高，数值相当于牺牲生命值的50%。

options.description_en:
A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.

Consuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing 1,342 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
一个恶魔实体寄宿在你的灵魂中，产生灵魂碎片时可以感知其是否为诱人灵魂。

吞噬一个诱人灵魂会释放你的恶魔之魂，对目标周围10码范围内的所有敌人造成1,342点暗影伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.
options.description_zh: 你的召唤恶魔暴君法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其获得3个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Manifested Avarice by 5 sec and increases the damage of Soul Swipe by 10%.
options.description_zh: 具现贪欲的持续时间延长5秒，并使灵魂横扫的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Increases your Mastery by 2%.

This effect is doubled while the demonic entity is aiding you in combat.
options.description_zh:
使你的精通提高2%。

当有恶魔实体协助你作战时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en:
Each Succulent Soul consumed has an increasing chance to unleash the Demonic Soul within you, enabling it to assault your enemies for 9 sec.

 Soul Swipe
Strikes nearby enemies with a malevolent claw, dealing 742 Shadow damage to its target and 495 Shadow damage to other enemies in 10 yds.
options.description_zh:
每消耗一个诱人灵魂，你都有逐渐增高的几率释放你内心的恶魔之魂，使其攻击你的敌人，持续9秒。

 灵魂横扫
用恶毒之爪打击附近的敌人，对其目标造成742点暗影伤害，并对10码范围内的其他敌人造成495点暗影伤害。

options.description_en:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 5,119 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.
options.description_zh:
混沌之母强化你的下一个烧尽，使其变为狱火箭。

 狱火箭
射出一支包裹在深渊狱火中的飞箭，对敌方目标造成5,119点火焰伤害，并产生3个灵魂碎片。

options.description_en:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 9,644 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
召唤深渊领主会使你的下一个混乱之箭变为陨灭。

从扭曲虚空的深处召唤一颗恶魔滋孽的流星，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成9,644点混乱伤害并召唤3个野生小鬼。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_zh: 强化召唤地狱火，造成的伤害提高40%。当你的召唤地狱火结束时，它会分裂成两个较小的地狱火，产生50%的效果，持续10秒。

options.description_zh: 火焰伤害提高4%，你的恶魔造成的伤害提高4%。

options.description_en: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 主宰对敌人造成伤害时击溃他们的灵魂，使其受到你和你的宠物的伤害提高5%，持续15秒。
