options.description_en: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心在10秒内为你恢复最大生命值的30%。

options.description_en: Unending Resolve grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of your maximum health and increases the maximum amount Soul Leech can absorb by 10% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心产生相当于最大生命值的10%的灵魂榨取吸收量，并使灵魂榨取的吸收量最大值提高10%，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.
options.description_zh:
施放混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧会使你获得敬魔仪式，持续20秒。如果敬魔仪式已经激活，则使其持续时间减少1秒。

敬魔仪式结束时，你获得恶魔法术，使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧召唤一个主宰、混沌之母或深渊领主，对敌人施展一次毁灭性攻击。

options.description_en:
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
options.description_zh:
恶魔法术使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧伤害提高20%，施法时间缩短50%。

施放混乱之箭会使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外减少1秒。

options.description_en: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的天魔邪眼观察战场并收集信息，在爆炸时将信息传递给你，每个天魔邪眼都会使你的智力提高2%，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 304 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.
options.description_zh:
你的天魔邪眼激活时，现在会每1秒对你的主要恶魔的目标施放天魔凝视。

 天魔凝视
向目标发射一道毁灭性的混乱魔法光束，造成304点混乱伤害。

每个激活的恶魔邪眼会使伤害提高100%。

options.description_en:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 891 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
每当你的法术缩短敬魔仪式的持续时间时，你都会召唤一个恶魔邪眼，最多3个。

恶魔邪眼在消耗恶魔法术时会爆炸，对目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成891点火焰伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
options.description_zh: 你下一次召唤小鬼、虚空行者、夜魔、魅魔、地狱猎犬或恶魔卫士不消耗能量，施法时间缩短90%。

options.description_en: All single-target damage done by you and your minions grants you and your pet shadowy shields that absorb 3% of the damage dealt for 15 sec, up to 5% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 你和你的仆从造成的所有单体伤害会为你和你的宠物提供一个能够吸收伤害的暗影护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的3%，持续15秒，吸收量最多不超过最大生命值的5%。

options.description_en: Increases your movement speed by 50%, but also damages you for 4% of your maximum health every 1 sec. Movement impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until canceled.
options.description_zh: 使你的移动速度提高50%，但每1秒会对你造成4%最大生命值的伤害。期间移动限制效果不会让你的移动速度降低到正常移动速度的100%以下，持续直到主动取消。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Fel Domination by 60 sec.
options.description_zh: 使邪能统御的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_en:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.1% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 5% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 45%.
options.description_zh:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.1%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的5%。

你的护甲值提高45%。

options.description_en:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
options.description_zh:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.2%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的10%。

你的护甲值提高90%。

options.description_en:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 5% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 1.5%.
options.description_zh:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的5%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低1.5%。

options.description_en:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
options.description_zh:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的10%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低3.0%。

options.description_en: Reduces the damage dealt by Burning Rush by 10%. Burning Rush increases your movement speed by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh: 爆燃冲刺造成的伤害降低10%。爆燃冲刺使你的移动速度额外提高20%。

options.description_en: Stamina increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 耐力提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
options.description_zh: 打破你的恐惧效果需要的伤害量提高60%。

options.description_en: Your Fear causes the target to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.
options.description_zh: 你的恐惧术将使受影响的目标在原地战栗而不是仓惶地逃跑。

options.description_en: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你和你宠物的最大生命值提高5%。

options.description_en: Banishes an enemy Demon, Aberration, or Elemental, preventing any action for 30 sec. Limit 1. Casting Banish again on the target will cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 放逐一个敌方恶魔、畸变怪或元素生物，使其无法行动，持续30秒。只能对一个目标使用。再次对目标施放放逐术会取消该效果。

options.description_en:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续12秒。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en:
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
强迫目标使用恶魔语，使其所有法术的施放时间延长30%，持续1分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 吸取生命的治疗效果也会以400%的效果治疗你的主要恶魔。

options.description_en: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 使敌方目标因恐惧而逃跑，瘫痪3秒，并为你恢复20%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
options.description_zh:
召唤一道持续15分钟的恶魔法阵。施放恶魔法阵：传送可将你传送到恶魔法阵的位置，并移除所有减速效果。

你还学会了：

 恶魔法阵：传送
将你传送到你的恶魔法阵并移除所有移动减速效果。

options.description_en: Increases your haste by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的急速提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
options.description_zh: 死亡缠绕的射程增加10码，并且死亡缠绕现在会额外治疗5%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 950 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
options.description_zh: 牺牲你当前生命值的20%，为你施加护盾抵挡伤害。该护盾可吸收相当于已牺牲生命值的200%以及额外的950点伤害，持续20秒。可在遭受控制限制效果时施放。

options.description_en: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
options.description_zh: 施放疲劳诅咒、语言诅咒或虚弱诅咒现在会诅咒目标10码范围内的所有敌人。

options.description_en: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
options.description_zh: 治疗石为你恢复额外5%的生命值。

options.description_en: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用恶魔法阵：传送或你的恶魔传送门会使你受到的所有伤害降低4%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取现在可以额外吸收你生命值上限的5%。

options.description_en:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
options.description_zh:
你的主要宠物会获得额外效果。

小鬼：成功施放烧灼驱魔会使目标受到的伤害降低4%，持续5秒。

虚空行者：暗影壁垒的冷却时间缩短30秒。

地狱猎犬：吞噬魔法的冷却时间缩短5秒。

萨亚德：诱惑的冷却时间缩短10秒，并且会使目标快速走向恶魔。

options.description_en: Drain Life now channels 100% faster and restores health 100% faster.
options.description_zh: 吸取生命的引导速度加快100%，恢复生命的速度加快100%。

nodes.name_zh: 恶魔灵液 / 契约供体

options.description_en: Dark Pact sacrifices only 5% of your current health for the same shield value.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约仅会牺牲你当前生命值的5%，获得的护盾值不变。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约的冷却时间缩短15秒。

options.description_en: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
options.description_zh: 使你的智力提高3%。

options.description_en: Increases your Leech by 2%.
options.description_zh: 使你的吸血提高2%。

options.description_en: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
options.description_zh: 你受到爆击的几率降低2%。你的主要恶魔受到的所有伤害降低8%。

options.description_en: Drain Life heals for an additional 200% of damage dealt and grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 生命吸取的治疗量额外提高所造成伤害的200%，并获得等同于所造成伤害10%的灵魂榨取。

nodes.name_zh: 意志的力量 / 黑暗协约

options.description_en: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心会使你受到的伤害额外降低15%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Unending Resolve by 45 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心的冷却时间缩短45秒。

options.description_en: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 在两个位置分别召唤一个恶魔传送门。使用者激活传送门后会立即被传送到另一个传送门。每名玩家每90秒只能使用一次恶魔传送门。

nodes.name_zh: 恐惧嚎叫 / 暗影之怒

options.description_en: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 施放出恐怖的嚎叫，使附近10码内的5名敌人在恐惧中逃走，并使其陷入迷惑，持续20秒。受到伤害可能取消此效果。

options.description_en: Stuns all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 使8码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Soulstone and Create Healthstone by 50%.
options.description_zh: 灵魂石和制造治疗石的施法时间缩短50%。

options.description_en:
5% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 3%.
options.description_zh:
你所受伤害的5%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高3%。

options.description_en:
10% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 6%.
options.description_zh:
你所受伤害的10%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高6%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
options.description_zh: 恶魔传送门的施法时间缩短0.5秒，并且你现在可以使用两次恶魔传送门才会触发冷却时间。

options.description_en: Soul Leech also heals you for 8% and your pet for 25% of the absorption it grants.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取还会为你和你的宠物恢复生命值，分别为其产生吸收量的8%和25%。

options.description_en: Soul Leech also heals you for 15% and your pet for 50% of the absorption it grants.
options.description_zh: 灵魂榨取还会为你和你的宠物恢复生命值，分别为其产生吸收量的15%和50%。

options.description_en:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
options.description_zh:
暗影之怒的冷却时间缩短15秒，半径增加2码。

恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短5秒，并且现在额外恐惧5个敌人。

options.description_en:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 25% health. 60 sec cooldown.
options.description_zh:
你为自己召唤的治疗石变为恶魔治疗石，可以在战斗中使用多次。恶魔治疗石无法交易。

恶魔治疗石
立即恢复25%的生命值。 60秒冷却时间。

options.description_en:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh:
消耗一块灵魂碎片，解锁你法术中的隐藏能力。

恶魔法阵：传送：使你的移动速度提高50%，并且使你免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

恶魔传送门：变为瞬发。

吸取生命：获得与治疗量等量的吸收盾，持续30秒。护盾的吸收总量不超过你最大生命值的30%。

治疗石：使你的治疗石的治疗效果提高30%，使用治疗石还会使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

nodes.name_en: Blight of Weakness / Blight of Tongues
nodes.name_zh: 虚弱灾厄 / 语言灾厄

options.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing the time between their attacks by 100% and reducing their critical strike chance by 10% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其攻击间隔延长100%，爆击几率降低10%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

options.description_en:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing their casting time of all spells by 100% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
options.description_zh:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其所有法术的施法时间延长100%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。

options.description_en:
Bestows a vile malediction upon the target, burning the sinew and muscle of its host, dealing 95 Shadowflame damage immediately and an additional 1,560 Shadowflame damage over 18 sec.

Replaces Corruption.
options.description_zh:
对目标降下恶毒的诅咒，燃烧宿主的经脉与血肉，立即造成93点暗影烈焰伤害，并在接下来的18秒内额外造成1,553点暗影烈焰伤害。

代替腐蚀术。

options.description_en: Unleashes a devastating blast of chaos, dealing a critical strike for 3,196 Chaos damage. Damage is further increased by your critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 释放出一道破坏性的混乱冲击，总是爆击，造成3,322点混乱伤害。你的爆击几率会进一步使伤害提高。

options.description_en: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的火焰伤害提高6%，你的火焰法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 548 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
options.description_zh:
如果目标受到了你的枯萎影响，施放混乱之箭和暗影灼烧会使其叠加层数增加1层。

每当枯萎叠加一层时，都有几率开始塌缩，每1秒消耗一层效果对宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

options.description_en: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的暗影伤害提高6%，你的暗影法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en:
Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 35% and Rain of Fire by 6%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
options.description_zh:
混乱之箭的伤害提高35%，并且火焰之雨的伤害提高6%。

激活怨毒时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en:
Triggers an explosion on the target, dealing 1,376 Fire damage.

Generates 5 Soul Shard Fragments.
options.description_zh:
在目标身上引发爆炸，造成1,361点火焰伤害。

生成5块灵魂碎片裂片。

options.description_en:
Calls down a rain of hellfire the target location, dealing 1,814 Fire damage over 7.1 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
options.description_zh:
地狱之火如雨般落在目标位置，在7.1秒内对范围内的敌人造成1,814点火焰伤害。

该法术对指定位置施放。

options.description_en:
Calls down a rain of hellfire upon your target, dealing 1,814 Fire damage over 7.1 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at your target.
options.description_zh:
地狱之火如雨般落在目标位置，在7.1秒内对范围内的敌人造成1,814点火焰伤害。

此法术会对你的目标施放。

nodes.name_en: Curse of the Satyr / Aura of Enfeeblement
nodes.name_zh: 萨特诅咒 / 虚弱光环

options.description_en:
Curse of Weakness is empowered and transforms into Curse of the Satyr.

 Curse of the Satyr
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% and the casting time of all spells by 30% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
虚弱诅咒被强化，转变为萨特诅咒。

 萨特诅咒
使敌人的攻击间隔延长20%，法术施放时间延长30%，持续2分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 当不灭决心激活时，30码范围内的敌人都会受到语言诅咒和虚弱诅咒影响，效果为100%。

nodes.name_zh: 怨怒祭仪 / 冷心策略

options.description_en: Wither deals 30% increased periodic damage but its duration is 15% shorter.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的持续伤害提高30%，持续时间缩短15%。

options.description_en: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的伤害提高20%。当枯萎通过黑化灵魂获得层数时，有几率再获得一层。

nodes.name_zh: 瑟雷姆的坚韧 / 邪蹄诡图

options.description_en: Dark Pact heals you for 781 every 1 sec while active.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约激活时每1秒为你恢复781点生命值。

options.description_en: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health. Soul Leech now absorbs an additional 15% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 献祭你10%的最大生命值。现在灵魂榨取会额外吸收你最大生命值15%的生命。

options.description_en: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的周期性伤害有几率使你获得怨毒，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Conflagrate gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 燃烧获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en: Conflagrate reduces the cast time of your next Incinerate, Chaos Bolt, or Soul Fire by 30%. Maximum 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 燃烧将使你的下一个烧尽或混乱之箭或灵魂之火的施法时间缩短30%。最多可拥有2次使用次数。

options.description_en: Increases Mastery by 2%.
options.description_zh: 精通提高2%。

options.description_en:
Increases Conflagrate damage by 10%. 

Conflagrate now erupts the target's Immolate, spreading it up to 3 nearby enemies.
options.description_zh:
燃烧的伤害提高10%。

燃烧现在会引爆目标的献祭，并将其蔓延至最多3名附近敌人。

options.description_en:
Wither damage increased by 25%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
枯萎的伤害提高25%。

每层枯萎使黑化灵魂造成的伤害提高2%。

options.description_en:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 548 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
options.description_zh:
枯萎叠加至8层后，或者当宿主的生命值降低至20%时，枯萎每1秒对其宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

黑化灵魂造成伤害时，你有一定几率获得碎片动荡。

options.description_en:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
options.description_zh:
枯萎造成的爆击伤害为215%，而不是通常的200%。

黑化灵魂造成的爆击伤害为225%，而不是通常的200%。

options.description_en: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
options.description_zh: 怨毒额外提供4%急速，并且在施放时使激活的枯萎效果额外增加2层。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Conflagrate by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 燃烧的冷却时间缩短2秒。

options.description_en:
Your single target spells have a 35% chance to apply Havoc to a nearby enemy for 5.0 sec.

 Havoc
Marks a target with Havoc for 5.0 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh:
你的单体目标法术有35%的几率对附近一名敌人施加浩劫，持续5.0秒。

浩劫
用浩劫标记一名敌人，持续5.0秒，使你所有单体法术对浩劫标记的目标造成50%的伤害。

options.description_en: Marks a target with Havoc for 15 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 用浩劫标记一个目标，持续15秒，使你的单体目标法术也会攻击浩劫的目标，造成初始伤害50%的伤害。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of Immolate by 25% and its duration by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 献祭的伤害提高25%，持续时间延长3秒。

options.description_en:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
黑暗魔法从你的体内喷薄而出，腐化你的灵魂，持续20秒，对受到你的枯萎影响的敌人造成4,808点暗影烈焰伤害，并使其额外叠加6层。

被腐化时，你的急速提高8%，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术会额外叠加1层枯萎。

options.description_en:
Blasts a target for 1,858 Shadowflame damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

Restores 1 Soul Shard and removes its cooldown if the target dies within 5 sec.
options.description_zh:
冲击目标，造成1,861点暗影烈焰伤害，仅可对生命值低于20%的敌人使用。

如果目标在5秒内死亡，则恢复1块灵魂碎片并重置其冷却时间。

options.description_en:
Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.

Physical attacks against you have a 20% chance to make your next Incinerate instant cast. This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的爆击几率提高2%。

对你发起的物理攻击有20%的几率使你的下一个烧尽变为瞬发。此效果每6秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en:
Increases your critical strike chance by 4%.

Physical attacks against you have a 40% chance to make your next Incinerate instant cast. This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.
options.description_zh:
你的爆击几率提高4%。

对你发起的物理攻击有40%的几率使你的下一个烧尽变为瞬发。此效果每6秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Havoc by 5 sec and increases the damage Havoc victims are dealt by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 浩劫的持续时间延长5秒，并且浩劫的受害者受到的伤害额外提高10%。

options.description_en: Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, and Incinerate deal 3% increased damage to targets afflicted by Immolate.
options.description_zh: 混乱之箭，暗影灼烧和烧尽对受到献祭效果影响的目标造成的伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, and Incinerate deal 6% increased damage to targets afflicted by Immolate.
options.description_zh: 混乱之箭，暗影灼烧和烧尽对受到献祭效果影响的目标造成的伤害提高6%。

options.description_en: Calls forth a cataclysm at the target location, dealing 1,413 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 8 yards and afflicting them with Immolate.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一场大灾变，对8码范围内的所有敌人造成1,396点暗影烈焰伤害，并施加献祭。

options.description_en:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.
options.description_zh:
施放混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧会使你获得敬魔仪式，持续20秒。如果敬魔仪式已经激活，则使其持续时间减少1秒。

敬魔仪式结束时，你获得恶魔法术，使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧召唤一个主宰、混沌之母或深渊领主，对敌人施展一次毁灭性攻击。

options.description_en: Critical strikes dealt by Chaos Bolt, Conflagrate, or Incinerate have a 10% chance to make your next cast of Shadowburn within 30 sec cost no Soul Shards and usable on any target regardless of health.
options.description_zh: 混乱之箭、燃烧或烧尽的爆击有10%的几率使你在30秒内施放的下一个暗影灼烧不消耗灵魂碎片，且可以对任意目标使用，无视其当前生命值。

options.description_en: Increases Chaos Bolt damage by 5% and Chaos Bolt now has a 25% chance to make your next Incinerate instant.
options.description_zh: 混乱之箭的伤害提高5%，并且混乱之箭有25%的几率使你下一个烧尽变为瞬发。

options.description_en:
When your Immolate deals periodic damage to a target above 80% health, gain 2% Haste for 10 sec.

Stacks up to 3 times.
options.description_zh:
当你的献祭对生命值在80%以上的目标造成周期性伤害时，获得2%急速，持续10秒。

该效果最多可叠加3次。

options.description_en:
Summons an Infernal from the Twisting Nether, impacting for 226 Fire damage and stunning all enemies in the area for 2 sec.

The Infernal will serve you for 30 sec, dealing 221 damage to all nearby enemies every 1.8 sec and generating 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec.
options.description_zh:
从扭曲虚空召唤出地狱火，对坠落区域内的所有敌人造成228点火焰伤害，并使其昏迷2秒。

地狱火会在30秒内为你作战，每1.8秒对附近所有敌人造成218点伤害，并且每1秒就会产生1块灵魂碎片裂片。

options.description_en: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2% and reduces the cast time of your Incinerate spell by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你的火焰法术造成的伤害提高2%，你的烧尽法术的施法时间缩短20%。

options.description_en: Incinerate now also hits all enemies near your target for 25% damage.
options.description_zh: 烧尽现在还会击中目标周围所有的敌人，对其造成25%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Cataclysm now leaves behind a lake of fire that deals 2,281 Fire damage to enemies within it over 8.9 sec.

Immolate deals 20% increased damage to enemies within the lake of fire.
options.description_zh:
大灾变现在会留下一片烈火之池，在8.9秒内对其中的敌人造成总计2,281点火焰伤害。

献祭对烈火之池中的敌人造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 主宰对敌人造成伤害时击溃他们的灵魂，使其受到你和你的宠物的伤害提高5%，持续15秒。

options.description_en:
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
options.description_zh:
恶魔法术使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧伤害提高20%，施法时间缩短50%。

施放混乱之箭会使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外减少1秒。

options.description_en:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 5,119 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.
options.description_zh:
混沌之母强化你的下一个烧尽，使其变为狱火箭。

 狱火箭
射出一支包裹在深渊狱火中的飞箭，对敌方目标造成5,119点火焰伤害，并产生3个灵魂碎片。

options.description_en:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 891 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
每当你的法术缩短敬魔仪式的持续时间时，你都会召唤一个恶魔邪眼，最多3个。

恶魔邪眼在消耗恶魔法术时会爆炸，对目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成891点火焰伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en: Your spells have a chance to grant you 15% Haste for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的法术有一定几率使你的急速提高15%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Chaos Bolt consumes up to 5 sec of Immolate's damage over time effect on your target, instantly dealing that much damage.
options.description_zh: 混乱之箭最多消耗掉目标身上5秒的献祭的持续伤害效果，并立刻造成同等的伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 粉碎混沌 / 混乱之雨

options.description_en: Summon Infernal increases the damage of your next 8 casts of Chaos Bolt by 25% or your next 8 casts of Rain of Fire by 35%.
options.description_zh: 召唤地狱火会使你的下8个混乱之箭伤害提高25%，或使你的下8个火焰之雨伤害提高35%。

options.description_en: While your initial Infernal is active, every Soul Shard you spend has a 15% chance to summon an additional Infernal that lasts 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 在你手动召唤的地狱火存在期间，你每消耗一块灵魂碎片，就有15%的几率额外召唤一只持续8秒的地狱火。

nodes.name_zh: 召唤者之拥 / 牺牲魔典

options.description_en: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和恶魔的伤害提高3%。

options.description_en:
Sacrifices your demon pet for power, gaining its command demon ability, and causing your spells to sometimes also deal 138 additional Shadow damage.

Lasts until canceled or until you summon a demon pet.
options.description_zh:
牺牲你的恶魔宠物来获得力量，获得它的恶魔掌控技能，并使你的法术有时会额外造成141点暗影伤害。

持续直到主动取消或者直到你召唤出一个恶魔宠物为止。

nodes.name_zh: 刻魂法阵 / 安尼赫兰的咆哮

options.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when casting Demonic Circle: Teleport, increasing your movement speed by 50% and making you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 你在施放恶魔法阵：传送时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使你的移动速度提高50%，并且免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Howl of Terror cooldown is reduced by 10 sec and range is increased by 5 yds.
options.description_zh: 恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短10秒，范围扩大5码。

nodes.name_zh: 科善的暴虐 / 炼狱装置

options.description_en: Summon Infernal grants Diabolic Ritual and reduces its duration by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤地狱火会触发敬魔仪式，并使其持续时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
options.description_zh: 你的地狱火激活时，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外缩短1秒。

options.description_zh: 不灭决心在10秒内为你恢复最大生命值的30%。

options.description_zh: 不灭决心产生相当于最大生命值的10%的灵魂榨取吸收量，并使灵魂榨取的吸收量最大值提高10%，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 304 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.
options.description_zh:
你的天魔邪眼激活时，现在会每1秒对你的主要恶魔的目标施放天魔凝视。

 天魔凝视
向目标发射一道毁灭性的混乱魔法光束，造成304点混乱伤害。

每个激活的恶魔邪眼会使伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike damage of your Destruction spells by 15%.
options.description_zh: 你的毁灭系法术的爆击伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike damage of your Destruction spells by 30%.
options.description_zh: 你的毁灭系法术的爆击伤害提高30%。

options.description_en: Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 混乱之箭的伤害提高10%，施法时间缩短0.5秒。

options.description_en: Increases how quickly Rain of Fire deals damage by 25% and how quickly your Infernal's Immolation deals damage by 10%.
options.description_zh: 火焰之雨造成伤害的速度提高25%，你的地狱火的献祭造成伤害的速度提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 3%.
options.description_zh: 使你的毁灭系法术的爆击几率提高3%。

options.description_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 6%.
options.description_zh: 使你的毁灭系法术的爆击几率提高6%。

options.description_en: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 火焰伤害提高4%，你的恶魔造成的伤害提高4%。

options.description_en: Summon Infernal becomes empowered, dealing 40% increased damage. When your Summon Infernal ends, it fragments into two smaller Infernals at 50% effectiveness that lasts 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 强化召唤地狱火，造成的伤害提高40%。当你的召唤地狱火结束时，它会分裂成两个较小的地狱火，产生50%的效果，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Enemies marked by your Havoc take 7% increased damage from your single target spells.
options.description_zh: 被你的浩劫标记的敌人受到你的单目标法术伤害提高7%。

options.description_en: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的天魔邪眼观察战场并收集信息，在爆炸时将信息传递给你，每个天魔邪眼都会使你的智力提高2%，持续10秒。

nodes.name_zh: 次元裂隙 / 灵魂之火

options.description_en:
Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn have a 10% chance to rip open a hole in space and time, opening a random portal that damages your target:

Shadowy Tear
Deals 3,143 Shadow damage over 14 sec.

Unstable Tear
Deals 2,696 Chaos damage over 6 sec.

Chaos Tear
Fires a Chaos Bolt, dealing 1,240 Chaos damage. This Chaos Bolt always critically strikes and your critical strike chance increases its damage.

Generates 10 Soul Shard Fragments.
options.description_zh:
混乱之箭和暗影灼烧有10%的几率撕裂时空，在你的目标附近开启一个随机传送门，对其造成伤害：

暗影裂隙
在14秒内持续造成3,143点暗影伤害。

不稳定的裂隙
在6秒内造成2,696点混乱伤害。

混乱裂隙
释放混乱之箭，造成1,240点混乱伤害。混乱之箭必定会爆击，并且你的爆击几率会提高其伤害。

生成10块灵魂裂片。﻿

options.description_en:
Burns the enemy's soul, dealing 14,765 Fire damage and applying Immolate.

Generates 1 Soul Shard.
options.description_zh:
灼烧敌人的灵魂，造成14,639点火焰伤害并施加献祭效果。

产生1块灵魂碎片。

options.description_en: Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, and Shadowburn always gain at least 70% of the maximum benefit from your Mastery: Chaotic Energies.
options.description_zh: 混乱之箭、火焰之雨和暗影灼烧总是能够从你的精通：混乱能量中获得至少70%的最大加成。

options.description_en: Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critical strike and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 燃烧和暗影灼烧有100%的几率爆击，并且它们的伤害随你的爆击几率而提高。

options.description_en: Incinerate now generates 100% additional Soul Shard Fragments.
options.description_zh: 烧尽现在可以额外生成100%的灵魂碎片裂片。

nodes.name_zh: 恶魔之火注能 / 引导恶魔之火

options.description_en:
Periodic damage from Immolate has a 4% chance to fire a Demonfire bolt at 100% increased effectiveness.

Incinerate has a 25% chance to fire a Demonfire bolt at 100% increased effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
献祭的持续伤害有4%几率发射一道恶魔之火箭矢，效果提高100%。

烧尽有25%几率发射一道恶魔之火箭矢，效果提高100%。

options.description_en: Launches 15 bolts of felfire over 2.7 sec at random targets afflicted by your Immolate within 40 yds. Each bolt deals 147 Fire damage to the target and 76 Fire damage to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 向40码以内被你的献祭影响的目标随机射出15枚邪火箭矢，持续2.7秒。每枚箭矢对目标造成149点火焰伤害，并对目标附近的敌人造成75点火焰伤害。

options.description_en:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 9,644 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
召唤深渊领主会使你的下一个混乱之箭变为陨灭。

 陨灭
从扭曲虚空的深处召唤一颗恶魔滋孽的流星，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成9,644点混乱伤害并召唤3个野生小鬼。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Casting Soul Fire summons an Overfiend.

Opening a Dimensional Rift has a chance to summon an Overfiend instead.

 Summon Overfiend
Generates 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec and casts Chaos Bolt at 80% effectiveness at its summoner's target. Lasts 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
施放灵魂之火会召唤一个大恶魔。

开启混乱裂隙有几率变为召唤一个大恶魔。

 召唤大恶魔
每1秒产生1个灵魂碎片裂片，并以80%的效果对召唤者的目标施放混乱之箭。持续8秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Summon Infernal by 30.0 sec and increases your Mastery by 3%.
options.description_zh: 召唤地狱火的冷却时间缩短30.0秒，你的精通提高3%。

options.description_en: Rain of Fire has a 20% chance to reduce the cost of your next Rain of Fire within 8 sec by 100%.
options.description_zh: 火焰之雨有20%的几率使你在8秒内施放的下一个火焰之雨的消耗降低100%。

options.description_en: Channel Demonfire fires an additional 2 bolts. Each bolt increases the remaining duration of Immolate on all targets hit by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 引导恶魔之火额外射出2道箭矢，每一道箭矢都会使命中的所有目标身上的献祭持续时间延长0.5秒。

options.description_en:
Casting Incinerate has a 10% chance to evoke an echo of the Dark Titan's power.

 Echo of Sargeras
Hurl an ember torn from Nihilam at the target, dealing 712 Shadowflame damage and an additional 617 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
施放烧尽有10%的几率唤起黑暗泰坦之力的回响。

 萨格拉斯的回响
向目标投掷一片从奈兰撕裂而来的余烬，造成712点暗影烈焰伤害，并对10码范围内的所有敌人额外造成617点暗影烈焰伤害。

超过8个目标后伤害降低。

nodes.name_en: Curse of the Satyr / Aura of Enfeeblement
nodes.name_zh: 萨特诅咒 / 虚弱光环

options.description_en:
Curse of Weakness is empowered and transforms into Curse of the Satyr.

 Curse of the Satyr
Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% and the casting time of all spells by 30% for 2 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
options.description_zh:
虚弱诅咒被强化，转变为萨特诅咒。

 萨特诅咒
使敌人的攻击间隔延长20%，法术施放时间延长30%，持续2分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。

options.description_en: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 当不灭决心激活时，30码范围内的敌人都会受到语言诅咒和虚弱诅咒影响，效果为100%。

options.description_en:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 548 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
options.description_zh:
枯萎叠加至8层后，或者当宿主的生命值降低至20%时，枯萎每1秒对其宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

黑化灵魂造成伤害时，你有一定几率获得碎片动荡。

options.description_en:
Wither damage increased by 25%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
枯萎的伤害提高25%。

每层枯萎使黑化灵魂造成的伤害提高2%。

nodes.name_zh: 瑟雷姆的坚韧 / 邪蹄诡图

options.description_en: Dark Pact heals you for 781 every 1 sec while active.
options.description_zh: 黑暗契约激活时每1秒为你恢复781点生命值。

options.description_en: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health. Soul Leech now absorbs an additional 15% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 献祭你10%的最大生命值。现在灵魂榨取会额外吸收你最大生命值15%的生命。

options.description_en:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 548 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
options.description_zh:
如果目标受到了你的枯萎影响，施放混乱之箭和暗影灼烧会使其叠加层数增加1层。

每当枯萎叠加一层时，都有几率开始塌缩，每1秒消耗一层效果对宿主造成548点暗影烈焰伤害，直到只剩余1层。

options.description_en:
Bestows a vile malediction upon the target, burning the sinew and muscle of its host, dealing 94 Shadowflame damage immediately and an additional 1,568 Shadowflame damage over 18 sec.

Replaces Corruption.
options.description_zh:
对目标降下恶毒的诅咒，燃烧宿主的经脉与血肉，立即造成94点暗影烈焰伤害，并在接下来的18秒内额外造成1,594点暗影烈焰伤害。

代替腐蚀术。

options.description_en:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
options.description_zh:
黑暗魔法从你的体内喷薄而出，腐化你的灵魂，持续20秒，对受到你的枯萎影响的敌人造成4,808点暗影烈焰伤害，并使其额外叠加6层。

被腐化时，你的急速提高8%，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术会额外叠加1层枯萎。

options.description_en:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
options.description_zh:
枯萎造成的爆击伤害为215%，而不是通常的200%。

黑化灵魂造成的爆击伤害为225%，而不是通常的200%。

options.description_en: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的暗影伤害提高6%，你的暗影法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
options.description_zh: 你的法术和技能造成的火焰伤害提高6%，你的火焰法术从所有来源获得的爆击几率提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 怨怒祭仪 / 冷心策略

options.description_en: Wither deals 30% increased periodic damage but its duration is 15% shorter.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的持续伤害提高30%，持续时间缩短15%。

options.description_en: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的伤害提高20%。当枯萎通过黑化灵魂获得层数时，有几率再获得一层。

options.description_en: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
options.description_zh: 怨毒额外提供4%急速，并且在施放时使激活的枯萎效果额外增加2层。

options.description_en: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 枯萎的周期性伤害有几率使你获得怨毒，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 35% and Rain of Fire by 6%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
options.description_zh:
混乱之箭的伤害提高35%，并且火焰之雨的伤害提高6%。

激活怨毒时，此效果翻倍。

options.description_en:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 5,119 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.
options.description_zh:
混沌之母强化你的下一个烧尽，使其变为狱火箭。

 狱火箭
射出一支包裹在深渊狱火中的飞箭，对敌方目标造成5,119点火焰伤害，并产生3个灵魂碎片。

options.description_en:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 9,644 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
召唤深渊领主会使你的下一个混乱之箭变为陨灭。

 陨灭
从扭曲虚空的深处召唤一颗恶魔滋孽的流星，对目标周围8码内的所有敌人造成9,644点混乱伤害并召唤3个野生小鬼。

目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Summon Infernal becomes empowered, dealing 40% increased damage. When your Summon Infernal ends, it fragments into two smaller Infernals at 50% effectiveness that lasts 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 强化召唤地狱火，造成的伤害提高40%。当你的召唤地狱火结束时，它会分裂成两个较小的地狱火，产生50%的效果，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 火焰伤害提高4%，你的恶魔造成的伤害提高4%。

nodes.name_zh: 刻魂法阵 / 安尼赫兰的咆哮

options.description_en: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when casting Demonic Circle: Teleport, increasing your movement speed by 50% and making you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 你在施放恶魔法阵：传送时始终获得灵魂燃烧的增益，使你的移动速度提高50%，并且免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Howl of Terror cooldown is reduced by 10 sec and range is increased by 5 yds.
options.description_zh: 恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短10秒，范围扩大5码。

options.description_en: Enemies marked by your Havoc take 7% increased damage from your single target spells.
options.description_zh: 被你的浩劫标记的敌人受到你的单目标法术伤害提高7%。

nodes.name_zh: 科善的暴虐 / 炼狱装置

options.description_en: Summon Infernal grants Diabolic Ritual and reduces its duration by 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤地狱火会触发敬魔仪式，并使其持续时间缩短3秒。

options.description_en: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
options.description_zh: 你的地狱火激活时，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外缩短1秒。

options.description_en: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 主宰对敌人造成伤害时击溃他们的灵魂，使其受到你和你的宠物的伤害提高5%，持续15秒。

nodes.name_zh: 狱火活力 / 狱火壁垒

options.description_en: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心在10秒内为你恢复最大生命值的30%。

options.description_en: Unending Resolve grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of your maximum health and increases the maximum amount Soul Leech can absorb by 10% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 不灭决心产生相当于最大生命值的10%的灵魂榨取吸收量，并使灵魂榨取的吸收量最大值提高10%，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.
options.description_zh:
施放混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧会使你获得敬魔仪式，持续20秒。如果敬魔仪式已经激活，则使其持续时间减少1秒。

敬魔仪式结束时，你获得恶魔法术，使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧召唤一个主宰、混沌之母或深渊领主，对敌人施展一次毁灭性攻击。

options.description_en:
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
options.description_zh:
恶魔法术使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧伤害提高20%，施法时间缩短50%。

施放混乱之箭会使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外减少1秒。

options.description_en: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 你的天魔邪眼观察战场并收集信息，在爆炸时将信息传递给你，每个天魔邪眼都会使你的智力提高2%，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 304 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.
options.description_zh:
你的天魔邪眼激活时，现在会每1秒对你的主要恶魔的目标施放天魔凝视。

 天魔凝视
向目标发射一道毁灭性的混乱魔法光束，造成304点混乱伤害。

每个激活的恶魔邪眼会使伤害提高100%。

options.description_en:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 891 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
每当你的法术缩短敬魔仪式的持续时间时，你都会召唤一个恶魔邪眼，最多3个。

恶魔邪眼在消耗恶魔法术时会爆炸，对目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成891点火焰伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en: Heals the target for 6,386 over 7.1 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.
options.description_zh: 在7.1秒内为目标恢复6,386点生命值。引导时，可以在目标身上瞬发氤氲之雾和活血术。

options.description_en: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 使目标瘫痪，持续1分钟。只能对一个目标使用。伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en: You shrug off attacks, delaying a portion of Physical damage based on your Agility, instead taking it over 10 sec. Affects magical attacks at 58% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 灵活地应对敌人的攻击，化解部分受到的物理伤害，改为在10秒内承受，化解的比例由你的敏捷决定。对魔法攻击有58%的化解效果。

options.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by you and your target while channeling Soothing Mists by 6%.
options.description_zh: 引导抚慰之雾时，你和目标受到的所有伤害降低6%。

options.description_en: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.
options.description_zh: 使一名友方目标的移动速度提高70%，持续6秒，并解除所有定身和诱捕效果。

options.description_en: Targets you Roll through are snared by 40% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻穿过的目标被诱捕，移动速度降低40%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec, duration refreshed by your melee attacks.
options.description_zh: 使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续15秒。近战攻击会刷新持续时间。

options.description_en: Blackout Kick deals 20% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 幻灭踢的伤害提高20%，神鹤引项踢的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases all healing taken by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的所有治疗效果提高4%。

options.description_en: Roll and Chi Torpedo travel a small distance further.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻和真气突的移动距离略微延长。

options.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.
options.description_zh: 受到的所有伤害降低3%。

options.description_en:
The range of Disable is increased by 5 yds.
 
The duration of Crashing Momentum is increased by 3 sec and its snare now reduces movement speed by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh:
金刚震的射程延长5码。

迅威压迫的持续时间延长3秒，诱捕效果现在使移动速度额外降低20%。

options.description_en: Removes all Poison and Disease effects from the target.
options.description_zh: 移除目标身上所有的中毒和疾病效果。

options.description_en:
After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

This effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.
options.description_zh:
施放旭日东升踢后，你的下一次活血术变为瞬发。

此效果还会使活血术的能量消耗降低75%。

options.description_en: While no enemies are within 15 yds, you heal for 1,425 every 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你周围15码内没有敌人时，你每3秒获得1,425点治疗。

options.description_en: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 未进入战斗时，你的移动速度提高15%。

options.description_en: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.
options.description_zh: 分筋错骨现在会移除目标的所有激怒效果。

options.description_en: Jabs the target in the throat, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 猛击目标的咽喉，打断其施法，并阻止其施放任何同系的法术，持续5秒。

options.description_en: After Detox successfully removes an effect from an ally, their movement speed is increased by 30% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 清创生血成功移除一名盟友身上的效果后，其移动速度提高30%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 8 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 使分筋错骨的冷却时间缩短8秒，扫堂腿的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 15 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使分筋错骨的冷却时间缩短15秒，扫堂腿的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: Every 15 sec, your next Rising Sun Kick or Vivify releases a wave of Chi energy that flows through friends and foes, dealing 7 Nature damage or 21 healing. Bounces up to 7 times to targets within 25 yards.
options.description_zh: 每过15秒，你的下一个旭日东升踢或活血术会释放一道真气能量波拂过你的盟友和敌人，造成7点自然伤害或恢复21点生命值。可弹射到25码范围内的目标身上，最多弹射7次。

options.description_en:
Hurls a torrent of Chi energy up to 40 yds forward, dealing 98 Nature damage to all enemies, and 75 healing to the Monk and all allies in its path. Healing and damage reduced beyond 5 targets.


Casting Chi Burst does not prevent avoiding attacks.
options.description_zh:
向前丢出真气能量漩涡，最远40码，对其路径上的所有敌人造成97点自然伤害，并为武僧和所有盟友恢复75点生命值。目标数量超过5个后造成的治疗量和伤害降低。


施放真气爆裂时依然可以躲闪攻击。

options.description_en: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.
options.description_zh: 将你的肉体和灵魂分离，并将灵魂留在原地，持续15分钟。使用魂体双分：转移，让你的肉体和你的灵魂交换位置。

options.description_en: Successfully interrupting an enemy reduces the cooldown of Paralysis and Roll by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 成功打断敌人会使分筋错骨和滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.
options.description_zh: 使滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒，使用次数上限提高1次。

options.description_en: Torpedoes you forward a long distance and increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 sec, stacking up to 2 times.
options.description_zh: 向前突进很长一段距离，并使移动速度提高30%，持续10秒，可叠加2次。

options.description_en: Leg Sweep applies Disable for 5.0 sec when it ends.
options.description_zh: 扫堂腿结束时，会施加5.0秒的金刚震效果。

options.description_en: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你受到的诱捕效果的持续时间缩短20%。

options.description_en: Provoked targets move towards you at 50% increased speed.
options.description_zh: 激怒的目标向你移动，并且移动速度提高50%。

options.description_en: Increases all damage dealt by 2%.
options.description_zh: 造成的所有伤害提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases all damage dealt by 4%.
options.description_zh: 造成的所有伤害提高4%。

nodes.name_en: Ring of Peace / Song of Chi-Ji
nodes.name_zh: 平心之环 / 赤精之歌

options.description_en: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置形成平心之环，持续5秒。进入环中的敌人将被推出环外。

options.description_en: Conjures a cloud of hypnotic mist that slowly travels forward. Enemies touched by the mist fall asleep, Disoriented for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放一团催眠云雾，缓缓向前移动。接触到雾气的敌人将陷入沉睡，迷惑20秒。

options.description_en: Transcendence: Transfer snares targets within 10 yds by 70% for 4 sec when cast.
options.description_zh: 施放魂体双分：转移时诱捕10码内的目标，使其减速70%，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.
options.description_zh: 使扫堂腿的范围提高4码。

options.description_en: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.
options.description_zh: 现在轮回之触可以对剩余生命值低于15%的目标使用，造成相当于你最大生命值35%的伤害。

options.description_en: Expel Harm's healing increased by 6% and critical strike chance increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 移花接木的治疗效果提高6%，爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 1.0% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 10%.
options.description_zh: 激战时真气的流动令你变得坚毅，在战斗中每3秒获得一层魔法吸收护盾，吸收相当于最大生命值1.0%的伤害，最多叠加至10%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 平心之环的冷却时间缩短5秒，赤精之歌的施法时间缩短0.5秒。

options.description_en: Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 让你的皮肤化为坚石，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Your dodge chance is increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 你的躲闪几率提高5%。

options.description_en: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the current health of your target. Lower health targets are healed for more.
options.description_zh: 基于目标的当前生命值，你的治疗效果最多提高10%。生命值较低的目标会获得更多治疗。

options.description_en: Roll removes a snare effect once every 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻每30秒可移除一个诱捕效果。

nodes.name_zh: 灵魂之力 / 后发制人

options.description_en: Expel Harm's healing is increased by up to 100%, based on your missing health.
options.description_zh: 移花接木的治疗效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高100%。

options.description_en: Expel Harm's critical healing is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh: 移花接木的爆击治疗效果提高50%。

options.description_en:
Summons a Black Ox Statue at the target location for 15 min, pulsing threat to all enemies within 20 yards.

You may cast Provoke on the statue to taunt all enemies near the statue.
options.description_zh:
在目标位置召唤一座玄牛雕像，持续15分钟。对20码范围内的所有敌人产生威胁值。

你可以对雕像使用嚎镇八方，嘲讽雕像附近的所有敌人。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum health by an additional 10% and your damage taken is reduced by an additional 10% while Fortifying Brew is active.
options.description_zh: 壮胆酒激活时，你的最大生命值额外提高10%，受到的伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 壮胆酒的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.
options.description_zh: 激活壮胆酒会尽可能将你身上当前激活的所有有害魔法效果返还给施法者。

options.description_en: While your Celestial is active, you cannot be slowed below 90% normal movement speed.
options.description_zh: 当你的天神激活时，你的移动速度不会降低到正常速度的90%以下。

options.description_en: Magical damage done increased by 2% and healing done increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 造成的魔法伤害提高2%，造成的治疗效果提高2%。

options.description_en: Magical damage done increased by 4% and healing done increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 造成的魔法伤害提高4%，造成的治疗效果提高4%。

options.description_en: Transcendence: Transfer immediately heals you for 10% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 魂体双分：转移会为你恢复最大生命值的10%。

options.description_en: You and your allies within 10 yards have 4% increased movement speed. Stacks with other similar effects.
options.description_zh: 你和10码内的盟友的移动速度提高4%。可与其他类似效果叠加。

options.description_en: Touch of Death now heals you for 60% of its damage done.
options.description_zh: 轮回之触现在会治疗你该技能造成伤害的60%。

options.description_en: Increases your Physical damage done by 2% and Avoidance increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的物理伤害提高2%，闪避提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases your Physical damage done by 4% and Avoidance increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的物理伤害提高4%，闪避提高4%。

options.description_en: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻令你身轻如羽，使你可以在5秒内施展一次二段跳，向前冲刺一小段距离，滚地翻的冷却时间提高2秒。

options.description_en:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
你会根据当前生命值获得一个额外效果。

生命值高于90%：移动速度提高5%。该效果可与其他相似效果叠加。

生命值在90%与35%之间：受到的伤害降低5%。

生命值低于35%：受到的治疗效果提高10%。

nodes.name_en: Escape from Reality / Transcendence: Linked Spirits
nodes.name_zh: 魂游天外 / 魂体双分：链接之魂

options.description_en: After you use Transcendence: Transfer, you can use Transcendence: Transfer again within 10 sec, ignoring its cooldown.
options.description_zh: 施放魂体双分：转移后，你可以在10秒内再次施放魂体双分：转移，无视其冷却时间。

options.description_en: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.
options.description_zh: 魂体双分现在使你的灵魂与一名盟友绑定，持续1小时。使用魂体双分：转移可以传送到你的盟友的位置。

options.description_en: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 轮回之触的冷却时间缩短90秒。

options.description_en: Your heightened reflexes allow you to react swiftly to the presence of enemies, causing you to quickly lunge to the nearest enemy in front of you within 10 yards after you Roll.
options.description_zh: 敏锐的反应使你能够快速应对附近的敌人，使用滚地翻后会立刻扑向前方10码内最近的敌人。

options.description_en: Smash a keg of brew, dealing 101 Physical damage to your primary target and 67 Physical damage to all other enemies within 8 yds, and reducing their movement speed by 20% for 15 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 向目标投掷一桶酒，对主要目标造成98点物理伤害，对8码范围内的所有其他敌人造成66点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低20%，持续15秒。超过5个目标后，造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Your auto attacks have a chance to generate 1-2 Flurry Charges. When you cast Keg Smash, unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing 21 Physical damage per charge.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击有几率产生1-2层疾风拳势。施放醉酿投会释放所有疾风拳势，每层造成21点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Clears 50% of your Staggered damage, or a minimum of 8% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 清除醉拳50%的延缓伤害，或至少相当于你最大生命值8%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Niuzao's teachings allow you to shuffle during combat, increasing the effectiveness of your Stagger by 100%.

Shuffle is granted by attacking enemies with your Keg Smash, Blackout Kick, and Spinning Crane Kick.

 Stagger: You shrug off attacks, delaying a portion of Physical damage based on your Agility, instead taking it over 10 sec. Affects magical attacks at 58% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
砮皂的引导让你可以在战斗中触发酒醒入定，醉拳的效果提高100%。

用醉酿投、幻灭踢和神鹤引项踢攻击敌人可以获得酒醒入定效果。

 醉拳：灵活地应对敌人的攻击，化解部分受到的物理伤害，改为在10秒内承受，化解的比例由你的敏捷决定。对魔法攻击有58%的化解效果。

nodes.name_zh: 潘达利亚之豪 / 拳劲贯体

options.description_en: Flurry Strikes have 15% additional chance to critically strike.
options.description_zh: 疾风乱打的爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Enemies who die within 10 sec of being damaged by a Flurry Strike explode, dealing 35 physical damage to uncontrolled enemies within 8 yds.
options.description_zh: 在受到疾风乱打伤害后的10秒内死亡的敌人会爆炸，对8码内未受到失控效果影响的敌人造成35点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高5%。

options.description_en: Your attacks penetrate 12% armor.
options.description_zh: 你的攻击穿透12%的护甲。

options.description_en: Flurry Strikes deal 18 Nature damage to all enemies within 6 yds, reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 疾风乱打对6码内的所有敌人造成18点自然伤害，超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en: When you would be healed above maximum health, you instead convert an amount equal to 40% of your critical strike chance to a heal over time effect.
options.description_zh: 当你即将受到过量治疗时，你会将等同于你爆击几率40%的过量治疗转化为持续治疗效果。

nodes.name_zh: 幻灭醉拳 / 浅斟快饮

options.description_en: When you Blackout Kick, your Stagger is reduced by 263, increased by up to 200% based on your missing health.
options.description_zh: 当你使用幻灭踢时，你的醉拳额外化解263点伤害，此效果基于你损失的生命值最多提高200%。

options.description_en: Purify 5% of your Staggered damage each time you gain 3 sec of Shuffle duration.
options.description_zh: 你每获得3秒的酒醒入定效果，就会化解5%的醉拳伤害。

options.description_en: When you fall below 40% health, you gain an absorb for 30% of your recently Purified damage, or a minimum of 8% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你的生命值降低至40%时，你获得一个护盾，吸收量相当于最近净化伤害的30%，至少为你的最大生命值的8%。每15秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Blackout Kick deals 20% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 幻灭踢造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Drinking from a Brew increases your movement speed by 15% and your auto-attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 饮用佳酿会使你的移动速度提高15%，自动攻击速度提高10%，持续15秒。

nodes.name_zh: 作战姿态 / 意到锋至

options.description_en: The cooldown of Roll is decreased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻的冷却时间减少10%。

options.description_en: Movement speed is increased by 50% for the first 8 sec of combat.
options.description_zh: 战斗开始时的8秒内移动速度提高50%。

options.description_en:
Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.


Keg Smash damage increased by 35%.
options.description_zh:
自动攻击的爆击会使疾风拳势层数翻倍。


醉酿投的伤害提高35%。

nodes.name_zh: 钢铁漩涡 / 先觉磨砺

options.description_en:
When your health drops below 50%, summon Whirling Steel, increasing your parry chance and avoidance by 15% for 6 sec.

This effect can not occur more than once every 180 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至50%时，召唤钢铁漩涡，使你的招架几率和闪避提高15%，持续6秒。

该效果每180秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: When you dodge or parry an attack, reduce all damage taken by 10% for the next 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你躲闪或招架一次攻击时，接下来6秒内受到的所有伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Activating Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox instantly grants 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes that trigger on your next attack at 70% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 激活玄牛下凡会立即获得10层疾风乱打，在你的下一次攻击时触发，效果为70%。

options.description_en:
When you take damage, you have a chance to summon a Healing Sphere.

Healing Sphere:
Summon a Healing Sphere visible only to you. Moving through this Healing Sphere heals you for 114.
options.description_zh:
当你承受伤害时，有几率召唤一个只有你能看到的疗伤珠。

疗伤珠：
召唤一个只有你能看到的疗伤珠。穿过疗伤珠时会为你恢复116点生命值。

nodes.name_zh: 特别快递 / 碧玉疾风

options.description_en: Drinking from your Brews has a 100% chance to toss a keg high into the air that lands nearby after 3 sec, dealing 34 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用所有酒类技能时，有100%的几率将一个酒桶掷向空中，3秒后在附近落下，对周围8码范围内的所有敌人造成34点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Summons a whirling tornado around you, causing 42 Physical damage over 5.4 sec to all enemies within 8 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 在你身边召唤出一股旋转疾风，在5.4秒内对8码范围内的所有敌人造成41点物理伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Blackout Kick has a chance to summon a Healing Sphere.

Healing Sphere:
Summon a Healing Sphere visible only to you. Moving through this Healing Sphere heals you for 114.
options.description_zh:
幻灭踢有一定几率生成一颗疗伤珠。

疗伤珠：
召唤一个只有你能看到的疗伤珠。穿过疗伤珠时会为你恢复115点生命值。

options.description_en: Your agility is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你的敏捷提高4%。

options.description_en:
Energy spenders deal an additional 20% damage.
The cooldown of Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is reduced by 25 sec.
options.description_zh:
消耗能量的技能造成的伤害提高20%。
玄牛下凡的冷却时间缩短25秒。

options.description_en: Blackout Kick deals an additional 30% critical damage.
options.description_zh: 幻灭踢造成的爆击伤害提高30%。

options.description_en: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox's stomp damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 玄牛下凡的践踏伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Crackling Jade Lightning deals its damage in 75% less time, costs 75% less Energy, and strikes 4 additional targets, but has a 60 sec cooldown.
options.description_zh: 碎玉闪电造成伤害所需时间缩短75%，能量消耗降低75%，并额外击中4个目标，但有60秒的冷却时间。

options.description_en: A swig of strong brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 2,381 damage.
options.description_zh: 吐出一大口凝结了纯正真气的烈酒，使其化为天神守卫，吸收2,381点伤害。

options.description_en: A strong herbal brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 30% of incoming damage, up to 2,381 total.
options.description_zh: 灌下一口强劲的草药酒，凝结散逸至体外的真气，使其化为天神守卫，吸收所受伤害量的30%，最多可吸收2,381点伤害。

options.description_en: Healing Spheres now heal over 10 sec, and their healing is increased by up to 80% based on your missing health.
options.description_zh: 疗伤珠现在会在10秒内持续提供治疗，治疗效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高80%。

options.description_en:
Drinking from Brews has a 30% chance to coat you with Celestial Flames for 6 sec. While Celestial Flames is active:

 Special Delivery:
Kegs thrown by Special Delivery are ignited and splash upon landing, dealing 34 Fire damage to up to 5 nearby enemies.

 Rushing Jade Wind:
Rushing Jade Wind becomes a firestorm, increasing its radius by 30% and causing it to deal Fire damage.
options.description_zh:
使用酒类技能时，有30%的几率使你获得天神烈焰，持续6秒。当天神烈焰激活时：

 特别快递：
特别快递投掷的酒桶会被点燃，在落地时迸裂，对最多5名附近敌人造成35点火焰伤害。

 碧玉疾风：
碧玉疾风变为火焰风暴，半径扩大30%，并造成火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Blackout Kick's damage increased by 20% and it strikes an additional 2 targets.
options.description_zh: 幻灭踢的伤害提高20%并且能够额外攻击2个目标。

options.description_en: Blackout Kick's cooldown is reduced by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 幻灭踢的冷却时间缩短1秒。

options.description_en: Blackout Kick deals an additional 5% damage. Blackout Kick critical hits grant an additional 1 stack of Elusive Brawler.
options.description_zh: 幻灭踢额外造成5%伤害。幻灭踢爆击时额外获得1层醉拳大师效果。

options.description_en: You have a 10% chance to not reset your Elusive Brawler stacks after a successful dodge.
options.description_zh: 成功的躲闪有10%的几率不重置醉拳大师的层数。

options.description_en: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox causes Breath of Fire to launch 3 Flurry Strikes.
options.description_zh: 玄牛下凡会使火焰吐息施放3次疾风乱打。

options.description_en:
Store vitality from 10% of your damage dealt and 30% of your healing.

For 10 sec after casting Thunder Focus Tea your spells and abilities draw upon the stored vitality to deal 40% additional healing over 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
造成伤害的10%和治疗的30%存储为活力。

施放雷光聚神茶后的10秒内，你的法术和技能会消耗存储的活力，造成40%的额外治疗，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Breathe fire on targets in front of you, causing 35 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

Targets affected by Keg Smash will also burn, taking 23 Fire damage and dealing 5% reduced damage to you for 12 sec.
options.description_zh:
向你面前的目标喷吐火焰，造成35点火焰伤害。对次要目标造成的伤害降低。

受到醉酿投影响的目标将被点燃，在12秒内受到23点火焰伤害，且对你造成的伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Purifying Brew instantly heals you for 25% of the Staggered damage it clears.
options.description_zh: 活血酒立即为你恢复生命，相当于醉拳所化解伤害的25%。

nodes.name_zh: 酒仙轻酿 / 砮皂的试炼

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Purifying Brew, Celestial Brew, and Celestial Infusion by 20%.
options.description_zh: 活血酒、天神酒和天神灌注的冷却时间缩短20%。

options.description_en: Gain up to 15% Mastery based on your current level of Stagger.
options.description_zh: 根据你当前的醉拳等级，获得最多15%的精通加成。

options.description_en: Drinking a Brew grants you 10% dodge for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 使用酒类技能时，你获得10%躲闪，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Chi Burst and Chi Wave deal 50% increased damage and healing.
options.description_zh: 真气爆裂和真气波的伤害和治疗效果提高50%。

nodes.name_zh: 净化之魂 / 以和致胜

options.description_en: When Aspect of Harmony ends, any remaining vitality is expelled as healing over 8 sec, split among nearby targets.
options.description_zh: 和谐化身结束时，释放剩余的活力，在8秒内造成治疗，由周围的目标均摊。

options.description_en: During Aspect of Harmony, Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick, and Tiger Palm also withdraw vitality to damage enemies for an additional 20% over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 在和谐化身期间，旭日东升踢、幻灭踢和猛虎掌还会消耗活力，在8秒内对敌人造成20%的额外伤害。

options.description_en: Casting a Physical spell or ability increases the damage and healing of your next Fire or Nature spell or ability by 3%, and vice versa. Stacks up to 5.
options.description_zh: 施放一个物理法术或技能会使你的下一个火焰或自然法术与技能的伤害和治疗效果提高3%，反之亦然。最多叠加5次。

options.description_en:
Casting Thunder Focus Tea grants 2 charges of Potential Energy. Your next cast of Tiger Palm or Vivify consumes all charges of Potential Energy to cause a Harmonic Surge.

Harmonic Surge:
For each charge of Potential Energy, deal 836 Nature damage to your target and 836 Nature damage to other nearby enemies, and heal up to 5 allies for 190. Damage reduced above 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
施放雷光聚神茶会使你获得2层潜在能量。你施放的下一次猛虎掌或活血术会消耗所有潜在能量层数，造成和谐涌动。

和谐涌动：
每拥有一层潜在能量，对你的目标造成836点自然伤害，对附近其他敌人造成836点自然伤害，并为最多5个受伤的盟友恢复190点生命值。目标超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

nodes.name_zh: 滚烫烧酒 / 萨萨拉比姆的力量

options.description_en: Keg Smash deals an additional 20% damage to targets affected by Breath of Fire.
options.description_zh: 醉酿投对受到火焰之息影响的目标造成额外20%的伤害。

options.description_en: When you use Keg Smash, the remaining cooldown on Breath of Fire is reset.
options.description_zh: 使用醉酿投会重置火焰之息的剩余冷却时间。

options.description_en:
Fortifying Brew increases Stagger effectiveness by 15% while active.

Combines with other Fortifying Brew effects.
options.description_zh:
壮胆酒生效期间，醉拳的效果提升15%。

可与其他壮胆酒效果相结合。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of Stagger by 5.0 sec, causing Staggered damage to be dealt to you more gradually.
options.description_zh: 醉拳的持续时间延长5.0秒，因醉拳而延迟造成的伤害会施加得更加缓慢。

options.description_en: Chug some Black Ox Brew, which instantly refills your Energy, Purifying Brew charges, and grants one charge of Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion.
options.description_zh: 饮下玄牛酒，立即回满你的能量、活血酒层数，并获得一层天神酒或天神灌注的充能。

options.description_en: Your damaging abilities have a chance to invoke Niuzao, causing him to charge to your target's location and Stomp, dealing 139 Physical damage to your target and reduced damage to secondary targets.
options.description_zh: 你的伤害性技能有几率召唤砮皂，冲向你的目标位置并施放践踏。对你的目标造成139点物理伤害，并对次要目标造成较少伤害。

options.description_en: Your damaging abilities have an increased chance to invoke Niuzao, causing him to charge to your target's location and Stomp, dealing 140 Physical damage to your target and reduced damage to secondary targets.
options.description_zh: 你的伤害性技能有更高几率召唤砮皂，冲向你的目标位置并施放践踏。对你的目标造成141点物理伤害，并对次要目标造成较少伤害。

options.description_zh: 你的醉拳化解效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高15%。

options.description_en: When you consume a Healing Sphere, you clear 5% of your currently Staggered damage.
options.description_zh: 每当你消耗一颗疗伤珠，就可以化解你身上5%的醉拳伤害。

options.description_en: Tiger Palm's damage is increased by 100% and reduces the remaining cooldown of your Brews by 0.5 additional sec.
options.description_zh: 猛虎掌的伤害提高100%，并使你的酒类技能剩余的冷却时间额外缩短0.5秒。

options.description_zh: 施放迅如猛虎使滚地翻的剩余冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Tiger's Lust grants 20% movement speed to up to 2 allies near its target.
options.description_zh: 迅如猛虎使目标附近的最多2名盟友的移动速度提高20%。

options.description_zh: 对自己施放时，你的单目标治疗法术的治疗效果提高10%，并且在6秒内额外恢复570点生命值。

options.description_zh: 壮胆酒使醉拳化解量提高20%。

options.description_zh: 施放醉酿投会使你获得一层潜在能量。

options.description_zh: 火焰之息造成的伤害提高100%，并且在使用火焰之息后，你会额外喷火2次，每次造成7点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Your Breath of Fire ignites your right leg in flame for 8 sec, causing your Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick to deal 50% additional damage as Fire damage and refresh the duration of your Breath of Fire on the target.
options.description_zh: 你的火焰之息会将火焰缠绕在你的右腿上，持续8秒，使你的幻灭踢和神鹤引项踢能够额外造成50%的火焰伤害，并刷新目标身上火焰之息的持续时间。

options.description_en:
Stagger is 2% more effective at delaying damage.

Purifying Brew refunds 2.0 sec of its cooldown if cast at Elevated Stagger.
options.description_zh:
醉拳化解伤害的效果提高2%。

活血酒在强化醉拳时施放，可以返还2.0秒冷却时间。

options.description_en:

Purifying Brew refunds 4.0 sec of its cooldown if cast at Elevated Stagger.
options.description_zh:
醉拳化解伤害的效果提高4%。

活血酒在强化醉拳时施放，可以返还4.0秒冷却时间。

After 10 attacks, the next casts Tiger Palm at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh:
你的主手自动攻击使酒类技能的冷却时间缩短0.50秒，同时阻断目标的真气，额外造成10点自然伤害。

在10次攻击后，下一次施放的猛虎掌会造成100%的效果。

options.description_en:
Blackout Kick also empowers your next ability:

 Tiger Palm: Damage increased by 100%.

 Keg Smash: Reduces the remaining cooldown on your Brews by 2 additional sec.
options.description_zh:
幻灭踢还将强化你的下一个技能：

猛虎掌：伤害提高100%。

醉酿投：你所有酒类技能的剩余冷却时间额外缩短2秒。

options.description_zh: 你每次躲闪或未被敌人命中时，你的酒类技能剩余的冷却时间就缩短0.5秒。每增加一个最近的攻击者，效果就减少50%，最多5个。

options.description_en: Each time you dodge or an enemy misses you, the remaining cooldown on your Brews is reduced by 1.0 sec. Effect reduced by 50% for each additional recent attacker, up to 5.
options.description_zh: 你每次躲闪或未被敌人命中时，你的酒类技能剩余的冷却时间就缩短1.0秒。每增加一个最近的攻击者，效果就减少50%，最多5个。

options.description_en: Each time you dodge or an enemy misses you, your next Tiger Palm or Spinning Crane Kick deals 100% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 你每次躲闪或未被敌人命中时，下一个猛虎掌或神鹤引项踢造成的伤害提高100%。

options.description_en: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm deal 15% additional damage to enemies in a line in front of you. Damage reduced above 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 旭日东升踢、幻灭踢和猛虎掌对你前方直线范围内的敌人造成15%的额外伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

options.description_zh: 真气爆裂使存储的活力提高25%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm contribute 30% additional vitality.
options.description_zh: 旭日东升踢、幻灭踢和猛虎掌额外产生30%的活力。

options.description_en: Casting Enveloping Mist stores 1,140 additional vitality.
options.description_zh: 施放氤氲之雾会额外储存1,140点活力。

options.description_en:
Blackout Combo:
Increases Tiger Palm damage by an additional 50% and Keg Smash reduces the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 1.0 sec.

  Press the Advantage:
Nature damage dealt by your main hand auto-attacks is increased by 100% and they now reduce the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 0.25 sec.
options.description_zh:
幻灭连击：
使猛虎掌的伤害额外提高50%，醉酿投使你的酒类技能冷却时间额外缩短1.0秒。

顺水推舟：
你的主手普通攻击造成的自然伤害提高100%，并使你的酒类技能冷却时间额外缩短0.25秒。

options.description_en:
Hurls a flaming keg at the target location, dealing 133 Fire damage to nearby enemies, causing your attacks against them to deal 10 additional Fire damage, and causing their melee attacks to deal 100% reduced damage for the next 3 sec.

Resets the cooldown of Keg Smash.
options.description_zh:
向目标位置投掷一个燃烧的酒桶，对附近的敌人造成133点火焰伤害。你对这些敌人的攻击会额外造成10点火焰伤害，并使他们在接下来3秒内的近战攻击伤害降低100%。

重置醉酿投的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Casting Purifying Brew grants a charge of Ox Stance. When you take damage that is greater than 60% of your current health, a charge is consumed to increase the amount you Stagger.
options.description_zh: 施放活血酒会获得一层玄牛式。当你受到的伤害量超过你当前生命值的60%时，消耗一层并提高你的醉拳化解量。

nodes.name_zh: 觉醒之魂 / 生命之焰

options.description_en:
Purifying Brew also surrounds you with protective energies for 15 sec. 

When Staggered damage would be dealt to you, you instead absorb up to 50%, until 210 has been prevented.
options.description_zh:
活血酒还会用保护性的能量包围你，持续15秒。

当醉拳即将对你造成伤害时，你改为吸收最多50%的伤害，直到防止了210点伤害为止。

options.description_en: Heal for 50% of all Fire or Nature damage dealt by your spells and abilities.
options.description_zh: 你法术和技能造成的所有火焰或自然伤害的50%会为你恢复生命值。

options.description_en:
Summons an effigy of Niuzao, the Black Ox for 25 sec that attacks your primary target and Stomps when you cast Blackout Kick, damaging all nearby enemies.

While active, 40% of damage delayed by Stagger is instead Staggered by Niuzao, and Niuzao is healed for 100% of your purified Stagger.
options.description_zh:
召唤玄牛砮皂的幻身，持续25秒。砮皂会攻击你的主要目标，并在你施放幻灭踢时施放践踏，对附近所有敌人造成伤害。

激活时，醉拳化解伤害的40%会由砮皂代为化解，清除醉拳伤害的100%会治疗砮皂。

options.description_en:
When Aspect of Harmony heals, it has a chance to spread to a nearby ally. When you directly heal an affected target, it has a chance to intensify, withdrawing additional vitality to increase its effect by up to 20%.

Vivify no longer contributes vitality. While Aspect of Harmony is not active, Vivify instead draws on available vitality to deal an additional 100% healing over 8 sec.

Vitality stored by other abilities is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh:
当和谐化身产生治疗时，有一定几率传播给附近的一个盟友。当你直接治疗一个受影响的目标时，有几率增强效果，抽取更多活力，将效果最多提高20%。

活血术不再产生活力。当和谐化身未激活时，活血术改为汲取现有的活力，额外造成100%的治疗，持续8秒。

其他技能储存的活力提高50%。

options.description_en: Exploding Keg also causes your next 2 casts of Keg Smash to summon a whirl of flame which spirals outwards, dealing 70 additional Fire damage to each enemy struck.
options.description_zh: 爆炸酒桶还会使你的下2个醉酿投召唤出一道螺旋向外的火焰旋风，对击中的每个敌人造成70点额外火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Exploding Keg can be reactivated within 20 sec to throw 5 additional kegs at nearby targets, each dealing 70 Physical damage and reducing the cooldown of your Brews by 3.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 爆炸酒桶可以在20秒内再次激活，向附近目标投掷5个额外酒桶，每个酒桶造成70点物理伤害，并使你的酒类技能冷却时间缩短3.0秒。

options.description_en: Keg Smash deals 50% additional damage to its primary target, has 1 additional charge, and its range is increased by 10 yards.
options.description_zh: 醉酿投对其主要目标造成的伤害额外提高50%，获得额外1次使用次数，且射程增加10码。

options.description_en: Mastery increased by 5%. Double this effect while Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is active.

options.description_en: While active, Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox can be recast to cause Niuzao to stomp mightily and knock nearby enemies into the air.

options.description_en:
When Aspect of Harmony heals, it has a chance to spread to a nearby ally. When you directly heal an affected target, it has a chance to intensify, withdrawing additional vitality to increase its effect by up to 20%.

Vivify no longer contributes vitality. While Aspect of Harmony is not active, Vivify instead draws on available vitality to deal an additional 100% healing over 8 sec.

Vitality stored by other abilities is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh:
当和谐化身产生治疗时，有一定几率传播给附近的一个盟友。当你直接治疗一个受影响的目标时，有几率增强效果，抽取更多活力，将效果最多提高20%。

活血术不再产生活力。当和谐化身未激活时，活血术改为汲取现有的活力，额外造成100%的治疗，持续8秒。

其他技能储存的活力提高50%。

options.description_en: Casting Enveloping Mist stores 1,140 additional vitality.
options.description_zh: 施放氤氲之雾会额外储存1,140点活力。

nodes.name_en: Mantra of Purity / Mantra of Tenacity
nodes.name_zh: 纯净真言 / 坚韧真言

options.description_en: When cast on yourself, your single-target healing spells heal for 10% more and restore an additional 570 health over 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 对自己施放时，你的单目标治疗法术的治疗效果提高10%，并且在6秒内额外恢复570点生命值。

options.description_en: Fortifying Brew grants 20% Stagger.
options.description_zh: 壮胆酒使醉拳化解量提高20%。

options.description_en: Casting a Physical spell or ability increases the damage and healing of your next Fire or Nature spell or ability by 3%, and vice versa. Stacks up to 5.
options.description_zh: 施放一个物理法术或技能会使你的下一个火焰或自然法术与技能的伤害和治疗效果提高3%，反之亦然。最多叠加5次。

options.description_en:
Casting Thunder Focus Tea grants 2 charges of Potential Energy. Your next cast of Tiger Palm or Vivify consumes all charges of Potential Energy to cause a Harmonic Surge.

Harmonic Surge:
For each charge of Potential Energy, deal 836 Nature damage to your target and 836 Nature damage to other nearby enemies, and heal up to 5 allies for 190. Damage reduced above 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
施放雷光聚神茶会使你获得2层潜在能量。你施放的下一次猛虎掌或活血术会消耗所有潜在能量层数，造成和谐涌动。

和谐涌动：
每拥有一层潜在能量，对你的目标造成836点自然伤害，对附近其他敌人造成836点自然伤害，并为最多5个受伤的盟友恢复190点生命值。目标超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Casting Keg Smash grants a charge of Potential Energy.
options.description_zh: 施放醉酿投会使你获得一层潜在能量。

options.description_en:
Blackout Combo:
Increases Tiger Palm damage by an additional 50% and Keg Smash reduces the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 1.0 sec.

  Press the Advantage:
Nature damage dealt by your main hand auto-attacks is increased by 100% and they now reduce the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 0.25 sec.
options.description_zh:
幻灭连击：
使猛虎掌的伤害额外提高50%，醉酿投使你的酒类技能冷却时间额外缩短1.0秒。

顺水推舟：
你的主手普通攻击造成的自然伤害提高100%，并使你的酒类技能冷却时间额外缩短0.25秒。

options.description_en: Heals the target for 6,386 over 7.1 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.
options.description_zh: 在7.1秒内为目标恢复6,386点生命值。引导时，可以在目标身上瞬发氤氲之雾和活血术。

options.description_zh: 引导抚慰之雾时，你和目标受到的所有伤害降低6%。

options.description_en: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.
options.description_zh: 使一名友方目标的移动速度提高70%，持续6秒，并解除所有定身和诱捕效果。

options.description_en: Rising Sun Kick deals 70% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高70%，神鹤引项踢的伤害提高10%。

options.description_zh:
施放旭日东升踢后，你的下一次活血术变为瞬发。

此效果还会使活血术的能量消耗降低75%。

options.description_zh: 猛击目标的咽喉，打断其施法，并阻止其施放任何同系的法术，持续5秒。

options.description_zh: 清创生血成功移除一名盟友身上的效果后，其移动速度提高30%，持续5秒。

options.description_zh: 使分筋错骨的冷却时间缩短15秒，扫堂腿的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_zh: 将你的肉体和灵魂分离，并将灵魂留在原地，持续15分钟。使用魂体双分：转移，让你的肉体和你的灵魂交换位置。

options.description_zh: 成功打断敌人会使分筋错骨和滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_zh: 使滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒，使用次数上限提高1次。

options.description_zh: 你受到的诱捕效果的持续时间缩短20%。

options.description_en: Provoked targets move towards you at 50% increased speed.

options.description_zh: 造成的所有伤害提高2%。

options.description_zh: 造成的所有伤害提高4%。

nodes.name_zh: 平心之环 / 赤精之歌

options.description_zh: 在目标位置形成平心之环，持续5秒。进入环中的敌人将被推出环外。

options.description_zh: 施放一团催眠云雾，缓缓向前移动。接触到雾气的敌人将陷入沉睡，迷惑20秒。

options.description_zh: 施放魂体双分：转移时诱捕10码内的目标，使其减速70%，持续4秒。

options.description_zh: 激战时真气的流动令你变得坚毅，在战斗中每3秒获得一层魔法吸收护盾，吸收相当于最大生命值1.0%的伤害，最多叠加至10%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 平心之环的冷却时间缩短5秒，赤精之歌的施法时间缩短0.5秒。

options.description_zh: 让你的皮肤化为坚石，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack, stacking up to 4.
options.description_zh: 你受到的物理伤害降低10%，且每4秒额外降低10%，直到受到一次物理攻击，最多可叠加至4层。
