options.description_zh: 基于目标的当前生命值，你的治疗效果最多提高10%。生命值较低的目标会获得更多治疗。

options.description_zh: 滚地翻每30秒可移除一个诱捕效果。

options.description_zh: 激活壮胆酒会尽可能将你身上当前激活的所有有害魔法效果返还给施法者。

options.description_zh: 幻灭踢的爆击几率提高12%，爆击伤害提高20%。

options.description_zh: 最大真气值提高1点，最大能量值提高20点，能量回复速度提高10%。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Roll is decreased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻的冷却时间减少10%。

options.description_zh: 战斗开始时的8秒内移动速度提高50%。

Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.

自动攻击的爆击会使疾风拳势层数翻倍。


醉酿投的伤害提高35%。

This effect can not occur more than once every 180 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至50%时，召唤钢铁漩涡，使你的招架几率和闪避提高15%，持续6秒。

该效果每180秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: When you dodge or parry an attack, reduce all damage taken by 10% for the next 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你躲闪或招架一次攻击时，接下来6秒内受到的所有伤害降低10%。

options.description_zh: 激活玄牛下凡会立即获得10层疾风乱打，在你的下一次攻击时触发，效果为70%。

options.description_zh: 壮胆酒让你获得最大生命值25%的吸收护盾。

After Invoking Xuen, the White Tiger you may cast Celestial Conduit within 1 min.

 Celestial Conduit:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 292 Nature damage onto enemies and 21,061 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

You may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.
options.description_zh:
在召唤白虎雪怒后，你可以在1分钟内施放天神御身。

 天神御身:
至尊天神赋予你力量，使你能够在3.6秒内对15码范围内的敌人造成283点自然伤害，并为最多5名受伤的盟友恢复21,350点生命值，超过5个目标后效果降低。

引导期间，你可以移动，但施放其他治疗或伤害法术会取消该效果。

You switch between alignments every 8 sec, increasing a corresponding secondary stat by 2%.

Haste

Tiger Stance:
Critical Strike

Ox Stance:
Versatility

Serpent Stance: 
Mastery

急速

options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击有30%的几率改为脚踢目标，造成169点物理伤害。使用双手武器时造成的伤害提高。

options.description_en:
Tiger Palm causes your next Blackout Kick to strike an additional time dealing 29 Physical damage, stacking up to 4.

options.description_zh:
猛虎掌会使下个幻灭踢额外攻击一次，造成30点物理伤害，最多可叠加4次。

幻灭踢有12%的几率重置旭日东升踢的剩余冷却时间。

options.description_en: Rising Sun Kick has a chance equal to 100% of your haste to trigger a second time, dealing 17 Physical damage and restoring 1 Chi.
options.description_zh: 旭日东升踢有等同于急速的100%的几率被再次触发，造成17点物理伤害，并恢复1点真气。

天神御身可以在持续期间再施放一次，召唤所有至尊天神协助你，产生200%的效果。

如果在天神御身效果结束时未施放，则会在结束时自动施放众神聚心。

options.description_zh: 神鹤引项踢的伤害提高15%，范围扩大15%。

options.description_zh:
轮回之触的冷却时间缩短45秒。

轮回之触额外造成15%的伤害。

options.description_en: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15% and critical strike damage increased by 12%.
options.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高15%，爆击伤害提高12%。

真气消耗降低1点，并且幻灭踢使受影响技能的冷却时间额外缩短1秒，持续15秒。

激活乾元之巅会重置旭日东升踢的剩余冷却时间。

options.description_zh: 神鹤引项踢会引爆能量并产生真气破，对8码内的所有敌人造成122点自然伤害，目标超过5个时伤害降低。

options.description_en: You gain 10% more Haste from all sources of Haste.
options.description_zh: 你从所有来源获得的急速属性额外提高10%。

options.description_en: The damage of Fists of Fury is increased by 20%.

options.description_zh: 乾元之巅的持续时间延长5秒。

options.description_en: The cooldown of Zenith is reduced by 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 乾元之巅的冷却时间缩短20秒。

nodes.name_zh: 风领主之击 / 升龙霸

options.description_en: Strike with both fists at all enemies in front of you, dealing 529 Physical damage and reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.
options.description_zh: 用双拳攻击你前方的所有目标，造成529点物理伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续6秒。对次要目标造成较低的伤害。

Performs a devastating whirling upward strike, dealing 330 damage to all nearby enemies and an additional 158 damage to the first target struck. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Only usable while both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are on cooldown.
options.description_zh:
施展拳法，发动盘旋向上的毁灭性攻击，对附近的所有敌人造成332点伤害，并对第一个击中的目标额外造成157点伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

只有在怒雷破和旭日东升踢都在冷却时才能使用。

options.description_en: When you consume Blackout Kick!, you have a 100% chance to generate 1 Chi.
options.description_zh: 当你消耗“幻灭踢！”效果时，有100%的几率产生1点真气。

options.description_en: Increases maximum Energy by 30. Tiger Palm's Energy cost reduced by 5.
options.description_zh: 能量上限提高30点，猛虎掌消耗的能量降低5点。

options.description_en: You have a 100% chance to gain Blackout Kick! after consuming Dance of Chi-Ji.
options.description_zh: 消耗赤精之舞后，你有100%的几率获得幻灭踢！

options.description_en: Rising Sun Kick gains 40% additional effectiveness from Mastery: Combo Strikes.
options.description_zh: 旭日东升踢从精通：组合拳获得的效果提高40%。

options.description_en: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have their cooldowns reduced by 5 sec and their damage is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 风领主之击和升龙霸的冷却时间缩短5秒，伤害提高20%。

options.description_zh: 施放风领主之击或升龙霸会获得幻灭踢！效果。

options.description_zh: 你的法术伤害提高8%。

Rushing Wind Kick:

在消耗幻灭踢！后，旭日东升踢有60%的几率变为疾风呼啸踢。

疾风呼啸踢:
掀起一股强劲疾风，对你前方25码锥形范围内的敌人造成62点自然伤害，由所有敌人均摊。每命中一个目标，伤害提高6%，最多提高30%。

旭日东升踢爆击时，怒雷破的冷却时间缩短4秒。

神鹤引项踢每击中一个不同的目标，怒雷破的冷却时间缩短0.5秒，最多缩短2.5秒。

options.description_zh:
风领主之击和升龙霸使你获得4层雷霆拳效果，每额外击中一名敌人额外获得一层。

近战攻击会消耗雷霆拳层数，造成56点自然伤害。

options.description_zh: 你在乾元之巅期间的伤害提高5%。

风领主之击和升龙霸产生4层禅院教诲。

禅院教诲现在最多可叠加8次。

将自己包裹在势如刀锋的劲风中，随后猛冲向前，对路径中的敌人造成156点自然伤害。敌人超过5个时伤害降低。

options.description_zh: 你的近战攻击速度提高30%。在乾元之巅期间该加成提高至60%。

Unity Within is automatically cast when Celestial Conduit ends if not used before expiration.
options.description_zh:
天神御身可以在持续期间再施放一次，召唤所有至尊天神协助你，产生200%的效果。

如果在天神御身效果结束时未施放，则会在结束时自动施放众神聚心。

options.description_en: Strength of the Black Ox's effect is 400% more effective on your primary target.
options.description_zh: 玄牛之力的效果对你的主要目标提高400%。

options.description_en:
Xuen claws your target for 118 Physical damage, healing a nearby ally for 100% of the damage done.

Invoking a celestial guarantees your next cast activates this effect.
options.description_zh:
雪怒爪击你的目标，造成118点物理伤害，并为附近的一位盟友恢复伤害量的100%的生命值。

使用任意天神下凡后，下次施放必定激活此效果。

options.description_en: Summons an effigy of Xuen, the White Tiger for 20 sec. Xuen attacks your primary target, and strikes 3 enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec with Tiger Lightning for 8 Nature damage.
options.description_zh: 召唤白虎雪怒的幻身，持续20秒。雪怒会攻击你的主要目标，并且每0.9秒对10码范围内的3个敌人施放伏虎闪雷，造成9点自然伤害。

options.description_en: Heart of the Jade Serpent increases your haste by 10% while active.
options.description_zh: 青龙之心激活时，你的急速提高10%。

options.description_en: upon Yu'lon to increase the cooldown recovery rate of  by 75% for .
options.description_zh: 会召唤玉珑，让的冷却回复速度加快75%，持续。

options.description_en:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 287 Nature damage onto enemies and 20,929 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

You may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.
options.description_zh:
至尊天神赋予你力量，使你能够在3.6秒内对15码范围内的敌人造成293点自然伤害，并为最多5名受伤的盟友恢复20,960点生命值，超过5个目标后效果降低。

引导期间，你可以移动，但施放其他治疗或伤害法术会取消该效果。

options.description_en: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift have a chance to trigger Heart of the Jade Serpent for 4 sec at 100% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 活血术和神龙之赐有几率以100%的效果触发青龙之心，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
After Invoking Xuen, the White Tiger you may cast Celestial Conduit within 1 min.

 Celestial Conduit:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 293 Nature damage onto enemies and 21,333 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

You may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.
options.description_zh:
在召唤白虎雪怒后，你可以在1分钟内施放天神御身。

 天神御身:
至尊天神赋予你力量，使你能够在3.6秒内对15码范围内的敌人造成285点自然伤害，并为最多5名受伤的盟友恢复21,339点生命值，超过5个目标后效果降低。

引导期间，你可以移动，但施放其他治疗或伤害法术会取消该效果。

nodes.name_zh: 恢复平衡 / 雪怒羁绊

options.description_en: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger's damage is increased by 30% and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 白虎下凡的伤害提高30%，冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Blackout Kick deals an additional 30% critical damage.
options.description_zh: 幻灭踢造成的爆击伤害提高30%。

nodes.name_zh: 钢铁漩涡 / 先觉磨砺

options.description_en:
When your health drops below 50%, summon Whirling Steel, increasing your parry chance and avoidance by 15% for 6 sec.

This effect can not occur more than once every 180 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你的生命值降至50%时，召唤钢铁漩涡，使你的招架几率和闪避提高15%，持续6秒。

该效果每180秒只能触发一次。

options.description_en: When you dodge or parry an attack, reduce all damage taken by 10% for the next 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你躲闪或招架一次攻击时，接下来6秒内受到的所有伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Your attacks penetrate 12% armor.
options.description_zh: 你的攻击穿透12%的护甲。

nodes.name_zh: 潘达利亚之豪 / 拳劲贯体

options.description_en: Flurry Strikes have 15% additional chance to critically strike.
options.description_zh: 疾风乱打的爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en: Enemies who die within 10 sec of being damaged by a Flurry Strike explode, dealing 35 physical damage to uncontrolled enemies within 8 yds.
options.description_zh: 在受到疾风乱打伤害后的10秒内死亡的敌人会爆炸，对8码内未受到失控效果影响的敌人造成35点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Your auto attacks have a chance to generate 1-2 Flurry Charges. When you cast Keg Smash, unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing 21 Physical damage per charge.
options.description_zh: 你的自动攻击有几率产生1-2层疾风拳势。施放醉酿投会释放所有疾风拳势，每层造成21点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Haste increased by 5%.
options.description_zh: 急速提高5%。

options.description_en:
Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.


Keg Smash damage increased by 35%.
options.description_zh:
自动攻击的爆击会使疾风拳势层数翻倍。


醉酿投的伤害提高35%。

options.description_en:
Energy spenders deal an additional 20% damage.
The cooldown of Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is reduced by 25 sec.
options.description_zh:
消耗能量的技能造成的伤害提高20%。
玄牛下凡的冷却时间缩短25秒。

options.description_en: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox causes Breath of Fire to launch 3 Flurry Strikes.
options.description_zh: 玄牛下凡会使火焰吐息施放3次疾风乱打。

options.description_en: Your agility is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你的敏捷提高4%。

nodes.name_zh: 作战姿态 / 意到锋至

options.description_en: The cooldown of Roll is decreased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻的冷却时间减少10%。

options.description_en: Movement speed is increased by 50% for the first 8 sec of combat.
options.description_zh: 战斗开始时的8秒内移动速度提高50%。

options.description_en: Flurry Strikes deal 18 Nature damage to all enemies within 6 yds, reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 疾风乱打对6码内的所有敌人造成18点自然伤害，超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en: Activating Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox instantly grants 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes that trigger on your next attack at 70% effectiveness.
options.description_zh: 激活玄牛下凡会立即获得10层疾风乱打，在你的下一次攻击时触发，效果为70%。

options.description_en: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox's stomp damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 玄牛下凡的践踏伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Heals the target for 6,386 over 7.1 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.
options.description_zh: 在7.1秒内为目标恢复6,386点生命值。引导时，可以在目标身上瞬发氤氲之雾和活血术。

options.description_en: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 使目标瘫痪，持续1分钟。只能对一个目标使用。伤害可能取消该效果。

options.description_en: Kick upwards, dealing 50 Physical damage.
options.description_zh: 向上猛踢，造成50点物理伤害。

options.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by you and your target while channeling Soothing Mists by 6%.
options.description_zh: 引导抚慰之雾时，你和目标受到的所有伤害降低6%。

options.description_en: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.
options.description_zh: 使一名友方目标的移动速度提高70%，持续6秒，并解除所有定身和诱捕效果。

options.description_en: Targets you Roll through are snared by 40% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻穿过的目标被诱捕，移动速度降低40%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec, duration refreshed by your melee attacks.
options.description_zh: 使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续15秒。近战攻击会刷新持续时间。

options.description_en: Rising Sun Kick deals 70% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高70%，神鹤引项踢的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Increases all healing taken by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的所有治疗效果提高4%。

options.description_en: Roll and Chi Torpedo travel a small distance further.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻和真气突的移动距离略微延长。

options.description_en: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.
options.description_zh: 受到的所有伤害降低3%。

options.description_en:
The range of Disable is increased by 5 yds.
 
The duration of Crashing Momentum is increased by 3 sec and its snare now reduces movement speed by an additional 20%.
options.description_zh:
金刚震的射程延长5码。

迅威压迫的持续时间延长3秒，诱捕效果现在使移动速度额外降低20%。

options.description_en: Detox additionally removes all Poison and Disease effects.
options.description_zh: 清创生血能够移除所有的中毒和疾病效果。

nodes.name_zh: 活力苏醒 / 静水奔流

options.description_en:
After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

This effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.
options.description_zh:
施放旭日东升踢后，你的下一次活血术变为瞬发。

此效果还会使活血术的能量消耗降低75%。

options.description_en: After casting Enveloping Mist, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.
options.description_zh: 施放氤氲之雾后，你的下一个活血术变为瞬发。

options.description_en: While no enemies are within 15 yds, you heal for 1,425 every 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 当你周围15码内没有敌人时，你每3秒获得1,425点治疗。

options.description_en: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 未进入战斗时，你的移动速度提高15%。

options.description_en: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.
options.description_zh: 分筋错骨现在会移除目标的所有激怒效果。

options.description_en: You heal for 3% of all magical damage taken.
options.description_zh: 你受到的所有魔法伤害的3%将转化为治疗。

options.description_en: After Detox successfully removes an effect from an ally, their movement speed is increased by 30% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 清创生血成功移除一名盟友身上的效果后，其移动速度提高30%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 8 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 使分筋错骨的冷却时间缩短8秒，扫堂腿的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 15 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 使分筋错骨的冷却时间缩短15秒，扫堂腿的冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en: Strength of the Black Ox's effect is 400% more effective on your primary target.
options.description_zh: 玄牛之力的效果对你的主要目标提高400%。

options.description_en: Every 15 sec, your next Rising Sun Kick or Vivify releases a wave of Chi energy that flows through friends and foes, dealing 7 Nature damage or 21 healing. Bounces up to 7 times to targets within 25 yards.
options.description_zh: 每过15秒，你的下一个旭日东升踢或活血术会释放一道真气能量波拂过你的盟友和敌人，造成7点自然伤害或恢复21点生命值。可弹射到25码范围内的目标身上，最多弹射7次。

options.description_en: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.
options.description_zh: 将你的肉体和灵魂分离，并将灵魂留在原地，持续15分钟。使用魂体双分：转移，让你的肉体和你的灵魂交换位置。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.
options.description_zh: 使滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒，使用次数上限提高1次。

options.description_en: Torpedoes you forward a long distance and increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 sec, stacking up to 2 times.
options.description_zh: 向前突进很长一段距离，并使移动速度提高30%，持续10秒，可叠加2次。

options.description_en: Leg Sweep applies Disable for 5.0 sec when it ends.
options.description_zh: 扫堂腿结束时，会施加5.0秒的金刚震效果。

options.description_en: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.
options.description_zh: 你受到的诱捕效果的持续时间缩短20%。

options.description_en: Provoked targets move towards you at 50% increased speed.
options.description_zh: 激怒的目标向你移动，并且移动速度提高50%。

options.description_en: Increases all damage dealt by 2%.
options.description_zh: 造成的所有伤害提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases all damage dealt by 4%.
options.description_zh: 造成的所有伤害提高4%。

nodes.name_en: Ring of Peace / Song of Chi-Ji
nodes.name_zh: 平心之环 / 赤精之歌

options.description_en: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置形成平心之环，持续5秒。进入环中的敌人将被推出环外。

options.description_en: Conjures a cloud of hypnotic mist that slowly travels forward. Enemies touched by the mist fall asleep, Disoriented for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 施放一团催眠云雾，缓缓向前移动。接触到雾气的敌人将陷入沉睡，迷惑20秒。

options.description_en: Transcendence: Transfer snares targets within 10 yds by 70% for 4 sec when cast.
options.description_zh: 施放魂体双分：转移时诱捕10码内的目标，使其减速70%，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.
options.description_zh: 使扫堂腿的范围提高4码。

options.description_en: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.
options.description_zh: 现在轮回之触可以对剩余生命值低于15%的目标使用，造成相当于你最大生命值35%的伤害。

options.description_en: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift trigger a Gust of Mist on yourself.
options.description_zh: 活血术和神龙之赐会在你自己身上触发一次迷雾之风。

options.description_en: Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 1.0% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 10%.
options.description_zh: 激战时真气的流动令你变得坚毅，在战斗中每3秒获得一层魔法吸收护盾，吸收相当于最大生命值1.0%的伤害，最多叠加至10%。

options.description_en: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.
options.description_zh: 平心之环的冷却时间缩短5秒，赤精之歌的施法时间缩短0.5秒。

options.description_en: Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 让你的皮肤化为坚石，持续15秒。

options.description_en: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack, stacking up to 4.
options.description_zh: 你受到的物理伤害降低10%，且每4秒额外降低10%，直到受到一次物理攻击，最多可叠加至4层。

options.description_en: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the current health of your target. Lower health targets are healed for more.
options.description_zh: 基于目标的当前生命值，你的治疗效果最多提高10%。生命值较低的目标会获得更多治疗。

options.description_en: Roll removes a snare effect once every 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻每30秒可移除一个诱捕效果。

options.description_en: Vivify and Sheilun's Gift critical strike chances are increased by 15% on yourself.
options.description_zh: 对你自己施放时，活血术和神龙之赐的爆击几率提高15%。

nodes.name_en: Jade Infusion / Summon Jade Serpent Statue
nodes.name_zh: 玉龙灌注 / 召唤青龙雕像

options.description_en: Thunder Focus Tea summons a Jade Serpent Statue at your location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.
options.description_zh: 雷光聚神茶在你的位置召唤一座青龙雕像。当你引导抚慰之雾时，青龙雕像也会开始对你的目标引导抚慰之雾，在7.1秒内为其恢复2,128点生命值。

options.description_en: Summons a Jade Serpent Statue at the target location. When you channel Soothing Mist, the statue will also begin to channel Soothing Mist on your target, healing for 2,128 over 7.1 sec.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一座青龙雕像。当你引导抚慰之雾时，青龙雕像也会开始对你的目标引导抚慰之雾，在7.1秒内为其恢复2,128点生命值。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum health by an additional 10% and your damage taken is reduced by an additional 10% while Fortifying Brew is active.
options.description_zh: 壮胆酒激活时，你的最大生命值额外提高10%，受到的伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 壮胆酒的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.
options.description_zh: 激活壮胆酒会尽可能将你身上当前激活的所有有害魔法效果返还给施法者。

options.description_en: While your Celestial is active, you cannot be slowed below 90% normal movement speed.
options.description_zh: 当你的天神激活时，你的移动速度不会降低到正常速度的90%以下。

options.description_en: Magical damage done increased by 2% and healing done increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 造成的魔法伤害提高2%，造成的治疗效果提高2%。

options.description_en: Magical damage done increased by 4% and healing done increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 造成的魔法伤害提高4%，造成的治疗效果提高4%。

options.description_en: Transcendence: Transfer immediately heals you for 10% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 魂体双分：转移会为你恢复最大生命值的10%。

options.description_en: You and your allies within 10 yards have 4% increased movement speed. Stacks with other similar effects.
options.description_zh: 你和10码内的盟友的移动速度提高4%。可与其他类似效果叠加。

options.description_en: Touch of Death now heals you for 60% of its damage done.
options.description_zh: 轮回之触现在会治疗你该技能造成伤害的60%。

options.description_en: Increases your Physical damage done by 2% and Avoidance increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的物理伤害提高2%，闪避提高2%。

options.description_en: Increases your Physical damage done by 4% and Avoidance increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的物理伤害提高4%，闪避提高4%。

options.description_en: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 滚地翻令你身轻如羽，使你可以在5秒内施展一次二段跳，向前冲刺一小段距离，滚地翻的冷却时间提高2秒。

options.description_en:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.
options.description_zh:
你会根据当前生命值获得一个额外效果。

生命值高于90%：移动速度提高5%。该效果可与其他相似效果叠加。

生命值在90%与35%之间：受到的伤害降低5%。

生命值低于35%：受到的治疗效果提高10%。

nodes.name_en: Escape from Reality / Transcendence: Linked Spirits
nodes.name_zh: 魂游天外 / 魂体双分：链接之魂

options.description_en: After you use Transcendence: Transfer, you can use Transcendence: Transfer again within 10 sec, ignoring its cooldown.
options.description_zh: 施放魂体双分：转移后，你可以在10秒内再次施放魂体双分：转移，无视其冷却时间。

options.description_en: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.
options.description_zh: 魂体双分现在使你的灵魂与一名盟友绑定，持续1小时。使用魂体双分：转移可以传送到你的盟友的位置。

options.description_en: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
options.description_zh: 轮回之触的冷却时间缩短90秒。

options.description_en: Your heightened reflexes allow you to react swiftly to the presence of enemies, causing you to quickly lunge to the nearest enemy in front of you within 10 yards after you Roll.
options.description_zh: 敏锐的反应使你能够快速应对附近的敌人，使用滚地翻后会立刻扑向前方10码内最近的敌人。

options.description_en:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 288 Nature damage onto enemies and 21,085 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

options.description_en:
Consuming 20 Soul Fragments or casting Sigil of Spite converts your next Throw Glaive into Reaver's Glaive.

 Reaver's Glaive: 
Throw a glaive enhanced with the essence of consumed souls at your target, dealing 134 Physical damage and ricocheting to 2 additional enemies.

你首先施放的强化技能会造成10%的额外伤害，第二个技能会造成20%的额外伤害。

options.description_zh:
吞噬有35%的几率获得1层虚落。

达到3层虚落时，收割会消耗1层虚落探入虚空，并在你的目标位置召唤一次流星撞击，对8码内的所有敌人造成671点宇宙伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Void Metamorphosis now also greatly empowers Voidblade and Hungering Slash.

While demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Voidsurge, causing you to explode with Void energy, dealing 2,381 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
虚空变形现在还会大幅强化虚空之刃和饥渴斩击。

恶魔形态激活时，你第一次施放每种强化技能时都会触发一次虚空涌动，使你爆发出虚空能量，对周围的敌人造成2,335点宇宙伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Vengeful Retreat has a 5 sec reduced cooldown and generates 80 Fury over 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 复仇回避的冷却时间缩短5秒，并在10秒内产生80点恶魔之怒。

options.description_en: Eye Beam generates 10 Fury every second, has 10% increased duration, and deals 10% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 眼棱每秒产生10点恶魔之怒，持续时间延长10%，伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Eye Beam generates 20 Fury every second, has 20% increased duration, and deals 20% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 眼棱每秒产生20点恶魔之怒，持续时间延长20%，伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: When Eye Beam finishes fully channeling, your Haste is increased by an additional 8% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 完整施放眼棱之后，你的急速会额外提高8%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: The final slash of Blade Dance deals an additional 25% damage.
options.description_zh: 刃舞的最后一击造成的伤害提高25%。

options.description_en: The final slash of Blade Dance deals an additional 50% damage.
options.description_zh: 刃舞的最后一击造成的伤害提高50%。

options.description_en: Immolation Aura's damage increases by 10% each time it deals damage.
options.description_zh: 献祭光环每次造成伤害，其伤害就会提高10%。

nodes.name_en: Wave of Debilitation / Pursuit of Angriness
nodes.name_zh: 衰竭波动 / 怒意追击

options.description_en: Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.
options.description_zh: 混乱新星在其昏迷效果消失后，使敌人减速60%，并使其攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 1% per 10 Fury.
options.description_zh: 每10点恶魔之怒使移动速度提高1%。

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% Haste.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使急速提高2%。

options.description_en:
Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.
options.description_zh:
当虚空涌动仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高50%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低10%。

options.description_en:
Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.
options.description_zh:
虚空射线的伤害提高15%。

完整引导虚空射线会使你获得1层虚落。

options.description_en: Enemies struck by a Voidfall Meteor take an additional 25% damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 被虚落流星击中的敌人在8秒内额外受到25%的伤害。

nodes.name_en: Set Fire to the Pain / Improved Soul Rending
nodes.name_zh: 沐焰为殇 / 强化灵魂劈裂

options.description_en:
5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec.

Fire damage taken reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh:
受到的所有非火焰伤害的5%改为视作火焰伤害，持续6秒。

受到的火焰伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Leech granted by Soul Rending increased by 2% and an additional 2% while Void Metamorphosis is active.
options.description_zh: 由灵魂劈裂获得的吸血提高2%，在虚空变形期间再额外提高2%。

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% reduced damage taken.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使受到的伤害降低2%。

options.description_en:
Cosmic damage increased by 2%.

Effect is doubled while in demon form.
options.description_zh:
宇宙伤害提高2%。

在恶魔形态下效果翻倍。

nodes.name_zh: 能量放射 / 冲撞惯性

options.description_en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase your damage by 5% for 20 sec.
options.description_zh: 恶魔追击和复仇回避使你的伤害提高5%，持续20秒。

options.description_en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat cause your next Fel Rush or Felblade to empower you, increasing damage by 12% for 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 恶魔追击和复仇回避会使你从下一次邪能冲撞或邪能之刃中得到强化，伤害提高12%，持续5秒。

options.description_en:
Chaos Nova, Eye Beam, and Immolation Aura gain bonuses when striking 1 target.

 Chaos Nova:
Stun duration increased by 2 sec.

 Eye Beam:
Deals 30% increased damage.

 Immolation Aura:
Always critically strikes.
options.description_zh:
混乱新星、眼棱和献祭光环击中1个目标时获得加成。

 混乱新星:
昏迷持续时间延长2秒。

 眼棱：
造成的伤害提高30%。

 献祭光环：
总能造成爆击。

options.description_en: Charge to your target, striking them for 261 Chaos damage, rooting them in place for 1.5 sec and inflicting 188 Chaos damage over 6 sec to up to 5 enemies in your path.
options.description_zh: 冲向你的目标，对其造成254点混沌伤害，将其定在原地1.5秒，并在6秒内对路径上最多5名敌人造成188点混沌伤害。

options.description_en: Striking an enemy with Chaos Strike or Throw Glaive increases Chaos Strike and Throw Glaive damage by 15% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 用混乱打击或投掷利刃击中敌人会使混乱打击和投掷利刃的伤害提高15%，持续12秒。

options.description_en:
Demon's Bite and Throw Glaive leave open wounds on your enemies, dealing 25 Chaos damage over 15 sec and increasing damage taken from your Immolation Aura by 35%.

May be applied to up to 3 targets.
options.description_zh:
恶魔之咬和投掷利刃会在敌人身上留下伤口，在15秒内造成25点混乱伤害，并使你的献祭光环对其造成的伤害提高35%。

最多可对3个目标施加此效果。

options.description_en:
Your blades burn with Cosmic energy, causing your Voidblade, Hungering Slash, and Throw Glaive to deal an additional 35% damage as Cosmic damage.

Reap damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
你的利刃燃烧着宇宙能量，使你的虚空之刃、饥渴斩击和投掷利刃造成额外35%的宇宙伤害。

收割的伤害提高20%。

nodes.name_en: Path to Oblivion / State of Matter

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 3% increased movement speed.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使移动速度提高3%。

options.description_en: Shift has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 变换额外获得1次充能。

options.description_en:
Entering Void Metamorphosis resets the cooldown of Voidblade and The Hunt.

The Hunt deals 25% increased damage and resets the cooldown of Soul Immolation.
options.description_zh:
进入虚空变形时，重置虚空之刃和恶魔追击的冷却时间。

恶魔追击的伤害提高25%，并且会重置灵魂献祭的冷却时间。

options.description_en: Gain 3 stacks of Voidfall and reset the cooldown of Reap upon activating Void Metamorphosis.
options.description_zh: 激活虚空变形时，获得3层虚落并重置收割的冷却时间。

nodes.name_zh: 末日预言者 / 掌驭宇宙

options.description_en: Activating Void Ray out of combat or within 5 sec of entering combat calls down 3 Voidfall Meteors over its duration.
options.description_zh: 在脱离战斗或进入战斗后的5秒内激活虚空射线会在其持续时间内召唤3个虚落流星。

options.description_en: Voidfall Meteor damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 虚落流星的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Mastery: Monster Within's effectiveness by 20%.
options.description_zh: 在你脱离恶魔形态后，该形态仍以减弱状态持续，使你的精通：内在恶魔的效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Soul Immolation has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.
options.description_zh: 灵魂献祭有25%的几率在结束后重燃，重新施加其效果。

options.description_en: Consume generates 2 additional Fury and deals 15% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 吞噬额外产生2点恶魔之怒，造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: The Hunt and Vengeful Retreat increase the damage of your next Fel Rush or Felblade by 300%. Lasts 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 恶魔追击和复仇回避会使你的下一个邪能冲撞或邪能之刃的伤害提高300%。持续12秒。

nodes.name_zh: 混沌理论 / 内心之魔

options.description_en: Blade Dance causes your next Chaos Strike within 8 sec to have a 14-30% increased critical strike chance and will always refund Fury.
options.description_zh: 刃舞使你8秒内的下一个混乱打击的爆击几率提高14-30%，而且总会返还恶魔之怒。

options.description_en: Entering demon form causes your next Chaos Strike to unleash your inner demon, causing it to crash into your target and deal 74 Chaos damage to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh: 进入恶魔形态会使你的下一个混乱打击释放内心中的恶魔，让它冲向你的目标，对附近的所有敌人造成74点混乱伤害。目标数量超过5个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: When you activate Metamorphosis, the cooldowns of Blade Dance and Eye Beam are immediately reset.
options.description_zh: 激活恶魔变形会立即重置刃舞和眼棱的冷却时间。

nodes.name_zh: 无情强攻 / 碎魂创痕

options.description_en: Chaos Strike has a 10% chance to trigger a second Chaos Strike.
options.description_zh: 混乱打击有10%的几率触发第二次混乱打击。

options.description_en: Throw Glaive causes targets to take an additional 80% of damage dealt as Chaos over 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 投掷利刃会导致目标在6秒内受到额外的80%伤害，伤害类型为混沌伤害。

options.description_en:
Each time Immolation Aura deals damage, 35% of the damage dealt by up to 3 critical strikes is gathered as Ragefire.

When Immolation Aura expires you explode, dealing all stored Ragefire damage to nearby enemies.
options.description_zh:
献祭光环每次造成伤害时，最多3次爆击伤害的35%会被作为怒焰收集起来。

献祭光环结束时，你会爆炸，储存的所有怒焰会对附近敌人造成伤害。

options.description_en: Passive bonuses granted by each stack of Voidfall persist for 8 sec after being consumed.
options.description_zh: 每层虚落提供的被动加成在被消耗后仍会持续8秒。

options.description_en: Maximum Fury increased by 20.
options.description_zh: 恶魔之怒上限提高20点。

options.description_en: While at 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes all 3 to rapidly call down that many meteor strikes.
options.description_zh: 当拥有3层虚落时，收割会消耗所有3层效果，快速召唤同等次数的流星撞击。

options.description_en: Void Ray applies Student of Suffering to you, increasing Mastery by 10.6% and granting 5 Fury every 2 sec, for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 虚空射线会对你施加苦难修行，精通提高10.6%，并且每2秒产生5点恶魔之怒，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.
options.description_zh: 饥渴斩击的半径提高2码，并且额外提高50%爆击伤害。

options.description_en: Your first Collapsing Star after casting Void Metamorphosis causes a Cosmic meteor shower to assault the area, dealing 2,317 Cosmic damage over 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 在施放虚空变形后，你的第一次坍缩之星会召唤一阵宇宙流星雨袭击该区域，在6秒内造成2,297点宇宙伤害。

options.description_en: Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.
options.description_zh: 不处于恶魔形态时，智力提高15%。

options.description_en: Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.
options.description_zh: 进入恶魔形态会使你的下一次虚空涌动在短暂延迟后重复。

options.description_en:
Collapsing Star and Voidfall meteors deal 30% increased damage when striking a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 5%.
options.description_zh:
当坍缩之星和虚落流星仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高30%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低5%。

options.description_en: Gain critical strike damage equal to 40% of your critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 你的爆击伤害提高，数值等同于你的爆击几率的40%。

options.description_en: Gain critical strike damage equal to 80% of your critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 你的爆击伤害提高，数值等同于你的爆击几率的80%。

options.description_en: Activating Eye Beam reduces the cooldown of your next Eye Beam by 2.5 sec, stacking up to 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 激活眼棱使你的下一个眼棱冷却时间减少2.5秒，最多减少10秒。

options.description_en: Your Chaos damage has a 7.77% chance to be increased by 17%, occurring up to 3 total times.
options.description_zh: 你的混乱伤害有7.77%的几率提高17%，最多发生3次。

options.description_en: Your Chaos damage has a 7.77% chance to be increased by 17%, occurring up to 7 total times.
options.description_zh: 你的混乱伤害有7.77%的几率提高17%，最多发生7次。

options.description_en: The third Voidfall meteor strike called down in sequence is larger, has 50% increased area, deals 50% increased damage, and generates 1 Soul Fragment.
options.description_zh: 连续召唤的第三次虚落流星撞击规模更大，范围扩大50%，造成的伤害提高50%，并且产生1个灵魂残片。

options.description_en:
Activating Void Metamorphosis greatly empowers The Hunt.

Voidsurge damage is increased by 10% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.
options.description_zh:
激活虚空变形大幅强化恶魔追击。

恶魔形态激活时，之前每触发过一次虚空涌动，其造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Slash all enemies in front of you for 161 Chaos damage, causing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance to deal 91 Chaos damage to them for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 斩击你身前的所有敌人，造成163点混沌伤害，使混乱打击和刃舞对其造成91点混乱伤害，持续4秒。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en: The final slash of Blade Dance consumes 25 Fury when it strikes 3 or more enemies, launching two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing 64 Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh: 刃舞的最后一次斩击在击中3个或更多敌人时，消耗25点恶魔之怒，投出两把恶魔战刃，产生能量旋风，在3秒内对附近所有敌人造成64点混乱伤害。目标数量超过8个后，造成的伤害降低。

nodes.name_zh: 破碎的命运 / 聚凝痛楚

options.description_en: The duration of your active demon form is extended by 0.1 sec per 12 Fury spent.
options.description_zh: 每消耗12点恶魔之怒，你激活的恶魔形态的持续时间就会延长0.1秒。

options.description_en: Eye Beam summons an allied Vengeance Demon Hunter who casts Fel Devastation, dealing 91 Fire damage over 2 sec. Dealing damage heals you for up to 60 health.
options.description_zh: 眼棱会召唤一名复仇恶魔猎手盟友，该盟友会施放邪能毁灭，在2秒内造成91点火焰伤害。造成伤害会使你回复最多61点生命值。

options.description_en: Blade Dance automatically triggers Throw Glaive on your primary target for 100% damage and each slash has a 50% chance to Throw Glaive an enemy for 35% damage.
options.description_zh: 刃舞对你的主要目标自动触发投掷利刃，造成100%的伤害，每次斩击有50%的几率对一名敌人施放投掷利刃，造成35%的伤害。

options.description_en:
Immolation Aura has 1 additional charge, has 6 sec reduced cooldown, and deals Chaos damage instead of Fire.

You can have multiple Immolation Auras active at a time.
options.description_zh:
献祭光环可以额外使用1次，冷却时间缩短6秒，并将造成的火焰伤害改为混沌伤害。

你可以同时激活多个献祭光环。

options.description_en: The Hunt empowers your next Eye Beam, increasing damage by 100% and affecting enemies in a wider area.
options.description_zh: 恶魔追击强化你的下一个眼棱，使其伤害提高100%并影响更大区域的敌人。

options.description_zh: 恶魔尖刺激活时，对你发动近战攻击的目标会受到10点物理伤害。产生大量威胁值。

options.description_en: Activating Infernal Strike out of combat or within 5 sec of entering combat places a Sigil of Flame at the target location.
options.description_zh: 在脱离战斗或进入战斗后5秒内激活地狱火撞击，会在目标位置放置一个烈焰咒符。

options.description_en: After consuming both enhancements, gain Thrill of the Fight, increasing the damage of your next Reaver's Glaive by 30% and increasing Haste by 8% for 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 在消耗两种强化效果后，获得酣战热血，使你的下一个收割者战刃的伤害提高30%，且急速提高8%，持续30秒。

options.description_en:
Place a demonic sigil at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Detonates to deal 242 Chaos damage and shatter up to 3 Soul Fragments from enemies affected by the sigil. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
options.description_zh:
将一枚魔化咒符放置在目标位置，2秒后激活。

引爆咒符会造成246点混沌伤害并从受到影响的敌人身上炸出最多3个灵魂残片。目标多于5个时，造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Immolation Aura increases your movement speed by 10% and its duration is increased by 50%.
options.description_zh: 献祭光环使你的移动速度提高10%，并且其持续时间延长50%。

options.description_en:
Place a Sigil of Silence at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Silences all enemies affected by the sigil for 2 sec.
options.description_zh:
在目标位置放置一个沉默咒符，于2秒后激活。

所有受到咒符影响的敌人将被沉默2秒。

options.description_en: Fire damage increased by 8%.
options.description_zh: 火焰伤害提高8%。

options.description_en:
6.0% of your Fire damage shields you, up to a maximum of 3,055.

Shield and maximum values are doubled while Fiery Brand is active.
options.description_zh:
你的6.0%的火焰伤害为你产生最多3,055点护盾。

当烈火烙印激活时，护盾和最大吸收量翻倍。

options.description_en:
Consume has a 35% chance to grant 1 stack of Voidfall.

Upon reaching 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes a stack to reach into the Void and call down a meteor strike at your target's location, dealing 673 Cosmic damage to all enemies within 8 yards. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
吞噬有35%的几率获得1层虚落。

达到3层虚落时，收割会消耗1层虚落探入虚空，并在你的目标位置召唤一次流星撞击，对8码内的所有敌人造成673点宇宙伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Enemies struck by Sigil of Flame, Soul Cleave, and Spirit Bomb are afflicted with Frailty for 8 sec.

You heal for 10% of all damage you deal to targets with Frailty.
options.description_zh:
被烈焰咒符、灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹命中的敌人会受到脆弱效果的影响，持续8秒。

你对有脆弱效果的目标造成伤害时会恢复生命值，恢复量相当于造成的所有伤害的10%。

options.description_en: Soul Cleave heals for an additional 78.
options.description_zh: 灵魂裂劈的治疗效果提高78。

options.description_en: Immolation Aura's initial burst has a chance to shatter Soul Fragments from enemies.
options.description_zh: 献祭光环的初始爆炸有几率从敌人身上炸出灵魂残片。

options.description_en: Fel Devastation heals for an additional 10%, and 50% of its healing is converted into an absorb shield for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 邪能毁灭的治疗效果提高10%，并且治疗的50%会转化为吸收伤害的护盾，持续10秒。

options.description_en:
Immolation Aura has 10% increased critical strike chance and generates 1-5 Fury when it deals critical damage.

This effect may only occur once per 1 sec.
options.description_zh:
献祭光环的爆击几率提高10%，并在爆击时产生1-5点恶魔之怒。

此效果每1秒只能触发一次。

nodes.name_zh: 灵魂壁障 / 灵魂咒符

options.description_en: Spirit Bomb shields you for 10 sec, absorbing 2,444 damage plus 611 for each Soul Fragment consumed.
options.description_zh: 幽魂炸弹使你获得护盾，持续10秒，可吸收2,444点伤害，并且每消耗一个灵魂残片就可以额外吸收611点伤害。

options.description_en: Afflicting an enemy with a Sigil generates 1 Soul Fragment.
options.description_zh: 对一名敌人施加咒符效果会产生1个灵魂残片。

options.description_en: You take 10% reduced magic damage while Immolation Aura is active.
options.description_zh: 献祭光环激活时你受到的魔法伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% Haste.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使急速提高2%。

options.description_en:
Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.
options.description_zh:
虚空射线的伤害提高15%。

完整引导虚空射线会使你获得1层虚落。

options.description_en: Enemies struck by a Voidfall Meteor take an additional 25% damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 被虚落流星击中的敌人在8秒内额外受到25%的伤害。

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% reduced damage taken.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使受到的伤害降低2%。

options.description_en: Frailty now also reduces all damage you take from afflicted targets by 5%.
options.description_zh: 脆弱现在还会使受影响的目标对你造成的所有伤害降低5%。

options.description_en: Consuming a Soul Fragment reduces all damage you take by 3% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗一个灵魂残片会使你受到的所有伤害降低3%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Consuming a Soul Fragment reduces all damage you take by 6% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 消耗一个灵魂残片会使你受到的所有伤害降低6%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Fel Devastation heals you for up to 50% more, based on your missing health.
options.description_zh: 基于你损失的生命值，邪能毁灭的治疗效果最多提高50%。

options.description_en: Fiery Brand also increases Fire damage you deal to the target by 15%.
options.description_zh: 烈火烙印还会使你对目标造成的火焰伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Fiery Brand also increases Fire damage you deal to the target by 30%.
options.description_zh: 烈火烙印还会使你对目标造成的火焰伤害提高30%。

options.description_en: Increases the duration of your Sigils by 2 sec and radius by 2 yds.
options.description_zh: 咒符的持续时间延长2秒，半径扩大2码。

options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使移动速度提高3%。

options.description_en: Shift has 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 变换额外获得1次充能。

options.description_zh: 虚落流星的伤害提高15%。

options.description_zh: 吞噬额外产生2点恶魔之怒，造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_zh: 脆弱还会使你对受到影响的目标造成的所有伤害提高6%。

options.description_en: Metamorphosis has 5 sec increased duration and increases the damage of Fracture, Soul Cleave, and Spirit Bomb by 20%.
options.description_zh: 恶魔变形的持续时间延长5秒，并且提高破裂、灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹20%的伤害。

options.description_en: Immolation Aura damage increases the duration of your Fiery Brand and Sigil of Flame by 0.25 sec.
options.description_zh: 献祭光环造成伤害时会使烈火烙印和烈焰咒符的持续时间延长0.25秒。

options.description_en: Immolation Aura damage increases the duration of your Fiery Brand and Sigil of Flame by 0.50 sec.
options.description_zh: 献祭光环造成伤害时会使烈火烙印和烈焰咒符的持续时间延长0.50秒。

options.description_en: The third Voidfall meteor strike called down in sequence is larger, has 50% increased area, deals 50% increased damage, and generates 1 Soul Fragment.
options.description_zh: 连续召唤的第三次虚落流星撞击规模更大，范围扩大50%，造成的伤害提高50%，并且产生1个灵魂残片。

options.description_en: The effects of Frailty are doubled.
options.description_zh: 脆弱的效果翻倍。

options.description_en: Carve into the soul of your target, dealing 171 Fire damage and an additional 106 Fire damage over 3 sec.  Immediately shatters 3 Soul Fragments from the target and 1 additional Soul Fragment every 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 切割目标的灵魂，造成171点火焰伤害，并在3秒内额外造成106点火焰伤害。立即从目标身上切下3个灵魂残片，在此后每1秒额外产生1个灵魂残片。

options.description_en:
Sustaining fatal damage instead transforms you to Metamorphosis form.

This may occur once every 8 min.
options.description_zh:
受到致命伤害时你会变成恶魔形态。

此效果每8分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en: When Fel Devastation finishes fully channeling, it refreshes 15-30% of its cooldown and refunds 15-30 Fury.
options.description_zh: 邪能毁灭完全引导结束时，会刷新15-30%的冷却时间，并返还15-30点恶魔之怒。

options.description_en: Fiery Brand has 12 sec reduced cooldown and 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 烈火烙印冷却时间缩短12秒，而且可以额外使用1次。

options.description_en: Soul Cleave and Spirit Bomb have a chance per soul fragment consumed to grant Untethered Rage, allowing Metamorphosis to be cast without incurring its cooldown and lasting 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 灵魂裂劈和幽魂炸弹每消耗一个灵魂残片都有几率使你获得无羁邪怒，使你可以施放恶魔变形且不触发冷却时间，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Soul Cleave deals 10% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 灵魂裂劈造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_zh: 邪能之刃在你身边环绕，形成一道利刃结界，使你受到的伤害降低10%，持续5秒。

options.description_zh: 你每消耗一个灵魂残片，都会为你额外提供吸收护盾，相当于治疗量的15%。

options.description_en: Expose weaknesses in the target of your Reaver's Mark, causing your Physical damage to any enemy to also deal 30% of the damage dealt to your marked target as Chaos, and sometimes shatter a Soul Fragment.
options.description_zh: 揭露收割者印记目标的弱点，使你对任何敌人造成的物理伤害，同时对被标记目标造成该伤害30%的混乱伤害，有时会剥离一块灵魂残片。

options.description_en:
When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Soul Cleave casts 3 additional glaive slashes to nearby targets. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

If cast after Shear, cast 6 slashes instead.
options.description_zh:
受到收割者战刃效果强化时，灵魂裂劈对附近目标额外施放3次战刃斩击。目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

如果在裂魂之后施放，则改为施放6次斩击。

options.description_en:
When enhanced by Reaver's Glaive, Shear applies Reaver's Mark, which causes the target to take 7% increased damage for 20 sec. Max 2 stacks.

options.description_zh:
受到收割者战刃效果强化时，裂魂会施加收割者印记，使目标受到的伤害提高7%，持续20秒。最多可叠加2次。

Fury of the Aldrachi further empowers Blade Dance when cast after Chaos Strike, increasing slashes to 12.

options.description_zh:
奥达奇之怒在混乱打击之后施放时，会进一步强化刃舞，使劈砍次数增加到12次。

options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使受到的伤害降低2%。

options.description_en: Enemies struck by a Voidfall Meteor take an additional 25% damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 被虚落流星击中的敌人在8秒内额外受到25%的伤害。

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% Haste.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使急速提高2%。

options.description_en:
Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.
options.description_zh:
虚空射线的伤害提高15%。

完整引导虚空射线会使你获得1层虚落。

options.description_en: Empower spells cause your next Disintegrate to strike up to 3 targets. When striking fewer than 3 targets, Disintegrate damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.
options.description_zh: 蓄力法术使你的下一个裂解击中最多3个目标。击中的目标少于3个时，每少一个目标，裂解的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Conjure a path of shifting stone towards the target location, rooting enemies for 15 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
options.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤层层山岩，将敌人定身，持续15秒。任何伤害都有可能打断该效果。

options.description_en: Reinforce your scales, reducing damage taken by 30% . Lasts 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 强化你的鳞片，使受到的伤害降低30%。持续12秒。

options.description_en: Expunge toxins affecting an ally, removing all Poison effects.
options.description_zh: 净除一名盟友沾染的毒素，移除其所有中毒效果。

options.description_en: Disintegrate channels 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 裂解的引导速度加快20%。

options.description_en: Wing Buffet's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.
options.description_zh: 飞翼打击的冷却时间缩短2分钟。

options.description_en: Fly to an ally and heal them for 6,532, or heal yourself for the same amount.
options.description_zh: 飞向一个盟友，为其恢复6,532点生命值，或为你恢复等量的生命值。

options.description_en: Landslide's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, and it can withstand 200% more damage before breaking.
options.description_zh: 山崩的冷却时间缩短30秒，并且在被打破前能够额外承受200%的伤害。

options.description_en: Essence regenerates 5% faster.
options.description_zh: 精华的产生速度加快5%。

options.description_en: Essence regenerates 10% faster.
options.description_zh: 精华的产生速度加快10%。

options.description_en: Obsidian Scales has an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片可以多使用一次。

options.description_en: Living Flame deals 3% more damage and healing.
options.description_zh: 活化烈焰造成的伤害和治疗效果提高3%。

options.description_en: Living Flame deals 6% more damage and healing.
options.description_zh: 活化烈焰造成的伤害和治疗效果提高6%。

options.description_en: Store 20% of your effective healing, up to 857. Your next damaging Living Flame consumes all stored healing to increase its damage dealt.
options.description_zh: 储存你有效治疗量的20%，最多不超过857点。你的下一个伤害性活化烈焰会消耗所有已储存的治疗量，造成额外的伤害。

options.description_en: Your Living Flame and Emerald Blossom are 30% more effective on yourself.
options.description_zh: 你对自己施放活化烈焰和翡翠之花时，效果提高30%。

options.description_en: You may reactivate Deep Breath within 3 sec after landing to travel back in time to your takeoff location.
options.description_zh: 你可以在落地后的3秒内再次激活深呼吸，以返回起飞的地方。

options.description_en: Tail Swipe's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.
options.description_zh: 扫尾的冷却时间缩短2分钟。

options.description_en: Hover increases your movement speed by 70% for the first 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 悬空的前4秒内，你的移动速度提高70%。

options.description_en: Cauterize an ally's wounds, removing all Bleed, Poison, Curse, and Disease effects. Heals for 1,330 upon removing any effect.
options.description_zh: 给盟友的伤口加热，移除所有流血、中毒、诅咒和疾病效果。移除任何效果后恢复1,330点生命值。

options.description_en: Casting Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace reduces the cast time of your next Living Flame by 40%.
options.description_zh: 使用翡翠之花或青翠之拥治疗你自己会使你下一个活化烈焰的施法时间缩短40%。

options.description_en: Your Magic damage done is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的魔法伤害提高2%。

options.description_en: Your Magic damage done is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你造成的魔法伤害提高4%。

options.description_en: Compress time to make your next empowered spell cast instantly at its maximum empower level.
options.description_zh: 压缩时间，使你下一个蓄力法术变为瞬发，且为最高蓄力等级。

options.description_en: Your healing done and healing received are increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 造成和受到的治疗效果提高2%。

options.description_en: Your healing done and healing received are increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 造成和受到的治疗效果提高4%。

options.description_en: Disorient an enemy for 20 sec, causing them to sleep walk towards you. Damage has a chance to awaken them.
options.description_zh: 迷惑一名敌人，持续20秒，使其在梦游中向你走来。伤害有几率将其唤醒。

options.description_en: Azure Strike damages 1 additional enemy.
options.description_zh: 碧蓝打击额外对1个敌人造成伤害。

options.description_en: Magic damage taken reduced by 2%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低2%。

options.description_en: Magic damage taken reduced by 4%.
options.description_zh: 受到的魔法伤害降低4%。

options.description_en: Your Stamina is increased by 6%.
options.description_zh: 你的耐力提高6%。

options.description_en: Hover lasts 2 sec longer.
options.description_zh: 悬空的持续时间延长2秒。

options.description_en: Hover lasts 4 sec longer.
options.description_zh: 悬空的持续时间延长4秒。

options.description_en: Emerald Blossom heals 2 additional allies.
options.description_zh: 翡翠之花额外治疗2名盟友。

options.description_en: Your Leech is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你的吸血提高2%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续性伤害效果延长4秒。

options.description_en: While above 75% health, your movement speed is increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 当生命值在75%以上时，你的移动速度提高10%。

options.description_en: Obsidian Scales surrounds you with a Renewing Blaze, causing 100% of the damage it prevented to be healed back over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片用新生光焰环绕着你，将所阻挡伤害的100%转化为治疗效果，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Wing Buffet and Tail Swipe knock enemies further and daze them, reducing movement speed by 70% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 飞翼打击和扫尾的击退距离提高，并使敌人眩晕，使其移动速度降低70%，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Emerald Blossom and Verdant Embrace instantly heal you for 950 when cast.
options.description_zh: 翡翠之花和青翠之拥在施放时使你立即恢复950点生命值。

options.description_en: While flying during Deep Breath, 100% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 在深呼吸期间飞行时，你受到伤害的100%会改为在10秒内生效。

options.description_en: Direct damage from Fire Breath consumes absorb shields from enemies, dealing 4,600 additional Spellfrost damage to them.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成的直接伤害会消耗敌人的吸收护盾，对其额外造成4,598点法术冰霜伤害。

options.description_en: Let out a bone-shaking roar at enemies in a cone in front of you, increasing the duration of crowd controls that affect them by 50% in the next 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 对你前方锥形区域内的敌人发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，在接下来的10秒内使影响他们的群体控制持续时间提高50%。

options.description_en: Renewing Blaze restores you more quickly, causing damage you take to be healed back over 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 新生光焰会更高效的治疗你，在4秒内恢复等同于你所受到伤害的生命值。

options.description_en: Swoop to an ally and fly with them to the target location. Clears movement impairing effects from you and your ally.
options.description_zh: 飞向一名盟友，与其一同飞到目标地点。清除你和盟友受到的移动限制效果。

options.description_en: Green spells restore 5% more health.
options.description_zh: 绿龙法术治疗效果提高5%。

options.description_en: Green spells restore 10% more health.
options.description_zh: 绿龙法术治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: Redirect your excess magic to a friendly healer for 1 hour. When you cast an empowered spell, you restore 0.25% of their maximum mana per empower level. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 将你溢出的魔力转移给一名友方治疗者，持续1小时。当你施放蓄力法术时，每层蓄力都会为其恢复最大法力的0.25%。只能影响一个目标。

options.description_en: Glide speed and height increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 滑翔速度和高度提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath causes your next Living Flame to strike 1 additional target per empower level.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息会使你的下一个活化烈焰命中额外的目标，每级蓄力增加一个。

options.description_en: Oppressing Roar removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy, and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 压迫怒吼从每个敌人身上移除1个激怒效果，冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Hover gains 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 悬空额外获得1次使用次数。

options.description_en: Rescue increases movement speed by 100% and allows spells to be cast while moving for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 营救使移动速度提高100%，并且可以在移动中施放，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Source of Magic increases the target's healing and damage done by 3%.
options.description_zh: 魔力之源使目标造成的治疗效果和伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: Deep Breath stuns enemies for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸使敌人昏迷3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 时间螺旋 / 空间悖论

options.description_en: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.
options.description_zh: 扭曲时间，使你和40码内的盟友能够在接下来的10秒内施放一次主要移动技能，无视其冷却状态。

options.description_en:
Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec.

Affects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.
options.description_zh:
为你和最近的友方治疗者唤起悖论，使你们能够在移动时施法，并使大部分法术的射程提高100%，持续10秒。

如果你的目标不是治疗者，则会影响60码内最近的治疗者。

options.description_en: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤上升气流，将你和20码内最近的4位盟友托举到空中，使你们受到的范围攻击伤害降低20%，移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Fire Breath gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en: Black spells deal 20% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 黑龙法术造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en:
Mass Disintegrate marks your primary target for destruction for the next 6 sec.

You and your allies have a chance to trigger a Bombardment when attacking marked targets, dealing 1,805 Volcanic damage split amongst all nearby enemies.
options.description_zh:
群体裂解将你的主要目标标记为毁灭的对象，持续6秒。

你和盟友攻击被标记的目标时有几率触发一次连环轰炸，造成1,805点熔火伤害，由附近的所有敌人均摊。

options.description_en: Entering combat grants a charge of Burnout, causing your next Living Flame to cast instantly.
options.description_zh: 进入战斗可以获得一层燃尽，使你的下一次活化烈焰可以瞬发。

options.description_en: While flying during Deep Breath you are assisted by a squadron of Dracthyr who assault enemies with Pyre, dealing 967 Fire damage to nearby enemies up to 8 times.
options.description_zh: 在深呼吸飞行期间，你会动员由龙希尔组成的特遣队，使用葬火对目标发起猛攻。对附近的敌人造成951点火焰伤害，最多触发8次。

options.description_en: Hover and Deep Breath travel 40% faster, and Hover travels 40% further.
options.description_zh: 悬空和深呼吸的飞行速度加快40%，悬空的飞行距离延长40%。

options.description_en: Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet scorch enemies and blind them with ash, causing their next attack within 4 sec to miss.
options.description_zh: 扫尾和飞翼打击会灼烧敌人，并以灰烬令其致盲，使他们在4秒内的下一次攻击无法命中。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Essence abilities are enhanced with Flame, dealing 20% of healing or damage done as Fire over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 精华技能被烈焰增强，在8秒内造成治疗或火焰伤害，数值相当于造成治疗或伤害的20%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time is increased by 30%. Dream Breath's heal over time is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续性伤害提高30%。梦境吐息的持续性治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath has a 50% chance to generate Essence Burst.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息有50%的几率产生精华迸发。

options.description_en: Lob a ball of flame, dealing 1,673 Fire damage to your target and all enemies within 8 yds.
options.description_zh: 投掷一发火球，对目标及8码范围内的敌人造成1,639点火焰伤害。

options.description_en:
Deep Breath causes enemies to take 20% increased damage from Bombardments and Essence abilities for 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.
options.description_zh:
深呼吸使敌人受到的连环轰炸和精华技能的伤害提高20%，持续12秒。

多次施放深呼吸会延长此效果的持续时间。

options.description_en: Mass Disintegrate reduces the remaining cooldown of Deep Breath by 1.0 sec for each target struck.
options.description_zh: 群体裂解每击中一个目标，就会使深呼吸的剩余冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

options.description_en: For each second you are in combat, Azure Strike, Living Flame, and Disintegrate deal 1% increased damage, up to 15%.
options.description_zh: 当你进入战斗以后，碧蓝打击、活化烈焰以及裂解造成的伤害每秒提高1%，至多15%。

options.description_en: Mass Disintegrate strikes 1 additional target.
options.description_zh: 群体裂解额外攻击1个目标。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance against targets above 50% health increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 对生命值高于50%的目标的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath reaches its maximum empower level 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息到达最大蓄力层数的速度提高20%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath deals its damage 15% more often.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成伤害的频率提高15%。

options.description_en: Consuming Essence Burst fires a twin flame, striking your target for 547 Fire damage.
options.description_zh: 消耗精华迸发会发射一道孪生烈焰，对目标造成547点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Your Living Flame has a 20% chance to cause an Essence Burst, making your next Disintegrate or Pyre cost no Essence.
options.description_zh: 你的活化烈焰有20%的几率触发一次精华迸发，使你的下一个裂解或葬火不消耗精华。

options.description_en: Azure Strike has a 15% chance to cause an Essence Burst, making your next Disintegrate or Pyre cost no Essence.
options.description_zh: 碧蓝打击有15%的几率触发一次精华迸发，使你的下一个裂解或葬火不消耗精华。

nodes.name_zh: 硬化鳞片 / 威慑英气

options.description_en: Obsidian Scales reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Knocking enemies up or backwards reduces their damage done to you by 15% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 将敌人击飞或击退使其对你造成的伤害降低15%，持续8秒。

nodes.name_zh: 持久鏖战 / 力量分流

options.description_en: Essence abilities extend Bombardments by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 精华技能会使连环轰炸的时间延长1秒。

options.description_en: Bombardments have a chance to generate Essence Burst.
options.description_zh: 连环轰炸有几率生成精华迸发。

options.description_en: While Hovering, damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 悬空时，受到的范围攻击伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Deep Breath resets a charge of Hover.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸重置一层悬空的充能。

options.description_en: Essence abilities deal 15% additional damage.
options.description_zh: 精华技能会额外造成15%的伤害。

options.description_en: Living Flame and Azure Strike have 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when they critically strike.
options.description_zh: 活化烈焰和碧蓝打击爆击时有额外1次触发精华迸发的机会。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续伤害时间延长4秒。

nodes.name_zh: 生命烬火 / 腾龙本能

options.description_en: Obsidian Scales also applies to your target or 1 nearby injured ally at 50% value.
options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片还会施加给目标或附近1个受伤的盟友，产生50%的效果。

options.description_en: Your wounds have a small chance to cauterize, healing you for 30% of damage taken. Occurs more often from attacks that deal high damage.
options.description_zh: 你的伤口有较小的几率灼烧愈合，为你恢复生命值，数值相当于受到伤害的30%。造成较高伤害的攻击触发频率较高。

options.description_en: Twin Flame bounces to up to 2 additional targets.
options.description_zh: 孪生烈焰会弹射到最多2个额外目标。

options.description_en: Deep Breath's damage is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Interrupt an enemy's spellcasting and prevent any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 打断一名敌人施放的法术，使其无法施放任何同系法术，持续6秒。

options.description_en:
Focus your energies to release a salvo of pure magic, dealing 4,146 Spellfrost damage to an enemy. Damages additional enemies within 25 yds when empowered.

I:   Damages 1 enemy.

II:  Damages 2 enemies.

III: Damages 3 enemies.
options.description_zh:
集中能量释放一波纯净魔法齐射，对一名敌人造成4,076点法术冰霜伤害。蓄力施放会对25码范围内的额外敌人造成伤害。

I：   对1名敌人造成伤害。 

II：  对2名敌人造成伤害。 

III： 对3名敌人造成伤害。

options.description_en:
Deep Breath can now be steered in your desired direction.

In addition, Deep Breath burns targets for 3,576 Volcanic damage over 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.
options.description_zh:
深呼吸现在可以控制方向。

另外，深呼吸会点燃目标，在12秒内造成3,576点熔火伤害。

多次施放深呼吸会延长此效果的持续时间。

options.description_en:
Disintegrate consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.

Pyre consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.
options.description_zh:
裂解造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上1.0秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量150%的伤害。

葬火造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上4秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量115%的伤害。

options.description_en: Pyre has a 15% chance to flare up and explode again on a nearby target.
options.description_zh: 葬火有15%的几率在一个相邻的目标身上再次爆燃。

options.description_en: Pyre has a 30% chance to flare up and explode again on a nearby target.
options.description_zh: 葬火有30%的几率在一个相邻的目标身上再次爆燃。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Essence to 6.
options.description_zh: 你的精华上限提高至6。

options.description_en:
Erupt with draconic fury and exhale Pyres at 3 enemies within 25 yds.

For 18 sec, Essence Burst's chance to occur is increased to 100%.
options.description_zh:
爆发龙族怒火，对25码内的3个敌人施加葬火。

18秒内，精华迸发的发生几率提高至100%。

options.description_en:
Eternity Surge upgrades your next Azure Strike to Azure Sweep, damaging all nearby enemies and dealing 75% additional damage.

 Azure Sweep
Concentrate azure energy into your tail and sweep to release pure magic upon an enemy and nearby targets for 623 Spellfrost damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:

深呼吸和狂龙之怒期间，你无视目标生命值，始终获得精通：巨人杀手的最大效果。

释缚烈焰始终获得最大效果。

options.description_zh: 你的蓝龙伤害使你的下一次葬火的伤害提高2%，可叠加20次。

Eternity Surge additionally releases a Shattering Star at your target that deals 50% more damage per empower level reached.

 Shattering Star
Exhale a bolt of concentrated power from your mouth at the target for 661 Spellfrost damage.
options.description_zh:
永恒之涌额外向你的目标释放一道碎裂星辰，每达到一个蓄力等级，其造成的伤害就提高50%。

 碎裂星辰
从口中向目标呼出一股浓缩能量，造成668点法术冰霜伤害。

After casting 6 Pyres, your next Pyre will explode into a Firestorm.

 Firestorm

options.description_zh:
在施放6次葬火后，你的下一个葬火将爆炸成为火焰风暴。

火焰风暴
向目标区域投掷炽燃灰烬，在10秒内对敌人造成5,477点火焰伤害。

提高碎裂星辰35%的伤害。

碎裂星辰会向你的所有永恒之涌目标散发效果。

深呼吸造成的伤害提高20%，并且可以在使用后的18秒内再次施放。

options.description_zh: 你所施放的红龙法术对受到火焰吐息持续伤害影响的敌人造成的伤害提高25%。

裂解每次造成伤害时，会使你的蓄力法术的剩余冷却时间缩短0.50秒。

深呼吸使敌人受到的连环轰炸和精华技能的伤害提高20%，持续12秒。

裂解造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上1.0秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量150%的伤害。

options.description_zh: 使用翡翠之花或青翠之拥治疗你自己会使你下一个活化烈焰的施法时间缩短40%。
