options.description_en: While above 75% health, your movement speed is increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 当生命值在75%以上时，你的移动速度提高10%。

options.description_en: Obsidian Scales surrounds you with a Renewing Blaze, causing 100% of the damage it prevented to be healed back over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片用新生光焰环绕着你，将所阻挡伤害的100%转化为治疗效果，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Wing Buffet and Tail Swipe knock enemies further and daze them, reducing movement speed by 70% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 飞翼打击和扫尾的击退距离提高，并使敌人眩晕，使其移动速度降低70%，持续4秒。

options.description_en: Emerald Blossom and Verdant Embrace instantly heal you for 950 when cast.
options.description_zh: 翡翠之花和青翠之拥在施放时使你立即恢复950点生命值。

options.description_en: While flying during Deep Breath, 100% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 在深呼吸期间飞行时，你受到伤害的100%会改为在10秒内生效。

options.description_en: Direct damage from Fire Breath consumes absorb shields from enemies, dealing 4,606 additional Spellfrost damage to them.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成的直接伤害会消耗敌人的吸收护盾，对其额外造成4,559点法术冰霜伤害。

options.description_en: Let out a bone-shaking roar at enemies in a cone in front of you, increasing the duration of crowd controls that affect them by 50% in the next 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 对你前方锥形区域内的敌人发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，在接下来的10秒内使影响他们的群体控制持续时间提高50%。

options.description_en: Renewing Blaze restores you more quickly, causing damage you take to be healed back over 4 sec.
options.description_zh: 新生光焰会更高效的治疗你，在4秒内恢复等同于你所受到伤害的生命值。

options.description_en: Swoop to an ally and fly with them to the target location. Clears movement impairing effects from you and your ally.
options.description_zh: 飞向一名盟友，与其一同飞到目标地点。清除你和盟友受到的移动限制效果。

options.description_en: Green spells restore 5% more health.
options.description_zh: 绿龙法术治疗效果提高5%。

options.description_en: Green spells restore 10% more health.
options.description_zh: 绿龙法术治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: Redirect your excess magic to a friendly healer for 1 hour. When you cast an empowered spell, you restore 0.25% of their maximum mana per empower level. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 将你溢出的魔力转移给一名友方治疗者，持续1小时。当你施放蓄力法术时，每层蓄力都会为其恢复最大法力的0.25%。只能影响一个目标。

options.description_en: Glide speed and height increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 滑翔速度和高度提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath causes your next Living Flame to strike 1 additional target per empower level.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息会使你的下一个活化烈焰命中额外的目标，每级蓄力增加一个。

options.description_en: Oppressing Roar removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy, and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 压迫怒吼从每个敌人身上移除1个激怒效果，冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Hover gains 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 悬空额外获得1次使用次数。

options.description_en: Rescue increases movement speed by 100% and allows spells to be cast while moving for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 营救使移动速度提高100%，并且可以在移动中施放，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Source of Magic increases the target's healing and damage done by 3%.
options.description_zh: 魔力之源使目标造成的治疗效果和伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: Deep Breath stuns enemies for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸使敌人昏迷3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 时间螺旋 / 空间悖论

options.description_en: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.
options.description_zh: 扭曲时间，使你和40码内的盟友能够在接下来的10秒内施放一次主要移动技能，无视其冷却状态。

options.description_en:
Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec.

Affects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.
options.description_zh:
为你和最近的友方治疗者唤起悖论，使你们能够在移动时施法，并使大部分法术的射程提高100%，持续10秒。

如果你的目标不是治疗者，则会影响60码内最近的治疗者。

options.description_en: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤上升气流，将你和20码内最近的4位盟友托举到空中，使你们受到的范围攻击伤害降低20%，移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Fire Breath gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en: Hover and Deep Breath travel 40% faster, and Hover travels 40% further.
options.description_zh: 悬空和深呼吸的飞行速度加快40%，悬空的飞行距离延长40%。

options.description_en: Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet scorch enemies and blind them with ash, causing their next attack within 4 sec to miss.
options.description_zh: 扫尾和飞翼打击会灼烧敌人，并以灰烬令其致盲，使他们在4秒内的下一次攻击无法命中。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_en: Essence abilities are enhanced with Flame, dealing 20% of healing or damage done as Fire over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 精华技能被烈焰增强，在8秒内造成治疗或火焰伤害，数值相当于造成治疗或伤害的20%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time is increased by 30%. Dream Breath's heal over time is increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续性伤害提高30%。梦境吐息的持续性治疗效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath has a 50% chance to generate Essence Burst.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息有50%的几率产生精华迸发。

options.description_en: Wrap an ally with temporal energy, healing them for 912 and causing your next healing spell to cast an additional time on that ally at 70% of normal healing. Essence spells cannot be Echoed.
options.description_zh: 用时光能量封裹一名盟友，为其恢复912点生命值，并使你下一个治疗法术对该盟友额外施放一次，治疗量为正常的70%。精华法术无法回响。

options.description_en: Critical strike chance against targets above 50% health increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 对生命值高于50%的目标的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath reaches its maximum empower level 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息到达最大蓄力层数的速度提高20%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath deals its damage 15% more often.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成伤害的频率提高15%。

options.description_en: Consuming Essence Burst fires a twin flame, striking your target for 547 Fire damage.
options.description_zh: 消耗精华迸发会发射一道孪生烈焰，对目标造成547点火焰伤害。

options.description_en:
Inhale, gathering the power of the Dream. Release to exhale, healing yourself and 5 injured allies in a 40 yd cone in front of you for 1,977.

I:   Heals 350 instantly and 1,627 over 16 sec.

II:  Heals 757 instantly and 1,220 over 12 sec.

III: Heals 1,163 instantly and 814 over 8 sec.
options.description_zh:
吸一口气，积聚梦境的力量，然后喷吐而出，为你和你前方40码锥形范围内的5名受伤盟友恢复1,977点生命值。

I：立即恢复350点生命值，并在16秒内恢复1,627点生命值。

II：立即恢复757点生命值，并在12秒内恢复1,220点生命值。

III：立即恢复1,163点生命值，并在8秒内恢复814点生命值。

options.description_en:
Reverse an ally's injuries, healing them for 1,092 over 12 sec.

When Reversion critically heals, its duration is extended by 2 sec, up to a maximum of 12 sec.
options.description_zh:
逆转一名盟友的伤势，在12秒内为其恢复1,092点生命值。

当逆转的治疗爆击时，其持续时间延长2秒，最多延长12秒。

options.description_en: Living Flame and Azure Strike have 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when they critically strike.
options.description_zh: 活化烈焰和碧蓝打击爆击时有额外1次触发精华迸发的机会。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续伤害时间延长4秒。

nodes.name_zh: 生命烬火 / 腾龙本能

options.description_en: Obsidian Scales also applies to your target or 1 nearby injured ally at 50% value.
options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片还会施加给目标或附近1个受伤的盟友，产生50%的效果。

options.description_en: Your wounds have a small chance to cauterize, healing you for 30% of damage taken. Occurs more often from attacks that deal high damage.
options.description_zh: 你的伤口有较小的几率灼烧愈合，为你恢复生命值，数值相当于受到伤害的30%。造成较高伤害的攻击触发频率较高。

options.description_en: Twin Flame bounces to up to 2 additional targets.
options.description_zh: 孪生烈焰会弹射到最多2个额外目标。

options.description_en: Each cast of a Bronze spell causes your next empower spell to reach maximum level in 10% less time, stacking up to 4 times.
options.description_zh: 每施放一个青铜龙法术，都会使你的下一个蓄力法术达到最高级的时间缩短10%。最多叠加4次。

options.description_en: Living Flame has a 20% chance, and Reversion has a 15% chance to make your next Essence ability free.
options.description_zh: 活化烈焰有20%的几率，逆转有15%的几率使你下一个消耗精华的技能不产生消耗。

options.description_en:
Rewind 30% of damage taken in the last 5 seconds by all allies within 40 yds. Always heals for at least 760.

Healing increased by 200% when not in a raid.
options.description_zh:
回溯40码内所有盟友此前5秒中受到的所有伤害的30%，至少治疗760点生命值。

不在团队中时，治疗量提高200%。

options.description_en:
Disintegrate consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.

Pyre consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.
options.description_zh:
裂解造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上1.0秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量150%的伤害。

葬火造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上4秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量115%的伤害。

options.description_en: Verdant Embrace temporarily bonds your life with an ally, causing your healing on either partner to heal the other for 60% of the amount. Lasts 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 青翠之拥会暂时将你的生命与一名盟友联结在一起，使你对你们其中一人产生治疗效果时，该效果可以让另一名伙伴获得60%的治疗。持续8秒。

options.description_en: Essence Burst stacks 2 times.
options.description_zh: 精华迸发叠加2次。

options.description_en: Stretch time around an ally for the next 8 sec, causing 50% of damage they would take to instead be dealt over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 在接下来的8秒内延展一个盟友周围的时空，延缓其即将受到的伤害的50%，改为在8秒内承受。

options.description_en: Living Flame is enhanced with Bronze magic, repeating 25% of the damage or healing you dealt to the target in the last 5 sec as Arcane, up to 950.
options.description_zh: 用青铜龙魔法强化活化烈焰，重复你在过去5秒内对目标造成伤害或治疗量的25%，伤害为奥术伤害，最多950点。

options.description_en: Your empower spells are 10% more effective. While charging a healing empower spell, you cannot be knocked back.
options.description_zh: 你的蓄力法术效果提高10%。引导治疗蓄力法术时，你无法被击退。

options.description_en:
Emerald Blossom sends out 1 flying seedling when it bursts, plus up to 2 additional seedlings if Emerald Blossom heals fewer than 3 allies.

Seedlings each heal an ally up to 40 yds away for 988.
options.description_zh:
翡翠之花会在绽开时散播出1颗婆娑幼苗，若治疗的盟友少于3名，则额外散播2颗幼苗。

每颗幼苗为最远40码内的一名盟友恢复988点生命值。

options.description_en:
Emerald Blossom sends out 2 flying seedlings when it bursts, plus up to 4 additional seedlings if Emerald Blossom heals fewer than 3 allies.

Seedlings each heal an ally up to 40 yds away for 988.
options.description_zh:
翡翠之花会在绽开时散播出2颗婆娑幼苗，若治疗的盟友少于3名，则额外散播4颗幼苗。

每颗幼苗为最远40码内的一名盟友恢复988点生命值。

options.description_en: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 你的蓄力法术等级上限提高1级，且蓄力至最高等级的速度加快20%。

options.description_en: Reversion instantly heals the target for 15% of damage taken in the last 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 逆转会立即恢复目标在最近5秒内所受伤害的15%。

nodes.name_zh: 延缓伤害 / 恰逢其时

options.description_en: 15% of delayed damage from Time Dilation is absorbed.
options.description_zh: 吸收15%时间膨胀延缓的伤害。

options.description_en: Time Dilation gains an additional charge, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 时间膨胀可以额外使用一次，冷却时间缩短10秒。

options.description_en:
Send forward a vortex of temporal energy, absorbing 2,280 damage on you and any allies in its path. Absorption is reduced beyond 5 targets.

Applies Echo at 30% effectiveness on the first 5 allies it passes through.
options.description_zh:
向前发射一道时光能量漩涡，为你和路径中的任意盟友吸收2,280点伤害。目标数量超过5个后吸收量降低。

对经过的前5名盟友施加回响，效果为30%。

options.description_en:
Hover now causes you to briefly warp out of existence and appear at your destination. Hover's cooldown is also reduced by 5 sec.

Hover continues to allow Evoker spells to be cast while moving.
options.description_zh:
悬空现在使你短暂地迁跃到现实之外，并在目标位置出现。悬空的冷却时间缩短5秒。

悬空依然使唤魔师法术可以在移动中施放。

options.description_en: Tip the Scales overloads you with temporal energy, increasing your haste, movement speed, and cooldown recovery rate by 30%, decreasing over 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 扭转天平会为你注入超量的时空能量，使你的急速、移动速度和冷却恢复速度提高30%，然后在30秒内逐渐降低。

options.description_en: Tip the Scales' cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 扭转天平的冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Upheaval deals 50% additional damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 地壳激变在8秒内额外造成50%的伤害。

nodes.name_zh: 移情共生 / 精神澄澈

options.description_en: Empower spells increase your Essence regeneration rate by 100% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 蓄力法术会使你的精华恢复速度提高100%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: Dream Breath's cooldown is reduced by 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 梦境吐息的冷却时间缩短6秒。

options.description_en: Each time you gain Essence Burst, your critical heals are 230% effective instead of the usual 200% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当获得精华迸发，你的爆击治疗效果就会变为230%，而非通常的200%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Each time you gain Essence Burst, your critical heals are 260% effective instead of the usual 200% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当获得精华迸发，你的爆击治疗效果就会变为260%，而非通常的200%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Every other Emerald Blossom has a 100% chance for one of your Fluttering Seedlings to grow into a new Emerald Blossom.
options.description_zh: 每间隔一朵翡翠之花有100%的几率使你的一株婆娑幼苗长成新的翡翠之花。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Essence to 6.
options.description_zh: 你的精华上限提高至6。

options.description_en: Echo replicates 25% more healing.
options.description_zh: 回响复制治疗量提高25%。

options.description_en: Echo replicates 50% more healing.
options.description_zh: 回响复制治疗量提高50%。

options.description_en: Empower spells cause time to flow 5% faster for you, increasing movement speed, cooldown recharge rate, and cast speed. Lasts 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 蓄力法术使你的时间流动速度加快5%，提高移动速度、冷却充能速率，以及施法速度。持续10秒。

options.description_en: Empower spells cause time to flow 10% faster for you, increasing movement speed, cooldown recharge rate, and cast speed. Lasts 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 蓄力法术使你的时间流动速度加快10%，提高移动速度、冷却充能速率，以及施法速度。持续10秒。

nodes.name_zh: 时光屏障 / 诺兹多姆的讲义

options.description_en: Send out a ripple of temporal energy, absorbing 4,446 damage and applying Echo at 30% effectiveness on your target and up to 4 allies within 40 yds.
options.description_zh: 发出一道时光能量涟漪，吸收4,446点伤害，以30%的效果为你目标及其40码内最多4名盟友施加回响。

options.description_en: Temporal Anomaly reduces the cooldowns of your empower spells by 5 sec.
options.description_zh: 时空畸体使你的蓄力技能的冷却时间缩短5秒。

nodes.name_zh: 瞬息之隔 / 加速微粒

options.description_en: Warp reduces damage taken by 20%, starting high and reducing over 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 迁跃使受到的伤害降低20%，效果初始较高，并在3秒内衰减。

options.description_en: Warp leaves a trail of Motes of Acceleration. Allies who come in contact with a mote gain 20% increased movement speed for 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 迁跃会留下加速微粒痕迹，接触到微粒的盟友的移动速度提高20%，持续30秒。

options.description_en: Prescience cooldown reduced by 2 sec and it grants 1% additional critical strike chance.
options.description_zh: 先知先觉的冷却时间缩短2秒，且额外提供1%的暴击几率。

options.description_en: Living Flame's cast time is reduced by 0.2 sec, and it deals 50% increased damage or healing when it is a non-instant cast.
options.description_zh: 活化烈焰的施法时间缩短0.2秒，并且当其非瞬发时，造成的伤害或治疗效果提高50%。

options.description_en: For each damage over time effect from Upheaval, gain 3% haste, up to 9%.
options.description_zh: 每有一个地壳激变的持续伤害效果，急速提高3%，最多9%。

options.description_en: Dream Breath healing increased by 20%, and Living Flame healing increased by 30%.
options.description_zh: 梦境吐息的治疗效果提高20%，活化烈焰的治疗效果提高30%。

options.description_en:
Take in a deep breath and fly to the targeted location, healing all allies in your path for 1,900 immediately, and 4,353 over 15 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Removes all root effects. You are immune to movement impairing and loss of control effects.

Damage taken while you are flying is absorbed, up to 100% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh:
深深地吸一口气，飞向目标地点，立即为路径上的盟友恢复1,900点生命值，并在15秒内恢复4,248点生命值，目标超过5个时效果降低。

移除所有定身效果。你在飞行时免疫所有的移动限制和失控效果。

吸收你在飞行时受到的伤害，最多相当于你100%的最大生命值。

options.description_en: Causes your next 3 helpful spells to be duplicated and stored in a time lock. You may reactivate Stasis any time within 30 sec to quickly unleash their magic.
options.description_zh: 复制你接下来的3个有益法术，将其存入一道时空谜锁。你可以在30秒内随时重新激活静滞，快速释放出其中的魔法。

options.description_en: Your healing is increased by 10% on targets with your Reversion.
options.description_zh: 你对带有你所施放逆转的目标造成的治疗效果提高10%。

nodes.name_zh: 再逢其时 / 时光汇流

options.description_en: Ebon Might and Prescience gain a chance equal to your critical strike chance to grant 50% additional stats. For Ebon Might, this increase lasts 15.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 黑檀之力和先知先觉可提供额外50%的属性，几率等同于你的爆击几率。对于黑檀之力，此增幅持续15.0秒。

options.description_en:
Non-defensive abilities with a 45 second or longer cooldown grant 5% Intellect for 15 sec.

Essence spells extend the duration by 1 sec.
options.description_zh:
使用冷却时间为45秒及以上的非防御技能可使智力提高5%，持续15秒。

使用精华法术使持续时间延长1秒。

options.description_en: Each time you cast an empower spell, unstable time magic reduces its cooldown by up to 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 每当你施放一个蓄力法术，不稳定的时光魔法会使其冷却时间缩短最多6秒。

options.description_en: Chrono Flames' maximum damage or healing is increased by 40%, up to 1,330 Arcane.
options.description_zh: 时序烈焰的最大伤害或治疗效果提高40%，最高可达1,330点奥术效果。

options.description_zh: 先知先觉的持续时间延长15%。

options.description_zh: 消耗一个完整的时光压缩将使你获得精华迸发。

options.description_zh: 施放回响会获得一层衔尾轮回，使你的下一个翡翠之花的治疗效果提高30%，最多可叠加5次。

options.description_zh: 火焰吐息和深呼吸会治疗附近5名受伤的盟友，效果相当于对最多5个目标所造成伤害的80%，由治疗的所有盟友均摊。

options.description_en: Casting Dream Flight or Stasis increases your healing over time by 50% and causes Living Flame and Reversion to have a 100% increased chance to grant Essence Burst. Lasts 15 sec.
options.description_zh: 在施放梦境飞行或静滞后，你的持续治疗效果提高50%，并且活化烈焰和逆转触发精华迸发的几率提高100%。持续15秒。

options.description_zh: 回溯的冷却时间缩短60秒。

options.description_zh: 裂解额外造成35%的伤害，并在持续时间内产生1,080点法力值。

options.description_en:
When you or an ally fall below 30% health, a version of yourself enters your timeline and heals them for 19,596. Your alternate self continues healing for 8 sec before returning to their timeline.

May only occur once every 60 sec.
options.description_zh:
当你或一名盟友的生命值降至30%以下时，另一个时间线中的你会为其恢复19,596点生命值。你的另一个自己会在返回其时间线前继续治疗，持续8秒。

此效果每60秒只能触发一次。

options.description_zh: 蓄力法术会向目标射出最多3股时序烈焰。

options.description_en: Dream Breath healing is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 梦境吐息的治疗效果提高15%。

options.description_zh: 梦境吐息的治疗效果提高30%。

options.description_en: Reversion, Time Dilation, Echo, and Temporal Anomaly last 15% longer and cost 15% less mana.
options.description_zh: 逆转、时间膨胀、回响以及时空畸体的持续时间延长15%，消耗的法力值降低15%。

options.description_en: Reversion, Time Dilation, Echo, and Temporal Anomaly last 30% longer and cost 30% less mana.
options.description_zh: 逆转、时间膨胀、回响以及时空畸体的持续时间延长30%，消耗的法力值降低30%。

nodes.name_zh: 梦境幻影 / 自由之翼

options.description_en: Verdant Embrace healing is increased by 40%. In addition, it no longer causes you to leap to your target, instead sending forth a Dream Simulacrum.
options.description_zh: 青翠之拥的治疗效果提高40%。此外，该技能不再使你跃向目标，而是向前释放一个梦境幻影。

options.description_en: Verdant Embrace gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 青翠之拥获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en: Essence Burst increases the effectiveness of your next Essence ability by 35%.
options.description_zh: 精华迸发使你下一个精华技能的效果提高35%。

options.description_en: Reversion healing has a chance to cause your next Living Flame to cast instantly and deal 100% increased healing or damage. Stacks up to 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 逆转的治疗效果有一定几率使你的下一个活化烈焰变为瞬发，并且治疗效果或伤害提高100%。该效果最多可叠加2层。

options.description_en: Casting Emerald Blossom causes your next Echo to cast on an additional ally within 25 yards at 100% effectiveness. Stacks up to 2 charges.
options.description_zh: 施放翡翠之花后，你的下一次回响会额外以100%的效果对25码范围内的一名盟友生效。最多可叠加2层。

options.description_en: Bronze healing and absorption increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 青铜龙治疗和吸收效果提高15%。

options.description_en:
Essence abilities have a chance to infuse your next Reversion with the power of the Green Dragonflight, upgrading it to Merithra's Blessing:

 Merithra's Blessing
Spring a bloom of life from your target, healing them and up to 4 other allies within 30 yards for 855. Blooms may heal your primary target multiple times if no nearby injured allies are present.
options.description_zh:
精华技能有几率使你下一次逆转注入绿龙军团的力量，将其升级为麦琳瑟拉的祝福：

 麦琳瑟拉的祝福
从你的目标处绽放生命之花，为其和30码内最多4名其他盟友治疗855点生命值。如果附近没有受伤的盟友，绽放可能会多次治疗你的主要目标。

options.description_en: Living Flame and Azure Strike have 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when they critically strike.
options.description_zh: 活化烈焰和碧蓝打击爆击时有额外1次触发精华迸发的机会。

options.description_en:
Disintegrate consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.

Pyre consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.
options.description_zh:
裂解造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上1.0秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量150%的伤害。

葬火造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上4秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量115%的伤害。

options.description_en: Fire Breath deals its damage 15% more often.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息造成伤害的频率提高15%。

options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片还会施加给目标或附近1个受伤的盟友，产生50%的效果。

options.description_en: Your wounds have a small chance to cauterize, healing you for 30% of damage taken. Occurs more often from attacks that deal high damage.
options.description_zh: 你的伤口有较小的几率灼烧愈合，为你恢复生命值，数值相当于受到伤害的30%。造成较高伤害的攻击触发频率较高。

options.description_en: Hover and Deep Breath travel 40% faster, and Hover travels 40% further.
options.description_zh: 悬空和深呼吸的飞行速度加快40%，悬空的飞行距离延长40%。

options.description_zh: 扫尾和飞翼打击会灼烧敌人，并以灰烬令其致盲，使他们在4秒内的下一次攻击无法命中。

options.description_en: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的持续伤害时间延长4秒。

options.description_zh: 火焰吐息到达最大蓄力层数的速度提高20%。

options.description_zh: 对生命值高于50%的目标的爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_zh: 火焰吐息获得一层额外充能。

options.description_zh: 精华技能被烈焰增强，在8秒内造成治疗或火焰伤害，数值相当于造成治疗或伤害的20%。

options.description_zh: 火焰吐息的冷却时间缩短5秒。

options.description_zh: 孪生烈焰会弹射到最多2个额外目标。

options.description_zh: 火焰吐息有50%的几率产生精华迸发。

options.description_zh: 消耗精华迸发会发射一道孪生烈焰，对目标造成547点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Upheaval deals 50% additional damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 地壳激变在8秒内额外造成50%的伤害。

options.description_zh: 蓄力法术会向目标射出最多3股时序烈焰。

options.description_zh: 每当你施放一个蓄力法术，不稳定的时光魔法会使其冷却时间缩短最多6秒。

options.description_zh: 黑檀之力和先知先觉可提供额外50%的属性，几率等同于你的爆击几率。对于黑檀之力，此增幅持续15.0秒。

options.description_en:
Non-defensive abilities with a 45 second or longer cooldown grant 5% Intellect for 15 sec.

Essence spells extend the duration by 1 sec.
options.description_zh:
使用冷却时间为45秒及以上的非防御技能可使智力提高5%，持续15秒。

使用精华法术使持续时间延长1秒。

nodes.name_zh: 瞬息之隔 / 加速微粒

options.description_en: Warp reduces damage taken by 20%, starting high and reducing over 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 迁跃使受到的伤害降低20%，效果初始较高，并在3秒内衰减。

options.description_zh: 迁跃会留下加速微粒痕迹，接触到微粒的盟友的移动速度提高20%，持续30秒。

options.description_zh: 先知先觉的持续时间延长15%。

悬空现在使你短暂地迁跃到现实之外，并在目标位置出现。悬空的冷却时间缩短5秒。

悬空依然使唤魔师法术可以在移动中施放。

options.description_zh: 扭转天平会为你注入超量的时空能量，使你的急速、移动速度和冷却恢复速度提高30%，然后在30秒内逐渐降低。

options.description_zh: 活化烈焰造成的伤害和治疗效果提高6%。

options.description_en: Your Living Flame and Emerald Blossom are 30% more effective on yourself.
options.description_zh: 你对自己施放活化烈焰和翡翠之花时，效果提高30%。

options.description_zh: 你可以在落地后的3秒内再次激活深呼吸，以返回起飞的地方。

options.description_zh: 悬空的前4秒内，你的移动速度提高70%。

options.description_zh: 给盟友的伤口加热，移除所有流血、中毒、诅咒和疾病效果。移除任何效果后恢复1,330点生命值。

options.description_zh: 使用翡翠之花或青翠之拥治疗你自己会使你下一个活化烈焰的施法时间缩短40%。

options.description_zh: 你造成的魔法伤害提高2%。

options.description_zh: 你造成的魔法伤害提高4%。

options.description_zh: 当生命值在75%以上时，你的移动速度提高10%。

options.description_zh: 绿龙法术治疗效果提高10%。

options.description_en: Redirect your excess magic to a friendly healer for 1 hour. When you cast an empowered spell, you restore 0.25% of their maximum mana per empower level. Limit 1.
options.description_zh: 将你溢出的魔力转移给一名友方治疗者，持续1小时。当你施放蓄力法术时，每层蓄力都会为其恢复最大法力的0.25%。只能影响一个目标。

options.description_en: Glide speed and height increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 滑翔速度和高度提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath causes your next Living Flame to strike 1 additional target per empower level.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息会使你的下一个活化烈焰命中额外的目标，每级蓄力增加一个。

options.description_en: Oppressing Roar removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy, and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
options.description_zh: 压迫怒吼从每个敌人身上移除1个激怒效果，冷却时间缩短30秒。

options.description_en: Hover gains 1 additional charge.
options.description_zh: 悬空额外获得1次使用次数。

options.description_en: Rescue increases movement speed by 100% and allows spells to be cast while moving for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 营救使移动速度提高100%，并且可以在移动中施放，持续3秒。

options.description_en: Source of Magic increases the target's healing and damage done by 3%.
options.description_zh: 魔力之源使目标造成的治疗效果和伤害提高3%。

options.description_en: Deep Breath stuns enemies for 3 sec.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸使敌人昏迷3秒。

nodes.name_zh: 时间螺旋 / 空间悖论

options.description_en: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.
options.description_zh: 扭曲时间，使你和40码内的盟友能够在接下来的10秒内施放一次主要移动技能，无视其冷却状态。

options.description_en:
Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec.

Affects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.
options.description_zh:
为你和最近的友方治疗者唤起悖论，使你们能够在移动时施法，并使大部分法术的射程提高100%，持续10秒。

如果你的目标不是治疗者，则会影响60码内最近的治疗者。

options.description_en: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 召唤上升气流，将你和20码内最近的4位盟友托举到空中，使你们受到的范围攻击伤害降低20%，移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。

options.description_en:
Increase all damage dealing allies' primary stat by 8.0% of your own and increase your own damage by 20% for 10 sec.

Ebon Might will split its effect when applied to more than 2 other allies.

Eruption, Deep Breath, and your empower spells extend the duration of these effects.
options.description_zh:
使所有伤害输出型盟友的主属性提高，数值相当于你自身主属性的8.0%，并使你自身造成的伤害提高20%，持续10秒。

当黑檀之力作用于超过2名其他盟友时，效果会被分摊。

喷发、深呼吸和你的蓄力法术可以延长这些效果的持续时间。

options.description_en: Cause a violent eruption beneath an enemy's feet, dealing 1,064 Volcanic damage split between them and nearby enemies.
options.description_zh: 在一名敌人脚下引发剧烈喷发，造成1,064点熔火伤害，由目标和附近的所有敌人均摊。

options.description_en: Your Living Flame has a 20% chance, and your Azure Strike has a 15% chance, to make your next Eruption cost no Essence.
options.description_zh: 你的活化烈焰和碧蓝打击分别有20%和15%的几率使你的下一个喷发不消耗精华。

options.description_en: Interrupt an enemy's spellcasting and prevent any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 打断一名敌人施放的法术，使其无法施放任何同系法术，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Eruption deals 30% more damage per enemy struck, up to 150%.
options.description_zh: 喷发每击中一个敌人，造成的伤害提高30%，最多提高150%。

options.description_en: Essence Burst stacks 2 times.
options.description_zh: 精华迸发叠加2次。

nodes.name_zh: 阿莱克丝塔萨的门徒 / 回响打击

options.description_en: When cast at an enemy, Living Flame strikes 1 additional enemy for 100% damage.
options.description_zh: 对敌人施放时，活化烈焰会额外打击1名敌人，造成100%的伤害。

options.description_en: Azure Strike deals 15% increased damage and has a 10% chance per target hit to echo, casting again.
options.description_zh: 碧蓝打击造成的伤害提高15%，每击中一个目标就有10%的几率触发回响，额外施放一次。

options.description_en:
Gather earthen power beneath your enemy's feet and send them hurtling upwards, dealing 1,625 Volcanic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Empowering expands the area of effect.

I:   3 yd radius.

II:  6 yd radius.

III: 9 yd radius.
options.description_zh:
将大地之力汇聚在敌人脚下并将其击飞，对目标和附近的敌人造成1,599点熔火伤害。

蓄力会扩大效果范围。

I：3码范围。

II：6码范围。

III：9码范围。

options.description_en:
Fly to the targeted location, exposing a Temporal Wound on enemies in your path for 10 sec.

Removes roots and grants immunity to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying.

 Temporal Wound
15% of damage dealt by allies affected by Ebon Might is copied as additional Arcane damage to enemies after 10 sec.

Damage is reduced if Ebon Might affects more than 2 other allies.
options.description_zh:
飞向目标位置，使路径中的敌人暴露出时光创伤，持续10秒。

移除定身效果，并在飞行期间免疫移动限制和失控效果。

时光创伤
受到黑檀之力影响的盟友所造成伤害的15%复制到敌人身上，在10秒后造成额外的奥术伤害。

当黑檀之力影响的其他盟友超过2名时效果降低。

options.description_en:
Fatal attacks are diverted into a nearby timeline, preventing the damage, and your death, in this one.

The release of temporal energy restores 12,584 health to you, and 4,206 to 4 nearby allies, over 9 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.

May only occur once every 6 min.
options.description_zh:
将致命攻击转移至附近的时间线，在本条时间线中阻止伤害并使你免于一死。

释放的时间能量在9秒内为你恢复12,442点生命值，并为附近的4名盟友恢复4,147点生命值。治疗量开始时较高，并会逐渐降低。

每6分钟只能触发一次。

options.description_en: Essence Burst reduces the cast time of Eruption by 40% and increases its damage by 20%.
options.description_zh: 精华迸发使喷发的施法时间缩短40%，并使其伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Increases your maximum Essence to 6.
options.description_zh: 你的精华上限提高至6。

options.description_en: Eruption's Essence cost is reduced by 1.
options.description_zh: 喷发的精华消耗降低1。

nodes.name_zh: 命途劫难 / 时序结界

options.description_en: Breath of Eons reduces enemies' movement speed by 70%, and reduces their attack speed by 50%, for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 亘古吐息使敌人的移动速度降低70%，攻击速度降低50%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: When allies deal damage with Temporal Wounds, they gain a shield for 100% of the damage dealt. Absorption cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.
options.description_zh: 盟友通过时光创伤造成伤害时，会获得相当于造成伤害100%的护盾。吸收量不能超过你最大生命值的30%。

options.description_en:
Conjure a pair of Weyrnstones, one for your target ally and one for yourself. Only one ally may bear your Weyrnstone at a time.

A Weyrnstone can be activated by the bearer to transport them to the other Weyrnstone's location, if they are within 100 yds.
options.description_zh:
召唤一对军营之石，使你和目标盟友各获得一个。同一时间只能有一名盟友佩戴你的军营之石。

只要两块军营之石相距100码内，佩戴者激活军营之石即可传送至另一块军营之石的位置。

options.description_en:
Enchant an ally to appear out of sync with the normal flow of time, reducing threat they generate by 30% for 1 hour. Less effective on tank-specialized allies. 

May only be placed on one target at a time.
options.description_zh:
为一名盟友施展魔法，使其仿佛与正常的时间流动脱节，产生的威胁值降低30%，持续1小时。对坦克专精的盟友效果较差。

同一时间只能对一个目标生效。

options.description_en: Defy Fate healing increased by 100% and its cooldown is reduced by 1 min.
options.description_zh: 驳斥命运的治疗效果提高100%，冷却时间缩短1分钟。

options.description_en:
Protect an ally with 15 explosive dragonscales, increasing their Armor by 20% of your own.

Melee attacks against the target cause 1 scale to explode, dealing 114 Volcanic damage to enemies near them. This damage can only occur every few sec.

Blistering Scales can only be placed on one target at a time. Casts on your enemy's target if they have one.
options.description_zh:
用15枚高爆龙鳞保护一名盟友，使其护甲值提高，数值相当于你自身护甲值的20%。

对受保护目标的近战攻击会引爆一枚龙鳞，对附近的敌人造成114点熔岩伤害。此伤害每数秒只能触发一次。

同一时间只能对一个目标施放炽火龙鳞。若对敌方目标施放，则会施加给该敌人的目标。

options.description_en:
Learn to attune yourself to the essence of the Black or Bronze Dragonflights:

Black Attunement: You and your 4 nearest allies have 2% increased maximum health.

Bronze Attunement:You and your 4 nearest allies have 10% increased movement speed.
options.description_zh:
学习与黑龙或青铜龙军团的精华协调：

黑龙协调：你和最近的4名盟友的最大生命值提高2%。

青铜协调：你和最近的4名盟友的移动速度提高10%。

options.description_en:
Grant an ally the gift of foresight, increasing their critical strike chance by 3% for 18 sec.

Affects the nearest ally within 25 yds, preferring damage dealers with their cooldowns active, if you do not have an ally targeted.
options.description_zh:
使一名盟友能够先知先觉，令其爆击几率提高3%，持续18秒。

如果你的目标不是盟友，则会影响25码内最近的盟友，优先选择技能正在冷却的伤害输出者。

nodes.name_zh: 不屈领域 / 构造位点

options.description_en: Upheaval cannot be interrupted, and has an additional 10% chance to critically strike.
options.description_zh: 地壳激变无法被打断，并且爆击几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Upheaval deals 50% increased damage to the primary target, and launches them higher.
options.description_zh: 地壳激变对主要目标造成的伤害提高50%，并提高击飞高度。

nodes.name_zh: 愈复甲质 / 熔火血脉

options.description_en: Blistering Scales no longer loses charges and deals 20% more damage.
options.description_zh: 炽火龙鳞不再消耗充能，造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: When cast, Blistering Scales grants the target a shield that absorbs up to 5,700 damage for 30 sec based on their missing health. Lower health targets gain a larger shield.
options.description_zh: 施放技能时，炽火龙鳞会使目标获得一个吸收护盾，根据其损失的生命值吸收最多5,700点伤害，持续30秒。低生命值目标获得的护盾吸收量较高。

options.description_en: Consuming Essence Burst grants you 5% Intellect for 6 sec. Stacks up to 2 times.
options.description_zh: 消耗精华迸发使你的智力提高5%，持续6秒。最多叠加2次。

options.description_en:
Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by 3.0% for 12 sec.

Hover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by 25% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
黑曜鳞片会激活黑龙协调并强化其效果，使最大生命值提高3.0%，持续12秒。

悬空会激活青铜协调并强化其效果，使移动速度提高25%，持续4秒。

options.description_en:
Obsidian Scales activates Black Attunement, and amplifies it to increase maximum health by 4.0% for 12 sec.

Hover activates Bronze Attunement, and amplifies it to increase movement speed by 40% for 4 sec.
options.description_zh:
黑曜鳞片会激活黑龙协调并强化其效果，使最大生命值提高4.0%，持续12秒。

悬空会激活青铜协调并强化其效果，使移动速度提高40%，持续4秒。

options.description_en: The range of your helpful magics is increased by 5 yards.
options.description_zh: 你的有益魔法效果的射程延长5码。

options.description_en: Prescience grants the ally a chance for their spells and abilities to echo their damage or healing, dealing 15% of the amount again.
options.description_zh: 先知先觉有几率使盟友的法术和技能引发回响，再次产生15%的伤害或治疗效果。

options.description_en: Emerald Blossom increases targets' healing received by 3% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 翡翠之花使目标受到的治疗效果提高3%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Emerald Blossom increases targets' healing received by 6% for 10 sec.
options.description_zh: 翡翠之花使目标受到的治疗效果提高6%，持续10秒。

options.description_en: Each time Blistering Scales explodes it deals 15% more damage for 12 sec, stacking 10 times.
options.description_zh: 炽火龙鳞每次爆炸造成的伤害提高15%，持续12秒，最多叠加10次。

options.description_en: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.
options.description_zh: 你的蓄力法术等级上限提高1级，并且达到最高级的速度加快20%。

options.description_en: Essence Burst has a 20% chance to not be consumed.
options.description_zh: 精华迸发有20%的几率不会被消耗。

options.description_en: Eruption has a 25% chance to form a mote of diverted essence near you. Allies who comes in contact with the mote gain a random buff from your arsenal.
options.description_zh: 喷发有25%的几率在你附近形成一个转移精华微粒。接触到微粒的盟友将获得你能提供的一个随机增益效果。

options.description_en: Prescience has a 35% chance to grant Essence Burst.
options.description_zh: 先知先觉有35%的几率获得精华迸发。

nodes.name_zh: 芳蕊长春 / 春晖梦晓

options.description_en: Your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Symbiotic Bloom.
options.description_zh: 延长黑檀之力的效果也会延长共栖荣花。

options.description_en: Emerald Blossom no longer has a cooldown, deals 35% increased healing, and increases the duration of your active Ebon Might effects by 1 sec, but costs 3 Essence.
options.description_zh: 翡翠之花不再有冷却时间，造成的治疗效果提高35%，并使你激活的黑檀之力效果的持续时间延长1秒，但会消耗3点精华。

options.description_en: Eruption reduces the remaining cooldown of Upheaval by 1.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 喷发使地壳激变的剩余冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

options.description_en: Deep Breath reduces the Essence cost of your next 6 Eruptions by 1.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸使你的下6个喷发的精华消耗减少1点。

options.description_en: Surge forward in time, causing your cooldowns to recover 1,000% faster for 2 sec.
options.description_zh: 在时光中跃进，使你的冷却速度加快1,000%，持续2秒。

options.description_en: Motes of Possibility may now grant Prescience to allies and have a 10% increased chance to activate.
options.description_zh: 机遇微粒现在可以给予盟友先知先觉，且激活几率提高10%。

options.description_en: Fire Breath grants the inferno's blessing for 8 sec to you and a nearby ally, giving their damaging attacks and spells a high chance to deal an additional 1,022 Fire damage.
options.description_zh: 火焰吐息会为你和一名附近的盟友施加狱火祝福，持续8秒，使伤害性攻击和法术有很高的几率额外造成1,022点火焰伤害。

options.description_en: Upheaval causes an aftershock at its location, dealing 30% of its damage 2 additional times.
options.description_zh: 地壳激变在其位置引发余震，额外造成2次伤害，伤害量等同于其伤害的30%。

options.description_en: Deep Breath grants you Fury of the Aspects for 15 sec after you land, without causing Exhaustion.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸落地后使你获得守护巨龙之怒，持续15秒，而且不会导致筋疲力尽。

nodes.name_zh: 明日今夕 / 丝缕交织

options.description_en: Time Skip channels for 1 sec longer.
options.description_zh: 时间跳跃的引导时间延长1秒。

options.description_en: The cooldowns of your spells are reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 你的法术的冷却时间缩短10%。

options.description_en: Deep Breath casts an Eruption at the first 3 enemies struck. These Eruptions have a 100% chance to create a Mote of Possibility.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸首次击中3个敌人时施放一次喷发。这些喷发有100%的几率产生一个机遇微粒。

options.description_en: Inferno's Blessing's damage is increased by 40%, and your effects that extend Ebon Might also extend Inferno's Blessing.
options.description_zh: 狱火祝福的伤害提高40%，同时你的延长黑檀之力的效果也会延长狱火祝福。

options.description_en: Breath of Eons summons a version of you from the future to assist you in battle, lasting 20 sec. Your duplicate casts Eruption, Fire Breath, and Upheaval.
options.description_zh: 亘古吐息会召唤一个来自未来的你协助战斗，持续20秒。你的复制体会施放喷发、火焰吐息和地壳激变。

options.description_en:
Deep Breath causes enemies to take 20% increased damage from Bombardments and Essence abilities for 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.
options.description_zh:
深呼吸使敌人受到的连环轰炸和精华技能的伤害提高20%，持续12秒。

多次施放深呼吸会延长此效果的持续时间。

nodes.name_zh: 持久鏖战 / 力量分流

options.description_en: Essence abilities extend Bombardments by 1 sec.
options.description_zh: 精华技能会使连环轰炸的时间延长1秒。

options.description_en: Bombardments have a chance to generate Essence Burst.
options.description_zh: 连环轰炸有几率生成精华迸发。

nodes.name_zh: 硬化鳞片 / 威慑英气

options.description_en: Obsidian Scales reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.
options.description_zh: 黑曜鳞片使受到的伤害额外降低10%。

options.description_en: Knocking enemies up or backwards reduces their damage done to you by 15% for 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 将敌人击飞或击退使其对你造成的伤害降低15%，持续8秒。

options.description_en: For each second you are in combat, Azure Strike, Living Flame, and Disintegrate deal 1% increased damage, up to 15%.
options.description_zh: 当你进入战斗以后，碧蓝打击、活化烈焰以及裂解造成的伤害每秒提高1%，至多15%。

options.description_en:
Mass Disintegrate marks your primary target for destruction for the next 6 sec.

You and your allies have a chance to trigger a Bombardment when attacking marked targets, dealing 1,805 Volcanic damage split amongst all nearby enemies.
options.description_zh:
群体裂解将你的主要目标标记为毁灭的对象，持续6秒。

你和盟友攻击被标记的目标时有几率触发一次连环轰炸，造成1,805点熔火伤害，由附近的所有敌人均摊。

options.description_en: Empower spells cause your next Disintegrate to strike up to 3 targets. When striking fewer than 3 targets, Disintegrate damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.
options.description_zh: 蓄力法术使你的下一个裂解击中最多3个目标。击中的目标少于3个时，每少一个目标，裂解的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en:
Deep Breath can now be steered in your desired direction.

In addition, Deep Breath burns targets for 3,576 Volcanic damage over 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.
options.description_zh:
深呼吸现在可以控制方向。

另外，深呼吸会点燃目标，在12秒内造成3,576点熔火伤害。

多次施放深呼吸会延长此效果的持续时间。

options.description_en: While Hovering, damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh: 悬空时，受到的范围攻击伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Deep Breath resets a charge of Hover.
options.description_zh: 深呼吸重置一层悬空的充能。

options.description_en: Entering combat grants a charge of Burnout, causing your next Living Flame to cast instantly.
options.description_zh: 进入战斗可以获得一层燃尽，使你的下一次活化烈焰可以瞬发。

options.description_en: Black spells deal 20% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 黑龙法术造成的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Mass Disintegrate reduces the remaining cooldown of Deep Breath by 1.0 sec for each target struck.
options.description_zh: 群体裂解每击中一个目标，就会使深呼吸的剩余冷却时间缩短1.0秒。

options.description_en: Empower spells cause your next Eruption to strike up to 3 targets. When striking less than 3 targets, Eruption damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.

options.description_zh:
在虚空变形期间，每收集30个灵魂残片即可使用坍缩之星。

坍缩之星
引导磅礴的虚空能量，汇聚成一次猛烈的冲击，对你的目标造成2,398点宇宙伤害，并对所有附近敌人造成1,780点宇宙伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

施放坍缩之星时，你的恶魔之怒流失速度会大幅降低。

options.description_en: After fully channeling Void Ray, the cooldown of Reap is reset and your next Reap will collect up to 6 additional Soul Fragments.
options.description_zh: 完整引导虚空射线后，重置收割的冷却时间，且你的下一次收割最多可额外收集6个灵魂残片。

options.description_en:
Activating Void Metamorphosis greatly empowers The Hunt.

Voidsurge damage is increased by 10% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.
options.description_zh:
激活虚空变形大幅强化恶魔追击。

恶魔形态激活时，之前每触发过一次虚空涌动，其造成的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Your critical strike chance is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你的爆击几率提高2%。

options.description_en:
While in combat, generate 1 Soul Fragment every 12 sec.

While out of combat, you will slowly build towards your Void Metamorphosis, up to 25 Soul Fragments.
options.description_zh:
在战斗中，每12秒产生1个灵魂残片。

脱离战斗时，你会缓慢地积累虚空变形所需的能量，最多25个灵魂残片。

options.description_en: Damage from Void Ray has a 200% increased chance to generate a Soul Fragment.
options.description_zh: 虚空射线造成伤害时产生灵魂残片的几率提高200%。

options.description_en: Each Soul Fragment gathered by Reap increases its damage by 8%.
options.description_zh: 收割收集的每个灵魂残片都会使其伤害提高8%。

options.description_en:
Consume has a 35% chance to grant 1 stack of Voidfall.

Upon reaching 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes a stack to reach into the Void and call down a meteor strike at your target's location, dealing 675 Cosmic damage to all enemies within 8 yards. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
吞噬有35%的几率获得1层虚落。

达到3层虚落时，收割会消耗1层虚落探入虚空，并在你的目标位置召唤一次流星撞击，对8码内的所有敌人造成667点宇宙伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Void Metamorphosis now also greatly empowers Voidblade and Hungering Slash.

While demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Voidsurge, causing you to explode with Void energy, dealing 2,416 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
虚空变形现在还会大幅强化虚空之刃和饥渴斩击。

恶魔形态激活时，你第一次施放每种强化技能时都会触发一次虚空涌动，使你爆发出虚空能量，对周围的敌人造成2,363点宇宙伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en: Soul Immolation generates an additional 12 Fury over its duration.
options.description_zh: 灵魂献祭在其持续时间内额外产生12点恶魔之怒。

options.description_en:
The duration of Feast of Souls is increased by 1 sec.

 Feast of Souls
Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
灵魂盛宴的持续时间延长1秒。

 灵魂盛宴:
灵魂残片使你造成的伤害提高1%，持续6秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en:
The duration of Feast of Souls is increased by 2 sec.

 Feast of Souls
Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
options.description_zh:
灵魂盛宴的持续时间延长2秒。

 灵魂盛宴:
灵魂残片使你造成的伤害提高1%，持续6秒。多次施加可以重叠生效。

options.description_en: Reap gains an additional charge.
options.description_zh: 收割获得一层额外充能。

options.description_en: Reap's cooldown is reduced by your Haste.
options.description_zh: 收割的冷却时间随你的急速属性缩短。

options.description_en: Consume deals 10% increased damage and its cast time is reduced by 0.25 sec.
options.description_zh: 吞噬造成的伤害提高10%，施法时间缩短0.25秒。

options.description_en: Your chance to shatter a Soul Fragment from enemies you damage is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你从伤害的敌人身上击碎灵魂残片的几率提高2%。

options.description_en: Your chance to shatter a Soul Fragment from enemies you damage is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你从伤害的敌人身上击碎灵魂残片的几率提高4%。

options.description_en: Void Ray's cooldown during Void Metamorphosis is reduced by 2.0 sec.
options.description_zh: 虚空变形期间，虚空射线的冷却时间缩短2.0秒。

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% Haste.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使急速提高2%。

nodes.name_en: Wave of Debilitation / Pursuit of Angriness
nodes.name_zh: 衰竭波动 / 怒意追击

options.description_en: Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.
options.description_zh: 混乱新星在其昏迷效果消失后，使敌人减速60%，并使其攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 1% per 10 Fury.
options.description_zh: 每10点恶魔之怒使移动速度提高1%。

options.description_en:
Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.
options.description_zh:
当虚空涌动仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高50%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低10%。

options.description_en:
Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.
options.description_zh:
虚空射线的伤害提高15%。

完整引导虚空射线会使你获得1层虚落。

nodes.name_en: Set Fire to the Pain / Improved Soul Rending
nodes.name_zh: 沐焰为殇 / 强化灵魂劈裂

options.description_en:
5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec.

Fire damage taken reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh:
受到的所有非火焰伤害的5%改为视作火焰伤害，持续6秒。

受到的火焰伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Leech granted by Soul Rending increased by 2% and an additional 2% while Void Metamorphosis is active.
options.description_zh: 由灵魂劈裂获得的吸血提高2%，在虚空变形期间再额外提高2%。

options.description_en: Enemies struck by a Voidfall Meteor take an additional 25% damage over 8 sec.
options.description_zh: 被虚落流星击中的敌人在8秒内额外受到25%的伤害。

options.description_en: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% reduced damage taken.
options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使受到的伤害降低2%。

options.description_en:
Cosmic damage increased by 2%.

Effect is doubled while in demon form.
options.description_zh:
宇宙伤害提高2%。

在恶魔形态下效果翻倍。

options.description_en:
After dealing damage with The Hunt or Voidblade, Voidblade is replaced with Hungering Slash for 6 sec.

 Hungering Slash
Violently slash your scythe around you, dealing 940 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies and generating 10 Fury. Shatters up to 2 Soul Fragments from nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hungering Slash grants a temporary charge of Vengeful Retreat and causes your next Vengeful Retreat within 6 sec to deal an additional 570 Cosmic damage.
options.description_zh:
使用恶魔追击或虚空之刃造成伤害后，虚空之刃会被饥渴斩击取代，持续6秒。

 饥渴斩击
在你周围猛烈挥舞镰刀，对附近的敌人造成940点宇宙伤害并产生10点恶魔之怒。从附近的敌人身上击碎最多2个灵魂残片。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

饥渴斩击会使你暂时获得一层复仇回避充能，并使你在6秒内施放的下一次复仇回避额外造成570点宇宙伤害。

options.description_en: Your Mastery is increased by 2%.
options.description_zh: 你的精通提高2%。

options.description_en: Your Mastery is increased by 4%.
options.description_zh: 你的精通提高4%。

options.description_en: Void Ray deals 80% more damage when damaging 3 targets.
options.description_zh: 虚空射线对3个目标造成伤害时，造成的伤害提高80%。

options.description_en:
Your blades burn with Cosmic energy, causing your Voidblade, Hungering Slash, and Throw Glaive to deal an additional 35% damage as Cosmic damage.

Reap damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
你的利刃燃烧着宇宙能量，使你的虚空之刃、饥渴斩击和投掷利刃造成额外35%的宇宙伤害。

收割的伤害提高20%。

options.description_zh: 每一层虚落都使移动速度提高3%。

options.description_zh: 变换额外获得1次充能。

options.description_zh: 激活虚空变形时，获得3层虚落并重置收割的冷却时间。

options.description_en:
Entering Void Metamorphosis resets the cooldown of Voidblade and The Hunt.

The Hunt deals 25% increased damage and resets the cooldown of Soul Immolation.
options.description_zh:
进入虚空变形时，重置虚空之刃和恶魔追击的冷却时间。

恶魔追击的伤害提高25%，并且会重置灵魂献祭的冷却时间。

options.description_en: The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Mastery: Monster Within's effectiveness by 20%.
options.description_zh: 在你脱离恶魔形态后，该形态仍以减弱状态持续，使你的精通：内在恶魔的效果提高20%。

nodes.name_zh: 末日预言者 / 掌驭宇宙

options.description_zh: 在脱离战斗或进入战斗后的5秒内激活虚空射线会在其持续时间内召唤3个虚落流星。

options.description_en: Voidfall Meteor damage increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 虚落流星的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Soul Immolation has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.
options.description_zh: 灵魂献祭有25%的几率在结束后重燃，重新施加其效果。

options.description_en: Consume generates 2 additional Fury and deals 15% increased damage.
options.description_zh: 吞噬额外产生2点恶魔之怒，造成的伤害提高15%。

options.description_en: Hungering Slash and Voidblade's critical strike chance is increased by 15%.
options.description_zh: 饥渴斩击和虚空之刃的爆击几率提高15%。

options.description_en:
Voidblade damage increased by 25%.

Hungering Slash deals 50% increased damage to its primary target.
options.description_zh:
虚空之刃伤害提高25%。

饥渴斩击对其主要目标的伤害提高50%。

options.description_en: Void Ray and Hungering Slash damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 虚空射线和饥渴斩击的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Void Ray and Hungering Slash damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 虚空射线和饥渴斩击的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: Reap and Consume damage increased by 10%.
options.description_zh: 收割和吞噬的伤害提高10%。

options.description_en: Reap and Consume damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh: 收割和吞噬的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en: After fully channeling Void Ray, gain 10 Fury.
options.description_zh: 完整引导虚空射线后，获得10点恶魔之怒。

options.description_en: When Void Metamorphosis expires, for each unused Soul you harvested, gain 5 Fury and increase your damage by 0.50% for 12 sec.
options.description_zh: 虚空变形结束时，每个已收割但未使用的灵魂会使你获得5点恶魔之怒，且造成的伤害提高0.50%，持续12秒。

options.description_en: Maximum Fury increased by 20.
options.description_zh: 恶魔之怒上限提高20点。

options.description_en: Passive bonuses granted by each stack of Voidfall persist for 8 sec after being consumed.
options.description_zh: 每层虚落提供的被动加成在被消耗后仍会持续8秒。

options.description_en: Void Ray applies Student of Suffering to you, increasing Mastery by 10.6% and granting 5 Fury every 2 sec, for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 虚空射线会对你施加苦难修行，精通提高10.6%，并且每2秒产生5点恶魔之怒，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.
options.description_zh: 饥渴斩击的半径提高2码，并且额外提高50%爆击伤害。

options.description_en: While at 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes all 3 to rapidly call down that many meteor strikes.
options.description_zh: 当拥有3层虚落时，收割会消耗所有3层效果，快速召唤同等次数的流星撞击。

options.description_en: Your first Collapsing Star after casting Void Metamorphosis causes a Cosmic meteor shower to assault the area, dealing 2,299 Cosmic damage over 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 在施放虚空变形后，你的第一次坍缩之星会召唤一阵宇宙流星雨袭击该区域，在6秒内造成2,289点宇宙伤害。

options.description_en: Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.
options.description_zh: 不处于恶魔形态时，智力提高15%。

options.description_en: Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.
options.description_zh: 进入恶魔形态会使你的下一次虚空涌动在短暂延迟后重复。

options.description_en:
Collapsing Star and Voidfall meteors deal 30% increased damage when striking a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 5%.
options.description_zh:
当坍缩之星和虚落流星仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高30%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低5%。

Collapsing Star reduces the cooldown of Voidblade by 10 sec.

options.description_zh:
坍缩之星使虚空之刃的冷却时间缩短10秒。

在虚空变形期间，虚空之刃和恶魔追击会短暂减少你消耗的恶魔之怒。

options.description_zh: 你每施放一次坍缩之星，你的下一次坍缩之星的伤害就提高20%。

options.description_zh: 冲向你的目标，对其造成2,288点宇宙伤害，将其定在原地1.5秒，并在6秒内对路径上最多5名敌人造成1,628点宇宙伤害。

根除最多可以收集4个附近的灵魂。

options.description_en:
Void Ray damage increased by 15%.

Fully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.
options.description_zh:
虚空射线的伤害提高15%。

完整引导虚空射线会使你获得1层虚落。

options.description_en: Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.
options.description_zh: 不处于恶魔形态时，智力提高15%。

options.description_en:
Cosmic damage increased by 2%.

Effect is doubled while in demon form.
options.description_zh:
宇宙伤害提高2%。

在恶魔形态下效果翻倍。

options.description_en: The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Mastery: Monster Within's effectiveness by 20%.
options.description_zh: 在你脱离恶魔形态后，该形态仍以减弱状态持续，使你的精通：内在恶魔的效果提高20%。

options.description_en: Void Ray applies Student of Suffering to you, increasing Mastery by 10.6% and granting 5 Fury every 2 sec, for 6 sec.
options.description_zh: 虚空射线会对你施加苦难修行，精通提高10.6%，并且每2秒产生5点恶魔之怒，持续6秒。

options.description_en: Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.
options.description_zh: 饥渴斩击的半径提高2码，并且额外提高50%爆击伤害。

options.description_en: Soul Immolation has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.
options.description_zh: 灵魂献祭有25%的几率在结束后重燃，重新施加其效果。

options.description_en: Maximum Fury increased by 20.
options.description_zh: 恶魔之怒上限提高20点。

options.description_en: Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.
options.description_zh: 进入恶魔形态会使你的下一次虚空涌动在短暂延迟后重复。

options.description_en:
Your blades burn with Cosmic energy, causing your Voidblade, Hungering Slash, and Throw Glaive to deal an additional 35% damage as Cosmic damage.

Reap damage increased by 20%.
options.description_zh:
你的利刃燃烧着宇宙能量，使你的虚空之刃、饥渴斩击和投掷利刃造成额外35%的宇宙伤害。

收割的伤害提高20%。

options.description_en:
Void Metamorphosis now also greatly empowers Voidblade and Hungering Slash.

While demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Voidsurge, causing you to explode with Void energy, dealing 2,391 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
options.description_zh:
虚空变形现在还会大幅强化虚空之刃和饥渴斩击。

恶魔形态激活时，你第一次施放每种强化技能时都会触发一次虚空涌动，使你爆发出虚空能量，对周围的敌人造成2,350点宇宙伤害。目标超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

options.description_en:
Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.
options.description_zh:
当虚空涌动仅击中一个目标时，造成的伤害提高50%。

每多击中一个目标，该加成降低10%。

nodes.name_en: Wave of Debilitation / Pursuit of Angriness
nodes.name_zh: 衰竭波动 / 怒意追击

options.description_en: Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.
options.description_zh: 混乱新星在其昏迷效果消失后，使敌人减速60%，并使其攻击和施法速度降低15%，持续5秒。

options.description_en: Movement speed increased by 1% per 10 Fury.
options.description_zh: 每10点恶魔之怒使移动速度提高1%。

options.description_en:
Entering Void Metamorphosis resets the cooldown of Voidblade and The Hunt.

The Hunt deals 25% increased damage and resets the cooldown of Soul Immolation.
options.description_zh:
进入虚空变形时，重置虚空之刃和恶魔追击的冷却时间。

恶魔追击的伤害提高25%，并且会重置灵魂献祭的冷却时间。

options.description_en:
Activating Void Metamorphosis greatly empowers The Hunt.

Voidsurge damage is increased by 10% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.
options.description_zh:
激活虚空变形大幅强化恶魔追击。

恶魔形态激活时，之前每触发过一次虚空涌动，其造成的伤害提高10%。

nodes.name_en: Set Fire to the Pain / Improved Soul Rending
nodes.name_zh: 沐焰为殇 / 强化灵魂劈裂

options.description_en:
5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec.

Fire damage taken reduced by 10%.
options.description_zh:
受到的所有非火焰伤害的5%改为视作火焰伤害，持续6秒。

受到的火焰伤害降低10%。

options.description_en: Leech granted by Soul Rending increased by 2% and an additional 2% while Void Metamorphosis is active.
options.description_zh: 由灵魂劈裂获得的吸血提高2%，在虚空变形期间再额外提高2%。

bosses.description_en: Long ago, the shadow hunter Nek'zali and her followers were entombed for the blasphemous act of summoning Ula'tek. Restored by the very power she unleashed, she calls the other Soulcoilers from their tombs to serve her once more.
bosses.description_zh: 很久以前，暗影猎手内克扎莉与她的追随者因犯下召唤乌拉特克的亵渎之罪，惨遭活埋。如今，这股由她亲手释放的力量又令她重获新生。她正从坟墓中唤醒其他的盘魂者，让它们再次为自己效命。

sections.description_en:
As Nek'zali energizes the [Soulcoil Well] by invoking the [Soulcoil Rite], she provokes the [Restless Amani] to the well. 

Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to begin the [Ritual of Awakening]. Destroying Echoes of Jawae removes their [Tethers of Awakening] and draws her back. 

Upon reaching full energy, she unwinds the Soulcoil and begins [Uncoiling], empowering her with new abilities until her defeat.
sections.description_zh:
内克扎莉通过引导[盘魂仪式]为[盘魂之井]充能时，会惊动[无眠的阿曼尼]向水井靠拢。

当生命值降至50%时，内克扎莉会撤退并开始施放[觉醒仪式]。摧毁贾瓦埃的回响可以移除它们的[觉醒之缚]并将其拉回。

当能量蓄满时，她会解开盘魂并开始[解除盘卷]，这会赋予她全新的技能，直至其被击败。

sections.description_en:
•  [Essence Rend] lingers and leaves behind a [Latent Cultist] upon expiration.
•  [Restless Amani] awaken from the sarcophagi on the outer edges of the room, empowered with [Gravebound Advance] until they are destroyed.
•   Echoes of Jawae awaken during [Soul Transfer] and provide Nek'zali with [Tether of Awakening].
sections.description_zh:
• [精华撕裂]会持续存在，并在效果结束时留下一名[潜藏的教徒]。
• [无眠的阿曼尼]会从房间外围的石棺中苏醒，并且在被摧毁前会一直受到[墓缚推进]的强化。
• 贾瓦埃的回响会在[灵魂转移]期间苏醒，并为内克扎莉提供[觉醒之缚]。

sections.description_en:
•  [Essence Rend] lingers and leaves behind a [Latent Cultist] upon expiration.
•  [Soulcoil Ignition] inflicts significant damage to all players.
•  [Soulcoil Rite] inflicts deadly damage if too many souls enter the[Soulcoil Well].
sections.description_zh:
• [精华撕裂]会持续存在，并在效果结束时留下一名[潜藏的教徒]。
• [盘魂点燃]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。
• 如果有过多灵魂进入[盘魂之井]，[盘魂仪式]会对所有玩家造成致命伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Possession Barrage] inflicts damage based on the distance each barrage travels.
•   Echoes of Jawae awaken during [Soul Transfer] and provide Nekk'zali with [Tether of Awakening].
•  Nek'zali attacks her target with [Hollowing Strikes].
sections.description_zh:
• [附身弹幕]造成的伤害取决于每波弹幕飞行的距离。
• 贾瓦埃的回响会在[灵魂转移]期间苏醒，并为内克扎莉提供[觉醒之缚]。
• 内克扎莉会使用[摄魂打击]攻击她的目标。

sections.description_en: Ancient spirits return to their corpses, and make their way towards the [Soulcoil Well].
sections.description_zh: 远古幽灵会返回他们的尸体中，并向[盘魂之井]移动。

sections.description_en: Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to the Soulcoil Well and summons an Echo of Jawae that protects her from harm.
sections.description_zh: 当生命值降至50%时，内克扎莉会退向盘魂之井，并召唤贾瓦埃的回响来保护她免受伤害。

sections.description_en: A spectral echo that protects Nek'zali from harm. Defeating an Echo of Jawae severs their Tether of Awakening.
sections.description_zh: 幽魂回响会保护内克扎莉免受伤害。击败贾瓦埃的回响即可切断其觉醒之缚。

sections.description_en: Ancient spirits return to their corpses, and make their way towards the [Soulcoil Well].
sections.description_zh: 远古幽灵会返回他们的尸体中，并向[盘魂之井]移动。

sections.description_en: Nek'zali uncoils the Soulcoil Well, gaining new abilities until defeated.
sections.description_zh: 内克扎莉解开盘魂之井的封印并获得全新的能力，直至被击败。

bosses.description_en: The Blood and Breath of Ula'tek bar the way to Vashnik's inner sanctum. Ancient golems that long stood guard within the vaults, now corrupted by the venom of the nightmarish monster they imprisoned.
bosses.description_zh: 乌拉特克之血与乌拉特克之息挡住了前往瓦什尼克内室的去路。这两尊远古魔像长期守卫在地窟之中，如今却已被它们所囚禁的梦魇怪物的剧毒所腐化。

sections.description_en:
The Sentinel Golems of Ula'tek are filled with the caustic venoms flowing throughout the temple. The Breath of Ula'tek animates venom to destroy invaders while the Blood of Ula'tek infects players with deadly toxins. 

At 100 energy the Sentinels come together to fill their venom levels with [Vitriolic Stasis], restoring health to the weaker Sentinel and infecting all players with [Helical Toxins].
sections.description_zh:
乌拉特克的哨兵魔像体内充满了在神庙中流淌的腐灼毒液。乌拉特克之息会活化毒液来消灭入侵者；而乌拉特克之血则会使玩家感染致命的毒素。

当能量达到100点时，两尊哨兵会聚到一起，施放[强酸静滞]来重新平衡体内的毒液浓度。这不仅会治愈生命值较低的哨兵，还会让所有玩家感染[螺旋毒素]。

sections.description_en:
• [Toxic Droplets] sprays droplets of venom in front of the Breath of Ula'tek.
• [Empowering Slam] and [Bloodvenom Injection] increase in intensity each time they strike the same target.
• [Helical Toxins] is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly 4 applications.
sections.description_zh:
• [剧毒水滴]会在乌拉特克之息的正前方倾泻致命的毒液。
• [强化猛击]和[鲜血毒液注射]只要连续命中同一个目标，其威力就会越来越大。
• [螺旋毒素]精确叠加至4层时，该毒素就会被完全中和，且不会造成任何伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Venom Coagulation] creates a massive slime that uses [Contaminate] until it is destroyed.
• [Vitriolic Stasis] restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the healthier Sentinel.
• [Helical Toxins] is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly 4 applications.
sections.description_zh:
• [毒液凝块]会催生出一个巨大的软泥怪，它会不断散播[污染]，直到被彻底消灭为止。
• [强酸静滞]会不断恢复较弱哨兵的生命值，直到两者的血量完全持平。
• [螺旋毒素]精确叠加至4层时，该毒素就会被完全中和，且不会造成任何伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Blighted Blood] infects players and can be dispelled.
• [Helical Toxins] is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly 4 applications.
• [Contaminate] inflicts a high amount of damage to all players.
sections.description_zh:
• [凋零之血]会感染玩家，且可以被驱散。
• [螺旋毒素]精确叠加至4层时就会被完全中和，且不会造成任何伤害。
• [污染]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en: Constantly seeking to improve his toxins, Vashnik infects players and obfuscates their attempts to save themselves.
sections.description_zh: 瓦什尼克总是在不断钻研并改良他的毒素，他不仅能让玩家身中剧毒，还会千方百计阻挠他们自救。

bosses.description_en: Within The Chamber of Virulence, Vashnik the Malignant distills Ula'tek's venoms into ever more lethal forms. The creature lurks in its noxious chamber, brewing foul toxins to empower its brood.
bosses.description_zh: 万毒邪祟者瓦什尼克盘踞在邪毒密室内，将乌拉特克的毒液提炼成了更为致命的形态。这只怪物潜伏在充满瘴气的巢穴中，调配着令人作呕的毒素，以此来强化它的子嗣。

sections.description_en:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Vashnik [Imbibes] from the nearest two fountains, increasing his affinity to them. These fountains erupt with vapor, bringing forth living venom that crawl toward the Malignant Cavity in the center of the chamber.

Should a living venom reach its destination, a [Malignant Burst] occurs.
sections.description_zh:
当能量达到100点时，瓦什尼克会从离他最近的两座喷泉中[痛饮]，从而提升他与这些喷泉的亲和度。喷泉随之喷涌出毒气，化作活体毒液爬向场地中央的万毒之穴。

一旦有活体毒液到达目的地，便会引发[恶性爆发]。

sections.description_en:
•  [Imbibe] creates living venom from two nearby fountains.

•  Living venoms explode in [Malignant Bursts] unless destroyed.

•  The initial Clotting Venom is protected by [Sanguineous Fortitude].
sections.description_zh:
• [痛饮]会从附近的两座喷泉中生成活体毒液。

• 如果不被摧毁，活体毒液就会引发[恶性爆发]。

• 最初的结块毒液受到[猩红坚韧]的保护。

sections.description_en:
•  [Imbibe] inflicts heavy damage to all players.

•  Vashnik's chamber fills with increasing [Toxic Vapor] each time he [Imbibes].

•  [Siphoning Infection] absorbs a large amount of incoming healing.
sections.description_zh:
• [痛饮]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。

• 瓦什尼克每次[痛饮]，房间里都会弥漫越来越多的[剧毒蒸汽]。

• [虹吸感染]会吸收大量的治疗量。

sections.description_en:
•  [Dripping Fangs] inflicts increasing damage over time.

•  [Imbibe] infuses Vashnik with the power of two nearby fountains.
sections.description_zh:
• [滴毒之牙]会造成越来越高的持续伤害。

• [痛饮]会向瓦什尼克灌注附近两座喷泉的力量。

bosses.description_en: A band of tortollans, possessed by spirits, have come to their senses near the sarcophagus of an ancient Soulcoiler. Trapped in the vault, they seek ancient artifacts to protect themselves from further possession by vengeful spirits.
bosses.description_zh: 一群曾被精魂附身的始祖龟在远古盘魂者的石棺附近恢复了神智。被困在地窟中的他们正在寻找远古神器，以防再次被复仇精魂附身。

sections.description_en:
Mor'zahi uses [Dark Whispers] to gain control over a group of tortollan explorers he has lured into the temple. If his control over them is broken, Mor'zahi casts [Mor'zahi's Command], expending all of his energy to reassert control and grant the target additional abilities.

Mor'zahi inflicts deadly damage if he is allowed to finish casting [Final Ascension].

Mor'zahi's concentration can be broken if a tortollan he is controlling consumes a Disgusting Fish.
sections.description_zh:
莫尔扎希会使用[黑暗低语]控制一群被他诱骗进神庙的始祖龟探险者。一旦精神控制被打破，莫尔扎希便会施放[莫尔扎希的命令]，消耗全部能量来重新夺回控制权，并赋予目标额外的能力。

如果莫尔扎希完成施放[最终扬升]，他将造成致命伤害。

如果被他控制的始祖龟吃下一条恶心的鱼，莫尔扎希的专注就会被打断。

sections.description_en:
•  Frost and Fire patches left behind by [Frostfire Volley] can be removed by the opposing elemental efects of [Burning Flames] and [Piercing Frost].
•  [Mighty Thud] inflicts very high damage to all players. Each impact inflicts damage split evenly between players directly hit.
•  Trader Gebbo's [Explosive Surprise] triggers [Blas Wavet], which can be avoided using the mushrooms from [Mushroom Toss].
sections.description_zh:
• [霜火连射]留下的冰霜和火焰区域可以通过[燃烧烈焰]和[穿刺冰霜]等相反的元素效果来移除。
• [巨力重击]会对所有玩家造成极高的伤害。每次冲击造成的伤害将由被直接击中的玩家均摊。
• 商人盖博的[爆炸惊喜]会触发[冲击波]，可以使用来自[蘑菇投掷]的蘑菇来躲避。

sections.description_en:
•  [Blink Nova] inflicts high damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Iku's target receive less damage.
•  [Icebound Flames] inflicts high damage to a player if Scrollsage Iku is not interrupted, but the lingering effects can be dispelled.
•  [Splinters] inflicts damage over time to any players who stomp on crates thrown by Trader Gebbo.
sections.description_zh:
• [闪现新星]会对所有玩家造成高额伤害。距离书卷贤者伊库的目标越远的玩家受到的伤害越低。
• 如果书卷贤者伊库未被打断，[冰封烈焰]将对玩家造成极高的伤害，但残留的效果可以被驱散。
• [炉渣]会对任何踩踏商人盖博扔出的板条箱的玩家持续造成伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Shredding Shards] from Scrollsage Iku inflicts high magic damage and vulnerability to this effect to the current target.
•  First Mate Nama's attacks against his current target gain increasing Physical damage from [Steady Strikes].
•  First Mate Nama grants [United Defense] to the tortollan explorers when Scrollsage Iku and Trader Gebbo are both near him.
sections.description_zh:
• 书卷贤者伊库的[撕裂碎片]会对当前目标造成高额魔法伤害并施加对该效果的易伤。
• 大副纳玛的每一次攻击都会通过[稳固打击]对其当前目标造成越来越高的物理伤害。
• 当书卷贤者伊库和商人盖博都靠近大副纳玛时，大副纳玛会为始祖龟探险者提供[联合防御]。

sections.description_en: A fish found within one of Trader Gebbo's boxes. Tossing it to a possessed tortollan interrupts Mor'zahi and causes him to repossess them with Mor'zahi's Command.
sections.description_zh: 在商人盖博的板条箱里找到的一条鱼。将其扔给被附身的始祖龟会打断莫尔扎希，并迫使他用莫尔扎希的命令重新附身他们。

sections.description_en: Jumping on a Bouncy Mushroom will bounce a player high into the air but will perturb the mushroom, triggering Fungal Burst soon after.
sections.description_zh: 跳到弹跳蘑菇上会将玩家高高弹入空中，但这会扰动蘑菇，在不久后触发真菌爆炸。

bosses.description_en: A horrifying creature, warped by Ula'tek's toxic venom, Sszorak is a brutal instrument of vengeance. Calling upon the winds that howl deep within Atal'Utek, it tears apart any living creature it encounters.
bosses.description_zh: 斯索拉克因乌拉特克的剧毒而发生扭曲，化身成为一头可怕的野兽与残忍的复仇工具。它能够召唤在阿塔乌特克深处呼啸的狂风，将遭遇的一切活物撕成碎片。

sections.description_en: Sszorak relentlessly assaults players with [Apex Predator] combination attacks and noxious [Venomous Surge] globs. The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes [Raging Crosswinds] and eventually builds to a massive [Howling Maelstrom] that pushes players around the arena.
sections.description_zh: 斯索拉克无情地用[顶级捕食者]连击和有毒的[剧毒涌动]水团攻击玩家。六风祭坛会释放出[狂怒侧风]，并最终形成一个巨大的[呼啸旋涡]，将玩家在场地中推来推去。

sections.description_en:
• [Venomous Surge] inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
• [Raging Crosswinds] inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.
• [Dig In] increases Sszorak's damage taken during [Howling Maelstrom].
sections.description_zh:
• [剧毒涌动]会造成全团伤害。距离受影响玩家越远的玩家受到的伤害越低。
• [狂怒侧风]会随着时间的推移造成伤害，然后将受影响的玩家击退到指定方向。
• [掘地固守]会使斯索拉克在[呼啸旋涡]期间受到的伤害提高。

sections.description_en:
• [Venomous Surge] inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
• [Raging Crosswinds] inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.
• When the winds in the Altar of Six Winds build to a [Howling Maelstrom], players are pushed in the wind's direction.
sections.description_zh:
• [剧毒涌动]会造成全团伤害。距离受影响玩家越远的玩家受到的伤害越低。
• [狂怒侧风]会随着时间的推移造成伤害，然后将受影响的玩家击退到指定方向。
• 当六风祭坛中的风势聚集成为[呼啸旋涡]时，玩家将被推向风的方向。

sections.description_en:
• During [Apex Predator], Sszorak casts a combination of [Ravage] and [Mutilate].
• [Corroding Venom] increases Physical damage taken. This effect stacks.
• When the winds in the Altar of Six Winds build to a [Howling Maelstrom], players are pushed in the wind's direction.
sections.description_zh:
• 在[顶级捕食者]期间，斯索拉克会交替施放[毁灭]与[毁伤]。
• [侵蚀毒液]会使受到的物理伤害提高。该效果可叠加。
• 当六风祭坛中的风势聚集成为[呼啸旋涡]时，玩家将被推向风的方向。

bosses.description_en: The first of Ula'tek's blood, Vexhul and Ithraz brood beneath a roiling sea of venom deep within the vault of Atal'Utek. Any foolish enough to enter the prison's inner chamber risk their monstrous jaws and toxic strikes.
bosses.description_zh: 维克苏尔与伊斯拉兹作为乌拉特克的初代子嗣，正潜伏在阿塔乌特克秘窟深处那翻滚的毒海之下。任何胆敢踏入这座监牢内室的蠢货，都将面临它们骇人的巨颚与猛烈的毒击。

sections.description_en:
The Twin Fangs' [Eternal Venom] accumulates throughout the battle. Vexhul funnels toxin into her target with [Caustic Deluge] forming [Caustic Globules] and calls her progeny with [Venomous Emergence]. Ithraz consumes players with [Ravenous Feast] and strikes repeatedly with [Stone Breaker].

At 100 energy, both serpents submerge and reposition before attacking together. Vexhul releases a [Vile Flood] while Ithraz spews globs of gore during [Sanguine Storm].
sections.description_zh:
双子毒牙的[永恒毒液]会在整场战斗中不断积聚。维克苏尔以[腐蚀洪流]向目标倾泻毒素，形成[腐蚀液滴]，并通过[剧毒涌现]唤出子嗣。伊斯拉兹以[贪婪盛宴]吞噬玩家，并以[碎石击]反复打击。

能量达到100点时，两条巨蛇都会潜入水下并重新就位，随后一同发动攻击。维克苏尔释放[邪恶洪流]，同时伊斯拉兹在[血色风暴]期间喷吐血块。

sections.description_en:
• [Caustic Deluge] ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with [Eternal Venom] when touched.


• [Venomous Emergence] summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with [Corrosive Spit].
sections.description_zh:
• [腐蚀洪流]会喷射出一波液滴，触碰后会使玩家感染[永恒毒液]。


• [剧毒涌现]会召唤维克苏尔之嗣，它们会不断以[腐蚀唾液]攻击玩家。

sections.description_en:
• [Caustic Deluge] ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with [Eternal Venom] when touched.


• [Venomous Emergence] summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with [Corrosive Spit].
sections.description_zh:
• [腐蚀洪流]会喷射出一波液滴，触碰后会使玩家感染[永恒毒液]。


• [剧毒涌现]会召唤维克苏尔之嗣，它们会不断以[腐蚀唾液]攻击玩家。

sections.description_en:
• [Caustic Globules] form near the [Caustic Deluge] target.


• If [Stone Breaker] strikes no players, it instead strikes all players.
sections.description_zh:
• [腐蚀液滴]会在[腐蚀洪流]目标附近形成。


• 如果[碎石击]没有击中任何玩家，便会转而击中所有玩家。

bosses.description_en: The spirit of Malacrass will not release his grip on Zul'jan so easily. At the Coiled Altar, the shaman commands the warrior to enact the final ritual to unleash Ula'tek on the Amani--for revenge, and to gain their promised reward.
bosses.description_zh: 玛拉卡斯的精魂可不会轻易放过祖尔加。在盘卷祭坛上，这位萨满祭司向战士下达了执行最终仪式的命令，意图将乌拉特克释放到阿曼尼部族之中——这既是为了复仇，也是为了获取他们梦寐以求的奖赏。

sections.description_en:
A mutated Zul'jan unleashes his new power by [Coalescing Venom] within The Coiled Altar. He wields twin axes that [Sever] players and destroy Coalesced Venom.

Upon Zul'jan's defeat, Malacrass joins the fray. Malacrass haunts players with [Dreadmarch], creating Manifestations of Dread as it resolves. His casts of [Soul Sever] hurt players and destroy any Manifestations of Dread in its blast.

Upon defeat, Malacrass begins a ritual of [Soulbinding] to revive Zul'jan as his puppet, and claim what is rightfully his.
sections.description_zh:
发生变异的祖尔加在盘卷祭坛内通过[凝结毒液]释放新的力量。他挥舞双斧[撕裂]玩家，并摧毁凝结的毒液。

祖尔加倒下后，玛拉卡斯加入战斗。他以[恐惧行军]纠缠玩家，效果结束时会生成恐惧具象。他的[灵魂撕裂]会伤害玩家，并摧毁爆炸范围内的恐惧具象。

玛拉卡斯倒下后，会开始[灵魂绑定]仪式，将祖尔加复活为自己的傀儡，夺回本应属于他的一切。

sections.description_en:
•  [Toxic Deluge] creates [Coalesced Venom] around the arena.
•  Freeing players possessed by [Dreadmarch] creates [Manifestations of Dread] that fixate on a random player.
•  [Eternal Nightfall] inflicts deadly damage unless [Veil of Twilight] is broken.
sections.description_zh:
• [剧毒洪流]会在场地周围生成[凝结的毒液]。
• 解救被[恐惧行军]附身的玩家时，会催生出[恐惧具象]，它们会死死锁定一名玩家直到被摧毁为止。
• 如果未能打破[暮光之帷]，[永恒夜幕]将会对全团造成极其致命的伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Fangs of the Coiled Altar] and [Defilement of the Coiled Altar] inflicts massive damage and healing absorbs to all players.
•  [Coalesced Venom] explode into a [Venom Rupture] when destroyed.
•  [Venomfang] and [Gloombomb] inflict heavy damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [盘卷祭坛之牙]和[盘卷祭坛亵渎]会对所有玩家造成巨额伤害，并附带高额的治疗吸收效果。
• 被摧毁的[凝结的毒液]会直接爆炸，引发一次[毒液爆裂]。
• [毒牙]和[幽暗炸弹]会造成巨大伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Sever] inflicts a massive amount of damage, destroying [Coalesced Venom].
•  [Soul Sever] afflicts players hit with [Gravebound] and destroys [Manifestations of Dread].
•  [Corrupted Toxin] inflicts stacking moderate damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [撕裂]会造成巨额伤害，同时摧毁[凝结的毒液]。
• [灵魂撕裂]会使被命中的玩家受到[墓缚]的影响，并消灭在场的[恐惧具象]。
• [腐化毒素]会造成不断叠加的中等伤害。

bosses.description_en: The great shame of the Amani empire. The vast complex of Altal'Utek was created to imprison the weapon that proved to be as much of a threat as the enemy she was intended to destroy. Ula'tek has risen from her ancient slumber and threatens all of Azeroth if she should escape.
bosses.description_zh: 这是阿曼尼帝国的奇耻大辱。庞大的阿塔乌特克建筑群，起初只是为了囚禁这件武器而建造的——但事实证明，她与她原本要消灭的敌人一样极具威胁。如今，乌拉特克已经从远古的沉睡中苏醒，一旦让她逃脱，整个艾泽拉斯都将面临灭顶之灾。

sections.description_en:
Ula'tek splashes venom across her platform with [Caustic Waves]. Any Blightscale Spawn that touch her venom hatches and covers players in a [Putrid Membrane]. While her slithering children continue to spawn, Ula'tek uses her [Spectral Coils] to shatter the space.

After Ula'tek rails against her prison with [Rage of the Shackled] she summons her faithful then dives beneath the venom to gather her strength. Ula'tek's Doomscale Wardens move between the Blightscale Spawn imbuing them with [Writhing Gestation] as the Doomscale Eggs begin to hatch.

With her progeny broken, Ula'tek shatters the arena. She continues to use [Call of the Serpent] to gather her forces while destroying the only safe spaces remaining with [Circling Prey].
sections.description_zh:
乌拉特克使用[腐蚀浪潮]在平台上泼洒毒液。任何触碰毒液的疫鳞子嗣都会孵化，并给玩家覆盖上一层[腐臭薄膜]。当她的蛇裔不断涌现时，乌拉特克会利用[幽魂盘卷]粉碎空间。

乌拉特克用[被缚之怒]猛击牢笼后，会召唤信徒并潜入毒液深处积蓄力量。随着厄鳞之卵开始孵化，厄鳞守卫在疫鳞子嗣间穿行，为它们注入[蠕动孕育]。

随着子嗣被尽数消灭，乌拉特克将彻底震碎整个竞技场。她会继续施放[毒蛇呼唤]集结部队，同时施展[盘绕猎物]，摧毁仅存的安全区域。

sections.description_en:
•  Blightscale Spawn hatch a Blightscale Viper when they connect with venom.
•  A [Blightscale Clutch] grows in power unless destroyed.
•  Doomscale Wardens use [Writhing Gestation] on nearby Blightscale Spawn.
sections.description_zh:
• 疫鳞子嗣在接触毒液后会孵化成疫鳞蝰蛇。
• 如果不被摧毁，[疫鳞卵簇]的力量会持续增长。
• 厄鳞守卫会对附近的疫鳞子嗣施放[蠕动孕育]。

sections.description_en:
•  Every Blightscale Viper hatched inflicts [Putrid Membrane] to all players.
•  [Spectral Coils] inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.
sections.description_zh:
• 每孵化一条疫鳞蝰蛇，都会对所有玩家施加[腐臭薄膜]。
• [幽魂盘卷]会对所有人造成伤害，冲击点范围内的玩家数量越多，该伤害就越低。

sections.description_en:
•  Ula'tek uses [Unchecked Rage] while not engaged in melee combat.
•  Ula'tek's Gore Rattle uses [Rattler Slam] while not engaged in melee combat. 
• [Mother's Wrath] inflicts damage to everyone while no one is in its area of effect.
sections.description_zh:
• 未处于近战状态时，乌拉特克会施放[无羁之怒]。
• 未处于近战状态时，乌拉特克的血腥响尾会施放[响尾猛击]。
• 当效果区域内没有玩家时，[蛇母之怒]会对所有人造成伤害。

sections.description_en: The endless spawn of Ula'tek. These eggs go through rapid gestation and hatch whenever they come into contact with the venom that fills Ula'tek's prison.
sections.description_zh: 无穷无尽的乌拉特克子嗣。这些蛇卵能进行极其快速的孕育，只要一接触到充满乌拉特克囚笼的毒液，就会立刻破壳而出。

sections.description_zh: 过早破壳的疫鳞幼体正艰难求生。

在史诗难度下，疫鳞子嗣会处于[硬化]状态，并会对捡起它们的玩家施放[剧毒之壳]。
