sections.description_zh:
过早破壳的疫鳞幼体正艰难求生。

在史诗难度下，疫鳞幼体会施放[沸腾毒液]，使其能够施放[酸液喷发]。

sections.description_en: Fully gestated, the Blightscale Viper is a lethal predator.
sections.description_zh: 完全发育成熟的疫鳞蝰蛇是极其致命的掠食者。

sections.description_en:
As Ula'tek destroys her prison, Blightscale Shriekers rip themselves from their eggs on the ceiling and begin to hunt.

On Mythic difficulty, Blightscale Shriekers cast [Boiling Venom].
sections.description_zh:
当乌拉特克摧毁牢笼时，疫鳞尖啸者会从天花板的卵中挣脱而出，开始猎杀玩家。

在史诗难度下，疫鳞尖啸者会施放[沸腾毒液]。

bosses.description_en: Nymrissa Wavecaller commands the restless sea itself, concealing her lair beneath shifting tides. Those who dare uncover her sanctuary find her murloc minions eager to answer their mistress' call.
bosses.description_zh: 尼姆瑞莎·唤波者掌控着躁动不安的海洋，将她的巢穴隐匿于变幻莫测的潮汐之下。那些胆敢侵入她圣所的人将会发现，她的鱼人仆从们正急切地响应着女主人的召唤。

sections.description_en: Nymrissa Wavecaller creates an [Alluring Bubble] within the grotto that lures nearby murlocs into her grasp. She then summons [Swirling Whirlpools] to break the bubble, empowering murlocs within.
sections.description_zh: 尼姆瑞莎·唤波者在石窟内制造一个[诱人水泡]，将附近的鱼人引诱到她的身边。随后，她会召唤[激荡漩涡]击破水泡，并强化其中的鱼人。

sections.description_en:
• [Water Jet] inflicts sustained damage to Nymrissa Wavecaller's current target, and removes icy patches of [Lingering Frost].
• [Alluring Bubble] attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.
sections.description_zh:
• [水流喷射]会对尼姆瑞莎·唤波者的当前目标造成持续伤害，并能够清除[残留冰霜]形成的冰霜地面。
• [诱人水泡]会吸引一大群泡鳍滩行者前赴后继地冲向这个巨大的气泡

sections.description_en:
• [Iceblade Flurry] inflicts sustained damage to Nymrissa Wavecaller's current target.
• [Alluring Bubble] attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.
sections.description_zh:
• [冰刃乱舞]会对尼姆瑞莎·唤波者的当前目标造成持续伤害。
• [诱人水泡]会吸引大批泡鳍滩行者冲向巨大的水泡。

sections.description_en:
• [Abyssal Rain] inflicts significant damage to all players.
• [Alluring Bubble] inflicts a large burst of damage to all players when it [Pops!]
sections.description_zh:
• [深渊之雨]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。
• [诱人水泡]在[破裂！]时会对所有玩家造成大量爆发伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Alluring Bubble] attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.
• Murlocs that enter a [Alluring Bubble] become empowered.
sections.description_zh:
• [诱人水泡]会吸引一大群泡鳍滩行者前赴后继地冲向这个巨大的气泡。
• 一旦鱼人钻进[诱人水泡]，它们就会获得强化。

sections.description_en: Murlocs heed the call of the bubble and swarm toward it.
sections.description_zh: 鱼人响应了水泡的呼唤，正在蜂拥而至。

sections.description_en: Murlocs that enter the bubble transform into Bubblefin Berserkers.
sections.description_zh: 进入水泡的鱼人会变身为泡鳍狂战士。

sections.description_en: Murlocs heed the call of the bubble and swarm toward it.
sections.description_zh: 鱼人响应了水泡的呼唤，正蜂拥而至。

sections.description_en: A deepwater murloc that protects nearby allies.
sections.description_zh: 一种会保护附近盟友的深海鱼人。

sections.description_en: Murlocs that enter the bubble transform into Bubblefin Berserkers.
sections.description_zh: 进入水泡的鱼人会变身为泡鳍狂战士。

dungeons.description_en: Upon the Altar of Fangs, the ancient Amani sealed the vaults of Atal'Utek with the Fang of Ula'tek. Only that cursed dagger has the power to unseal the prison of the great weapon of the Amani. Aid Orweyna and Liadrin in their pursuit of Zul'jan, who has entered this accursed place in a misbegotten attempt to bring lost glory back to the Amani.
dungeons.description_zh: 在毒牙祭坛之上，远古的阿曼尼用乌拉特克之牙封印了阿塔乌特克地窟。唯有那柄受诅的匕首，才拥有解开封印、释放阿曼尼武器监牢的力量。协助奥威娜和莉亚德琳追捕祖尔加，他已步入这片受诅之地，企图以此妄举为阿曼尼夺回失落的荣光。

bosses.description_en: This ravenous hydra has survived this cursed place through scavenging the meat of the fallen. That doesn't mean it is not a fearsome combatant, eager to add some fresh temple explorers to its otherwise rotting diet.
bosses.description_zh: 这只贪婪的多头蛇通过吞食死者的尸肉，在这个受诅之地存活至今。但这并不意味着它不是一个可怕的对手。相反，它正渴望为自己那早已腐坏的食谱，再添上几名鲜活的神殿探险者。

sections.description_en:
Rav'i's domain is littered with Carrion Piles from the many sacrificed creatures thrown into the pit. Occasionally, Rav'i makes a [Ravenous Stomp], dropping [Fresh Meat].

Upon running out of energy, Rav'i begins [Ssscavenging] from the nearest Carrion Pile. If the Carrion Pile contains [Fresh Meat], Rav'i goes into a [Feeding Frenzy].
sections.description_zh:
拉维的领地里堆满了腐肉，这些都是被扔进深坑作为祭品的生物残骸。拉维偶尔会发动[贪婪践踏]，掉落[鲜肉]。

在能量耗尽时，拉维会开始从最近的腐肉堆处进行[嘶嘶食腐]。如果腐肉堆中含有[鲜肉]，拉维就会进入[进食狂热]状态。

sections.description_en:
•  [Ravenous Stomp] drops [Fresh Meat] on some Carrion Piles.
•  Carrion Piles with [Fresh Meat] cause Rav'i to go into a [Feeding Frenzy].
•  Rav'i inflicts melee damage with [Hydrastrike].
sections.description_zh:
• [贪婪践踏]会在部分腐肉堆上掉落[鲜肉]。
• 含有[鲜肉]的腐肉堆会使拉维进入[进食狂热]状态。
• 拉维会使用[多头蛇打击]造成近战伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  Rav'i stops [Ssscavenging] or her [Feeding Frenzy] when her absorb shield is removed.
•  [Ssscavenging] and [Feeding Frenzy] both continuously apply [Carrion Burst] to all players until stopped.
•  [Regurgitate] hurls waves of acid in a player's direction.
sections.description_zh:
• 当其吸收护盾被打破时，拉维就会停止[嘶嘶食腐]或[进食狂热]。
• [嘶嘶食腐]和[进食狂热]在被阻止前都会对所有玩家持续施加[腐肉喷发]。
• [反刍]会向玩家的方向喷吐出酸液洪流。

sections.description_en:
•  [Triple Shot] inflicts damage around 3 players over time.
•  While Rav'i is eating, she afflicts all players with increasing applications of [Carrion Burst] and is a [Messy Eater].
•  [Regurgitate] hurls waves of acid in a player's direction.
sections.description_zh:
• [三重喷吐]会在3名玩家周围持续造成伤害。
• 在拉维进食期间，她会为所有玩家施加层数不断提高的[腐肉喷发]，并且变得[狼吞虎咽]。
• [反刍]会向玩家的方向倾泻酸液浪潮。

bosses.description_en: In the feeding frenzy upon each other, there has been one Child of Ula'tek that has proved victorious over the rest of the brood. With every battle won, the twisting monstrosity known as the Writhing Coil only grows stronger.
bosses.description_zh: 在同类相食的疯狂厮杀中，有一只乌拉特克之嗣战胜了同巢的其他幼蛇。随着一次次战胜对手，这只被称为扭缠盘蛇的扭曲巨怪只会变得愈发强大。

sections.description_en:
The Writhing Coil assaults its enemies relentlessly with [Vindictive Onslaught] and its razor sharp [Tail Scythe].

When the beast prepares to unleash [Death Rattle], Orweyna empowers players with [Vine Grip] to [Uncoil] the creature and clash with the serpents one by one.
sections.description_zh:
扭缠盘蛇会使用[复仇猛攻]和锋利如刃的[镰尾]无情地攻击敌人。

当这头猛兽准备释放[濒死喘息]时，奥威娜会用[藤蔓之握]来强化玩家，以使该生物[解除盘卷]，并与这些毒蛇逐一交战。

sections.description_en:
•  [Tail Scythe] inflicts heavy Physical damage.
•  Interrupting [Death Rattle] with [Vine Grip] causes the creature to [Uncoil].
sections.description_zh:
• [镰尾]会造成极高的物理伤害。
• 使用[藤蔓之握]打断[濒死喘息]，会使该生物[解除盘卷]。

sections.description_en:
•  Interrupting [Death Rattle] with [Vine Grip] causes the creature to [Uncoil].
•  Damage inflicted while the Writhing Coil is [Uncoiled] persists after [Assimilation].
•  [Toxic Atrophy] reduces all players' speed and damage done.
sections.description_zh:
• 使用[藤蔓之握]打断[濒死喘息]，会使该生物[解除盘卷]。
• 扭缠盘蛇在被[解除盘卷]期间受到的伤害，在其完成[同化]后仍会保留。
• [剧毒萎缩]会降低所有玩家的移动速度和造成的伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Death Rattle] inflicts increasing damage to all players.
•  Interrupting [Death Rattle] with [Vine Grip] causes the creature to [Uncoil].
sections.description_zh:
• [濒死喘息]会对所有玩家造成越来越高的伤害。
• 使用[藤蔓之握]打断[濒死喘息]，会使该生物[解除盘卷]。

bosses.description_en: With the Fang of Ula'tek, Zul'jan performs the final ritual to gain the power to release the monstrous weapon his ancestors sealed away thousands of years ago. Still held in the sway of the spirit of Malacrass, Zul'jan is unaware that the Fang is also the only hope for his sister Zul'jarra's survival.
bosses.description_zh: 祖尔加手持乌拉特克之牙，正在举行最后的仪式，以获取释放那件被其先祖封印于数千年前的凶兽兵器的力量。尽管仍受玛拉卡斯精魂的摆布，祖尔加并不知道，这柄毒牙也是他姐姐祖尔加拉生还的唯一希望。

sections.description_en:
During [Ritual of the Fang], Zul'jan invokes the altar's ancient venoms to empower the dagger.

Zul'jan then hacks, slashes, and chops down his enemies as the sacred grounds stain crimson with [Bloodletting].
sections.description_zh:
在[毒牙仪式]期间，祖尔加会唤起祭坛的远古毒液来强化匕首。

随后，祖尔加对敌人进行疯狂的砍杀，对其[放血]，在神圣的土地上溅起猩红的血迹。

sections.description_en:
• [Chop Down] inflicts heavy Physical damage.
• [Ritual of the Fang] inflicts damage to all players unless intercepted.
• [Bloodletting] removes [Ritual Venom].
sections.description_zh:
• [砍倒]会造成大量物理伤害。
• [毒牙仪式]会对所有玩家造成伤害，除非有人拦截。
• [放血]会移除[仪式毒液]。

sections.description_en:
• [Ritual of the Fang] inflicts damage to all players unless intercepted.
• [Bloodletting] removes [Ritual Venom].
• [Axegrinder] and [Boneslicer] inflict Physical damage to players struck.
sections.description_zh:
• [毒牙仪式]会对所有玩家造成伤害，除非有人拦截。
• [放血]会移除[仪式毒液]。
• [碎斧]和[切骨者]会对被击中的玩家造成物理伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Axegrinder] and [Boneslicer] inflict Physical damage to players struck.
• [Ritual of the Fang] inflicts damage to all players unless intercepted.
• [Bloodletting] removes [Ritual Venom].
sections.description_zh:
• [碎斧]和[切骨者]会对被击中的玩家造成物理伤害。
• [毒牙仪式]会对所有玩家造成伤害，除非有人拦截。
• [放血]会移除[仪式毒液]。

dungeons.description_en: Wounded by Zul'jin and Malacrass, Nalorakk turned his back on the Amani, slumbering in his den to ease his pain. Now, the Amani seek to heal the rift between their tribe and the loa. But, to gain Nalorakk's favor, those who come before him must complete his trials. Assist Zul'jarra as she journeys into the mind of the Loa of War to defeat him and gain his blessing.
dungeons.description_zh: 祖尔金和玛拉卡斯的背叛令纳洛拉克遍体鳞伤。他回到了巢穴，在沉睡中缓解痛苦，对阿曼尼巨魔置若罔闻。现在，阿曼尼希望弥合部族与神灵间的嫌隙。然而，要想博得纳洛拉克的垂青，请愿之人就必须完成他的试炼。协助祖尔加拉闯入战争之神的心灵，击败神灵并赢取他的祝福。

bosses.description_en: Driven by voracious greed, the gluttonous Hoardmonger fiercely defends the stashes of food and supplies he has stolen from nearby troll tribes. Nalorakk's first trial is to eliminate him before the tribes go hungry.
bosses.description_zh: 贪得无厌的囤宝狂人受贪婪驱使，疯狂守护着他从附近巨魔部族偷来的食物和补给储备。纳洛拉克的第一个试炼就是在他让部族挨饿之前消灭他。

sections.description_en:
The Hoardmonger prevents his reserves from being pilfered at all costs, casting [Resourceful Measures] upon reaching 90%, 70%, and 40% health, empowering one of his abilities.

Upon reaching 100 energy, he tosses [Spoiled Supplies] throughout the arena, growing Rotten Mushrooms for 12 seconds. Upon contact, these apply [Toxic Spores] destroying the fungi, preventing [Putrid Burst].
sections.description_zh:
囤宝狂人会不惜一切代价保护自己的物资。当生命值降至90%、70%和40%时，他会施放[资源巧用]来强化自身的一项技能。

当能量达到100点时，他会向场上投掷[腐坏补给]，并长出持续12秒的腐烂的蘑菇。玩家接触蘑菇会感染[剧毒孢子]并将其摧毁，从而阻止[腐烂爆发]。

sections.description_en:
•  Rotten Mushrooms apply [Toxic Spores] upon contact, preventing them from detonating in a [Putrid Burst].
•  [Earthshatter Slam] and [Bonespike Slam] inflict massive damage in a frontal cone.
•  [Ravenous Bellow] and [Hearty Bellow] inflicts high damage to all players.
sections.description_zh:
• 接触腐烂的蘑菇会施加[剧毒孢子]，阻止其引发[腐烂爆发]。
• [裂地强击]和[骨刺猛击]对前方锥形区域造成巨量伤害。
• [贪婪咆哮]和[饕餮怒吼]对所有玩家造成高额伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Ravenous Bellow] and [Hearty Bellow] inflict high damage to all players.
•  Rotten Mushrooms' [Toxic Spores] can be removed by Poison-cleansing effects.
•  [Earthshatter Slam] and [Bonespike Slam] inflict massive damage in a frontal cone.
sections.description_zh:
• [贪婪咆哮]和[饕餮怒吼]对所有玩家造成高额伤害。
• 腐烂的蘑菇的[剧毒孢子]可通过驱散中毒效果移除。
• [裂地强击]和[骨刺猛击]对前方锥形区域造成巨量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  The Hoardmonger gathers from the nearest resource pile during [Resourceful Measures].
•  Rotten Mushrooms apply [Toxic Spores] upon contact, preventing them from detonating in a [Putrid Burst].
•  [Ravenous Bellow] and [Hearty Bellow] inflict high damage to all players.
sections.description_zh:
• 囤宝狂人在施放[资源巧用]期间会从最近的资源堆中收集资源。
• 接触腐烂的蘑菇会施加[剧毒孢子]，阻止其引发[腐烂爆发]。
• [贪婪咆哮]和[饕餮怒吼]对所有玩家造成高额伤害。

sections.description_en:
This fungi grows for 12 seconds then detonates in a Putrid Burst, covering all players in Toxic Spores.

Upon contact, the spores transfer, applying Toxic Spores and destroying the fungi.
sections.description_zh:
这种真菌生长12秒后会因腐烂爆发而爆炸，让所有玩家沾染剧毒孢子。

接触后，孢子会转移并施加剧毒孢子，同时摧毁真菌。

bosses.description_en: The seasons can be kind or cruel. Sentinel of Winter unleashes the harshest of winter storms to test all who face him. To surpass Nalorakk's second trial, endure the biting cold and defeat the embodiment of a winter storm.
bosses.description_zh: 季节既仁慈又残酷。寒冬哨兵释放出最凛冽的寒冬风暴，以此考验所有面对他的挑战者。要通过纳洛拉克的第二个试炼，就必须忍受刺骨的寒冷，击败这寒冬风暴的化身。

sections.description_en:
The Sentinel of Winter harnesses the power of the surrounding blizzard. This forms [Raging Squalls] which wander the landscape, and Fractured Shivercores which cast [Winter's Shroud] until defeated.

[Frozen Tempest] creates a massive storm that pulses Frost damage to all players and continously pushes them back.
sections.description_zh:
寒冬哨兵驾驭着周围暴雪的力量，形成在场地上四处游荡的[狂怒的飑风]；并召唤出碎裂的震颤核心，它们会持续施放[寒冬帷幕]，直到被击败。

[寒冰暴雨]会制造出一场巨大的风暴，周期性地对所有玩家造成冰霜伤害，并不断将其击退。

sections.description_en:
• [Frozen Tempest] inflicts heavy damage and pushes players back.
• [Raging Squalls] wander the landscape and inflict moderate damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [寒冰暴雨]会造成大量伤害并击退玩家。
• [狂怒的飑风]会在地面上游荡并造成中等伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Frozen Tempest] inflicts heavy damage and pushes players back.
• [Glacial Torment] inflicts a large amount of damage, but can be removed by Magic-cleansing effects.
sections.description_zh:
• [寒冰暴雨]会造成大量伤害并击退玩家。
• [冰川折磨]造成大量伤害，但可被驱散魔法效果移除。

sections.description_en:
• [Frozen Tempest] inflicts heavy damage and pushes players back.
• [Raging Squalls] wander the landscape and inflict moderate damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [寒冰暴雨]会造成大量伤害并击退玩家。
• [狂怒的飑风]会在地面上游荡并造成中等伤害。

bosses.description_en: Slumbering in his fitful and battle-filled dream, Nalorakk, the Loa of War, will only test the mettle of the worthy. Survive his trial and receive his blessing or die trying.
bosses.description_zh: 战争之神纳洛拉克在充满战斗的断续梦境中沉睡，他只会考验强者的勇气。在试炼中幸存下来并获得他的赐福，或者在此过程中殒命。

sections.description_en:
The Loa of War spares no mortal as the final trial, assailing players with [Echoing Maul] and pushing them with [Forceful Roar].

At 100 energy, Nalorakk casts [Fury of the War God], slamming Zul'jarra across the arena and incapacitating her with [Concussive Shock]. Nalorakk commands Echoes of Nalorakk to charge the defenseless Zul'jarra, casting [Echoing Fury] when colliding with the first target they encounter.
sections.description_zh:
作为最终的试炼，战争之神不会放过任何凡人，他使用[回响重击]猛攻玩家，并用[强力咆哮]将其推开。

能量达到100时，纳洛拉克施放[战神之怒]，将祖尔加拉猛击至竞技场另一侧，并用[震荡冲击]使其瘫痪。纳洛拉克命令纳洛拉克的回响冲向毫无防备的祖尔加拉，并在撞上遇到的第一个目标时施放[回响狂怒]。

sections.description_en:
•  [Fury of the War God] sends Echoes of Nalorakk to attack Zul'jarra, stopping only to cast [Echoing Fury] on the first target they encounter.
•  Each Echo of Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul] when Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul].
•  Nalorakk's [Forceful Roar] pushes all players away.
sections.description_zh:
• [战神之怒]派出纳洛拉克的回响攻击祖尔加拉，它们只会在对遇到的第一个目标施放[回响狂怒]后停下。
• 当纳洛拉克施放[回响重击]时，每个纳洛拉克的回响也会施放[回响重击]。
• 纳洛拉克的[强力咆哮]会击退所有玩家。

sections.description_en:
•  [Overwhelming Onslaught] inflicts significant damage even while protected from Zul'jarra's [Defensive Stance].
•  Each Echo of Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul] when Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul].
•  Nalorakk's [Forceful Roar] pushes all players away.
sections.description_zh:
• [压制强攻]会造成大量伤害，即使在祖尔加拉[防御姿态]的保护下也是如此。
• 当纳洛拉克施放[回响重击]时，每个纳洛拉克的回响也会施放[回响重击]。
• 纳洛拉克的[强力咆哮]会击退所有玩家。

sections.description_en:
•  Zul'jarra's [Defensive Stance] greatly reduces Nalorakk's [Overwhelming Onslaught].
•  [Fury of the War God] sends Echoes of Nalorakk to attack Zul'jarra, stopping only to cast [Echoing Fury] on the first target they encounter.
•  Each Echo of Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul] when Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul].
sections.description_zh:
• 祖尔加拉的[防御姿态]大幅降低纳洛拉克的[压制强攻]伤害。
• [战神之怒]派出纳洛拉克的回响攻击祖尔加拉，它们只会在对遇到的第一个目标施放[回响狂怒]后停下。
• 当纳洛拉克施放[回响重击]时，每个纳洛拉克的回响也会施放[回响重击]。

dungeons.description_en:
Few places in Zandalar are more sacred than Kings' Rest. Every king, conqueror, or tyrant who has held control of the Zandalari empire is housed within this great city of the dead to protect and honor not only their bodies, but also their spirits.

Entry has historically been restricted solely to the Zandalari priesthood and royalty, but as Zul's dark magic winds its way through the tomb you must venture inside and put an end to the darkness that has found purchase there.
dungeons.description_zh:
诸王之眠是全赞达拉最为神圣的地方。所有统治过赞达拉帝国的君王、征服者或者暴君都在这座宏伟的亡者之城安息，他们的肉体和灵魂在这里得到保护，受到祭拜。

一直以来，这里只有赞达拉祭司和皇室才能进入，但如今，祖尔的黑暗魔法正在墓室间穿梭。你必须深入其中，阻止酝酿中的黑暗。

bosses.description_en: Kings' Rest has come under attack before. After a foolish troll tried to summon Hakkar the Soulflayer to this island many millennia ago, the priests of Zandalar created a mighty construct to defend this tomb. The Golden Serpent has stood against intruders ever since, judging who is worthy to enter these sacred halls.
bosses.description_zh: 诸王之眠曾久经战火。自从数万年前，一位愚蠢的巨魔试图将夺灵者哈卡唤回这片土地，赞达拉的祭司们就创造了一个强大的生物来保卫这座神庙。自此之后，黄金风蛇就在这里抵挡入侵者，考验他们是否有进入这些神圣殿堂的资格。

sections.description_en: The Golden Serpent spits gold at party members, who then leave it behind in the form of [Molten Gold]. The Golden Serpent later animates these pools with [Lucre's Call]. Any Animated Gold that reaches The Golden Serpent is absorbed, granting a stack of [Luster] that shields the Serpent and increases its damage.
sections.description_zh: 黄金风蛇会朝队伍成员喷吐黄金，随后化作[熔化的黄金]留在他们身后。黄金风蛇稍后会使用[卢彻的召唤]赋予这些水池生命。任何抵达黄金风蛇处的活性黄金都会被其吸收，获得一层[金光闪闪]，为毒蛇提供护盾并提高其伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Tail Thrash] inflicts Physical damage to the current target player.
• Each stack of [Luster] shields The Golden Serpent and increases its damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [甩尾]会对当前目标玩家造成物理伤害。
• 每一层[金光闪闪]都会为黄金风蛇提供护盾，并提高其伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Spit Gold] inflicts Fire damage over time to the afflicted player and leaves a pool of [Molten Gold] at their location.
• [Serpentine Gust] inflicts damage to all  players.
sections.description_zh:
• [吐金]会对受影响的玩家持续造成火焰伤害，并在其位置留下一滩[熔化的黄金]。
• [蛇之风]会对所有玩家造成伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Lucre's Call] turns all pools of [Molten Gold] into Animated Gold, which move toward The Golden Serpent.
• [Spit Gold] inflicts Fire damage over time to the afflicted player and leaves a pool of [Molten Gold] at their location.
sections.description_zh:
• [卢彻的召唤]会将所有[熔化的黄金]水池变成活性黄金，它们会向黄金风蛇移动。
• [吐金]会对受影响的玩家持续造成火焰伤害，并在其位置留下一滩[熔化的黄金]。

sections.description_en: Attempts to move towards The Golden Serpent. If any reach it, The Golden Serpent absorbs them and gains a stack of Luster. When any Animated Gold are killed, they return to pools of Molten Gold.
sections.description_zh: 会试图朝黄金风蛇移动。抵达后，黄金风蛇会将其吸收并获得一层金光闪闪。活性黄金被吸收后会回到熔化的黄金状态。

sections.description_en: Kings' Rest is not available in Normal Difficulty.
sections.description_zh: 诸王之眠不在普通难度下开放。

bosses.description_en: There was once a caste of Zandalari whose purpose was to preserve and defend the remains of past rulers. But when a terrible plague of corrupted blood tore through the empire, it was too risky for mortals to handle the dead. Golems were summoned for the grim work of preservation and burial; they have been used ever since.
bosses.description_zh: 赞达拉部族曾有专人殓葬并守护先王的遗骸。然而当可怕的腐血之疫席卷整个帝国时，凡人来照料亡者就变得危险重重。因此赞达拉部族召唤了魔像来进行这项恐怖的殓葬工作，这一传统也由此延续到了今天。

sections.description_en: Mchimba the Embalmer prepares his victims for mummification. [Drain Fluids] inflicts Nature damage over time on target player that ends in [Desiccation]. [Entomb] seals a player inside one of the chamber's crypts, after which Mchimba begins to [Open Coffin] on the remaining crypts one at a time, releasing a Finished Mummy from every unoccupied crypt.
sections.description_zh: 殓尸者姆沁巴会为他的受害者准备木乃伊化。[排干体液]会对目标玩家持续造成自然伤害，最终导致[干枯]。[埋葬]会将一名玩家封印在大厅的其中一个墓穴内，之后姆沁巴会开始对剩余的墓穴逐个施放[打开棺材]，从每一个未被占据的墓穴中释放出一个制成的木乃伊。

sections.description_en:
• [Entomb] seals the afflicted player inside one of the crypts.
• [Open Coffin] opens one of the crypts and summons a Finished Mummy.
sections.description_zh:
• [埋葬]会将受影响的玩家封印在其中一个墓穴内。
• [打开棺材]会打开其中一个墓穴，召唤一个制成的木乃伊。

sections.description_en:
• [Drain Fluids] inflicts Nature damage over time to the afflicted player. When the effect completes, it applies [Desiccation], reducing the afflicted player's damage done and movement speed until they are healed above 90% health.
• [Burn Corruption] inflicts Fire damage to target player and creates a patch of [Burning Ground].
• [Entomb] seals the afflicted player inside one of the crypts.
sections.description_zh:
• [排干体液]会对受影响的玩家持续造成自然伤害。当效果结束时，它会施加[干枯]，降低受影响玩家造成的伤害量和移动速度，直到其被治疗到90%以上的生命值。
• [燃烧腐蚀]会对目标玩家造成火焰伤害，并制造出一片[爆燃之地]。
• [埋葬]会将受影响的玩家封印在其中一个墓穴内。

sections.description_en:
• [Entomb] seals the afflicted player inside one of the crypts.
• [Drain Fluids] inflicts Nature damage over time to the afflicted player. When the effect completes, it applies [Desiccation], reducing the afflicted player's damage done and movement speed until they are healed above 90% health.
• [Burn Corruption] inflicts Fire damage to target player and creates a patch of [Burning Ground].
sections.description_zh:
• [埋葬]会将受影响的玩家封印在其中一个墓穴内。
• [排干体液]会对受影响的玩家持续造成自然伤害。当效果结束时，它会施加[干枯]，降低受影响玩家造成的伤害量和移动速度，直到其被治疗到90%以上的生命值。
• [燃烧腐蚀]会对目标玩家造成火焰伤害，并制造出一片[爆燃之地]。

sections.description_en: While trapped, players can struggle against the doors of the crypt, alerting other players to their presence.
sections.description_zh: 被困时，玩家可以通过挣扎来震动墓穴的门，让其他玩家知道自己的位置。

sections.description_en: When a coffin that does not contain a player is opened, a Finished Mummy will emerge and attack the party.
sections.description_zh: 当开启没有玩家的棺材时，会出现一只制成的木乃伊，攻击队伍成员。

sections.description_en: Kings' Rest is not available in Normal Difficulty.
sections.description_zh: 诸王之眠不在普通难度下开放。

bosses.description_en: There was once a time when no single emperor could rule Zandalar. After a period of civil war, the heads of three families formed an uneasy coalition and tried to rule the empire together. Though they did not often agree, there was peace in Zandalar. Briefly.
bosses.description_zh: 曾经没有一位帝王能一统赞达拉。经历了漫长的内战后，三大部族的首领建立了一个摇摇欲坠的联盟，以期共同执掌帝国。尽管他们时常政见不合，但赞达拉也一度迎来了短暂的和平。

sections.description_en:
The battle will begin with Kula the Butcher.

When a councilor is defeated, they will return to their urn and the next will join the encounter. However, the defeated councilor will periodically rejoin the battle to use a single ability, and then return to their urn.

When all three councilors are defeated, the encounter ends.
sections.description_zh:
屠夫库拉将开启战斗。

议员被击败时会回到自己的瓮中，下一名议员随即加入战斗。每隔一段时间，被击败的议员会重新入场并使用一个技能，之后再返回瓮中。

当三名议员均被击败时，战斗结束。

sections.description_en:
• [Debilitating Backhand] inflicts Physical damage to Aka'ali the Conqueror's current target player, knocks them back, and applies [Shattered Defenses], increasing the target's Physical damage taken.
• [Barrel Through] causes Aka'ali the Conqueror to charge a targeted player, inflicting heavy Physical damage that splits among all players hit.
sections.description_zh:
• [衰弱抽击]会对征服者阿卡阿里的当前目标玩家造成物理伤害，将其击退，并施加[粉碎防御]，提高目标受到的物理伤害。
• [翻滚]会使征服者阿卡阿里朝一名被锁定的玩家发动冲锋，造成沉重的物理伤害，由所有被击中的玩家均摊。

sections.description_en:
• [Barrel Through] causes Aka'ali the Conqueror to charge a targeted player, inflicting heavy Physical damage that splits among all players hit.
• [Severing Axe] inflicts Physical damage over time to random players.
sections.description_zh:
• [翻滚]会使征服者阿卡阿里朝一名被锁定的玩家发动冲锋，造成沉重的物理伤害，由所有被击中的玩家均摊。
• [斩首之斧]会对随机玩家持续造成物理伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Barrel Through] causes Aka'ali the Conqueror to charge a targeted player, inflicting heavy Physical damage that splits among all players hit.
• [Poison Nova] inflicts Nature damage over time to all players.
• [Call of the Elements] summons three elemental totems with powerful effects.
sections.description_zh:
• [翻滚]会使征服者阿卡阿里朝一名被锁定的玩家发动冲锋，造成沉重的物理伤害，由所有被击中的玩家均摊。
• [毒性新星]会对所有玩家持续造成自然伤害。
• [元素的召唤]会召唤出三个带有强大效果的元素图腾。

sections.description_en: Kings' Rest is not available in Normal Difficulty.
sections.description_zh: 诸王之眠不在普通难度下开放。

bosses.description_en:
Dazar. The founder and first King of Zandalar, who led an exodus of his people out of the muck and mire and built a city of gold. The first tamer of raptors. The warrior undefeated. The father of a kingdom.

His eternal repose cut short by Zul's dark magic, it lies to you to once again put him to rest.
bosses.description_zh:
达萨，赞达拉的建立者与第一位帝王。他带领自己的子民走出了泥潭，建立了黄金之城。他是初代迅猛龙骑手，所向披靡的战士，帝国之父。

祖尔的黑暗魔法将他从永恒的长眠中唤醒，现在让他再度安息的重任就落到你身上了。

sections.description_en:
Dominated by Zul's dark magic, Dazar returns from the dead with his overwhelming martial prowess intact. 

At 80% health, he mounts T'zala, his loyal steed.
sections.description_zh:
在祖尔黑暗魔法的支配下，达萨死而复生，且其无与伦比的武艺完好无损。

当生命值降至80%时，他会骑上忠诚的坐骑提扎拉。

sections.description_en:
• [Blade Combo] inflicts heavy damage to its target.
• T'zala's [Savage Maul] increases its target's Phyiscal damage taken.
sections.description_zh:
• [剑刃连击]会对目标造成巨额伤害。
• 提扎拉的[野蛮槌击]会使目标受到的物理伤害增加。

sections.description_en:
• [Gilded Destruction] inflicts Fire damage on all players.
• [Impaling Spear] periodically springs from the ceiling, inflicting heavy Phyical damage to players hit and causing them to bleed.
• T'zala's [Savage Maul] increases its target's Phyiscal damage taken.
sections.description_zh:
• [镀金毁灭]会对所有玩家造成火焰伤害。
• [穿刺之矛]会周期性地从天花板刺下，对命中的玩家造成巨额物理伤害并使其流血。
• 提扎拉的[野蛮槌击]会使目标受到的物理伤害增加。

sections.description_en:
• [Impaling Spear] periodically springs from the ceiling, inflicting heavy Phyical damage to players hit and causing them to bleed.
• King Dazar's [Aerial Smash] and T'zala's [Quaking Leap] inflict Physical damage to all players at their destinations.
sections.description_zh:
• [穿刺之矛]会周期性地从天花板刺下，对命中的玩家造成巨额物理伤害并使其流血。
• 达萨大王的[凌空猛击]与提扎拉的[震地之跃]会对落点处的所有玩家造成物理伤害。

sections.description_en: When Dazar reaches 80% health, he will mount T'zala.
sections.description_zh: 当达萨的生命值降至80%时，他将骑乘提扎拉。

sections.description_en: Kings' Rest is not available in Normal Difficulty.
sections.description_zh: 诸王之眠不在普通难度下开放。

dungeons.description_en: The darkened streets of Murder Row hide a secret fel-smuggling operation that has been preying on the fears of Silvermoon's citizens ever since the Voidstorm appeared.
dungeons.description_zh: 密谋小径的黑暗街道掩藏着一个秘密的邪能走私行动。自从虚影风暴出现以来，这个行动就一直在利用银月城居民的恐惧牟利。

bosses.description_en: Although an accomplished Magister, Kystia Manaheart was far too devoted to fel magic to give it up entirely. Little wonder she's become a staunch supporter and ally to underground fel smuggling operations in the Row.
bosses.description_zh: 虽然是个声名显赫的魔导师，凯斯媞亚·魔力之心为邪能魔法付出了太多，已经到了无法放弃的地步。她自然而然地成为了同谋，坚定地支持着密谋小径里见不得人的邪能走私活动。

sections.description_en: Kystia Manaheart is accompanied by her pet mana wyrm Nibbles, who is controlled by [Illicit Infusion]. When this infusion is removed, Nibbles breaks free of Kystia's control and reverts back to her light form to assist players in battle with [Light Infusion].
sections.description_zh: 凯斯媞亚·魔力之心由她的宠物：法力浮龙“咬咬”陪伴，其被凯斯媞亚的[非法灌注]所控制。当此灌注被移除后，咬咬会摆脱凯斯媞亚的控制，恢复其圣光形态，并使用[光明灌注]在战斗中协助玩家。

sections.description_en:
•  Kystia turns Nibbles hostile to players with [Illicit Infusion].
•  Avoid Nibbles' [Fel Spray].
•  Interrupt Kystia's [Mirror Images].
sections.description_zh:
• 凯斯媞亚通过[非法灌注]使咬咬对玩家怀有敌意。
• 躲开咬咬的[邪能飞溅]。
• 打断凯斯媞亚的[镜像]。

sections.description_en:
•  Kystia turns Nibbles hostile to players with [Illicit Infusion].
•  Avoid Nibbles' [Fel Spray].
•  Kystia inflicts heavy damage to all players while [Destabilized].
sections.description_zh:
• 凯斯媞亚通过[非法灌注]使咬咬对玩家怀有敌意。
• 躲开咬咬的[邪能飞溅]。
• 凯斯媞亚在[不稳定]状态下会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  Kystia turns Nibbles hostile to players with [Illicit Infusion].
•  Avoid Nibbles' [Fel Spray].
•  Interrupt Kystia's [Mirror Images].
sections.description_zh:
• 凯斯媞亚通过[非法灌注]使咬咬对玩家怀有敌意。
• 躲开咬咬的[邪能飞溅]。
• 打断凯斯媞亚的[镜像]。

bosses.description_en: Clever, quick-witted and commanding, Zaen Bladesorrow oversees the shipments of illegal fel artifacts. Those under his command follow his orders to the letter... or pay the price.
bosses.description_zh: 聪明伶俐、头脑活络又自视甚高的赞恩·刃悲监督着非法邪能神器的运输过程。他手底下的人要么不折不扣地照办……要么付出惨痛的代价。

sections.description_en: Zaen Bladesorrow demonstrates how this town got its name by occassionally casting [Murder in a Row] at all players. Dodge his deadly aim by taking cover to avoid heavy damage.
sections.description_zh: 赞恩·刃悲偶尔会对所有玩家施放[绝命凶径]，以此展示这座城镇名字的由来。寻找掩护来躲避其致命的瞄准，以避免受到大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  At 100 energy, Zaen casts [Murder in a Row]. Get to cover!
•  Avoid damage from [Same-Day Delivery] and [Fire Bomb].
sections.description_zh:
• 能量达到100时，赞恩会施放[绝命凶径]。快找掩护！
• 躲开[当日送达]和[火焰炸弹]的伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  At 100 energy, Zaen casts [Murder in a Row]. Get to cover!
•  Avoid damage from [Same-Day Delivery] and [Fire Bomb].
sections.description_zh:
• 能量达到100时，赞恩会施放[绝命凶径]。快找掩护！
• 躲开[当日送达]和[火焰炸弹]的伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  At 100 energy, Zaen casts [Murder in a Row]. Get to cover!
•  Avoid damage from [Same-Day Delivery] and [Fire Bomb].
•  Zaen inflicts heavy damage to his current target with [Envenom].
sections.description_zh:
• 能量达到100时，赞恩会施放[绝命凶径]。快找掩护！
• 躲开[当日送达]和[火焰炸弹]的伤害。
• 赞恩通过[毒伤]对他当前的目标造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en: A shipment meant to be kept hidden from prying eyes. Provides an excellent source of cover.
sections.description_zh: 一批需要避人耳目的货物。可以作为绝佳的掩体。

bosses.description_en: Xathuux the Annihilator is one of Lithiel Cinderfury's most powerful summons. Although he loathes serving the warlock, he follows her commands for the sheer visceral joy of destruction.
bosses.description_zh: 歼灭者萨祖克斯是利希尔·烬怒最强大的召唤物之一。虽然对颐指气使的术士深恶痛绝，但为了享受破坏的快感，他还是会听从她的命令。

sections.description_en: Xathuux the Annihilator's rage increases until he erupts with [Demonic Rage] and gains [Burning Steps].
sections.description_zh: 歼灭者萨祖克斯的怒气会逐渐增加，直到他爆发出[魔化狂怒]并获得[燃烧脚步]。

sections.description_en:
• [Burning Steps] leaves damaging pools of fel magic on the ground for a long duration.

• [Axe Toss] targets a random player and applies [Fel Lightning] to all players until the axe is destroyed.
sections.description_zh:
• [燃烧脚步]会在地面上留下造成伤害的邪能魔法池，持续很长时间。

• [利斧投掷]会锁定一名随机玩家，并对所有玩家施加[魔能闪电]，直到利斧被摧毁。

sections.description_en:
• [Legion Strike] inflicts heavy Physical damage and reduces incoming healing.

• [Axe Toss] targets a random player and applies [Fel Lightning] to all players until the axe is destroyed.
sections.description_zh:
• [军团打击]会造成大量物理伤害并降低受到的治疗效果。

• [利斧投掷]会锁定一名随机玩家，并对所有玩家施加[魔能闪电]，直到利斧被摧毁。

sections.description_en:
• [Legion Strike] inflicts heavy Physical damage and reduces incoming healing.

• [Burning Steps] creates damaging pools of fel magic that expand from Xathuux the Annihilator's location and remain on the ground for a long duration.
sections.description_zh:
• [军团打击]会造成大量物理伤害，并降低受到的治疗效果。

• [燃烧脚步]会制造造成伤害的邪能魔法池，从歼灭者萨祖克斯的位置向外扩散，并在地面上保留很长时间。

bosses.description_en: Lithiel Cinderfury sees the Voidstorm above Silvermoon as both threat and opportunity. Her people are afraid, and she has a perfect solution... the power of fel. She claims her smuggling operation protects her people from the dangers above, but the profits she receives are a pleasing bonus.
bosses.description_zh: 利希尔·烬怒在银月城上空的虚影风暴中看到了威胁，也发现了机遇。她的族人胆战心惊，而她找到了完美的解决办法——邪能之力。她宣称自己的走私活动是为了让人民不被风暴所害，而她获得的利益只是个喜闻乐见的意外。

sections.description_en:
[Fingers of Gul'dan] will summon Wild Imps near every target.

After casting [Fingers of Gul'dan] Lithiel Cinderfury casts [Demonic Gateway] to escape and then begins casting [Malefic Wave].

[Malefic Wave] slowly expands over a large area inflicting heavy damage along with lingering damage over time.

Players traveling through Lithiel's [Demonic Gateway] are immune to the initial impact and lingering Fire vulnerability from passing through [Malefic Wave].
sections.description_zh:
[古尔丹之指]会在每个目标附近召唤出野生小鬼。

施放[古尔丹之指]后，利希尔·烬怒会开启[恶魔传送门]进行战略撤退，随后开始引导[灾厄浪潮]。

[灾厄浪潮]会在大范围内缓慢扩散，不仅会造成大量初始伤害，还会附带挥之不去的持续伤害。

玩家可以穿过莉希尔留下的[恶魔传送门]，从而在接触[灾厄浪潮]时免疫其造成的初始冲击与残留的火焰易伤效果。

sections.description_en:
•  [Malefic Wave] grants [Malefic Empowerment] to any summoned demons still alive when it passes over them.

•  [Chaos Bolt] inflicts high damage to a random target if not interrupted.
sections.description_zh:
• [灾厄浪潮]在经过任何仍然存活的已召唤恶魔时，会使其获得[灾厄强化]。

• [混乱之箭]若未被打断，会对一个随机目标造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Chaos Bolt] inflicts high damage to a random target if not interrupted.

• Furious Vilefiend inflicts heavy damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [混乱之箭]若未被打断，会对一个随机目标造成大量伤害。

• 狂怒的邪犬会造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Malefic Wave]  applies lingering damage over time when players using Lithiel's [Demonic Gateway] pass through [Malefic Wave].

• Furious Vilefiend inflicts heavy damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [灾厄浪潮]会在使用利希尔的[恶魔传送门]的玩家穿过[灾厄浪潮]时，对其施加持续伤害效果。

• 狂怒的邪犬会造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en: Lithiel summons a vilefiend that attacks players.
sections.description_zh: 利希尔会召唤一只攻击玩家的邪犬。

sections.description_en: Summons a slow but powerful Infernal that fixates onto players.
sections.description_zh: 召唤一个迟缓但强大的地狱火，它会锁定玩家为目标。

dungeons.description_en:
As the ancestral nesting grounds for the five flights, the Ruby Life Pools is a sacred place. The Red Dragonflight, whose charge it is to nuture all life, protect these pools and the the future of all dragonkind held within them.

However, Raszageth and her Primalists have come to steal that future away and infuse their own powers into the sacred pools. They must be stopped for dragonkind to thrive.
dungeons.description_zh:
作为五大巨龙军团的先祖巢穴，红玉新生法池是一片神圣之地。红龙军团负责孕育所有的生命，他们保护着这些法池，也守护着所有龙族的未来。

然而，莱萨杰丝和她的拜荒者们已经到来，他们试图盗走龙族的未来，并将自己的力量注入神圣的法池。只有阻止他们的疯狂行径，才能让龙族茁壮成长。

bosses.description_en: Melidrussa Chillworn leads the Primalist infusion efforts in the Ruby Life Pools. Her fervent belief is that she is protecting young dragon eggs from the influence of the titans and cleansing them from the stain of Order magic. She will stop at nothing to fulfill her calling and return the eggs to what she believes is their natural state.
bosses.description_zh: 梅莉杜莎·寒妆在红玉新生法池领导着拜荒者部队的注能工作。她笃信自己是在保护幼小的龙蛋不受泰坦影响，并能将它们从污秽的秩序魔法中净化干净。她会不惜一切代价地完成使命，力求让龙蛋回归她所认定的自然状态。

sections.description_en:
• [Awaken Whelps] causes many Infused Whelps to swarm the party.
• Melidrussa's Infused Whelps apply [Cold Claws] to their current target until defeated.
sections.description_zh:
• [唤醒雏龙]会唤来大群注能龙崽围攻小队。
• 梅莉杜莎的注能龙崽会不断对当前目标施加[冰寒利爪]，直到被击败。

sections.description_en:
• [Awaken Whelps] causes many Infused Whelps to swarm the party.
• [Chillstorm] and [Hailburst] cause significant damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [唤醒雏龙]会唤来大群注能龙崽围攻小队。
• [霜风]和[冰雹爆裂]会造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Chillstorm] and [Hailburst] cause significant damage.
• Melidrussa's Infused Whelps apply [Cold Claws] to their current target until defeated.
sections.description_zh:
• [霜风]和[冰雹爆裂]会造成大量伤害。
• 梅莉杜莎的注能龙崽会不断对当前目标施加[冰寒利爪]，直到被击败。

sections.description_en:
• [Awaken Whelps] causes many Infused Whelps to swarm the party.
• Melidrussa's Infused Whelps apply [Cold Claws] to their current target until defeated.
• [Frost Overload] becomes deadly quickly unless stopped.
sections.description_zh:
• [唤醒雏龙]会唤来大群注能龙崽围攻小队。
• 梅莉杜莎的注能龙崽会不断对当前目标施加[冰寒利爪]，直到被击败。
• 若不加以阻止，[冰霜过载]会迅速变得极其致命。

sections.description_en:
• [Frost Overload] becomes deadly quickly unless stopped.
• [Awaken Whelps] causes many Infused Whelps to swarm the party.
• [Chillstorm] and [Hailburst] cause significant damage.
sections.description_zh:
• 若不加以阻止，[冰霜过载]会迅速变得极其致命。
• [唤醒雏龙]会唤来大群注能龙崽围攻队伍。
• [霜风]和[冰雹爆裂]会造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Chillstorm] and [Hailburst] cause significant damage.
• [Frost Overload] becomes deadly quickly unless stopped.
• Melidrussa's Infused Whelps apply [Cold Claws] to their current target until defeated.
sections.description_zh:
• [霜风]和[冰雹爆裂]会造成大量伤害。
• 若不加以阻止，[冰霜过载]会迅速变得极其致命。
• 梅莉杜莎的注能龙崽会不断对当前目标施加[冰寒利爪]，直到被击败。

bosses.description_en: As Primalist forces assault the Ruby Life Pools from all sides, it falls to Kokia and her Blazebound lieutenants to capture precious eggs from overwhelmed defenders, all while spreading flame and havoc as they go.
bosses.description_zh: 拜荒者部队从四面八方突袭红玉新生法池时，柯姬雅和她的炎缚军官的使命就是趁守备军难以招架之时，夺取珍贵的龙蛋，并在所及之处散播烈焰和浩劫。

sections.description_en:
Throughout the fight, Kokia alternates between hurling [Molten Boulders] at players and pummeling her target with [Searing Blows].

Upon reaching 100 energy, Kokia performs a [Ritual of Blazebinding].
sections.description_zh:
柯姬雅在战斗中会交替向玩家投掷[熔火巨石]或使用[灼热打击]攻击目标。

当能量达到100点时，柯姬雅会举行[缚焰仪式]。

sections.description_en:
• [Searing Blows] applies additional [Searing Wounds] with each hit.
• [Blaze Volley] inflicts significant damage to all players unless interrupted.
• Blazebound Firestorms from [Ritual of Blazebinding] cast damaging abilities until defeated.
sections.description_zh:
• [灼热打击]每次命中都会施加额外的[灼热伤口]。
• [烈焰狂轰]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害，除非被打断。
• 由[缚焰仪式]召唤的炎缚火焰风暴会持续施放伤害技能，直到被击败。

sections.description_en:
• Blazebound Firestorms from [Ritual of Blazebinding] cast damaging abilities until defeated.
• [Blaze Volley] inflicts significant damage to all players unless interrupted.
• [Molten Boulder] inflicts heavy Fire damage and knocks away any player it hits.
sections.description_zh:
• 由[缚焰仪式]召唤的炎缚火焰风暴会持续施放伤害技能，直到被击败。
• 如果不加以打断，[烈焰狂轰]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。
• [熔火巨石]会造成巨额火焰伤害，并击退被命中的玩家。

sections.description_en:
• [Inferno] inflicts significant damage to all players.
• [Ritual of Blazebinding] inflicts significant damage to the targeted player.
• [Molten Boulder] inflicts heavy Fire damage and knocks away any player it hits.
sections.description_zh:
• [地狱烈火]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。
• [缚焰仪式]会对目标玩家造成大量伤害。
• [熔火巨石]会造成巨额火焰伤害，并击退被命中的玩家。

bosses.name_zh: 基拉卡与厄克哈特·风脉
bosses.description_en: Kyrakka and Erkhart roam the skies above the Ruby Life Pools coordinating attacks on the shrine below, while also taking out any interfering dragons. If left unchecked, they will burn the Life Pools to the ground and blow the remaining ash away in a cleansing elemental storm.
bosses.description_zh: 基拉卡和厄克哈特在红玉新生法池的上空游荡，会对下方神殿发动协同攻击，同时也会消灭任何试图干扰的巨龙。如果不加以控制，他们会将新生法池烧成灰烬，并在净化元素的风暴中吹走剩余的所有灰烬。

sections.description_en:
Kyrakka begins the battle airborne, breathing flames and spitting fire from around the Ruby Overlook, whilst Erkhart intercepts players directly.

Upon either of them reaching 40% health, Kyrakka lands so Erkhart can remount, battling players atop Kyrakka.
sections.description_zh:
基拉卡在战斗开始时位于空中，会在红玉瞭望台周围喷吐炽焰并溅射火花，而厄克哈特则会直接拦截玩家。

当两者中的任何一方生命值降至40%时，基拉卡会着陆，这样厄克哈特就可以重新骑上基拉卡，与玩家继续战斗。

sections.description_en:
•  Erkhart's [Stormslam] inflicts high damage.
•  Kyrakka's [Inferno Spit] denies space with resultant [Flaming Embers].
•  Erkhart's [Winds of Change] push players and Kyrakka's [Flaming Embers].
sections.description_zh:
• 厄克哈特的[风暴猛击]会造成巨额伤害。
• 基拉卡的[烈焰喷吐]会留下[烈焰余烬]，从而压缩走位空间。
• 厄克哈特的[变迁之风]会推开玩家以及基拉卡的[烈焰余烬]。

sections.description_en:
•  Kyrakka's [Inferno Spit] denies space with resultant [Flaming Embers].
•  Erkhart's [Winds of Change] push players and Kyrakka's [Flaming Embers].
•  Erkhart's [Interrupting Cloudburst] interrupts casts.
sections.description_zh:
• 基拉卡的[烈焰喷吐]会留下[烈焰余烬]，从而压缩走位空间。
• 厄克哈特的[变迁之风]会推开玩家以及基拉卡的[烈焰余烬]。
• 厄克哈特的[阻断暴雨]会打断施法。

sections.description_en:
•  Kyrakka's [Inferno Spit] inflicts significant damage to players.
•  Erkhart's [Interrupting Cloudburst] interrupts casts.
•  Erkhart's [Winds of Change] push players and Kyrakka's [Flaming Embers].
sections.description_zh:
• 基拉卡的[烈焰喷吐]会对玩家造成大量伤害。
• 厄克哈特的[阻断暴雨]会打断施法。
• 厄克哈特的[变迁之风]会推开玩家以及基拉卡的[烈焰余烬]。

dungeons.description_en: Centuries ago, Sethraliss, a powerful snake loa, sacrificed herself to stop Mythrax from unleashing his master upon Azeroth. After the battle, her devoted followers transported her remains and built a temple around them while they awaited her rebirth. Now, a dark force stirs within this sacred temple that seeks to twist her power towards nefarious ends.
dungeons.description_zh: 数个世纪之前，强大的蛇神塞塔里斯牺牲了自己，阻止了米斯拉克斯释放其主人的阴谋，拯救了艾泽拉斯。那一战之后，她虔诚的信徒将她的遗体转移到这里，并修建了一座神庙以静候她的重生。现在，有股黑暗的力量在这座神庙中兴风作浪，想要扭曲她的力量来达成邪恶的目的。

bosses.name_zh: 阿德里斯和阿斯匹克斯
bosses.description_en: A pair of powerful sethrak that are blessed by the storm and charged with guarding the temple's entrance.
bosses.description_zh: 一对受到风暴祝福的强大蛇人，受命守卫神庙的入口。

sections.description_en:
Adderis is a fearsome warrior, unleashing deadly electric attacks like his twofold strike [Thunder and Lightning].

Aspix is a relentless caster, creating powerful winds that damage and disrupt.

Adderis and Aspix alternate being [Storm Blessed], which grants them immunity to damage.
sections.description_zh:
阿德里斯是一名极其可怕的战士，能够施展[电闪雷鸣]二连击等致命的感电攻击。

阿斯匹克斯则是一名冷酷的施法者，能够召唤出破坏力极强的狂风来干扰并重创敌人。

阿德里斯和阿斯匹克斯会交替获得[风暴祝福]，使他们免疫伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Storm Blessed] alternates between the sethrak duo which grants damage immunity.
• [Thunder and Lightning] is a two part attack, the first of which inflicts damage divided evenly between players hit.
• [Gale Force] violently pushes players backwards.
sections.description_zh:
• [风暴祝福]会在这对塞塔里斯双子之间不断交替，使其免疫伤害。
• [电闪雷鸣]会进行两段式攻击，第一击造成的伤害将由被击中的玩家均摊。
• [狂风之力]会将玩家猛烈击退。

sections.description_en:
• [Tempest Winds] inflict damage to players upon creation.
• [Thunder and Lightning] is a two part attack, the first of which inflicts damage divided evenly between players hit.
• [Gale Force] violently pushes players backwards.
sections.description_zh:
• [暴风]在生成时会对玩家造成伤害。
• [电闪雷鸣]会进行两段式攻击，第一击造成的伤害将由被击中的玩家均摊。
• [狂风之力]会将玩家猛烈击退。

sections.description_en:
• [Overload] causes Adderis to rapidly inflict additional Nature damage with each attack.
• [Thunder and Lightning] is a two part attack, the first of which inflicts damage divided evenly between players hit.
• [Gale Force] violently pushes players backwards.
sections.description_zh:
• [过载]会使阿德里斯的每次攻击都迅速造成额外的自然伤害。
• [电闪雷鸣]会进行两段式攻击，第一击造成的伤害将由被击中的玩家均摊。
• [狂风之力]会将玩家猛烈击退。

bosses.description_en: Merektha is the product of foul experiments to produce an army of unstoppable beasts. With her clutch of eggs beginning to hatch, this mother is on the hunt for victims to serve as food for her ravenous children.
bosses.description_zh: 米利克萨是禁忌实验的产物，而实验的目的是制造一整支无人能挡的野兽大军。米利克萨的子嗣破壳而出时，这位母亲开始为了她饥饿的孩子们四处猎食。

sections.description_en:
• [Hatch] releases snakes that join the fight.
• Toxic Viper's [Poison Spit] can be interrupted.
sections.description_zh:
• [孵化]会释放出毒蛇并加入战斗。
• 剧毒蝰蛇的[毒素喷吐]可以被打断。

sections.description_en:
• [Hatch] releases snakes that join the fight.
• Toxic Viper's [Poison Spit] can be interrupted.
• [A Knot of Snakes] stuns allies until destroyed or incapacitated.
sections.description_zh:
• [孵化]会释放出毒蛇加入战斗。
• 剧毒蝰蛇的[毒素喷吐]可以被打断。
• [缠绕蛇群]会使盟友陷入昏迷，直到其被消灭或瘫痪。

sections.description_en:
• [Serpentstorm] inflicts significant damage to all players.
• [Burrowquake] damages the party while Merektha [Burrows].
sections.description_zh:
• [毒蛇风暴]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。
• [钻地之震]会在米利克萨[钻地]时对队伍造成伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Serpentstorm] inflicts significant damage to all players.
• [A Knot of Snakes] damages allies while active.
• [Burrowquake] damages the party while Merektha [Burrows].
sections.description_zh:
• [毒蛇风暴]会对所有玩家造成大量伤害。
• [缠绕蛇群]在激活时会对盟友造成伤害。
• [钻地之震]会在米利克萨[钻地]时对队伍造成伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Lightning Bite] inflicts significant damage to Merektha's current target.
• Storm Serpent's [Storm Catalyst] leaves [Lingering Storm] underneath the creature.
sections.description_zh:
• [闪电撕咬]会对米利克萨的当前目标造成大量伤害。
• 风暴飞蛇的[风暴触媒]会在其下方留下[萦绕风暴]。

sections.description_en:
• [Lightning Bite] inflicts significant damage to Merektha's current target.
• Storm Serpent's [Storm Catalyst] leaves [Lingering Storm] underneath the creature.
• [Hatch] releases snakes that join the fight.
sections.description_zh:
• [闪电撕咬]会对米利克萨的当前目标造成大量伤害。
• 风暴飞蛇的[风暴触媒]会在其下方留下[萦绕风暴]。
• [孵化]会释放出毒蛇加入战斗。

bosses.description_en: With the corruption of her temple, Sethraliss' command of lightning has created twisted elementals that roam the sunken chambers. Formed by this aberrant energy, Galvazzt seeks to grow in power by any means.
bosses.description_zh: 随着神庙遭到腐化，塞塔里斯所掌控的闪电催生出了游荡在沉没大厅中的扭曲元素。由这种异常能量成型的加瓦兹特，正不择手段地汲取着力量。

sections.description_en: Galvazzt attempts to accumulate energy with [Lightning Spires]. Players standing between Galvazzt and these spires become [Galvanized], preventing energy from flowing to Galvazzt.
sections.description_zh: 加瓦兹特试图借助[闪电尖塔]积聚能量。站在加瓦兹特与这些尖塔之间的玩家会受到[镀流]效果，从而阻止能量流向加瓦兹特。

sections.description_en:
•  [Lightning Spires] form at targeted locations, inflicting damage and knocking away any players struck.
• Standing between Galvazzt and his [Lightning Spires] prevents Galvazzt from unleashing [Consume Charge].
sections.description_zh:
• [闪电尖塔]会在指定位置形成，对命中的玩家造成伤害并将其击退。
• 站在加瓦兹特与其[闪电尖塔]之间，可阻止加瓦兹特释放[放电]。

sections.description_en:
• Standing between Galvazzt and his [Lightning Spires] prevents Galvazzt from unleashing [Consume Charge].
• [Galvanized] inflicts significant damage to players.
sections.description_zh:
• 站在加瓦兹特与其[闪电尖塔]之间，可阻止加瓦兹特释放[放电]。
• [镀流]会对玩家造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Lightning Spires] form at targeted locations, inflicting damage and knocking away any players struck.
• [Galvanized] significantly increases Physical damage taken.
sections.description_zh:
• [闪电尖塔]会在指定位置形成，对命中的玩家造成伤害并将其击退。
• [镀流]会大幅提高受到的物理伤害。

bosses.description_en: The Heart of Sethraliss is in the grips of a terrible power that seeks to corrupt her. Her avatar must be restored before this evil takes root and she is reborn as a dark loa capable of destroying the whole of Vol'dun.
bosses.description_zh: 一股可怕的力量正掌控着塞塔里斯之心，想要将其彻底腐化。必须在这股邪恶之力完全扎根前拯救塞塔里斯，以免她重生为黑暗洛阿神灵，摧毁整个沃顿。

sections.description_en: Essence Defilers arrive to channel [Defiling Taint] upon the Avatar of Sethraliss until their defeat. As part of their assault, Corrupted Guardians appear whose [Corrupted Lifeforce] can be cleansed to heal the Avatar. Upon removal of [Defiling Taint], Faithless Tormentors fixate on the party's healer and attempt to strike them with [Shadowlash]. The battle ends once players fully restore the Avatar.
sections.description_zh: 精华污染者会成群结队地涌入战场，对塞塔里斯的化身持续引导[污染之秽]，直到被玩家击败。在敌人的这波攻势中，堕落的守护者也会随之参战；你可以净化其留下的[腐蚀生命力]，借此来治愈化身。当[污染之秽]被彻底清除后，无信折磨者将死死盯住小队里的治疗者，并试图用[暗影鞭笞]将其击杀。只要玩家能让化身完全恢复健康，这场战斗便会宣告胜利。

sections.description_en:
• Defeating all Essence Defilers cleanses the Avatar of [Defiling Taint].
• The Avatar consumes [Corrupted Lifeforce] from Corrupted Guardians once purified.
• After damaging Faithless Tormentors, the Avatar [Siphons the Weak].
sections.description_zh:
• 击败所有精华污染者即可清除化身身上的[污染之秽]。
• 化身被净化后，会吞噬堕落的守护者身上的[腐蚀生命力]。
• 对无信折磨者造成伤害后，化身会施放[虹吸弱者]。

sections.description_en:
• The battle ends in victory once the Avatar reaches full health.
• Essence Defilers' [Defiling Taint] and Faithless Tormentors' [Shadowlash] thwart healing.
• The Avatar consumes [Corrupted Lifeforce] from Corrupted Guardians once purified.
sections.description_zh:
• 化身恢复满生命值即可赢得战斗胜利。
• 精华污染者的[污染之秽]和无信折磨者的[暗影鞭笞]会阻碍治疗效果。
• 化身被净化后，会吞噬堕落的守护者身上的[腐蚀生命力]。

sections.description_en:
• Corrupted Guardians inflict significant Physical and Shadow damage with [Tainted Strike].
• The Avatar consumes [Corrupted Lifeforce] from Corrupted Guardians once purified.
• Essence Defilers' [Defiling Taint] and Faithless Tormentors' [Shadowlash] thwart healing.
sections.description_zh:
• 堕落的守护者施放的[污秽打击]会造成大量物理和暗影伤害。
• 化身被净化后，会吞噬堕落的守护者身上的[腐蚀生命力]。
• 精华污染者的[污染之秽]和无信折磨者的[暗影鞭笞]会阻碍治疗效果。

sections.title_zh: 第一阶段：污染者的腐化
sections.description_en: Jakra'zet's allies arrive to prevent healing energy from reaching the Avatar.
sections.description_zh: 加卡泽的盟友赶来，试图阻止治疗能量传递给化身。

sections.title_zh: 第二阶段：折磨者的锁定
sections.description_en: Faithless Tormentors attempt to disrupt the Avatar's restoration.
sections.description_zh: 无信折磨者试图阻挠化身的恢复。

sections.description_en: The battle concludes upon full restoration of the Avatar of Sethraliss.
sections.description_zh: 当塞塔里斯的化身完全恢复时，战斗结束。

dungeons.description_en:
The Blinding Vale sprouted instantly. From within the Lightbloom, rutaani emerged and spread the Lightbloom in their wake.
After the Lightbloom's defeat in Eversong, Orweyna began surgical strikes to keep the Lightbloom in check. But the hideous glare of the Blinding Vale hides a garden where the Lightbloom cultivates new creatures and magic to drive forward their one fanatical imperative. Growth unstoppable.
dungeons.description_zh:
夺目谷是一夜之间突然出现的，光绽芦塔尼从中源源不断地涌出，所到之处光绽随之蔓延。
在永歌森林挫败了光绽后，奥威娜开始通过精准打击来扼制光绽的传播。但夺目谷的险恶之光掩盖了一处秘密花园，光绽就在这里培育新的生物和魔法，只为实现它们唯一的狂热使命：势不可挡的生长。

bosses.description_en: The Lightbloom has suffered a terrible defeat, but like the rutaani it imbues, it changes. These Lightblossomed rutaani fanatically propagate their vicious and invasive garden.
bosses.description_zh: 光绽虽遭惨败，但正如它所浸染的芦塔尼一样，它也在不断演化。这些受光绽影响的鲁塔尼疯狂繁殖着它们那恶毒的、侵略性的花园。

sections.description_en: The trio of Lightbloom rutaani work in tandem to sow and nurture a Lightblossom garden. Meittik creates [Fertile Loam] that is then planted by Lekshi's [Lightsower Dash]. Kezkitt rapidly germinates the flora with [Lightblossom Beam] until they burst in a [Lightbloom Overgrowth].
sections.description_zh: 光绽芦塔尼三人组协同合作，播种并培育光绽花园。梅提克制造[肥沃壤土]，然后由莱克希的[播光急奔]进行种植。科兹齐特用[光明之花射线]迅速催生植物，直到它们因[光绽疯长]爆裂。

sections.description_en:
•  Lightblossoms gain an increasing amount of [Light-Gorged] unless the rays of [Lightblossom Beam] are blocked.
•  Damage taken is shared between the trio with [Thicket's Trinity].
sections.description_zh:
• 光明之花会获得[噬光]层数，除非[光明之花射线]的光线被阻挡。
• 受到的伤害会通过[密林三杰]在三人组之间分摊。

sections.description_en:
•  [Lightbloom Overgrowth] inflicts higher damage based on applications of [Light-Gorged].
•  [Thornblade] causes random players to bleed for high damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [光绽疯长]对玩家造成的伤害会根据[噬光]层数而提高。
• [荆棘之刃]会对随机玩家施加流血效果，造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Lightbloom Overgrowth] inflicts higher damage based on applications of [Light-Gorged].
•  [Thornblade] causes random players to bleed for high damage.
•  [Bedrock Surge] inflicts periodic damage to all players.
sections.description_zh:
• [光绽疯长]对玩家造成的伤害会根据[噬光]层数而提高。
• [荆棘之刃]会对随机玩家施加流血效果，造成大量伤害。
• [基岩涌动]会对所有玩家造成周期性伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Bedrock Slam] creates patches of [Fertile Loam] near the location of the target.
•  Lightblossoms gain an increasing amount of [Light-Gorged] unless the rays of [Lightblossom Beam] are blocked.
sections.description_zh:
• [基岩猛击]会在目标位置附近制造[肥沃壤土]区域。
• 光明之花会获得[噬光]层数，除非[光明之花射线]的光线被阻挡。

bosses.description_en: Ikuzz is a fearsome carnivore who once stalked prey throughout Harandar. Now the Light Hunter has succumbed to the overwhelming power of the Lightbloom, and his insatiable hunger serves its growth.
bosses.description_zh: 伊库兹是可怕的食肉动物，曾经在哈籁恩达尔各地捕猎。如今，这位圣光猎手已屈服于光绽的压抑力量，他永不满足的饥饿，正助长着它的生长。

sections.description_en: Ikuzz entangles players in [Bloodthorn Roots] to immobilize his prey. At 100 energy, he fixates on a player with a [Bloodthirsty Gaze] and attempts to [Incise] them.
sections.description_zh: 伊库兹用[血棘之根]缠绕玩家以固定他的猎物。能量达到100时，他会用[嗜血注视]锁定一名玩家，并试图使其受到[切裂]。

sections.description_en:
•  [Bloodthorn Roots] immobilize players until the roots are destroyed.
•  Players targeted by [Bloodthirsty Gaze] will be [Incised] if Ikuzz reaches their location.
sections.description_zh:
• [血棘之根]会固定玩家，直到根须被摧毁。
• 被[嗜血注视]锁定的玩家，如果伊库兹到达其位置，将会被[切裂]。

sections.description_en:
•  [Bloodthorn Roots] immobilize players until the roots are destroyed.
•  [Thorncaller Roar] channels Nature damage on all players.
•  Players take a high amount of damage when [Incised].
sections.description_zh:
• [血棘之根]会固定玩家，直到根须被摧毁。
• [唤棘者咆哮]会对所有玩家引导自然伤害。
• 当受到[切裂]影响时，玩家会受到大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Bloodthorn Roots] immobilize players until the roots are destroyed.
•  Players targeted by [Bloodthirsty Gaze] will be [Incised] if Ikuzz reaches their location.
sections.description_zh:
• [血棘之根]会固定玩家，直到根须被摧毁。
• 被[嗜血注视]锁定的玩家，如果伊库兹到达其位置，将会被[切裂]。

bosses.description_en: The once-respected Rootwarden Ruia could not defeat the Lightbloom on his own. His wounded pride led him to drawing power from the Lightbloom and using it to punish all others instead of aiding his allies.
bosses.description_zh: 曾经备受尊敬的护根者鲁伊亚无法凭一己之力击败光绽。受伤的自尊驱使着他从光绽中汲取力量，转而用它来惩罚所有其他人，而非援助他的盟友。

sections.description_en: Lightwaden Ruia unleashes his druidic power, shapeshifting between Moonkin and Bear forms. At 40% remaining health, he returns to Haranir form and channels [Spirits of the Vale], casting all his abilities in a rapid flurry.
sections.description_zh: 护光者鲁伊亚释放他的德鲁伊之力，在枭兽和熊形态之间变形。生命值降至40%时，他会变回哈籁尼尔形态并引导[峡谷之灵]，以极快的速度施放他所有的技能。

sections.description_en:
•  [Pulverizing Strikes] launches a cone of Physical damage at each target.
•  [Lightfall] inflicts high damage to players within each impact.
sections.description_zh:
• [粉碎打击]会向每个目标发射一道锥形的物理伤害。
• [光明坠落]会对每次冲击范围内的玩家造成大量伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Grievous Thrash] is only removed when the afflicted target reaches full health.
•  [Pulverizing Strikes] launches a cone of Physical damage at each target.
sections.description_zh:
• [凶残痛击]只有在受影响的目标生命值回满时才会移除。
• [粉碎打击]会对每个目标造成锥形范围的物理伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  In Moonkin form, Ruia's melee attacks are replaced with [Warden's Wrath].
•  [Pulverizing Strikes] launches a cone of Physical damage at each target.
•  [Lightfall] inflicts high damage to players within each impact.
sections.description_zh:
• 在枭兽形态下，鲁伊亚的近战攻击被[守卫之怒]取代。
• [粉碎打击]会向每个目标发射一道锥形的物理伤害。
• [光明坠落]会对每次冲击范围内的玩家造成大量伤害。

bosses.description_en: Born from the Lightbloom's epicenter, Ziekket was spawned and incubated by Light-infested rutaani to create an unstoppable engine of the Lightbloom's expansion.
bosses.description_zh: 兹欧凯特诞生于光绽的中心，由感染了圣光的芦塔尼产卵并孵化而成，其使命，就是成为一个推动光绽扩张的无情引擎。

sections.description_en:
Ziekket will periodically [Awaken the Lightbloom], sprouting Lightspawn Lashers from the earth and awakening any [Dormant] ones.

Surging with the Light's power, Ziekket projects a [Concentrated Lightbeam] at players that annihilates flora and fauna alike.
sections.description_zh:
兹欧凯特会周期性地[唤醒光绽]，使光诞鞭笞者从地下长出，并唤醒任何[休眠]中的鞭笞者。

在圣光之力的涌动下，兹欧凯特向玩家投射一道[凝聚光线]，将动植物一同湮灭。

sections.description_en:
•  [Concentrated Lightbeam] vaporizes [Dormant] Lightspawn Lashers into [Lightsap].
•  Touching globules of [Lightbloom's Essence] inflicts Holy damage while increasing damage and healing done.
sections.description_zh:
• [凝聚光线]会将[休眠]光诞鞭笞者蒸发成[光明树脂]。
• 接触[光绽精华]液球会造成神圣伤害，同时提高造成的伤害和治疗。

sections.description_en:
•  [Lightbloom's Essence] inflicts Holy damage to players, but increases damage and healing done.
•  [Oozing Xylem] continually inflicts Holy damage to all players.
sections.description_zh:
• [光绽精华]会对玩家造成神圣伤害，但会提高造成的伤害和治疗量。
• [渗流木质]持续对所有玩家造成神圣伤害。

sections.description_en:
•  [Thornspike] impales Ziekket's current target.
•  [Awaken the Lightbloom] summons a thicket of vicious Lightspawn Lashers.
sections.description_zh:
• [棘刺]会穿刺兹欧凯特的当前目标。
• [唤醒光绽]会召唤一片灌木丛，引来凶猛的光诞鞭笞者。

dungeons.description_en: The Voidscar Arena awaits worthy challengers! Overseer Charonus has filled the arena with opponents plucked from across Azeroth, forcing them to participate in his games.
dungeons.description_zh: 虚空之痕竞技场虚位以待，静待值得一战的挑战者！监督者煞戎努斯从艾泽拉斯各地掳来无数对手，强迫他们参与自己的竞技场游戏。

bosses.description_en: The domanaar's prized champion, Taz'Rah, is forced to fight against his will. Taz'Rah demands his own death from every opponent, hoping each battle will finally end his suffering.
bosses.description_zh: 塔兹拉尔是多曼纳尔最为珍视的勇士，却被迫违心而战。他向每一个对手祈求赐死，只盼能在一场战斗中终结自己的痛苦。

sections.description_en:
Taz'Rah summons Ethereal Shades that perform [Nether Dash], damaging targets in a line in front of them.

Taz'rah's [Dark Bloom] causes [Void Fissures] to erupt.
sections.description_zh:
塔兹拉会唤出虚空残影，这些残影会施展[虚空冲刺]，对前方直线上的所有目标造成伤害。

塔兹拉的[黑暗绽放]会引爆场上的[虚空裂隙]。

sections.description_en:
• Ethereal Shades periodically cast [Nether Dash] on a random player, damaging targets in a line in front of them.
• [Dark Bloom] causes [Void Fissures] to erupt.
sections.description_zh:
• 虚空残影会周期性地锁定随机玩家施展[虚空冲刺]，重创其正前方直线上的所有目标。
• [黑暗绽放]会引爆场上的[虚空裂隙]。

sections.description_en:
• [Nether Dash] strikes all players in a line and inflicts Shadow damage over a long duration.
• [Dark Bloom] inflicts heavy Shadow damage on all players and causes [Void Fissures] to erupt.
sections.description_zh:
• [虚空冲刺]不仅会贯穿直线上的所有玩家，还会留下持续时间极长的暗影伤害。
• [黑暗绽放]会对所有玩家造成毁灭性的暗影伤害，同时引爆[虚空裂隙]。

sections.description_en:
• [Void Blast] inflicts heavy Shadowstrike damage.
• [Dark Bloom] causes [Void Fissures] to erupt.
sections.description_zh:
• [虚空冲击]会造成巨额暗影打击伤害。
• [黑暗绽放]会引爆场上的[虚空裂隙]。

bosses.description_en: Imprisoned by Charonus, this starving behemoth is hoping for a new victim to sate his appetite. Atroxus's sheer size is almost as dangerous as the poison he spews.
bosses.description_zh: 这头被煞戎努斯囚禁的巨兽饥肠辘辘，渴望着下一个受害者来填饱食欲。阿特洛苏斯的庞大身躯几乎与它喷吐的毒液一样致命。

sections.description_en: Atroxus assaults players with its powerful venoms using [Noxious Breath] and [Poison Splash]. Its [Monstrous Roar] inflicts heavy physical damage to all players summons a Toxic Creeper.
sections.description_zh: 阿特洛苏斯会利用[毒性吐息]和[毒液喷溅]，用强效毒素攻击玩家。它的[巨响咆哮]会对所有玩家造成高额物理伤害，并召唤出一只剧毒蠕行者。

sections.description_en:
• [Noxious Breath] inflicts high damage in front of Atroxus.

• [Monstrous Roar] inflicts heavy physical damage to all players summons a Toxic Creeper to attack its target.
sections.description_zh:
• [毒性吐息]在阿特洛苏斯前方造成高额伤害。

• [巨响咆哮]对所有玩家造成沉重的物理伤害，并召唤一只剧毒蠕行者攻击其目标。

sections.description_en:
• [Hulking Claw] inflicts high Nature damage to the primary target.

• [Noxious Breath] inflicts high damage in front of Atroxus.
sections.description_zh:
• [巨型爪击]对主要目标造成高额自然伤害。

• [毒性吐息]对阿特洛苏斯前方的区域造成高额伤害。

sections.description_en:
• [Hulking Claw] inflicts high Nature damage to the primary target.

• [Sickening Bite] applies stacking vulnerability to Nature damage.
sections.description_zh:
• [巨型爪击]对主要目标造成高额自然伤害。

• [致病撕咬]施加可叠加的自然伤害易伤。

bosses.description_en: The overly confident and ostentatious owner of the Voidscar Arena, Charonus, is impressed by the fighting ability of Azerothians and demands them for his grand collection.
bosses.description_zh: 虚空之痕竞技场的主人煞戎努斯既狂妄自大又极爱排场。他对艾泽拉斯人的战斗能力印象深刻，点名要将他们纳入自己宏大的收藏之中。

sections.description_en: Charonus truly tests his prey to learn their limits. He attacks players using [Unstable Singularity] and creates [Gravitic Orbs] to hunt them down.
sections.description_zh: 煞戎努斯通过真正的试炼来测试猎物的极限。他使用[不稳定的奇点]攻击玩家，并制造[引力宝珠]来追捕他们。

sections.description_en:
• [Unstable Singularity] inflicts Shadow damage and reduces the movement speed of players caught within it.

• [Gravitic Orbs] continually seek out players until collapsed by an [Unstable Singularity].
sections.description_zh:
• [不稳定的奇点]造成暗影伤害，并降低被卷入其中的玩家的移动速度。

• [引力宝珠]会持续寻找玩家，直到被[不稳定的奇点]坍缩。

sections.description_en:
• [Condensed Mass] inflicts high damage to all players.

• [Gravitic Orbs] continually seek out players until collapsed by an [Unstable Singularity].
sections.description_zh:
• [凝缩物质]对所有玩家造成高额伤害。

• [引力宝珠]会持续寻找玩家，直到被[不稳定的奇点]坍缩。

sections.description_en:
• [Unstable Singularity] inflicts Shadow damage and reduces the movement speed of players caught within it.

• [Gravitic Orbs] continually seek out players until collapsed by an [Unstable Singularity].
sections.description_zh:
• [不稳定的奇点]造成暗影伤害，并降低被卷入其中的玩家的移动速度。

• [引力宝珠]会持续寻找玩家，直到被[不稳定的奇点]坍缩。
